4 rīrirwa 4 mu35྅ ne zi dhe — 3༄ —/ — — —44 pyornge — sned+ngha sto d+kusngurko khegechosru pa d+ku /34 byā ñtsa ṅge5 spre r+sā gudzo rno 'irwa go༄kyi ḍa che ji sgo stsa d+kune ༄ —snye'i ༄rka —shātreX tshwasri1 r+ṣa— ri 〉 ri —༷ ri skre 0jurī rīdze+e ju ji — ༄ — — r+pā ༷rdo / ༷2dze pho rīsnyimipa) ༄ ri sta miXbyu4dzejubhe —dzā ji shā rke r+sha d+kud+ngha tre nga tsā ri )—tsho dzo ne+e jitre ༷stohūṃneglibye je3rkeru tho — snye —cho〉sgori—— zhe shesna byusnane+er+pā / —‘geri 5 rīstasgru4cho sgo — zhe— sdod mi tho nga ri sgroju co ṭī+o dzi+o ne/rī ge — —rke ṣ+ṭṛ ji༈ — ri rir+ṣardzi ri ju4 —rāk+shid+ngha— rna3 kātho la sko shā—— ci4cho bi — —spu dh+ra ri༄ two7 ༷ — ༷d+ngha tsho sna— stodze+edābye rkel liri ciṅka ske7༷ tram̐ sto~Xsto rke lco k+ṣ-i0 ༷ 4‘ nesnertsorī skenek+ṣewīrme ṭ+wāṃ 7/ phyo〉 0rtso nge phyadz+remu dhe r+ṣa rdo )cu / zi jucho/ 4 ༄lke d+ku bye rdzotrīsko rtswatsā 5jibye sdelarnyi wī wa zlo nga mi — 4 da ltoXgeji khu ༷stosto lha rketsone+eṭ+wāṃ4 4r+yāliX9 r+sha rkotsa r+ṣathi0sgo

cisna sgrig pa po'i gtam/ slob dpon chen mo dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtsho mchog ni/deng dus bod mi rigs spyi'i gtsug tu mchod pa'i mkhas dbang chen po zhig red/ khong gis sku tshe gang bor rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas la thugs zhen zab bzhes ngos nyams pa sor chud/ ma nyams gong 'phel/ shes rig yar rgyas kyi don du brtse gzigs zol med/ brtson pa lhod med/ gsung dbyangs 'gag med kyis rang nus gang yod phul ba'i bka' drin ni bsam brjod yul las 'das pa zhig red/ lhag par du khong gis nga tshor bzhag pa'i rig gzhung gi shul bzhag rin po che la bltas kyin bltas kyin mos gus mchi ma rab tu 'khrigs/ bsam bzhin bsam bzhin rin thang gzhal du med pa shes/ nga rang tsho mi rigs dpe skrun gyi las ka byed mkhan zhig yin pa'i ngos nas bshad na/ slob dpon chen me 'di ba'i phyag rtsom mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te gsung 'bum cha tshang zhig bsgrigs nas par du bskru na na ni rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas bang mdzod la rin chen nor bu 1

zhig bsnan pa lta bu'i dge mtshan chen po ldan zhing / lar blo gsal gzhon nu'i tshogs la rig pa'i dngos po phun sum tshogs pa zhig mngon par bstabs pa'i phan yon shin tu mi dman pa zhig yod par mthong nas de lugs kyi brtson pa lhur len pa'i 'dun pa drag pyo snying la bcags khar/ nye lam rje nyid kyi sku sring bde mchog skyid dang khong gi yang tsha grwa btsun bslab skesum rgya mtsho zung gis sa thag ring bo'i dka' sdug la ma 'dzems par rje nyid kyi gsung rtsom mtha' dag dre'u khal du longs pa zhig dngos su khur nas rang re'i dpe skrun khang du slebs shing / khyed dpe skrun khang gi rtsom sgrig spus tshad legs pas gzhan su dang gang la'ang ma sprad par khyed cag la gtad pa yin zhes gsung 'bum dpar skrun gyi dngos shugs dbang cha yod tshad nga tshor phul ba dang / khyad par du nged dpe skrun khang la ma dngul gyi 'khos ka zhan pa mthong nas/ gcen po'i gsung 'bum par du btab nas bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas la phyar ba gru 'degs kyi nus pa thon na de las che ba med ces gsungs te gcen rin po che'i brtsams yon skar gcig kyang med pa'i thog da dung gzhan las zhal 'debs dngul sgor khri gnyis tsam bsdus nas gun gsab kyi rogs skyor byas pa la nga tsho sems 'gul chen po dang skul ma lha

po thebs te/ gzhi nas khong gi gsung 'bum cha tshang zhig sgrig pa'i 'char gzhi dngos bstar byas pa yin/da cha nga tshos par du bskrun pa'i gsung 'bum 'di la khyon —bsdoms pod drug tu bkar/ pod dang po ni gtso cher rnam tharoskor yin/ 'di'i nang du nga tshos de snga sus kyang mjal gamyong ba'i mdo smad bstan pa'i bdag po rje bla kho rin po che 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rnam thar lo rgyus mjal thub par ma zad/ rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi byung ba lo rgyus las mkhas chen dam pa zhig thos sbyang gi stobs ga 'dra zhig la brten nasa'atshar longs byung ba'i tshul la rgyus mnga' lon cing rang nyid la sbyang —stobs che ru bskyed pa'i skul ma thebs nges yin/ pod gnyis pa ni gtso cher gzhung 'grel skor te/ 'di'i nang nas rtsom pa po rang nyid nang don rig pa'i mkhas dbang zhig yin pa'i ngos nas deng gi 'chad grwa'i gzhung khrid kyi dka' gnad la dmigs nas tshig don gnyis gsal gyi 'grel bshad gnang yod/ pod gsum pa ni gtso cher lo rgyus skor te/ 'di'i nang du bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas dar tshul gyi lo rgyus sogs bkod yod bas/ nga tshos lo rgyus 'di dag las rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus zhib 'jug gi phul byung grub 'bras mthong thub par ma zad/ mkhas pa gzhan gyi 3

gsung na med pa'i legs bshad btso ma'i gser lta bu'ang mi nyung ba zhig zin rgyu yod do/ /pod bzhi ba ni gtso cher sgra snyan ngag skar rtsis kyi skor yin/ 'di'i nang du slob dpon 'di bas srol rgyun rig gnas kyi bslab bya so so rgyas bsdus 'tsham zhing go bde ba'i lam nas bkral yod pas las dang po ba rnams la nye bar mkho zhing 'jug bde ba'i gnas dam pa zhig tu 'khums so/ /pod lnga ba ni gtso cher sum rtags dag gsum skor yin/ 'di'i nang nas nga tshos rtsom pa po'i deng rabs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i brda sprod kyi gzhung lugs dang lta ba gsar ba/ lag len gyi rin thang ldan zhing nye bar mkho ba'i bshad pa gsar ba shes rtogs byed thub pa yin/ pod drug pa ni gsung thor bu'i skor te/'di'i nang nas nga tshos rtsom pa pos gdul bya'i blo gang la gang 'tsham du sbyar ba'i shes bya sna tshogs/ dri ba dris lan/ chab shog sogs mjal thub la/ gsung tsag tsig la snang chung mi byed par zhib tu bklags na ni bye ma'i gseb nas gser rdo rnyed pa lta bu'i dga' snang skye'ang srid do/ /mdor na/ khong gi gsung 'bum la brjod don zab kyang tshig 'grel gsal ba/ rig pa'i gnas la 'jug pa'i las dang po ba rnams kyi blor 'tsham zhing go sla ba/ gnas lnga rig pa'i 4

snying bcud 'dus shing 'jug bde ba/ shes ldan rgan pas bklags na blo skyed gsar ba thob pa/ a gsar gzhon nus bklags na mos gus dbang med 'chor ba'i yon tan gyi mdzod chen po zhig yin pas/ rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi dge ba'i bshes dang brtse ba'i grogs su gyur cig gu/ /zhes 'di ga'i rtsom sgrig khang nas/5 spyi lo1996zla8tshes3la phul/—

dkar chag rluzhu dad sko/ sdod spyizhi sko rgyurga buzhad pu/dang bo/ snod bcud chags tshul/ — — ( 6 )gnyis pa/ bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal bo gnya' khri btsan po/ — (13〉gsum pa/ gnam gyi khri bdun sogs/ (20)bzhi ba/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan sogs/ te (26)lnga ba/ rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po/ ske (32〉/ (gcig)'khrungs spyol dang khrir bzhegosaskor/ ‘32〉(gnyis)rang gis ge 'bri ba'i 56ba bstode tshul/ rjo34)(gsum)rgyal bo srong btsan gyis khrims gtane la phasge pa'i skor/ ske — (45〉(bzhi) btsun dang jo tho rdom gnyispospyan drangs pa sogs/ 4 (52)

drug pa/ mang srong mang btsan sogs/ (65)bdun pa/ khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom dang sras 'khrungs pa'i skor/ (72)brgyad pa/ khri srong lde btsan gyi skor/ (77)dgu ba/ mu ne btsan po dang sad na legs kyi skor/ (84)bcu ba/ khri ral dang dar ma sogs kyi skor/ (88)bcu gcig pa/ bod sil bur gyur pa sogs/ (95)bcu gnyis / pa/ sa skya ba'i lo rgyus/ (105〉bcu gsum pa/ phag gru ba'i lo rgyus/ (120)bcu bzhi ba/ rin spungs pa'i lo rgyus/ (142)bco lnga ba/ sde srid gtsa nga ba'i lo rgyus/ (148)bcu drug pa/ dga' ldan pho brang ba'i lo rgyus/ (152) rgyal dbang sku phreng dang bo/ (152〉rgyal dbang skuphreng gnyis pa/ (153〉rgyal dbang sku sbeng gsum pa/ (155)rgyal dbang sku zeng bzhi ba/ 〈162)rgyal dbang sku phreng lnga ba/ (166)rgyal dbang sku zeng drug pa/ (187)rgyal dbang sku zeng bdun pa/ (205)rgyal dbang skya preng brgyad pa/ / (222)3

rgyal debang sku phreng dgu ba/ (232)rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu ba/ (234nyirgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gcig pa/ (235〉rgyal dbang skya phreng bcu gnyis pa/ ri (239〉rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa/ (250)rgyal dbang sku zeng bcu bzhi ba/ (274)rlu'u gnyis pu/ nado snade kyi dza rgyug pye brag tu buzhad pu/ spyi'i gnas tshul gleng ba/ (279)dang bo/ mdo smad kyi lo rgyus las tsong kha'i rgyal bo'i skor/ (282)gnyis pa/ mdo smad kyi lo rgyus las gling ge sar gyis dbang bsgyur tshul/ ༷ (288)gsum pa/ mdo smad kyi lo rgyus las mgo log sogs kyi skor/ ༷ (294)bzhi ba/ mdo smad kyi lo rgyus las rgyal rong gi skor/ (326)lnga ba/ mdo smad kyi lo rgyus las zung chu'i phyogs kyi lo rgyus/ ri (369)thod du nig gnas dar tshuzha nadon brastus brazhad pu/ (384)bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs su bod du rig gnas dar zu

tshul/ (385)bsta na pa phyi dar gyi skabs su bod du rig gnas dar tshul/ (424)bod kyi rig gnas rgya yul du dar tshul/ (455)bod kyi rig gnas sog yul du dar tshul/ snye (458)snyag tsha bukra giska choska buzwad oṃja gi gdan rabusu don ldan lhazhi rdolka rgo zhes byu bu brazhugs sro/ / (464)sa bcad dang bo/ dgon bdag rnams kyi lo rgyus skor/ (464)sa bcad gnyis pa/ chos sde'i lo rgyus skor/ (539 )rgyazha dge dgon gyi byud nimā gzher gyi rnga sko chezhas byu bu zhazhugs sgo (573)rgyalka dge dgon zhapri shrīska rabu zhartan l+līd gi byud nimā nadon bstuska/ (608)bod kyi snan rig byud tshuzha nador busturga/ (612)gabra tshig dad khed gahaṃspe kyi khyid pur brarnod pu drad sprod tshadaspe zhig ces py-i zha/ (622)ka gi zhazhi daden gtan/ (630)4 rī

sgon tshig bud bu rgan pozhi gargog sgra/ (641 〉skesnadwags pozhi sgri nigaska gyi gnad don skor/ (644)/ bheskedwags pozhi mi nigs kyai skon ska lta stangaska buzhad pu/ (663)ngo sprod sdon du/ (668)rā mā ṇazhi rtogag darnod zharga sdon du smyed bun bya da/ (674)k+shid ged chen gyi byud bu nadon busdurga/ ji (681 )bradhu sdog non bruzhi thod zhen/ (713)nun gelka sgron ma/ (732)nado snad tsod sazhi thod rgyulka rdo snas samā rgyalka snas n+dan buzhi p+lu rgyus nadz+wan busduska/ (761)skod kyai zho rgyus dad spyi tshogaska skon ragarga tsamā sped bra/ (769)rtugs ne+e chen pozhi dza rgyasajinadon dastuska pud dkar chun po/ (811)spyi non zhun tshogs zheska py-i bu brazhugs sro/ (816)zlu ne+en myom sgrig dag gi zhu bu/ (860)rkan pozhi snyid gtan/ (868)

྅smo ma rtswa — cichi/ ri / e ge mraci su ri rtsod lged+ngha /snane d+ku dze5 tsu snye dzo nisnye ha ri ca snye / smi ji ci na r+sha za ma ṭa k+ṣi k+taci 'e rtso ru dzo / rkuspyo7 /lasdo snye byu cicho be+e smosga phu ra ti sma/ ci— nya snyesnyosnyesnyo 5snye sne rdzo ri ci

lnge zuri sdernamaske sgo / — 33 haṃ smud 1re— /sau /nesbi/5 5 slo5snye rwa ldo smur+ṣa1spu/ spe/spe 5 ske rko bīshilha3 snyopaṃlcish+laur+ṣa r+ṣa shaṃ sdotshosnye wo5snye 〉 pa'izhu rte kyusmre ྾ ri / 'i myu ze macisgrusna5 ṭ+wāṃ sna r+sā rtsi smo rke r+sā r+ṣa stse blu ’ ca 5 r+yā rmi cha r+sha ༅༅/rnge tshoshā/ stetso/ dro ny-iḥ su ñtshorta dha r+shango/ rī rla 'i māṃ/zhunyuldi /bdan+d+ra gtim sa pyo'ad snang 'gum bsngolngo ཿiholke+o /༄ 3 tsani+o sde2 dze2 ’ tshohūṃ 2 zheza na shrīnu ru ma k+ṣi ma tshwa— ma shī sgyu7 cha ཿ sgro 6 khri gli 1 zaḥ sa kroḥ shu rka raḥ dra ci 8 sru waṃXṣālha shā ra ṇan //snyirdzi citsābs gakau smag tso sakho'arjalo mjad pa/ra ‘ / /smotsho7spadzñashā / 2 2 : ske 2ri snyesnye 2 / 2༷ sali spe mji snga mi ma ma ma (khu ma 4 za snad+ku mai sa' r+sāri lho spre nari ya sa r+ṣa sau snasnyedre//mdi me+e na yaḥsko༅tsho rnamaṭatshin sum̐b pamelcospyogagayonama' spre sa/ /3— / 3 rto rnye /sa 2 3 re 2 3 bheza d+dha 'eri 'ichi sna 5 ri gle ji za cha ma rmi pho be+e sa rmi / 'i dzo sa rngaritrarirmā u lha ā ོsa rnga /gtanabad ma neg nya du ga'adum da/ —/

bden gtam chos kyi 'od snang 'bum bgye bas/ /rdzun gtam smag rum stug po 'joms mdzad pa/ /rnam 'dren thub pa mchog sogs rnam 'dren rnams/ /gtan bde ma reg bar du gtan du mchod/ /mkhyen pa'i mkha' la thos pa'i sprin bsags nas/ /mdo rgyud legs bshad dbyangs kyi g.yu 'brug sdir/ /lo rgyus smra ba'i ljags dmar glog zhags che/ /rkyong mdzad mkhas dbang ma tha' dag phyag gi yul / /bsil ldan khams su chags pa'i mun pa'i dgra/ /chos srid nyi zla zung gi 'od spro ba/ /rgyal blon lo paṇa mkhas grub klu dbang 'bum/ / —gangs ljongs mtsho chen rgyas pa'i dpyid du shar/ /de yi byung ba gzugs brnyan gzigs mo 'bum/ /3

yongs su shar ba'i kun dga'i me long zhig /lo rgyus rig pa smra ba'i mkhas gral du/ /snyeg 'dod gzhon nu dga' ba'i skyes su 'bul/ /ji skad du/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/shar rdo rje gden gyi byang phyogs na/ /gnas pur rgyal bod ces bya ba yod/ /ri mthon po gnam gyi ka ba yod/ /mtsho dma' mo g.yu yi maṇa ḍal yod/ / gangs dkar bo shel gyi mchod rten yod/ /spang ser bo gser gyi lhun po yod/ /dri zhim po sman gyi bdug spos yod/ /ston bkra ba gser gyi me tog yod/ /dbyar bkra ba g.yu yi me tog yod/ / kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /gnas de na khyod kyi zhing khams yod/ /zhing de— na khyod kyi gdul bya yod/ /ces bsngags pa'i pur rgyal bod ces bya ba'i zhing khams kyi zilo rgyus mdor bsdus te brjod par bya'o/ / 4

le'u dang bo/ bod spyi'i lo rgyus bshad pa / dad bro/ sdod buskyod chagaska spyo lu/ de yang bod yul 'di ni sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sangs rgyas pa'i gnas rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogaso su yod la/ ljongs 'di'i phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang / nang bcud kyi sems can gnyis ka gna' ches snga mo zhig nas chags shing / ming la'ang 'dod rgyal gyi ming bod ces pa ches snga mo zhig nas 'bod pa yin te/ deb ther dmar bo gsar ma las/ lung rnam 'byed dang /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sogs su bod ces mang du byung bas/ bdage rtswag gi ston pa shāspya thub pa 'jig4 rten du byon pa'i dus las yul dang mi gnyis ka ches snga bar cha gas pa zhig snang / zhes gsungs pa rdon la gnas so/ /tshul 'dz+wa la ni bod kyi lo rgyus smra ba'i mkhas dbang phal mo che mgrin gcig yin te/ nel ba paṇa ḍi ta/ stag tshang lo tsā ba/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa /5

'gos lo gzhon nu dpal sogs kyis/ bod kyi yul 'di rgya gar dang 'dra bar yul dang mi la sogs pa gnas pa'i bskal pa nas byung ba byas na yang / lung dang rigs pas gnod pa med ces ga sungs so/ / yul 'dir ri lung chags nas mi'i 'gro ba ma chags pa'i sngon du/ ri lung thams cad chus gang nas yod par bshad/ de rjes chu 'khyil sa'i yol go rnams kyi kha shor te chu rnams rgya mtshor bzhur ba'i shul du rim gyis rtsi shing nags tshal rgyas/ de nas rim gyis srog chags dag grub pa yin te/ stod mnga' ris kyi cha ni glang bo che dang ri dwags kyi yul/ bar dbus gtsang gi cha ni ri dwagayodang spre'u'i yul/ smad mdo khams kyi cha ni spre'u dang brag srin gyi yul du gyur to/ / de yang stod g.ya' ri dang brag ri/ bar brag dang spang ljongs/ smad rtsi shing dang nags tshal gyi yul du gyur nas lo ches mang b.radzo mi'i 'gro ba med la/ yang stod mnga' ris skor gsum gyi sa 'di gangs dang g.ya'i ra ba yo da pas rdzing dang 'dra 6bar bshad/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi yod sa 'di brag dang chu 'thab sa yur ba dang 'dra bar bshad/ smad mdo khams sgang drug gi sa 'di nags dang na'i ljongs zhing dang 'dra bar bshad do/ /6

sngongs 'dir mi'i 'gro ba chags tshul ni/ gna' chis snga mor yul dbus gtsang gi phyogs spra dang spre'us gang ba'i dus shig tu lho kha sne gdong gi phyogs kyi brag mgon po'i ri la gnas pa'i spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las sprel phrug mang du 'phel ba las rim 7gyis mir gyur pa'i rgyud las byung zhing /sprel phrug rnams narigs tshal du gnas te shing thog gi 'tsho ba byas nas bsdad pas mang du 'phel/ bar skabs shig nas gzhung gi chu rnams bzhur ba'i shul du spang gzhongs rgya chen po byung / spang gzhongs de dag tu/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ bra bo/ so ba rnams rgod skyes kyi 'bru rigs 'khrungs pa la ma rmos pa'i lo thog zer/ spre'u rnams rim gyis spang gzhongs su 'ongs nas rgod skyes kyi 'bru rigs rnams la longs spyad/ rim gyis spu je thung dang rnga ma yang je thung la song ba dang chabs cig rig pa'i 'char sgo yang ye cher gyur/ skabs shig naspornga ma med cing lus kyi spu yang gyi nas mi'i 'gro bar gyur te/ deb ther mkhas dga' las/ ‘‘lo tog zos phas de kun mi nyid gyur/ /ma rmos 'bru za gos sushing lo gyon/ /nags na ri dwags lta bur gnas pa yin/ /’mizhertswagasungs so/ /rtsed thang gi mgon po'i ri ni spre'u de dag gnas yul gyi ri nags tshal snag po can yin pa dang / rtsed thang zhes 7

pa'i sa cha sdi ni sprel phrug rnams thang du bab nas rtsed sa yin pa'i stabs kyis rtsed thang zhes grags pa dang / thang de'i sa zhing ni spre'u rnams kyis sa bon btab ste 'bru rigs 'khrungs skabs/ phan tshun zo dang zhes pa'i mi'i skad smra shes par gyur pas/ zhing de la zo dang zhing zer ba dang / zhing la snga ba zo dang zhing zhes grags pa dang / de nas yar lung khog mi yul du gyur stabs/yul la snga ba yar lung sog ka zhes grags so zer ro pha rigs rnams 'char sgo myur zhing snying rje che ba/ khog grim pa/ ma rigs rnams gdong dmar sdig las la rngam zhing ro gyong ba/ de dag las rim par 'phel bas bod yul 'di mi'i rgyal khams su gyur te/ rus chen bzhi las gyes pa'i khams ni/ye sang dkar bo gnam gyi 'ju thag can dang gcig ye smon nag po khro chu'i pha bong 'dra ba dngasaganyis/ spyang khrig ye shes lha'i sgron me dang gsum/ mon rdzu nag po khyi'i rnga ljang can dang bzhir dbye ba byung ngo / /zhes sngon gyi dus su grags so/ /yang rtsa ba'i rus chen bzhi ni/ sde dge rgyal bo'i lo rgyus las/ ‘‘bod chen cayongs kyi 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /sga 'bru spra gdong bzhi las chad mod kyang / / zhes sga/ 'bru/ sbra/ gdong bzhi drangs 'dug rgya bod yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed las/ ‘‘nang gi 8

rigs bzhi ni/ stong dang / ldong dang / sī dang / rmu rnams te— 'di bzhi bo las bod mi phal che ba gyes par bshad pas 'di rnams rus kyi phyi mo'o/ /’’zhes bshad 'dug yang de las/ bod kyi rus mi'u gdung drug la/ dbra/ 'bru/ ldo5 / sga/ nu bo/ dbas brda dang drug drangs yod/ sde srid bai ser las/ dga'/ ldong / 'bru/ dbra/ne bo/ dpal dang drug drangs 'dug sde srid g.ya' sel las /swe/ mu/ stong / ldong /ji dbra/ 'bru dang drug drangs 'dug deb ther mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ bod kyi mi bu rigs bzhi zhes/swe dang / rmu dang ldong / stong gi rigs bzhi byung bar grag cing /yang dbra dang 'dru bsnan nas mi bu rigs drug tu'ang grag go zhes gsungs 'dug 'di dag la yi ge 'bri lugs mi mthun pa 'byung ba ni/ sngar bod rang gi yi ge 'bri ba'i srol ma dar gong du ngag thog nas sgra tsam brjod pa de/ phyis su bod yig 'bri srol dar ba'i skabs sgra de nyid yig thog tu phab lugs mi 'dra bar gyur pa yin te/ dper na/ sga la da dga' dang / sa sga gnyis ka 'byung ba dang / sbra la da dbra dang sa spra gnyis ka 'byung ba dang /ldong la ga gdong dang la ldong gnyiloka 'byung ba lta bu mang ste/gling ge sar gyi sgrung du smug po gdong gi mi rgyud ces bris pa mang la/ mi'u gdung drug gi rus mdzod nang du smug po ldong gi rgyud 9

pa zhes bris pa lta bu'o/ / rus chen bzhi 'dren tshe/ stong dang sga gnyis gcig tu byas te sga zhes 'dren pa dang / swe dang spra gnyis yang gcig par gsungs pas sbra zhes gcig tu 'dren pa yin la/ de ltar byas tshe/ rus chen bzhi ni/ sga 'bru sgra snyogadong bzhi'am/ sga 'bru smra ldong bzhi zhes 'dren ba yin snang / mdo khams stod smad du sga 'bru'i rigs mang la/ sbra rigs kyang rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi mi lta bu dang / ldong rigs kyang gling ge sar gyi mi rgyud da lta yod pa dang mdo stod smad kun tu yod de/ rus mdzod las/ 'gag dog mo gsum po spra yis bzung / /spra dpa' rtsal che ba de don yin/ /zhes dang / ri mthon po gsum po gdong gis bzung / /gdong zhwa mgo mtho ba de don yin/ /zhes zer ba lta bu yin la/mdo khams kyi lo rgyus skabs su 'bri'o/ /bod kyi mi'i rigs kyi byung tshul sogs ni/ srong btsan sgam po yan du yi ger bkod pa med la/ srong btsan sgam pos sngon gyi bshad rgyun dag pa rnams yi ger bkod de chud mi za ba'i phyir ji gter du sbas pa bka' chemasazubaka' khol ma dang / ma ṇi bka' 'bum sogs ji snyed cig yod pa rnams/ yi ge rgyun 'byams dang drung yig sogs kyis gris bshus sna tshogs kyi dbang 10

gis 'dra min 'ga' re mchis mod/ don gyi dgongs pa'i khog gcig yin stabs/ spre'u dang brag srin mo lhan cig tu 'dus pa'i phru gu gdong dmar sha zan gyi rigs su bshad pa ni/ yab mes dag gi bshad rgyun yang dag pa red do/ /des na spre'u mir gyur te mi'i 'gro ba chags pa ni snga la/ lha las phul byung gi bstod pa'i 'grel ba shes rab go chas mdzad pa las gsungs pa ltar/ rtsod ldan thog ma'i skabs/ skyabs seng bu lnga'i dmag 'khrug byung nas/: g.yu/la bkyes pa'i charu pa ti bya ba'i rgyal bo g.yul las pham nas dpung tshogs gcig dang bcas bud med kyi cha lugs su byas te bros nas/ ri kha ba can gyi khrod du zhugs te gnas pa'i rigs la bod ces grags pa yin gsungs pa ltar/gnyug mar gnas pa'i sprel rigs kyi mi'i steng du de dag las 'phel ba'i rigs kyang yod de/ rdog rabs gsal ba'i me long las/5bod kyi gtam rgyud dag las spre'u snang brag srin mo las 'phel ba dag ni zur du shes la/ rdog 'di rgya gar nas chad pa yin te/ de yang rtsod dus steng nas ring zhig lon pa na/ rgya gar du rgyal bo yul 'khor skyong gi sras g.yulangor brtan pa/ zhes —sam/ dgra ngan zhes kyang bya ba dpung tshogs bcu gnyis sam/lha las phul byung gi bstod pa'i 'grel bar dpung tshogs bco 11

brgyad zer ba/ rgyal bo skyabs seng gi bu lnga/ tsha bo dang drugakhyab 'jug dang bdun gyis bcom nas/ dgra ngan gum pa'i tshe dgra ngan gyi chab srid nyams/ skyabs seng gi bu mnga' ris su yod pa la/ rgyal bo hrūpa ti zhes bya bsadang / blon po rdog gi mgo byas/ mi stong phrag gcig bud med kyi chas su zhugs nas/ri gangs can gyi gseb tu bros pa las 'phel lo/ /rdog gi rgyud pa 'di mdo khams shar tsong kha'i yul dang nye ba na/ rdog gi sde che bar chags so/ / ri’zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skyabs seng gi phyis kyi bu rgyud cig yin par snang / mi rgyud de ni phyis su byung bar gsal la/ rdog gi mi rgyud 'di do n+de/da kyi rnga ba dang dmu dge sogs su'ang yod/ 'on kyang rdog gi yi ge dbu can 'bri tshe da dang nga gnyis nor nas/ rdog nyi ma seng ges mdzad pa'i gze ma ra mgo la rngog gi gze ma ra mgo dang / rdog ar ya de ba la rngog ar ya de ba zhes bris pa dang / 'don pa mang la de bzhin du dbu can gyi nga dang da nor ba mang ste/ dper na/brda rnying gi shi dge/ 'dad btang zhes pa yi ge ma dag pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ deng sang 'dang btang zhes 'bri mkhan yod pa lta bu'o/ /der ma zad de las gzhan pa'i mi rigs las chad pa'i rigs kyang yod nges so/ /12

de ltar sprel rgyud las byung ba'i mi dag thog mar shing thog dang rgod skyes 'bru rigs dang rngon byermod pa sogs kyis 'tsho zhing rim gyis zhing 'brog gi las kyang dar nas sde shog gi lam lugs sogs dar zhing / phyi nas 'ongs pa'i chos lugs 'ga' re'ang byung ba 'dra zhing dar khyab ma byung bar mngon/ 'on kya4/ lha mchod 'dre mchod byed mkhan dag la ni bon zhes 'bod par snang lta/ datheron/ deng dus su'ang gto chog mdos chog byed pa lo bon byed ces gzhung du mar gsungs 'dug pa bzhin no/ /gahaṃska bu/ brod spyi lu dbud buzhi nulu bro gnyazha shā 2tsan rdo/ bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal bo'i thog ma ni gnya' khri btsan po yin te/ rgyal bo la snga ba gnya' khri btsan po zhes grags jiso/ /rgyal bo 'di spyi lo zug pa'i thog ma shing ltag lor 'khrungs par bshad/ de'i sngon rim gyis sde shog gi dbang sgyur dag rgyal phran chung ba'am rgyal phran sil ma'i lam lugs su gyur te/ sngon gyi lo rgyus dag las/ ma sangs spun dgus dbang bsgyur ba dang / rgyal phran nyi shu rtsa lnga/ sil ma bzhi bcu/ yang rgyal phran bcu gnyis kyisadabang bsgyur bar bshad pa ltar la/ tha ma'i rgyal phran bcu gnyisapo yang gcig gi 'og la gcig ma sgur bar phan tshun mi mthun 13

par 'thab rtsod kyis dus 'da' bas/ 'bangs la'ang dka' tshegs byung bar mngon te/ deb ther mkhas dga' las/ ‘‘rgyal phran de rnams 'thab rtsod gsod gcod dga'/ /legs nyes mi rtsi bkyon 'be+ebs btson rar 'ju ga mices dang / lde'u jo sras kyis masdod pa'i lo rgyus las kyang / ‘‘dus de tsam na rgyal phran bcu gnyis kyis dbang byed pa la rgyal phran che ba ma 'chams (che tsho ba'am gtso bo gang byed ma 'chams pa'i don)nayo bogaskya rje saujid+nghabatub pa'i dus su zhang gsum bon bzhi la sogs ba dang / shes pa mkhan mi bcu gnyis kyis/ mchid bgros nas rje btsal te/ mizhes gsungs pa ltar lo rgyus gzhan dag tu'ang yod do / /gnya' khri btsan po'i yab la bshad tshul mi mthun pa du ma zhig yod mod/ mang bos bkur ba'i rgyal rgyud yin pa ban bon gyi yig cha khungs dag rnams mthun la/ de yang mang bos bkur ba'i rgyal bo'i rgyud las byurdo ba'i rgyal bo dmag brgya ba'i sras yin par deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i slu dbyangs sogs su bshad pa bzhin/ gleng gzhi bstan pa'i 'byung khungs khyung bo blogros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa las/ (bon gzhung )yamatho thog mdzod dang / zhi khro rtsa 'grel dang gzhan sde'i lung kha cig mthun par/u rgyan gyi rgyal bo dmag brgya ba'i sras yin par gsungs so ’zhes 14

dang / yang de las/ ‘‘byams ma'i rgyal rabs las/ skyabasau seng gi bu yin par bshad do/ /’ zhes dang / lde'u jo sras kyis mdzad pa'i lo rgyus las/ ‘‘gsang ba rgyal bo las chad pa ltar na/gdung rgyud rigs gsum las/ che ba shākya chen po/ 'bring bo li tsa byi/ chung ba ri brag pa gsum las/ chung ba las dmag brgya ba'am skyabs seng las chad par 'dod do/ / ’zhes gsungs pa ltar la/ gong gi de gsum skutshomached kyi rigs su bshad pas 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyi lung bstan las4‘li tsa byi yi rigs su 'khrungs’’ga sungs pa dang yang mthun no/ /gnya' khri btsan po bod du byon lugs ni/ rgyal bo dmag brgya ba la sras mig mas 'gribs su yod pa g.yu'i smin ma can tshute/ g.yu mdog can/ so dung so 'khor mar yod pa/ lag pa 'khor lo'i yan lag can te ngang ba ltar 'brel ba/ rna ba la g.yung drung yod pa zhig 'khrungs pa yab kyis mthong nas/ lha 'dre'i sprul ba'am ltas ngan red snyam nas/ blon po dag la chur smyur cig ces bka' bsgos pas/ blon po rnams kyis sgam gyi nang du bcug nas chur 'phangs pa chus khyer nas/ yangs pa can gyi zhing ba rnams kyis zhing chu 'dren pa'i rka nang nas rnyed de kha phyes pas byis pa rigs mi 'dra ba zhig yod pa/ ngo mtshar 15

skyes te blangs pa yul 'khor skyong gi dmag sdes thob kyang zer/gang ltar cher skyes nas kho rang chu rka'i nang nas rnyed pa'i lo rgyus dang / sngon gyi dmag 'khrug gi lo rgyus la sogs pa ba shad pa'i rkyen gyis khyim la skyo ba skyes nas 'khor 'ga' zhig bcas yul gzhun du 'khyams/ mthar 'khor glu bu 'dzin mched drug dang bcas bod yul ri mtho la sa gtsang zhing bsil bar mthong nas der phebs te/ lha ri gyang tho'i rtse la slebs te gzigs pas/ yar lung gi yul 'di gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba/ yar lha sham po'i gangs ri 'di mdzes shing lta na sdug par mthong ste/lha ri rol bo'i rtse la gshegs nas/ btsan thang sgo bzhir bab pa'i skabs su/ bod 'bangs shes rig gsal ba rnams rgyal phran dag ma 'chams pa'i 'thab rtsod sogs la skyo zhing / bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal bo dbang thang can zhig yod na snyam du gleng mol mchid bgros byed bzhin pa yin te/ lde'u jo sras kyis mdzad pa'i bsgrags pa bon lugs bshad pa'i skabs las/ ‘‘rgyal phran che ba ma 'chams nas bod kyi rje ma btub pa'i dus su/ zhang gsum bon bzhi la sogs pa dang / shes pa mkhan mi bcu gnyis kyis/mchid bgros nas rje btsal te/ ’’zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /de nas yon tan can gyi mi bcu gnyis kyis gnas der phyugs skyong 16

zhing bsdad yod pa dang 'phrad/ gzugs byad ltanubs chog mi shes par mthong nas ngo mtshar skyes te khyed gang nas 'ongs dris kyang / khong 'khor dang bcas pas bod skad mi go stabs/ gnam la mdzub mo ker bas/ 'di ni gnam las bab pa'i lha red do zer 'ing / 'di ni bod kyi rgyal bor 'os zer nas shing gis khyogs shig bzos te gnya' bar khur nas gdan drangs/ bod 'bangs thams cad kyis lha las chad pa'i ngo mtshar can du bzung ste thams cad kyis bkur sti zhus shing rgyal bor bkur bas dbang thang cher gyur te rgyal phran bcu gnyis dbang du bsdus/ thog maraganya' bar khri bcas nas gdan drangs pas/ mtshan la gnya'akhri btsan por gsol/ pho brang yu bu bla mkhar brtsigs/ rgyal bol snga ba gnya' khri btsan po/ yul la snga ba yar lung sog ka grong la snga ba phying ba stag rtse/ rimakhar la snga ba yu bu bla mkhar zhesagrags pa byung ngo / / de'i skabs su khong gis dbang du bsdu bya'i rgyal phran bcu — gnyis ni/ mchims rje (tun hong du no'u)'gu yod ces bya ba la blon po snang dang ding zhes pas byas pa dang gcig zhang zhung yul na rje legs snya shur zhes bya bar blon po rma dang ra sangs (tun hong du stong los ma tse) kyis byas pa dang gnyis/ 17

myang ro phyed dkar storje thod dkar zhis bya ba ldoblon po—gnang zhes pas byas pa dang gsum/ gnubs yudzigling dgu narnarje dmigs pa (tun hong du gnub rje sris ma)zhes bya bar blon po snyermi'u dang 'brotrezhes pas byas pa dang bzhi/ nyang ro sham por rje lo rngam rdzi 'grom (tun hong du 'o ma gyi) zhes bya ba la blon po shes nyis nes pas byas pa dang lnga/ kyi ri ljon (tun hong du ljang )sngonan rje kyi rje rmang bo nes bya ba la blon po ngam dang 'bro (tun hong du she'u dang sug gnyis) zhes pas byas pa dang drugangam shod khra snar (tun hong du ngas po'i khra sum)zhes rje khri 'phrang sum zhes bya ba la blon po mgar dang gnyan zhes pas byas pa dang bdun/ 'ol phu spang mkhar du rje zing rje thon greng (tun hong du 'ol rje'i zin brang tsha) zhes bya ba la blon po rdog dang sbas (tun hong du rngo dang dbas ) zhes pas byas pa dngatshu brgyad/ sribs yul gyi ral gong du rje brang rje gong nam zhes bya ba la blon po sprad zhugs zhes pas byas pa dang dgu/ kong yul khre sna na rje kar po tug ces bya ba la blon po mkhar ba zhes pas byas pa dang bcu/ nyang yul rnam gsum na rje nyang btsun glang rgyal zhes bya ba la blon po phug dang ngo rje zhes pas byas pa dang bcu gcig 'gas yul gru bzhi na rje 'gas rje mang bo rgyal zhes bya ba 18

la blon po rlangs skam gnyis kyis byas pa dang bcu gnyis so/ /'di ni gtsug phreng gis yig—rnying las btus pa las bshus pa yin la/ tun hong gter yig na bcu gnyis dang bcu gsum zer yang bcu bdun bgrangs 'dug de ltar rgyal phran dang sil ma mtha' dag dbang du bsdus te bod khams spyi'i rgyal bor gyur stabs bod kyi rgyal bo'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po nas 'dren pa la thams cad mthun pa yin te/ deb ther mkhas pa'i da ga' ston las/ ‘‘dang bor lha ri gyang tho'i rtse la bab/ /lha ri rol bo btsan thang sgo bzhir byon/ /de tshe bod mi skal ldan 'ga' yis mthong / /lta bas mi ngoms gzugs la ngo mtshar skyes/ /dris pas phan tshun maspyogo brda ma 'jal/ /mdzub mo nam mkhar ker ba mthong ba yis/ /lha yul gnam nas 'ongs pa'i btsan por 'dug /'di la bdag cag rje bo zhu dgos zer/ /gnya' bar khri la btegs nas spyan drangs pas/ /mthong thos thams cad 'dud cing ngo mtshar skyes/ /mtshan du gnya' khri btsan po zhes byar grags/ /sku mkhar thog ma yu bu bla sgang mdzad/ /’’ces gsungs pa dang / lde'u jo sras kyi deb ther las/ ‘‘de nas rnarje gnya' khri btsan po de byon lugs ji ltar byon na/ gong gi rgyadze+ephran rnams kyi rjerī me byung zhirdo / dze bod mngar ma 'dus nas rje lha9

btsal ba la/ yab 'bangs rus drug shes pa mkhan bcu gnyis kyis rje btsal ba las gnya' khri spyan 'drongs te/ zhes bshad pa ltar ban bon gyi yig cha khungs dag rnams mthun la/ 'ga' zhig gis srong btsan sgam po yan chod du/ phyi rgyal rnams kyis yar lung rgyal bo zer bas yar lung kho na dbang ba'i rgyal bo yin gyi/ bod spyi la dbang ba min no zer ba ni bod rmospyi la dbang ba'i rgyal bo'i thog ma rang gis kyang gnya' khri nas drangs pa dang rang tshig 'gal zhing / yar lung rgyal bo zer ba ni bzhugs yul gyi sgo nas btags pa yin te/ deng sang 'gas pe cin srid gzhung zer ba bzhin no/ /'di dag gi skabs su khungs med kyi gtam sna tshogs shig 'dug mod/ 'dir bshad na yig tshogs lci bas lta mi bde bar 'gyur stabs logs su mchan gyi tshul du dpyad par bya'o/ / ghagun pu/ gnan nyu shā budun zhogaska/gnya' khri btsan po dang gnam mug mug gi sras mu khri btsan po/ 'di bu ston chos 'byung du med/ de dang sa ding deng gi sras ding khri btsan po/ de dang so tharme tham gyi sras so khri btsan po/ de dang dog mer mer gyi sras mer khri btsan po/ de dang 30

/dgas kyi lha mo dkar mo'i sras gdags khri btsan po/ de dang srib kyi lha mo'i sras srib khri btsan po/ 'di bdun la gnam gyi khri bdun zhes grags/srib khri btsan po dang / sa btsun rlung rje'i sras gri gum btsan po 'di'ang bu ston chos 'byung du med/ 'di'i dus su bon zhig byung ba ni kun mthun te/ dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs las/ ‘‘yab kyi ring la zhang zhung dang bru sha'i gshen gyitwar bon byung / sras kyi ring la sku mkhar phying ba stag rtse brtsigs/ sgrung dang lde'u gnam bon gshen po che byung / ’zhes dang / deb ther mkhas dga' las/ ‘‘de tshe rgya gar yul dang stag gzig mtshams/ /gur+ṇa wa tra zhes bya'i yul khams nas/ /mu stegs bon po 'a zha zhes pa byung / /’’zhes dang / lde'u jo sras kyi deb ther las/‘‘de nas bar du steng gnyis te/ /yab steng ba dang sras steng ba'o/ /de la yab steng ba ni sripa khri btsan po'i sras gri gum btsan po ste/ 'di'i sku ring la rgya gar dang stag gzig ṣ+kamatshams nas/ yul 'gyur rna ba zhes bya ba nas/ 'a zha'i bon po zhig byung nas/ de lam lam ni 'bar/ thol thol ni smra/ gnam gyi lha mchod/ sa'i 'dre brdung / gshin gyi gri 'dul/ gson gyi rim gro byed/ rdo nag po lhu dum du 'grel ba zhig byung bas/ mi 21

zhes so/ /de la rgyal bos bla mchod bkur sti mdzad/ ces kyang gsungs/ gri gum btsan po 'di la sras bya khri/ sha khri/ nya khri gsum byung mod/ rgyal phran blon lo ngam rta rdzi zhes bya bas 'bangs gyen log byas te/ rgyal bo gri gum bsad/ sras rnams kong po'i phyogs su bros/ sras mo gcig yod pa kho'i chung ma byas yug cig lo ngam gyis rgyal srid bzung / gri gum gyi btsun mo lcam sring bzhi'i ma yin pa de la rta rdzi byed du bcug rta rdzi byed pa'i skabs yar lha sham po'i sprul ba zhig dang 'dus pa las/ bu ru las skyes zer ba skyes/ de cher gyur nas/ lo ngam bsad de/ sras bya khri gdan drangs te rgyal sar bskos/ mtshan la pu de gung rgyal du grags/ 'di dag sgra cam yi ger phab stabs/ spu de gung rgyal yang 'bri/ pur rgyal bod dang spur rgyal bod ces rgyal khab kyi ming la yang de ltar 'bri srol dar/ sras 'bring ba sha khri kaung yul du bzhugs shing de ga'i rje mdzad/ chung ba nya khris kong po'i yul nas btsun mo go ma ral zhes pa blangs te/ sog yul bu khan du na por han gal twon zer ba'i ri bo dang / sbe kal mtsho'i nye 'gram spe ta'i mi rigs (sog po) gnas pa'i yul du phebs nas/ der gnas pa'i mi rnams kyis rje bor bkur te lha3

sog po'i rgyal rgyud kyi thog ma 'di yin par chen po hor gyi rgyal rabs las gsungs pa bzhin du sog po rnams mthun par gleng ngo rīlo ngam gyis gri gum bsad de pur sgam du bcug nas chur 'phangs pa/ ru las skyes kyis thabs sna tshogs kyis nyang chu skya mo nas gri gum gyi pur btsal te/ byang yul dar thang du bang so brtsigs/ spu de gung rgyal gyis rgyal sa bzung / ru las skyes kyis blon po byas/ blon po ru lasaniskyes ni bod kyi 'phrul blon mdzangs pa'i mi bdun gyi thog ma yin/ de'i sras lha bu mgo dkar yang blon byas/ blon po 'di gnyis kyis thong gshol bzo ba dang /zhing la chu 'dren pa sogs zhing las dar rgyas btang / gser dngul zangs lcags kyi rdo'i gter kha phud de bzo las kyang dar/chu la zam 'dzugs pa dang lam bcos —pa dang / sol bacho sreg pa/spyin bzo ba sogs dar rgyas che tsam byung bar grags so/ /spu de gung rgyal dang bom thang —mong mnya'i sras e sho legs/lha bu mgo dkar ni 'di'i yang blon po yin la/ 'di ni bod kyi 'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun gyi gnyis pa yin/ zhing la dor kha brtsis/ 'brog la thur rtsis byas/ phu chu mda' ru drangs te mda' zhing chu ma rgya je cher btang / e sho legaslo dang rmu lcam bra ma na'i 23

sras de rgo legs/ bu'i chos 'byung du gong ma de la a sho legs dang / 'di la e sho legs zhes bris 'dug de dang klu sman mer mo'i sras thi sho legs/ 'di la de sho legs zhes bris/ de dang btsun mo gur sman gyi sras gu ru legs/ de dang mtsho sman 'brang ma'i sras 'brong zhi legs/ 'di la'ang 'brong sher dang 'brong rje dang 'brong gzher bris pa'ang snang / de dang sman bu mo'i sras i sho legs/ bu'i chos 'byung du/ tho sho legs/—de rnams lasa'i legs drug zer/ i sho legs dang mu lcam smad legs kyi sras za nam zin lde/bu'i chos 'byung du rgyal za rnam zin zhes yod/ de dang mtsho sman khri dkar gyi sras lde 'phrul nam gzhung btsan/ 'di'ang bu'i chos 'byung du med/ mkhas dgar 'phrul nam gzhung btsan zhes 'dug de dang se snyan mang ma'i sras se snol gnam lde/ 'di la'ang yi ge 'dra min snang / de dang klu mo mer ma'i sras se snol bo lde/ 'di nas bzung khri thog rje btsan bar gyi gdung rabs dgu bu'i chos 'byung du med/ de dang 'o ma lde mo mtsho'i srasalde snol nam/ de dang khri sman rje ma'i sras lde snol bo/ de dang se gnyan rje'i sras lde rgyal bo/ de dang sman btsun lug sgong gi sras lde sprin btsan/ de brgyad la lde brgyad zer/24

sde gin btsan dadzo nyi btsan mang ma rje'i sras rgyal to re long za cho ma rig sa pa btsan/ 'di ni rgyal rabs gsal me'i nang du'ang med/ de dang 'o ma lde bza' 'bri btsun byang ma'i sras khri btsan nam/ de dang sman bza' khri dkar gyi sras khri sgra dpung btsan/ de dang sman bza' klu steng gi sras khri thog rje btsan te gdung rabs nyer bdun gyi ring chab srid sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs pa yin zhes grags la/ bon ni dge sgrub lha mchod 'dre 'dul mo rtsis byed pa sogs yin la/ de dag byed mkhan zhig rgyal bo'i a mchod du bsten pa la chab srid sdon gyis bskyangs zer/ bon byung ba sngags dang 'dul ba 'byung ba'i snga ltas yin zer/ sgrung ni ro langs gser sgrub kyi sgrung / ma sangs sgrung / mchil ba'i sgrung sogs nyan bshad byas te/ mi rnams kyi blo rig pa'i gnar+sā la gzhol bar byas/ sgrung byung ba ni mdo sde'i sde snod 'byung ba'i snga ltasaceyin zer/ lde'u ni/ deng sang khed ces grags pa me srang la/ them gnyer wa ba che ci yin/ zhes 'dri ba sogs te/ des mi rnams kyi rig pa'i sgo 'byed pa ste/ lde'u byung ba ni mngon pa'i sde snod 'byung ba'i snga ltas yin zer/ de ltar byed pa la chab srid bon sgrung lde'u gsum gyis bskyangs zhos grags/7 25

zhazhi spru/ snya sdo sdo ni gnyan butsan zhighaska/khri thog rje btsan dang / ru yong bza' stong rgyal na mo mtsho'i sras su (spyi lo 255shing phag lor 'khrungs zer) lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan 'khrungs/ 'di ba dang gong gi rgyal bo ste lnga la btsan lngar grags shing / bang so phying lung dar thang du btab gsungs/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan 'di ba'i dus su dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pa yin te/ dpang skong phyag rgya ba dang gser gyi mchod rten/ mdo sde za ma tog gi snying bo yi ge drug pa/ tsin snya ma ṇi'i brkos phor rnams pho brang yu bu bla sgang gi yang thog tu nam mkha' las bab kyang zer/ paṇa ḍi ta blo sems mtsho dang lo tsā ba li thi se gnyis kyis khyer yong ba red kyang zer/ tsin dha ma ṇi'i brkos phor zhes pa bcu gcig zhal yid bzhin nor bu'i byu gzungs kyi brkos phor zhig dang / zhes mkhas pa'i dga' ston du gsungs pas/ sats+tsha dpar rgyag byed cig yin zer ba yod/gang ltar don ma go yang ngo mtshar du bzung nas ming gnyan po gsang bar btags te mchod pa byas pas/ de'i yon tan gyis rgyal bo lo gzhon par gyur te lo brgya dang nyi shu thub pa byung zhing /mnal lam du khyod nas gdung rabs lnga na 'di'i don shes pa 26

'byung / zhes pa'i lung bstan yang byung ste/ srong btsan sgam po'i dus la chos rnams bod skad du bsgyur pa byung ste/ dam pa'i chos dar ba la dgongs so/ / lha tho tho ri dang rno za mang bo rje'i sras su (spyi lo 333chu sbrul lor 'khrungs zer) khri gnyan gzung btsan 'khrungs/ 'di'i bang so don mkhar mdar brtsigs/ de dang 'brong bza' mo dur yangs bzher gyi sras su (spyi lo 394shing rta lor 'khrungs zer) 'brong gnyan lde'u 'khrungs te/ btsun mo mchims bza' klu rgyal ngan bu mtsho khab tu bzhes/ des sbal ba'i ro mar khur btsos pa'i za ma'i rigs mdzod phugs su bzhag pa gzigs pas rnam par rtog pa'i dbang du gyur nas slun du klu nad kyis thebs shing sras kyang dmus long zhig byung ba la ming dmus long dkon pa bkra shis su btags/ de nas sras la zhal chems bzhag pa ni/ yab mes kyi thugs dam gnyan po gsang ba la mchod pa gyis/ 'a zha'i yul nas sman pa bos la/ mig phye nas rgyal srid zungs gsungs te/ gdung rgyud la snyun mi 'byung ba'i ched yab yum gnyis dang blon po skags thang ba yar rje dang gsum po gson bzhin du bang so zhang mdar brtsigs pa der gshegs nas bang sor zhugs/ —bang so'i ming yang gson chas zlum por grags/ ri 5lha7

sras dmus longartsodakonasgopa bkra shis kyis/ rgyal phran 'a zha'i yul nas sman pa bos nas mig phyes te/ skyid shod stag mo ri la gnyan 'dug pa gzigs pas stag ri gnyan gzigs su grags/ bar skabs su rgyal phran rnams mnga' 'og tu mi 'du bar gyur pa la/ rgyal bo 'dis ban pa rje/ 'a zha rje/ drang gar rje/zin po rje/ zhang zhung rje ste rgyal phran de rnams btul nas mnga' 'og tu 'du bar byas/ 'di dus khri ngor snang gi bus blon byas te bre dang srang bcos/ 'bru mar 'jal byed bzos/ las sdeb dang tshong byed pa sogs dar rgyas btang / blon po 'di ni bod kyi blon mdzangs mi bdun gyi gsum pa yin/ gzhan yang sna nam mang gnya'/ spra khri zung lan pa rnams kyis blon pho byas/ bang sgodon mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ 'khrungs lo mi gsal lo/ /de dang 'ol gong bza' stong btsun 'gro dkar gyi sras su (spyi lo 558sa stag lor 'khrungs zer) gnam ri srong btsan 'khrungs/ dpa' snang baner/ nyang tseng gu sogs kyis blon byas/rgya nag yul nas rtsis dang sman dpyad blangs/ mtha'i rgya dang gru gu sogs mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ rgya'i mkhar phab pa dang / mer btang ba sogs kyi lo rgyus kyang mang bo yod la/ mnga' thang shin tu rgyas shing / lo drug cur rgyal srid bzung / ba dmar mo'i 'o ཿbyi

mas sbrus pa'i 'jim dzi las brtsirgus pa'i pho brang khri brtsegasatshu 'bum gdugs zhes bya ba brtsigs/ brag gsum lding ma'i mtsho 'gram nas rta 'do ba cang shes rnyed par bcibs nas/ phung g.yag thal dkar ru ring zhes bya ba'i 'brong bsad pa'i sha sa la lhung ba las tshwa rnyed/ byang nas tshwa len pa byung / bang so don mkhar ca/dar brtsigs so/ / 'di yan gyi rgyal bo rnams kyi mtshan grangs sogs deb ther yongs grags rnams mi mthun pa du ma zhig snang ste/ bu ston chos 'byung du mu khri btsan po med pa dang / gdags khri btsan po'i ming la'ang 'bri tshul gnyis byung ba dang / mer khri btsan po la/ye khri btsan po khya/sa bris pa yod pa dang / srib khri la'ang de bzhin/gri gum btsan po 'bri tshul gnyis dang 'di bu ston chos 'byung du med/ spu de gung rgyal la'ang 'bri tshu la gnyis/ a sho legs la'ang 'bri tshul gnyig/ de sho legs la'ang de ltar/ thi sho legs la'ang de bzhin/ gu ru legs la'ang de ltar 'bri tshul gnyis/'brong zhi legs la 'bri tshul bzhi/ i sho legs la'ang gsum/za nam zin lde la gnyis/ sde 'phrul nam gzhung btsan la 'bri tshul gnyis dang / bu ston chos 'byung du med/ se snol gnam lde la 'bri tshul gsum/ se snol bo lde la 'phri tshul gnyis dang 'di yang 29

bu ston chos 'byung du med/ lde snol nam la'ang gnyis/ 'di'ang bu ston chos 'byung du med/ lde rgyal bo'ang der med/ lde sprin btsan yang der med/ rgyal to re long btsan la 'bri tshul gsum dang / gsal me dang bu gnyis kar med/ khriri btsan nam yang bu ston chos 'byung du med/ khri sgra dpung btsan la 'bri tshu'asna gsum dang / de yang bu ston chos 'byung du med/ khri thog rje btsan la 'bri tshul gsum dang / bu ston chos 'byung du med/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan dang / snyan btsan te 'bri tshul gnyis/ khri gnyan gzung btsan la'ang 'bri tshul sa/sum yod/ de ltar yi ge mi mtshungs pa dang / chad lhag can gyi yi ge gzhan yang yod pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de dag gi dus su bod rang gi yi ge 'bri srol ma dar gshis ngag rgyun tsam brgyud nas 'ongs pa rnams phyis bod rang gi yi ge 'bri srol yod dus yi ger phab tshe sgra tsam la brten pa dang / ngag rgyun tsam la brten nas bris shing / ming yig gcig thog tu ma khel bas 'dra min byung ba red snyam ste/ srong btsan man nas de 'dra ba ni shin tu nyung ngo / /lde'u jo sras kyi deb ther las/ lde brgyad la se snol lde jam/thang mtshams su thod dka—ra bya ba'i bu yin te/ i sho legs dang 'di gnyis/ gcen po thang mtshams su phab pas/ 'di gnyis 30

kyi rgyud pa la zhang lnga gcen pa zhes grags so/ /'di'i dus na blon po rig pa can gyis rgyal bo mang na 'gran zlar 'gyur bas/gcig rgyal sar bzhag nas gzhan thang mtshams su 'bebs te/'di gnyis thang mtshams su phab pa/ rigs ni yar gar gnang zhes bya ste zhang lnga gcen pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas rigs la btsan lnga byung ste/ rgyal bo lde sprin btsan gyi sras rgyal to re long btsan 'di ni/ 'bangs dang sku gnyen pa la snga bas bdog pa la burten pa'i rgyal bo zhes bya'o/ /rgyal to re long btsan gyi gcung thang mtshams su phab pa ni/ gcung lhab nag bya ba yin pas/ de'i rgyud la zhang lnga gcung ba zhes gragre/sa so/ /zhes dang / khri thog rje btsan gyi gcung rgung mtha'/ snubs mtha'/ 'bring snya/ snya 'bring bzhi thang mtshams su phab bo/ /zhes dang / yang de las/ lha tho tho ri'i gcung lha bzang zhes bya ba thang mtshams su phab par bshad/ 'di dag la dpag na/ yun nan zhing chen gyi deng sang pe rigs zer ba dang /la shas rigs zer ba'i mi ser gyi ngag rgyun la/ khong tsho'i rgyal rgyud la spun gsum yod pa'i gcig bod kyi rgyal bo byas pa dang /gcig pe rigs kyi rgyal bo dang / gcig la shas rigs kyi rgyal bo byas pa red zer bas/ phyi ma gnyis thang mtshams su phab pa'i 31

rgyal bu yin 'dra snyam/ rgya'i yi ge'i lo rgyus nang du'ang de ltar du yod cespomakhas pa 'ga' zhig zer ro/ / sdo bu/ nuska bro sprod butsan sgan bro/ cho(gcig/ 'khrangs tshul dang khrir bzhugs skor/rgyal bo gnam ri srong btsan dang / yum 'bri bza' thod dkar gnyis la/ pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling du sras ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan dang ldan pa zhig 'khrungs/ sras 'khrungs pa'i dga' ston rgya chen po dus mi thung bar byas/ khri srong btsan zhes mtshan gsol/ lo tshigs la mi mthun pa 'ga' yod pas gzhan du dpyad par bya'o/ /lo shas nas blon phug bzang bo rig pa can/ mgar gyi bu stong btsan zhes bya la dang / thu mi snang grags kyi bu thu mi a nu zhes bya ba gnyis chung grogs byas/ de gnyis kyis rgyal bu la zhe sa 'bul ba'i skabs rgyal bu'i dbu steng du yang dbu zhig yod pa mthong ngo zhes bsnyad pa phyi rol tu thos pa phyogs su grags te/ bod kyi rgyal bo la rgyal bu dbu gnyis ma ya mtshan zhig 'khrungs yod do zhes phyogs kun tu grags/ rgyal bu de nar son dus/ thig 'debs pa dang / khang bzo/ rdo bzo/byilha

'ing bzo sogs bzo'i gnas la rig pa shin tu 'gro zhing / dngos po rnams grangs su 'debs pa la blo myur zhing mkhas pa dang / rte bzhon mda' 'phen sogs kyi sgyu rtsal dang / gar dang / rol mo ste/ de dus yod pa'i rig gnas lnga ste de sogs la thugs gzhol zhing mkhas par gyurangapas/ blon po rnams na re/ 'o cag gi rgyal bu 'di ni yon tan dang ldan zhing thugs shin tu sgam po zhes zer bas/ mtshan yardosrong btsan sga ma po zhes yongs su grags pa de'o/ /de lta bu'i rgyal sras de nyid dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa'i tshe yab kyis rang gi rgyal srid la dbang bskur to/ /de nas po ta la'i rtse la pho brang 'debs par bzhed nas phebs pas ge re'i 'phrang du gro btab pa'i tshe yig drug rang byon zhal gzigs nas sku khrus gsol/ dmar bo'i ristertsopo ta lar pho brang btab ste dmag dpung dang bcas der bzhugs/ de nas rgya gar rgya nag khrom ge sar stag gzig sogs mtha'i rgyal bo rnams kyis/bod yul du sprul ba'i rgyal bo lo shin tu gzhon pa zhig gis rgyal srid skyong ngo zhes snyan pa'i gtam thos nas/ re re nas dpya dang skyes yang yang phul 'ing / so so'iphe ge'i thog nas bstod pa'i 'phrin dang / dpya dang skyes lo ltar du dngos po 'di dang 'di yod do nes 'phrin bskur ba'i lan/ so so'i yi ge shes pa'i drung bye3

yig rnarmi sa kyis/ yul gru gzhan dag gi yi ge'i thog nas 'bri ba spus/ bod rang gi yi ge'i thog 'bri rgyu med do/ / (gnyis/ rang gi yi ge 'bri ba'i srol brtod tshul/ de nas rgyale bo'i thugs dgongs la yul gru so so'i yi ge la ma ltos par bod rang gi yi ge zhig dargos so shar nas/ rig pa can mgar stong btsan yumu bzung sogs blon phrug blo lha ba 'ga' dang gzhan yang bod phrug du ma rgya gar du btang yang yi ge'i bzhed pa ma grub ste/ smyu gu'i bstan bcos 'phrul gyi sgron me las/ ‘‘rgyal bo srong btsan gyis/ mgar g.yul bzang 'khor mang bo rgyu nor dngos po'i rdzong brda rgya chen po byas te/ rgya gar du mngags mod/ 'khor phal cher tshad pas shi/ mgar g.yul bzang kho rang yang shi la khad byas/ nor rnams kyang zad de phyir log pas/ rgyal bo'i thugs dgongs ma 'grub/ ’ ces gsungs so/ / de nasablon po chen po gnyal thu mi snang grags kyi bu thu mi a nu zhes bya ba/ phyis su thon mi sasto ṭa zhes grags pa de nyid la grogs po khrel yod pa'i lo gzhon bcu drug dang bcas pa la gser dang rta drel sogs dngos skyes phun sum tshogs rnga/ gnang 34

nas rgya gar du mngags pa yin te/ smyu gu'i bstan bcos 'dzul gyi sgron me las/ de nas thon mi sasto ṭa de dus lo brgyad lon zhing rig pa gsal la brtson 'grus che bar shes nas/ de la grogs ngo tsha shes shing —khrel yod pa'i lo gzhon pa bcu drug dang bcas pa la gser dang rta drel sogs dngos skyes phun sum tshogs pa gnang nas rgya gar du mngags/ zhes dang / zur mkhar blo gros rgyal bos mdzad pa'i shes bya spyi'i khog dbug las/ rgya gar nag dang li bal sogs mtha' bzhi'i rgyal bo rnams dang bka' 'phrin yang mdzad do/ /de'i tshe thugs dgongs la mtha' bzhi'i rgyal bo rnams ni dam pa'i chos dang yi ge zung du rmod pas bka' 'phrin yang yi ge la rdzong ba zhig na/ rang cag la de lta bu med pas/ dman pa'i grangs su 'gro ba dang / gzhan dag gis kyang dpyas pa'i yul du gyur pas/ da ni mi las lhar sgrub pa'i thabs dam pa'i chos dang de nyid rtogs par byed pa'i thabs su 'phrul gyi yi ge 'tshol du gtang bar dgongs nas/ blon po'i mchog rig pa can mgar stong btsan yul bzung g.yog dang bcas te btang ba ca la wa ti rnam gsum du byon pa na g.yog phal cher nad kyis gum ste slob dpon nyid kyang gumardzipar dgongs te the tshom nas slar log go/ /de nas thu misnang grags kyi bu a nu zhes bya ba 35

g.yog dang bcas pa brdzangs pa bal bor chu bsnyams zhing bsil sman khyer nas phyin pas/ nā len drar bgrod de a zhwa mi tra'i slob ma lha rig pa'i seng ge zhes bya ba dang lo bdun 2grogs nas yi ge dang sgra'i bstan bcos bslabs nas shin spyo mkhas par gyur pa gosasto ṭa zhes bla thabs su btags te bod yar dag pa zer ro/ /zhes dang / lde'u jo sras kyi deb ther las/ rgya'i mkhas pa li byin la bod phrug thon mi 'bri to mi ma nus yi ge bslabs nas/ ka mad sum cur bsgrigs/ zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /des na sngar deb ther mang bo'i nang du gnyal thu mi a nu'i bu thon mi sasto ṭa zhes pa ni/ yi ge log pa yin te/ gnyal thu mi snang grags kyi bu a nu zhes pa'i yi ge log nas gnyal thu mi a nu'i bu zhes bris pa yin la/ sasto ṭa zhespopa phyis su mi gar nas bla thabs su btags pa red/ khong gi mtshan dngosani thu mi a nu ze2 gleyin no/ /blon po mchog 'di nyid kyi sras/ ma hā sa twa/ de'i sras ye nag de'i sras nyi ma klong gsal/ de'i sras ber nag can/de'i sras mon mo/ de'i srasagatso bo lha srag 'di rnams dgung lo brgya lhag tsam bzhugs pa sha stag byung / de'i sras bsod namagargyal bo/ de'i sras rgyal bo dga'/ de'i sras rta mgrin rgyalīmatshan/ de'i sras rdo rje bkra shis/ 'dis dpal ldan sposkyar ti 36

shrī kun blo'i zhabs la gtugs/ de nyid kyis hor rgyal bo'i dru nga du brdzangs pas du dben shrī'i bya las chen po gnang / de'i sras dpon bzhi 'dzom/ gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis gzhis ka gong dkar gyi rdzong dpon la bskos/ de'i sras rgyadze+eb shes rab/de'i sras dpon chen gral lnga/ 'di nyid kyi sku tshe'i stod līgong ma grags pa 'byung gnasakyisayar rgyab dpon chen dang gong dkar rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnang / sku tshe'i smad la rabardzotu byung ste/ gsang sngags kyi chos sde gong dkar rdo rje gdan btab/ 'di nyid kyi dpon sras nas bzung ste/ sde ba rnam rgyal ba sku mched kyi bar du mnga' thang yar rgyas su gnas so zhis/ deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs glegs sagasungs/ 'di ba'i mi rgyud 'dren dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ deng sang rgyus med kyis rgyus gtam smra mkhan shin tu mang bar ma zad/ khyi gar zug gi rjes su zug pa'i dpe ltar du 'gro nyen che bas/ cung zad tsam brjod pa yin no/ /de ltar lho kha gnyal nes bya ba'i yul gyi blon po thu mi snang grags kyi bu gzhon nu blo gsal zhing gizhung drang ba ma nu zhes bya ba de grogs dang bcas rgya gar du yi gi slob tu brdzangs/ khong 'khor bcas 'phags yul du slebs nas/ slob dpon bram ze 37

li byin dang paṇa ḍi ta lha rig pa'i seng ge sogs paṇa ḍi ta mang bo bsten nas/ yig rigs mang bo dang —/ sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos mang bo dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa lo mang bo'i ring la bslabs nas phyir rang yul du bde bar phebs/ dga' bsu rgya chen po byas/ de nas rgyal blon gnyis sku mkhar ma rur lo gsum bzhi'i bar du mtshams bcad de rgyal bos kyang yi ge dang sgra rig pa sogs bslabs/ thon mis legs sbyar la dpe blangs te/ bod skad kyi dbyangs gsal bsgrig 'god byas tshul dang / legs sbyar gyi dbyangs gsal las 'dor len dang / gsar snon dang / sngon rjes mgo 'dogs sogs rig 'phrul bla na med pa gsar bzo byas/ 'phags yul gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang bsngags brjod mdzad tshul sogs lo rgyus tsho gzhan dag tu'ami gsal la/ bdag gis yi ge'i rnam bzha ga dag tu mdor bsdus re bris zin pas 'dir bskyar zlos mi byed do/ / de ltar thon mis yi ge gsar du bzos pa'i yig phud du rgyal bo la bya dka' ba'i lam nas drangs pa'i bstod pa phul ba/zhal ras gsal la ngang mdangs gang ba bzang sogs sho lo ka gnyis dang rkang ba gsum yod pa yongs su grags pa de dzen khog sna rdo'i lha khang du brag la brkos nas yod gsungs/ rgyal bos 38

spyang yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba yi ge yin zhing / yon tan gang las thob pa'i slob dpon la brtsi bkur dang bsti stang byed pa ni legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba yin par dgongs nas/ slob dpon thon mir bkur sti dang phu dud cher mdzad pas/ blon po 'ga' zhig gi rgyud la phrag dog gi blo skyes te/ rje rgyal bos 'bangs la 'di lta bu'i bkur nyi mi 'os so zhes bsgrags pa la/ thon mis de dag gi 'gran sems gcog pa'i phyir/ nga drin chen blon po thon mi ngas/ /lam bgrod par dka' ba'i rgya gar du/ /zhes sogs sholo ka lnga dang rkang ba gcig yod pa'i thon mi'i nga rgyal gyi glu zhes pa de blangs so/ / de nas rgyal bo'i bka' bzhin/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra dang bram ze sha/ nga ka ra/ slob dpon li byin/ bal bo'i slob dpon shī la mañdza/ kha che'i slob dpon ta nu ta dang / snya nu ta/ rgya nag gi slob dpon hwa shang ma hā de ba tshe rnams spyan drangs te/ bod kyi lo tsā ba thon mi sasto ṭa/ de'i mchan bu dharma ko sha.a lo ka ye shes dpal sogs kyis lo tsā byas te༈/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs/ mdo rgyud chos dang rig gnas mang bo bod skad du bsgyur to/ /de ltar thon mi'i rig 'asgal las byung ba'i bod kyi skad yig 'di'i thog tu yul gru 39

gzhan gyi rig pa'i gnas mtha' dgabasgyur du btub cing / thon mi mchan bu lo paṇa dang bcas pa'i lag len dang dpyad dzi ji — rdzogs pa'i grub 'bras la slob dpon thon mis/ mdo rdzi'i sgratshomado la sogs pa'i bstan bcos chen po brgyad mdzad do/ /deng dus yongs su grags pa'i sum cu ba dang rtags kyi 'jug pa 'di gnyis kyang bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du bod rang skad la brtag dpyod zhib mo byas pa'i brda sprod pa'i ga zhung man med pa yin gshis/ deng dus su'ang bod rang gi spyi skad la 'phrod cing spyod brode ba'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs 'gran bla dang bral ba'o/ / bcom ldan rigs ral gyis mdzad pa'i/ sgra'i bstan bcos smra ba rgyan gyi me rtog ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa/ zhes bya ba las/bkas bcad yul skad 'phral skod gsum/ bkas bcad dang bo dadz+wabar ba tha ma gsum mi mthun/ chos bsgyur ba na lo paṇa dang / rgyal blon dang / brda la mkhas ba rnams 'dus te/ciyul thard na ming du ma yod kyang 'di'i ming ni 'dir 'thad do / /zhes bcad pa ni bkas bcad/ de la yang gsum ste/ thostomi sasto ṭa dang btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus kyi dang bo byas pa'i 'gyur rnams ni dang borabyas pa'i bkas bcad kyi 'gyur te/40 sni

saungayorgyas phal bo gle dang / lung sde bzhi dang / mdo sde kha cig dang / sher phyin gyi mdo kha cig ste dang bor skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa rnams so/ /de la ni gang la gag dang / zhes sogs dang / yang de las/ gnyis pangaskad gsar bcad la ni/de dag zla bo ji skad bshad pa rnams dadz+wa/ gzhan yang / deng sang gsung rab la grags pa'i ming phalakheche ba rnams yin no/ /bkas bcad gnyis pa de ni mnga' bdag khri ral ba can yan chad du ka cog zhang gsum la sog/sa bsadzinasapa yin rgo /bkas bcad gsum pa ni/ lha bla ma yeshes 'ogakyi dus kyi sgra bsgyur rin chen bzang rgo nas bzung ste kho bo'i bla ma mchog lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal yan chad kyis byas pa yin no/ /de lane+eni bstan chos la bltan bcos zhes sogs gsungs so/ / gzhan yang / bstan rtsis lhag bsam rab dkar las/4chos bsgyur ba'i bod kyi skad la yang / de yang bod la grags —pa'i ming / bka sa bcad yul skad 'phral skad gsum/ bkas bcad la yang dang bo dang / bar ba dang / tha ma gsum mi mthun/ ’zhes pa ltar chos bsgyur ba'i bod skad la/ bkas bcad rnam pa gsum byung ba'i/ bkas bcad dang bo/ rgyal bo khri srong lde btsanaciyan chad nas/ srong btsan sgam po man chad 4(

kyi bar la/ lo tsā ba —thon mi nas/ bai ro༈tsa na'i bar gyi lo tsā bas bamyur ba rnams te/ de yang lung sde bzhi dang— / tsho phal bo che dang / dkon brtsegs sogs sher phyin gyi mdo kha cig sogasu skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa rnams so/ /rgyal bo khri srong ldobatsan dus/ blo rno ba'i mchog khams pa go chas sher phyin stongasaphrag brgya ba byāthugasar+shalabazung nas bsgyur ba'i 'bum thugs 'gyur mar grags me dang / der rgya'i nyang iṣ+ṭa rdu rtsisarang / sas mamyu thi gnyis kyisargya spe sbyangs nas bsgyur ba'i bca' 'bum du grags pa sogs kyang bkas bcad dang bo'o/ / bkas bcad gnyis pa ni mnga' bdag khri ral gyi dus su/ lo tsā ba ka cog zhang gsum sogs kyis skod gsar bcad kyis gten la phab nas bsgyur pa/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa sogase mang bo dag yod de/ khri srong sde btsan nas khri ral gyi bar bshadaljub kyi bstan pa'am mdo sngags kyi bstan pa ches mchog tu dar bas de dus kyi bstan pa 'dra ba 'phags yul du yang ma byung ba 'dra zhe sa a ti shas gsungs so/ /zhes deb sngon na bris 'dug bkas bcad gsum pa ni/ lo chen rin chen bzang bo man chad bstan pa phyi dar la byung ba yin te 'og nas 'chad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na skad gsar bcad gsum byung ngo / /zhes 4lha

4 wī grags pa tsam las/ri khungs gsal bo ma mthong phyir/ rang — gzhan du mas rtog bzo'i bshad pa ci rigs yod mod/ 'di nyid 'thad par sems te/ slob dpon thon mi'i skabasasu'ang bod yul sa rgya che zhing yul sde'ang phyogs kun tu bkram nas yod gshis yul du ma na yul skad kyi ming brda du mgayod nges la/ de dag gtso bo yul dbus lta bu'i skad la bstun dgos par bkas bcad de/ spyi 'gro'i yig skad dang brda sprod pa'i gzhung gtan la phab pa yin nges so/ /de ltar gnyal thu mi snang grags kyi sras thu mi a nu zhes bya ba/ yongs grags la thon mi sasto ṭa zhes mtshan snyan po dbyar skyes rnga gsang gi skad la 'gran pa de nyid ni/ bod kyi blon po mdzangs mi bdun gyi bzhi ba yin la/ mdzangs pa'i las su bod rang gi skad kyi steng nas yi ge 'bri ba'i srol btod/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung 'gran zla bral ba gtan la phab/ yul gru gzhan gyi chos dang rig pa'i gnas du ma bod skad du bsgyur bas/ bsildoldan 'gro ba yongs la bka' drin gzhal du med pa'i dang bo'i lo chen yin no/ /ji skad du/ yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma bris klog gis/ /bod yul rmongs pa'i mun pa kun bsal te/ /chosadang srid kyis rgyal khams bde bar mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ shes rig 'phel ba'i stobs kyis/ srid kyi bya ba yang 43

rnam par rgyas pa yin te/ bka'i blon po sum brgya yod pa'i nang du/ gtso bo bcu drug yod de/ phyi blon btsan po drug nang blon bzang bo drug bka'i 'phrul blon bzhi'o/ /nang blon bzang bo drug ni/ 'phrul gyi sna rig bzang (khra 'brug pa)/ zhang bo rgyal gyi khram bzang (hor yin)/ cog ro rig pa'i skad bzang (cog ro ba)/ lhar gzigs shog po bstan bzang (khams pa)/ka'i gnyan ston 'phel bzang (rgya ma yar stod pa)/ sbas lcang dpal gyi legs bzang (sbas kyi skyid thag ring mo'ang zer)la sogs te blon po brgya tham pas/ rgyal bo'i sku'i zhabs tog dang nang gi bya ba thams cad byed/ phyi blon btsan po drug ni/ khyung bo spu na bzang btsan(byang gi khyung bo ba)/ lam khri bde blag khri btsan (yar stod pa)/ mu khri rdo rje gnam btsan('phan yul rgyal ba)/mjing gi byang chub mchog btsan('dzad pa)/ khur ba klu'i dpal btsan('phyongs rgyas pa)/ rong bo 'phrul gyi sde btsan(yar lung son pa)la so gas pa'i blon po blorgya tham pas phyi blon byed/shar phyogs rgya dang mi nyag gi yulanas bzo dang rtsis kyirape blangs/ lho phyogartswargya gar yul na.ā+oṃdam pa'i chos kyi sgra bsgyur/nub phyogs bal bo dang stag gzig (sog po'ang zer)nas zas nor longs spyod kyi gter kha 'byed/ byang phyogs hor dang yu 44

gur nas khrims dang las kyi dpe blangs/ mdor na phyogs bzhir dbang bsgyur zhing / longs spyod par mdzad do/ /med thabs med pa'i bka'i 'phrul blon bzhi ni/ thon mi sasto ṭa (thon lung ra ga ba)/ mgar stong btsan yul bzung (stod lung ram pa ba)/'bri se ru gong ston('bri khung ba)/ nyang khri bzang yang ston (nyang ser ba)la sogs pa'i blon po brgya tham pas bar gyi khod snyoms shing khrims gnyis bzo ba sogs byed do/ /khri bzang yang ston snyags kyi bu ni bod kyi blon po mdzangs mi bdun gyi lnga ba yin te/ mdzangs pa'i las su/ sngar bod mi'i kharostim mang che ba ri la yod pa la 'dis klungs su phab/ mkhar brtsigs nas grong khyer bcos so/ /(gsumakyi rgyal bo srong btsan gyis khrims gtan la phab pa'i skor/rgyal bo srong btsan gyis lo gsum bzhi zhig la sku mtshams bcad nas rig gnas la sbyangs pas/ 'bangs 'ga' zhig gis rgyal bo smren pa zhig yin 'dra/ 'bangs rnams bde ba blon po rnams kyi drin red/ zer ba rgyal bos gsan te/ 'bangs rnams bsdus nas/ rgyal bo glen par 'dug 'bangs bde ba blostopo rnams kyi drin red/ zer ba 'dug ste/ de ltar min/ blon po 45

rme rnams ngas bskos nas/ ngas bka' bsgo ba yin/ da ni ngas rgyal khrims chen po bca' dgos/ sngar khrims lugs yang dag pa zhig med pas/ rgyal phran rnams skabs 'gar so sor 'thor 'gro ba red/ da rung khrims med na nyes byed dar zhing 'bangs rnams sdug bsngal bar 'gyur bas da ni khrims bca'o gesungs so /de nas thog mar bod yul ru chen lnga ru phyes/ yul gyi dbang ris rnam pa bco brgyad du bcad/ rgod kyi stong sde drug cu rtsa gcig tu phyes/ g.yung gi mi sde kheng dang yang kheng gnyis su byas/ zhang gsum blon dang bcas pas yul dbus kyi gdan sa 'dzin/ dpa' sde gsum gyis mtha'i so mtshams srung ngo / /de drug la bod kyi 'khos drug zer/ de yang khrims yig chen mo drug mdzad de/ de drug ni/ khri rtse 'bum bzher gyi khrims/ 'bum gser thog sha ba can gyi khrims/ rgyal khams dper blangs kyi khrims/ mdo lon zhu bcad kyi khrims/ dbang chen bcad kyi spyi khrims/ khab so nang ba'i khrims te drug go/ /gzhan yang bka' gros che na po drug yig tshangs drug bka'i phyag rgya drugarkyen drug dpa' mtshan drug de rnams kyi steng du khrims yig drug po bsnan pas bod kyi 'khos sum cu rtsa drug ces bya'o/ /46

khrims yig chen po drug gi dang bo khri rtse 'bum bzher gyi khrims zhes pa'i nang du/ bka' gros drug yig tshangs drugaphyag rgya drug rkyen drug dpa' mtshan drug rnams 'dus 'dug la/ 'di dag mchan gyi tshul du 'god par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'bum gyi gser thog sha ba can zhes pa'i nang du/ bre srang phul khyor zho se sran rnams gtan la phab 'dugagasum pa rgyal khams dper blangs kyi khrims zhes pa'i nang du/ bya bar 'os dang mi 'os ston pa ste/ dgra 'dul zhing rgyal khams bde bar mdzad pa/ nang gi tshis mdzad cing 'bangs 'khor skyong bar mdzad pa/ phyi mar phan phyir dam chos mdzad pa —gsum la/ mdzad pa gsum zer/ dam pa lha chos ni snod min kheng bo la mi bshad pa/ gsang sngags snying du bcangs pa las nor du mi 'tshong ba/ ngan pa la bstod pa mi mdzad pa gsum la mi mdzad pa gsum zer/ dpa' la stag gis bstod/ legs pa la bya dgas bstod/ mdzangs pa la yig tshangs kyis bstod pa gsum la bstod pa gsum zer/ sdar ma wa yis dmad/ ngan pa nan tur gyis dmad/ nyes pa byed pa chad pas dmad pa gsum la dmad pa gsum zer/ pha mar mi mnar ba/ mchan gyi bu la mi mnar ba/ mdza' grogs la mi mnar ba gsum la mi mnar ba cho 47

gsum zer/ bco lnga bo de la rgyal khrims bco lnga zhis spags so/ /de yang khrims chen bdun gtan la phab ste/ srog mi gcod pa'i khrims gshin stong dang gson stong / ma byin pa mi len pa'i khrims/ru dkon mchog gi nor brkus na brgya 'jal/ rgyal bo'i nor brkus na brgyad cu 'jal/ 'bangs kyi nor brkus na brgyad 'jal/ log par mi g.yem pa'i khrims smad 'jal dang byi chad/rdzun spong ba'i khrims lha srung dpang du byas nas mna' spobs pha/ chang la tshod zin pa/ kheng mi ldog pa/ bang so mi 'dru ba ste bdun no/ /ya/nga mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims bcas pa ste mi dge ba bcu spo nga ba'i steng du/ ma la mar 'dzin pa/ pha la phar 'dzin pa/ dge sbyong dang bram ze la dge sbyong dang bram zer 'dzin pa/ rigs kyi rgan rabs la bkur bar bya ba/ drin du gzo ba/ gzhan la ngan g.yo spang ba ste bcu drug go/ /gzhan yang bod khrims nyi shu/ skyid shod dang / sho ma ra ru gtan la phab ste/ rje blon kun gyis phyag rgyas btab pa ni/'thab mo byas pa la chad pa/ bsad pa la che chung gi stong byed pa/brkus pa la brgyad 'jal ngos dang dgu/ byi byas pa'i yan lag gi phran bcad nas yul gzhan du sgyugs pa/ rdzun byas pa'i lce 48

gcod pa/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing dad pa dang mos gus bya ba/ pha ma la drin du gzo zhing bkur sti bya ba/mi drin dang pha khu rgan gsum gyi yi mi gcod cing bzang botshi lan byed pa/ mi ya rabs dang rigs btsun pa la mi rgol cing dang du len pa/ las dang spyod pa thamagocad ya rabs kyi rjes su 'brang ba/ lha chos dang yi ge la blo 'jug tsing don shes par bya ba/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches shing mi dge ba la 'dzem pa/ mdza' bshes dang khyim mtshes la phan 'dogs shing gnod sems mi bya ba/ gzhi drang bor bya zhing blo sems dpang du 'jog pa/ zas chang la tshod 'dzin cing khrel lod par bya ba/ bu lon dus su 'jal ba / bre srang la g.yo zol mi bya ba/ ma paskos shing ma bcol ba'i bya ba la rtog 'jug mi bya ba/ gros kyi nang du bud med kyi kha la mi nyan cing rangadzitshugs 'dzin pa/ yin min gyis ma chod pa byung na yul lha bltan srung dpang du btsugs nas mna' byed pha rnams so/ /bzhi ba mdo lon zhu bcad kyi khrims yig ni/ kha drag zhan gnyis rtsod na bden rdzun brtags pa'i mthar/ kha drag pa ma skyengs shing / zhan pa yi mi 'chad par gcod pa/ mdo lon zhu bcad kyi khrims yig zer zhing / bden rdzun gyi zhal lce gcod tshul — 49

gcig go/ / lnga ba dbang chen bcad kyi spyi khrims ni/ gnyis ka lan pa la/ bram ze dbyug pa can gyis khyim bdag gi glang g.yar nas gtod du phyin pas glang khyim bdag gi ra bar btang ste/ ci yang ma smras par log khyim bdag gis glang bskyal byung ba mthong yang ma btags par bzhag pas/ glang phugs kyi sgo nas thon te stor ba/ rgyal bo me long gdong la zhal lce zhus pas/ bram zes glang btang yod do/ /zhes ma smras pas lce chod/ khyim bdag gis glang mthong yang ma btags pas lag pa bregs shig ces zhal lce bcad pa dpe byas nas chad pa gnyis mnyam du gcod pa dbang bcad kyi spyi khrims zer zhing / zhal lce gcod tshul gyi khrims gcig go/ / drug pa khab so nang ba'i khrims yig ni/ gnyis ka bden na/ khyim bdag gcig gi mobu skyes ma thag chur lhung ba nya zhig gis mid pa/ ri'i 'og gi grong na gnas pa khyim bdag gzhan zhig gi g.yog gis nya de zin nas bshas pas/ khye'u zhig ma shi bar byung ba khyim bdag des bur gsos pa/ khyim bdag gong mas thos nas rtsod de/ rgyal bo la zhal lce zhus pas/ gnyis kas khye'u de res mos su gsos la bud med re re longs/ bu byung 50

/sdu/ lhas/redros tsābye/ /ce) /ce) /rje/ /rdo/na ma bdag sa ra ga sa zhal bcad pas 'u rigs gnyis par ming chags/ bu re re skyesu pa so sos khyer/phyis su rab tu byung ba la dge slong rigs gnyis par grags pa de la dpe blangs nas/ gnyis bden dang dga' gsum du gcod pa la khab so nang ba'i khrims /yig tu grags skad/ de drug la khrims yig drug zer ro/ /de ltar bzang bo'i khrims gnyan zhing btsan pas rje 'bangs tshang ma bde skyid dang ldan zhing / ra lug phyugs rigs tshang ma rang dgar gtong / la khar la btsas brtsigs/ chu chen gru yis bcad/ rgyal bo'i chab srid dang /'bangs kyi bde skyid dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel to/ /mi kun dge bcu'i khrimagyil gnasatshupas/ dam pa'i chos kyi snod du gyur par shes nas/ yi da ma gyi lha'i sku khyad par ba zhig spyan 'dren dgos dgongs te/ sprul ba'i dge slong a ka ra ma ti shī la pho nyar mngags nas/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram bye ma'i gling nas tsan dan sbrul gyi snying bo las grub pa'i thugs rje chen po dang / bal bo'i yul nas tsan dan ha ri'i sdong bo las grub pa'i 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra spyan drangs pa pho brang po ta la'i rtser bzhugs so/ / 51

— (bzhi) btsun mo dang jo bo rnam gnyis spyan drangs ba sogs/ de nas btsun mo rnam gnyis dang jo bo rnam gnyis spyan drangs pa'i tshul sogs ni/ de nas rgyal bo'i thugs dgongs la/rgya bal gyi btsun mo gnyis rten skal lha dang bcas spyan 'dren dgos dgongs te/ nang bar blon po rnams phyag 'bul du 'ongs nas bka' mchid mdzad pa'i tshe/ yengs ma lam du rgyal bo'i zhal nas/ mdang nga'i rmi lam du nub phyogs bal bo dang /shar phyogs rgya'i yuladu bu mo yid du 'ong ba gnyis yod pa rmis gsungs pa dang / g.yas nas mgar stong btsan yul bzung dang / g.yon nas thon mi sasto ṭa mi chung gnyis kyis 'bras chang kaiḍūr+ya'i phor ba re rgyal bo la stob cing / mnal lam de su la'ang mi gsung bar zhu zhus/ de nas blon po rnams kyis gros byas tshul sogs yongs grags ltar la/ mgar gyis ji ltar spyan drang zhes rgyal bo la zhus pas/ rgyal bo'i zhal nas/ thon mis sna drangs pa'i blon 'khor rnams ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad skar ma rgyal la pho brang dmar bo'i ri la nyi ma shar ba dang song gsungs/ de ltar 5lha

blon chen thon mi dang mgar gnyis gtso byas te blon 'khor khadzi — rta brgya phrag du ma bcas bal yul du song / bal rgyal 'od zer go cha la mgar dang thon mi gnyis kyis gtsos bod blon rnams kyis zhu rten gser gyi dong tshe stong / gser phye bre gang sogs phu'akyi te sras mo bslangs par/ rgyal bos 'phral du khas ma blangs par/ ster mi 'dod pa'i gtam rim pa gsum rim par gsung ba la/ bod rgyal gyi bka' lung gi 'phrin yig bal bo'i yi ger bris pa rim pa gsum rim bzhin phul bas/ bal rgyal skrag ste ster bar khas blangs/ sras mo'i rten skal du jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje/ byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo/ tsan dan sgrol ma rang byon rnams dang / gzhan yang baiḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed sogs rin po che glang bo che'i rgyab khal bdun sogs gnang ste brdzangs/ shing pho rta'i lor pho brang du phebs/ rgyal bor mjal te btsun mor mnga' gsol/ zhes ka khol mar gsungs/ de rjes bal bza' khri btsun 'di nyid kyis pho brang khri rtse dmar bo zhes bya ba'i pho brang 'dzam gling na grags che ba zhig bzhengs/ pho brang brtsigs tshul 'di ra sa'i klu khang gi nub logs la bris nas yod skad do/ /yang rgya nag gi rgyal bo thang tha'e tsung gi sras mo wun khreng kong jo blangs pa'i skor ni/ de'i sngon du bod dmag gis gru gu'i 53

rgyal bo bcom/ der mthud thang gi dmag dang lo brgyad lhag la 'khrug ste/ thang gi mnga' khongs kru'u bcu gcig lhag med du btang / bkan shan dang bkra shis gling rgyal phran gyi sa mtshams su 'dzam gling la grags pa'i dmag 'khrug cig brgyab/ de'i skabs kyi 'thab rdzong rnams da dung yang yod/ rnga ba/ mdzod dge/ zung chu sogs su de dus kyi mkhar shul gyi so phag sogs rnyed rgyu yod/ de skabs bod dmag 'bum phrag gnyis lhag slebs te sa cha rgya chen po blangs nas/ so mtshams srung dmag bzhag pa'i mi rgyud rnams ni/ deng sang gi chu dkar rgyud dang chu nag rgyud/ rgyal mo rngul chu'i chu rgyud sogs su yod pa'i bod sde rnams yin/ de nas thang rgyal gyis chings mdzad nas sras mo sbyin rgyu'i bab bstan/ de rjes rgyal bo srong btsan gyis btsan brjid can gyi bka' shog rgya'i yi ger bris pa rim pa gsum dang dngos skyes du ma dang bcas gnang nas/ mgar stong btsan dang thon mi sasto ṭa/ 'bri se ru gong ston/ nyang khri bzang la sogs pa rgya yul du sras mo kong jo slong du song skabs/ rgya gar gyi rgyal bo sogs rgyal khag bzhi sras mo slong du 'ongs pa dang 'phrad de/blon chen mgar gyis rig 'phrul 'gran zla dang bral bas sras mo bod kyis thob tshul sogs yongs su grags pa ltar la/ mgar rgyu 54

nag tu mi tshab tu bsdad mod/ mgar gyis thon mi dang nyang gnyis lkog tu khrid nas/ nga rgya yul du zla ba lnga las mi sdod gsungs/ de nas kong jo dpon g.yog mdo khams su phebs nas/ mgar sgug pa'i phyir/ brag logs la yum rgyas pa'i dbu dum dang bzang spyod brkos/ rdo'i byams sku khri brgyad cu ba brkos/ sha ba bzung nas zhing rmos/ chu bskor btsugs/ rgya mo'i 'phred lam bcos pa sogs mdzad/ ldan ma'i brag la bzad spyod brkos pa'i skor la/ si tu'i rang rnam du/ bar khams kyi ldan yul nang 'bis zer ba'i lung bar kong jos bzhengs pa'i rnam snang gtso 'khor dang / legs sbyar gyi sher snying / bzang bo spyod pa'i smon lam brag la brkos pa rnams mjal/ 'di'i zhal byang bklag thub pa 'dug pas zhib mor dpyad tshe mes ag tshom gyi sku rim du bzhengs pa 'dug ces gsungs pas de ni wun khreng kong jos bzhengs pa ma yin par bshad pa dang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar las/ 'bum gling gi byams che na sa gnon mnyam bzhag bzang bo'i 'dug stangs can la mjal/'di stod smad gang yang ma 'dzol ba'i thig ldan/ shin tu byon legs pa nga/ mtshan pa zhig snang / rgya bza' kong jo bod du phebs lam nas/ brag la byams pa khri brgyad cu ba bzhengs zhes pa 55

gzhan na ston rgyu med la/ 'di'i nye 'khor du sgrol ma rang byon yang bzhugs pas/ 'bum gling gi byams pa gong tses bzhengs zer ba de kong jo dang sgra nor ba 'dug ces gsungs stabs kan su'u zhing chen gyi byams pa 'bum gling zhes grags pa'i rdo sku byams chen de wun khreng kong jos bzhengs pa'i byams chen la ngos bzung 'dug de nas dbyar zla 'bring bo'i tshes brgyad nyin 'o thang gi mtsho 'gram ste da lta'i lha sa der slebs par bshad pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang zhang zhung gi rgyal bo li mig skya'i sras mo zhang zhung bza' li thog dman dang / mi nyag rgyal bo'i sras mo ru yong bza' rgyal mo btsun/ stod lung mong nas zhang blon gyi sras mo mong bza' khri lcam bcas khab tu bzhes/ btsun mo rnams kyi rang rang gis spyan drangs pa'i rten skal bzhugs yul lha khang bzhengs par bzhed pa na/ de'i sngon du rgyal bos mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gyi lha khang bcu gnyis bzhengs/ mtha' 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi ni/ g.yo ru na khra 'brug spu ru na ka stsal/g.yas ru na gtsang 'phrang gi lha khang / gtsang na grum pa rgyang gi lha khang bzhi'o/ /yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi ni/ kong po na bu chu'i lha khang / 'khon mthing gser gyi lha khang / byams sprin 56

dge rgyas kyi lha khang / spra dum rtse'i lha khang bzhi'o/ /zhes gsungs/ ru gnon gyi lha khang bzhi ni/ khams su klong thang sgron ma lha khang / 'bum thang skye chu'i lha khang / tshal rigs shes rab sgron ma'i lha khang / tshangs pa rlung gnon gyi lha khang bzhi'o/ /de dag re re la yan lag gi lha khang re re/ 'byung bo'i kha gnon gyi lha khang dgu sogasalha khang mang bo bzhengs so/ /de nas bal bza' khri btsun gyis ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje de'i nang du bzhugs su gsol/ rgya bza' kong jos ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas jo bo shākya mu ne de'i nang du bzhugs su gsol/ phyis su dus 'khrug gi dbang gis lha gnyis phan tshun bzhugs yul brjes pa byung / lha khang 'di gnyis da lta'ang yod do/ /zhang zhung bzas thirma bu bkog pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ ru yong bzas brag lha klu phug gi lha khang bzhengs/ mong bza' khri lcam gyis yer ba'i lha khang bzhengs so/ /dus skabs der 'bar ma stod kyi sa cha rnams kyang bod kyi chab 'og tu bcug de rjes badzoyul yang bod kyi mnga' 'og tu bcug de'i rtags su da lta'ang bal bo'i mi rigs kyi nang du gtsang dang / bla ma dang / shar ba/ rta mang sogs bod rigs 57

yod la/ bal yul du'ang de tsho bod pa'i mi rgyud yin par gleng ba ma zad/ bal yul gyi rgyal bo na ran ḍa ḍi sbis btsugs pa'i shi la ḍi sbis rdo ring nang bod la dpya khral phul ba'i lo rgyus kyang gsal bor yod zer/ zhang zhung ni sngar nas bod kyi rgyal phran zhig yin te/ gnya' khri btsan pos dbang bsgyur sa'i rgyal phran bcu gnyis kyi nang du'ang zhang zhung yod/ tun hong gi yi ge'i nang chu yos lor zhang zhung gi rgyal bo legs mi zhes pa bod kyi chab 'bangs su tshud/ ces pa'ang skabs re zhig mnga' 'og tu mi sgur bar ngo log lta bu byas pa slar mnga' 'og tu tshud par byas pa yin gda'/ 'di lta bu rgyal phran dang mi dpon 'ga' zhig gi ngo logagi 'khrug zing 'byung ba sngar ma zad phyis su'ang yod/ shing mo sbrul la srong btsan gyis blon po zhig mngags nas rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar lha khang bzhengs pa bu ston chos 'byung du gsal/srong btsan gyi btsun mo gzhan la sras ma byung la/ mong bza' khri lcam la sras gung ri gung btsan 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gsum thog rgyal sar 'khod kyang (spyi lo 686) me khyi lor dgung lo bco brgyad thog gshegs pas/ yab rgyal bo rang nyid kyis slar yang rgyal srid bskyangs/ sa sprel lor rgya nag rgyal bos rgya gar gyi rgyal bo har sha la mthun lam byed par sku tshab wang yun 58

snyetse rta ba sum cu bcas rgya gar du btang zhing / de rnams rgya gar du ma 'byor gong rgyal bo har sha 'das/ de la sras med par blon po ar 'jun zer bas rgyal sa bzung / ar 'jun nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i chos la mi dad pas/ rgya gar gyi mi ser spyi dang /bye brag nang ba rnams la mi bzod pa byung / ar 'jun gyis bka' phab ste rgya nag rgyal bos mngags pa'i sku tshab rnams la 'phrog bcom dang / wang yun tse dang zla bo gcig bros pas thar nas/ bod kyi mnga' 'bangs su gtogs pa'i bal yul du 'byor/ wang gis bod rgyal srong btsan la mgon skyabs zhus/srong btsan gyis bod nas rta dmag stong phrag bcu gnyis dang /bal yul nas rta dmag stong phrag bdun btang ste gyi har nang ti ra ha ti zhes pa'i sa char nyin gsum la dmag 'khrug byas pas/ar 'jun gyi dmag pham ste ar 'jun bod dmag gis bzung nas bod du khrid/ ar 'jun gyi dgra zla (a sam) ka ma ru ba'i rgyal bo ha cang dga' nas/ bod rgyal la rta dang / ba lang dang dngos skyes mang bo phul te gzengs bstod byas/ rgya nag gi rgyal bo ni bod kyi rgyal bo'i rogs skyor 'di lta bu thob par dga' spro tshad med skyes te bod kyi bka' drin dran pa'i phyir nga rtag tu sdod pa'i pho brang dang 'byung 'gyur dur khang gi mdun 'gram bcas 59

par srong btsan sgamapapo'i 'dra sku re bzheng dgos zhes bkod khyab gnang / zhes si mi tha dang 'bu shal sogs lo rgyus du mar yod ces bshad do/ / ride ltar chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis yi ge dang sgra sogs rig pa'i gnas dang / chos la brtson pa cher bskyed nas yun mi thung ba'i ring la sbyangs pa cher mdzad pas/ mkhas pa chen por gyur te bstan bcos mang bo mdzad/ dper na bka' chems kyi lo rgyus chen mo rnams dang / thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs cho ga'i rim pa brgyad/mdo skor le'u sum cu rtsa drug sgrub skor che phran gnyis/ chen mo la drug skor dang gsum skor gnyis/ de gnyis kyi bshad chos/spyi'i khog dbug sgos kyi bshad 'grel/ ṭīka dang bsdus don rnams dang / sgrub phran la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs dang /gzhan yang chos srid lugs gnyis kyi bstan bcos mang bo mdzad do/ / mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bcu gnyis/de rnams kyi yan lag gi gtsug lag khang bcu gnyis/ 'byung bo'i kha gnon du grags pa'i gtsug lag khang dgu sogs dang /ra sa'i gtsug lag khang dang / ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang sogs sgo0

btsun mo rnams kyis spyan drangs dzi'i rten bzhugs sa'i lha khang rnams dang / ri bo rtse lngar lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs ba sogs gtsug lag khang ches mang bo bzhengs ba dang / d+kurgya dkar nag sogs nas paṇa ḍi ta dang hwa shang mang bo spyan drangs nas sgra bsgyur sogs chos kyi bya ba dpag med bsgrubs/ rgya nag thang gi rgyal bo dang lo mang bo'i bar du g.yul bkyesanas pham par byas pa dang / 'jangayal nas bzung ste 'bar ma'i bar drag shugs kyis dbang du bsdus pa/ bod dmag 'bum phrag du ma btang ste/li dang bal bo rgya gar stag gzig tshun chad dbang du bsdus nas de dag gi sa dbya khral 'bul dgos byung ba/ zhang zhung 'a zha sogs rang gi mnga' 'og gi rgyal phran 'ga' zhig kyang skabs 'gar mnga' 'og tu mi 'du ba'i rnam pangayod pa rnams drag pos btul te bod rgyal khams gong bu gcig gyur byas/ mdor na phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad na dmag 'jug byas te dbang du bsdus pa ni/ 'dzam gling na 'gran zla dang bral bar grags so/ /gzhan yang nub phyogs stagagazig sogs nas nor longs spyod dpag tu med pa drangs te dmangs kyi 'tsho ba gong du spel ba sogs/ rgyal bo gcig la phyag rjes mdzad 'phrin 'di lta bu yod pa zhig gzhan la med par grags so/ / 61

de ltar bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po de nyid kyis rgya che zhing ya mtshan che ba'i mdzad pa rlabasu chen po rdzogs nas dgung grangs gya gnyis thog yab yum gsum ga sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa tha ma bstan te/ bang so yar lung 'phyongs rgyas su btab bo/ /dgung grangs gya gnyis thog gshegs pa ni sngon gyi chos 'byung deb ther phal mo che gcig mthun yin la/ de dag la ni lung rnam par dag pa'i khungs yod par ma zad/ rigs pas kyang 'grub ste/ de lta bu'i mdzad pa rgya chen po ni lo grangs nyi shu tsam la 'grub pa'i gnas med do/ /des na dgung grangs so gsum zer ba dang / so bzhi zer ba dang so drug zer ba dag ni/ rgyal bo 'dis chos byas pa la ma dga' ba'i phyogs lhung gi gtam dang ngag rgyun ma dag pa dag gi rjes su 'brangs pa'o/ / 'dir smras pa/ sngon bsags sa 'dzin sgeg mo'i lto ba las thon rin chen rdul mang bsags pa'i ri /lhun gyis yongs grub mi mthun rlung gis g.yo ba'i go skabs dang bral brjid pa'i sku/ /chos srid zung gi nyi zla'i rna cha 'chang zhing blon chen gser ris yongs su bskor/ / 6lha

'bangs kyi rgya mtsho'i dbus na 'gying ba'i srong btsan lhun po rtag tu rgyal gyur cig / mkhyen pa'i nyi ma rab tu 'bar bas gangs ljongs mun pa lhag med bcom/ / mthu stobs rta gdong me ri 'bar bas dgra sde'i tshang tshing lhag med bsregs/ / ci 'phrin las don zhags lcags kyus phyogs kyi yid 'phrog mdzes ma grogs su bkug / phyogs las rgyal ba'i rnga chen brdung bas g.yu 'brug khengs pa sa la bsnyil/ /rgyal chen dbyings su 'das kyang snyan pa'i rgyud mang da dung snyan/ / snyan pa'i dbyangs las drin dran yid kyi shing rta kun nas 'khor/ / 'khor med sku drin gzhal phyir tshig phreng me tog 'dab ma bzhad/ /bzhad pa'i mtsho skyes rkang drug dpal du slar yang bzhad par shog /de lta'i byung ba me na kā'i/ /rgyud mang sbrengs pa'i nyan bya la/ /chags pa'i ri skyes rgan po de'i/ /kun 63
