rtog rlung gi shugs sgra byung / /deng dus legs bshed sna tshogs 'od/ /ma bzod 'khun sgras rna ba 'tsher/ /mes po rma bya bsad pa'i ro/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan byed/ /pha rgan bsad pa'i dmar ba'i khrag /byu ru'i mdangs zhes ngo so byed/ /gces nor dor te mu to'i phye/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal bo lo/ /gna' deng rig pa rin chen dpya/ /phyur bur spungs pa'i phung bo las/ /mching dang nor bu 'byed pa'i mi/ /zho 'thung rus pa'i mched zlar gyur/ /phyogs zhen tshig gi zil ba de/ /mngar ba'i rkang drug zas so lo/ /rang rig 'joms pa'i khu char de/ /kun bden kun snyoms char du lta/ /ma rig dgra chen 'cha' ba'i stag /'dzum drug rgyas pa'i gra kha ngom/ /ma g.yeng rig gsal gzhon nu dag /gzu bo'i mig gis cer gyis ltos/ /ngang bas chu las 'o ma bzhine/ /bden pa'i bcud de 'ub kyis thungs/ /chu sna gar gyi gshis dor nas/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i rang gshis zungs/ /phugs bsam bde ba'i thang chen la/ /blo gros rta pho'i rgyug 'dur de/ /dran pa rin chen gser snod du/ /rtag bcangs 'dun pa lhod med zhu/ /zhes brjod pa ni rgan po'i kun rtog g.yo ba'i rlung sgra'o/ / 64

rī steg da/ nad sdod nad sprutsan zhogaska/srong btsan gyis btsun mo lnga bzhes pa'i gzhan la sras ma byung zhing / mong bza' la sras gung ri gung btsan 'khrungs/ lo bcu gsum lon tshe rgyal sar bkod/ 'a zha bza' kho 'jo mang rje khri dkar ti shags bya ba khab tu bsus pa la sras mang srong mang — btsan 'khrungs/ gung ri gung btsan lo bco brgyad thog gshegs pas/ srong btsan rang nyid kyis slar rgyal srid bzhes te sngar bzhin rgyalasrid bskyangs/ srong btsan gshegs nas dbon sras mang srong mang btsan dgung lo bcu gsum thog rgyal sa mdzad/btsun mo 'bro bza' khri lod khab ṭubazhes/ mgar stong btsan yul bzung dang / chims mang gnyen gnyis kyis blon gtso bo mdzad/ lo bco lngar rgyal srid bskyangs/ lo nyi shu rtsa bdun thog gtsang gi bar snang sgang du 'das te/ bang so gung ri gung btsan bang so'i g.yon du brtsigs pa deng sang bang so dag mjal rgyu yod do/ / mang srong mang btsan gyi dus su/ sngar srong btsan gyi dus su mgar sogs dmag dpon byas te rgya bod gnyis lan du mar dmag 'khrug byas skabs thang gi rgya dmag pham tshabs che ba'i zhe 65

nad du rgya dmag mang du brtsams kyang / blon po mgar gyis dmag dpon byas nas lan mang du pham par byas/ — phyis su blon po mgar yang dmag thog tu 'das/ de nas slar yang rgya dmag gi skad chen po byung bas/ jo bo lho sgo me long can du bcug sgo la zhal ba byas nas 'jam dbyangs kyi sku bris/ rgyal bo mang srong gshegs tshe yang rgya dmag byung nas pho brang khri rtse dmar bo bsregs/jo bo shākya mu no 'khyer ma thub/ mi bskyod rdo rje snga dro gcig gi sar drangs kyang 'khyer ma thub ste/ de skabs mgar stong btsan gyi bu che bas dmag dpon byas te slar yang rgya pham par byas pa'i lo rgyus rgya'i deb ther nang 'khod yod tshul sogs sngon gyi lo rgyus dag mthun mod/ kha cig na re/ de ltar yin na rgya nag gi rgyal rabs dang / tun hong gi yig cha'i nang nges par 'khod dgos rgyur zur tsam yang gsal med/ ces zer/ bod kyi lo rgyus gang yod rgya nag gi lo rgyus nang du yod dgos pa'i nges pa med par ma zad/ yod kyang khyed cag gis mthong ba'i yul du 'gyur dgos pa'i nges pa med pa dang / bod kyi lo rgyus gang yod tun hong gi gter yig nang du yod dgos pa'i nges pa med la/ gal te yod kyang da lta lag tu 'byor yod pa'i nges pa yang med par ma zad/ 'byung bzhis chud zos su btang ba'ang mang du srid 66

rda/ /des na de ltar smras pa ni khyab pa ma nges pa'i rtags sbyor ro/ /mdor na bod kyi lo rgyus nang du yod pas yod go r+shachod la/ mi rigs gzhan gyi lo rgyus nang du med pas med go rī chod ces ma smra zhig ces thal mo sbyar nas gsol lo/ / gzhan yang mang srong mang btsan gyi dus 'dir/ rgya nag gi sa khongasabyusu yod pa'i thu lu hun zhes pa'i mi rigs rnams phar 'ded kyi ched du dpung chen bsags/ de'i don du mgar stong btsan gru gu'i yul du lo brgyad bzhugs zer yang / mgar stong btsan de'i sngon nas gshegs tshar ba gong du bshad pa ltar ro/ /bod dpung gis thu lu hun phan par byas/ de rjes bod kyis dri ma 'khol zhes pa'i sa gnas su dmag gi rten gzhi chen po zhig btsugs/ thu lu hun rnams kyis bod kyi rgyal bo'i chab 'bangs su bka' brtsi khrims 'khur zhutrergyu'i mna' tshig phul 'dug de rjes bod dmag sda ram zhes pa'i sa char song nas an sha'i dmag sde bzhi blangs(ṭhakhrolngarmā) / rgya nag gi zhu'i ring go'i zer ba'i dmag dpon gyis dmag 'bum phrag gcig khrid nas 'ongs te bod la 'thab kyang pham nyes chen po byung stabs/ rgya nag rgyal bos kho'i dmag spyi'i go gnas phab bo de rjes bod kyi rgyal bo mang srong mang btsan gyis blon po 67

'dzin 'dzin—nes pa rgya'i skad yig shes pa zhig yod pa rgya nag tu sa mtshams skor 'dri zhib tu mngags/ rgya rgyal gyis mthong chen gyis sne len mdzad pa sogs la brten re zhig mtha' mtshams su zing 'khrug lobyung ba 'dra/ 'on kyang lo drug tsam gyi rjes sa yang bod dmag gis rgya'i yul gru shan co dang ko co zer ba gnyis bcom ste nor spos rnams bod yul du drangs/ de 'phral rgya rgyal gyis srid blon li'u jan go zer ba dpung bcas dang / gzhan yang ta'o hos dang / li li yu zer ba'i dmag dpon bcas lan cha'o la btang / dmag dpung de tsho ma slebs gong bod dmag gis grong khyer e cha'o dang / mi kong / tang ling sogs kyang bcom par brten grong khyer mang bo bod 'og tu shor/ rgya rgyal gyis dmag dpon tsho'i go gnas phab/ slar yang srid don drung yig chen yo lis cin wan la dmag spyi'i go gnas sprad thog ce nan zhing cherna dang shan nan zhing chen nas dmag bsnan te 'ongs nas long cir yod pa'i bod dmag la rgol nas pham par byas/yang bskyar dmag snon dang bcas bod kyi blon po mgar btsan gnyan ldem bu bzhugs pa'i sa cha ko ko nor te mtsho sngon du dpung 'jug byas skabs rgya'i dmag dpon li'u shan li zer ba dmag thog der bsad pas dmag rnams phyir bros/ slar yang lis cin 66

wan gyi 'og gi dmag dpon ha'i chi chang chi zer bas dmag khrid de bod kyi dmag sgar thog mtshan 'gebs byas nas bod dmag rozhig kha gtor tsam las/ bod dmag 'ded ma thub 'dug 'di dag spe lo ṭa zhes pa'i lo rgyus nang du yo da 'dug go/ /mang srong mang btsan 'das nas zhag bdun song mtshams/ lo der de'i sras 'dus srong mang bo rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal bo sgrags phur 'khrungs/ sras de dgung lo gsum la ma slebs bar du yab gshegs pa gsang rgya byas zer mkhan yod mod/ khu ngas rnam dag yod med ma shes/ nar son nas rgyal bor mnga' gsol/ mchims bza' btsan me tog btsun mor bsus/ mgar btsan gnyan ldem bu dang dbas ta ra khong lod gnyis kyis blon byas/ rgyal khams dbang du bsdus/ rgyal bo 'di'i ring la rtsal bo che'i mi bdun byung ba ni/ rngog ring la nag pos glang bo che'i phru gu theg rngog gling khams kyis g.yag grus po che theg gnon rgyal mtshan gyis mda' ste kha mas bya khra'i sked pa bcad/ dbas rgod ldongs btsan gyis mig rgyang gsum la mda' rgyang slebs/'gos g.yag chung gis sha ba'i rmid bu bye mas bkang ba klad la bskor/ cog ro 'brong shor gyis 'brong thur du rgyug pa gyen la 'then/ gnon khri bdun g.yu byin gyis rta g.yang la mchong ba 69

gyen la 'then nus pa'o/ /'di dag ni dmag dpon chen po bdun yin te/ rta dkyu ba la mkhas pa/ dmag 'thab la mkhas pa/ mda' 'phen pa la mkhas pa/ gri dbyug pa la mkhas pa/dmag ju sa la mkhas pa/ rkyang dang bang 'gran thub pa/ 'brong dang sbre bkye thub pa sogs dpa' rtsal shin tu che ba'i dmag dpon chen po bdun zhes grags so/ / mgar stong btsan la sras bzhi yod de/ mgar btsan gnyan ldem bu/ mgar khri 'bring btsan rgod/ mgar blon zi mdo ye/ mgar btsan gnyan srung ston te bzhi yin/ mgar btsan gnyan ldem bu ni blon chen yin pa gong smos ltar dang /gzhan gsum dmag dpon byas/ deb dmar gsar ma las/mgar gyi bu btsan gnyan ldem bus bod dmag khri tsho bcu khrid nas rgya'i rgyal khams pham par byas/ bod kyi rgyal bo gcig la mnga' thang dang mthu stobs che bar byed/ ces gsungs pa dang /mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ snga gong bod rgyal byon la mnga' thang che/ zhes dang / de'i mchan las/ d+ngha byang phyogs skar ma smin drug 'char ba'i mtha' sngon nags shod gzig phreng las ma mchis—pa la ga gon dang / hor dang sog po btul te sha ba hab kyi la rgyud la gtugs pa mnga' mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pa 70

ltar/ mgar btsan gnyan ldem bu sogs mgar sku mched bzhi rgya bod kyi rmes mtshams su bzhugs te g.yul bkyes nas dgra pham zhing so mtshams srung ba'i bya ba byas stabs rgya'i lo rgyus nang du'ang 'di bzhi grags che bar yod 'dug go/ /rgyal bo 'dus srong mang rje 'di'i ring la bod yul du ja 'debs pa'i srol da ra zhing / ja 'thung byed kyi dkar yol/dar snod dang dar tshe zhes bya ba bod rang gis bzos pa'i lo rgyus yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed du gsalatsā/ gzhan yang rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs dar bar bshad do/ /rgyal bo 'dis lo nyi shu rtsa dgur rgyal srid bskyangs par bshad/ 'das lo brgya phrag brgyad pa'i nang tha'i rgyal bos bod la mgo btags/ der brten bod dmag gi rogs ram rgyun du yod ces/ tun hong gi yig char gsal ba dang / yang de las smre ba zer ba'i sa gnas la gshegs/ zhes yod la/ de 'jang yul yin par bshad/ des na rgya'i yig cha'i nang / bod kyi rgyal bo ('dus srong mang bo rje) rang nyid kyis dmag khrid nas bal yul dang / rgya gar gyi byang phyogs la ngo log pa khag cig gnon pa'i phyir phebs skabs bkrongs tshul bris yod pa ni ma dag pa yin par shes la/ bod kyi deb ther mang che ba'i nang du 'jang 7/

yul du gshegs par gsungs pa ni dag pa yin no/ /bang so mang srong gi g.yon du hor gyi mi sdes brtsigs/ ming la bang so lha ri can zer zhes grags so / /sprudun pu/ shā rne gtsug burtan sdeska nagha tshon dad shāska zhadudaska puzhi ske/na/'dus srong mang rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi sras/ khri sde gtsug brtan/ sma ra can dang bgres nyams che bas/ mes ag tshom du'ang grags/ pho brang ldan dkar du sku 'khrungs/ nar son nas ljang mo khri btsun bya ba khab tu bzhes/ blon po sbas skyes bzang stong btsan/ mchims rgyal gzigs shu ting / 'bro chu bzang 'or ma gsum gyis byas/ gangs te se nas paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas gsang ba dang sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis gdan drangs kyang ma 'drongs/ 'on kyang pho nya bas theg pa chen po'i mdo sde lnga blo la bzung nas 'ongs pas/ glegs bam lnga bzhengs te bzhugs khang du brag dmar mgrin bzang / brag dmar ke ru/ gsang mkhar brag mchims phu nam ral/ ma sa gong gi lha khang dang lnga bzhengs/ rgya yul kong shi nas gser 'od dam pa dang / 'du‘shaṃ ba 'a/sa rnam par 'byeṅka pa dang / sman dpyad kyi rigs 'ga' 72

zhig bsgyur/ li yul nas rab tu byung ba spyan drangs nas gus par mdzad cing bod mi rab tu byung ba ni ma byung / nub phyogaṅkasu sngon la kem g.yag mig tshun chad mnga' 'og yin pa la/ rje 'dis de phan chad kyi sa tang tang zhes pa dang si gur btul te/ spu stag shad dung gi sgo mo la thug bar mnga' mdzad/ ces gsungs/ 'di ni a rab kyi sa khongs red zer mkhan yod do/ /btsun mo ljang mo khri btsun la sras yid du 'ong ba lha 'dra ba zhig skyes/ de nar sonarkunas khab ran pa na/ rgya rjerdziyag 'jam li khri bzher lang ma'i sras mo gyim shing kong jo zhes bya ba 5 yod zer ba thos nas/ de len rgyur blon 'bangs kha 'chams/gnyags khri bzang yang ston ngo g.yog dngos po'i skyes bcas mngags/ rgya the dngasgekong jos khas blangs te/ rgyu'i deb therarilas/ rgya rje 'khor dang bcas pas kong mkhar chen po zhing phed han gyi bar du skyel thung mdzad/ mkhar de'i gles can thar du bcug (btson grol btang) dmag dang ldab nor (khral) lo gcigal med par byas/ mkhar de'i ming yang gyim shing hen zhes btags/ rgyal bus bod du rta brgyugs pas rtas bsgyur te 'das/ zhes rgya'i deb ther du bshad pa dang mthun par/ bod kyi deb ther rnams su'ang / kong jo bod du ma 'byor gong du/73

bod du blon po rnams kyis rgyal bu gdan drangs te/ mtshan mo zla ba'i 'od la thams cad kyis rta brgyugs pa la rgyal bus kyang rta brgyugs pas rtas bsgyur te 'das/ bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/ zhes mthun par gsungs zer ro/ /kong jo bod du slebs dus rgyal bu 'das tshar la/ phyir pha yul du log ma 'dod nas/ yab mes ag tshom dgung lo so gcig thog tshobatsun mor mnga' gsol lo/ /jo bo shākya mu ne rgyal rabs gsum du mun par bzhugs pa lho sgo me long can nas bton te gtsang khang dbus mar bzhugs su gsol nas mchod pa btsugs so/ /de nas rgya bza' la khri srong lde btsan 'khrungs/ de'i tshe btsun mo che ba sna nam bzas/ ‘‘nga la rgyal bo'i gdung rgyud lus la yod do/ /’’zhes rdzun smras te/ rgya mo bza' la khri srong lde btsan pho brang brag dmar du 'khrungs ma thag rgya mo'i rtsar byung /shin tu blo nye ba ltar byas nas rgya mo'i bu chung phrogs te/ nga rang la skyes pa yin no zhes bsnyon byas so/ /der rgya mos rang gi nu ma bstan/ smre sngags bton/ cho nges bos kyang ma btang /blon po sbran/ rgyal bo la zhus pas/ sna nam bzas kyang rang gi nu ma la rang 'bab kyi rdzas byugs te/ nu zho 'ong ba byas nas blon po rnams la bstan pas/ blon po rnams kyang the tshom du gyur 74

kyang sna nam phyogs dbang che bas bya thabs bral/ der rgya mo'i burichung btsun mo che ba dbang che mas phrogs pas / kong jo yi ma rangs par bod kyi dpyad bzang ba 'ga' zhig nyams su bcug ces grags so/ / sras kyi lo 'khor te zhabs 'dzugs kyi dga' ston la/btsun mo gnyis po'i pha ming rgyasadang sna nam pa rnams bos/ der sna nam pa rnams kyis bu chung dga' bar byed pa'i yo byad/ rgyan dang / gos dang / me tog gi phreng ba rnams khyer 'ongs so/ /der rgyal bo'i pho brang du rgyal bo gong du bzhugs/ g.yas na sna nam pa rnams bsdad/ g.yon du rgya rnams bsdad/ blon po rnams 'tshogs pa'i dbus su/ rgyal bos 'bras chang gis bkang ba'i gser gyi phor ba sras kyi lag tu gtad de/ 'di khyed kyi zhang bo'i lag tu gtod/ ma gang yin gyi yid ches de la byed gsungs nas/ dmod bor te sras gom pa thub tsam de btang bas/ sna nam pa rnams kyis gos dang / rgyan dang / me tog gi phreng ba bstan nas bos kyang / 'gror ma nyan par rgya rnams kyi rtsar sing nas/ nga khri srong lde btsan rgya tsha yin/ /sna nam zhang gi don mi 'tshal/ /zhes zer bas/ rgya mo shin tu dga' ste/ tshe sngon ma'i las kyi 'phen pa yis/ /nga rgya 75

nas 'ongs pa'i bu mo la/ /sde 'gran med rgyal bo'i sras shig 'khrungs/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /de ltar khri srong lde btsan rgya bza'i bu yin par lo rgyus khungs dag rnams mthuno parom zad rgya bod gnyis char la yongs su grags shing mthun pa yin —la/ khrin te rdzong gi lha khang ljang khu'i dkar chag rgya yig gi nang du'ang de ltar bris pa bdag gis mthong / 'on kyang / tun hong gi gter yig nang du sna nam bza'i sras yin par bshad pa skeni/ sna nam dbang che phyogs kyi phyogs lhung gi gtam rgyun ma dag pa zhig bris pa 'dra ste/ lo tshigs kyang gud nas bsgrig tu med do/ /yang lo gcig lon pa'i byis pas gtam sno'adra smra ba la thugagadogs za ba ni thugs rin chen gyi bu ga dog par mngon te/ khye'u la lalo gcig lon tsam nas 'gro bzhud dang dz+ra brjod da ga pa dang / la līlo gsum bzhijilon yang da dung gtayomi 'chol ba lta bu sna tshogs shig de/nga dus su'ang yod par ma zad/ dmigs bsal can rna shes kyis yig gzugs 'dzin pa dang / rkang 'og gi lus shes kyis yig gzugs 'dzin pa lta bu du ma zhig deng dus yod pa par dang bcas tshags par thog tu bkram pa dang / dper na yus mas la sgrung 'bab pa lta bu mngon sum du gyur pa mang / chos lugs rmongs dad du brtsi zhing tshan 76

rig la yid ches pa ni sngon thon yin bsams mod/ 'on kyang thugs rgya ha cang dog mi dgos so snyam pa zhus pa lags la/thugs zur la phog na bzod par gsol lo/ /'jang tsha lha dpon gyi btsun mor bsus pa la dogs pa byed pa yang lo tshigs ma dag pa dag gis 'khrul gzhi byas shing / gzhan zer gyi rjes su zhugs pa'o/ /sras khri srong lde btsan dgung lo lnga lon dus yum 'das/yab rgyal bo mes ag tshom ni/ yar 'brog sba tshal mkhar du sku gshegs/ bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs so/ / rinargyud pu/ shā sprod rde sprutsan spyi sken/de nas khri srong lde btsan dgung lo bcu gsum thog rgyal sar 'khod mod/ sku na phra bas blon po ma zhang dron pa skyes dang /stag ra klu gong sigs dbang che bas/ rgyal bo'i thugs 'dod ma grub/ rgyal bo'i thugs dgongs ni/ yab mes kyi dus ltar chos byed 'dod kyang / ma zhang gis chos byed mi chog pa'i khrims bu chung bcas/ jo bo shākya mu ni bye them du sbas/ slar mi shis pa'i mtshan ma byung nes rnam par rtog pa skyes te/ rgya gar du skyel bar btang / mang yul snid grong du slebs pa na lam ma thar 77

bar snyad btags nas der bzhugs su gsol/ rgyal bo nar son pa na chos la dga' ba'i blon po 'gos khri bzang dang / zhang nyams bzang sogs dang gros byas nas/ 'gos kyis blo thabs phud de/ ma zhangad+ngha gson por dur du bcug stag ra klu gong byang phyogs su sgyugs/ jo bo mang yul nas gdan drangs te 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang rga bzhugs/ sang shis rgya nag nas spyan drangs pa'i chos po ti rnams rgyal bo la phul/ sba gsal snang mngags te mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho spyan drangs/ slar ya nga mkhan po'i zhal bkod bzhin slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs/ dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ mkhan slob gnyis kas rab gnas mdzad/mkhan po'i drung du sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung / der mthud rab tu byung ba mang bo thon/ khams yas mas rnams su chos kyi grwa bcu gnyis btsugs/ yer ba dang mchims phur sgom grwa btsugs/ lo paṇa rnams kyis sngags mtshan nyid kyi chosdo/ phal mo che bsgyur zhing 'chad nyan gyis gtan la 'bebs pa'i zhabs tog bsgrubs pa ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ches cher dar bar mdzad do/ /de rjes rgya nag nas hwa shang ma hā ya na byung ste/ tsen min dang don min te/ rim gyis pa dang cig char ba'i rtsod pa 7'i

byung / hwa shang pham nas rgya nag tu phyir brdzangs pa sogs deb ther rnams su shin tu gsal zhing rgyas so/ /rgyal rabs 'phrul gyi lde mig gam/ deb dmar gsar ma zhes grags pa las/ ‘‘bsam yas kyi rgyal blon 'di dag gi dus su yang rgya dang dbon zhang ma mthun nas dmag 'dren res 'ga' byas shing / lan cig dmag dpon lha bzang klu dpal bya bas bod dmag 'bum tsho gnyis khrid de/ shing khun dang / tsi'u mkhar dang / sman rtse'i yul sogs bcom zhes rgya'i deb ther chen mo las 'byung / ’ zhes gsungs/ rgya'i deb ther las bshad tshul ni/ bod rje khri srong lde btsan gyis/ blon po zhang rgyal lha snang / zhang mchims rgyal gzigs shu ting / stag sgra klu gong ('di byang phyogs su rgyang 'phud gtong rgyu'i stag ra klu gong dang mi gcig)/ lha bzang klu dpal rnams dmag 'bum phrag gnyis dang bcas la rgya nag phyogs su dpung 'jug dgos pa'i bka' stsal ba bzhin khong tshos rgya'i grong khyer cing cor dpung 'jug byas/ de ga'i spyi khyab ko hi zer bas bod la mgo btags/ de rjes spin ca'o nang khul gyi grong khyer phan si hun yang blangs/ de 'phral rgya rgyal tha'i tsung gis blon chen ko dzu ki dmag bcas mngags te lo gsum gyi ring lajigatugs kyang pham nas phyir bros/79

bod dmag rnams myur shugs dang drag shugasangang na sa/ rgya'i rgyal sa cwa rngan du dmag 'jug byas ska bas rgya rgyal gong ma snem cu phyogs su bros/ rgya'i blon chen ko dzu gi 'khor bcas so gas lho phyogs su bros/ bod dmag rgya'i rgyal sar slebs nas chibasdanang go wang zer ba/ khri srong gi yum gyim shing kong jo'i ming bo de rgya nag gi rgyal bor bskos/ dga' ston so gas byas/ rgya nag gisalo ltar bod la daphya khral 'bul rgyu'i chodabyuyig bzhag de nasponyin bcohalnga'i rjes su bod dmag rnams rgya nag gi rgyal sa nas phyir —'then byas/ zhes bshad yod 'dug 'di'i skabs kyi lo rgyus ni khri srong lde btsan gyi sku dus/ pho brang po sto la'i mdun gyi rdo rirogi ngos la brkos 'dug pa mthong rgyu yod mod chag grum chen po shor 'dug mthong thub pa gzhan gyis bshusapa yod do/ /gzhan yang khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs su rma chu'i byang phyogs su skyen po mi dgu ste/ dmag dpon stobs ldan dgu dmag dang bcas pa mngags nas sa khul de'i dgra bo dag cham la phab ste sa khul brtan por bsrungs/ lo mang song rjes dmag dpon dgus sa mtshams nas phyir log chog min gyi snyan zhu phul bar/ rgyal bos bka' ma byurnga bar du phyir ma log cig ces bka' phab par brten/ bka' ma log ces ming thogs/ deng sang yang de'i mi 80

rgyud la ming de 'bod kyin yod la/ rgya nag gi skad la deng sang sus nan zhes 'bod kyin yod zer la/ gang ltar dpal ris phyogs kyi bod mi dag dang / mdo smad kyi mi rgyud phal che ba de las chad pa yin gsungs/gzhan yang / rgya gar ma ga snya nas sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel spyan 'dren pa'i phyir du/ spre'agos kyis dmag dpon byas nas rta dmag bye ba kha shas song nas ma ga dhar dmag 'jug byas te/ ma ga dha'i rgyal bos dpya dang skyes lo ltar 'bul rgyu khas blangs/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing la mchod pa phul/ de ga'i mchod rten nang nas sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel bre drug spyan drangs/ chu bo gang gā'i 'gram du bod kyi sa mtshams byas nas rdo ring btsugs/ bye khung du lcags kyi ka ba btsugs so/ /gzhan yang / bod dmag a rab yul gyi og so gtsang bo'i pha rol tu'ang slebs te/ dbang du bsdus pa sogs phyogs bzhi'i rgyal khams mang bo dbang du bsdus/ lo rgyus rnying ba rnams su phyogs bzhi dbang du bsdus/ zhes bris pa ni don dngos gnas so/ ri /de'i skabs kyang bod kyi rgyal bo'i mnga' thang stobs shugs ni 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig yin te/ 'phyongs rgyas stag rtse'i zam sna'i rdo ring las/ btsan po yang mes lha mi'i 81

rjer gshegs te/ chos gtsug lag ni lugs kyis bzang / dbu rmog btsan po ni byin du che'o/ /lha btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi zhal snga nas kyang / yab mes kyi lugs bzhin lha'i gtsug lag ni ma nyams/ gnam sa'i chos dang ni mthun par mdzad/ sku yon yongs kyi brjod pa'i yi ge nam zhig rdo ring la bris so/ /dbu rmog btsan po byin gyis chab srid skyes pa la stsogs pa'i gtam gyi yi ge zhib mo gcig ni gud nas yod do/ /'phrul gyi lha btsan po khri lde srong btsan gyi zhal snga nas/ mtha' bzhi'i rgyal bo gzhan dang mi 'dra ste/ byin gyi sgam dkyel chen po dang /dbu rmog btsan pos yar ni ra zhig gi sa mtshams man chad/ mar ni long shan gyi la rgyud yan chad chab 'og tu 'du ste chab srid ni lho byang shar nub mtha' klas par che'o/ /de ltar chab srid che ba'i byin gyis/ bod yul che khong phyug tu gyurd pas/ nang nas kyang nam zhar bde zhing skyid pa'i gnas so/ /thugs la byang chub kyi spyod pa rlabs po che mnga' bas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos zab mo brnyed nas kun la bka' drin du byin no/ /de ltar 'greng dud gnyis la 'phral yun gnyis kyi bka' drin chen pos ma khyab pa med de/ myi yongs kyis mtshan yang 'phrul gyi lha byang chub chen por gsol to/ /zhes rdo ring de 82

las bshus pa dang / —yang / tshal ba'i deb dmar du rgya nag gi rgyal rabs deb ther drangs pa las/ de dus bod kyi mtha' bzhi ni/ shar du rtse'u/ mu ci'u/ su ci'u gsum yin/ lhor bram ze'i yul dang / byang hor gyi yul te/ de rnams bskor ba la dpag tshad stong phrag mang bo yod pas/ bod las dpa' ba dang / rtul phod pa rgya'i gong ma hān dang / g.yu dang / lci'u la sogs pa'i dus su'ang ma byung ba yin no/ /zhes rgya'i deb/ ther las bshad 'dug pa ltar ro/ / chos rgyal de la btsun mo tshe spong bza' me tog sgron/ 'bro bza' byang chub sgron/ pho yong bza' rgyal mo btsun dang gsum yod/ gzhan gnyis la sras med/ tshe spong bza' la sras gsum yod pa'i che ba mu no btsan po la rgyal sa gtad de/ rgyal bo rang nyid zung mkhar du sgom sgrub la zhugs/ de'i phyi lo shing glang (845)lor zung mkhar du sku gshegs/ bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs so/ /rgyal dbang gis sras 'bring ba mu tig btsan po rmoyin pa dang / mu tig btsan po dang sad na legs mjing yon gcig yin par gsungs pa ni/ rgyal bo'i bka'i thang yig la brten pa yin la/ thang yig la/ nor 'khrul mang ba dpa' bo 83

gtsug lag 'phreng ba sogs kyis bshad cing / rgyaladabang rang gis kyang du klu la'i gos bzang du/ thang yig gi lo tshigs sogs bsgrig thabasalhamed ces/ ma dag par gsungs/ des na lo rgyus ma nga che bar mu tig btsan po dang / sad na legs mi gcig par bshad pas/ de ltar don la gnas snyam zhing / mu tig btsan po zhes pa zhig deb ther mang che bar mi 'byung la/ gal te yod na/ sras che ba yin pa la/ chung dus nas gshegs pa 'dra zhes mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gsung / sad na legs kyi mtshan la khri lde srung btsan du 'chad pa ni sgra sbyor bam gnyis ma mthong ba'i skyon no/ /gsungs mod/ sgra sbyor bam gnyis su de ral ba can gyi mtshan byas pa ni yi ge ma dag pa shin tu gsal te/de'i skor la bu ston chos 'byung / deb dmar gsar rnying gnyis/deb sngon/ mkhas pa'i dga' ston/ bka' gtsigs chen mo/me long ma/ sa skya'i chos 'byung / klong chen chos 'byung /gser gyi shing rta/ rdo ring yi ge/ tun hong gi gter yig sogs gcig mthun red do/ /dgu bu/ nu ne+e butsan k+ko dad skad na zhegaska / skon/mu ne btsan po ni rga stag (822)lor 'khrungs/ yab byi4

rgyal bo ma gshegs gong rgyal sar bzhugs/ rgyal dbadz+wagis deb dmar dang / me long ma dang mthun par/ mu ne btsan pos lo gcig dang zla ba dgur rgyal srid bzung zhes bshad/ deb ther dmar bo gsar ma'i nang / ki gi spyan snga 'i chos 'byung sogs dang mthun par/ lo bdun dang zla ba dgur rgyal srid bzung bar bayad/ thang yig gsar ma'i nadz+wadu'ang loskegrangs 'di dang mthun 'dug phyag las sogs la dpag na de dag snyam/ btsun mo ru yong bza'(mdo rgyal)khab tu bzhes/ dge ba bcu'i khrims bzung ste/ sde snod gsum gyi mchod pa rgya chen po btsugs/ 'bangs rnams dbul phyug mi mnyam par mthong nas/'bangs kyi dbudziphyug lan gsum gyi bar snyoms par mdzad —mod/ sngar bzhin dbul phyug mi mnyam par gyur/ lo paṇa rnams kyis sngon gyi sbyin 'bras yin gsungs pas/ lhag par rnam dkar la yid ches par gyur/ mnga' thang yab mes kyi dus bzhin rgyas te byang du dpung chen bshams pa sogs mdzad pa dang phyag rjes rgya che mod/ yab kyi btsun rdzopho yong bza' rgyal mo btsun zer ba de lo gzhon cing gzugs byad mdzes pas/ btsun mo gzhan gyis phrag dog byed yong snyam du yab kyi thugs 'phreng bar gyur te/ zung mkhar du byon dus/ sras la gtad gnyer 85

mdzad de sras kyi khab tu bzhes yod pa la/ yum tshe spong bza' phrag dog skyes nas/ yab rgyal bo grongs dus/ pho yong bzas rgyan ma bkrol/ mya ngan ma byas zhes snyad btags te/ gshed ma bskos nas gsod du btang tshe/ sras mu ne btsan pos srung skyob byas stabs gsod ma thub/ yum ma dga' nas rang sras mu ne btsan po la dug drangs te dgung lo nyer dgu'i thog pho brang yu bur grongs so/ /bang so ni mes ag tshom gyi bang so'i g.yas ngos kyi mdun na yod do/ /'bring bo mu tig btsan po ni/sngar yab rgyal bo dang blon po zhang gnyis dmag srid sogs kyi don la bka' bgros skabs sgo srung la zhang rgyal tsha lha snang gi bu dbu ring bzhag pa la/ sras mu tig bka' bgros sar 'gro grabs byed skabs/ dbu ring gis bkag pas/ sras kyis chu gri bsnun te bkums/ blon po 'gos kyis zhal lce dga' gsum dang sdig gsum bcad de/ sras mu tig sa mthar sgyugs pa/rgyal sar 'don rgyu byas te spyan drangs mod/ lam du sna nam pas chibs dkrogs te lhung nas rta grir 'das/de nas sras chung ba khri lde srong btsan sad na legs mjing yon rgyal sar bton/ blon po mkhas pa bran kha dpal gyi yon tan/ nyang ting 'dzin bzang bo/ zhang mdo khri sher/ ngan 86

lam khri rgyal bzhis blon gtso bo byas te rgyal srid bskyangs/ blon dang bo gnyis rten rab byung yin mod nyams myong che bas blon du bskos pa red gsungs/ rgyal bo des rgyal khams la dbang bsgyur te dge bcu'i khrims bcas shing / yab mes kyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba dang / paṇa ḍi ta du ma spyan drangs/ lo paṇa rnams kyis sngon ma 'gyur ba'i mdo dang bstan bcos mang bo bsgyur/ skyid shod du dkar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs/ blon 'bangs thams cad la dam pa'i chos mi zhig cing / dkon mchog gsum bla mar bya ba'i khrims bsgrags shing / mna' bor/ bka' gtsigs kyi yi ge mang bo bris te rgyas btab nas mdzod du bzhag rdo ring la brkos pa sogs mkhas pa'i dga' ston du zhib par yod/ rgyal bo de'i ring la dkar chag 'phang thang ma dang / dkar chag ldan dkar ma bzhengs par gsungs/ 'di dang mu ne btsan po'i dus su rgya dang dmag 'dren res thengs kha shas byas pa dang / nub phyogs su 'brel ba rgya chen byas/ me long mar/ sad na legs kyi sras ldeng khri/ de la sras lnga byung bar bshad pa ni lo rgyus gzhan gang dang mi mthun pas ma dag pa red/ rgyal bo 'di me bya (877)lor 'das/ lo der ral ba can khrir bkod do/ / 87

naskyo spru/ shā nazha dad dan na rgog snya nyu skerna/ rgyal bo khri lde srong btsan sad na legs mjing yon la sras gtsang ma/ dar ma/ ral ba can/ lha rje/ lhun 'grub ste lnga/ dar ma 'u dum btsan chu lug (863)lor 'khrungag khri gtsug lde btsan ralab can me khyi (866)lor 'khrungs/ lha rje/ lhun 'grub gnyis chung ngu nas 'das/ gtsang ma rab spyo byung / darom blun zhing spyod pa ngan la sdigaspyod la dga' bas/spyod pa ngan na rigs don med/ ceyogasungs pa ltar/ rgyal bor mi 'os pa the/sa nas/ blon po nyams myong can rnams kyis gros thog nas/ khri gtsug lde btsan ral gcan rgyal sar bkod/btsun mo dpal gyi ngang tshul khab tu bzhes/ bragakha dpal yon sogs kyis blon po byas te/ rgyal khams ladabang bsgyur/ 'u shang rdo'i dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ paṇa ḍi ta mang bo sbyan drangs te lo paṇa rnams kyis mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang bo bsgyur/ lo paṇa rnams kyis sngar bsgyur pa rnams la dag bcos dang / skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab ste/ bye brag rtogs byed che 'bring chung gsum mdzad/ 'bring ba la sgra sbyor bam gnyis zer/ 'di'i dus su 88

yang rgya dang dbon zhang ma mthun par/ bod dmag khri tsho mang bo drangs te/ rgya yul gyi mkhar mang bo bcom pa'i skabs/ bod kyi dge 'dun pa rnams dang / rgya'i btsun pa rnams kyis bar byas nas bka' mol gyi mtshams sbyar te dbon zhang mthun par mdzad/ rgya'i gung gu the rur rdo ring btsugs te rgya bod kyi sa mtshams su bcad nas/ phan tshun gnyis kas sa mtshams las phyi rol tu brgal te dmag gi g.yul bshams pa sogs mi byed pa'i dpang du lha klu gnyan po bzhag ste bro bor ba'i yi ge lha sa dang / rgya rje'i pho brang / gung gu rmi ru gsum gyi rdo ring la bris/ dus der rgya bod gnyis mthun zhing 'brel ba bzang bas/gnam la nyi zla zung gcig dang / sa la btsan po dbon zhang zhes gleng / dbon zhang zhes pa'i don/ sngar mes ag tshom gyis rgya bza' gyim shing kong jo blangs pa la sras khri srong lde btsan 'khrungs stabs/ bod kyi btsan po rjes ma rnams rgya'i tsha rgyud du gyur stabs/ bod la dbon zer ba tsha bu'i ming / rgya la zhang zer/ de'i dus kyi chings yig skor gyi lo rgyus rgya'i ma/bas pa wang cung zer bas brtsams pa'i deb cig gi nang du gsal bo yod zer/ rdo ring gi ngos yi ge ni gzhan gyis bshus pa'i bu yig da lta'ang yod/ gung gu me ru ni ka ci'i mchod rten dkar bo yod 89

sa de red zer zhing / mchod rten 'di sangs rgyas 'od spung dus kyi mchod rten zhig yin zer ba dang / bdag cag gi ston pa'i 'phel gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten yin zer ba'i lo rgyus ci rigs snang / zhes gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar las gsungs/ 'on kyang mchod rten de lo bcu phrag 'ga'i sngon du bshigs nas/ der chu mdzod cig bzos yod/ da lta slar yang mchod rten zhig ri khar bzhengs yod 'dugargyal bo 'dis yab mes dus kyi khrims yig rnams gzhir bzhag nas bka' khrims legs par bca sa te/ ngan pa la chad pa gcod pa/ bzang ba la bya dga' ster ba/ mtho ba'i gnya' nas gnon cing / dma' ba thabs kyis skyong ba'i srol bzang phyogs kun tu khyab ste/ khyim na bag dro mi ni khong dal/ phyugs ni lo dang zla ba na sdud/ mi nyal mis slong / 'bri yan sna med/sgo la khyi med/ rje byams/ 'bangs gus/ grogs gzhung bzang / gnyen sha tsha/ pho ni dpa' bo dang / mo mdzangs la chas bzang / bod 'bangs bde spyid kyi dpal la gnas/ rgyal bo'i ral ba'i sne la dar yug btags nas/ de'i steng du dge 'dun bzhugs su bcug pa sogs dkon mchog gsum la gus 'dud lhur blangs/ dge 'dun re la mi khyim bdun re phu la to/ /90

rgyal bo 'dis bkas bcad gsum mdzad pa ni/ skad gsar bcad kyi bkas bcad dang / 'dul ba gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde ba las/ sde ba gzhan gyi 'dul ba mi bsgyur bar bkas bcad/ gsang sngags ma rgyud rnams mi bsgyur bar bkas bcad pa ste gsum mo/ /lha tho tho ri nas 'di'i bar la skyi da pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu gsum zhes zer/ mu ne btsan po yun thung bas phyed du brtsis/ mang srong ma bgrangs/ mes ag tshom nas 'di'i bar la shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs lnga zhes snga rabs la grags so/ /de nas/ blon po 'ga' zhig gi sems rgyud phrag dog gis dkrugs te/ blon chen po bran kha dpal yon dang btsun mo dpal gyi ngang tshul gnyis mthun zhes phra ma bcug nas/ ban de bran kha dpal yon bkums/ btsun mo gzhi med kyi phra ma des yi mug nas pho brang thog nas lcebs te shi/ btsan po khri ral dgung lo sum cu so drug thog lcags bya (901)lor pho brang ma zhar nyi ma la bzhugs skabs/ dbas to re dang / cog ro legs sgra gsang stabs su 'ongs nas zhal ltag par bsgyur te bkrongs so/ /bang so don mkhar mda'i g.yon phyogs su brtsigs so/ /91

de nas 'u dum btsan rgyal sar bzhag dbas rgyal to re dang / sbas stag sna/ nya nam rgya tsha khri srung sogs blon po byas /btsan po 'di ni chung dus nas gzugs ba lang gi sha tshugs dang 'dra zhing / blortul la rgyud gyong bas/ 'bangs rnams kyis glang dar ma zhes btags/ ming dngos la 'u dum btsan zer/ rgya'i lo rgyus rgya'i lo tsā ba ba hu gyang ju zer bas bod yig tu bsgyur ba las/ ‘‘rgyal bo 'di chang la dga' zhing spyod pa ngan pas/ bod kyi rgyal khams thams cad 'khrugs/ si ha ce'u la bod 'bangs dbang ba'i ri brtsigs yod pa 'gyel/ klu chu zhag gsum gyen la log ltas ngan byung zhing rgyal khams zhig pa yin no/ ’ /zhes bshad do/ / de nas glang dar kho rang blo rmongs shing yon tan med par ma zad/ yon tan can lasnying nas mi dga' bas/ chos byas pa bkra mi shis zer nas/ rma rin chen mchog dang / nyang ting 'dzin sogs lo tsā ba chen po mang bo bkrongs/ paṇa ḍi ta rnams sa mthar bskud pa dang / la la rang rang so so'i yul durtswas/rab tu byung ba la la sa mthar bros/ ma thar ba rnams khyim sar phab/ mi nyan pa rnams bsad/ la la khrid nas rgyal blon rnams kyis rta la 'bab 'dzeg byed tshe sgur du bcug nas stegs 93

byag la la'i lag tu rnga gshang dang mgo la khyim sar phab pa'i rtags bya sgro btsugs nas ri dwags rngon du bcug khyim pa rnams zhwa'i thog tu bya sgro 'dzugs pa yin la/ rab byung dag gis gos brje byed ma rnyed kyang mgo la bya sgro btsugs nas khyim pa yin tshul byed dgos byung / lha sa dang bsam yas bshas ra byas/ gtsug lag khang mang bo bshigs/ dpe cha rnams chu la skur ba dang me la sreg pa dang / sa 'og tu gnon pa sogs byas/ 'on kyang bsam yas ni rgyal sar cung thag ring bas ra sa'i gtsug lag khang lta bu'i gtsang dag byed ma thub par dpe cha mang bo shul du lus/ bod 'bangs rnams kyi 'tsho ba'ang nyin re bzhin je sdug la song / blon po dang mngag gzhug pa sogs kyis sdig btsir bzod glags med pa byas pa sogs kyis sdug bsngal gyi gnas su bcar rto/ / de'i tshe lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje ye ba brag lha ri na sgom byed —kyin yod pa/ nyin gcig sgom khang phyi la phebs gzigs pas btsun pa'i mgo la bya sgro btsugs/ lag tu rnga gshang thogs te lings byed pa(rngon)mthong bas/ rgyal bos bstan pa bsnubs shing / 'bangs rnams sdug bsngal ba'i gnas la bcar bar shes nas/ snying rje chen po skyes te rgyal bo ma bsgral na 'bangs 93

rnams sdug bsngal zhing / rgyal snabo rang nyid kyes kyang las ngan pa ches mang bo bsags nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ro dgongs nas/ rta zhon mda' gzhu thogs te rgyal bo gsod du chas/ de'i tshe rgyal bo gla ba'i tshal du mig mang rtse zhing 'dug pa'i thag nyer 'bangs 'dus te ngu 'bod byed cing (khrom skor)rgyal bo lags 'di 'dra'i bya ba ngan pa byed pa ni mi rigs so/ /yab mes kyi yig tshang dang dkor mdzod kyi sgrom bu rdo ring gi yikhyuge rnams la gzigs dang / zhes ngu 'bod byas pa'i 'ur sgra rgyal bos thos nas sems mi bde bar/ yar 'gro mar 'gro byas te rdo ring gi rtsar slebs nas/ rdo ring gi yi ge klog gin yod skabs/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje slebs te/ rgyal bo la phyag 'bul khul gyis phu dung nang nas mda' gzhu blangs te lcags kyi mda' 'phangs pas/ rgyal bo'i snying gar phog ste tshe'i dus byas so/ /'dis rgyal srid lo drug la bzung / me stag (906)lor glang dar 'das so/ /'di la deb sngon dang sum pa'i chos 'byung du/ me 'brug la khri ral bkrongs/ dar ma khrir bzhag gsungs mod/ mkhas pa mang che bas lcags bya la ngos 'dzin/ phyis kyi zhib dpyod mkhan mang che bane phyi ma de dag par bshad/ gzhan yang bstan 94

bsnubs lcags bya lo zhes mkhas pa kun mthun par gleng / des na bstan bdag rgyal blon btsun mo dang bcas pa bkrongs/bstan dgra rgyal blon dang bcas pa khrir 'gying nas/ bstan pa'i bsnyen bkur chad de/ bstan 'dzin la gnag pa'i lo de la bstan bsnubs lo zer dgos la/ mang che bas bstan bsnubs lcags bya lo zer ba dang yang mthun no/ / spruskyo gceg sko/ sdod zhiska dun gyun sko srogaska /glang dar bsgral ba'i phyi lo me yos (907)lor 'od srung dang yum brtan gnyis ka 'khrungs par bshad/ btsun mo chun ma tshe spong bza' btsan mo 'phan la sras gcig byung ba/ chen ma sne nam bzas 'phrog gam gsod ces dogs nas mtshan mor mar me'i 'od dang ma bral bar bsrungs pas mtshan la gnam lde 'od srung du thogs/ de'i tshe chen ma sna nam bzas kyang 'bangs dbul zhig la bu chung zhig nyos nas nga la yang bu chung zhig skyes zhes bstan pas/ blon po rnams kyis mdang skyes pa'i bu la so ni tsag tsig 'dug 'on kyang yum gyi bka' brtan du chug zer bas/ khri lde yum brtan du ming chags/ bu chung de gnyis nar son nas/ blon po rnams kyis phas chos bsnubs pas 95

bkre mi shis pa byung song / zhis bsnyad nas jo bo rnam gnyis dang byams pa chos 'khor ma spyan drangs te khri thog tu bzhugs su gsol/ mchod pa byas/ 'on kyang bstan pa nar ma ni ma byung 'dug de nas glang dar gyi sras rtsod med gnam lde 'od spung dang / dogs pa can khri lde yum brtan gnyis nang ma 'chams par/ yum brtan gyis dbu ru bzung / 'od srung gis g.yo ru bzung nas 'khrug pa byas/ de'i rkyen gyis bod yul phal che ba'i sde ba dang shog kha'i nang ma 'chams par 'khrug rtsod byung / yang glang dar gyi dus nas bod yongs sukhral sogs r+sha'atsham pa sna tshogs kyis mnar zhing / rgyal khrims zhig pas 'tsho ba sogs gang sa nas dka' tshegs byung stabs/ 'bangs rnams bod rgyadze+esrid gzhung la mi dga' bar gyur/glang dar gyi sras gnyis lo nyer gsum lon pa sa glang (929)lo nas rim gyis kheng log byung / thog mar dbas kho bzher legs steng zhes bya bas lag dpon byas te mdo smad du kheng log byung / de nas dbu rur 'brong dang sbas kyi 'khrug pa la brten nas/ dbas lo pho lo chung zhes bya bas lag dpon byas te— kheng log byung / de nas g.yo rur zhang rje gsas sne btsan zer bas dpon g.yu sne zer ba bsad/ khyim kong mi drug gis lag 96

dpon byas te 'od 'bar kheng log tu grags pa byas/ khe nga log byas nas dzo dgu ba me bya (937)lorashud pu stag rtse sogs mi bzhis gros byas nas bang so rnams bgo bsha' brgyab phal cher ske brus/ gnyags kyis don mkhar ma da' yi bang so brus/ shud pus seng ge can gyi bang so brus/ 'phrul rgyal bang so greng 'phyos khu yis brus/ sngo bzher snyi bas thob kyang 'bru 'phror lus/ srong btsan bang so 'bro dang cog la thob kyang 'bru 'phror lus/ zhes yig rnying las bshad 'dugasras rtsod med gnam lde 'od srung de pho brang yu bu bla sgang du 'khrungs/ so dgu ba shing sbrul (945)lor pho brang 'phang thang du 'das/ de'icesras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan shing bya (925)lor 'khrungs/ yab 'udas nas rgyal sa mdzad/ sman lung sogs lha khang brgyad bzhengs kyang / lo rgogacig thog stag rtse gnyags kyis bkrongs/ de'i sras bkra shi sa brtsegs pa dpaladang / skyid lde nyi ma mgon gnyis/ mi sde phal cher yum brtan la shor bas mnga' ris su bros/ mnga' rispokyi—blon po zhang ba tshab rin chen sde dang / cog ro legs sgra lha legs gnyis kyis bsnyen bkur zhus/ rgyal sras de gnyis spyod pa bzang zhing blo gros che bas mnga' ris kyi rgyal bor gyur/ spu rangs su sku mkhar 97

ṅka nyi bzung brtsigs/ blon po gnyis kyi bu mo re btsun mor phul/skyid lde nyi ma mgon dpa btsun mo cog ro bza' la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba dpal lde nyi ma mgon yang zer/ rig pā mgon yang zer ba des mang yul bzung / bkra shis mgon gyis spu rangs bzung / lde gtsug mgon gyis zhang zhung bzung / 'di gsum la stod kyi mgon gsum zer/ chung ba lde gtsug mgon la sras 'khor re dang / srong nge gnyis/ srong nges sku tshe'i stod la khab bzhes pas/ sras nā ga rā dza dang / de wa rā dza gnyis 'khrungs/ sku tshe'i smad la rab tu byung bas mtshan la lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces grags/ khong gis mthon lding gi lha khang bzhengs pa dang / khye'u blo rno ba nyi shu rtsa gcig rgya gar du rig pa'i gnas dang chos slob tu brdzangs/ lo chen rin bzang dang legs shes gnyis kyang 'di'i grangs yin/ rgyal bo khong yang chos dang rig pa'i gnas la shin tu mkhas/ paṇa ḍi ta warma gsum spyan drangs chos mang du bsgyur/ sku mched 'di gnyis sras rgyud dang bcas pa'i dus mnga' ris su 'bangs bde skyid dang ldan no/ /phyis su gar log dang ma 'grig nas/ gar log gis btson du bcug ste btson 'og nas 'das/ khong gi gcen po 'khor re la sras lha lde 'khrungs/ de la sras 'od lde/ pho brang zhi ba 'od/ btsun 98

pa byang chub 'od dang gsum yod/ btsun pa byang chub 'od kyis jo bo rje spyan drangs pa sogs phyag rjes che ba sogs lo rgyus rnams su grags che/ de'i gcen 'od sde'i sras mnga' bdag rtse lde/rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab rgya gar sogs su phyi nang gi rig gnas slob tu phyin pa la/ mthun rkyen rgya chen mdzad/ mnga' ris su chos 'khor chen mo btsugs/ mnga' bdag rtse lde 'di'i sras 'bar lde/ de'i sras bkra shis lde/ de'i sras bha ne/ de'i sras nā ga de wa/ de'i sras btsan phyug lde/ btsan phyug lde 'di ya tsher byon nas sa de'i rgyal bo mdzad/ de'i sras bkra shis lde/de'i sras grags btsan lde/ de'i sras grags pa lde/ 'dis sku gsung thugs rten rgya chen po bzhengs/ de'i sras a sog lde/'di bas rgya gar rdo rje gdan du mchod pa'i rgyun btsugs/ de'i sras 'dzi dar rmal dang / a nan rmal gnyis/ a nan rmal gyi sras re'u rmal 'di bas rgya gar rgyal khams mang bo blangs/ de'i sras sang snya rmal/ 'di'i sras la'ang 'dzi dar rmal zer/ de'i sras a 'dzid rmal gyis rgyal sa ma thob gong sa skyar rab byung mdzad/ slar rgyal srid bzung / de'i sras ka lan rmal/ de'i sras bar btab rmal/ 'di nas ya tshe'i gdung rgyud chad de/spu rangs nas mnga' bdag bsod nams lde spyan drangs nas ya 99

tshe'i rgyal srid bzung / satshan la bu khya rmal du grags/ de'i sras pri ti rmal dang blogapo dpal ldan grags pa gnyis kyis rtosar bcu gcig zhal gyi steng du gser thog phub bo/ /stod mnga' ris kyi rgyal bo 'asri rnams ni dpal 'khor btsan la sraspoganyis yod pa'i chung ba skyid lde nyi ma mgon la yang sras ga sum yod pa'i chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyi rgyud pa red/ bu ston rjes 'brang dag gis 'khor re rab tu byung ba ye shes 'od— yin zer ba tsam las mi mthun pa med/ 'di rnams kyi dus subod kyi mtha' mtshams su yod gshis rgya gar dang gar log gi rgyal bo kha shas dze+ernam par rgyal ba'i g.yul bkyes nas bod kyi —mtha' mtshams legs par srung ba las/ sa phag rin gtsang sogs kyi skabs ltar gyi nang gi sdogazar mang bo'i lorgyus mi snang zhing / rgya gar nas baṇa ḍi ta mang bo spyan drangs/ lo tsā ba mang bo la mthun sgrub dang / lha khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs nas dam chos rgya chen po spel ba'i lo rgyus las/ smad rgya nag sogs dang 'brel 'dris byas pa'i lo rgyus mi snang /'bangs la'ang byams shing / spyir 'bangs byings bde bar gnas par snang / rgyas pa ni la dwags rgyal rabs dang mnga' ris chos 'byung sogs las shes par bya'o/ /1glu

mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal la sras dpal lde/ 'od lde/ skyid lde gsum la smad kyi lde gsum du grags/ dang bo dpal lde'i rgyud pa las stod mnga' ris smad kyi btsan po rnams byung ba ste/ gung thang ba/ klu rgyal ba/ sbyi ba lha rtse ba/ glang lung rtsang skor ba rnams yin gsungs/ sras chung ba gyid lde 'dzad rta nag tu byon nas de'i rgyal bo mdzad/ de la sras drug byung ba'i lnga byang du gshegs te/ 'bro ba/ g.yas ru/ ru lag— nyang / mus sogs kyi btsan po rnams so/ /khri bkra shis brtsegs pa'i sras 'bring ba 'od lde la sras bzhi byung ba ni/ pha ba lde/ khri lde/ khri chung /nyag lde'o/ /dang bo pha ba lde'i rgyud pa gtsang ro nga sbub yul dang / gtsang rong / g.yag lde/ nyang stod stag tshal gyi btsan po rnams so/ /gnyis pa khri ldes rang gi sde 'bangs pra lde zer ba khrid nas mdo smad tsong kha'i yulamatsho khri shor rgyal mo ste/ deng sang mtsho sngon zer ba ru gzhis chags/ bod rgyadze+egadung rgyud khri lde ni yul de'i khri dpon byas/ pra lde'i brda 'gyur nas phyis su pra sti zer ba yin zhes thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma'i rnam thar 'ag gsungs la/ rgyal ṣ+pespyan snga don chen la sogs ba mdo smad kyi rgyal rgyud rnams 'di'i rgyud pa7khyod par bshad/ bzhi ba nyag 101

lde'i rgyud gtsang g.yas ru dang / skyi mkhar btsan po'i bar du yod pa de dag yin gsungs/ gsum pa khri chung yar lung du byon nas sku mkhar phying ba stag rtse bzung / de'i sras 'od skyid 'bar/de la sras bdun byung ba'i che ba rje tshwa khri 'bar dang / gcung spun drug las dang bo nas brgyud pa la g.yu thog sna mo ba/ 'phying nga ba/ don mkhar ba/ thang 'khor ba btsan po rnams so/ /gcungalhuspun drug ni lha spyan dang g.yu spyan gnyis/ 'di nas yar lung jo bo byung / da ra da nga lhun po gnyis/ 'od btsan dang gung btsan gnyis te drug go/ /'od btsan dang gung btsan gyi rgyud pa ni khra 'brug pa/ bying ba/ byar ba/ chu mig gog po na yod pa'i btsan po rnams so/ /g.yu spyan gyis bya sa bzung /de'i sras jo dga'/ de la sras gsum yod pa'i che ba la bya sa lha chen zer/ 'dis bya sa'i lha khang bzhengs/ sras gnyis pa khri dar ma la sras gtsug lde/ khri gtsug jo bo rnal 'byor/ jo bo smon lam dang bzhi byung / jo bo rnal 'byor gyis 'ban tshigs bzung / smon lam gyis sbru gu rdo'i gzims khang dkar bo brtsigs te bzhugs/ khri gtsug gis bya sa dang dpe sngon bzung / de nas brgyud pa yar 'da' ba'i btsan po rnams yin la/ jo bo rnal 'byor la sras jo 'bag lha chen/ lha ngam shod pa ste sras 102

gsum byung / gnyis pas 'chad spyil gyi gdan sa mdzad de lha lung gi dbang phyug ces grags/ jo 'bag la sras jo bo shākya mgon/ lha 'gro mgon/ lde bo dang lde chung / jo rgyal te sras lnga byung / gnyis pas 'chad spyil gyi gdan sa mdzad pas gzhan don 'phrin las che gsungs/ dngaribos gcung rnams tha dad du phog nas pho brang gnas chung btab/ de'i sras jo bo shākya bkra shis kyis pho greng rnying ma brtsigs/ chos rgyal pho brang zer/ de la sras lha brag kha ba dang / mnga' bdag grags pa rin chen te sras gnyis byung ba mnga' thang dpal 'byor shin tu che gsungs /phyi ma de la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba blo gros 'od de 'dis kyang 'chad spyil gyi gdan sa mdzad/ chung ba lha btsun tshul khrims bzang ste/ gdan sa thel du rab tu byung zhing / rgyal rabs deb ther chen mo mdzad/ jo rgyal gyi sras jo 'bar/ de la sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba lha zur khang ba/ 'dis kyang 'chad spyil gyi gdan sa chung ba rong khrom po rnams kyis dpon du spyan drangs/ de'i gdung rigs lho rgyud pa rnams te/ gnam lde 'od srung gi rgyud pa rnams so/ / de nas grwang dar gyi sras dogs pa can khri lde yum brtan gyi sras khri lde mgon snyan/ de'i sras rig pa mgon dang nyi ma mgon 103

gnyis/ nyi gamagon gyi sras nyi 'od dpal mgon/ 'di'i rgyud pa rlung shod/ 'phan yul/ mdo khams na mang ngo / /gcen rig pa mgon gyi sus sde bo dang rdo rje 'bar gnyis/ lde bo'i srayorgyud yar stod phug pa can dang / thang lha brag pa rnams yin la sde ba bsam bde ba yang 'di'i rgyud par grags so/ /rdo rje 'bar gyi sras khri dbang phyug btsan/ de'i sras tsha na ye shes rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras mnga' bdag khri ba/ yab sras 'di gnyis kyis bsam yas la zhabs tog dang / dbus gtsang gi mi bcus mdo smad nas sdom pa blangs te bsamastoya sa su slebs skabs ba stan dzispelaba'i zhabs tog legs par bsgrubs/ khri ba'i sras a tsa ra/ lha dge slong / lha bla ma bo gyi ra dzā gsum /'di'i dus jo bo rje bsam yas su phebs/ a tsa ra'i rgyud pa/'phrong bo ba/ lcang rgyab‘pa/ glag pa lam pa/ grib pa/ snye thang ba/ lum pa/ btsan pa rnams so/ /lha dge slong gi rgyud brtsedape bzhi ba dang / 'on rdo mon mkhar ba rnams—yin zer/bo khyi ra dzā'i rgyud la lha btsun sngon mo dang snyug rum pa dang / lha 'bri sgang ba la sogs pa bsam yas kyi lha rnams so/ /de rnams kyi rgyud pa phyogs phyogs su so sor gyes pa'i jo bo dang btsan por ming btags pa rnams yin la/ khri lde yum brtan gyi gdung rgyud sne04

rnams so/ / —rgyal rabs 'di dag ni zhu ba bo'i re 'dod ltar rgyal rabs deb therardzimang che ba dag dang mthun par bris pa yin la/ rgyas par ni ki ke'i chos 'byung dang / yar lung jo bo'i lo rgyus sogs las shes dalhas/ deng sang bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis brtsams pa'i lo rgyus dag ni/ chos lugs grub mtha'i phyog sa zhen sha stag las dag mo gcig kyang med pas khungs subyed mi rung / khungs rnam dag ni tun hong dang rgya nag rgya ser sogs kyi yig cha las shes dgos so zhes pa'i gtam gyis dus deb sna tshogs gang 'dug mod/ gong du bshad pa 'di dag zhib ba thar chags ni de dag las rnyed pa'i gnas med kyang ma dmigs so / /:la spruskyo ghahaṃska da/ ska k+ṣiṃbuzhi zho rgyuska/sa skya ba 'i lo rgyus ni/ de yang 'khon dkon mchog rgyal bos sa skya'i dgon pa btab nas sa skya ba zhes grags pa de byung la/'di'i rigs rgyud byung tshul ṣ+karnam thar dang / deb ther dag las byung ba 'di ltar/ la stod mnga' ris sa'i char/ gnam nas skye ring / g.yu ring / g.yu bse ster+shaspun gsum byung ba'i chung ba g.yu bse yul mi'i dpone du gyur/ de la sras bzhi byung 105

ba la si ji li spun bzhi zhis grags/ de bzhis ldong rus chen bco brgyad dang 'thab skabs/ g.yu bse'i gcen g.yu ring gis rogs mdzad de ldong rus chen bco brgyad btul nas munga' 'og tu bsdus/ g.yu ring gis rmu'i bu mo dmu sa ldeb bu khab tu bsus pa la sras ma sangs spun bdun byung bar grags/ spun bdun gyi tha chung gis/ thog lha 'od chen gyi bu mo thog tsam 'ur ma khab tu bsus pa la/9 thog tshad dpa' bo stag byung / des mon bza' mtsho mo rgyal khab tu bsus pa la/ sras g.ya' spang skyes 'khrungs/rgya bod yig tshang du 'di thog tsha dpa' bo stag gi tsha bu yin par bshad/ g.ya' spang skyes 'dis/ srin po skya rengs khrag med kyi chung ma g.ya' grum bsil ma phrogs te/ srin po skya rengs khrag med bsad/ g.ya' grum bsil ma la sras gcig 'khrungs pa de/srin po dang 'khon pa'i bar du skyes pas ming 'khon par skyes zhes btags/ de'i rgyud pa la 'khon zhes grags pa'i mi rgyud de byung / 'khon par skyes kyis jo mo btsan mo bza' lce sman khab tu bsus pa la sras dpa' bo che 'khrungs/ de cher skyes dus/yab kyis yul bzang bo zhig btsal du btang bas la stod gnyan rtse thang gi ya changs la/ yul gyi dge mtshan brgyad tshang bar mthong nas sa de bzung / mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyi snye06

mdun na 'don du gyur te/ rlangs lo tsā ba'i bu mo lha sa khrim bu khab tu bzhes pa la sras khren mdzes/ lha legs/ tshe la dbang phyug 'khon klu'i dbang bo tshe 'dzin te bzhi 'khrungs/ 'khon klu'i dbang bo ni/ mkhan po bo ti sa twa las rab tu byung ba'i sad mi mi bdun gyi gcig yin/ de la rab tu ma byung gong sras drug byung ba'i drug pa shes rab yon tan la sras gnyis byung ba'i chung ba byang du chad de de'i rigs rgyud la 'khon tsho stod smad gnyis su gyes/ che ba yon tan 'byung gnas la sras gsum byung ba'i bar ba tshul khrims rgyal bo/ de la sras gsum byung ba'i che ba rdo rje gtsug tor shes rab/ de la sras bdun byung ba'i chung ba dge skyabs/ de'i sras dge mthong / de'i sras bal bo/de'i sras shākya blo gros/ de la sras gnyis las/ che ba rog shes rab tshul khrims/ 'di rten rab byung / chung ba 'khon dkon mchog rgyal bo rab byung dang bo'i shing khyi (1034)lo la 'khrungs nas/ rab byung gnyis pa'i chu rta (1102) lo la dgung lo drug cu re dgu'i thog gshegs/ khong gis rab byung dang bo'i chu glang (1073) lor saskya'i dgon sde chen po btab/gsang ni'u thog dang btab lo gcig yin gsungs/ de nas bzung dpal ldan sa skya ba zhes grags pa byung / 107

rab byung gnyis pa'i chu sprel (1092) lor yab dkon mchog rgyal bo dang / ma cig zhang mo gnyis la sras sa chen kun dga' snying bo tre'akhrungs/ dgung lo bcu gcig thog yab gshegs pas/ ba ri lo tsā bas gdan sa lo brgyad la mdzad/ de na sa khong gis gdan sa mdzad de/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa bdun thog rab byung gsum pa'i sa pho stag ṣ+kalo (1158) la zhi bar gshegs/ sa chen la sras bzhi byung ba'i dang bo kun dga' 'bar rgya gar du phyon pa ma ga snyar gshegs/ gnyis pa slob dpon bsod na.oṃs rtse mo rab byung gnyis pa'i chu pho khyi'i (1142) lo lha'akhrungs/ yab mes kyi chos 'bras bu'i theg ba dang / gsang phur cha ba chos seng bsten nas lo bcu gcig la rgyu'i theg pa la gsan sbyong mdzad/ 'di bas gdan sa ma mdzad/ sa chen gyi sras gsumajipa rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung gsum pa'i me mo yos (1 147)lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gnyis thog yab gshegs/ bcu gsum thog gdan sar byon/gsang sngags kyi bstan pa'i srog bzung / dgung lo bdun cu ba rab byung bzhi ba'i me byi (1216) lo la gshegs/sa chen gyi sras bzhi ba dpal chen 'od po rab byung gsum pa'i lcags pho rta (1150) lor 'khrungs/ mkhas chen de nyid 108

dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog gshegs/ de la sras gnyis las che tha sa skya paṇa ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan ni rab byung gsum pa'i chu stag (1182)lor 'khrungs/ rje btsun bsod nam sa rtse mo gshegs lo red gsungs/ chung ba zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan rab byung gsum pa'i shing 'brug (1184)lor 'khrungs/dgung lo nga drug pa rab byung bzhi ba'i sa phag (1239)lo la 'das/ de la srasachos rgyal 'phags pa/ 'gro mgon phyag na/rin chen rgyal mtshan/ ye shes 'byung gnas dang bzhi yod/phyag na'i sras snyarma pā la/ ye shes 'byung gnas kyi sras bdag nyid chen po bzang bo dpal/ 'di ba la sras bcu gnyis yod pa'i gnyis chung ngu nas gshegasasgozer/ de dag sogs sposkya'i gdung rabs rnams ni lo rgyusamang bo'i nang du shin tu rgyas gastabs 'dir bris na nyog 'gro bas mi sgro'o/ /de yang sa skya paṇa ḍi tas mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsuyogyisadus 'da' bar mdzad pas/ snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs kun tu rgyas/ gdan sar lo sum cu so lngar bzhugs/ dgung lo re gsum bzhes pa rab byung bzhi ba'i shing 'brug sko(1244)lo la hor rgyal go tan gyis gdan drangs/ 'dir hor rgyal gyi byung ba mdo tsam brjod na/ hor jing gir rgyal bo 109

zhes grags pa'i dbang sdud can de rab byung ga sum pa'i chu rta (1162) lo la skyes pa red zer/ khong lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad lon dus pe te zhes sog po'i sde chen po zhig gi rgyal bor gyur/ kho ni thabs la mkhas shing dpa' rtsal 'dzom pa zhig yin 'dug la/kho la bu dpa' rtsal blo rig ldan pa bzhi dang / blon po mkhas pa dgu yod par bshad/ rim gyis kho'i mnga' thang rgya bskyed de yul khams mang bo dbang du bsdus/ byang phyogs u ru si dang /shar lho'i rgya nag yongs la dbang bsgyur/ kho'i sras che ba 'jor ji zer ba tho mog yul gyi rgyal bor bskos/ bu gnyis pa cha ga ta'i zer ba u ru si dang thod dkar yul gyi rgyal bo byas/ de la bu lnga sdod pa'i che ba ab to zer ba rang gi pha'i rgyal sar bsdad/gnyis pa i ma ma hu li zer ba nub phyogs kyi tur k+ṣi sogs kyi rgyal bo byas/ gsusdo pa a tir ma hā ma zer ba rgya gar gyi rgyal bo byas/ bzhi ba kong khar zer ba ro 'om phyogs kyi rgyal bo byas/lnga ba the mur zer ba o rod kyi rgyal bo byas/ jing gir rgyal bo'i bu gsum pha u go ta'i zer ba/ jing gir rgyal bo rang gi rgyal sar bzhag 'di'i bu che ba go yug dang / go tan gnyis kyang rgyal sar bsgrud par ma zad go tan lang gru phyogs kyi khams rgyal byas te/ bod kyi sa sne dag la'ang the gtogs byas/ jing 110

gir rgyal bo'i bu tho lo no yon zer ba mug tun mkhar du bsdad de man ju dang rgya'i khams rgyal byas/ de la bu bzhi yod pa'i dang bo hor se chen rgyal bo zer ba des/ pha'i shul bzung bar ma zad rgya sog kun la dbang bsgyur pa'i rgyal bo chen po byas so/ /rab byung gsum pa'i shing mo yos (1195)lo la hor jing gir rgyal bo'i dmag bod kyi sa mtshams su slebs skabs/bod kyi sde dpon so sos dmag blog thabs su dmag dpon rnams la rgyu nor gtos chen bskur te/ deng phyin chad hor la khral 'jal rgyu yin zhes sogs kyi 'phrin btang nas re zhig bzlogade rjes lo skor gcig gi 'phror rab byung bzhi ba'i me yos (1207)lo la yang sog dmag bod du slebs pa 'gog thabs su ldab nor phran bu re ster rgyu byas 'dug zer/ hor jing gir rgyal bo rang lo drug cu'i thog rab byung bzhi ba'i me mo phag gi (1227)lo la tsha ba'i nad byung nas 'das/ u go ta'i rgyal sar bkod/ bod kyis lo shas la ldab nor te khral ma sprad stabs/ khams rgyal go tan khros te rab byung bzhi ba'i lcags pho byi ba'i (1240)lo la dmag dpon li ci dang / dor rta nag po dmag khri gsum dang bcas btang nas/ mdo stod smad kyi mi mthong tshad bsad/ grong sde mang bo bcom/ rgyal lha khang sogs 111

gtsug lag khang du ma mer bsrigs/ so ston sogs rwa sgreng gi grwa ba lngabak+ṣiṃlhag bsad/ bod kyi rgyal khams cham la phab/ slad nartswamanga' 'og tu bcug ste/ lung bsgyur ba ni sa skya ba dang ma/chod yon du 'brelasab yin/ zhes paṇa bsod nams grags payogasungs/de nayolang gru na yod pa'i khams kyi rgyal bo go tan gyis dor rta la/ deng dus bod na su bzang dris pas/ dor rtas/dge 'dun gyi sde ni bka' gdamasapa mang / mi chos ristag lung ba mkhas/ gzi brjid ni 'bri gung ba che/ chos ni sa skya paṇa ḍi ta ma khas/ zhes lan phul bas/ dge 'dun mang yang tshang ma gdan 'dren mi thub/ mi chos la nga yang mkhas/ gzi brjid ni nga che/ nga la dgos pa ni chos la mkhas pa dgos zer nas/gser yig pa rdor sri mgon dang / dpon jo dar gnyisabaka' shog dang 'bul ba gtos chen po bcas gdan 'dren du mngags/khong gis kyang khu bo grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi lung bstanathugs la shar nas/ dbon (tsha bu)'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dgung lo bcu lon pa dang / phyag na drug lon pa gnyis/ phyag phyir khrid de byon/ rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas chos kyis tshim bar mdzad/ de nas bzung ste hor rgyal dang sa skya ba mchod yon du 112

'brel ba'i 'go tshugs/ hor rgyal gyis 'jom gling gi yul khamasamang bo dbang bsgyur yod/ bod sil bur 'thor zhing gcig gyur med pas/ hor gyi ngo ya mi yong bar ma zad/ ngo ma bltas na gyong chen po rag yong dgongs nas/ sa paṇa gyis bod yongs la hor gyi ngo blta dgos tshul gyi chab shog rgyas pa gnang / de'i stabs kyis re zhig hor dmag gis bod la gsod bcom chen po ma byung ba red/ dgung lo bdun cu bzhes pa rab byung bzhi ba'i lcags phag (1251)lo la lang gru sde bzhi'i nang tshan sprul ba'i sde'am me tog ra ba'i sde zhes bya bar gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus/ de'i skabs khong gi dbon (tsha bu)'gro mgon 'phags pa dgung lo bcu bdun yin gsungs/ de'i phyi lor go tan yang 'das/ hor dmag bod du slebs nas mon mkhar mgon po gdong bcom nas mi shin tu mang bo bsad/ rgyal tsha dang jo 'bar zer ba'i bod kyi mi chen gnyis kyang bsad/'phags pa rin po che dgung lo bcu dgu'i thog se chen rgyal bus gdan drangs te bla mchod mdzad/ dgung lo nyer gcig thog mdo khams su phebs nas mkhan po grags pa seng ge las ba snyen par rdzogs/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i lcags sprel (1260) lo la se chen rgyal bo rang lo zhe drug thog rgyal sar 113

'khod de rgya sog man gsum sogs mi rigs du ma la dbang bsgyur/ 'phags pa rin po che gong ma'i rgyal sar phebs/ gong masariban dhe shed skyed kyi 'ja' sa thog mar gnang / rgyal bo dang btsun mos gtsos rgyal blon skal ldan nyer lnga la yi dam kye rdo rje sogs kyi dbang lan gsum gyi bar bskur/ hor gyi rgyal khams su gsang sngags bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ dbang dang bo'i yon du bod khri skor bcu gsum phul/ gnyis pa'i skabs su bod chol kha gsum phul/ gsum pa'i skabs su dbang yon du rgya'i mi yul chen po zhig phul/ rten gsum gser dngul dang dar gos sogs dngos skyes phul ba ni bgrangs kyis mi lang / dgung lo so gcig thog bod du phebs/ slar dgung lo so lnga'i thog gong ma'i pho brang du phebs/ lo bdun la bzhugs nas dgung lo zhe gnyis pa la sa skyar phebs/ sa skya ba bod chol kha gsum gyi bdag por gyur stabs/ bla mas bla ma'i bya ba mdzad/ dpon na rim du bskos pa rnams kyis 'jig rten rgyal srid kyi bya ba mdzad do/ /sa chen kun dga' snying bo dang / khong gi sras slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gsum rten dge bsnyen yin stabs/ dkar bo rnam gsum zer/ sa skya paṇa chen dang / 'gro mgon 'phags pa gnyis rten dge slong yin 114

gshis/ dmar bo rnam gnyis zer/ 'di rnam pa lnga la sa skya gong ma rnam lnga zer zhing / gong ma rnam lnga'i gsung 'bum sde dger shing par yod/sa skya'i chos sde chen po'i gdan sa ba thog ma ni/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal bo dang / ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen kun snying /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇa chen rnams yin/ 'di rnams kyi dus su sa skya ba zhes snyan grags rab tu che ba las/ bod yongs la sa skyas dbang bsgyur pa min la/ bod yongs la dbang bsgyur pa ni chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dus nas yin te/ se chen rgyal bos bla ma 'phags pa la bod chol kha gsum phul ba nas bzung bod khams yongs la dbang bsgyur te/ dpon chen rim par bskos pa rnams kyis bod kyi srid dbang bzung / khri skor bcu gsum la khri dpon re re bzhag mdo stod dang mdo smad la dpon kha shas bzhag ste srid dbang brtan por bzung zhing / rgyab brten sa sog rgyal gong ma byas so/ /'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa sa paṇa gyi rjes su gdan sar bzhugs shing / dgung lo zhe drug steng gshegs/ de rjes phyag na'i sras rnyarma pā la rten dge bsnyen/ gdan sa lo bdun mdzad nas lo nyi shu'i thog gshegs rjes/ gdan sa 'dzin pa'i snye1bya

gdungartsorgyud med gshis/ chos rje khu dbon gyi slob ma shar ba sher 'byung gi srayogasum pa shar ba 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal ji mtshan gyis gdan sa'i khur bzung nas/ 'chad nyan sgom sgrub sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po losum cu'i ring dze+ebasgrubs pas byas rjes che zer/ zangs tsha'i sras slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas kyi sras su/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal 'khrungs pa de nyid/ snyarma pā las sa skya'i gdung rgyud dngos min zhes phra ma bcug par brtonartsorgya mtsho chen po'i gling chung zhig tu phebasardzidagos byung / phyis su gdung rgyud nyag phra bar brten/bad ga nyid chen po gdan drangs chog pa'i mi sna gong du btang nas/ ga nang ba thob ste bdagartenyid chen po sa skyar gdan drangs/gdan sa'i khrir—bzhugs/ gdung rgyud spel ched bdag mo bdun bzhes/ sras du ma byung / gdan sa lo bcu bdun bskyangs te dgung lo re gsum thog shing pho byi ba'i (1324)lo la bzhi thog gzims khang du gshegs rjes/ sras che ba nam ma kha' legs pas gdan sa lo bcur bzung / de'i skabs bdag nyid chen po'i bdag mo gsum pa'i sras ti kri kun dka'e blo gros kyis/ gcung srasangarnams la/ bzhi thog bla brang / rin chen sgang bla brang /lha khang bla brang / dus mchod bla brang ste bla brang bzhi so sor bgos sne16

shing / gdung rgyud bgres rim gyis gdan sa mdzad rgyu'i srolabatod do/ /sa skya bas dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ mdo stod mi'ichol kha/ mdo smad rta'i chol kha ste/ bod bo 'i chol kha gsum ladabang bsgyur/ dbus gtsang du—bod khri skor bcu gsugabyas ba ni/ la stod lho byang / gur mo/ chu mig shangs/ zha lu ste gtsang khri drug rgya ma/ 'bri gung / tshal ba thang bo che ba/ phag gru/ g.ya' bzang ste dbus kyi khri drug dbus gtsang gi mtshams su yar 'brog stag lung khri skor gcig ste bod khri skor bcu gsum du bgos/ khri skor re la khri dpon re dang / khri dpon re'i 'og tu stong dpon bcu re bskos shing / mdo stod smad du'ang dpon bzhag nas dbang bsgyur 'dug go/ /de ltar bod yongs la dbang byed pa'i dpon chen rim par bskos pa ni/ dpon chen dang bo dpon chen shākya bzang—bo/'dis sa skya'i lha khang chen mo'i lcags ri phyi nang dang / khang gsar chen mo brtsigs/ 'di mdo smad bka' galog gi mi yin gsungs/de 'das nas dpon chen gnyis pa nang kun dga' bzang bo dpon chen du bskos/ 'di'i skabs bla ma 'phags pa rin po che dang / dpon chen kun dga' bzang gi bar du nye gnas kyis phra 117

ma bcug nas/ bla ma thugs ma dgyes/ 'di khog tu bzhag nas nye gnas kyis lkog tu rgyal bo la yi ge phul rkyen bla ma gshegs/nye gnas kyis hor dmag bod du bos pa bla mas shes dogs nas nye gnas kyis bla ma dug gis bkrongs pa red/ ces kyang zer/gang ltar bla ma 'phags pa dgung lo zhe drug thog gshegs/ rab byung dang bo'i lcags sbrul (1281)lo la se chen gyi lung gis hor dmag bod du slebs te nyang smad bya rog rdzong phab nas dpon chen kun dga' bzang bo bsad/ kho 'chi khar gos dkar bo gyon nas zhwa nag po gyon pa/ nyes pa med pa'i brdar go nas/se chen gyis zhib 'jug sgos dmag dpon rnams la chad las drag po btang 'dug zer/ dpon chen gsum pa zhang btsun/ bzhi ba phyug po sgang dkar ba/ lnga ba byang rin/ byang rin la se chen gyis shel dam gnang / drug pa dkon gzho na/ bdun pa gzhon dbang / 'di'i ring la che gsal chen mo dang dbuyogatsang gi khrims kyi zhib cha byas gsungs/ brgyad pa byang rdor/ dgu ba ang len/ da pon 'di gsugagyi ring la 'bri gung ba dang 'thab/khyad par ang len gyi skabs/ rab byung lnga ba'i shing bya (1285)lo la 'bri gung ba'i dmag gis bya yul dgon mer bsregs/ bla ma gtsang ston bkrongs/ stod hor gyi rgyul bo hu la'i ha'i dmag //byi

khrid nas/ sa skyar dmag drangs te/ sa skya gtor nas dbang cha 'phrog rtsis byas skabs/ ang len gyis khri skor bcu gnyis kyi dmag bsdus te/ rab byung lnga ba'i lcags stag (1290)lo la 'bri gung ba'i thog tu dmag drangs nas 'bri gung gi gzim spyil ma gtogs thams cad me la bsregs/ 'bri gung gling log tu grags pa'i bcom khyer /chen po de byung / dwags po sogs su dmag drangs pa'i sa mtshams kyi brag la ang len gyi ming bris 'dug zer/ sa skya'i dpon chen zhig la drag shul 'di las che ba ma byung zer/ ang len gyi rjes su gzhon dbang yang bskyar dpon chen du bskos kyang lam nas g.yog gis bsad/ de rjes dpon chen bcu ba legs pa dpal/ bcu gcig pa seng ge dpal/bcu gnyis pa 'od zer seng ge/ bcu gsum pa kun dga' rin chen/ bcu bzhi ba don yod dpal/ bco lnga ba yon btsun/bcu drug pa 'od zer seng ge yang bskyar bskos/ bcu bdun pa rgyal ba bzang bo/ bco brgyad pa dbang phyug dpal/ bcu dgu ba bsod nams dpal/ nyi shu ba yang bskyar rgyal ba bzang bo bskos/ 'on kyang 'di'i skabs/ dbang brtson pas dpon chen gyi go sa 'phrog rtsod byas stabs/ sa skya ba nang ma 'grig pa sogs phyi nang gi rkyen du ma byung nas/ bod skyu chab srid kyi dbang cha 119

yongs rdzogs ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi lag tu shor te/sde srid phag mo gru bas bod khams yongs la dbang bsgyur ro/ /de rjeyos skya'i dpon re bsko gzhag byas mod/ sa skya'i rang khongs bdag byed pa las spyi dbang med 'dug go/ /skistu gaspun pu/ 2ga glu nazhi zho rgyuska/ —phag gru ba'i lo rgyus ni/ de yang phag gru'i gdung rabs chos srid gnyis kyi sgo nas yar ldan du gtong ba'i byed po gtso bo ni/ chos rje spyan snga rin po che dang / gong ma ta'i si tu sogs dpal ldan rlangs kyi gdung las rim par byon pa rnams yin la/rlangs kyi po ti bse ru las/ ‘‘lar skyes pa'i mis rang gi skye brgyud ma shes na g.yu 'brug zol gdang 'dra/ yab mes kyi che ge'i yig tshang ma shes na/ mon phrug yal bor dngag 'dra’’zhes dang / ‘‘skyes pa'i mi la grags pa'i gtam dgos/ /byas pa'i chos la grub pa'i mtha' dkos/ /che ba'i mi la mtho ba'i rtags dgos’mizhes gsungs te/ thog mar mi'i rigs sgo nga las skyes par bshad/ bshad tshul 'di phyi rol mu stegs pa'i grub mtha' dang 'dres/ zhes mkhas pa dag gis gleng / de nas rim gyis brgyud de bod kyi rus chen bco brgyad dang / 'bras la dkar 120

nag khra gsum sogs dang / bod mi'u gdung drug sogs byung tshul nas/ mang ldom stag btsan gyi bar gyi mi rgyud byung tshul gsungs/ mang ldom gyis jo mo rong bza' khye lcagazhes pa blangs pa la sras ma byung stabs/ sman btsun zhig dang bshos pa las sras shig 'khrungs pa mas lha ri 'i rtser khyer te g.ya' sgrom zhig tu sras bzhag nas/ mang ldom gyi sras yin na mi rgyud lha las sra ba dang / min na bya dang / gcan gzan gyis za bar shog ces smon lam btab/ de mang ldom la bshad nas/ phyi nyin nang snga bar yab yum gnyis lha ri'i rtser phyin te bltasapas/ khye'u g.yu'i zur phud can spyi gtsug rlangs pa dkar bo yod pa de bya rnams kyis gshog pas bkab/ gcan gzan dang / ri dwags kyis skor ba byed pa gzigs pas/ yab dgyes te/ rlangs so/ /rlangs so/ /rlangs so lan gsum gsungs pas rlangs kyi rgyud ce sa grags/ de'i mirgyud la dpa' lhadang / lha'i spyan gyis gzigs pa mang bo byung bas/ gdung rigs la rlangs lha gzigs zhes grags pa de byung /de nas mi rabs du ma'i rjes sarlangs lha gzigs kyi mi rgyud la a mi byang chub 'dre 'kholabyon/ 'di gling ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gyis/ gling yul du lan gnyis gdan drangs/ de 121

dag gi rgyud du chos rje spyan snga rin po che 'khrungs gsungs/bod kyi khri dpon phal che ba ni/ bla ma re'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun las byung bar bshad pas/ phag gru'i dpon rgyud 'di yang /'gro mgon phag mo gru bas phag gru'i gdan sa btab pa las byung ba yin la/ bde gshegs phag mo gru ba ni/ no rab byung gnyis pa'i lcags stag (1110) lor khams 'bri chu'i rgyud du 'khrusgyungs nas/ dgung lo dgu ba'i thog rab tu byung ste mtshan rdo rje rgyal bor btags/ bla ma mang bo bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang bo gsan/ mkhas pa chen por gyur te/ dgung lo zhe dgu ba rab byung gsum pa'i sa stag (1158)lor phag mo gru ba'i dgon pa btab ste gnas gzhi bzung / de'i chos rgyud 'dzin mkhan rnams la phag gru bka' brgyud zer/ de'i slob ma 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po ni khams nas 'khrungs/phag mo gru ba sogs bla ma mang bo bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang bo gsan/ dgung lo so bdun pa rab byung gsum pa'i sa phag (1179)lor 'bri gung gi dgon pa btab/ de'i rgyud 'dzin pa rnams la 'bri gung bka' brgyud zer/rlangs lha gzigs kyi gdung rgyud 'gro mgon phag mo gru ba'i sku mched du gtogs pa yon chen rgyal ba skyabs la sras spyan snga 122

grags pa 'byung gnas/ dpon mgon po rgyal/ yon sangs rgyas skyabs gsum byung / che ba grags pa 'byung gnas gzhon nu'i skabs nas 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ lo bco brgyad nas sum cu rtsa bzhi'i bar 'bral med du chos rje 'bri gung ba 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan sngar bzhugs nas sku g.yog zhus pas spyan snga ba zhes mtshan thogs/ dgung lo so bzhi ba sa 'a brug la 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po'i bka' bzhin du phag gru'i dgon pa gdan sa thel gyi gdan sa ba gnang /de nas bzung ste thel gyi gdan sa ba la spyan snga zer zhing rlangs kyi mi rgyud cig dgos/ dgung lo re gcig thog 'bri gung gi gdan sar phebs/ yon chen sangs rgyas skyabs kyi sras rgyal ba rin po che grags pa brtson 'grus sam rgyal sras thog rdugs pa yang zer/ de nyid thel gyi gdan sar phebs/ 'di'i sngon du khri dpon gyi thob med/ bla ma rgyal ba rin po che grags pa brtson 'grus/ 'di thel gyi gdan sa ba yin skabs/ sig rgyal gong mas phag gru ba la khri dpon gyi 'ja' sa byin pas/ ldan ma sgom brtson spyi dpon byas na'ang / legs po ma byung stabs/ bla ma khong gi nye gnas rdo rje dpal khri dpon du bskos/ rgyal sa sne snyeḥ 3

gdong du brtsigs pas/ phag gru ba dang / sne gdong ba zhes grags/ sne gdong ni/ deng sang lho kha kron chu'u yod sa de red/ — rlangs lha gzigs kyi gdung rgyud phag gru'i dpon phal cher rab tu byung nas slob gnyer mdzad de mkhas grags thob nas/thel gyi gdan sar phebs te/ spyan snga'i mtshan gsol zhing lugs gnyis kyi bdag po lta bur byas/ 'ga' res sa skya nas khri dpon gyi bka' shog blangs te khri dpon byas/ gdung 'dzin skya bo rnams kyis khyim thab bzhes te gzhis ka dang rdzong bdag gnyer byed cing gdung rgyud spel ba sogs byed pa red/ khri dpon rdo rje dpal gyis gzhis rdzong bcu gsum brtsigs pa sogs dar rgyas che tsam byung zer/ rdo rje dpal 'das rjes de'i gcung gzhon nu rgyal mtshan khri dpon byas na'ang / cha lugs ya ma zung byas/mtshan phyed bar du glu dang bro rdung / nyin phyed bar nyal bsdad pas/ lo gsum tsam lasadapon ma zin/ de rjes khri dpon rin rgyal/ byang gzhon/ gzhon nu yon tan rnams rim par khri dpon la bskos na'ang / nag chang la 'dzem med du spyod pa sogs/ dpon gyi 'dzin tshugs ma byung bas/ sa dang ri sde mang bo lag nas shor/ de nas mi drug gis re zhig khri dpon gyi rngolhan

tshab byas/ de rjes spyan snga grags pa rin chen thel gyi gdan sar phebs te khri dpon zur du ma bskos par bla dpon sbrags ma mdzad/ khong thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin pa'i mkhas pa yin stabs thabs mkhas kyis sngon shor ba'i sa dang ri sde rnamayordzas kyis blu ba sogs kyis tshur bsdus/ phag gru skor la bka' drin che zer/ de rjes rgyal mtshan bzang bo dang rgyal mtshan skyabs gnyis rim par khri dpon byas kyang / 'khos ka chung bayokun gyis brnyas par byas te phag gru'i sde srid kyi bya ba nyag phra bar gyur/rgyal mtshan skyabs kyi lag nas ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis khri dpon gyi go sa blangs so/ /de yang dpon rin chen skyabs la lcam gnyis las chung ba 'bum skyid la chu pho stag (1302)gi lo la byang chub rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ dgung lo gsum gyi thog nas klog bslabs te mkhas par gyur/ dgung lo dgu'i thog rab tu byung / dgung lo bcu bzhi'i thog sa skyar phebs/ slob gnyer byed pa dang chabs cigs skya bzhi thog pa'i drung 'khor las bdag gnyer ba zhes pa'i las tshan nang ma'i las ka gnang yang / bdag chen pa thugs gtum pas gsol gzim dam gnyer sogs la bka' bkyon yang 125

yang yong 'dug stabs/ las tshan la sdod rgyu dgongs pa zhus nas bla ma 'jam dpal dang / kun dbang / bla ma mnyam med pa sogs bsten nas mtshan nyid kyi gzhung mang bo dang sngags la sogs pa'i slob gnyer rgya chen po gnang / skabs de'i dus su khri dpon dang sde dpon khag gi bu phrug dang / gzhan yang slob gnyer du byis pa mang bo yod la/ byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis 'byor ldan dang / nga rgyal che ba'i slob phrug su la'ang rgyal kha mi bskur zhing / gnyom chung rnams dang 'grogs shing / de tshor mthun sgril dang / 'go 'dren byed/ ston thog chu mig chos thog tu (slob sbyong 'dzin grwa btsugs pa)phebs dus/ bla ma mnyam med pas slob gnyer ba rnams la gad bdar/ chu len/me shing 'thu ba/ zas g.yo lto skol sogs res mos byed du bcugaslob tshan gtso bo ston pa'i zhor la/ rta bzhon stangs/ mda' rdo mchong gsum tshogs pa'i dbus su gtam shod stangs/ tshogs pa dang mang bo'i 'go khrid byed stangs la sogs pa sbyangs pas bka' drin che gsungs/ byang chub rgyal mtshan dgung lo nyi shur slebs skabs slob gnyer mthar phyin pa dang / sa skya bas khong la ta'i si tu zhes pa'i go gnas dang / stag mgo nor gsum pa zhes pa'i tham/ ka 1 26

tsan dan las grub pa/ stag mgo zer ba yu ba'i mgo la stag mgo yod pa/ gong ma tho gan the mur gyis byin pa de gnang nas phag gru khri dpon du bskos/ rgyal mtshan skyabs kyi bya spyod ngan zhing / khri dpon gyi go sa sprod ma 'dod pa la/ sa skya nas bka' phab ste go sa las phab/ chu khyi (1322)lo'i zla9tshes9nyin bca' hu bsgrags (khrims yig) / bcu bzhi la sne gdong rtsis blangs/ de nas rim gyis gzhis ka rnams la nyams gso/ yul gru so sor skye shing 'dzugs pa/ chu chen la zam chen 'dzugs pa/sne gdong pho brang rgya bskyed de pho brang yid du 'ong ba bzos sde 'bangs rnam/sa tshul bzhin bskyangs pas mnga' thang rgyas/ khri dpon snga ma'i dus su shor ba'i sde 'bangs 'ga' zhig tshur blangs/ de nas g.ya' bzang bas phag gru'i steng du dmag gis tshur 'gebs lan kha shas byas shing kha mchu gtugs bsher byas na'ang / g.ya' bzang khri dpon gyi rgyab tu tshal ba khri dpon yod pa dang / sa skya'i dpon chen rnams kyang / g.ya' bzang ba'i phyogs su yo bas g.ya' bzang ba rgyal ba thengs kha shas byung na'ang / kha mchu'i rtsa ba ma chod phar g.ya' phag thang bar gyi sa char dmag 'khrug byas skabs phag gru pham ste bros/ de nas sa skya'i dpon chen dbang phyug dpal ba'i drung du g.ya' phag 1lha7

gnyis gtugs bsher byas/ ga grur bden chatsam byu nga yang tshal ba dpon kun rdor zer bas g.ya' bzang ba phyogs 'then byas stabs g.ya' bzang ba rgyal/ de nas saskya'i nang gyi'akhamatshan pa'i gras bsod nams rgyalamatshan pa rlangs kyi mi rgyud yin spyo zer nas phag gru khri dpon du bskos te/ sne gdong du song yagata'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis go sa ma sprad/ de rjes mi ring bar sa skya'i dpon chen dbang brtson gyis si tu ston thog la —bos nas/ bslu thabs kyis zhag bcu dgur gung thang du btson la bcug nas tsha 'jam sna tshogs kyis/ thamahoka stag mgo gtod dgos byas kyang / si tus nga khri dpon las tsha len byed dgosadon med/ ngas sa skya gong ma'id+kuzhabs 'degs ma bsgrubs pa dang / mi ser la gnod pa'i bya ba 'di byas zer rgyu med par khri dpon gyi las ka sprod mi thub ces pa kho na bsha da de/ nga ma bsad bar du khri dpon gyi rtsis mi sprod zer/ dbang brtson thabs zad nas si tu phyir btang /de rjes lcags yos (1351)lor g.ya' phag gtugs bsher byas pas si tu rgyal yang / g.ya' bzang bas slar yang dmag drangs te gtugs pas phag gru rgyal nas/ g.ya' bzang dgon dang / g.ya' bzang gi gzhis ka rnams rtsis blangs/ de 128

noyoloskya 'i dpon chen rgyal bzab ba yer lung du sob nas — ga ya' phag gi gyodadzhabashad rgyu byas skabs/ ta'i si tus rang gi blon po rnams la/ sang nged bzung nas pags pa dmar bshus byedadzhakyin 'dug zer na'ang / sne gdong ma ga tod/ ces sogs bkod khyab btang / phyi nyin dpon chen gyis cu tu bzung yang the lotshe me la ba sregs nas len rgyu ma yod/ de nas dpon rgyal bzang ba rang nyid kyis sne gdong pho brang du skor g.yeng byas te/ sne ga dongatshur sprod dgos zer na'ang / phag gru'i blon po rnams kyi zhal ngo (dpon chen) las sde srid gal tshe zer nas pho brang ma gtad/ de nayosde srid si tu la btson las byas shing / btson chas kyi rnam payos skyar khyer/ de skabs sa skya'i nang chen gyi dbang brtson gyis hor rgyal dang 'brel ba byas te/ dpon chen rgyal bzang ba'i lag nas dpon chen gyi go sa 'phrog rgyu byas pyo rgyal bzang bas shesanas/ si tu dang lkog gros byas te phan tshun gcig grogs gcig gis byed rgyu byas te shor ba ltar mdzad nas si tu btang / de ltar si tu sab phyed gsum tsam la sa skyas btson du bzung ste 'o brgyal mang du byung na'ang / zla ba gza' las grol ba ltar/ chu 'brug (1352)lo'i mjug tu phyir sne gdong du slebs te/ dmag btegs nas g.ya' bzang ba'i 129

gzhis dgon sngar blangs pa'i 'apo ma rnams dpung shugs kyis blangs/ ring bor ma lon par thang bo cher yang dpung 'jug byas 'dug — ci de nas nang chen dbang brtson gyis glo bur du dpon chen rgyal bzang ba bzung nas btson la bcug dpon chen gyi las ka blangs nas/ bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag bsdus te/ yar lung sne gdong ba'i thog tu song / si tus phag gru khri skor gyi dmag bsdus te 'thab pas rgyal kha thob/ si tu rang yang dmagachi thog tu byon nas sa skya'i dmag rnams bsad bzung dang ded nas rgyal kha 'thob bzhin pa'i skabs su/ sa skya'i bla ma dam pa dang /dbus gtsang gi mi chen mang bo bar 'dum la byon te/ rgyal bzang ba btson nas glod pa sogs nang 'grig byung tshul gyis sa gla nga (1349)lor gtsang gi jo mo mkha' reg bar du phag grur+sā blangs/de nas lo shas kyi rjes su/ sa skyar dpon chen dbang brtson gyi rgyab tu lha rtse ba dang / nang chen nam mkha' bstan pa'i rgyab tu byang ba langs te sa skyar na nga 'khrug byung / de skabs rgyal ba bzang bo dug gis bsad pa yin yang zer/ chang 'thungs ches nas shi ba yin yang zer/ gang ltar rgyal bzang ba 'das/ de dag si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis gsan te/ dmag gi dpung snye30

chen btegs nas sa skya blangs/ sa skya'i gdan sa ba tā dben blo gros rgyal mtshan khri las phab/ dpon chen bzung / las byed gnad che ba bzhi brgya brgal ba khrims la sbyar ba dang / gnas nas dbyung ba sogs byas te/ rab byung drug pa'i sa pho khyi lo (1358) la sde srid phag mo gru ba ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bod chol kha gsum yongs su rdzogs par dbang bsgyur to/ / de nas sde srid phag mo gru ba'i dpon chen ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bod yongs la dbang bsgyur nas/ chos kyi phyogs la bya ba rgya chen po bsgrubs/ srid phyogs nas/ ri rgya klung rgya bsdams pa/ chu chen la zam pa dang / ko gru gsar 'dzugs/la 'phrang dben pa ci yod la 'jigs skyob/ tsa ri tra dang /gangs te se sogs gnas chen yod tshad la ja tshul chang tshul/ zhing ba dang / 'brog pa rnams la khral 'os 'bab cig las/ hor ltar khral chen bsdu mi chog par mdzad/ mnga' ris nas bzung ste sa cha rnams su rdzong chen bcu gsum brtsigs pa dang sne gdong rgya bskyed/ sngon sa skya'i khrims lugs hor gyi shan zhugs nas sdig pa'i las shas che bas/ khrims kyi lugs srol bzang bo'i srol gsar du btsugs pa ni/ 131

dpa' bo stag gi zhal rtse/ sdar ma wa'i zhalīrtse/ sne mo las 'dzin gyi zhal rtse/ zhu bzhes bden rdzun gyi zhal lce/ bzung bkyigs khrims ra'i zhal rtse/ nag chen khrag sbyor gyi zhal rtse /dran 'dzin chad las kyi zhal lce/ hor 'dra za rkang gi zhal rtse/bsad pa stong gi zhal rtse/ rmas pa khrag gi zhal lce/ bsnyon hayomana' dag gi zhal lce/ brkus pa 'jal gyi zhal lce/ nye 'brel 'bral 'dum gyi zhal lce/ byi byas byi rin gyi zhal lce/ nam phar tshur gyi zhal lce/ bco lnga'i sgo nas gtan la phab/ 'di dag la 'grel ba dang yang 'grel sogs khrims mang bo thag bcad de/ phra zhing mdzangs pa'i blos bka' khrims kyi 'jam dar yug gcig gis bskyangs pas rgan mo gser 'khur gyi dus/ zhesakun gyis bsngags brjod byed pa'i yul du gyur to/ /skabs de'i sngon tsam la sprul sku bslu srol gyi thog ma karma pak+ṣi chos kyi bla ma yu gur dang hor yul sogs su phebs/ de rjes lcags byi (1360)lor karma bzhi ba rol pa'i rdo rje yang hor gong ma'i pho brang du gdan drangs/ ban de rnams kyis gong mar phyag byed mi dgos pa'i 'ja' sa thob/ de dus hor gong ma tho gan the mur gyi khri lo nyer brgyad pa yin zer/ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan dgung lo re gsum pa la 132

44 d+ngha——— phebs pa shinga'abrug (1364)lor sne gdong pho brang du hūṃ4 gshegs/ 'jam dbyangs shākya rgyal mtshan nam 'jam dbyangs gu shrī chen po yang zer ba/ 'di sne gdong gong ma'i khrir bzhugs/bu ston rin po che sogs bla ma mang bo bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par sbyangs nas mkhas pa chen por gyur pas kun gyis bkur/ lo bcu gsum tsam la sne gdong gi khrir bzhugs/sa sprel (1368)lo la sog jing gir rgyal bo'i mi rgyud kyis rgya nag gi rgyal sa shor te hor yul du bros/ rgya nag tā ming gi rgyal bo dang bo hung lu (tshi2) khrir 'khod/ gyirgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po chu byi (1372)lor mdo smad nas dpus phyogs su phebs/ de'i lo rjes mar 'jam dbyangs shākya rgyal mtshan gshegs/de rjes shing stag (1374)lor grags pa byang chub dgung lo bcu dgu'i thog sne gdong gi khrir 'khod/ rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos kyang 'di ba'i zhabs la gtugs/ 'di basportogayobarjod dpag bsam lhun po brtsams/ spyan snga 'di bas kyang rje bdag nyid chen po la bsngags brjod bla na med pa gnang / spyan snga grags byang ba 'di lo brgyad la khri khar bzhugs/ — —133
