de rjes 'di ba'i gcung bsod nams grags pa ཿdza lngar khrir bzhugs/ dpon 'di gnyis kyi ring la lo phyugs legs pas bsod nams ca na gyi rgyal bor grags/ mkhas grags shin tu che de rjes shing glang (1385)lor mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan dgung lo bcu gnyis thog khrir bkod/ skabs de tsam na grub thob lcags zam pa thang stong rgyal bos/ kong po sogs la lcags kyi slong mo mdzad de/ dbus gtsang / mdo stod/ lho 'brug sogs kyi chu chen rnams la lcags thag gi zam che chung lnga bcu nga gsum tsam btsugs/ skabs de'i dus su blon chen rnams kyi nang nas sku zhang rdzong phyi ba grags rin dbang che bas blon po nang tshags phrag dog gi dbang gis rdzong phyi ba grags rin bkrongs stabs yo 'khyom che tsam byung yang / stag lung rin po che bkra shis dpal brtsegs kyis zhi 'jags mdzad pas ring bo ma thogs par 'khrug pa zhi/ rdzo rgya nag tā ming gi rgyal bo yung los (lkolo)bod kyi bla chen rnams la che bstod kyi mtshan gnas dang / dgon pa khag la mchod 'bul byas/ mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan rgya nag tu gdan 'dren zhus kyang ma phebs/ karma de bzhin gshegs pa me 134

rdzi(1406)lor gdan drangs te rgya nag pho brang du phebs/ rje blo bzang grags pa snga phyir gdan 'dren pa mngags kyang ma phebs/ de rjes rgya yul du chos ston pa'i slob ma zhig gtong bar zhu zhes zhus pas/ sa byi (1408)lor byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes mngags pa rgya yul du byon/ rgya rgyal gyi bla mar gyur/khong gis rgya nag tu lha khang dang dgon pa kha shas btab/ mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / dpon chen nam mkha' bzang bo gnyis kyis/ mnyam med tsong kha pa chen po gtsug gi nor bur bsten te/ rab byung bdun pa'i sa glang (1409)lor lha ldan sprul ba'i gtsug lag khang dang ra mo che rten dang brten par bcas nyams gso bsnyen bkur mdzad pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad de/ rje bdag nyid chen pos cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo 'dzugs pa'i lo de rang la/rje tsong kha pa chen pos dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling phyag 'debs mdzad/ me sprel (1416)lo la rje'i thugs sras 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan pas 'bras spungs btab/sa phag (1419)lor rje'i thugs sras byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes kyis se ra bteb bo/ / mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan 'di ba gsan rgya che la sku 135

yon che/ chos phyogs la zhabs tog blor mi shong ba mdzad/ chab srid phyogs nas dmangs la brtse/ khrims srol ba nga ṣ+pergyun 'khyongs byas stabs1/ mchog dman kun gyis gong ma chos rgyagleg chen po zhesa'abod pas/ mtshan de ltarachags/ myang stod ratshobartan kun bzang 'phags kyi thog tu dpung 'jug lan gnyis tsam byas pa las sde gzar gang yang ma byung bar dbus gtsang mdo khams dang bcas pa 'tham dar yugagacig tu song bas —mnga' thang mtho/ 'di ba'i blon po tsheb/ gzhis ka rin spungs rdzong dponardzinam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ chu mig gi khri dpon/ sa skya lha khang chen mo 'i dpon chen/ gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon/ 'phyongs rgyas pa hor dpal 'asgar bzang bo/ 'di dmag dpon yang byas/ sne'u nam mkha 'a bzang bo 'ol ba bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ rin spungs ba nam mkhan rgyal bo/ brag dkar rgya'o sku mched/ rin dpal khu dbon/ ) gong dkar a nag bzhi 'dzom/ yar rgyab dge bsnyen pa sku mched/ bya bkra shis dpal bzang / rgya ma khri dpon zla ba/ sgom log chos rgyal/rtsed thang dpon dge/ rtse shar ba rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pa/ rtse nub pa si tu bsod nams dpal/ bsam sde ba/ span rnam pa/ gling dkar ba/ bu tshal ba/ rgyal chen rtse ba sogs ①36

mang / mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan dgung lo nga dgu'i thogachu byi ( 1432)lor sku gshegs so/ji /mi’dbang gshegs rjes/ chu byi lo'i mjug tu khong gi gcung che sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi sras grags ba 'byung gnas 'os — banadagu'i thogacirgyal sar bkod/ de rjes shing stag lor/ 'di — ba'i yab che sa sangs rgyasargyal mtsharna gyis sgothog e yong sgo rerdzib byas te bya saṣ+pelegs pa mang du mdza da stabayoyar4lung du sde —gzar langs/ de'i stabs che sa sangs rgya r+sā rgyal mtshanaṅged ponagayog la gsol skadzibyin nas yar rgyab k+ṣiṃ thegs dgos byung /ṣ+kang stag (1434)lo la phag gru nang zhig sgolo zer/ de lasabarten nas shing yos(1435)lo nas rin sbungs pa'i shugasarka je rgyas dang / phag gru'i mnga' thang nyams gu/da du song / phag gru'i rgyal srid nyams nas rin spungs pas bod yongasasnyel dbang —bsgyur ba'i 'go tshugs pa 'dra/ lo de'i yayoms su dbus gtsarokhamagogasum la mu ge chen po byung zor/ gong ma 'dis mkhayogrub dge legs dpal bzang sogs bla mar bsten/ deb sngostortsom pa bo 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nurapal jirgyun ring du g.yodu skebasten/ chos phyogs nas mdzad dzir+shanyung ba bsgrubs/ mkhyen pa rgya che zer/ byang phyogs kyi so khangasrung ba'i phyir 'od yug glidz+wa137

dkar gyi rdzong brtsigs/ srid kyi zhabs zhur rin spungs nor bu bzang bo dang / 'phyongs rgyas pa hor dkon mchog bzangalte bo gnyis kyis byas/ rjes sor yab che sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan yang yar rgyab nas gdan drangs te bkur sti mdzad/ dgung lo —so gnyis pa shing glang la (1445)lo la gshegs/ tshes lnga la gshegs stabs/ phyis su spyan snga tshes lnga ba yang zer/ rgya nag gong ma kyen tha'i yis dbang gi 'ja' sa garneng ba nas bzung dbang grags pa 'byung gnas yang zer/ grags pa 'byung gnas 'di ba'i gcung kun dga' legs rab byung bdun pa'i mjug gi me stag (1446)lor sne gdong gi khrir bkod/ rin spungs nas bdag mo zhig blangs pas sras rin chen rdo rje dbang gi rgyal bo 'khrungs/ kun legs 'di la sde dpon thams cad kyis gus bkur byas na'ang / rin spungs pa nor bzang gong ma 'di'i mdzad spyod la khog nas rmo dga' ba dang gong ma kun legs rang nyid kyang ka bzhi ba sku mched kyi kha la nyan nas/ yab yum nang mi mthun pa byung ste/ mi bde ba mang bo byung / yum gshegs rjes rin spungs mtsho skyes rdo rjes mkhar thog bzung / rab byung brgyad pa'i shing khyi (1454)lor gong ma grags pa 'byung gnas kyi sras/ dpal ngag gi dbang bo dgung lo bcu 13byi

drug gi thog thel gyi spyan sngar bskos/ spyan snga nyer gnyis pa gshegs nas shing khyi 'di lan gyi lo nyi shur gdan sa stong ba yin zer/ 'di nyid gzhon nu nas 'gos lo dpal ye bzang rtse ba sogs bsten nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum mang du mdzad kyang /nang mtshams su mi mthun pa byung ste/ dgung grangs nyi shu ba'i thog gong ma kun legs kyis thel gyi spyan snga'i go sa blangs nas lho khar bton te brag kha dang / rgyal gnyis rang du lo bcu drug tsam lo bzhugs rgyu byung / slar chu sbrul la mtshan jus rgyal te/ yang dgon pho brang du phebs nas 'phrin las rgyas pa byung / de skabs nang gyod zhi 'jags skabs/ rin spungs don yod rdo rjes gtsang dmag dbus su drangs te/ sne gdong ba'i lag nas rdzong gzhis 'ga' zhig blangs/ gong ma kun legs dang spyan snga ngag gi dbang bo gnyis kyi gyod bshad de nang 'dum mdzad/lcags mo glang (1481)gi lo'i lo sar skabs rin spungs pa sogs dpon chen rnams kyis/ dpon sa khu dbon gnyis mthun sgrig pa yin zer ba'i gtam bsgrags te/ spyan snga ngag gi dbang bo lho kha nas spyan drangs/ gong ma kun legs zur bzhugs byas te dgon gsar du gdan drangs/ spyan snga ngag gi dbang bo nyid sne gdong rtse'i rgyal sar bkod/ rdzong kha ba'i bu mo zhig 139

bdag mor phul/ lo 'dir 'gos lo dgung lo dgu bcu'i thog sku gshegs/ 'di nas lo gsum pa chu yos (1483)la sngar gyi gong ma kun legs gshegs/ de nas lo gsum pa shing sbrul la/ rin spungs pas rgyal rtse'i khar dmag drangs pa sogs sde gzar mang du byung na yang / gong ma ngag gi dbang bo nyid sde 'khrug la mi dgyes shing / spyi dpon drang bor bzhugs/ khong dgung lo lnga bcu'i thog sras ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gsum thog gshegs/ sras sku na phra bas rin spungs mtsho skyes rdo rjes sku tshab byas/ sde gzar mang du byung / sa lug (1499)lo'i lo sar skabs/ rin spungs pas gtso bo byas/ sde dpon rnams kyis gdung rgyud ngag dbang bkra shisagrags pa dgung lo bcu gnyis thogasartse'i khri thog tu —bkod/ 'di nyid kyi dus rin spungs ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis e gnyal gyi phyogs su dmag drangs pa sogs sde 'khrug bslangs/zhwa dmar ba bzhi bas chings mdzad kyang thugs bzhed ji bzhigam grub/ de nas lo bzhi song ba sa 'brug lasras 'gro ba 'i mnan po dang / de rjes sras spyan snga grags 'byung ba 'khrungs/ de'i phyi lo sa mo sbrul la sde srid dang bsam sde dpon gyi nang zhig sde gzar byung / gong ma 'di'i dus su rin spungs pa sogs kyis sde 140

'khrug mang bo bslangs te/ dus mi bde ba shin tu mang r+habyung ba brjod kyis mi lang / ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa 'di'i sras/ spyan snga grags 'byung ba thel gyi gdan sar phebs phag gru'i gdung rgyud 'di la grags pa 'byung gnasazer ba gsum byung ba'i 'di ba gsum pa yin zer/ de'i gcupazhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa sde gdong gi khrir bkod/ 'di'i dus yang sngar ltar sde gzar mang bo langs nas dus mi bde ba byung 'dug de la sras bka' brgyud rnam rgyal dang / rnam rgyal grags pa gnyis 'a khrungs/ bka' brgyud rnam rgyal la sras mi lham bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rnam rgyal dpal bzang sne gdong gi khrir bsdad do/ /lha de ltar sde srid phag mo gru ba'i dpon rgyud 'di'i khri dpon gyi thog ma rdo rje dpal nas bzung / rgyal mtshan skyabs kyi bar dpon rabs brgyad ni phag gru khri skor gyi khri dpon tsam yin/ ta'i sirtsotu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis sa skya'i lag nas bod cho la kha gsum gyi srid dbari tshang ma phrogs nas bod yongs la dbang bsgyur/ de nas 'jam dbyangs shākya rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga grags pa byung chub/ spyan snga bsod nams grags pa/ mi dbang grags pa sde 141

rgyal mtshan te dpon rabs 'di lngaṣ+pe ring la dbang sgyur brtan por gnas shing / khyad par du mi dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan snyan grags shin tu che/ de rjes grags pa 'byung gnas kyi ring nas/ rin spungs pa'i lag tu dbang sne shor te bod rgyal gyi ming yod cing / — sa gernams sna shor sne shor dang / dus mi bde ba byung nas rim gyis rgyal srid nyams so/ /spruskyo buzhi zha/ nain spu daska pruzhi zho rgyuska/ sde srid phag mo gru ba'i rjes su rin spungs pas dbang bsgyur ba yin la/ rin spungs pa'i mi rgyud ni sngon bod kyi rgyal bo sha khri btsan po'i dus/ ma sangs la khar khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig byung ba la sger dpal legs 'od zer zhing / de nas bzung ste/mophyi sger/ nang sger/ grub thob kyi sger zer ba'i mi rgyud gsum byung / de gsum gyi rgyud pa la chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi blon po byung la/ de dag gi rgyud las byung ba sger dkar shākya 'bum gyi sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la phag gru'i sde srid mi — dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sa byi (1408)lor rin spungs rdzong dpon gyi go gnas dang / gtsang chu mig ring mo'i khri dpon/ sa skya lha khang chen mo'i dpon chen du bsko gzhag gnang 14nyu

zheng / rjes su rin spungs su yun ring bor bsdad stabs/ rin spungs mi rgyud chags nas sne gdong gong mas nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la shel dam gnang ste/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi mi rgyud la rin spungs pa zhes grags so/ / nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi sras nam mkha' rgyal bo ni phag gru gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / grags pa 'byung gnas gnyis kyi zhabs 'bring che khag gi gras kyi go gnas bzung zhing / de'i sras rin spungs nor bu bzang bo yab mes kyi dus ltar rdzong dpon dang / khri dpon gyi go sar bsdad/ dpung gi sbyor bas rta g.yag gi rdzong dang / lcags thag mgo sbrel du grags pa'i rgyal phran mang bo mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ shing yos (1435)lo la nyang smad bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon mdzad/ rong bo byams chen gyi chos sde btab/ rong bo byams chen sogs sku gsung thugs rten mang bo bzhengs/ rgya gar gyi paṇa ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen gdan drangs nas rab gnas mdzad/ gong ma sde srid phag mo gru ba'i gdung rgyud rnams dang / dbon zhang 'brel ba byung stabs chab srid kyi thog mthong bzos che/ rin spungs nor bzang 'di dang / 'phyongs rgyas pa hor dkon mchog rin chen gnyis nas blon chen gyi las ka rkang 'dzin byas/ shā43

snorobu bzang lhal sras u ba rme ka dang / kun tu bzang bo/ donabyu'agrub rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ shākya rgyal mtshan dang lnga 'khrungs/ dang bo chudzodus nas gshegs/ gnyisagakun bzang bas/ phag gru gong ma grags pa 'byung gnas sku mched kyi zhabs la gtugs nas yab mes kyi 'ja' sa dang / las kablangs shing / sa skya ba kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel dang / go rams ba bsod nams seng ge dang mchod yon du 'brel te/ 'azas yul skyed tshal gyi bshad grwa btsugs shing / rta nag thub bstan dgon 'debs pa'i mthun rkyen bsgrubs/ sras gsum pa don 'grub rdo rjes bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon bzung / sras bzhi ba mtsho skyes rdo rjes yar lung mkhar thog rdzong drag shugs kyis bzung / phag gru gong ma ngag gi dbang sgyug gshegs te/ sras sku na phra skabs pho brang sne gdong gi dngon tshab byas nas dbang bzung / der brten rin spungs pa'i dbang thang je rgyas su song yang / phag gru sde srid gong ma'i nang blon de dag nang ma mthun par yar lung du sde 'khrug mang du byung / rin spungs pas bka' brgyud kyi chos lugs phyogs su 'then 'khyer byas te sne gdong phyogs su dmag drangs nas gzhis ka kha shas phrogs/ lcags rta (1510) lor mtsho skye sa rdo rje 'das/ nor bzang ba'i sras lnga 144

ba shākya rgyal mtshan gyis/ nyang khog gi rdzong bzung nas/ rgyal mkhar rtse ba la dgra thabs byas pa sags dgra thabs la mkhas par grags/ nor bu bzang bo'i sras gnyis pa kun bzang ba la/ sras rdo rje tshe brtan dang / don yod rdo rje gnyis yod/ dang bo'i lorgyus mi snang / gnyis pa don yod rdo rjes rdzong chen bcu gnyis kyi rdzong dpon bzung nas/ sa phag (1479)lor zhwa dmar chos grags dang mchod yon du 'brel te/ yangs pa can gyi dgon ba btab/ karma chos grags rgya mtsho'i 'dod pa ltar lha sa'i nye 'dabs ma zhes pa'i sa char karma ba'i dgon pa zhig btab na yang se 'bras kyis bshigs pa sogs dus mi bde ba'i me chen 'bar zer/ lcags byi (1480)lor don lod rdo rje dang /g.yung ba tshi dbang gnyis kyis dmag gartos chen yar lung du drangs nas/ ka bzhi ba shar nub gnyer ba'i go sa nas phab/gzhis kabrag da kar ba dang / chu shur lhun po'i rtse'i rdzong sogs snel ba'i lag nas phrogs/ la stod byang ba dag pa nam mkha' rdo rje dang / la stod lho ba rdzong kha ba chos rgyal nor bu'i sde sogs kyi thog tu dmag kha yar drangs/ skyid shod du'ang dmag lan gnyis drangs shing / gzhan dbang gis phyir log byed rgyu byung 145

ltabs/ skyid shod dang se 'bras sogs la skyon ma byung ze ra/de rjes skyid shod du snang rtse khu dbon bsad pas rkyen byas nas/ rin spungs pas gtsang dpung gtos che ba dbus su drangs/ sde ba dga' ldan pa nam mkha' rgyal bos ngo ya byas/karma ba dang / stag lung ba/ 'ol kha ba sogs kyis chings brgyab ste/ sa skyong ngag dbang lhun po sku mched sku skal blangs nas skyor mo lung du phebs dgos byung ba dang / sne'u gzhis rtsis blangs/ lha sa dang / po ta la sogs kyi bdag po byas/ lo 'di nas bzung lha ldan smon lam chen mor se 'bras gnyis phebs mi chog par byas/ don yod rdo rje rang lo lnga bcu'i thog chu sprel (1512) la 'das skabs kha chems su/ sna dkar rtse nas zil gnon pa bos la/ zhal ngor zhog zer ba ltar/ sna dkar rtse stag lungardzinas sde ba zil gnon pa rin spungs su yong nas/ don yod rdo rjes las ka'i mjug skyong byas/mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sras ngag dbang rnam rgyal ni rig gnas chung ba lnga dang sgyu rtsal la mkhas par grags/ e gnyal phyogs su dmag drangs pa lam rgyugs byung min gyi rkyen las dbus phyogs kyi gzhis ka sne'us gtsos rdzong gzhis 'ga' zhig shor/ mnga' thang cung zad nyams/ 'on kyang gtsang phyogs kyi seng ge rtse ba dang /146

lo stod sogs mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ de la sras gsum yod/ che ba pad ma dkar bo nang tshags nas bkrongs pas rin spungs dme khrag gi lo zer/ de 'og don 'grub tshe brtan rdo rjes sngar yab mes kyis ma lon pa'i pa snam lhun 'grub rtse'i rdzong mang9di 'bangs dang bcas pa rang dbang du byas/ karma mi bskyo da rdo rjes gsung rab gling 'debs pa'i zhabs 'degs byas/ 'brug pa pad ma dkar bo dang mchod yon du 'brel/ chos 'a/jeg rten gang la'ang mkhyen rgya che zhing /mthun lam la mkhas pas sde dpon tshugs thub pa'i tshad du byed zer/ de'i gcung ngag dbang 'jig rten grags pa ni rig gnas bcu la sbyangs pa'i rgyal bo paṇa ḍi ta yin la/ gos sku chen mo bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la kun dga' grol mchog gdan drangs/ dan ḍi'i dgongs rgyan 'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ro sogs rtsom pa mang du mdzad/ sa skya dang byang bdag ma mthun pas/ sa skya'i rgyab tu rin spungs pa langs te/ chu phag (1563) lor rin spungs pa'i dmag g.yas ru byang ba'i steng du chas pa'i tshe ngag dbang 'jig grags rang yang dpung bcas bsam 'grub rtser slebs/ lo de ga'i nang rin spungs pa rang gi zhabs 'bring ba chibs da/zhun du— gtogs pa zhing shag pa tshe brtan k+ṣe47

rdo rje zer ba bsam rtse'i rdzong dpon byas nas yod pa des 'bangs gyen log byas te/ sras pad ma dkar bo bkrongs pa sogs rim gyis nyams rgud du gyur/ rin spungs pa yang dar ba'i tha sargud pas mjug bsdurtswaso/ /sprudzu lda bu/ sde sded gtsad buzhi zho smyuska/ rin spungs pa'i rjes su/ sde srid gtsang bas bod la dbang bsgyur pa yin la/ 'di la gtsang stod sde ba yang zer/gtsang ba rgyal bo yang zen/ 'di ni gnyags 4 na ku ma ra sogs kyi gdung rgyud yin zer/gtsang rgyal gyi thog ma ni/ zhing shag pa tshe brtan rdo rje yin la/ kho ni rin spungs pa'i gnyen tshan du gtogs la/ rin spungs pa dang / sne gdong ba gnyis ka'i zhabs 'bring gi khongs su bsdad/rin spungs sde srid ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi skabs su chibs dpon gyi las ka bzung / de rjes las tshan du slebs te/ shangs dang /myang smad kyi yong 'babe sdud mkhan lo mang bor byas/ sa sprel (1548)lor gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong depon gyi go gnas thob ste der bsdad/ rin spungs sde srid ngag dbang 'jig grags kyi skabs su/ khong gi gcen che ba pad ma dkar bo zhing snye4byi

shag pas bkrongs stabs/ rin spungs pas dmag drangs pa lam durtsom song bar/ bsam 'grub rtse ba zhing shagangapangatshe brtan rdo rjes 'bangs gyen log byas te/ rin spungs pa'i mnga' 'og nas bud/me sbrul (15 57)lor/ zhing shag pa tshe brtan rdo rjes/shangs don rab pa'i salde rnams dpung shugs kyis blangs/ shing glang (1565)lor zhing shag pa rang nyid dmag dpon byas te/ ba snam lhun 'grub khyung rtse dang / rdzong gsar phag mo ri rnams blangs/ slar me stag (1566)lo'i lo sar mtshams gtsang rin gnyisarikyis myang stod smad du dmag 'khrug bslangs mthar/ ba snam rdzong yongs rdzogs gtsang bas thob/ zhing shag pa tshe brtan rdo rje gtsang gi rgyalartebor gyu ra/zhing shag pa la bu da gu byung ba las/ karma mthu stobs rnam rgyal/ kun spang lha dbang rdo rje/ karma bstan srung dbang bo 'di gsum gyis gtsang phyogs su dbang bsgyur 'dug sras ga zha na gyi losargyus mi snang / lha dbang rdo rje bsam 'grub rtse'i rgyal sar bsdad/ bstan srung dbang bo pa snam nor khyung rtser bsdad/ de rjes lha dbang rdo rje 'das rjes/ bstan srung dbang bo bsam 'aspub rtse'i rgyal sar bsdad/de 'das rjes/ de'i sras phun tshogs rnam rgyal lo bcu 4 klo49

bzhi'i thog lcags phag (1611)lor srid dbang bzung / de'i dus byi glang lo'i sde gzar zhes bya ba byung ste/ de ni chubyubyi (1612)lo dang / chu glang (1613)lor phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis mnga' ris rgyal bo dang / lho ba byang ba rnams la dmag drangs nas mnga' 'og tu bcug pa de la zer/ kho bka' brgyud pa la mos khul byas mod/ 'brug pa pad ma dkar bo'i yang sprul ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang dpag bsam dbang bo gnyis 'khrungs pa gdan sar gang 'god 'then 'khyer byung / ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis gtsang ba'i bka' chad phog dogs nas lho 'brug phyogs su bros byol byed dgos byung ba dang / gtsang dmag 'brug pa'i thog tu lan gnyis btang ba sogs 'brug pa bka' brgyud dang 'gras pa byung / 'on kyang karma ba'i sbyin bdag byas te/ karma chos dbyings rdo rje la dbus gtsang gi bdag po'i bka' shog dang tham ga dmar nag byin/ jo nang tā ra na tha yang bla mar bsten/ karma ba la dad khul gyis dge lugs pa la shin tu sdang / rab byung bcu ba'i sa rta (1618)lor dbus su dmag drangs nas sa— lug lor se 'bras gnyis bcom/ dge 'dun rnams byang phyogs su ded/ skya ser brgya phrag mang bo bsad/ bkra shis lhun po'i rgyab ri'i kha nas sa rdo drangs te bkra shis lhun po dang / gzhis /50

ka rtsi'i bar bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa gsar rgyag gi mkhar las byed skabs/ rbab rdo bsgril ba sogs paṇa chen rin po che dang bkra shis lhun po sogs la brnyas gtse byas pas 'o brgyal byung /lcags bya (1621)lor sog dmag stong gnyis lhag slebs te/gtsang dmag dang 'thab nas gtsang dmag pham/ paṇa chen rin po che sogs kyis bar 'dum mdzad/ se 'bras kyi mchod gzhis tshur sprad/ grub mtha' bsgyur ba rnams dang sa ris shor ba sogs rang babs su slog lcags lug la phun tshogs rnam rgyal 'das nas/ sras karma bstan skyong khrir bkod zer/ gtsang rgyal gyis rgyal ba paṇa chen gnyis dang / bkra shis lhun po dang se 'bras dge gsum sogs dang / skyid shod sde ba stag rtse ba sogs la yang yang brnyas gtse byas/ skyid shod sde ba sog yul du bros/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po'i pha hor bdud 'dul rab brtan btson du bcug pa btson zhabs nas 'das/ stag rtse sde ba sogs mi chen 'gas gros thog nas sog po o rod jun gar gyi dpon gu shrī khāng la rogs zhu mi byed ka med byung / gu shrī bstan 'dzin khāng gis chu rta (1642)lor gtsang ba'i srid gzhung rtsa med btang ste/ bod ljongs yongs kyi srid dbang dga' ldan pho brang ba'i lag tu 'byor/ thog ma'i char karma ba'i phyogs nas 151

nang 'khrug phran chogs byung stod/ rda ma thag zhi lta/ sor skya drag zhan thams cad sos bder gnas chogapa byung ngo / /tshospruskyo steltag daghazha lhan sgo chisdid spruzhi zho sgyug gtsang ba'i srid dbang mjug bsdus rjes rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dus nas dga' ldan pho brang bas bod la dbang bsgyur/snyo des na thog mar rgyal dbang skya phreng rim byon gyi lo rgyus mdo tsam shes dgos pas mdor bsdus shig brdzod par bya ste/ rgyal dbang sku zeng dang bo dge 'dun gyub pa/de yang paṇa chen dge 'dun 'ib pa sku phring dang bor byas nas sku phreng rim par brtsi dgos la/ de yang dge 'dun grub dzi dpal bzang bo ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i lcags lug (1391)lor gtsang shab stod gur mo zhes pa'i yul du 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu bzhi'i thog snar thang chos sder phebs/ rab tu byung / slob gnyer dang gsan bsam rgya cher gnang ste mkhas grag sa 'bar/ shing lug (1415) lor rje tsong kha pa dang mjal te/ slob ma'i gtso bo zhig tu gyur/ rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos (1447) lor bkra shis lhun po phyag 'debs mdzad/ dgon sde der 'chad nyan mdzad de yun ring bzhugs/ paṇa chen dge 152

'dun grub ces mtshan snyan rgyas/ de rjes bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sa 'dzin mkhan rnams la paṇa chen zhes mtshan thogs/tshad ma rigs rgyan sogs gsung rtsom mang / dgung lo gya bzhi'i thog gsungs mod gya drug yin dgos 'dra/ rab byung brgyad pa'i shing rta (1474) lor sku 'das so/ / rgyal dbang sku sbeng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ de'i phyi lo shing lug (1475) lor gtsang rtaranag tu 'khrungs/ dge 'dun grub pa'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad de bkra shis lhun por spyan drangs/ karma ba la sprul sku ngos 'dzin pa'i srol 'di'i sngon nas yod mod/ dge lugs pa la sprul sku ngos 'dzin pa'i thog ma 'di ba yin/ de dus rin spungs pa donayod rdo rjes dbang bsgyur ba'i skabs yin pas sde gzar mang bo byung / shing yos (149 5)lor rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho 'bras spungs su phebs/ bsnyen par rdzogs/ lo 'dir skyid shod du snang rtse khu dbon rkyen lam du btang / sa rta (1498) lor rin spungasajid+kudamag lha sar drangs/ snel ba dpon ngag dbang lhun po mche da gnyis skyor mo lung du phud/ de ga'i rdzong gzhis tshang ma rin spungs don yod rdo rjes blangs/ lo 'di nas bzung rdi ༵ga

(1518) bar du lo nyi shu'i ring la se 'bras kyi dge 'dun pa rnams lha sa smon lam chen mor phebs mi chog pa byung / sa sbrul (1509)lo ra rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos rgyal me tog thang gi dgon pa btab/ lha mo'i bla mtsho'i gnas sgo phyes/ bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen du bzhugs yod pa'i skabs/ sne gdong dpon sa ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa dang lha rgya ri ba mchod yon/'bras spungs spyi so sogs kyis yang dang yang du gdan 'dren zhus stabs/ me glang (1517)lor bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen bsko gzhag gnang ste/ 'bras spungs su phebs nas/ 'bras spungs kyi chos khrir bzhugs/ 'bras spungs su bla brang dga' ldan pho brang bzhengs/ rgyal dbang lnga bas bod yongs la dbang bsgyur pa nas gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes pa'ang / pho brang 'di'i mtshan srid gzhung gi mtshan du gyur 'dug me byi (1516)lo nas rin spungs pa'i mnga' thang rim gyis nyams te/ sa stag (1518)lo nas rje 'di'i 'phrin las la brten/ se 'bras kyi dge 'dun pa rnams lha ldan smon lam chen mor 'tshogs chog pa byung / me bya (1537)lor rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho 'phrin las shin tu rgyas/ 'on kyang chos 'khor rgyal du bzhugs skabs 'bri gung bas chos lugs 'then 'khyer 154

gyis/ 'ol kha ba'i steng du dpung rgol byas te rdzing phyi shor/'od sna sogs dge lugs pa'i dgon pa bco brgyad 'bri gung bas phrogs/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho dgung lo drug cu re lnga'i thog rab byung dgu ba'i chu stag (1542)lor 'das/rgyal dbang sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/rab byung dgu ba'i chu yos (1543)lor stod lung mdar sku bltams/ gdan sar bkod nas paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa sogs bsten te/ gsan bsam rgya chen po gnang stabs kun gyis gtsug tu bkur/ sde gzar khag la chings 'dum dang bka' khra sogs mdzad/ me 'brug (1556)lor yar lung sne gdong ba dang / 'phyongs rgyas nang so ma mthun par sde gzar chen po langs skabs/ rje 'di ba bar 'dum mdzad par phebs te zhi 'jags mdzad/ sa lug (1559)lor sne gdong gong ma chen po ngag dbang bkra shis grags pas rje bsod nams rgya mtshor kwan ding ta'i gu shrī hong hang gi mtshan dang /phyag dam dmar bo gnang chog pa'i bka' shog gnang ste/ sne gdong pho brang du gdan drangs nas chos 'brel rgya chen po zhus/de'i phyi lor sne gdong gi zhal ngo rnams nang zhig byung ste sde 'khrug shā5bya

byung skabs/ rje 'di ba bar 'dum du phebs nas g.yul 'thab bkag slarayang ldosrid phag gru ba nang zhigazugi lde'akhrug skyid sho da phyogs nas langs par/ grub mtha' so so'i bla chen rnamasaci bar 'dum du byon yang pha na rgacher ma byung skabs/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho gdan drangs/ khong gis chings mdzad nas bka' khras bcad de dmag rna mas so sor gyes/ chu khyi (1562)lor lha sar chu nyen chen po byung skabs chu rags gsar rgyag dang / de nas bzung smon lam chen mo'i rjes thogs dge 'dun rnams kyi sa rags rdo skyel ba'i srol bzang btsugs/ sa sbrul (1569)lor bkra shis lhun por phebs/ gnas rnying ba chos kyi rgyal mtshan bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen du bsko gzhag mdzad/ gtsang phyogs kyi gnas chen rnams su phebs/ 'brong rtser rgyal byed tshal du 'brug pa pad ma dkar bo dang mjal 'phrad gnang /thugs snang gcig tu 'dres/ de nas bzung dge 'brug gnyis kyi mthun lam legs po byung /shing phag (1575)lor rin spungs pas dmag khri phrag yas mas btegs nas/ stodarilung sgal bo na khar phab/ sgal byang smon gsum bcom/ rim gyis skyid shod lha sar 'ong rtsis byas skabs/ rgyal dbang 'di bas drag po'i las snyor mdzad 156

pas phyi ra bzlog zer/ sog po cha har alagyithan rgyal bos gdan 'dren yang yang zhus pas rjes ma'i skabs phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes thog rab byung bcu ba'i me glang (1577) lo'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer drug nyin/ 'bras spungs nas chibs kha bsgyur/ de nas rim gyis phebs pas / rma chesasbom ra'i gangs kyi nye'adabs su slebs skabs/ mal than rgyal bo'i pheb sa bsu dang bo ba ku thaliji sogs kyis gtso byas pa'i rta ba brgyad brgya 'a/byor/ a rigs dkar bo'i thang du se chen hong tha'i ji sogs phebs bsu gnyis pa rta ba stong gsum tsam 'byor/ de rjes nyin gsum gyi ring jo rigs thu tha'i ji sogs phebs bsu gsum pa rta ba sum brgya skor dang / slar yang chos rje brtson 'grus bzang bo dang lo tsā ba gu shrī pak+ṣi sogs kyis gtsos rta ba lnga brgya skor phebs bsur 'byor/rab phyogs sa stag (1578) lo'i hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin mtsho sngon gyi lho nub zad mtshams chab cha zhes pa'i sa char al than rgyal bo yab yum 'khor khri phrag dang bcas phebs bsur sle bas nas/ dad gus chen pos ba sus te/ mchod yon thog maromajal/ sa der sa 'dul mdzad de theg chen chos 'khor gling zhes pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgyal bos 'bul ba rgya 157

chen po phul/ da nas sog yul du dam pa'i chos rgya chen po spel/sngar mi shi ba'i rjes su shi bor dmigs nas/ srog gcod pa'i srol ngan yod/ mchod yon gros thog nas srol ngan de mtshams bcad/ gal te mi bsad pa byung na lus srog la khrims gcod/rta phyugs bsad pa la nor thams cad 'phrog pa'i khrims bsgrags/sngar ong bkod ces zer ba gshin po thams cad kyi gzugs byas te/ zla ba re re bzhin nya stong tshes brgyad gsum la phyugs bsad de khrag mchod byed/ lo dus kyi mchod pa la dbul phyug gi dbye bas phyugs shin tu mang bo bsad de mchod pa byed pa'i srol ngan de'i rgyun bcad/ ong bkod ces pa'i rten brten pa me la bsregs/ de'i tshab tu ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sku re 'jog pa dang / de yang dkar mchod byed pa las khrag4mchod byed mi chog pa'i khrims bkod/ rgya bod hor sog gi mi su la'ang 'asbog bcom byed mi chog pa'i khrims bcas/ mdor na dge ba bcu la gnas dgos pa'i khrims mang du bsgrags/ dbang rjes gnang sogs chos kyi char ba phab bo rgyal dbang lnga ba'i rang rnam du klu la'i gos bzang gi rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar thad las/ lha sras mu ne dang 'khrungs rgyud gcig pa/ gnam sa'i dbang phyug al than chos 158

kyi rgyal bo'i dbu blar gyur te sa'i tshangs pa de nyid kyis mi rigs mi gcig pa du ma'i dbus su/ gser las grub pa'i dbu rgyan/bum pa/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ gser srang brgya las grub pa'i 'brug sder mo lngas mtshan pa/ kha ris la rdo rje 'chang tā la'i bla ma'i tham ga rgyal/ zhes hor yig gser du yod pa/ yo byad 'gangs che tshad med dang bcas/ tā la'i bla ma badz+ra dha ra zhes khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gi las ka phul/ rgyal bo la'ang lha'i tshangs pa chen po/ zhes mtshan gnang zhing / rgya nag gong ma wan li rgyal bos/ rgyal khams thams cad kyi bla ma gyig ching thi'i mtshan dang / tham ga lung / las zhwa/ las gos/'ja' sa sogs kyi sngon du rgyal bo'i che ba'i rol mo sna tshogs dang bcas rgya nag gi mi dpon gsum gyis gtso byas te mi sna 'byor/lu hang gsar ma'i na bza' cha tshang sogs dang / gser dngul gos dar sogs pho brang gi dpyad pa mang du phul/ nged rang gi 'bangs su gyur pa'i sog po tsho chen bzhi bcu dang / kan cu thang gi mi dpon sogs kyi re ba yongs su bskang ba legs shing /pho brang chen por yang rim gyis gdan 'dren zhes pa sogs kyi bka' shog gnang zhes gsungs so/ /dus de nas bzung rgyul dbang sku phreng rim byon la tā la'i 15mi

bla ma zhes yongs su grags/ tā la ni sog po'i skad la rgya mtsho zerartezhing / rgya mtsho'i bla ma zhes pa'i go don ni/ thugs rje dang min rlabs/ mtshan snyan dang 'phrin las sogs/ rgya mtsho chen po ltar mtha' dang mu med paraspurgya che ba'i don yin par gsungs/rgyal rigs gsum gyis gtso byas pa'i sog po brgya phrag mang bo rab tu byung / nar bsdus kyi rgyal bo sa gdan drangs/ der phun tshogs gzhan phan sde zhes pa'i dgon pa btab/ yul du mar phebs/ chos lan mang bor choganang / cha har rnams kyis rgya'i lcags ri'i nang khongs kyi sde la gnod 'tshe che bas/ rje 'di bas sog po rnams la5chos dang 'brel ba 'i bka' slob gnang nas bzung rgya'i rigs rnams la gnod 'tshe mi byed par gyur/ d+ngha ༄ yo sa (1579) lor 'ur bsdus dang / o rod nang 'khrug pa 'dum mdzad de bde bar bkod/ mchod yon bka' gros thog nas bod sog 'brel ba byed mi sog phyogs nas dpon po kho lo che ching pū thur 'khor bcas mtsho khar 'jog rgyu dang / bod phyogs nas sku tshab stong skor yon tan rgya mtsho bsko gzhag byas te sog yul du rdzong bda' mdzad/ sne gdong gong mar lo ltar mtsho kha'i phyogs nas rta khral 'bul rgyu'i rgyun btsugs/lcags 'brug (1580) lor khams stod li thang du phebs/160

mi nga dgon chen thub bstan byams chen phyogs thamasachacad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde—btab/ lcags sbrul (1581) lor rmar khams/ brag g.yab/ chab mdo sogs surtaphebs/ ldan chos 'khor dgon du phebs skabs al tshothan rgyal—bo'i sras du ring rgyal ribo mi sna mngagabo /dang bca sa/ al than rgyal—bo gshegs pa'i bsngo sku dang / gdan 'drenatwa byon pa ltar mtsho khar chibs bsgyur /chu lug (1583) lo'i lo sar ska bas sku 'bum du phyag phebs/ der bshad grwa btsugs/ tsong kha'i phyogs su rgya dang hor 'khrugartsopa chen po yod par 'dum mdzad de kun bde skyid kyi lam du bkod/ de nas 'ur bsdus da pon se chen hong tha'i ji'i sde thoskyig tu 'byor/ der dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ rab tu byung ba stong phrag brgal ba byung / shing bya (1585) lor se chen da 'i chingar+shagi sde thog tu phebs te/ phywan tshogs dar rgyas gling gi dgon pa btab/ me khyi ( 1586) lor al than rgyal bo'i sra sa du ringadzhagi—gdan 'dren 'byo ra ba ltar/ chibs bsgyur gnang ste a la than rgyal bo'i rgyal sa/ mkhar sngon por phebs/ mang tshogs la dbang bskur byin rlabs sog sa gnang ba dang /a la than rgyal bo'i gdung zhugs la phul/ bsngo smon mdzad/ du ri nga 'ing gi mchod yul du lo gcig tsam bzhugs/ du ring khrang 161

yang glo bur du gshigs/ rje 'di bas yang snyung tshul cung zad bzhes/ sa byi (1588)lo 'i hor zla dang bo'i zla mjug tu bro 'tshal ba'i tshul mdzad yod thog rgya nag gong ma'i gdan 'dren mi sna 'byor/ rten 'brel la dgongs phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang / zla gsum pa'i tshes nyer bdun nyin sku 'das/ dgung grangs zhe drug pa yin 'dra/ gdung zhugs la phul nas gdung rus rnams zhabs 'bring ba rnams kyis 'bras spungs su gdan drangs so/ / rgyal dbang sku phreng bzhi ba yon tan rgya mtsho/sog yul du yab thu med tha'i ji dang yum bā khen sbur gyi sras su rab byung bcu ba'i sa glang (1589)lo'i zla1tshes1nyin 'khrungs/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i yang sprul du ngos bzung /dgung lo gnyis bzhes skabs sog po'i stedapon rigs dang / sbyin bdag rnams kyis mkhar sngon por gdan drangs/ dga' ldan khri zur rgyal khang rtse ba dpal 'byor rgya mtshos thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho zhes pa'i mtshan stsal/ dgung lo bcu bzhi'i thog lcags glang (1601) lor dpal ldan 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi khrir 'khod/ de rjes dga' ldan khri zur sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mkhan po mdzad de rab tu byung nas dge tshul gyi /6lha

sdom pa bzhes/ — bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sa paṇa chen bco lnga ba blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo rgyal dbang mchog gis gtsug gi cod pan du bsten te mdo sngags kyi chos bka' mang du gsan/gong du bshad pa ltar bkra shis lhun por paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi gdan sar bzhugs mkhan rnams la paṇa chen zhes pa'i mtshan thogs la/ paṇa chen bco lnga ba blo bzang chos rgyan sku tshe gang la paṇa chen du bzhugs stabs/ de nas bzung paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi sku phreng rnams la paṇa chen rin po che zhes mtshan de rgyun 'jags su byung / shing 'brug (1604)lor rje 'di'i bka' gnang ltar 'on rgyal sras don yod chos kyi rgya mtshos mdo smad a mdo'i yul du dgon lung btab/ me lug (1607)lor bkra shis lhun por phebs/ slob dpon paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos rgyan la brgya 'bul dang bcas zla ba phyed gnyis lhag la chos bka' mang du zhus/ de skabs zhing shag pa tshe brtan rdo rje'i bu sde ba karma bstan srung dbang bos gtsang phyogs la dbang bsgyur pa'i skabs yin la/ de dang phyogs lhung can 'ga' zhig gis mi gus pa'i rnam 'gyur byas par grags/163

lcags khyi (1610) lor mtsho kha nas dpon kho lo che'i sraji5 lha btsun che ba dang / se chen tha'i jis gtso byas pa rdzisog 'grul dang / dmag dpon che ba byung / skyid shod sde ba bsod nams rnayorgya la dang / 'dan pa 'amo bye da sogs kyis gtsang rgolagyi dus zing bslangs par/ ga tsarodamag 'bor chen skyid shod lha sar 'ongs/ rdzong gzhis du ma phrogs/ chad 'anga'ibyas/hor sog gi dpung chen po ra nga yul du bskrad/ gtsang bas dbus la dbang bsgyur/ po ta la'i pho brang bzung / dge l+yag sa pa la shin tu sdang stabs/ paṇa chen rin 4che'i bka' bzhin/lam pa rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pas gtso byas nas drag po'i las sbyor mdza da pa dang / lam pa rab 'byamus pa bsod nams grags pas mu mthud nas las sbyor mdzad stabs/gtsang rgyal gyi sras rnams gzhon nu nayogashegs/ gtsang rgyal khrir 'khod dag kyang dar ma dar tho ga na sa 'das stabs/ gtsang rgya la khros nas/ lam pa rab 'byams pa bsod nams grags pa btson du ba cug mig rna ba so gas dbang bo rnams bregs/ de ltar byas mod/ phyis su mig sogs dbang bo gsar ba skyes te/ri phug ces pa'i khong gi gdan sa nas bka' lung dkon po mang bo gnang ba dang mu mthud nas drag po'i las sbyor mdzad stabs /164

de rjes lo gsum tsam las ma 'gor bar gu shrī bstan 'dzin gyisasnyo rigatsang srid lhag med du bco ma ste/ gtsang srid ming tsam lhagabyumar ma lus pa rje 'di ba'i mthu nus yin zhes rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i gsung gi 'jigs byed chos 'byung sogs rnam thar lo rgyus mang bo'i nang du 'dug go/ /lcags phag (1611)lor rje 'dis paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos rgyan 'bras spungs su spyan drangs te rdo rje phring ba sogs dbang bka' rgya chen po gsan/ lo 'dir gtsang dmag gtos chen po yar rgyab pa'i thog tu 'ongs nas/ yar rgyab pa 'i dbang cha tshang ma phrogs/ sku skal byin nas sa gzhan du phud/shing stag (1614)lor rgyal dbang rin po ches paṇa chen rin po che'i drung las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ me 'brug (161 6) lor rgya nag tā ming rgyal bos khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang zhes pa'i mtshan bstod phul/ lo der gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnamargyal gyis karma ba yab sras gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtser gdan drangs/ gtsang khul gyi ser mo yod tshad kyis chos 'brel zhu dgos pa dang / ser sbrengs zhu bar 'dzom dgos pa'i bka' phab/ lo der rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho dgung grangs nyer brgyad du slebs/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin sku 'das/165

phyi lo nas lo shas ring la slob dpon paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan se 'bras kyi mkhan khrir phebs pa dang / lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbur rgyun du phebs 'dug go/ /rgyal dbang sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang rgya mtsho/rab byung bcu ba'i me sbrul (1617) lo'i zla9tshes23nyin 'phyongs rgyas phying ba stag rtser/ yab za hor rgyal bo'i gdung rgyud hor bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / yum khri lcam kun dga' lha mdzes kyi sras su 'khrungs/ gtsang stse srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis paṇa chen rin po che dang bkra shis lhun por brnyas gtse chen po byed bzhin pa'i rkyen las/ sog po'i 'grul ba rgya che ba dbus phyogs su 'byor/ de tshos karma ba'i mdzo khyu jag 'ded byas/karma ba'i rgyab tu gtsang ba langs te/ sa rta (1618)lo'izla ba bdun pa'i nang / sde srid gtsang ba'i dmag dang / dwags kong gi dmag chen lha sar 'byor/ thu med tha'i ji'i sras lha btsun bgres gzhon gnyis dang / se chen da'i ching sogs thu med kyi rgyal rgyud har hu la/ khun du lung cho khur sogs hal ha'i rgyal rgyud/ sde ba skyid shod pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs se 'bras kyi gros la dbang ba du ma 'dus te/ dga' 166 —

lhan pho brang ba'i tsags nas dmag 'khrug bsgol thabs mdzad cing / gtsang srid phyogs nas ma nyan par mthar sog dmag dang / gtsang bas bsdus pa'i bod dmag gis skyid shod lha sa'i phyogs dmag 'khrug nyin mang bor byas/ gtsang dmag stong phrag lhag lha sar kha btags/ gtsang dmag mang bos 'bras spungs gtor rtsis kyis 'bras spungs rgyab ri'i rtser phyin pa/ da'i ching gis dmag sna drangs te/ sog dmag gtsang dmag gi thog tu brgyugs nas/ gtsang dmag gcig kyang ma lus par bsad/ de'i phyi nyin skyid chu'i 'gram du gtsang bas dmag sgar sngar las che ba brgyab pas/ sog dmag skrag ste 'bros 'go brtsams/ se 'bras kyi dge 'dun rnams dang / sde ba skyid shod pa sogs kyang skrag ste 'phan yul dang / byang stag lung sogs su bros/ gtsang dmag gis se 'bras bcom/ 'bras spungs rgyab rir skya ser shin tu mang bo bsad/ skyid shod pa'i rdzong gzhis thams cad blangs/ sde ba skyid shod pa yab sras mtsho khar bros/ dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' mang bo bsgyur/ chos rje stag lung bas chings mol zhus te/ se 'bras kyi grwa ba rnams sngar rgyun bzhin grwa sar bzhugs chog par byas kyang / 'bras spungs la gser zho nyis brgya'i chad pa dang / se ra la gser zho brgya ①67

tham pa'i chad pa bzhag se 'bras la gser ste' rgyu—mid pas byudaga' ldan sorībrang ba'i zhal ngo bsod nams cho sa 'thel gyis rgyal du mdzod cig yod pa las gser lenacidagos tshul blorjod de/gtsang ba'i sku tshab dang mnyam du rgyal du 'gro skabasacilamakharinas bros te nyang kongarībargyudaldesag yul du 'byor/de rjes gtsang bas yar lung sokas4kyi sde dponarams la ches mi 'atsam pa sha stag byas pa dang / snyodus mtshungs su rgyal dbang gi yab hor bdud 'dul rdo rje'i lagasanas phying ba stag rtse'i rdzong blangs 4te/ zug po nas la rtsis sprad/ rgyal dbang gi yum khri lcam la chu shur lha gshong lto skaladadu gnang ste chu shur la 'gro dgos byung / yab gtsang du khrid nas btson du bcug sa lug (1619) lor gtsang srid gzhung gis yum sras gnyisarīka myur du gtsang du yong dgos zer yang / gzim khang sde ba sna dkar rtse bas gtsang la yar zhus dang kha ga theg gnang stabs/rtsam sras gnyis ka sna dkar rtser bzhugs chog pa byung / rgyal dbang dgung lo gsum gyi thog mtshan mor dpal 'bar sur te bros byol byed skabs mi ser rnams kyis kyang sems skyo ba'i ngu 'bod sogs byas tshul rnam thar du gsal/lcags bya (1621) lor lha btsun blo bzang bstan 'dzin 56byi

rgya mtsho dang / gu ru hong tha'i jis gtsos hor sogalagi da mag stong gnyis lha sar slebs/ gtsang bas rkyang thang sgang du dmag sgor brgyab/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin/ glo bur du sogari dmag gtsang ba'i dmag sgar thog tu brgyugs pas mi brgya phrag du ma bsad/ paṇa chen rin —po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan nabras spungs su mtshams la bzhugs yod pas thos ma thag thugs kyis ma bzod par mtshams har 'do na gyis zhabs thang la sog dmag gis me mda' dang / mda'i char 'bebs pa'i skabs su phebs/ bod dmag rnams lcab/sa po rir 'khor ba la sog dmag brgyugs pa'i rgyug 'phro bcad/ mi stong phrag mang bo'i srog bskyabs/ gtsang sog gnyis kas lha sa paṇa chen rin po cher phul/ paṇa chen rin po che/ dga' ldan khri ba tshul khrims chos 'phel/ gling smad zhabs drung dkon mchog chos 'phel/ stag lung zhabs drung rnams kyis chings mdzad de bcad khra bzha gdaga' ldan pho brang bar chos 'khor lha sas gtso byas rags man gyi sa cha byin/ se 'bras mchod gzhis rnams tshur sprad/ dbus gtsang gi dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' bsgyur ba rnams dang gzhis shor sngar ltar du phyir slog sde ba skyid shod pa la yang bye ri stag rtse dang / bde chen gyi sa tshab tu 'phan yul mkhar rtse dang bcas 169

tshang ma byung / zhal ngo bsod nams chos 'phel 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang du gzhis phab nas rgyal ba'i yang srid btsal bar ngos 'dzin gsal ba 'phyongs rgyas phying ba stag rtse'i de dang gzhan gnyis bcas paṇa chen rin po che dang / gling smad zhabs drung gnyis ra sgrong du phebs nas jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje'i sku'i drung du zan brtag gnang ba/ 'phyongs rgyas sprul skur bab/ rab phyogs chu pho khyi'i (1622)lor dgung lo drug gi thog sna dkar rtse nas gdan drangs te 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi rgyal ba gong ma'i gdan sar bkod/ paṇa chen rin po che la gtsug phud phul bar mtshan ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho zhes stsal/gtsang sde srid dogs pa chung ched sku tshab cig zhus pas/ sku tshab des sog po sogs kyi yig 'grul yod med rtsam khug nang tshun chad brosngogs bsher bya sa/ shing glang (1625)lor paṇa chen jirin po che'i drung las dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ yab bdud 'dul rdo rje gtsang ba'i khrims 'og nas 'das/ gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal 'das rjes/ sras karma bustan skyong dbang bos srid dbang bzung / de'i skabs lo bco lnga yin zhes bris 'dug shā70

rab drag chu pho dz+ral (1632)lor sig po hal has/ hor stod dang / a mi sger ru bcom/ gtsang sde srid kyis bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag bsdu ba sogs gra sgrig dang / dus mtshungs paṇa chen rin po che dang dga' ldan pho brang gi zhal ngo bsod nams chos 'phel gnyis sog khrod du chings la phebs dgos zer ba ltar khong gnyis phebs pas/ sog dmag gis gsung brtsis te phyir rang yul du log bcug ste/ don 'khyol byung stabs/ gtsang ba dpon blon rab tu dga' ba byung 'dugader brten gtsang sde bar zhus te/ lcags po ri'i bcad khra ltar lha sa dga' ldan pho brang bas rtsis blangs/ sngar rgyal ba rin po che tā la'i bla ma lha sar phebs skabs sger shag tu bzhugs dgos kyang / de tshun chad gtsug lag khang gi steng gi gzim chung du bzhugs pa yin 'dug sngar hal ha nang zhig byung nas chog thu dpon sde dang bcas pa mtsho sngon por 'ongs nas re zhig mnga' thang rgyas te mdo smad phyogs kyi bod sog la dbang bsgyur/ kho rgya'i ta'o rin la dad cing bod sog gi bla ser la shin tu sdang / mdo stod du be ri— dpon don yod zer ba bon la dad cing / sa kar rnying dge rnams la shin tu sdang / dbus gtsang du gtsang ba sde srid kyis 171

dbang bsgyur te/ kho karma ba la dad cing / dge lugs pa la shin tu sdangag/ de gsum mna' 'bre la gyis dbus 'grul dang tshong 'grul gyi lam bkaga'agogachaso—gas mdo dbus gtsang gsum la dka' tshegs tshen po byung / de skabs a mdo dgon lung gi grwa ba dga' ru lo tsā ba dang / sems nyid kha che zer ba gnyis dbus su 'ongs nas// skyid shod sde ba bye ri stag rtse/ sde ba matsoskyes rdo rje sogs dang gros byas te/ dga' ru lo tsās dpa la riyo kyi dmag kha shas khrid de so ga po jing gir du rgyab gnyen 'tshol du phyin/ rgyu mtshan zhus/ sog po'i rgyal blon rnams kyi sa gros bsdur byed skabs/ bod yul du rgyab—gnyen la su 'gro byas pas gu shrī han bstan 'dzin gyis nga 'gro zhesakhas bla ngasaram bcas/shing phag (1635) lor mtsho sngon nas chog thu dpon gyi sa rang gi bu ar sa lang tha'i ji khri dmag dang bcas dbus gtsang codu mngags te/ sde ba gtsa nga ba dang karma ba la 'brel ba byas nas dge lugs pa med par gtong dgos pa'i bka' phab/dbus su 'byor nas ar sa lang gis mtshur phu karma bar mjal rtsis byas pa/ sog por skrag nas ngo ma bstan/ ar sa lang tha'i ji'i sems la phog ste/ kar gtsang la 'brel lam ma byume /me byi (1636) lo'i lo sar skabs ar sa lang tā la'i bla mar 172

mjal phyag zhus/ 'bras spungs su tā la'i bla ma'i sku mdun du bcar te dbang dang rjes gnang zhus/ de rjes 'dam gzhung brgyud nas phyir log de rjes zhwa dmar rab 'byams pa zer d+kub dang / blon po tha'i chin gnyis kyis gros thog nas chog thu'i sar bang chen pa mngags nas/ ar sa lang gis pha'i bka' bzhin ma byas pa'i gnas tshul tshang ma brjod pas chog thu zhe sdang 'phar te/ mi mang gas nas rang gi bu ar sa lang dang / de'i blonasgrupho gnyis stabasad/ —de'i skab sa zhig nas mdo stod kyi dpon be+e ri don yod kyis ruli thang dgon sogs gtor/ lo rjes mar kho dmag bcas dbus gtsang du 'ongs nas/ lha sa'i jo bo dang / se lkobras dge spusum med par gtong zhes 'phrin btang bar gtsang bas kyang der bskyan dmag gra sgrig 4byas/ me glang (1637) lo'i zla1bor gu shrī han gyi dmagaspem tsho sngon du yod pa'i chog zu'i steng dud+kurgyugs pas/ cho ga thu'i dmog sum khri yod pa pham par byas/ chog thu rang bros na sa ma tha ra bar bzung nas bsadaspya/ gu shrī han gyis mtsho sngon sogs mdo smad la dbang bsgyur/ mtsho sngon du gzhis chags/ de rjes rim gyis o rod jun gar gyi su shrī hanarīgyi ru sde rnams mtsho sngon 173

du gnas spos/ de nas gu shrīhan sogs bod sog gi 'grul ba gtos che ba lha sar 'byor/ gu shrī han gyis rgyal dbang rin po cher 'bul ba gtos che ba dang bcas chos mang bo zhus/ me glang lo der paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi drung las rgyal dbang rin po che bsnyen par rdzogs/lcags 'brug (1640)lo'i dbyar thog gu shrī han gyi sob/ dmag dang / a mdo'i dmag bcas be ri don yod kyi sa thog tu slebs nas g.yul bkyes te be+e ri gson bzung byas pa chab mdor khri mon du bcug sa rnying / kar dge/ jo 'bruga'abri stag gi bla ma sum brgya5lhag btson du bcug yod pa rnams btson las bton te mi 'jigs srog gi skyabs spyin mdzad/ shar dar rtse mdo nas 'jang sa tham rgyal bo'i sa cha tshun chad mdo khams tshang ma dbang du bsdus/ de nas lcags sbrul (1641) lor gu shrī han gyi dmag gtsang ba sde srid kyi thog tu chas/ gtsang ba'i bod dmag rnams kyis bkag kyang ma khogs par phal cher gyis mgo sgur/ kha shas rang yul du bros/ chu rta (1642)lo'i zla ba lnga ba'i nyer lnga la sog dmag rnams chos sde gsar ba'i nang la 'dzul/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes shar la/ gtsang ba cham la jiphab/ sde srid kyi srog skyabs zhu bar sa skya (nabs drung dang /174

paṇa chen rin po che 'phral du phibs nas rgyal bor ched mjal gyis gtsang sde srid kyi zhabs 'degs su gang 'gyur byas kyang / sngon du bro dam por bkag pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis srog skyob pa ma gtogs phan thogs rgya che ba ma thub gsungs 'dug gtsang rgyal karma bstan skyong dbang bo dang / mgron gnyer bon gong ba/rta nag 'o rlon pa/ sgang zug pa bcas sne'u rdzong du khrid nas khri mon du bcug rgyal bos gdan zhus ltar rgyal dbang rin po che zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin 'bras spungs nas btegs te/ thob rgyal mda' bde chen du slebs nyin gu shrī han bstan 'dzin chos rgyal sogs ser skya gtos che ba phebs bsur 'byor/ rgyal bo dang thog mar mjal skabs rin po che sna tshogs pa dang / bod khri skor bcu gsum dang bcas pa phul/ tshes nyer lnga'i nyin bkra shis lhun por phebs/ rab drag chu rta (1642) lo'i zla4tshes5nyin/ gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong gi tshoms chen nang ser skya bgrangs kyis mi lang ba'i dbus su gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por tā la'i bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs sor 'khod/ de nas gudzāshrī hen bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis maṇa ḍal sku gsung thugs rten gyi thog drangs/ rgyal ba'i 'phel gdung 175

sogs rten 'gangs du ma dang rin po che sna dgu'i sne drangs te/ shar dar rtse mdo nas nub la dwags bar gyi sa cha rnamaṣ+ka yul mi bcas 'bangs saphul zhing / rgyal bo rang nyid rigs rgyud dang bcas pa mchod sbyin du 'acibul bar mdzad/ zhal ngo b.lod nams chos 'phel la sde srid kyi go gnas phul/ bod kyi sa gnas yongs dze+edril bsgrags/ de nas bzung gtsang sde srid kyi srid dbang mjug bsdus/ bod srid dga' ldan pho brang ba'i phyag tu 'byor/ sog rgyal gyis rgyal bo'i mtshan bzung ste rgyab phyogs dmag dpon byas/ sde srid kyis chab srid kyi bya ba bsgrubs so/ / lo de'i zla ba dgu ba'i nang nas/ gtsang phyogs kyi dgon sde dang sde dpon dag gis lkog nas 'brel ba byas te ngo log rgya po byas stabs/ sog rgyal gu shrī han khros nas/ gtsang ba'i rgyal blon gnyis ka khri mon du yod pa srog chad bcad/ kar gtsang gi dgon sde rnams med par btang bas/ bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa 'jig pa'i rkyen de ltar byung ngo / /chu lug (1643) lor karma bra chos dbyings rdo rje dgung grangs zhe bdun thog lho brag nas bros te 'jang yul —du phebs nas yun ring bzhugs/ shing bya (1645) lo'i zla3tshes28176

nyin lto 'phye'i thig btab ste pho brang chen po po ta la bzhing rgyu'i gra sgrig gi 'go bzung nas pho brang chen po rtenatsho dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs shing / de rjes sde srid sa ngas rgyas rgya mtshos pho brang dmar bo rten dang brten par bcas bzhengs7pa tsā rjes bsdoms pas lo zhe gsum gyi ring la legs par grub pa yin 'dugajisngar shing sprel (1644) lo la bod kyi gzhung dmag 'bru ga pa'i thog tu song skabs/ paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos rgyan dang / sa skya bdag chen bsod nams dbang phyug gnyis kyis chi des brgyab mod/ yun ring ma gnas par sa byi (1648)lor slar yang bod gzhung gi dmag 'brug thog tu yong bas g.yul 'gyed ska/bas pham kha khur 'dug zer/ dmag 'khrug langs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bod gzhung gi mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i mon pha bla khag lnga dang lho 'brug ma mthun pa dang / 'brug pas bod gzhung la lo re bzhin 'bras 'bul dgos pa/ gtsang bas srid dbang bzung skabs phul mod/ dga' ldan pho brang bas srid dbang bzung ba nas ma phul ba'i ltab sa kyis yin 'dug lo 'di la dga' ldan pho brang nas/ rgyal rong dar mdo lcags la sogs mdo smad du dud tshang grangs len dang / gzhung khyal sogs kyi yig khra thel dam can deb lnga bcu nga drug bzo sa zer/177

trī ming rgyal bo'i rgyal sa phregs nas/ de'i tshab tu dbang bsgyur ba'i man ju'i rgyal bo'i bzhi ba hrun kris lo snga phyir yang dang yang du gdan 'dren zhus pa bzhin/ chu 'brug (1652)lo'i zla3tshes15nyin rgya nag phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur/ lam bar rgya sog bod rigs kyi dpon 'bangs dang / rgya dang man ju'i blon chen dmag dpung bcas kyis phebs bsu dang dngos 'bul rgya che ba mdzad/ chu sbrul (1653)lo'i zla ba dang bor gong ma hrun kri dang mjal 'phrad byung / mjal dar rtse sprod gnang / slar zla gnyis par gong ma'i pho brang du gdan drangs nas dngos 'bul gtos che ba phul ba sogs mjal 'phrad thengs kha shas gnang /gong ma dang sog po'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin rgya nag dang / sog yul gyi dgon sde rnams la bca' yig dang bka' slob sogs stsal/ de nas zhi drag gi blon chen rnams kyis phebs skyel dang bcas zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin pe cin nas chibs kha bsgyur/ zla ba lnga ba'i tshes lnga'i nyin ta'i kha zhes pa'i sa gnas su phebs skabs/ shin tu rgya che ba'i mdzad sgo'i thog gong ma'i dmigs bsal gyi mi snas gser gyi tham ga dang / gser gyi glegs bu bco lnga la mig dang 'brel 178

nas lteb chog pa'i nang / man ju/ hor/ bod yig 'bur dod du brkos pa'i nang / nub kyi lha gnas ches dge ba bde bar gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' lung gnam 'og gi skye 'gro thams cad bstan pa gcig tu gyur pa 'gyur med rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i bla ma zhes mtshan bstod phul/ tā la'i bla ma rin po che nas kyang gong dang 'dra ba'i gser gyi glegs bu'i thog bo da/man/ hor gsum gyi yi ge 'bur du dod pa brkos pa'i nang gnam gyi lha 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen po zhes mtshan bstod gong ma'i mi sna'i phyag tu phul/ de nas mkhar sngon brgyud zi ling sku 'bum sogs a mdo'i dgon gnas rnams dang / mtsho sngon gyi sa gnas khag chab mdo sogs mdo stod kyi dgon sde dang / yul sde sogs kyis bsnyen bkur bla na med pa zhus thogachos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshim par byas te/ zla ba bcu ba'i tshes nyer bzhi'i nyin lha ldan du 'byor 'dug go/ /shing rta (1654)lo'i zla12tshes7nyin gu shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal dgung grangs don gnyis thog gzim khri'i mtha' can du gyur/sa khyi (1658)lor gu shrī han gyi sras bstan 'dzin rdo rje la rgyal bo'i thob gnang / yab kyi dus ltar sog dmag gi 'go two 179

'dzin mdzad/ lo de 'i zla gsum par sde srid bsod nams chos 'phel sa/shegs/ logacig la gsang rgya mdzad/ lcags byi (16 60) lo'i zla7tshes1 3nyinawā'i sang sde ba zer ba grong smad pophrin las rgya mtshor sde srid kyi cho lo gnang ba dang / de dang mnyam rgyal bo bstan 'dzin rdo rje la yang / bstan 'dzin dā yan khrang zhes pa'i cho losnal te/ mchod yon gyis mdzad sgo dus gcig la gnang / lcags glang (1661) lor ba la bo'i dpung dmacig gis bod khongs glang bu mkhar du tshur rgol byung bar bod dmag gis 'awal du sa mtshams nas phar bskrad/ chu stag (1662) lor paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshasto sku 'das ga sungs 'dug lo 'dir 'bras rgyal sras bstan srung rnam rgyal rgyal sar 'a khod pa chabs cig tā la'i bla ma rin po cher mja lanebar lha sar phebs/ sde srid kyang mjal te khrims yig zhal rtse bcu drug skor la slob ston mang bo zhus gnang mjod/shing sbru la (1665) lor man5ju gong ma lnga ba khang shi rgyal bos/ dalagel dge slong dang / shes rab 'od zer gnyis dza drag gis mi snar mngags te tā la'i bla ma rin po cher zhus don/ sog po tshos rgya'i sa mtshams brgal nas rgya grong rnams la rta ga tu gnod pa byed kyin 'dug pas/ rgyu sog sa mtshams kyi 180

dpon sde rnams la zhal ta bka' slob gnang mi sku tshab ched gtong gnang rgyu thugs rje che zhes zhus pa ltar/ sa mtsha mas kyi dpon sde rnams la/ sa mtshams gtan khel ba'i rang sde rang 'dzin dang / sa mtshams brgal nas rgya sde rnams la bsun gtser mi byed yar sngar lugs ltar tshong 'brel —yag po byas nas 'dug dgos/ zhes bka' slob gnang mkhan byamasacagling mkhan po tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang / khang gsar rab brtan pa gtong gnang mdzad pas rtsod gzhi zhi 'jags dngabyu/ 'brel ba sngar lugs bzhin yag po byung /me lug (1667)lorangapaṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang bo/ bkra shis lhun po'i pho brang rgyal mtshan jimathon por sku gong ma'i khrir bkod/ de'i phyi lor sde srid grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho khri lo dgur ga nang ste gshegs/ de rjes bltan 'dzin tā yan shāl bo yang 'das/ sa sprel (16 68) lor mon pa a lcog pa'i steng du 'brug dmag byung bar/ a lcog pa'i rgyab gnyer la bod gzhung gi dmag song nas 'brug pa pham par byas — te chings bzhag shing yos (1675) lor mon 'brug gnyis 'khrugs pa dang / ye 'brug (1co76)yor 'brug pas mon dang 'bras ljongs la btsan 'a dzulko byasapas/ bod gzhung gi 8/

dmag song nas 'bras ljongs nas 'brug dmag phyi 'phud btang /sa cha shor ba rnams phyir blangs / sa rta (1678) lor bod 'brug bka' mol byas mod chings legs po ma byung / sa bya (1669)lor mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs sde srid du bsko gzhag gnang / 'di la zangs ri blo bzang mthu stobs yang zer/ de'i phyi lor o rod kyi nang du sde gzar langs par/ rgyal dbang dang sde srid kyis gangs can mkhan po dkon mchog rin chen mngags te phan tshun lugs legs byung / lcags phag (1671) lor paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes rgyal dbang mchog la dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhu ba/ mdocasngags kyi chos mang bo zhu ba'i don du lha sar phebs/ gu shrī han gyi sras chung ba dkon mchog da la'i la bstan sdedzin da la'i cho lo dang bcas rgyal bo'i go sar khri 'don mdzad/chu byi (1672)lo'i lo sar skabs nas rin chen rgyan cha spras pa'i srol btsugs/ de yang bod rje chos rgyal sku dus kyi chas gos gzhi byas nas gser ga sog rna/ sog sgor/ rna rgyangs/shal dkar dmar/ tsi gos/ tsi ber/ gtsug zhwa ste rin chen rgyan spras su grags pa sde srid sngon rab sa dag gi dus bzhin mdzad/ sde drug mkhan po blo bzang dar rgyus/ hal ha sde gzhung 182

gi bla mar rdzong bda' mdzad/ bar khamasadiphyogs su dpon mkha' 'gro dang sgar ba sku nyer 'brel ba byas te/ bod kyi bstan srid la gnod pa byung stabs/mtsho sngon nas da la'i hong tha'i jis dmag dpon byas/ dga' ldan dar rgyas tshe dbang rab brtan sogs kyi dpung dmag bar khams su 'byor ba tsam gyis dgra phyogs kyis mgo sgur/ dmag dpung phyir log da la'i hong tha'i ji 'khor bcas gnas tshul zhu bar lha sar byon/ shing stag (1674)lor mdo khams rgyal thang phyogs su bod gzhung sku tshab kyi bka' mi brtsi ba byung stabs/ ul jo'i tha'i jis dmag dpon dang / de'i rogs par bka' brgyad nor bu/ mas chags pa dpung bcas rdzong bda' mdzad pa ltar song nas dpung 'jug tsha nan byas/ shing yos (1675)lo'i zla1bor gte bo nyi shur srog chad bab ste lha sar khrid 'ongs pa la/gong nas srog sbyin mdzad de tshe btson byas/ gzhan 'ga' la'ang nyes bstun gyi chad las bkal/me 'brug (1sdo76)lor sde srid mthu stobs dgongs zhus kyis zur bzhugs mdzad/ rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi gnyer ba blo bzang sbyin pa sde srid du bskos/ me sbrul (1677)lo 'ba' chos 183

sde dgon la phogs thob sngar yod thog 'phar snon mchod gzhis gsar snon mdzad/ rmu li (mi li) sde spyi nas lo ltar sde gzhung la gser khril 'a bulorgyu byas/ dar rtse mdor dga' ldan 'grokyiphanangagling gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ dar rmado'i dgon sde dag dang /mgo log dgon gsar bcas la phogs thebs mchod gzhis skor gnang ba dang / khungs so sor slob dpon bcas rdzong bda' mdzad/ rgyal thang dgon grwa ba lnga brgya sum cu skor la yang gtong thebs mchod gzhis thag bcad/be cin nas gong ma khang shis bang chen pa mngags te/ rgya nag gi nang blon phing sing wang gi ngo log gis nang 'khrug byung gshis/ tā la'i bla ma mchog nas/ bod dngacisog po 'i dmag gi rgyab rogs yod pa 'tshal zhes zhu ba 'byor/ rgyal dbang mchog gis bod sog gis tshad pa mi thub/ 'brum partsolas ma thar sogs gsungs nas khas ma blangs/sa lug (1679)lor sde srid blo bzang sbyin pa lo gsum la bzhugs te dgongs pa zhus/ grong smad pa a war sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sde srid du bskos/ stod mnga' ris kyi dgon sde khag la/lasna dwags pas gnod 'tshe yang yang byas par brten/ bod sog gi dmag la dwags su dpung 'jug byas/ la dwags pham yang kho 184

tshos kha che'i rgyal bor mgo btags te kha che'i dmag khrid 'ongs nas g.yul thengs mang bor bkyes mod/ mthar ladwags pham ste/la dwags rgyal bo go sa nas phab/ la dwags cho sa rgyal rnying khungs kyi rgyud pa blo bzang pad ma rgyal bor bskos/ lo ltar dga' ldan tshopho brang bar gus 'dud zhu bar yong rgyu'i mna' gan bzhag rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu pho khyi (1682) lor tā la'i bla ma rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po dgung lo re drugasgothog sku gshegs / snoltar tā la'i bla ma rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po ni/ zhochad pa'i phyogs nas/ mdo sngags rig gnas kun dadzogrubaglim—tha' ris med kyi chos gsan zhing gzhagal 'chad pa—sa/ bod dang / rgya sog gi che dgu chung dgu mtha' dag slob mar gyur pa daro / rtsom pa'i phyogs nas/ mdo sngagasaurig gnas grub mtha' ris med kyi4 chos gsung rtsom pod sum cur longs ba yod la/ rtsod pa'i phyogs nas/ gzhon nu'i dus nas rtsod gleng rig pa 'gran zla dang bral bar grags pa dang / chab srigaphyogs nas/ chab srid kyi 'gan bzung ba nas/ nang 'khrug sde gzar sogs med par yul khams 'jam thing gis song ba sogs ni nges don bden gtam mo/ / rgyal dbang lnga ba sku 'das rjes/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya — 85

mtshos gsang rgya yun ring byas/ gsang rgya byed dgos don ni/rgyal dbang sku gshegs kha'i zhal chems yin zer ba dang / rgyal dbang mi bzhugs par shes na rgya sog gi dpon rigs dag bod gzhung la de tsam mi gus snyam pa'i dogs pa byung ba dang / lo brang po ta la yang bzhengs ma tsharajib dang / sde srid rang yang khrir 'khod nas lo gsum tsam las ma 'gor bas/ srid dbang brtan min la'ang bsam blo btang ba red zer ba sogs sna tshogs smra/ gang ltar lo bco lngar gsang rgya byas te zhabs gras spyi la'ang gsang zhing / rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi grwa ba sde ba bkras rab zer ba/zhal ngo sogs rgyal dbang dang 'dra ba dgung na mnyam pa de rgyal dbang du brdzus nas/ phyi nas 'ongs pa'i sbyin bdag dang dpon rigs gal chen la mjal kha gtong dgos tshe des rgyal dbang gi tshab byas/ sde srid kyis rgyal dbang gi yang srid rtsad gcod byed par/ chos rje zil gnon rdo rje dang / rdo ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan gnyis sogs gtong gnang gis/ mon yul nas yang sprul 'khrul med rnyed zer/ thugs brtag bcad tshul ni/ chos rje zil gnon rdo rjes mngon chung brtag dpyad ngos 'dzin zhus par/yid ches gsal bo rnyed pa dang / sde srid mchog nas lha blar gsang lung phul ba dang / zan brtag sogs la rtse mthun bzang 186

phebs byung zer/ gzhan paṇa chen rin po che sogs sa dge rnying gsum gyi bla chen sus kyang ma gsan 'dugargyal dbang sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho/de ltar yang sprul tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho ni/ mon la 'og yul gsum zhes pa'i sar/ yab sngags rgyud rig 'dzin bkra shis bstan 'dzin dang / yum tshe dbang lha mo gnyis la chu phag (1683)lo'i zla3tshes1nyin sku bltams/ gsang rgya dam par byas te mtsho snar gdan drangs nas/ mtsho sna rdzong sde gnyis kyis do dam byas/shing byi (1684)lo tsam nas sog yul nang mi mthun pa byung ba dang / rgya rgyal dang sde srid mthun lam ma byung ba sogs dka' tshegs byung zer/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags rta (1690)lor gser sdong 'dzam gling rgyan gcig bzheng rgyu'i las grwa btsugs pa dang /tshogs mchod chen mo ser sbrengs dang bcas pa btsugs/ rab nyi me byi (1696)lor gsang rgya grol te/ rgya nag dang sog po byings la'ang drilabasgrags/ me glang (1697)lo'i zla4tshes15nyin yang srid sna dkar rtser gdan drangs/ lo de'i zla dgu bar paṇa chen rin po rnge blo bzang ye shes spyan drangs nas 187

yang srid la rab byung gi sdom pa gnang / mtshan blo bzang rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho nes stsal/ lo de'i zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer lnga'i nyin/ pho brang po ta lar snyegadan drangs te khrir bkod/ paṇa rin po che sogs yab sras rnams kyis gser gyi mchod d+nghasdong 'dzam gling rgyan gcig la rab gnas mdzad/rab nyi sa yos (1699)lor bstan 'dzin da la'i khrang gi sras bgres pa bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal dang / gzhon pa lha ribazang gnyis nang ma mthur+shan pa yin yang zer/ sde srid kyis lha bzang bar dug drangs yang zer/ gang ltar sde srid kyis lha bzang ba la gsol skal byin nas mtsho sngon du phud/ mtsho sngon gyi sog dpon nang ma 'chams par nang name sogs byung / o rod jun gar gyi rgyal bo tshe dbang rab brtan gyis sde srid kyi bya spyodari la nga na smras dang skyon brjod mang ba dang / tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mdzad spyod la ma dga' ba'i gtam mang du byung ba sogs dang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho khri 'don skabs/ man ching gong ma'i sku tshab la lcang skya ngag dbangadhechos ldan gtong gnang mdzad de/ khyed gong ma'i sku tshab yin pas sde srid la phyag 'tshal mi chog ces bka' gnang na'ang / lha sar slebs skabs sde srid kyis mi mngags nas khyod kyis nga la phyag ma 'tshal na nged dang 18byi

bod kyi srid don rgyal dbang rin po che'i sku don yang 'grub dka' zer ba byung bas/ khong gis rgyal dbang rispyo po che'i sku don du song na nga la ci byung yang rung thugs la dgongs nas/ sde srid la phyag 'tshal/ phyir pe cin du slebs nas gong ma'i bka' chad phog ste bla ma'i go sa nas phab/ gnam bde sgo mo che'icimadun du/ brgya 'grul stong 'aspul gyis mthong sar phyag lag thal mo sbyar trozhing / pus btsugs kyis nyin gsum gyi bar du 'dug bcu ga pa'i chad las phog khong gi rnam thar du gsal/ stse yosarte(1699) lo'i zla12tshes13la bstan 'dzin da— la'i 'das/de'i sras chung ba lha ba zang mtsho sdon nayogadan drangs te rgyal skebor bsko gzhag byas/ de skabs shig nas ching gong mas paṇa — cirin po che rgya nag tu gdan drangs kyang 'brum pa ma thor gsungs nayophebs ma nyan/ ching srid gzhung phyogs nas sde srid kyis bkag cha byas song snyam pa'i dogs pa skyes/ rgyal dbang rin po ches rnam g.yeng bag med kyi mdzad spyod kho na mdzad par/ sde srid dang sku mdun pa sogs kyis snyan bskul ci tsam zhus kyang spyongagasan dgongs med pa dang / sde srid kyis gsan sbyong gi skul mkha zhus res bzhin thugs bsun gyi rnam pa rtag tu gnang pas zhu sa med par gyur zer/ tsho189

rab nyi chu rta (1702) lor rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho 'khor tshogs bcas bkra shis lhun por phebs/ thams cad kyis rgyal dbang rin po ches bsnyen rdzogs bzhes dgos zhes gsol ba ji ltar btab kyang / ma gsan par 'ur stabs kyis langs te/gzim chung nyi 'od kyi phyi nas phyag gsum 'tshal te bla ma'i bka' bcag pa mthol lo bshags/ da dge tshul gyi sdom pa phul yod do gsungs phebs te/ de nas bzung ste skya chas bzhes pa sogs paṇa chen rin po che'i rang rnam du gsal/ rī de nas bzung nyin mor rdzong rgyab sogs mda' rtsed sogs la phebs pa dang / mtshan mor grong khyim bud med dag gi khyim du bzhugs pa sogs dag snang sbyong dka' ba'i mdzad spyod la brten/ bod sog gi mi rigs mang bo dang / se 'bras sogs su dad pa log pa'i gtam mang bar gyur/ sde srid kyi drung 'khor mthar rgyas kyis sku zhabs bslad pa yin pas kho med par bzos na phan che ba yong zer nas/ sde srid dang / mda' dpon dga' chags pa/ dar byung ba/ drung yig bstan 'dzin dbang bo/ a pho lnga 'dzoms sogs bka' gros mdzad/ sku zhabs rdzong rgyab tu mda' 'phen la phebs/ mun rub mtshams su glu len bzhin phebs skabs mthar rgyas lam nas gsod rtsis 190

byas/ de nyin sku zhabs kyi na bza' mthar rgyas la bkab/mthar rgyas kyi gos g.yog por gyon bcug pas/ nor te dga' chags pas g.yog po der gris brgyab nas bsad/ de nor ba shes nas gzhan zhig gis mthar rgyas la gris brgyab pas cher rmas te 'gyel yang gsod ma thub/ sku zhabs sogs nas rim gyis shes te/ a pho lnga 'dzoms zangs rta me 'bar la bskyon te khrom skor la khrid/ gzhan rnams khrag sbyor byas/ de nas sde srid la sku zhabs mi dga' bar gyur/ 'di dag gi lo rgyus gsal bo che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyi rnam thar byung ba brjod pa gdung ba'i mun sel zhes bya bar yod 'dug rab nyi shing bya (1705)lor sde srid dang rgyal bo gnyis ma 'chams par/ sku zhabs la mo chos rje/ skyid shod sde ba/gdan sa'i mkhan po/ gzhung zhabs gnad yod khag paṇa chen rin po che'i sku tshab rnams kyis gros bsdur byed skabs/sna sde srid kyis bla ma tsho la rgyal bo bzung na ji ltar yong dris par/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas 'dzin rgyu yin na nga de'i gros na med ces gsungs pa ltar/ mkhan po gzhan rnams kyisu kyang de ltar brjod/ mjug tu gros chod la/ sde srid kyis dgongs zhus gnang ste/ gsol skal du gong dkane+e rdzong 'bul rgyu dang / lha 191

bzang rgyal bo'i mtshan gnas rangaji'ajog thog mtsho sngon phyogs su bzhugs te gzhung gi rgyal bo'i thab rten dang / su hrug khag gi 'bab sgo rnams bdag gnyer byed rgyu byas/ lde srid kyis dgongs pa zhug khong gi sras ngag dbang rin chen sde srid kyi go sar bzhag rgyal bo mtsho khar chas mod/ 'dam sogs su dal bgrod kyis byi nyan byed bzhin song / sde srid gong dkar du ma slos par pho brang du bzhugs pa lha bzang gi rna bar song ba dang /mthar rgyas kyis sku zhabs tshangs dbyangs pa'i yi ge yin tshul gyi yig rdzun bzos te rgyal bor sde srid med par gtong dgos zhes zhus sam zhes byung ba brjod pa gdung ba'i mun sel las bshad 'dug gang ltar lo de'i zla lnga ba'i nang rgyal bos sde srid gros chod la ma gnas/ zhes dmag khag gnyis byas nas khrid yong ba la/ dbus gtsang gi dmag bskul yang / sngar lo shas ring la mi ser la khral 'u lag sogs kyi dka' ngal che ba dang / gsang rgya yun ring ba dang / rgyal dbang dang sde srid nang mi mthun pa sogs ngan dgu 'dzo.oṃs pa lta bu'i dbang gis g.yul pham nas/rgyal bo'i dmag skyid 'phan phyogs su slebs nye'i skabs/ gdan sa khag rgyud grwa'i dpon slob/ paṇa chen rin po che'i sku tshab sogs bar chings la phebs te sde srid gong dkar du phebs rgyu 192 4 rtse

dang gzhung rgyal bo la gtod rgyu byas nas/ sde srid klo bur du gong dkar du spos/ rgyal bo rang nyid dmag dpung bcas 'phan yul brgyud lha sar yong gi yod dus/ rgyal mo tshe ring bkra shis dang / ja'i sang khag dpung khag gcig bcas yangs pa can brgyud stod lung sna rtser snga thon byung dus/ sde srid gong dkar du yod pa thos 'phral/ dmag mngags nas bzung ste stod lung sna rtser khrid 'ongs nas de ma thag bsad do/ /sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho ni rten khyim pa yin te chung dus rab tu byung bar 'dod nas rgyal dbang rin po cher zhus kyang ma gnang / zhes bai ser du gsungs/ kho chung dus nas rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag lajisbyangs pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ gsung rtsom sgra snyan ngag rtsis dkar nag /sma na sog sa par du 'khod ma 'khod kun bsdomasan pod bcu phrag longs pa yod la/ sgra snyan/ mi wang / glu dbyangs sogs kyi sgyu lcal la'ang shin tu mkhas par grags/ dgung grangs nyer bdun thog sde srid kyi las 'gan khur/srid jus la zhib cha che zhing las khungs so sor dngos phebs kyis zhib 'jug gnang ba dang / mi dmangs kyi gnas tshul dang dra ga zhan gyi spyod tshul shes phyir/ mi dkyus ma'i zol gyis dbus rīrī 193

gtsang shar nub lho byang kun tu nyul bskyod dang / rtse pho brang chen po'i ar bo'i mjug skyong dang / gser gyi mchod/ sdong chen mo sogs sku gsung thugs rten sogs la jus 'god bkod khyab sogs rnam dpyod mchog tu che ba'i rang rtag/ samangon gsal yin mod/ paṇa chen rin po che dang se 'bras sogs dge lugs phyogs la/ chab srid kyi dgos mkho dang— bstun/ phyi'i rnam pa gus tshul mi byed mthu med tsam las rnying ma las gzhan la dad zhen mi che ba khong gis gsungs/ du klu la'i gos bzang gi kha skong sogs la bltas na shin tu gsal lo/ /rjes sor sku dbang che ba'i skabs su mdzad spyod je lod du song ba ni che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyi rnam thar las/ ‘‘sde srid mchog sku dbang che zhing /bde yangs gsum skas mgo'i bka' shog tu/ rgyun du bag med kyis jo mo bzhes pa sogs mdzad mi chog par gsungs pa la/dus phyis 'chi med dga' tshal dang / dpal r+shab khang gsar gyi bdag mo gnyis bzhes te che 'don bdag rkyen yongs grags mdzad pa dang / de dus lha sa dngabyu/ phyogs nas yong ba'i skyes dman kha stabs drag tshad sde srid rang nas ma bzhes pa gcig kyang med/ phar phebs tshur phebs dus lam 'gag līmi tshos yang mngon mtshan chen por bltas mi chog pa'i tsha nyams dang /rngo94

bla khag rdzong gzhis/ phyi nang gi las tshan sogs gang la yang bdag mo gnyis kyi zhu dbang btsan pa baṭas de tsho'i gnas tshul gter ston rin po ches gsan nas shin tu thugs khral ba'i rnam pa dang / thugs zhen bzhes nas/ da mi byed dgu byed de kha gyis/ mgyogs po rang bla ma de'i rkang 'dren yong zhes thugs 'phar 'phar gnang / zhu yig tsha bo rkyang ba 'bul gnang mdzad nas/ sde srid rang yang4gter ston rin po cher thugs dad chung du song / rgyal bos stod lung sna rtser sde srid kyi mgul bcad pa gsan dus spyan chab dang sprags/ da zhus pa la rkang nas gsan ma byung zhes thugs dbyung ba'i gsung gcong chen po ga nang 'dug ’ces gsungs so/ / rab nyi shing bya (1705)lo nas lha bzang bas bod ljongs yongs la dbang bsgyur/ gong du brjod pa ltar rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i snarnga tshod kyi mdzad spyod la/ phyi nang gi mi mang bo zhig gis dad log dang zhen log byed pa dang dad zhen byed — mkhan yangabyulos yod/ rgyal bo sogs kridzi5 la mo tshangs pa'i sku rten la lung bstan zhus par rgyal dbang lnga ba'i sprul sku min zhes lung bstan pa red zer ba sogs lab gleng mang / gang ltar me khyi (1706) lo'i zla5tshes1nyin po taṣi sa nas lha klu dga' tshal 195

du gad—na drangs/ —the khyi (17kyo6) lo'i zlacatshes17nyin rkya nagagi phangaca pa sogs kyis rgya nag tu gdan drangs pa ltar phebs rtsis kyis chibs kha bsgyur/ mtshan nyid gling khar6 gib skyel steng du bzhugs yod thog 'bras spungs kyi grwa ba kha shas kyis rīmagatabyasa'inas phobs rma bcug par dga'ad+kuldastopho brang du ga dan drangs te bzhugs su ba—cug de nas mi kha shas kyis da krugasakhate 'bras spungs gling du 'ur zing chen po byung yang mtharir rang zhir song / slar rgya nag gong ma dang lha bozang gi 'dod pa ltar rgya nag tu chi bas kha bsgyur/mtsho sngon phyogs su phe4bas lam du kun dga' nor du slebs skabasang mgrin cham lta bu bzhes nas der sku 'das/ der skuji gdung zhugasa'il phul te/ gdung rus dang sku chasarnams gsol dpon grags pa rgya mtsho dang blo gros dbang phyug mchod dpon ngag dbang dpal 'bar/ em rje sangasacorgyas srid sgrub rnams kyis khyer nas lha sar 'byor ba'i lo rgyus 'di ni rgyal dab nga bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i rnam thar sogs rnam thar mang boroyod/ yang no mon han ngag dbang lhun 'gru ba dar rgyas sam/ ming gzhan lha btsun ngag dbang rdo rjes mdzad pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags rgya mtsho'i rnam thar lha'i tamyu ra'i 1ri9r+ṣa

rgyud misgra dbyangs/ zhes bya ba las/ sog po shi ma thago pa'i lkesnang sgros te drang don la mya dz+wagalas 'das tshul tsam las nges don la— cigacirka pur bros te a rigayo 'grul ba dang bsdebs nas sog yul du bzhugs shing / zhes sogs dang / mdo smad a mdo'i yul du gser khog dang dzag rung sogs su gdan sa rma dzad cing /'gro don rgya chen po bskyangs mthar sog yul a lag sha ru sa lug〉spyo(1739) lor sku gshegs zhes dgung grangasajilnga bcu nga drug la spushegs pa sogs bshad 'dug rnam thar rtsom pa bo a lag sha wang gi sras red/ rnam thar 'di la 'ga' zhig gis tshangs dbyangs pa'i gsang ba'i rnam thar zer/ deng sang 'di pe cino nas lcags par btab yod/ 'ga' zhigartegisalo rgyus snga ma nges don yin/ phyi ma ni tshangs dbyangs pa rdzus ma red zer/ yangartso la las snga ma drang don dang phyi ma nges don yin zer/ chab sridartsoskor 'di snyog dra che bas/ ngo ma gang yin sus shes/tshotshangs da byadzas rgya mtsho rgya nag tu gdanagyidrangs pa'i lo der/ ngag dbanga' shesadze+e rgya mtsho rgyal ba'i sprulaskyer ngos bzung ste/ po phyota lar gdan drangs/ de yangad+kuye shes rgya mtsho 'di ni/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i drug cu ba skejistag la tshangayodabyangs pa dgung lo bzhi ba'i skabs su bar khams tsha rong kha ba dkar bor 197

'khrungs/ sku na phra dus lcags po ri la bzhugs/ dgung lo bcu bzhi ba sa yos la 'bras spungs su phebs nas slob gnyer gnang / sle lung rje drung blo bozang 'phrin las kyi drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan la rin po che ye shes rgya mtsho gsol/ gar phebs la tshul khrims kyi dri ngad rgyang ring bor khyab pas 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po zhig yin par cha 'jog byed pa red zer/ dgung grangs nyer gnyis pa'i me phag (1707)lor po ta la'i khrir 'khod/ zla2nang paṇa chen rin po che gdan 'dren zhus te/tshes25nyin lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi jo bo rin po che'i mdun du myal ba pad dkar 'dzin pa la dge tshul dang / bsnyen rdzogs chabs cig tu gnang ste/ mtshan ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho zhes stsal/ yongs grags la rgyal ba pad dkar 'dzin pa zhes zhu ba de 'di ba red/ rje 'di'i dgung lo so gnyis pa me bya (1717)lor o rod jun gar gyi tha'i ji dga' ldan tshe ring don 'grub kyis jun gar gyi dmag mang bo khrid de bod yul du slebs nas lha bzang bsad/ me bya lo 'di nas lo bzhi ba lcags byi (1720)lor rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho gdan drangs/ pad dkar 'dzin pa ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho bod nas zhe hor du spyan drangs/ zhe hor du/ lha khang ljang gu zhes pa bsam yas la dpe rngo98

blangs nas bzhengs pa dang / po ta la'i pho brang zhig kyang bzhings nas/ der bzhugs su bcug sog yul nas grwa ba stong gnyis tsam bsdus nas mtshan nyid kyang btsugs/ sog po rnams kyis khong la zhe hor tā la'i bla ma zer zhing / ching gong mas mkhan po ho thog thu ngag dbang ye shes/ zhes zhu ba 'dra/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa me rta lo'i rnam thar du/ mkhan po ho thog thu ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho sku gshegs pa'i bsngo zhus byung ba la dgongs rdzogs kyi dge ba rnams byang chub tu bsngo bar mdzad/ ces pa de/ zhe hor du bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang de nyid yin na/ dgung lo zhe gcig pa'i skabs su gshegs pa 'dra'o/ /zhes cha har dge bshes kyi gsung bde legs 'byung gnas las gsungs/zhe hor (sad+ku)la deng sang khrin te (sgo.oṃ)zer gyin 'dug der bkra shis lhun po dang / bde mchog lha khang sogs lha khang mang bo 'dug bdag kyang1983lor de gar song nas bdun gcig la bsdad/ bde legs 'byung gnas las/ ‘‘rje ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho ni/ rgyal bo lha bzang gis rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'irmo drung du gsung brtag zhus nas ngos 'dzin mdzad/ ces zer ba ཿ99

sogs kyi gtam rgyun yod/ de bden na ye shes lhamatsho de nyid rgyal dbang rin po che'i sprul ba gcig gas/ ji ltar sprul ba yin pa ngos bzu nga mdzad paspodagos 5pa chen po yod paranges shing /rje de nyid rgyunalha thu gas dam nyams bzhes sogasasku/zhan dang mi 'dra ba/ gang zag khyad par can zhig yin zhing / tshul khrims kyi dri ngad rgyang ring bor bro ba yin/ zhes de dus kyi zhabs phyi sogs nas thos pa'i gtam yod par 'dug go/ /'di la zhe hor gyi tā la'i bla ma zhes phyogs 'di—ra grags shing / 'di bzhugs pa'i lha khang ljang gu zhes pa deng sang yang zhe hor na yod do/ /’ zhes gsungs/ tshangs dbyangs pa rgya khrid skabs su la mo tshangs pa'i sku rte na gyis/ tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho rgyal ba'i sprul sku min par gsungs pa dang / sprul sku gzhan zhig yod ces lung bstan pa red zer srolatshuyod/ lung bstan de yongs rdzogs ma mthong la/ mgo'i tshig rkang gnyis mthong ba ni/ phyi mun nang du ye shes sgron me 'bar/ nga ni gong ma dbyer med du 'dun pa byed/ ces 'dugade ni phyi mun nag ste mi dkyus ma'i nang du/ ye shes rgya mtsho bzhugs yod pa—/ gong ma lnga ba chen mo dang dbyer med yin/zhes pa e yin snyam pa dang / de rjes da lta gzhung gi gnas su ཿpyi0

lod—pa las/ lha dang mkha' 'gros btsalakyabartad yarar ka'/zhes gsungs pa de/ da lta gzhung dga' ldastopho brang gi gnaspo'abras spungs su yod oṃ las sbas pa'i tshul grwa rkyang dkyu0sa ma'i lugs su yod stabs sus kyang mi shes/ zhes pa'i don du go tha yin snyam/ rī rgyal bo lha bzang bas lo5bcu gnyis yas mas la dming —snye bsgyur/ se ra'i tshogs chen lgodu khang chen mo gsar bzheng sa dang byams sku chen so bzhengs/ 'du 7khangarwarnying ba'i nang jidu 'dam du yod pa'i gu shrī bstan 'dzin gyi urasgoge grwa zung spos te 4 sngags pa grwa tshang btsucags/ blon 'a khoradzāgamu bo ni da'i ching yā thur ba nams mgon po/ drung yig papha lha bsodarams stobs rgyal/ 'bum thang ba sogs shin tu d+kumang / rgyal bo 'di'i dus/ hor spra nag khag bzhi'i 'grog ririgs rnams kyis/ bod gzhung la lo dus kyi dpya khral ma phul bar brten/ —drung chen pho lha dang / lha rtse skyid sbug pa dpung bcas song nas mtha' bskor te/ lo thang 'bul rgyu dus las mi yol bar bya rgyu byas/ tha'i ji la rta bzang lnga bcu tham pa'i chad pa bcad/ de tsam las jun gar gyi btsan 'dzul yong ba'i bar du nang 'khrug byung ba'i lo rgyus mthong rgyu mi 'dug go/ /201

lha bzang be dang / jurna gar tshe dbang rab brtan ni sngar mthun yang / phyis mi mthun pa'i rkyen ni 'ga' zhig gis/ de'i ci—skababe jun gar dang / man ching gong ma gnyis kyis dam ga 'khrug yang yang byed skabs yin la/ lha bzang nas jing la ngo rgol gyi shed ma thon pas/ sngon la dbus gtsang blangs te/ de ci nas mtsho sngon phyogs nas ching gong ma la dpung 'jug byed bsam pa red zer/ la las zer ba ni/ lha bzang gi bu che ba dga' ldan bstan 'dzin jun gar gyi mgasapad 'gro skabs sgam gyi nang rtswa byad 'khor bcug pa dang / rim gro ba'i tshul du byad ma kha shas kyang mngags pa tshor nas dmag btang ba red zer/ gang ltar rgya nag tu khang shi nga drug pa me bya (1717) lo'i zla bdun pa'i nang jun gar dmag 'dam du 'byor/ zla8tshes29nyin/bod dmag gis jun gar gyi dmag sgar thog dpung rka'ajug byas rkyang / nyatrem nyes chen po byung / de nas jun gar bas bod kyi dmag dang dmangs mi rnams la/ nged cag bod la dmag rgyag par yong ba min/ bod kyi spyi don dang / rgyal dbang gi sku don la yong ba yin sogs mgo skor gyi gtam sna tshogs lab pas/ bod 'bangs rnams phar rgolabyed pu'i shugs nyams te/ de nas jun gar gyi dmag lha sa'i phyogs su bskyod nas/ bod kyi —pho02 ji tsho

sa7 slung rnams kyis 'gog ma thub par/ ra mo che'i phyogs nas lha sa'i nang du 'dzul/ sne lha bzang gi sras chung ba sur ya g.yog gnyis bcas mtsho sngon phyogs su 'bros bcug lha bzang 'khor —nyung shas bcas pho brang po ta la'ijinang du 'dzul nas sgo gtan/ zla11tshes1nyin lha bzang dang blo bzang chos 'phel dpon g.yog gnyis/ rtse zhol gzhung sgo nas bud de rta bzhon nas jun gar ba'i dmag sgar thog brgyugs nas jun gar ba kha shas bsad/ kha shas rmas pa'i mthar dmag mang bos bskor te dpon g.yog gnyis ka bsad/ de rjes pad dkar 'dzin pa khri las phab bo /de ltar rgyal bo lha bzang bas lo ngo bcu gnyis la bod khams yongs la dbang bsgyur to/ / rab nyi me bya (1717) lo'i zla11tshes16nyin gdugs dkar ja'i sang gis dmag brgya skor khrid de/ po ta lar song nas rnam rgyal grwad+kutshang garmor/ tshes22nyin rdor brag dang /smin gling gi zhal ngo rnams dang / rgyal bo lha bzang ba'i dus kyi mi drag rnams btson du bcug— zla de'i tshes24nyin/ tshe ring don 'grub/ gdugs dkar chos 'phel te/ ja'i sang gsum gyis/ bla brang steng du dbus gtsang gi bla dpon rnams bsdus te/rnying lugs gtan nas byed mi chog rnying ma'i sku gsung thugs 203
