rten rnams 'dor dgog zhos bsgrags/ de spyojib smin gleng lo chen dang / blo bzang bston pa 'i rgyal3mtshan/ byugadung srakhasa'agyur mede rgya mtsho sogs rnying ma'i bla chen khag gcig skyid chu'i 'gram du khrid de bkrongs/ do nogreyang sgron glidzogadung sra so gzhon/pa dang / phya ga mdzod zhabs drung legs grub/4 gzhung zhabs ga tso —che ba/— dadzos gzhi ba/ pad ma tshe ring / rgyal rtse lcang lo can/ chang khyim pa/ spunya' nang lcags ra spud pa sogs mang bo bsad/ rdo rje brage smin grol gling / chu shurartsobor ba gling / gsang sngags byang chub gling sogs rnying dgon rnams bshigs so/ / de dus jun gar gyi dpon rnams kyis gros thog nas stag rtsetheb lha rgyal rab brtan bod kyi srid 'dzin dpon du bskos/ pho lha thatsho ba nams stobs rgyal yang lha bzang gi gser yig pa (drung yig) yin stasas/ ji'abras spungasa'isu /gab yod pa shes nas bzung / srog chad gcod ṣ+ṭha'i skapas/ sde srid stag rtse ba dang /soge po jun gar ba 'bras spungaso sgo mang mkhan po ngag da4nga phun tshogs gnyis kyis ngo cheno zhuso te btson grol btang / de ltarari jun gar gyis me bya (1717) lo'irtsozla1 1pa nas bzung /lcags byi (172 0) lo'i lo mjug bar duji lo ngo gsum tsam la 204 rme

dbus gtsangaglongs rdzogs bzung na yadzā mdo smad du shugs 4 slebs 'dug go/ / — rgyapidabang 'iphreng bdun pa bskal bzangad+ku mtsho/rgyal dbang bskal bzang45 mtsho ni/ khams li thang bya mas pa gliri gi zholabyugyi grong sde'i nang du sa byi (1708) lo'i zla7tshes 19nyin sku bltams/ gnas chung chos skyong sku rten gyitha'atsangs dbyangs pa'i sprul skur ngos bzung / ṣ+kang rta (1714) lo dgung grangs bdun thog sde dge rdzong gsar dang lcang ra dgon sogs su phebs skabs lde da ge dpon bltan pa5tsho ring gis kyang sne len gzab rgyas zhus/ de rjes mtsho sngon gyi chingasawang pā thur tha'i ji dngaspre/ dpon ching wang 'ju nang / blo bzang bstan skyong rab brtan/ ngag dbangage'is 'phel sogs5)sa thos te —gdan zhu'i mi snaritang ste/ shing rta (1714) lo der chi0ngasgong dka' ldan er te ni 'ju nang gi urgor gdan drangs/ 'ju nang gis 'bad brtson gyis ching gong mar zhus pa sogs la r+sā brten/ ching gong mas kyang mi sna mngags ske sog bod kyi da pon chen rnams aukyis sku 'bum du gdan springs/ sa phag (1719)lor gong ma khang shi'i rgyalaphusas nga5〉 bzhi ba sku 'bum du yang srid bskal bzang rgyu mtsho'i mdun du bcar — 295

ba dang / bstan 'dzin ching wang dang / dga' ldan 'ju nang gis gtso byas dpon rnams kyis sku 'bum nas yang srid rin po che dbus phyogs su gdan 'dren zhu rgyu'i gros 'chams byung nas gong mar zhus te gong mas kyang rgyal dbang lnga ba'i sprulartesku yin par khas blangs nas/ sku phreng drug pa yin pa'i 'ja' sa dang /gser gyi glegs bu tham ga bcas stsal ba sogs rnam thar du gsal/de nas lcags byi (1720)lo'i zla4tshes22nyin rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho ston 'khor rnams bod sog rgya gsum gyi dpon dmag gtos chen po bcas sku 'bum nas chibs kha bsgyur/ de skabs o rod jun gar phyogs su/ o rod dang ching gong ma'i dmag gis dmag 'khrug byed pa dang / mdo smad nas rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho bod sog rgya gsum gyi dmag 'bor chen bcas 'byon gyin yod pa sogs 'ur sgra dbus phyogs su khyab pas dbus dpon kha shas kyis jun gar la ngo log byas pa sogs la brten/ jun gar gyi dmag rnams 'dug ma bzod par rang yul du —bros so/ / lcags byi (1720)lo'i zla9tshes15nyin rgyal dbang ston 'khor bcas lha ldan du 'byor te/ pho brang po ta la'i sku gong ma dag gi khrir zhabs sor 'khod/ dga' ston rgya chen po byas so/ /lha06

de nas bod snyogs nas/ nga phod pa dang / lum pa ba gnyis/ man ching gong ma'i phyogs nas/ da'i si cang jun/ gung tshe dbang nor bu gnyis/ sog po'i phyogs nas/ don 'grub wang / bstan 'dzin wang / e sbos pe li gsum bcas mi bdun gyis zhib dpyod lhan tshogs shig btsugs nas zla ba kha shas ring chab srid bskyangs/ sde srid stag rtse ba sogs junabyugar phyogs gtogs la zhib rtsad byas/ mthar sde srid stag rtse ba lha rgyal rab brtan dang / gung blon bkra shis/ // a chos sogs mang bo zhig skyid chu'i rags rgyab tu khrid nas srog chad bcad/stag rtse'i sras dang / lcam/ sras chung ba bcas rgya yul du khyer/ lcags glung (1721)lo'i lo sar skabs/ stod sgar dpon khang chen nas bsod nams rgyal bor/ da'i ching pā thur gyi cho lo byin/ thab rten du ('tsho rten) yar 'brog gling gi 'dzin dbang stsal/ bod rgya sog gsum gyi mi bdun mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs phyir bsdus/ da'i ching pū thur khang chen nas la/ srid rogs blon lta bur pe se nga phod pa/ lum pa ba/sbyar ra ba/ pho lha ba bcas mi lnga lhan 'brel gyi srid gzhung btsugs/ bod ljongs su dbang bsgyur/ po ta la'i zhol du de rī 207

dus btsugs pa'i rdo ring yod/ man ching gong ma'i sku tshab la da'i si cang jun dang / tā la'i bla ma'i sku srung lta bur cang jun tsodabang nor bu/ dmag bzhi stong bcas lha sar bzhag ste / phebs skyel du bcar ba'i rgya sog gi dpon rigs 'khor bcas phyir log pa red/ lke de'i dus skabs su modzad sgo dga' ston sogs la rgya mi'i dpon rigs dang / bod kyi dpon rigs rnams mdun gral dang / sog po'i dpon rigs rnams rgyab gral du bzhag pa blor ma bab pa dang / sde srid stag rtse bar srog chad mi gcod rgyu zhus kyang / don smin ma byung ba dang / tsār bod du gu shrī han bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud cig bod kyi rgyal bor bsko ba'i srole yod mod/ de— skabs rgyun srol de med par byas pa'i rkye na gyis/ sog po'i dpon rigs nang tshogs kyis mtsho sngon du phyir log rjes rgya mir ngo rgol byedajirgyu zhes gser gdung chen mo'i mdun du bro bor dam bcas/rab nyi chu yos (1723) lo nas mtsho sngon bstan 'dzin wang sogs kyis man ching gong mar ngo rgol byed pa'i 'khrug zing bslangs pa dang / lha sar sdod spru'i rgya dmag mi ser thog za rngam che ba sogs kyis mi ser rnams kyis kyang mi dga' ba'i rnam 208

'argyur yang yang bstan pa'i stabs/ shing 'brug (1724)lo ching gong ma g.yung ṭing khri lo dang bor lha sdod a sa am ban dang rgya dmag tshang ma phyir 'then byas/ mtsho sngon phyogs mdo smad byang rgyud du/ bod sog gis ching gong ma la— ngo log byed pa'i zing 'khrug chen po langs/ rgya dpon 'ga' gsod rmagadang /rgya mkhar kha shas gtor bshigs sogs ngo rgol rgya mi chung ba tsam byung / der brten rgya dmag chu brdol ba bzhin byung ste/ bod sog gi mi 'bum phrag mang bo bsad/ mi sde khri phrag mang bo brlags/ rgyalajidabang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i glam sku zhabs chu bzang rin po che sogs bla ma chen po mang bo gson sreg byas/'dan ma grub chen sogs bla grwa mang thozhi ga gi dbu me tog bzhin du bcad/ dgon lung / gser khog 'ju lag sogs mdo smad byang rgyud kyi dgon pa phal cher gtor sreg byas/ 'di dag ni lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i rnam thar dang / dgon lung dkar chag gdan rabs sogs rnam thar lo rgyus mang bor gsal/ 'di'i skabs thu'u bkwan chos kyi rgya mtsho pe cin du rgyal khab kyi dbu blar bzhugs yod pa dang / lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje pe cin du gdan drangs yod stabs/ khong rnam gnyis kyis thabs mkhas kyis zhu ba dang / mdzad sgo gang gzab gnang ba'i bka' drin lasaji 209

dazhon sde rnams rim gyis 'tshogs thub pa byung / bstan 'dzin wang o rod jun gar du bros pa slar 'ongs nas mgogyubatags/gong ma'i mdzod nas dgon khag nyams gso byed pa'i rgyu nor phud/ bod sog byings nas kyang 'bad brtson byas te/ sa bya'i lo nas dgon sde rnams slar chags pa'i mgo tshugs thub pa byung 'dug go/ /de rjes dbus kyi bod srid gzhung gi gtso 'dzin da'i ching snya thur khang chen nas dang / pho lha ba gnyis phyogs gcig tu chad/nga phod pa/ lum pa ba/ sbyar ra ba ste nga lum sbyar gsum phyogs gcig tu chad nas/ phyogs ris dang / phyogs 'then byas te/srid 'khyor ba'i lugs ngan khyab gdal du gyur/ pho lha bas nga lum sbyar gsum gyis byed ngan zhig byed 'ong snyam ste/ khang chen nartswal srog byol du song na legs tshul bshad kyang snang rtog mi gtong bar bsdad/ pho lha rang nas lcam la nad byung bar khag bzhag nas dgongs zhus kyis gtsang phyogs su song ste rgyal rtser bsdad/ nga lum sbyar gsum gyis khang chen nas dang / pho lha ba gnyis 'khor nye du dang bcas pa gsod rgyu'i gros byas te/ me lug (—1727)lo'i zla6tshes18nyin lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi gzim chung khams gsum nang du khang chen nas dang / riri nga lum 210

sbyar gsum tshogs 'du zhig 'tshogs/ yol ba'i phag tu gshed ma sbas yod pa des glo bur du khang nas pa'i skra nas 'jus shing nga lum sbyar gsum gyis gri phyung ste lag rub kyis bsad/ sgo na yod pa'i khang nas pa'i srung dmag rnams gzhan gsum gyi dmag gis lag rub kyis bsad/ de'i phyi nyin gshed ma btang ste khang nas pa'i lcam gnyis ka bsad/ yang gshed ma btang ste/ nag chu mkhan po dang / ja'i sang gnyis ka bsad/ de nas gshed ma bkra shis dpal rab sogs pho lha ba 'khor bcas gsod par gtsang du btang yang / pho lha bar bya shor te/ sras gnyis dang 'khor kha shas bcas gtsang stod du song ste/ mda' dbon lca/ nga lo can dang / rtebasam 'grub gling ba gnyis la yi ge btang ste/da'i ching pū thur khang nas pa'i dgra sha len phyir dbus phyogs su dmag beskyod dgos pa'i bka' bskul btang / de bzhin spo rong gi dpon a jo dang / mnga' ris kyi sgar dpon dga' bzhi ba sogs bskul te pho lha rang gi dmag bcas gtsang dmag 'bor chen gyis/ me lug (1727)lo'i zla7tshes17nyin dbusabiphyogs su dmag bskyod byas/ dbus phyogs nas nga lum sbyar gsum gyis dbus dmag stong phrag kha shas khrid gtong gis gtsang dmag la rgol 'gog byed du gtsang phyogs su lhags/ de'i tshe — lha1lha

gtsang ngam ring gi dpon nu ma pas nga lum sbyar gsum la gsang yig bskur ba pho lha ze'i lag tu 'byor/ de ma thag dmag mngags nas ngam ring nas kho bathung ste/ rkang lag dang lus thams cad thag pas bcings nas/ g.yang gzar ngos nas rbab la bsgril te bsad/ de nas 'brong rtse dang 'bras khud rgyud du gtsang dbus kyi dmag gis g.yul 'gyed thengs kha shas byas kyang rgyal pham cher ma byung / dbus dmag gis gtsang gi mi ser dang dgon sde 'ga' la 'phrog bcom gyis gyong rgud po byung zer/slar yang lo de'i zla10ba nas gtsang dbus kyi dmag 'khrugs te phan tshun gsod rmas chen po byung / de skabs rgyal dbang rin po ches kyang bde 'jags kyi don gsung bka' nan mo bskur ba dang paṇa chen rin po che'i mgron gnyer sa khud pa dang / sa skya bdag chen rin po che'i mgron gnyer ngag da—bang sogs kyis re zhig dmag mtshams 'jog pa'i chings yig bzhag ste/ phan tshun gyis dmag mi bzu nga ba rnams glod bkrol btang / sa sprel (1728) lor slar yang gtsang dmag dbus phyogs su bskyod de 'phan yul brgyud/ lum pa ba dpung bcas la 'thab bzhin dmag bskyod byas pas nga lum sbyar gsum gyi dmag pham ste/ po ta le'i nang du 'dzul nas rgyul dbang la skyabs zhus/ pho lha ba lhasnelha

dpung bcas/ sa sprel (172tri)lo'i zla7tshes26nyin lha sar 'byor te dbus gtsang gi bdag por gyur/ rgyal dbang sogs bla ma rnams kyis ngo chen zhus par brten/ re zhig gung blon nga lum sbyar gsum rang shag tu srung dmag bzhag nas 'dug bcugapho lha bas man ching gong ma la zhu yig phul te/ don gcod kyi ra mdar bos/ de rjes man ching gong ma'i mi sna a li khan am ban dang / me ring dzam gi sogs dmag 'bum phrag gcig dang bcas dbus su 'byor/ nga lum sbyar gsum khongs gtogs bcas btson du bcug nyin gcig mi drag zhan brgya phrag mang bo 'tshogs pa'i dbus su/ nga lum sbyar gsum/ skyor lung bla ma/rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi gnyer ba/ nga lum sbyar gsum gyi gnyen nye du bu phrug sogs mi grangs bcu dgu dmar gsod byas/ bud med phru gu kha shas rgya yul du rgyang 'phud btang ngo / /me tā rin dang / seng tā rin zer ba'i am ban gnyis dmag stong gnyis dang bcas pa bsdud/ gzhan rnams phyir logargyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i mdzad spyod bka' gdams gong ma nang bzhin gnang bas mi dmangs mtho dman skya ser tshang mas dad gus lhur blangs stabs/ pho lha ba phrag dog 'phar te/rgyal dbang rin po cher/ lo rjes mar man ching gong ma rgya bod lha13

sa mtshams su lta skor la phebs rgyu yin pas/ khyed gong mar mjal 'phrad kyi don du khams la song zhes bka' phab/ sa sprel (1728)lo'i zla11tshes23nyin mdo khams su chibs kha bsgyur/ sa bya (1729)lo'i zla2tshes8nyin li thang du 'byor/lcags sprel (1730)lo'i zla1tshes21nyin mgar thar phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur te/ mgar thar du dgon pa btab/ lo ngo mthong bdun tsam la mgar thar du bzhugs/ de'i ring la'ang khri ngag dbang mchog ldan yongs 'dzin du bsten nas slob gnyere dang mdo sngags kyi gsan pa rgya chen po mdzad/ de nas bod dbus lha ldan du phebs rgyu gtan khel te man ching gong ma'i rgyal sras bcu bdun pa dang / lcang skya rin po che rol ba'i rdo rje dpon g.yog phebs rdzong du phebs/ rgyal sras kyis rgyal dbang la chos zhus rjes phyir log ho thog thu lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rjes phebs skyel zhus te/ shing yos (1735)lo'i zla3tshes21nyin mdo khams phyogs kyi dpon dmag skya ser rgya chen pos phebs skyel zhus te dbus phyogs su chibs bsgyur/ zla7tshes11nyin lha ldan gtsug lag khang du zhabs sor 'khod de/ mi dbang pho lha bas snar thang bka' 'gyur par brkos pa'i par phud kyis gtso byas pa'i 'bul chen btegs/ 214

chu phag (1743)lor o rod jun gar gyi dpon dga' ldan tshe ring dbang bo'i mi sna sum brgya skor yong ste rgyal dbang rin po cher 'bul chen dang dbus gtsang gi rten khag la mchod 'bul byas/ shing byi (1744)lor sde dge'i dpon gyis bka' 'gyur par brkos pa'i par phud 'bul mkhan gyi mi sna 'byor ba la bsngags brjod dang / gsol ras 'bor chen rnamal/ shing byi (1744)lo der ching gong ma chen lung gis/g.yung hwa kung du mtshan nyid grwa tshang / rgyud pa grwa tshang / rig gnas grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs par bla ma las sne bcas rdzong bda' mdzad/lcags bya (1741)lo nas 'go btsugs te lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dag yig mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas kyi shing par phud/rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me yos (1747)lo'i zla2tshes 2nyin sde srid pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal gnya' bar gnyan 'bur byung ba ma sos par tshe las 'das/ de ltar mi dbang pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis lo ngo mthong nyi shu tsam la dbang bsgyur/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho la rgya sog bod 215

gsum sogs kyis dad 'dun che zhing gus 'dud lhur blangs par sde srid pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal phrag dog rgyas nas dngos su log sgrub mang du byas pa dang / lkog nas rgyal dbang dang lcang skya rnam gnyis la mthu byad byas pa'i lo rgyus yang snang ngo / /(lcang skya'i rnam thar du'ang gsapha) pho lha ba la sras gnyi sa yod/ che ba gung 'gyur med tshe brtan mnga' ris kyi sbya dpon du bskos/ chung ba 'gyur med rnam rgyal la da la'i da'i ching pā thur gyi cho lo dang bcas bod kyi rgyal bor bskos/da'i ching pā thur 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyis lo bzhi tsam la srid dbang bzung / kho'i spun che ba mnga' ris gung 'gyur med tshe brtan dang ma mthun par mnga' ris phyogs su dmag drangs /mnga' ris kyi mi drag zhan mang bo bsun gtser gyis dus mi bde bar byas/ dga' ldan khri ba nam mkha' bzang la drag po'i las sbyor mdzad de mnga' ris gung bsgral dgos zhus kyang / khong gis dga' ldan khri bas mi gsod mi thub gsungs pas kho ma dag 'a bar/ khri las phab ste rgyud pa dri med gser khrir bskos/mthar mnga' ris gung lha sar bka' mol gnang bar yong skabs mi mngags te lam nas lkog gsod byas/ lcags rta (1750)lor/ smon lam chen mo'i skabs kho'i gcen mnga' ris gung gi 216

dge rtsa yin zer nas rgyal dbang rin po che tshogs dbur gdan 'dren zhus nas bsngo smon zhu ba sogs byas/ gzhan yang ma༈mkhar zhabaspu drung la/ khyed dang dpon slob byams pa rin po che sogs kyis mnga' ris gung la dmag bskul byed kyin 'dug ces pa sogs gzhi med gleng 'gel gyis 'dri gcod byas/ dbus gtsang gi dpung chen bskul nas byang phyogs kyi ri dwags yod dgu bsad/ gzhon nu pho mo rnams bsdus te glu len bro gar gyis dus 'da' bar byas pa sogs la brten nas drag zhan kun gyi yid bsun par byas/ de'i skabs mdo mkhar zhabs drung gi chibs rta la mda' brgyab par ma zad/ 'khor gzhon nu zhig kyang don med du mda' brgyab ste bsad/sa sbrul (1749)lor paṇa chen rin po che dpal ldan ye shes/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i mdun du bsnyen rdzogs zhu bar phebs te/ zla4tshes 15nyin jo bo rin po che'i spyan sngar bsnyen par rdzogs/ yab sras gnyis ka'i thugs bzhed la gzhan yang bka' chos mang tsam gnang zhu'i re ba yod kyang / srid skyong 'gyur med rnam rgyal 'dis g.yo thabs kyis bdun phrag gsum tsam las bzhugs ma bcug par phyir phebs dgos byung /sa 'brug (1748) lor srid skyong 'gyur med rnam rgyal ci217

gyis/ bod du yod pa'i rgya dmag rnams kyis bod mi ser la brnyas gtse dang rgyu nor za rngam che bas/ man ching gi dpon dmag gcig kyang med par phyir 'then byed dgos zhes lha sdod kyi rgya dpon gnyis la yang yang zhus par brten/ gong ma chen lung gis bod sdod am ban gyi sku srung lta bur rgya dmag brgya tsam las 'asbo ma tshang ma phyir 'then byed rgyu dang / am ban ngo g.yog dang /dmag 'phro ma bcas kyis/ bod mi ser la 'phrog bcom dang /brdab gsig mi 'byung ched phogs thob dgos mkho 'dang nges gnang rgyu yin tshul khas len byas/lcags rta (17rmyo0)lor da la'i pā thur 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyis slar yang / ching gong ma la bod sdod am ban gnyis dang dmag 'phro ma gcig kyang ma lus par phyir 'then dgos zhes/ yi ge phul 'dug zer/ gzhan yang jun gar la mthun lam byed pa'i mi sna gtong yong byas pa'i gnas tshul am ban sogs kyis shes pa dang / bod nang gi mi drag du ma zhig srid skyong la mi dga' ba sogs kyi rkyen las/ am ban gnyis kyis g.yo thabs kyis da la'i pā thur 'gyur med rnam rgyal g.yone gnyis bcas bsad/ 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi mgron gnyer blo bzang bkra shes sogs kyis dmag khrid de 'ongs nas/ am ban gnyis 21kyi

ṭags rgya mi mthong tshad bsad/ tha na tshong ba/ za khang / spung bo sogs rgya mi mi grangs pho mo nyis brgya bzhi bcu lhag pho brang po ta lar skyabs zhur song ba dag la rgyal dbang dngos su phebs te srog skyob zhus par ma zad/ bka' shog kyang sbyar/ 'on kyang bka' shog kyang gted/ yongs 'dzin khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan phebs te srog skyob zhus kyang bka' brtsi rgyu phar zad/ blo bzang bkra shis sogs kyis khri rin po che la tshig ngan mang du brjod de/ po ta la'i ra ba'i nang du 'dzul ba'i rgya mi thams cad bsad de/ po ta la'i ra ba khrag gis dmar bor byas 'dug ces rnam thar lo rgyus kha shas su 'dug go/ / de rjes gong ma chen lung gis/ dga' bzhi rdo ring gung paṇa ḍi ta mgon po dngos grub rab brtan zer ba der gnas skabs su 'gan 'khur dgos shing / blo bzang bkra shis sogs gte bo shor mi chog ces bka' phab/ mgron gnyer blo bzang bkra shis sogs jun gar phyogs su bros 'gro rgyu byed skabs/ gung paṇa ḍi tas de dag gang du slebs kyang 'dzin dgos zer ba'i bka' bsgrags pa ltar/ 'dzin bzung byas te/ blo bzang bkra shis/dpal grong shar ba/ srang sbug pa sogs mi mang bo zhig la lha ldan lcang lo can gyi sgo ra'i nang du srog chad bcad/ da la'i pū 219

thur 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi sras dar rgyas tshe ring dang / lcamā chen chun sogs rgyang 'phud btang ngo / /mi ring bar ching gong mas mngags pa'i a li am ban dang tsong thung tshe gung yo rnam rgyal am ban/ srung dmag lnga brgya dang bcas 'byor ro/ /de nas gong ma'i bka' lung dngasargya bod gros mthun gyis lcags lug (1751)lor rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtshor bod kyi chos srid gnyis ka'i dbaje cha tshang ma phul/ 'di'i sngon rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dus nas bzung / rgyalabo sde srid logs su yod pas de dag gis srid bskyangs/ rgyal dbang rin po ches gtso cher chos kyi bya ba mdzad/ srid la dbang ba'i rgyal bo 'gyur med rnam rgyalagyi bar du yod mod/ 'di nartswabazung ste rgyal dbang nar ma son pa'i bar du rgyal bo'am srid skyong bsko gzhag dang / rgyal dbang nar son zhing slogaganyer mthar phyin rjes srid dbang rgyal ba rin po che la 'bul rgyu'i srol de dar bar snang / de nas bka' blon bzhis btsugs pa'i bka' shag btsugs/ bka' blon bzhi ni/gung paṇa ḍi ta/ mdo mkhar zhabs drung / thon pa sri chod tshe brtan/ ser mo ba mgron gasprer dar han rnams bsko bzhag go/ /de nas bzung bod gzhung bka' shag gis srid don mtha' dag gi bkod 'doms mdzad de dga' ldan pho brang ba'i chab srid ཿ20

sra brtan byas/ rgyal dbang rin po che la bod sogarigi drag zhan ches mang bo dad 'dun shin tu che stabs/ de nas bzung bod kyi srid dbang 'phrog res kyis khyod gsod nga gsod kyi nang dme re zhig mtshams chad de/ mi ser byings bde 'jags sos dal ngang la gnas thub pa byung ngo / /'di dag gi skor rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i rnam thar sogs su shin tu gsal lo/ /chu sprel (1752)lor paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes dbus su phebs nas/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal snga las bka' lung dbang khrid bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/shing khyi (1754)lo'i zla 2pa'i nang rtse slob grwa btsugs te slob dpon tshag sgur ba bskal bzang 'phrin las bsko gzhag mdzad/ rtse zhol du sku rten bris 'bur bzhengs pa'i bzo grwa gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ de ltar chos srid gnyis cha nas 'gran zla bral ba'i mdzad nga/ 'od di kar gyis nor 'dzin sgeg mo dkar chab tu btang /me glang (1757)lo'i zla gnyis par dgung lo lnga bcu'i thog sku'i bkod pa bsdus so/ /khong gis sku tshe gang bor sdom gsum dag pa nyams len gyi mthil du bzung nas/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ dge sbyong gi chos 221

bzhi dang du blangs nas/ srid skyong snga rjes kyis snyad 'dogs kyi 'o brgyal ji snyed cig byung ru nga / chags sdang mgo snyom mdzad/khyim mtshes kyi rgyal khab dag la drang snyom drang 'brel gyi mthun lam mdzad pa/ sna mnga' 'bangs rnams kyang bu bzhin bskyangs stabs/ nang 'khrug sde gzar dang / rgyal khab bar gyi 'khrug zing gang yang ma byung bas/ bu rta nor gsum brlag ma dgos shing dmangs byings kyis bde 'jags ngang 'tsho ba brgal thub pa byung ngo / /khong 'das ma thag bka' blon rnams dang / sku bcar khag gdan sa gsum gyi slob dpon/ drung yig ser skya sogs gros bsdur byas te/ gcig mthun spyi mos ltar/ de mo sprul sku ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtshor no mon han gyi cho lo dang bcas rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ bla sprul khongs nas rgyal tshab tu bzhugs mkhan thog ma khong yin zhes gsungs/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho la/ ching gong ma'i bka' shog dang /gser gyi glegs bur rgyal dbang drug pa zhes bkod yod mod/bod yongs grags la/ drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho/ bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho/ zhes 'dren par byed do/ / rgyal dbang sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/rgyal dbang brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho ni/ lcags sbrul 222

(1791)lo'i zla 1nang thob rgyal lha ri sgang du sku 'khrungs/paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyis/ gtsug phud bzhes te blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang byug 'jam dpal rgya mtsho zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ chu rta (1762)lo'i zla7tshes9nyin pho brang chen po po ta la'i gser khrir zhabs sor 'khod/ shing sprel (1764)lor lha sa dbang ldan dpal 'bar du 'brug pa'i slob gnyer ba'i don du dmigs bsal slob grwa btsugs/ bla ma chos rdzong ba dang / rag shag dge rgan gnyis dge rgan du bskos/ 'brug pa rnams slob gnyer ma thon bar du zur chas rgyun gtong dang /sdod gnas bcas kyi sku drin bskyangs/me phag (1767)lor mchod gzhis/ mi chen gzhis ka'i lam lugs/ phyi yong mi sna la sne len byed lugs/ lam yig ster lugs sogs gsar ba gtan la phab/gong ma chen lung gis zhe hor po ta la dang / bkra shis lhun po zhes pa'i chos sde gsar rgyag gnang ba'i mkhan po dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa kha shas gtong dgos zhes zhus pa ltar/ sgo mang dge bshes srad rgyud mkhan po sangs rgyas 'od zer/ sgo mang mdung nag—zhabs drung ngag dbang chos grags/blo gling blo bzang chos grwags/ dbu mdzad rgyud smad dge slong 323

ji ngag dbang rin chen dang / dge slong ngag dbang skal ldan bcas rdzong bda' mdzad/lcags yos (1771)lor sngar rgya dang o rod 'khrug — skabs/ bros byol gyis u ru si'i sa mtshams su bsdadasnepa'i jun gar ba rnams rang yul du yong chog pa dang gong ma'i rgya dmag gis gnod pa mi byed pa'i don la rgyal dbang ma chog gis bka' drin yang dag pa stsal/rgyal tshab de mo no mon han ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde — legs rgya mtshos chab srid kyi thugs 'gan lo nyi shu rtsa gcig la gnang ste/ me bya (1777)lo'i zla 1tshes23nyi na bstan rgyas gling du sku gshegs/ de 'phral bka' shag sogs mi drag rnamayodang / gdan sa'i mkhan slob sogs ser skya spyi mgrin gcigagis/ rgyal dbang rin po che dgung lo nyi shu ba zhes yod ga shis/chochab srid kyi las 'gan bzhes dgos zhes zhus na'ang / khong gis gsan bsam gyi 'asbo skyong dgos gsungs nas zhal gyis ma bzhes/ de nas rgyud stod mkhan zur tsha rdor ngag dbang tshu la khrims rgya nag tu chos spel bzhin bzhugs yod pa la gong mas no mon han gyi mtshan gnas gnang ba dang 'brel gdan 'dren zhus te srid skyong rgyal bor bskos/ khong gi 'khrungs yul ni a mdo 224

co ne red/ dbus su slob gnyer byed du phyin nas so ra oṃ5 du grwa sar zhugs/ bzhugs gnas tsha rdor khang tshan yin 'dug slob gnyeziri bgyis te slar rgyud sto da du phebs/ bla ma dbu mdzad dang /de rjes mkhan po mdzad/ rjes su pe cin la slob dpon du gzhung gis mngags/ lcang skya rol ba 'i rdo rje dang thugs snang mthun pa la brten/ gong ma chen lung gis kyang gzigs pa che/ me bya (1777) lo'i zla 7tshes 5nyin lha sar phebs skabs lha sa'i mi dmangs khri phrag mang bo ltad mor 'dus nas sngar gyi rgyud pa'i dge bshes grwa rkyang zhig glo bur du bod kyi srid skyong du phebs 'dug ces ha las nas blta bar yong ba red zer/ rjes su dga' ldan khri bar yang phebs/ khong gis srid 'dzi na pa'i skabs kyi blon po ni/ gung paṇa ḍi ta/ gung kun dga' brtsan 'dzin/thon pa srid zhi dbang 'dus/ mdo mkhar bsod nams dbang rgyal sogs red ces 'dugs phag (1779) lor chen lung gis zhe hor bkra shis lhun po bzhengs pa'i rab gnas dang / gong ma rang nyid dgung lo bdun cur phebs pa'i dga' ston dang 'brel chos rgya che ba zhu rgyu'i don du/ paṇa chen rin bo che dpal ldan ye shes pe cin du gdan drangs pa ltar chibs bsgyur gnang / de nas rim 225

gyis sku 'bum du phebs nas zla ba bzhi dang / zhag nyi shu tham pa bzhugs te lcags byi (1780)lo'i zla3tshes 10nyin sku 'bum nas chibs bsgyur/ de skabs 'jam dbyangs bzhad sprul ma hā paṇa ḍi ta dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bo'i phyag mdzod chen mo sogs zhabs gras lha 'brum gyis ma thar ba sum brgya skor la 'brum sman btab nga/sa lam lhong chen po byung / de nas zla7tshes 21nyin zhe hor la phebs 'byor byung / de nas pe cin du gong ma chen lung dang mjal 'phrad gnang / tshes22nyin zhe hor bkra shis lhun por phebs/ rab gnas mdzad/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyer lnga'i nyin zhe hor— bkra shis lhun po nasape cin du chibs bsgyur/ tshes nyer bdun nyidz+wa gong ma chen lung la mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs chos bka' ci rigs gnang / lcags byi (1780)lo'i zla 11tshes 1nyin nyi rgas tsam la gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim/ lcags glang (1781)lo'i zla2tshes23nyin sku gdung gdan 'dren zhus te sku 'khor rnams pe cin nas chas te/ zla8tshes20nyin gdan sa bkra shis lhun por 'byor to/ / sa ngan ri kha shi ba zhes pa'i sde dpon bcas nas rkun jag tshod med byas te/ mjal ba dang 'grul ba'i lam thon dka' ba ཿ26

byung stabs/ gung paṇa ḍi ta dang / mda' dpon lcang lo can sogs kyis bod dmag gtos che ba drangs nas lcags byi (1780)lo'i zla9nang sa ngan rdzong 'bur mo mer bsregs/jag gtso sde rong a tshogs dang / ru shod rta rgod byams pa pha bu sogs nyes can rnams sa gnas de gar srog chad khrag sbyor dang gzhan mang bo zhig rgyang 'phud btang /lo der hal ha rje btsun dam pa'i sprul sku thugs brtag bcad/ lcags glang (1781)lo'i zla 6tshes1nyin rgyal dbang mchog gis gsan bsam grub par brten chos srid lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bzhes rung / rgyun du chos phyogs kho nar nyams bzhes gnang stabs/ srid kyi las don la khri rin po che tsha rdor no mon han gyis las 'gan bzhes/ de'i phyi lor skyid grong bsam gtan gling nas mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug dka' chen ye shes rgyal mtshan yongs 'dzin du gdan 'dren zhus nas rgyun du rtse pho brang chen mor bzhugs nas bka' chos rgyun ma chad par gnang / pe cin nas rgyal dbang rin po cher gser gyi glegs bu bcu bdun thog yig rigs bzhi brkos kyi 'ja' sa 'bul mi 'byor/ shing 'brug (1784)lor nor gling bskal bzang pho brang gsar bzhengs mdzad/227

tsha rdor no mon han zhes bod kyi rgyal bo grags pa can 'di ni lo ngo bcur bod kyi rgyal srid skyong bar bzhugs shing / khong ni chos srid gnyis char mkhyen rgya che la rgya bod kyi dpon rigs gnon zil che zhing miser dze+eshin tu byams pha sogagokyi dbang girtswamatho dman kun gyis brtsi mthong che/ 'di ba'i ring la tshong las sogs dpal 'byor dar rgyas che zhing / dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'ang ha cang bzang ba dang / sde gzar 'khrug zing sogs kyi lo rgyus spyang mi snang / de skabs pe cin du lcang skya rol ba'i rdo je sku gshegs stabs/ pe cin chos kyi slob grwa'i dbu 'dzin dang rgya nag gi nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i dgon pa yongs la bka' slob kyi ched du rgya nag pe cin du gdan drangs pa ltar/ me rta (1786)lo'i zla5tshes28la lha sa nas btegs te be cin du phebs/ gong mas sa ma ti pak+ṣi zhes pa'i go gnas gnang ste pe cin du bzhugs/bod du rta tshag rje drung bstan pa'i mgon po la no mon han gyi cho lo dang bcas rgyal bor bskos 'dug go/ /me lug (1787)lo'i zla 6pa'i nang zhwa dmar ba sku phreng bcu ba chos 'grub rgya mtsho'i g.yog po karma mchog sbyin zer bas lam khrid byas te glo bur du bal bo gor dzi'i dmag gis btsan 'dzul byas te gnya' nang / rong shar/ skyid grong ste rdzong gsum 228

blangs/ rim gyis sa dga' sogs kyang blangs/ nobod dmag gis mu mthud nas 'gog rgol byas/ rgya nag nas kyang dpon dmag 'bor chen 'byor yang 'gog rgol ma byas par chings brgyab/ chings don rdzong gsum tshur blu rin la rgya dngul—rdo tshad sum brgya tham pa 'phral du sprad na rdzong gsum mkhregs bzung mi byed par bod la rtsis sprod byed byas te chings bar du rgya dpon — —rnams bsdad nas/ btsan shed kyisaḥngs yig cig bod kyi mgo la bzhag blu rin kha shas sprad nas gor dmag rnams phyir log lo gsum gyi ring gor dmag gis 'phrog bcom byas pa'i mi dmangs la skyob gso byas/ skyid grong bsam gtan gling gorodamag gis bcom ste dge 'dun pa phal che ba lha sar phebs yod stabs/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dgongs ltar lcags khyi (1790)lor lha sa'i skyid chu'i lho phyogs tshe mchog gling gi dgon pa btab/bod du stod phyogs gor dmag gis bcom pa dang / dbus gtsang mdo khams sogs kyi rgya dmag gi 'gro lam gyi mi ser —rnams thor ba dang / lhag par bod gzhung gi chab srid dpal 'byor gang thad nas nyams rgud byung stabs/ rgyal dbang mchog dang bka' shag sogs nas gros bsdur byas te/ slar yang tsha rdor 229

no mon han ngag dbang tshul khrims pe cin nas gdan drangs te/ lcags khyi (1790) lo'i zla 10tshes9nyin lha ldan du phebs te slar yang bod kyi rgyal bor bzhugs/ rta tshag no mon han bstan pa'i mgon po pe cin chos slob dbu 'dzin du phebs rgyu byas/ lcags phag (1791) lo'i zla 3nang tsha rdor no mon han ngag da bang tshul khrims sku 'das/ de 'phral rta tshag no mon han bstan pa'i mgon po pe cin du phebs pa'i lam bar nas phyir gdan drangs te sngar bzhin srid dbang 'dzin du bcugalcags phag (1791) lo'i zla 6tshes22nyin gnya' nang zhes pa'i sar gor dmag gis g.yo thabs kyis/ bod kyi mi sna gor dzir gros mol du song ba rnams mtha' bskor/ zhabs pad rdo ring ba bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor dang / zhabs pad g.yu thog pa bkra shis don 'grub gnyis dang / mda' dpon lcang lo can bcas gson 'dzin byas/ shod drung sgo mkhar ba sogs mi sna dang zhabs gras sum cu so lnga bsad/ bcu skor rmas/ gor dmag yang brgya lhag bsad/ gor dmag gis zhabs pad gnyis bal yul du khrid/ gor dmag khri gcig dang stong brgyad lhag gis bod yul du btsan 'dzul byas te/ bkra shis lhun po gezhis rtse yan chad du slebs te 'phrog bcom tshod med byas/230

chu byi (1792)lor bod gzhung dngul lor gsar bzo byas te gtong 'grem dang 'brel 'gro rgyugs dgos pa sogs kyi rtsa tshig sbyar/ lo 'dir ching gong mas nang blon gnyis dang / rgya dang a mdo rgyal rong gi dmag sogs dmag khri gnyis btang ba bal yul phyogs su song nas bod dmag dang zla bsgril/ yang man ju dang rgya'i dmag khri gcig 'ongs nas shel dkar du yod pa'i bod dmag dang zla bsgril nas gor dmag la 'thab 'dzing byas pas/gor dmag gis pham kha chen po khur/ de nas rgya bod kyi dmag rnams bal bo'i sa thog tu slebs 'dug bal bo'i sa thog tu rgya bod kyi dmag sa gzhir ma shong ba 'byor/ gor dzi'i rgyal bos gnas spos/ bla ma zhwa dmar bas rang garnang gis dug gsol te shi ba red zer /chu byi (1792)lo'i zla 6tshes27nyin bka' blon gnyis tshur bskyal ba dang mnyam du gor dzi'i sku tshab rnams 'ongs te mgo btags/ chings yig bzhag go/ /'di dag ni rdo ring paṇa ḍi ta'i rang rnam sogs su ches gsal bas zhib cha ma bris/ de nas rim gyis bod rgya'i dmag 'then nas/ chu glang (1793)lo'i zla 3tshes25la rgya dmag rnams phyir log rgyal rong gi dmag mi la la yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs la mjal zhing bka' lha3ram̐

rteb mno sa pas rang yu la du ma log par bod du bsnad do / /shing stag (1794)lor rgyal sprul rta tshag no monaha na nas kun bde gling btab/ lcags bya (1801)lor paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma dbus su phecibs—nas/ lha ldan jo bo rin po che'i mdun nas/ rgyal dbang 'jam dbal rgya mtshos mkhan po mdzad de bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ chusaphag (180kyi3) lor hal ha rje btsun dam ba'i sbrul sku bsnyenapar rdzogs/ shing byi (1804) lo'i zla 10tshes 18nyin rgyal dbang 'jam dpal rgya ma tsho sku 'das so/ /rgyal dbang sku phreng da gu ba spung rtogs rgya mtsho/rgyal dbang dgu ba blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug lung rtogs rgya mtsho ni/ mdo stod khams ldan chos 'khor dgon gyi nye 'gram du/ yab bstana'adzin chos skyong dang / yum don 'grub sgrol ma nanyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing glang (1805)lo'i zla 12tsherme 1nyi na 'khrungs/ paṇa chen ba stan pa'i nyi rmims rgyal ba'i sprul skur thugs brtag bcad/rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa 'brug (1808) lo'i zla9tshes 21nyin pho brang po ta lar zhabs sor 'khod/ tshes22nyi na sku gong ma'i khrir 'khod/ mdzad sgo rgyas spros byas/ lo 'anir ma go 333

log khang gsar dang khang rga na gnyis kyis gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang ba'i bka' ma brtsis par/ zhib dpyod du zhabs pad bshad sgra don 'grub rdo rje dang / las bya phogs dpon ye shes rgya mtsho sogs kyis dmag khrid de dbus dmag thog sde dge chu shar nub nas yu la dmag miñtsāng sabacas kyis mgo log tu dpung 'jug byas/ dam ga 'khrug rgya chen po byed ma dgos par/ gzhung sa dga' ldazhanapho brang gi bka' spyi brtsi bkur byed rgyu/ khas len dam —bca' byas/ byed gte 'ga' zhig yul 'phud btang / mtshoci sngon snyogs su 'ga' zhig gis rku jag byas stabs/ mdo stod smad gnyis kar bde 'jags kyi don du sgar dpon robazhag go/ /lcags rta (181pyi) lo'i zla 12tshes 3nyin bod kyi srid skyong rta tshag ho thog thu bstan pa'i mgon po sku gshegs/ lcags lug (181 1) lo'i zla 4tshes 1 1nyin de mo sprul sku no mon han thugebastaga'ajigs med srid skyong sgokhrir 'khod/ chu sprel (1812) lo'i zla 9tshes 22nyin paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi masporgyal dbang mchog la rab byung gi sdom pa stsal/shing khyi (1 814) lor bal bo'i gor dzi dang dbyin ji gnyis kyi dmag 'khrug byung /cirī shing pha ga (1815) lo'i zla2tshes 15nyin rgyal dbang 233

lung rtogs rgya mtsho nyid dgung grangs bcu tsam gyi thog mgul cham bzhes te sku mya ngan las 'das so/ / 4phro rgyal dbang sku zeng bcu ba tshul khrims rgya mtsho/mo rgyal dbang bcu ba tshul khrims rgya mtsho ni/ me byi (1816)lo'i zla3tshes29nyin li thang du 'khrungs/ sa yos (1819)lo'i zla3tshes3nyin srid skyong de mo rin po che dag zhing dgongs/tshe smon gling tsha rdor rgyal thog gnyis pa sa ma ti pak+ṣi ngag dbang 'jam dpal tshul khrims srid skyong gi go sar gdan drangs/chu rta (1822)lo'i zla 1tshes 15nyin paṇa chen rin po che bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs kyis gser bum dkrug khul gyis rgyal dbang rin po che thugs brtag bcad/ de 'phral zla 1tshes 18nyin paṇa chen rin po che bstan pa'i nyi mas rgya' ba'i yang srid rin po che'i gtsug phud bzhes te/ ngag dbang blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ zla2tshes 13nyin rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes/ lo de'i zla8tshes8nyin pho brang po ta la'i gser khrir 'khod/ nyin nyi shu'i ring rgyal khab phyi nang gi dpon po rten 'bul ba che dgu mang 'dzoms thog dga' ston chen po byas/chu lug (1823)lor rmar khams dang / sa ngan gyi gyod ཿ34

don du bka' blon bshad sgra don 'grub rdo rje sogs phebs/ shing sprel (1824)lor rgyal rong lha steng dgon nyams gso dang 'brel/ gzhi gsum gyi nyams len gsar 'dzugs dang mkhan po ser smad slob zur 'jam dbyangs dam rjos dang / grwa ba bco lnga bcas rdzong bda' mdzad/ lcags yos (1831) dang chu 'brug (1832)lo gnyis su mtsho sngon phyogs su dgra jag tshod med byed stabs zhib gcod byed mkhan dang 'brel dmag btang yang dmag 'khrug byed ma dgos/ de rjes spo bo phyogs su yang dmag bskyod byas 'dug chu sbrul (1833)lor rtse pho brang gi 'khrungs rabs lha khang du paṇa chen rin po che'i mdun nas rgyal dbang mchog gis bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me mo bya (1837)lo'i zla 9tshes 1nyin rgyal dbang tshul khrims rgya mtsho dgung grangs nyer gnyis thog sku gshegs so/ / rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gcig pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho/ tā la'i bla ma rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gcig pa ni/ mgar thar phyogs man chod kun brtsegs gshis tshang la/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa khyi (1838)lo'i zla 9tshes 1nyin sku bltams/ 235

lcags glang (1841)lo'i zla6tshes4nyin gung thang bde ba can du kun gzigs thams cad mkhyen pa paṇa chen blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog gis gtsug phud bzhes te mkhas grub rgya mtsho pizhes mtshan gsol/ chu stag (1842)lo'i zla4tshes 14nyin pho brang chen po po ta la'i gser khrir zhabs sor 'khod/ zla ba drug ring rten 'bul zhus/ lo 'dir mdo stod hor khog gling tshang /ru dam/ sde dge sogs su sa 'gul chen po byung ste mi phyugs nor gsum la gyong rgud chen po byung / bod gzhung nas sku tshab mngags te skyob gso dang / 'bru dngul gyi rogs ram rgya che ba gnang 'dugal dwags ni bod yin mod/ lo bcu phrag tsam gyi sngon nas kasmir gyi mnga' 'og tu shor 'dug lcags glang (1841)lo bod dang la dwags kyi tshong lam bcad nas/ larwags dang / sig (sing ba)gi dmag gis mnga' ris su btsana'adzul byas stabs/bod dmag la dwags phyogs su bskyod nas g.yul 'gyed mang bo byas/ kasmir gyi dmag dpon chen po dzo ra wa sing bsad/ la dwags sa cha rgya che ba blangs mod/ chu stag (1842)lor kasmir gyi ma hā ra dza sgug lab sing gis dmag stong phrag brgyad khrid de 'ongs nas gtug 'thab byas pas bod pham/ de rjes bka' mol gyis chings yig bzhag ste/ la dwags kyi bod dmag phyir 'then 336

byas/ mda' dpon bshad sgra dbang phyug rgyal bo la byas rjes—su bka' blon go gnas stsal pa sogs/ dmag 'khrug skabs kyi dpa' rtul rnams kyis bya dga' thob/chu yos (1843)lo'i zla 7nang bod kyi srid skyong tshesmon gling ngag dbang 'jam dpal tshul khrims rgya mtsho bod kyi rgyal bo byas nas lo nyi shu lon yang khri las phab/ tshe smon bla brang la sgo thel brgyab/ srid skyong zur ba khong chos ra'i nang du bzhugs bcug phyag mdzod dza sag ltag sgo rab gsal du btsolto'ajug byas te/ tsha 'dri btang ba dang / nyin gcig zhabs pad rnams tshegling chos rar yi ge sogs la zhib 'jug gnang bar phebayo skabs/ ser smad grwa shar mang bo 'ongs nas/ zur khang ba dang / spyi khang lcags grong bar rdung sdeg byayogashis bka' shag 'tshogs ma thub pa dang / srid zur tsha rdor tshe smon gling ba de se rar khrid nas mkhregs bzung byas pa sogs kyi rkyen las zing cha langs sgrugyu yang / sbyin bdag khag nas b.ra' bud 'grig thabs kyis zhi 'jags tsam byung 'dug tshe smon gling khri las phab pa'i zla phyi ma'i nang paṇa chen rin po che bstan pa'i nye ma gdan drangs te/ srid skyo nga gi 'gan bzhes na'ang / zla ba dgu tsam nas dgongayozhu gnang ste bkra shis lhan por phyir phebs/ shing lhal (1845)ཿbye7

lor rwa sgreng ho thog thu ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes tshul khrims rgyal mtshan srid skyong gi go sar bzhag me rta (1846)lo'i zla4tshes 7nyin paṇa chen rin po che gdan zhus kyis rgyal dbang mchog gis dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/sa sprel (1848)lor nor gling bskal bzang pho brang gi gzim chung gsar rgyag mdzad/chu byi (1852)lor paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma dgung grwangs bdun cu'i thog thun mong gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus/ shing yos (1855)lo'i zla 1tshes 13nyin rgyal dbang rin po che mkhas grub rgya mtshos gsan sbyang mthar phyin stabs rgyal srid kyi las 'gan bzhes/ srid skyong rwa sgreng ho thog thus dgongs zhu gnang ste rwa sgreng du phebs/de lor gor dmag gis gnya' nang / skyid grong / rdzong dga'/rong shar/ spu hreng sogs su 'phrog bcom byas/ dbus mda' dpon rang byon rdo rje don 'grub/ gtsang mda' dpon dpung bcas song nas rgol na'ang g.yul ngo pazlog ma thub 'dug de nas zhabs pad dpal lhun 'khor bcas/ri sde dge/ dim chu nyer lnga/ ri chab dpa' gsum gyi sa khul dang / zhabs pad bkra shis khang gsar 'khor bcas/ 'ba'/ li thang / rgyal 238

rong / rgyal thang / lcags la/ be ri sogs su dmag bskul byas te/ bkra shis khang gsar lha sar 'byor nyin dpung 'jug cho gi spyi khyab par bsko gzhag byas/ se 'bras dge gsum gyi grwa ba lo gzhon 'bor chen zhig dang blangs dmag la zhugs par/ rgyal dbang rin po che thugs shin tu mi mnyes pa garneng ste/ ser dmag 'di 'dra bskul ba ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan par gnod tshabs che/zhes sogs gsungs 'dug bod kyis dmag mang gra sgrig gi bya ba gor rgyal gyis thos nas/ skrag ste zhi bas gros mol byed rgyu khas blangs/ bod kyi chings pa bal yul gyi rgyal sar gros mol du phyin/shing yos (1855)lo'i zla 12tshes25nyin rgyal dbang mkhas grub rgya mtsho dgung grangs bco brgyad thog sku gshegs/rgyal bo rwa sgreng ho thog thu slar yang gdan drangs nas srid skyong du bsko gzhag byas/ me 'brug (1856)lo'i zla2tshes 12nyin bal bo'i rgyal sa nas bod dang bal bo'i bar gyi zhi ba'i chings yig la gros 'chams byung nas gor ṣa'i dmag rnams kyang bod kyi sa khongs nas phyir 'then dang / phan tshun gyi bzung dmag rnams kyang dus bcad kyis phyir slog byas mod/ chings yig de ni gor rgyal la rgyal kha thob 'dug pa zhig red zer/rgyal dbang sku sbeng bcu gnyis pa 'azin las rgya mtsho/239

rgyal dbang bcu gnyis pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho ni/ 'ol dga' phyogs su me 'brug (1 85 6) lo'i zla 1 2tshes 1nyin 'khrung sa/ sa rta ( 1858) lor thugaspobartag bcad/ lo de'i blo 1tshes 415nyin srid skyong rwa sgreng ho thog thu rin po ches gtsug phud ba‘zhes te/ blo bza nga bstan pa'i rgya la mtshan 'phrin las rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gsol/ sku go nga ma'i khrir mnga' gsol/ lo 'di'i yas mas su 'bras ljongs larabyin ji'i dmag gis btsan 'dzul byas byung / 'bras ljongaspodamag dpon spro khang mgron rnam rgyal bod du skyabs zhurad+ku' byor ba la/ bod gzhung nas mgron rnam rgyal la rim bzhi'i go gnas dang / 'tsho rten gsol ras su gzhis ko g.yog ri sa bcasabānapa red zer/srid tshoskyong ra sgreng ho thog thu dgre / bka' blon bshad sgra gnyis nang ma mthun par/ zhabs bad bshad sgra go gnas thams cad las phab nas/ gnas dbyung byas te/ snye mo smon mkhar gyi bshatshod sgra'i sger gzhis bya sgor zer sar tshul sathun byas te sdod dgos byung / bshad sgra snye mor 'dug ring / bal yul gyi srid blon 'jang sba thur rat+na'i 'tshams 'dri'i yi ge zhig 'byor ba srid skyong gi rna bar son stabs/ rwa sgrong srid skyong gis bka' shag gros thog nas/ mda' dpon thon pa ba dmag mi dang bcas 240

lībashad sgra phyir ldog rgyu mid par gyis zhes pa'i bka' yig dang bcas mngags/ mda' dpon thon pa ba snye mo smon mkhar sa'abyor te/ bshad sgra'i khang bar mtshan mor dmag gis ba skogam da' dpon nang du 'dzul tshe/ bshad sgra skrag dngangs med pa ra sngon gyi byas rjes dang nag med tshul sogs thabs mkhas kyis —bshad par brten/ mda' dpon thon pa bar kun rtog sna tshogs shig shar te gsod ma nus par/ snye mo rgyal byed dgon pa 'i khang chung zhig tu skra bzhar btsun gzugs byas te btson du bcug su dang yang thug 'phrad byed mi chog par byas te do dam pa bzhag de rjes lo gcig tsam gyi rjes su bshad sgra'i mched mchog dga' ldan gyi grwa ba kha shas kyis bshad sgra snye mor btson khang lta bur yod pa —shes te/ dga' ldan shar rtse'i mkhan po'i phyag mdzod dpal ldan do na 'grub zer ba blo stobs che gshis da ga' ldan nang gi gnad yod tshang mar 'brel ba byas te/ srid skyong rwa sgrong la ngo log byed rgyu byas/ de skabs rwa sgrong gis 'bras spungs rigs grwa'i mchod phogs dngul bsgyur te/ phran bu chag pa'i rkyen las/ 'bras spungs dang srid skyong rwa sgrong bar la 'khonagalda byung / 'bras spungs pa'i rgyab tu dga' ldan langs nas srid skyong la ngo rgol byas stabs/ chu khyi (1862)lo smon lam chen spo dang tshogs mchod kyang dus 241

thog tu tshugs ma thub par phyis zla ba dgu bar btsugs/ dga' 'bras kyi grwa shar btang ste snye mo nas bshad sgra lha sar gdan drangs/ dga' 'bras drung spyi zer ba zhig btsugs/ de ni dga' ldan/ 'bras spungs/ rtse shod drung 'khor bcas yod pa'i tshogs 'du zhig la zer/ de nas nyin shas nas srid skyong gi phyogs la ser byas grwa tshang gcig pu las med par gyur 'dug srid/ skyong rwa sgrong phyogs gtogs kha shas bcas tham ga bsnams te se ra la bros kyang der yang 'dug ma bzod par rgya nag tu bros byol du song /de ma thag dga' 'bras drung spyis gtso byas nas zhus te/chu khyi (1862)lo'i zla 3tshes 12nyin rgyal dbang 'phrin las rgya mtsho dgung grangs bdun las ma lon kyang / rgyal srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes pa'i tshul dang / nang don bshad sgra dbang phyug rgyal bo sde srid du bsko gzhag byas/ bshad sgra rten skya bo grong ba yin yang skra bzhar ba'i grwa gzugs byas na legs zhes btsun chas spras zhes bshad 'dug ste/ chab srid 'di'i don la ci byed 'di byed med tshod red/rwa sgrong 'khor bcas rgya nag pe cin du phebs nas gtug bsher byas/ gong ma'i gzu chings ltar phyir 'khor te rwa sgrong du bzhugs chog par byas nas phyir phebs lam zi ling nas sku 24lha

'das so/ /rwa sgreng gi phyogs zhabs pad bkra shis gsar khang dang 'khrungs gzhis dngos grub lding gi gzhis ka rnams kyang gzhung bzhes byas nas mthar 'bras spungs blo gsal gling grwa tshang gi mchod gzhis byas/ri bshad sgrar srid skyong gi go gnas thob ste/ phu lung ba la zhabs pad kyi go gnas/ mkhan chen blo bzang dpal ldan la spyi mkhan dar han gyi go gnas byin pa dang / dga' ldan shar rtse mkhan po'i phyag mdzod dpal ldan don 'grub la gzhung gi zhabs sdod kyi thog bla phyag mkhan chung gi go gnas stsal zhing / ring bor ma song bar dpal ldan don 'grub la bka' blon dang sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po sogs byas dbang shugs je cher gyur/dus skabs 'di'i lo kha shas kyi sngon nas/ mdo stod ri nang dpal mgon gyi bu rgyud mgon po rnam rgyal dang / mgon po tshe brtan pha bu gnyis kyis/ nyag rong sde drug hor ma zu/ brag 'go/ khang gsar/ tre hor/ stong skor/ be ri/ gling tshang sogs btsan shed kyis dbang du bsdus par ma zad/ sde dge/lcags la/ dge bshes tsa/ khro skyabs/ li thang // 'ba'/mgar thar sogs la btsan 'phrog mang bo byas rkyen/ brag 'go dpon dbang chen dgra 'dul dang / dpon mo nor bu/ ja'i 243

sang bla 'khos kyis gtsos dud khyim brgya skor dang / khang ga dngos grub phun tshogs/ ma zu gnyer ba zhu gu bkra shis sogs dud khyim sum ba rgya skor rang yul du 'dug ma thub par bod gzhung la skyabasu zhur song / sde gzhung gis sde ba mi ser de rnams chu shur/gong dkar/ stod—lung—khul du skyob gso dang bcas 'jog par mdzad/ slar yang nyag dmag gis/ 'ba'/ li thang / phyag phreng / rdza khog mi nyag rgyal thang khul la'ang bcom 'phrog byas par ma zad/ bod gzhung gi mdo sgar dpon khongs rtse'i ja dang /gdan sa gsum gyi mang ja'i mthun rkyen mdzod ja sogs tshang ma 'phrog bcom byas te/ rgya bod tshong lam bkag pa sogs kyi snyan zhu gcig mjug gnyis mthud du phul bar ma zad/ nyag dmag sde dger 'byor nas dgon chen bzung / sde dge'i gzhis ka rnams la dbang bsgyur/ sde dge rgyal bo yum sras bcas dang / kaḥthog dpon sprul sogs btson du bcug pa sogs byas stabs/bod sde gzhung gis dmag dpon spyi khyab zhabs pad phu lung ba tshe dbang rdo rje bsko gzhag byas te/ dbus mda' dpon khri smon pa 'chi med rdo rje dang / dbus mda' dpon mdo mkhar ba tshe dbang nor bu dmag dpung bcas dang / phogs dpon 'khor bcas sogs chu phag (1863)lo'i zla 2tshes 9nyin lha ldan 244

nas chas/ lam bar nas sho srar lho gsum/ ri chab dpa' gsum sogs na sa yul dmag 'gugs bzhin mgyogs shad kyis zla 9ba'i nang nyag rong la dpung 'jug byas/ rmar khams dang /brag g.yab nas dang blangs yul dmag gi 'go 'dzin gdong kam sprul sku ngo ma dmag thog tu phebs pa dang / kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis kyang rim gro rgya chen po gnang / mda' dpon khri smon pa'i dpung gis rdo rdzong / bya rgod rdzong / nyag chu rdzong sogs rim par blangs te/ shing glang (1865)lo'i zla ba bdun pa'i nang nas ri nang rdzong la mtha' skor gyis zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nyin mgon po rnam rgyal pha bu/ tsha rigs sum cu skor dang /blon po drag gras bzhi bcu skor bcas khang ba me 'bar ba'i nang du gson sreg byung ste/ lhag ma rnams kyis mgo btags so/ /shing byi (1864)lo'i zla4tshes 13nyin yongs 'dzin dga' ldan khri zur blo bzang mkhyen rab dbang phyug gi drung las rgyal dbang mchog gis rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes/ bka' blon bshad sgras lo/gsum ring chab srid kyi 'gan bzung nas/ lo 'di'i zla8tshes28nyin 'das/ zla 9tshes29nyin yongs 'dzin dga' ldan khri zur sde drug blo bzang mkhyen rab dbang phyug lha4bya

bod rgyal gyi khrir phebs so de nas zhabs pad phu lung ba nyag rong du phebs nas/phogs dpon phun rab pa tshe ring dpal ldan la tha'i ji'i go gnas dang bcas dar mdo yan nyag khog dang bcas pa'i spyi khyab par bskos/ khams khul gyi nyag dmag gis gnod skyon byung rigs la ngo yod phyir slog dang / gyong tshab byin/ dpon gyi go gnas sogs kyang rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dus ltar sor bzhag byas thog bcad khra gsar ba'ang bkod/me yos (1867)lor pe cin nas ching gong mas nyag rong dmag don thag chod par bkra shis bde legs zhu ba'i spang leb shing byang chen po phul/ sa 'brug (1868)lor dpal ldan don 'grub la sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po'i go gnas thob/ skabs der srid 'dzin sde drug blo bzang mkhyen rab thugs gshis 'jam pas/ spyi khyab dpal ldan don 'grub dang / dga' 'bras drung spyis dbang shed kyis gzhung sa'i zhabs 'bring dang 'bangs la — brdab gsig chen po byung yod zer/ dpal ldan don 'grub zer ba ni khams rmi li nas yin zhing / dbus su grwa sar yong nas dga' ldan jushar rtse grwa tshang du tshogs zhugs byas/ khang tshan rdo khang dang / mi tshan rmi li mi lha46

tshan khong red zer/ smon lam skabs shig bshad sgrar rbaka'o/'gyur dang / sgrol ma 'bum ther tshugs skabs ja ma byed du yong nas bshad sgra dang 'brel ba byung / skabs shig rgyudastsostod du zhugasacite rgyud stod chos thog gnyer ba logasum tsam byas/ de rjes dga' ldan shar rtse mkhan po'i phyag mdzod du bskos/ bka' blon zur ba bshad sgra snye mo rgyal byed tshal du btson du bcug skabs srid skyong rwa sgrong la ngo log gi las 'gul shugs chen brtsams te bshad sgra bskyar log gi las ka'i gtso bo kho red zer/ bar skabs shig la dga' ldan phyag mdzod sna bo che zhes grags pa che zhing dbang shugs che bar gyur/ sngar kho rang gi phyogs gtogs yin pa'i zhabs pad phu lung ba de yang / khams phyogs nas nag yig 'gazho 'byor ba'i stabs kyis red kyang zer/ kho'i gong du shor dogs pa red kyang zer/ gang ltar srar rdzong rdzong dpon la bka' shog phab nas chur bskyur te bsad/dga' ldan phyag mdzod sna bo che dpal ldan don 'grub kyis dga' ldan dang 'bras spungs kyi mi chen dag kho'i rgyab la yod snyam nas bod ljongs yongs la dbang bsgyur rgyu'i ham sems skyes te/ rgyal dbang rin po che pha bong kha lta bu'i ri khrod cig la gsol phogs dang bcas 'dzog rgyu byesno rtsis dang /— srid skyong sde 347

drug blo bzang mkhyen rab kyi srid skyong gi go gnas bshol thabs kyi bya ba byas/ zhabs pad gsar byung bskal bzang dgra 'dul dang mtsho sgo ba mig dmar tshe ring / bshad sgra tshe ring dbang phyugasgrum pa rnam rgyal rdo rje bcas kyang dpal don gyis zil gyis mnan yod/ nyin gcig mtsho sgo bas srid skyong sde drug tshang la dogs zon byed dgos tshul zhus pa/ srid skyong phyag mdzod kyis dpal don la bshad de bya shor nas/ dpal don gyis mtsho sgo ba la dogs pa zos pa dang / sgrum pa la yang dogs pa zos nas de gnyis med par byed snyam pa skyes/ lcags lug (1871)lo'i zla 1bo'i zla mjug tu nyin gcig rtser tshogs 'du zhig gi skabs spyi khyab mkhan po dpal don gyis srid skyong sde drug tshang gis chab srid kyi las don la nus pa mi thon pas/ dgongs zhu gnang dgos zhes/ nga tshos skul ma btang na ji 'dra zhes bsam 'char dris par/ mtsho sgo bas nga ni srid skyong gi phyag las la skyon brjod zhu rgyu med ces bshad/ nyin shas kyi rjes su g.yo thabs kyis mtsho sgo ba gshed ma la sprad nas lkog gsod byas/ rjes sor lkog gsod byas pa ha go nas/ srid skyong sde drug tshang gi bkod 'doms 'og dpal ldan don 'grub kyi phyogs gtogs kyi sku drag tshomi drag rnams btson du bcug dpal ldan don 'grub btson 248

du 'dzug grabs skabs bya shor nas dga' ldan phyogs—su bros te/rang yul du 'bros grabs byas kyang / dga' ldan gyi mi chen dag gis/ dga' ldan du drangs nas srung skyob byas mod/ sde gzhung braka' shag gis lha sar yod pa'i dmag dngos gzhi btang ste dga' ldan gyi mtha' skor nyin shas la dmag 'thab byas mthar/ dpal don dang kho'i spun mgron gnyer mgon po gnyis khang steng nas lcebs te bros pa dmag gis ded pas/ mthar thabs zad nas dpal don gyis mgron gnyer mgon po la nga gsod rogs zer ba ltar bsad/ mgron gnyer mgon po'i rkang ba la me mda' phog nas dmag gis bzung ste/ dpal don gyi ro dang / mgron gnyer mgon po khyer nas lha sar khrom skor byas/ dga' ldan dgon par yang dmag 'khrug gis gtor bshig dang nyes skyon mi nyung ba phog bshad sgra tshe ring dbang phyug gnas dbyung byas pa dang / nyes can gzhan dag la 'os 'bab kyis thag gcod byas zer 'dug de'i phyi lo chu sprel (1872)lo'i zla9tshes 18nyin srid skyong sde drug tshang sku gshegs 'dugachu bya (1873)lo'i zla 2tshes 14la rgyal dbang rin po ches bod ljongs chab srid kyi las 'gan bzhes na yang / lo ngo gnyis tsam las ma 'gor bar/ shing phag (1875)lo'i bla — 249

3tshes20nyin dgung grangs brtso brgyad thog mdzad pa'i mtha' ma bstan to/ / de nas kun bde gling rta tshag rje drung ho thog thu ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan lugs gnyis chab srid kyi khrir 'khod do/ / rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho/rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho ni/ snang rdzong 'og glang mdun zhes pa'i yul du yab kun dga' rin chen dang /yum blo bzang sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su me byi (1876)lo'i zla5tshes5nyin sku 'khrungs/ rgyud stod mkhan zur blo bzang dar rgyas mchog grwa ba dang bcas lha mo bla mtshor gzigs su phebs par/mtsho nang nas rgyal dbang 'khrungs sa'i yul phyogs/ 'khrungs khang sogs shin tu gsal bar shar ba dang / kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che/ rgyal tshab rta tshag rin po che/ gnas chung rdo rje grags ldan/ dga' gdong gnas srung chen po/ la mo tshangs pa/bsam yas tse'u dmar bo sogs bla ma dang lha srung tshang ma zhal mthun par rgyal ba'i yang srid du thag bcad/ me glang (1877)lo'i zla 11tshes 1nyin gung thang bde ba can du gdan drangs/ sa yos (1879)lo'i zla 6tshes 13nyin pho brang chen po po ta la'i 250

gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por mnga' gsol/ tshes 14nyin gser khrir mnga' gsol gyi mdzad sgo rgyas pa mdzad/ tshes 15nyin nas spyi sger so sos legs 'bul bstar/ sa yos (1879)lor dbyin ji'i lta zhib pa 'beng 'gol cegyi mi rigs sa ra can dhar dhā se zhes pa dang / de dang mnyam du 'bras ljongs bla ma o rgyan rgya mtsho bkra shis lhun por 'byor ba/bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i phyag mdzod seng chen sprul sku sogs kyis sne len byas/ bod gzhung gis dogs pa zos te 'dzin bzung byed rgyu byas kyang bros byol gyis rgya gar du log de la 'brel 'dris yod zer nas seng chen sprul sku sogs la nyes chad bcad/ de'i stabs dang sku drag 'ga' zhig gi byed las la brten nas/ bkra shis lhun po'i bla brang gi zhabs 'bring ba rnams dang bod gzhung gi bar du sel zhugs/ chu rta (1882)lo'i zla6tshes 16nyin paṇa chen rin po che bstan pa'i dbang phyug sku mya ngan las 'das/ me khyi (1886)lo'i zla4tshes8nyin srid skyong rta tshag rje drung ho thog thu srid skyong lo bcu gnyis pa'i thog sku 'das/ bstan rgyas gling de mo ho thog thu ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas srid khrir phebs/ lo 'di'i zla 10tshes 14nyin phyi dror 'bras spungs 35/

'jigs byed rang byonash+yas me bzhes/ gsar bzhengs mdzad rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/ lo 'di'i yas mas nas dbyin jis bod la btsan 'dzul gyi 'go tshugag sa byi (1888)lor kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma dge legs rnam rgyal dpal bzang bo thugs brtag gtan khel byung nas rgyal dbang mchog la gtsug phud phul/kong po zho kha khul du dngul lor bzo grwa btsugs nas/lcags stag (1890)lor ṭam dkar bco lnga nyer bzhi dpar ba dang / de'i phyi lor bco lnga nyer lnga 'khod pa'i dngul lor gsar ba par 'debs mdzad/ chu 'brug (1892)lor smon lam chen mor dngul phud sku 'gyed gnang ste/ de nas yongs khyab tu bkram/shing rta (1894)lor rtse skor nas zhabs pad ser skya mang nyung 'dra mtshungs dgos tshul snyan zhu la zhib dpyad gnang ste/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i dus bzhin du bka' blon skya bo gsum dang ser mo gcig bsko gzhag gnang rgyu dang / de yang gzhung don la lhag bsam byas rjes can la gzengs bstod dmigs bsal can ma gtogs gzhan yig rtsis sogs kyi yon tan dang / nyams myong mi gshis dang 'byon stangs/ kun ཿ5lha

spyod legs shing spyi mos drang tshugs che ba sogs la bstun te bsko gzhag byed rgyu las/ sngar lugs bzhin khang pha gzhis rgyud 'dzin lam 'jags gnang rgyu med pa'i rgyas dpyad dngos gtsang gnang ste/ las 'dzin mtho dman bsko gzhag gsar ba gnang / gdan sa gsum gyis gtsos dge 'dun rnams kyi 'dul khrims tshul bzhin dgos tshul las sne rnams la bka' sgyur dang / chos sde so sor dpyad khra sogs stsal/shing lug (1895)lor lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i skabs rgyal dbang mchog gis yongs 'dzin phur rtsog rin po che'i sku drung las dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ shing lug (1895) lo'i zla 8tshes8la lugs gnyis chab sridacikyi bdag por mnga' gsol/ chab srid kyi las 'gan bzhes pa'i thog mar/ rtsa tshig don tshan lnga ba zhig stsalda/ don tshan dang bo gtsug lag khang rnams mi nyams gong 'phel dang / nyams gso byed dgos skor/ gnyis pa/ dge 'dun gyi 'dul khrims dang / khyim pa rnams kyis pha ma dang gla g.yog rgan 'khogs rigs la bsnyen bkur dang / rta khal sogs tshad lasu brgal ba ldid 'gel byed mi chog pa sogs/ gsum pa/ phyi nang zhi drag gi gzhung zhabs rnams kyi byed sgo'i skor/ bzhi ba/ lam 253

thog rdzong gi rta khal mi gsum gtong phyogs la byams yangs gang che'i rgyas bsdus stsal ba dang / lnga ba/ sa stong be+ed med rnams la gsar sbol dang / shing 'dzugs pa sogs dpal 'byor gong spel skor sogs so/ /de mo ho thog thus chab srid kyi las 'gan dgongs zhu gnang / khal kha (hal ha)u cu mu ching wang la 'ja' sa dang tham ga dang cho lo gnang / khal kha'i yul du srid don don gcod du sku bcar mkhan ye shes chos 'phel dang / rtse mgron bstan 'dzin chos grags/ shod drung snang dkar ba dbang phyug mthar phyin bcas bsko gzhag gis byed sgo'i lag 'dzin bcas rdzong bda' gnang / skabs 'dir nyag rong spyi khyab sa mi zhib dpyod drang min byung lugs kyi rtsod gleng thog mar byung /me sprel (1896)lor la dwags me he sprul skur bka' shog dang / tham ga rta dar sogs kyi cho lo gnang / 'di lo nagoganas chung sgra dbyapas gling du tshes bcu'i dus ston btsugs/khams nas gter ston bsod nams rgyal bo gdan drangs/ gter bzhes sku brnyan la mjal bcar dang / gter ston rang nyid kyis gter bzhes rnams gsan bsam dang ljags bsnyen sogs gnang / 254

nyag rong spyi khyab pa dang / lcags la dpon mi drin thu si gnyis ma mthun par/ lcags las khrin tu nas rgya dmag khrid 'ongs nas rgya bod dmag 'khrug langs/ me bya (1897)lor nyag rong dang lcags la'i gyod gzhi thag chod/ rgya dmag 'phral du phyir 'then byas thog byed gte rnams la nyes chad drag po bcad/de'i lo rjes mar nyag rong spyo khyab la dbus mda' dpon dza sag hor khang ba gtong bar mdzad/ sa khyi (1898)lor gdan sa se 'bras dge gsum du rgyal dbang mchog gis grwa skor gnang / sa phag (1899)lor rgyal dbang mchog gis lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i grwa skor mtshan bzhes gnang / lo 'di'i zla3par gnas chung sku rten gyis rgyal dbang la mnan gtad yod tshul gyi lung stsal ba dang / yang zla5bar yang mnan gtad yod tshul gsungs zer/ sngar me sprel lor gnas chung gis mnan gtad yod tshul lung bstan pa ltar/ spyan g.yas gnas srung ra mgo can gyi sku rten gyis pho brang po ta la'i phyogs bzhi nas srog chags gdug sbrul gyi gzugs brnyan g.yo sgul byed pa bton zhes zer gyin 'dug ces grags/sa khyi lor bstan rgyas gling de mo bla brang gi gsol dpon 35bya

tshos 'byor gyis 'ja' lham sna ril zhig rgyal dbang la phul/ nyin gcig khong gis lham de gyon rtsis byas par sna khrag byung bas dogs pa skyes nas/ gter ston bsod rgyal dang / gsol gzim mchod gsum sogs tshang ma yod sar lham de gtedangapas/lham mthil gyi bar nas gshin rje tshe bdag gi srog sngags la sbyar ba'i gtad 'khor zhig thon song zer/ri spel tshig la/ me byi lo ba thub bstan rgya mtsho khug ces bris yod sogs zer/ de'i rkyen gyis srid skyong zur ba de mo ho thog thu shar chen lcog tu bkag bskyil dang / spun mched sogs zhol las khungs su bkag sdom byas te/ de mo tshang rang la 'dri gcod byas par/ kho rgyal sar 'jog dus lo chung stabs/ gzhung zhabs ser skya mi drag mang bos brnyas bcos yang yang byas stabs slar yang chab srid kyi las 'gan thob tu re nas de 'dra byed dgos byung / zhes dngos su khas blangs song zer/ gros khongs su gtogs pa tsha bo nor bu tshe ring dang / dpal chos mkhan po blo bzung don ldan/ las sbyor byed mi mi nyag sprul sku/ nyag sprul gyi dge rgan pad ma tshe ring / dpal ra'i sprul sku/ bla ma lhag bsam pa/ blo bzang chos 'byor/ gsol zur bstan 'dzin dar rgyas/ dpal sprul gyi bu mthu stobs bcas ngo yod rnams la tsha 'jam gyi dri ba byas lha56

pas mnan gtad byas pa ngos len gsal thon byung zer/ khrims thag bcad don/ de mo rgyal zur bstan gling chos rar tshe btson lta bu byas pa dang / slar sprul sku byung rung rgyal zur gyi go sa med pa dang / bla brang gi 'dzin dbang / de mo 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i skabs kyi 'dzin dbang ji yod dang / ban grwa tshang gi mchod gzhis ji yod rang 'jags las/ gzhan tshang ma gzhung bzhes dang / nor bu tshe ring dang / dpal chos blo bzang donasnan gnyis/ rags rgyab btson khang du tshegyubatson byas/ nyag sprul gyis btson khang nang du rang srog bcad/ dpal sprul de'i sngon tsam du 'das/ nyese can gzhan rnams la'ang nyes chad ga cod pa sogs/ lha zhol du khrims thag gcod pa'i tshogs chen 'tshogs pa dang / sa gnas so sor rtsa tshig kyang sbyare ro/ /de mo ho thog thu yang bkag sdom 'og nas 'das song zer/ 'on kyang bstan gling bla brang gi zhabaso 'bring ba kha shas dang / pan tshang grwa rigs kha shas kyis lha sdod ching gong ma'i gzhung tshab am ban brgyud nas rgya gtugs byas mod/ don smin ma byung 'dug phyis su chu byi (1912)lor lha sar rgya bod zing 'khrug byung—skabs bstan gling bla brang gis rgya dang lag 'brel byas stabs bstan glirobla brang ming tsam med par byas pa red 'dug 357

sa byi (1888)lo'i zla 2tshes 11nyin bod kyi sa lung thur zhes par dgra 'gog rdzong zhig yod par bod kyi mtha' srung dmag mi nyung ba zhig yod pa'i thog dbyin ji'i dmag 'bor chen zhig thon te/ bod dmag pham par byas pa ni/ bod la dbyin ji'i drag po'i btsan 'dzul gyi thog ma red/ chu yos (1903)lo'i zla 12tshes 16nyin dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul dmag stong phrag lnga tsam rdza leb la brgyab ste gro mo rin chen sgang dang sna gdong khul du 'byor/ shing 'brug (1904)lo'i zla 2tshes 15nyin snga dro dbyi na dmab/ btsan 'dzul bas dud sne dang / rgu ru'i grong gseb bar bod dmag sa/ srung gi ma/tha' bskor te bod dmag khyon che ba bsad rmas byas/ de nas nyin shas nas dbyin dmag btsan 'dzul ba rnams kyis 'dzam phreng sa'u sgang gnas rnying dgon pa bcas la dmag 'khrug rgyag bzhin spyi zla4tshes 11la rgyal rtser 'byor/ dud sne dang rgyal rtse'i bar du yod pa'i bod dmag phal cher bsad/ lo de'e zla 7tshes 14nyin dbyin dmag rgyal rtse nas sna dkar rtser 'byor/ tshes25nyin gam pa la brgal te lcags zam gru khar zhobyor/ lcags zam gru kha nas lha sar rta lam nyin phyed tsam red/ rgyal dbang rin po che de'i skabs dpal rdo 35byi ri

rje 'jigs byed kyi lo mtshams bcad rgya'i skabs yin kyang glo bur du phebs dgos byung stabs sku mtshams la bar chad byung ste/ shidz+wa'abrug (1904)lo'i zla 6tshes 15nyin rtse pho brang nas chibs bsgyur te rwa sgrong phyogs su phebs/ tshes 19nyin dbyin dmag lha sar 'byor/ de'i skabs grwa ba keb kran kra'i sba'i zer ba dang / kug yung zer ba gnyis glo bur dbyin ji'i dmag sgar du 'dzul te/ btsan 'dzul dmag dpon gnyis la gri btab ste rmas skyon chen po bzos/ grwa ba de gnyis dbyin dmag gis ngan gsod byas shing 'brug (1904)lo'i zla7tshes 17nyin rtse pho brang chen po'i nang bod dbyin zhi ba'i chings yig cig bzhag zla8tshes3nyin dbyin dmag phyir log pa'i mgo brtsams te rim gyis tshang ma phyir logadabyin ji'i dmag lha sar 'byor nye'i skabs rgyal dbang rin po che rwa sgrong du phebs nas bzhugs/ de nas rim gyis phebs te mi rta (1906)lo'i zla8pa'i nang sku 'bum du phebs 'byor byung / sku 'bum du lo gnyis ba zhugs ring sku zhabs zhwa dmar rin po che/ bde yangs rin po che/ mkhas dbang dpal ris rab gsal/ bka' bcu sngags rams pa bshad tsob bstan pa dar 259

rgyas sogs las mdo sngags rig gnas kyi chos bke' mang du gsan/ me lug (1907)lo'i zla 11tshes25nyin ri bo rtse lnga sogs su gnas gzigs ched chibs kha bsgyur/ sa sprel (1908)lo'i zla5bar ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs/ lo de'i zla8tshes 3nyin pe cin du 'byor1 tshes20nyin gong ma kwang zhu dang / yum hong thi'i hu (tshi shis tha'i hu)la mjal 'phrad gnang / zla 9tshes 6nyin rgyal dbang 'khor bcas nan he (lho mtsho)zhes pa'i skyed tshal pho brang du spro gseng gsol ston du gdan zhus thog rtsed rigs zlos gar sna tshogs pa gzigs 'bul zhus/nyin rjes ma nas gong ma dang / gong yum (tshi shis)la sger mjal kha shas dang zhi drag dpon rigs dag tshur bcar gyis bod rgya dbyin gsum gyi srid don sogs la bka' mol dang / sngar srol ltar gyi bka' shog dang / gser gyi glegs bu'i thog nub phyogs kyi snying rje chen po'i skyes bu sangs rgyas/ zhes pa/ yig rigs bzhi shan sbyar gyis brkos bris phul/ phar yang sho lo ka lnga can gyi bstod tshig phul/ 'on kyang de'i skabs ching gong ma'i chab srid nyams rul du 'gro bzhin pa mngon gsal du mthong /sa sprel (1908)lo'i zla 9tshes 18nyin gong ma kwang zhu 'das/ gong yum (tshi shis)gyis rgyal sras tā chin cu yung gi 260

byes phu yi gong mar bsko gzhag byas/ bla de'i tshis20nyin gong yum tha'i hu yang 'das/ lo de'i zla 1 0bar gong ma shon thong (phu yi)khrir 'khod mdzad sgo byas skabs rgyal dbang mchog kyang mdzad sgor zhugs/ 'di skor la/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig dang dpon rigs 'ga' zhig gis dbyin lugs kyi gsar brje byed dgos tshul gong ma kwang zhu la zhus par kwang zhus khas blangs par tshi shis tha'i t+yās ngo rgol byas te gong ma bzang btson du bcug bzi sbrid kyi dug drangs te tshor dbang nyams par byas/ gsar brje'i gros 'don mkhan gyi mkhartswapa 'ga' zhig phyi rgyal du bros/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig dang dpon rigs 'ga' zhig bzung nas bsad pa sogs kyis gsar brje'i bya bar pham nyes byung ba sogs bris 'dugargyal dbang mchog rgya sog gi sdil du lo ngo bzhi lhag la bzhugs skabs phyi rgyul gyi dpon rigs mang bor thug 'phrad bka' mol gyis srid don mi nyung ba re thag bcad pa dang /gsar brje mi byed thabs med kyi thugs dgongs shar na yang /dpon rigs 'ga' zhig nas chos phyogs la gnod zer ba sogs kyis bkag 'gog gis thugs dgongs ji bzhin ma grub/sa sprel (1908)lo de'i zla 10ba'i tshes 18nyin pe cin ri 261

nas zhal bsgyur/ blo 12tshes23nyin sku 'bum byams pa gling du zhabs sor 'khod/ 'di lo sde dge'i sras rgan gzhon gnyis ma mthun par 'khrug zing langs/ sradzes rgan pa a skya'i rgyab la kra'o ar phung langs te sde dger rgya dmag gis dpung 'jug byas/ sras gzhon pa ngag dbang 'jam dpal 'khor bcas sku 'bum du rgyal dbang la srog skyob zhu bar byon/ de nas bzung sras gzhon pa gzhung sa'i zhabs 'bring khongs su ba(nag 'dugs bya (1909)lo'i lo gas ra ba'i dga' ston dang smon lam mdzad sgo sogs sku 'bum rang nas mdzad/ zla4ba'i nang bya khyung sogs su gnas gzigs dang chos 'brel gnang / lo snga mar sku 'bum dgon gyi chos khrims la dag ther gnang ste las sde 'ga' re gnas dbyung byas pa sogs kyi rkyen las 'ga' zhig gis lkog tu gros byas ngo rgol byed rtsis byas na'ang zi ling gi rgya dpon bcas kyi rgyab skyor 'og zing cha cher ma byung / gle4tshes 18nyin sku 'bum nas btegs/ zla 8tshes 2nyin natha/ chur 'byor/kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma sogs phebs bsur 'byor/zla 11tshes9nyin pho brang chen po gle ta lar 'byor/ de skabs zi khron nas khrims srung rgya dmag 'dzugs rgyu yin zer 262

nas/ lu'u cun rgya dmag khri phrag brgal ba mdo stod brgyud mi gsod rgyu 'phrog dgon sde sogs gtor bzhin du yong ba lha sar slebs nyer yod pas dza drag gi ngang du gnas yod/tsholcags khyi (1910)lo'i zla 1tshes3nyin rgya dmag gi rta dmag rnams lha sar slebs/ de'i nub mor rgyal dbang 'khor bcas bros byol mi byed mthu med byung / rgya dmag gis ra mda' rjes 'ded byas cikyang ma zin par rgya gar du slebs/ lo 'di'i dgun thog rgyal dbang rin po che 'khor bcas rgya bal gyi gnas rten khag la gnas gzigs su phebs/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi nang ba'i mchod rten khag dang / sangs rgyas sku 'khrungs pa'i gnas bal yul gyi mnga' khongs su lum+bi ni dang / sangs rgyas pa'i gnas rdo rje gdan sogs su gnas mjal du phebs/lcags phag (1911)lo'i zla 9ba nas rgya'i dpon dmag nang tshags 'khrug zing gsod res yang yang byed pa dang / rgya nag pe cin du sun krong hran gyi gsar brje byung ste shon thong khri las phab pa'i gsar 'gyur thon byung stabs ko lo'e hu'i khongs gtogs kyi rgya dmag rnams kyis man ching dpon rigs tshor ngo log brgyab/ kra'o ar phung gi las khungs lte ba chab mdor brgyub yod kyang 'dug ma bzod par khyin tur phyin/ de'i phyi lo 363

kho rang khrin tu nas bsad/ bod kyi sa gnas so so nas rgya dmag la rgyab rten med par shes nas ngo rgol dang dpung 'jug byas/rgya dmag rnams kyang rgya yul du 'gro 'dod skyes te bod gzhung la lam dngul sogs dgos zer ba ltar bod gzhung gis lam gyi mi ser la brdab gsig mi 'byung ched dngul srang chig 'bum brgyad khri byin/ dngul lag tu 'byor mtshams nga rgyal skyes te 'gro rgyu phar zad bcom 'phrog byed rgyu'i gros ngan byas te/ chu byi (1912)lo'i zla 2tshes5la se rar dpung 'jug byas nas nyin gsum la gtugs kyang se rar 'dzul ma thub/ se ra'i mtha' skor gyi ritsho khrod dang dgon chung rnams la me btang nas bsregs/ dmag rnams se ra nas 'then te lha sar 'dzul/ rgya bod kyi dmag gi g.yul 'gyed drag po zla ngo kha shas la brgyab/ sa ga zla ba'i nang du grwa ba kha shas dang / bod dmag kha shas rtse pho brang nang du bka'ari shag gi tshogs 'du 'tshogs yod pa'i thog tu brgyugs nas bka' blon rnams bzung / rtse zhol du khrid nas/ tsha rong ba dbang phyug rgyal bo dang / tsha rong sras/ bka' drung tsha gur zhag pa/ mkhan drung phun rab pa/ bla phyag mkhan chung bsam mkhar ba/ rtse drung blo bzang rdo rje rnams la me mda' brgyab nas bsad/ bka' tshab bla ma bstan 'dzin chos grags/ bka' 264

tshab ram pa ba/ glang gdong ba bcas kyang re zhig zhol lagakhungs su bzang btson byas nas bzhag pa red zer/ 'di dag gis rgya mi dang 'brel ba byas pa red zer nas bsad pa dang / btson 'jug byas pa red zer 'dug zhib cha sus shes/dus de tsam na yon hri khe'i srid gzhung gis lha sar sdod pa'i man ching am ban lin yu 'phral du phyir log dgos pa dang /dmag dpon cung yun gyis am ban gyi las 'gan sngar ltar 'khur dgos pa sogs kyi bka' phab/ rgya dmag rnams la dmag snon dang dmag rgyags sogs med par dka' tshegs ha cang che stabs phyir logagyi'adod che ba byung / rgya'i zhi drag dpon rigs rnams kyis bod dmag lomago sgur/ mgo btags chings yig bzhag mthar chu byi (1912)lo'i zla 12tshes5la rgya dmag yongs rdzogs 'gro dgos byung ba red/ bstan rgyas gling bla brang gis rgya dmag dang lag 'brel byas par brten/ bla brang dang ban grwa tshang bcas gtan med byas pa red/ lo 'khor gcig la dmag 'khrug brgyab stabs lha sa grong khyer sum cha gcig tsam gtor bshigs byas pa sogs skyone chen po byung / chu byi (1912)lo'i zla 12tshes 16nyin rgyal dbang rin po che rtse pho brang chen por phebs 'byor byung / de ltar lo ngo gsum lha65

yas mas shig la rgya gar sogs su phebs gemathar slar gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod rgyu byung ngo / / lha sar phebs nas 'phral du rtsa tshig cig bsgrigs nas/ chu glang (1913)lo'i zla 1tshes 8nyin sbyar 'grem gnang ba dang 'brel/ gzhung zhabs go gnas sogs bskyar 'dems dang tshar gcod rjes 'dzin skabs su gang bab gnang zhing shog lor gsar ba bzo 'grem byas/ chu glang (1913) lo nas yig skyel sprag zam gsar ba btsugs/ gzhung zhabs kyi phru gu bzhi ing lan rag sba'i zhes pa'i slob grwar slob sbyong du btang / de ni dga' ldan pho brang ba'i skabs bod mi phyi rgyal du slob sbyong la 'gro mi dang bo red/ sgog mkhar ba bsod nams mgon po dmag las slob sbyong la 'jar man du mngags/ chu glog gsar 'dzugs gnang ste/ grwa bzhi thang du me mda'i bzo grwa/ dngul par khang /shog dngul par 'debs khang sogs btsugs/ lha sa'i dar 'phrin las khungs yang yar rgyas btang / shing stag (1914)lo rgya bod dbyin gsum gyis chings yig bzhag shing yos (1915)lor dmag dpon dang dmag gi 'god sgrig gnang / lo 'di'i yas mas su paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi nyi ma mchog nas bkra shis lhun por gser t+ta66

zangs las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan 'dzam gling du sngar byung ma myong ba'i chen po gcig bzhengs/me 'brug (1916)lor dmag sbyong dang dmag dpung lam lugs gsar ba gsar 'dzugs byas/ de mtshungs mi drug tsam zhig rgya gar du dmag 'thab lag rtsal sbyong du mngags/bstan rgyas gling gi nye 'gram du sman rtsis rig gnas khang gsar —skrun gnang / se ra sman sbyin mkhyen rab nor bur sman rtsis mkhan chung du bsko gzhag gnang ngo / /de lo nas mdo khams stod du bod dmag dang rgya dmag gi g.yul 'gyed thengs du mar byas/mthar gyod bshad de chings yig bzhag bal yul mchod rten rnam gsum zhig gso mdzad/ lcags sprel (1920)lor bu ston gsung 'bum dang /rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi par bskrun rgyu'i 'go bzung /bka' 'gyur rin po che'i par shing bzhugs yul rtse pho brang chen po'i zhol du gtsug lag rten gtso byams sku chen po bcas lo 'khor bzhi'i ring la legs par grub/ rigazhung sa'i dpon rigs dag gis byed las sna tshogs la brten/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma ston 'khor bcas/ chu phag (1 923)lo'i zla 11tshes 15la bkra — 267

shis lhun po nas chas te sog yul brgyu da rgya nag tu phebs pa dang / sog yul dang mdo khams rnams su 'gro don rgya chen po gnang / — chu phag (1spre23)lor rgyal rtser dbyin yig gi slob grwa gsar 'dzugs gnang ste lo gsum tsam song rjes/ gdan sa gsum gyi slob dpon las snes dbyin yig gi slob grwa btsugs na mi 'grig tshul shugs chen pos zhus pa ltar slob grwa phyir 'then mi byed mthu med byung / shing bya (1945)lor lha ldan drung spyi'i gling khar slob grwa gsar 'dzugs kyis/ dbyin yig dang bod yig slob pa'i slob grwa btsugs mod/ 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul mi shes pa dag gis chos lugs la gnod ces ngo rgol byas rkyen slob grwa phyir bsdu gnang ste/ bu phrug skya ser 'ga' zhig bod gzhung gis 'gro song btang nas rdo rje gling gi san jo seb ces pa'i slob grwar gtong gnang mdzad/ skabs de dus shig nas deng rabs kyi dmag sbyong dang dmag sgrig sogs la ched gnyer mdzad/ shing byi (1924)lor lha zhol grong khyer nang khrims srung dmag mi gsar 'dzugs gnang ste/ 'phrod bsten gtsang spra dang / rkun jag bde 'jags sogs la lta rtog byas pas phan pa chen po byung / me stag (1926) lor phag ri nas rgyal rtse bar rlangs 268

'khor 'gro lam bzos te rlangs 'khor bzhi tsam slebs pas/ mi ser sogs nas phyugs zog rta drel sogs 'drogs nas brdabs chag dang bor stor byung 'dug rlangs 'khor phyir 'then byed rogs zhes nan zhus byas pa ltar rlangs 'khor phyir 'then mi byed mthu med byung / sa 'brug (1928)lo nas lha sa dang grwa bzhi glog 'phrul khang sogs su phebs skabs rlangs 'khor che chung bzhi tsam bed spyad de rim gyis bod mi'i mig lam du 'dris cha byung mtshams rgya khyab tu spel rgyu'i thugs dgongs gnang / lcags lug (1931)lo nas grwa bzhi glog 'phrul khang gsar 'dzugs gnang ste/ zangs dang dngul gyi ṭam kha dang shog dngul tshon khra ma sogs par 'debs dang / me mda'/ rdzas mdel sogs bzo skrun gyi grwa rgya che btsugs shing / sa sbrul (1929) lo yas mas su sa 'du tshang dang be ri dpon ma mthun par dmag 'khrug langs nas be ri dpon gyis rgya dmag khrid 'ongs nas rgya bod dmag gi 'khrug zing langs te/ bod dmag re zhig rgyal/ lcags lug (1931)lor slar yang zi khron rgya dmag slebs te bod dmag gis ma thub par hor brag mgo rgya lag tu shor/ rgya dmag gis dar rgyas dgon pa rtsa gtor btang / hor khog dang / nyag rong gnyis ka sa shoraḥ69

te bod dmag la pham nyes che ba byung stabs chu sprel lo'i zla2pa'i nang chings mi rgyag mthu med byung / skabs de dang dus mtshungs su zi ling nas mā pi h+phang gi dmag nang chen sa khul du 'byor te bod dmag dang 'thab rtsod byas pas thog mar bod dmag rgyal ba 'dra yang phyis su bod dmag pham nas phyir 'then byed dgos byung / chu sprel (1932) lo de'i zla3pa'i nang ldan khog tu zi khron rgya dmag slebs nas/ bod dmag la pham nyes byung ste phyir 'then byas/ lo 'dir lho byang gnyis ka nas bod dmag la pham nyes byung /chu bya (1933)lo'i zla 2tshes 22nyin spre tsha dgon du zi ling gi mā pi h+phang gi srid tshab dang chings yig bzhagachu sprel (1932)lor gnas chung chos skyong chen po'i lung bstan bzhin brtan bzhugs phul ba'i gsung lan rnam thar du 'dug chu bya (1933)lo'i zla 1bo'i nang yang srid bka' lhan rgyas kyis zhu ba phul ba'i gsung lan la bltas na/ de'i dus chab srid 'gan 'khur ba dag gis thugs bzhed dang mthun pa zhig byed kyin med 'dug lo de'i zla ba bcu ba'i tshes shar nas sku snyun bzhes pa rim gyis je lcir song ste/ zla ba bcu ba'i tshes sum cu'i nyin gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim mo/ /lha70

sdi ma thag snyog gra langs te/ sku bcar kun 'ashāl lags kyis rgyal dbang sku bsnyun pa gsang rgya byas nas/ gzhung zhabs la ma bshad zer ba sogs kyi nag nyes btsal nas/ sku bcar kun 'phel dang / bkra shis don 'grub/ em chi byams pa/gnas chung sku rten sogs gnas dbyung byas pa sogs chab srid nyamasatrergud kyi rtags mtshan mngon du gyur 'dug go / /rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa chen po gshegs nas zla ba gnyis tsam la srid bka' lhan rgyas nas gzhung don bsgrubs/ de nas srid 'dzin rgyal tshab cig dgos tshul gros bsdur byas te/ dga' ldan khri ba las thog pa mi nyag a mi ye shes dbang ldan dngar+sha / ra sgreng ho thog thu 'jam dpal ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ phur lcog yongs 'dzin sprul sku thub bstan byams pa tshul khrims gsumartso gyi mtshan shog zan ril bsgril nas rtse 'phags mchog lo ke shwa ra'i spyan sngar srid bka'/ drung rtsis/ tshogs 'thus bcas pa'i dbus su dga' ldan khri zur byams pa chos grags sang gis thugs smon bden tshig brjod bzhin zan rtags bsgril bas rwa sgreng ho thog thu thon pa ltar shing khyi (1934)lo'i zla 1tshes 10nyin rgyal tshab kyi khrir phebs/ de nas ring bo ma song bar rtsis dpon lung shar gyis 'go khrid pa'i gzhung zhabs mang bo zhig zur 271

'tshogs byed pa'i gnas tshul thon/ lung shar de ni phyi rgyal du 'dug myong bsdo yar thon rgyal khab kyi lam lugs mthong stabs/gsar brje'i bcos bsgyur byed rgyu byas pa red zer srol 'dugagang ltar rtsis dponarkalung shar sogs 'dzin bzung dang / lung shar gyi mig bton/ ga zhan dag gnas dbyung sogs kyi khrims bcad/ rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i gser gdung rin po che thog tshad lnga yod pa lo 'khor gnyis la legs par grub /rgyal dbang bcu gsum pas spom mda' stobs rgyal la rmar — khams khul gyi yul dmag gi ru dpon du bsko gzhag gnang ste sa mtshams su yod par/ rgyal dbang gshegs rjes sku bcar kun 'phel do dam thog rgyang 'phud btang tshul thos 'phral ma dga' bar shing khyi (1934) lo'i zla 10nang kho rang gi 'og la yod pa'i yul dmag rnams khrid de rmar khams sa srung cha dang mda' dpon nor rgyas nang ba'i dmag sgar thog mtshan 'gebs ngo log byas te brgya dpon dang / dmag mi kha shas rmas skyon dang / spyi sger gyi rgyu dngos dang mtshon cha sogs sbogs/ ru dpon stobs rgyal dang / spun rgan pa rab dga' gnyis kyis khams phyogs tshang ma bod gzhung 'og nas 'bud dgos pa'i yi ge bkram mod don 'bras smin khom ma byung 'dug la/ chab mdo nas bod dmag 272

thon skabs 'ba' phyogs su bros/ de skabs 'ba' phyogs de rgya lag tu yod stabs bod dmag der 'gro thabs bral/ rgyal dbang bcu bzhi ba rtsad gcod ched/ shing phag (1935)lo'i zla5nang rgyal tshab rmorwa sgrong ho thog thu sogs lha mo'i bla mtshor gzigs zhib la phebs/ mtsho nang nas dbu can gyi yi ge a dang / ka ma zhes dang / dgon pa thog sa sum rtseg bar thog g.yu rtsi can gyi yang steng gser zangs kyi rgya phibs yod pa/ dgon pa de'i shar phyogs 'gro lam skya thal le ri chung zhig gi rtsar thug pa/ de'i thad khang ba thog gcig ma thog sngon po byas pa gcig shar 'dug gsungs/ shing phag (1935)lor bod gzhung gi gtso bo dag gis gros bsdur gyis paṇa chen rin po che rgya yul du bzhugs pa gdan 'dren zhus pa yin mod/ go min tang srid gzhung gis paṇa chen rin po che bod yul du phebs tshe phebs skyel du rgya dpon che ba kha shas dang / sku srung dmag mi lnga brgya bcas gtong rgyu yin tshul dang / paṇa chen rin po cher nub phyogs kyi yon tan khyad par can gyi mnga' bdag ces pa'i mtshan gsol ba sogs bod gzhung gis khas ma blangs pa sogs 'gal rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis paṇa chen rin po che bod du phebs rgyur 'gyangs 'gor byung zhing /273
