mi glang (1937)lo'i zla 10tshes28la paṇa chen rin po che skye dgu mdo'i don 'grub gling zhes pa'i dgon par sku mya ngan las 'das so/ /de skabs nyi hong (ri pin) gis rgya yul du btsan 'dzul byed sgang yin pas paṇa chen sku gdung rin po che hor khog tu gdan drangs nas dkar mdzes dgon du bzhugs/ sa stag (1938)lor li'u wun hus dang / paṇa chen zhabs 'bring ba rnams ma mthun par zing 'khrug langs te sku chas rnams rgya dmag gi lag tu shor yang / sku gdung rin po che gdan sa bkra shis lhun por gdan 'dren thub pa byung / sa stag (1938)lo'i zla2tshes30nyin srid 'dzin rwa spreng ba'i thugs dgongs ltar srid blon glang mdun zur bzhugs byas te/ rwa sgrong gis sride dbang yongs rdzogs bzung / —rgyal dbang sku sbeng bcu bzhi ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/rgyal dbang bcu bzhi ba ni/ sku 'bum byams pa gling gi nye 'dabs stag 'tsher zhes pa'i sde ba'i nang du yab chos skyong tshe ring dang yum bsod nams mtsho gnyis la rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing phag (1935)lo'i zla5tshes5la sku 'khrungs/ mtshan lha mo don 'grub zer/ 'di ba lha mo mtsho gzigs kyi lung bstan dang / chos skyong dang / paṇa chen rin po ches kyang thugs dgongs 274

yod pa dang / ke tshang sprul sku sogs kyis brtag dpyad sogs gang cha nas ngos 'dzin 'khrul med byung zer/ de nas bod ljongs su gdan 'dren zhu skabs 'khrungs yul mā pi h+phang gi 'og tu yod gshis/ mā pi h+phang la blu yon dngul sgor 'bum bzhi snga rjes su sprad nas gdan drangs te/ sa yos (1939)lo'i zla8tshes25nyin nor gling bskal bzang pho brang du zhabs sor 'khod/ zla 10tshes 13nyin gtsug lag khang du rwa sgreng ho thog thus gtsug phud bzhes te mtshan rje btsun 'jam dpal ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho srid gsum dbang bsgyur mtshungs pa med pa'i sde dpal bzang bo zhes mtshan gsol/ lcags 'brug (1940)lo'i zla 1tshes 13nyin pho brang po ta la'i khrir phebs/khrir phebs kyi mdzad sgo lugs srol bzhin mdzad/ lcags 'brug (1940)lo'i zla 12nang rgyal tshab rwa sgrong gis las 'khur dgongs zhu gnang / lcags sbrul (1941)lo'i zla 1tshes 1nyin yongs 'dzin stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab mthu stobs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid skyong gi khrir phebs/ chu rta (1942)lo'i zla 1tshes 10nyin lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi mdun du rgyal dbang gis srid spyong stag brag gi drung nas rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes / 275

shing bya (1945)lor 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa a ri dang dbyin ji mthun phyogs dang bcas par rgyal kha thob par/a ri dang / dbyin ji dang / go min tang srid gzhung rnams la rgyal kha thob par dga' ston zhu mi dza sag thub bstan bsam k+kophel sogasacimangags/spyi sger gyi bun skyed shin tu lci bas mi ser rnams ni bya rgan sgro zad du gyur te 'tsho thabs bral ba 'i skabs su shing sprel (1944)lor bod gzhung tshogs 'du nas mi ser la brdab gsig de 'dra byed mi chog pa sogs kyi bka' rgya bkram/ shing bya (1945)lo'i ston dus 'phan po lhun 'grub rdzong du ser byas grwa tshang dang / sngags pa grwa tshang gi 'bru len rnams kyis snga dus bzhin gyi skyed kha chen po len pa mi ser rnams kyis bod gzhung gi bka' gsar ltar las ma sprad par lhun 'grub rdzong dpon la gtug bsher byas pas rdzong dpon gyis bka' gsar ltar byed dgos zhes mi ser gyi rgyab rtsa byas stabs 'bru gnyer rnams kyis rdzong dpon nyes rdung btang ste bsad/ byed gte rnams la nyes chad bcad par/ ser byas sngags gnyis kyis de dag gi rgyab rtsa byas pa sogs kyis zing cha byung zer/ lo de'i zla dgu bar lha klu tshe dbang rdo rje la rdzong rgyab tu lkog mda' 'phangs te rta bsad zer/276

tshome phag (1947) lo'i smon lam skabs srid skyong stag brag tshang la 'bul rgyu'i sgam chung zhig gi nang nas 'gad mdel zhig bkad de srid gzhung la snyan zhu phul bar brten/ bka' blon zur khang dang / lha klu gnyis kyi dmag brgya skor zhig khrid nas ra sgyeng dgon nas 6la zur rwa phreng ho thog thu 'khor bcas bzung ste rtser khrid song zer/ rwa sgrong gis go min tang la'ang lag 'brel byas te srid skyong stag brag khri las 'phen thabs byas song yang zer/ gang ltar de nyin rwa sgrong bla brang dang / yab gzhis phun tshogs khang gsar dang / sa 'du tshang rnams la sgo rgya byas song zer/ ser byas sngags ba/nyis kyi mkhan po snga yoganyis tsha len byas te gsar bzhag byas yod stabs/ tshes 25nyin ser byas mkhan po gsar —ba blo bzang bstan dar ngo g.yog bzhi ser byas yi ba kha shas kyis bsad zer/ tshes 27nyin rgyal zur rwa sgyeng dang / mkhar rdo sprul sku/ sgyung gnas bla ma blo bzang ye shes rnam rgyal/ rwa sgrong sku tsha dza sag sogs la 'dri gcod byas par 6la zur tshang nas/ lhang mkhar dza gsum gyis snga rjes su srid skyong la lkog ngan byed rgyu'i skul ma btang ba/ rgyal zur tshang gis de ltar byed mi nyan gsungs par ma zad kha ta go bskon byas pa'i yi ge phar tshur bskur ba rnams sgyung gnas bla ma'i sgo chung nang 377

nas thon te/ rgyal zur tshang nas khas len dngos gtsang gnang ba dang / khong la nyes nag med 'dug zer gyin 'dug zer/ lha klu lkog gsod du mi mngag mkhan kho yin zhes mkhar rdo sprul skus khas blangs pa dang / lag 'bom yod pa'i sgam de 'bul mkhan kho yin/ zhes sgyung gnas bla mas khas blangs song zer/ zla3tshes 28nyin rgyal zur rwa sgreng bkag sdom khang nas sku 'das song zer/ se ras rgyal zur tshang gyi phyogs zung ste sde gzhung la ngo rgol byas stabs/ se rar dmag 'jug byas te gte bo 'ga' zhig 'dzin bzung byas zer/ rwa sgrong dgon du srung dmag bcu bdun bzhag yod pa/ rwa sgrong rgyal zurañtsatshang gi zhabs gras rnams kyis tshang ma bsad 'dug zer/sa glang (1949)lo'i zla 10tshes 1nyin krung go gung khran tang gis rgyal yongs la dbang bsgyur ba yongs bsgrags byas/ sa stag (1950)lo'i zla 11tshes 11nyin rgyal dbang ston 'khor rnams gro mor phebs bskyod byas/ lcags yos (1951)lo'i zla5tshes23nyin pe cin du bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gyi chings yig don tshan bcu bdun bkod do/ / 278

le'u gnyis pa/ mdo smad kyi lo rgyus bye brag tu bshad pa/ spyizhi gnaska sum̐lu sned‘bu/gangs ri'i mdangs la pad ma'i rgyajo gyis sprasarī/ /rgyud lnga'i 'gro la brtse ba'i 'dren byed dh+yāg / thugs bskyed sa bon las grub ljon pa'i 'bras/ /bsil ljongs 'gro ba'i dpal gyur de yis skyorings/ /bsil ldan srid 'dzin mu tig phreng ba'i dpal/ri / (rab tu 'bar ba'i byung ba me na kā'i/ /— mdzes zhal ra ri'i dri mas ma sbags par/ /ston la gzur gnas mkhas pas dgyes dgur rol/ /'dir mdo smad yul ljongs chen po'i bod mi'i byung tshul dang chags tshul gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus shig brjod par bya'o/ /gna' ches shin tu snga mo nas/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum/bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug gi sa chen 279

po 'dir/ spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa'i mi rgyud bod mi rus chen bzhis rim gyis khyab par gyur nas/ yun ring bo 'gor rjes/ rgyal phran bcu gnyis dang / sal ma mi zhi bcu la sogs par gyur pa'i skabs shig sdod spyi'i rgyal bo'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan pos gangs can gyi bo da rus chen bzhi sogs gcig gyur byas te dbang bsgyur babyusogs gong du brjod zin la/ de yang dbus gtsang la bod dang / stod mnga' ris nas smad mdo khams kyi bar la bod chespyo po zer/ smad mdo khams la mdo stod dang mdo smad gnyis byas pa'i mdo smad la a mdo zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mdo smad chos 'byung las/ ‘‘'bri chu'i se bo'i lung ring brgal ba'i ba yan ha ri'i shar ngos a chen gangs rgyab kyi ri dang / mdo la gnyis kyi ming bsdoms pas de ma/na chad la a mdo zer/ de ngos kyi chu rnams phyogs 'dres kyi rma g.yang rgyug mo'i gzhung du 'bab pa la rma chur grags pa mtsho solo ma'am skya rengs kyi gzhung brgyud lho phyogs su 'asgog pa'i khug tshoso man chad a mdo nyid la ngos 'dzin dgos cipa ni/ chol kha gsum dubyuphyetse/ mnga' ris gung thang nas sog la skya bo yan chad dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ de nas rma chu'i khug pa yan mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ de nas rgya'i mchod rten dkar bo yan mdo smad rta'i chol khar byed 280

pas shes so/ /smo’zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'di la'ang phyis kyi rtog bzo mkhan 'ga' zhig gis rtog bzo byas pa yod mod tsho spyang / don la 'di ltar yin no/ /mdo smad 'dir yang bod rgyal dag gi mnga' 'bangs bod mis khyab nas rim gyis dar zhing rgyas pa'i skabs su/ shar phyogs kyi rgyal bo dag gis nub phyogs su rgya bskyed pa dang / khyad par thang gi rgyal bo u te sogs kyi skabs mdo smad kyi sa sne dag tu dmag 'bor tshen btang ste/ bod mi dag gsod 'ded byas nas/ spu'u zer ba'i dmag gi gzhi sa brgya lhag btsugs/ mkhar du ma brtsigs te re zhig gzhis chags/ bod kyi gtam dpe la rgya zhag gcig 'dug sar mkhar brtsigs zhes zer/ de rjes srong btsan gyi skabs bod dmag 'bum phrag du ma mngags te/ thang dmag rang yul du bskrad nas so mtshams srung ba'i dmag ches mang bo bzhag mdo khams nags dang na'i ljongs de bod rang gi lag tu thob ste/ bod kyi btsan po dag gis dbang bsgyur/ de rjes glang dar ma'i byed spyod ngan pa'i stabs kyis/ 'bangs gyen log byung ste bod sil bur thor mod/ stod mnga' ris su glab dar gyi sras rtsod med gnam lde 'od srung gi rgyal rgyud rnams kyis rgyal po byas te rgya bal gyi sa mtshams srung zhing / chos dang rig gnas sogs dar bar byas 281

pa'i phyag rjes shin tu rlabs che ba yin rna/ / dad sdo/ nado snad nu zho rgyuska lug tsod ṣizhi nulu sdozhi sken/ mdo smad tsong kha'i yul du/ bod kyi rgyal rgyud tsong kha'i rgyal bo zer ba'i rgyal bo stobs ldan zhig byung nas/ da lta'i zi ling mkhar du rgyal sa bzung ste mtha' mtshams—brtan por srung / 'di ba bod kyi rgyal rgyud yin pa/ sung gi lo rgyus sogs rgya'i yig deb rnams gcig mthun yin zhing / mtshan la'ang jo sras sam rgyal sras zhes zer/ 'di'i rgyud pa ni bod kyi rgyal rgyud cig yin zer ba las/ byung tshul la rgya'i deb ther la lar shin cang nas bod kyi rgyal bo'i rgyud pa'i sras shig spyan drangs pa yin zer ba dang /yang 'ga' zhig gis yar lung jo bo'i rgyud pa zhig yin zer ba'ang snang mod/ phyi ma 'di ni rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long las/ yum brtan gyi rgyud pa yar lung du chags pa yar lung jo bor grags pa rnams kyi rgyud rabs bshad pa'i skabs su/ ‘‘nyi ma mgon gyi sras nyi 'od dpal mgon/ 'di'i brgyud rlung shod/'phan yul/ mdo khams na mang ngo’ zhes gsungs pa tsam la brten par snang / snga ma ni shin cang zer mod/ stod mnga' ris dang shin cang khad nye zhing / shin cang yang bar skabs shig tu 282 tre

bo da kyi chab 'og tu gtogs pas/ mnga' ris dang shin cang khyad ma phye bar 'dra ste/ rgyal sras 'di ni stod mnga' ris phyogs nas 'ongs pa yin te/ glang dar gyi sras rtsod med gnam lde 'od srung gi sras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/ de la sras khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dang / skyid lde nyi ma mgon gnyis/ khri bkra shis brtsegs pa la sras dpal lde/ 'od lde/ skyid lde gsum/ 'bring bo 'od lde la sras pha ba lde/ khri lde/ khri chung / nyag pa bzhi yod pa'i gnyis pa khri lde ni mdo khams su byon pa de yin par gsal/deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs las‘‘gnyis pa mdo smad tsong khar yod cing ’’zhes dang / deb ther dmar bo gsar ma las ‘‘sras gnyis pa khri lde'i rgyud ni/ shar tsong kha sogs mdo smad du chad de/ da lta'i lha don po che sa yang khri lde'i rgyud du me long mar bshad’’ces dang / deb ther dmar bo las‘‘khri sde'i brgyud shar tsong kha'i rgyal bo spyan snga don chen la sogs pa mdo smad kyi rgyal rgyud rnams yin no zhes dang / rgya bod yig tshang las‘‘shar tsong kha'i rgyal bo/ spyan snga don chen pa la sogs pa mdo smad kyi rgyal rgyud rnams yin no’’zhes dang / thu'u bkwan rnam thar las‘‘bra'i sde che ba zhig dbus nas mdo smad du chad pa la bra sde zhes 'bod pa phyis su zur nyams nas bra snyi zhos grags pa yin no/ /dbus nas lha83

chad tshul ni/ khri srong gi sras chung ba sad na legs mjing yon/de'i sras dar oṃ/ de'i srasahoganam lde 'od srung / de'i sras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/ de'i sras khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal/ de'i sras 'od lde la sras bzhi byung ba'i gnyis pa khri lde 'bangs ha ceng mi mang tsam dang bcas maṭasmad du byon/ de duspobra sde'ang rgyal bo dang lhan du mdo smad du thon cing / mtsho khri shog rgyal mo'i 'gram bod kyis bzung ste/ chos rgyal gdung rgyud des khri dpon mdzad cing / bra nyang btsan bya bas rgyal bo'i blon gyi gtso bo byas tshul/ rus mdzod za 'og ma las byung / rus mdzod der chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud phyi ma ji ltar byung tshul mi gsal zhing / bra sde'i rgyud pa byung tshul no jo bo dze bod du ma byon pa'i gong tsam du bra sgosachos kyi rdo rje sku 'khrungs/ 'di mtsho snying ma hā de war byon nas zhu ba pa mdzad pas mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul thob’’ces dang / ‘‘de dus mtsho 'gram gyi bod sde'i dpon ke khod rgya bya ba yin la/ 'di chos rgyal gyi rgyud pa yin min gsal kha mi 'dug ces dang / ‘‘de sa khri dpon ke khod rgya dga' nas/ bra sgom la rta stong / ri tshil dkar gyis gtsos pa'i 'bul phul te bla mar bkur/ bod 'bangs thams cad kyis bra sgom kho na bla mar bkur dgos pa'i dril bsgrags’mizhes dang / ‘‘ skabs shig 284

bra sdi'i tshe phyug 'phan bya ba zhig bod kyi khri dpon la dab nga bsgyur/ mi rabs kha shas kyi mtshams na sa khri dpon gyi mnga' thung nyams pas/ tshe phyug 'phan gyi rgyud pa gle gshin bon dadzar bya ba bon lugs kyi grub thob cig byung ba des bras sdes gtsos pa'i bod 'bangs mi nyung tsam khrid nas mdo smad kyi mtha' ri brag nags tshal yod pa'i gnas bzung zhes gsungs/mdo smad chos 'byung deb ther k+ṣiṃmatshorilas/ ‘‘khro bkra shis brtsegs pa'i sras 'od lde la sras bzhi byung ba'i gnyis pa khri lde mdo khams su phebs nas/ mtsho sngon 'dir gzhi bathung ste khri dpon mdzad/ tsong kha yul chen bco brgyad sogs mdo smad phal cher la mnga' mdzad pa'i rgyud du spyan snga don chen pa sogs byung bar bshad la/ da dung yang khri dpon de'i rgyud pa dpal ris phyogs su yod pa la/ 'phan yul rang skad ma nyams pas khri dpon du 'bod pa yod snang / 7zhes gsungs so/ /des na khri lde tsong kha'i rgyal bor gyur nas sothotshams brtan srung byas pa'i lag rjes che/ win then krin zer bas bris pa'i rgya yig gi lo rgyus nang du‘‘tshospyi lo 1 048nas 1089lo'i bar rgya bod gnyis lan gru phyogs su 'khrugs nas bod mi khriphurgyag tsam —bsad/ rgya'i dmag dpon rang nyid kyang dmag thog tu bkrongs7ri 285

zhes pa'ang chitsong kha'i rgyal bo dang 'thab pa yin nges te/rī spyi lo dang sbrags pa de yang dag pa yin na rab byung dang bo'i sa pho byi — ba'i lo nas/ rab byung gnyis pa'i sa mo sbrul gyi bar khel yod/ de dus dbus gtsang sil bur thor te/ lung ba re la sde dpon re/sde dpon re la btsan rdzong re/ rang sde srung ba'i dmag nyung shas re bsgrigs nas yod pa'i skabs red/ tsong kha'i rgyal bo 'dis kan su'u dang hra'an zhi'i sa cha 'ga' zhig bcas la dbang bsgyur/shar phyogs kyi rgya dang byang phyogs kyi mi nyag la'ang g.yul 'gyed du ma byas/mi nyag ni spyir bod yin te/ mi nyag dang / 'brug pa rgyal bo gnyis/ bod rgyal gyi spun gnyis so sor khams kyi rgyal bo byas pa yin par/ 'brug pa'i lo rgyus 'ga' dang / rgya bod yig tshang nang du'ang bshad yod/ mi nyag ces pa mi nag ces sgra 'gyur ba yin par bshad/ tsong kha'i rgyal bo dang mi nyag rgyal bos sa khongs 'phrog res dang / so so'i dar rgud kyi dbang gis sa mtshams mtha' gcig tu ngos zin dka' yang mdo smad chos 'byung las/ ‘‘phyi ma 'dis (bal bo'i bla ma pham mthing ba)mi nyag rgyal bo la dbang bskur ba'i bla ma gnang / de'i dus mi nyag gi yul ni/ byang gi bod sog gi mtshams chu nag dang nye ba'i sar mi nyag 286

gyil bo'i thog ma si hu'i ga'i ju zhis pa byung ste rgya hor phal sprer gyi r+pādag po byas/ shar na rgya nag lho na 'jang (tsherītshe) / nub na bod/ byang hor gyis bcad pa'i dbus ni mi nyag gi rgyal khams te’ zhes dang / yang de las‘‘snya dang byang ngos sogs ni yul gyi dngos gzhi yin la/ rab stod tshar sgang gi sa rnams kyang mi nyag la gtogs zhes bshad/ mi nyag rgyal rabs lnga ba the hus karma dus gsum mkhyen pa gdan 'dren zhus pa ma phebs par dge bshes gtsang bo sku tshab tu btang / de'i sras mi nyag rgyal rgod yin par grags ’zhes gsungs/ mi nyag gha zhes 'bod pa'i snya ni yul gyi ming yin par bshad/ mi nyag 'di rgyas tung khud dang /tung shang zer la phyis su shas zha zer/ bod kyis mi nyag zer ba'i brda la brten nas/ deng sang gi rgya'i lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu/ tung shang gi spyang (ṭha)la bod kyis mi 'og zer (mi nyag zer ba ma go ba red)/ mi'i 'og ma tha chad du brtsi zhes bris pa khungs med kyi 'chal gtam mo/ / sung rgyal rabs byang mas (4khyilko) mi nyag 'gog ched/ tsong kha'i rgyal bo la rgyu nor 'bor chen dang /— bya dga' ming btags sogs thengs du mar byin te 'brel ba bzang bo btsugs par/sung gi lo rgyus las bshad/ sung gi lo rgyus nang tsong kha'i rgyal 387

bo'i lo rgyus bshad pa'i le'u zhig yod pa la/ khom long byung tshe zhib 'jug bya rtsis yin/ sung gis tsong kha'i rgyal bo la rgyal sras zer zhing / 'bangaspo tshirnams la bod (4ro) zer la/ sung gi 'bangs mi rgya rigartswayongs kyis spyang ( za)zer/ tsong kha'i rgyal bos lo brgya yar mar la dbang bsgyur bar bshad/ skabs 'gar mi nyag ma gtogs pa'i mdo khams yongs la dbang bsgyur ba dang /skabs 'gar tsong kha yul chen bco brgyad tsam la dbang bsgyur/kho'i mnga' 'bangs kyi mi ni gtso bo bod mi yin la/ rgya dang sog po'ang mi nyung bar bshad/ kho dar ba'i skabs su 'bangs mi khyim khri brgya ste 'bum bcu lhag yod par bshad/ gang ltar rgya bodasgro so mtshams srung ba'i khams rgyal stobs ldan zhig yin par mngon no/ /sdong kha'i rgyaskya bo'i skabs so / /gahaṃskekyibu/ nadz+wa snad spya zho rgyuske skarga sned ge skan nuska dand sprusgyun sum̐lu/de dang dus rags pa mtshungs par/ mdo khams stod smad kyi sa mtshams su/ gling seng chen ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul zhes pa'i dpa' bo stobs ldan zhig gis/ phyogs bzhi'i dgra btul ba'i lo rgyus skad grags can yod la/ de'i 'byung khungs sogs lha8'i

ni bod kyi rus mdzod rnying ba dag cag saspu ba ltar bshad par bya ste/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi'i nang gi ldong la a spo ldong zhesazer 'gagana' sgrung las ldong che gnyan can zhes dbu 'phang mtho/ zhes dang / ri mthon po gsum de ldong la thob/ ldong zhwa mgo mtho ba ride nas byung / zhes sgrung glu 'arda dag gi don ni/ dpe rithob kyi glu gnyis dang / don thob kyi glu gnyis tobazhi / rus chen bzhir yod pa las/ ldong la daphe thob kyi glu yin te/ ri rtse mo gsum gyi dpe ltar dbu 'phang mtho ba'ibidon yin/ zhing/ sbyir ldong 'di mang la/ a spo ldodz+wadang lha ldong sogs yod zer/ 'di ni phu bo ldong dang / yum mchog 'bri sga ma zhes bya ba las— byung ba'i rigs yin la/ 'di la dkar bo ldong dang / nag po ldong dang / khra bo ldong dang smug po dzong gi rigs dang bzhi yod la/ 'di rigayo rnams su 'khrungasacapa'i skyes bu dpa' rtsal dgu ldan/ sngon byon dag gi lo rgyus mang / ldong rigs 'di ni dbus gtsang bar khams a mdo sog sa sasngar nasaci yod/ khyad par du bar khams sa cha 'di ni/ sa yi cha gling gi yul zhes pa ni/ sgang drug las zal mo sgang du grags pa'i sa 'di la/ gling khri gong 'og bar gsum yod pa ni/ gligakhri gong ma'i sa ni khams stod 'bri klung gi sa cha rnams dang / de las sgye sgom gyi rdza ri/ de las phu na g.ya' brag dang /389

gangs brag g.ya' bya ba'i ri khrod ngo mtshar can yod pa/ mda' na gong zi mang 'brug gnyis kyi dpon chen/ gling sa ldong seng blon yin la/ seng blon gyi bu che ba rgya tsha zhal dkar sogs yin/gling khri bar ma'i sa cha ni shar zla rol gyi sa cha rnams dang / gling khri 'og ma'i sa cha ni mdo khams rmar rol yin par bshad la/gling khri zhes pa ni mi khyim khri tsho re'i bdag po yin la/ khri dmag gsum gyi dpung gi bdag po yin pas de ltar grags so/ / ldong gling ba de la/ che rgyud dang / 'bring rgyud dang / chung rgyud dang gsum yod pa sogs kyi lo rgyus ni/ 'di ba'i che rgyud kyi dpon ni stag rong gi gzig 'phen/ 'bring rgyud kyi dpon po ni 'bri rong gi stag lha / chung rgyud kyi dpon po ni kla rong gi a mye khya rgan khra bo/ 'di tshe shin tu ring ba zhig yin pas khro rgan zer/ ming dngos la khro bo skyabs zer/'di'i bu che ba khro bo 'phan ni khro thung yin/ 'bring ba seng blon dang / chung ba gnang chung g.yu stag yin/ seng blon dang rgya bza'i bu rgya tsha ni khong rgyal dang / 'gag mo'i bu ge khod skyabs ni/ chung dus nas pho rtsal sna dgu dang ldan pas/ seng chen dang / ge sar yang zer la/ chung dus jo ru yang zer/ rjes nas gling gi yul 'di thams cad kyi bdag po rgyul bor gyur pas/lha90

'dzam gling gi rgyal bo ltar red ces zer nas/ 'dzam gling rgyal bo seng chen zhes grags pa ni che brjod do/ /khong gis sga skya lo'i bu mo 'brug mo zhes grags pa khabakātu bzhes/ khong gi 'khor phu nu dpa' thul(rtul) sum cu sog sa dang / blon po ni/ sga dpa' thul (rtul) tsha zhang 'dagam byang khra red/ tsha zhang zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gling chung rgyud kyi tsha bo dang zhang bo gnyis ka yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis red/ gling khri gong ma'i dpon rgyud ni/sngon 'bri klung nyin gyi pho brang chen po lcags ra bsam 'grub rtser gling chen po bdag drung gi bar du yod/ da lta'i khams sde dge'i rgyal rgyud kyang de'i gdung rigs yin zer/ bar khams su byung ba'i rnying ma'i bla ma rig 'dzin mgon po lhun 'grub kyang de'i mgadung rigs yin zer/ gling khri bar ma'i gdung rigs ni 'bri klung nyin gyi gling khar rag stag pho brang du bzhugs pa'i rje rigs rnams las deng skabs sgyelhang rje drung rin po che dang / gliro dpon mgon thar sku mched da lta bzhugs pa rnams yin zhes/ mi bu gdung drug gi rus mdzod las gsungs so/ / stegling bar ma 'di'i mi rigs pad ma tshe brtan zer ba mgo log yul du 'khyar 'ongs nas/ mgo log 'bum yag gitshonang 'khor phyag mdzod byas nos bsdad/ phyis nas khyim thab bzung 291

bas bu gsu dang 'khor g.yog mang ba dang / kho rang yang dpa' rtsal che ba zhig yin pas/ mis zer srol/ ‘‘mgo log khasku gsum gling dang bzhi/ /ma tshad rje dang 'dra 'dra yin/ /tshad narje yi lhag pa yin/ / ’ zer ba de byung / de'i 8 rgyud ni da lta'i 4dbang chen stod ma'i gling 'di rnams yin pa dang / gling bar ma'i rje rigs lha dbang zer ba mgo log pad ma rol nyin gyi smug chen a wi nang du brdza da shaṃ'i bu che ba tshe dbang / chung ba mgon po dbang gnyis yod/ tshe dasadz+wasog pos khusnyon cu bzung (hor jing3lde gyi dus yin 'dra) / —rjes sor sog mo zhig khrid nas rmar rol a wi nang du slebs nas bsdad pa la gling sog pobyutshang jer ba.ogs gling gi mi rgyud da lta'ang jal mnga.oṃ /gzhan yang mgo log sogs yul gru du sper snang gi spocha nas 'ongs pa'i sde shwams cad la gling zer mod/ de thams cad glingagi rje rigs yin pa'i nges pa med zer /tsong kha'i rgyal bo dang / mi nyag phan snyon 'thab rtsod sogs kyi rkyen las gnyis ka'i shugs cung nyams shaṃ'i skabs —dang bstun te/ hor dmag gis mdo smad kyi sa khul du mar rku —'phrog sogs byas par/ gling rje ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gyis hor dang 'jang dang / ta zig sogs pham par byas te/ bar khams ཿ9shā ji

dang rma chu'i stod smad bar gsum gling gis bzung ba yin te/ mdo smad chos 'byung las/ slorma chu shar nas nub tu 'khyog pa rma rmi 'dris mtshams su tsha gan pe shing dga' ldan rab rgyas khring ji ltar byung tshul ni/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen ba de nyid rgya phebs kyi dus skyabs mgon mchog la/ sngon gling ge sar gyis bzung ba'i yul ma dzod dge phyogs de mi rabes du mar 'dug kyang / da phan gang 'dra yong mi shes/ de'i sa gnad zin sa zhig tu dgon pa zhig byung na phan thogs yod pa 'dra ste khyed kyis dgon pa zhig thob/ ces bka' gnang ba thugs la btags ’—zhertes gsungs sgyus /gling song chen ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gyi dpung gang du slebs shul gyi rjes gsal bor yod de/ 'ga' zhig ni bdag gis sngar bris zin pa yod la/ de min dper na/ rgyal sras blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i co ne dgon chen gyi gnas bstod ka la ping ka'i sgra dbyangs las/ ‘‘'di nas shar lho'i rtsogs mtshams su/ /ba yan lung ba zhes bya bar/ tsho/ge sar rgyal bo rno go khrab dang / /grub rtags mtshan ma legs par gsal/ / zhes dang / khri byang rin po che'i rnam thar las/ nyin gcig gnas de'i phur/ kam po gnas —zhes tha snyad gdags 293ri

gzhi'i rtsa ba pha bong chen po yi ge ka rang byon can zhig yod pa de mjal zhing tshogs 'khor phul/ de'i lam zhor lha khang zhig tu gling ge sar gyi dpa' rtul mang bo'i go khrab dang / mda' gri mdung gsum sogs mtshon cha mang bo dang / rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi ral gri ya zi skar phran sogs mjal rgyu 'dug ces gsungs (mdo stod khams kyi ka bo'i gnas red ) / gling gi sgrung yig rnams su/ gling gis rma chu'i stod smad bar gsum bzung ba'i lo rgyus las gzhan/ tsong kha'i bde thang dang / tsong kha'i chu rgyud rnams dang / zi ling mkhar sogs bzung ba'i lo rgyus med pa ni/ tsong kha'i rgyal bo dang / mi nyag gis gang bzung ba'i sa dag ni/ bod rang gi lag tu yod gshis dpung 'jug ma byas ripar sems so/ /gling ki skabs so / /gagun pu/ nakau snad / zho rgyuska luska nago zhog sroghaska rnyu sken/gong du bshad pa ltar rma g.yang phyug mo'i stod nas a mardor brtsi bas/ de nas bzung bod mi chags tshul ni/ thang gis nub phyogs su rgya bskyed pa'i skabs rma stod mgo log gi sa cha sogs su thang dmag gis ma bzung bar/ de gar gnyug mar rīganas pa'i bod kyi mi sde yod pa ni/ rmar rol gyi sa cha'i stod du 294 tsho

sbra rigs kyi dpon gnyan rtse zer ba yed la/ bar du sbra rigs kyi dpon mkhar re zer ba yod/ smad du spra rigs kyi dpon ba li zer ba 'bangs bcas yod/ de rjes mgo log gi mi rgyud byung tshul ni/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi'i nang stong zhes bya ba de nyid yin la/ de la a lcags 'bri zhes zer/ 'a bri 'di la 'bru zhes—'bri/ ba dang 'bri tshul gnyis yod de/ mardo smad chos 'byung sogs dang rus mdzod sngon ma kha shas su'ang 'bru zhes bris pa yod mod/ rus mdzod dag tu 'bri rje rwa co can bco brgyad kyi gdung rigs zhes yod pa dang /'bri gung gi 'bri yang gug gu can du gtan khel zhing / de yang 'bri rigs kyi rus yig yin par gda' bas 'dir yang de ltar du gug gu can 'bri bar bya'o/ /de yang gna' sgrung las/ 'bri byas pa can zhes dgra la rgod ces dang / ri rtsa ba gsum de 'bri la thob/ /rgyal sa non pa nge yi don/ /zhes sgrung glu 'di dag la don thob kyi gnyis dang / dpe thob kyi gnyis te bzhi yod de/ de bzhi rus chen bzhi la yod pa las/ 'bri la dpe thob kyi glu yin/ri rtsa ba gsum gyi dpe ltar brtan te rgyal sa non pa'i don yin zer/ gna' sgrung du/ 'bri shing thung can des 'thab na mdzes/ /zhes 'thab 'dzing la bzang ba'i rigs yin zhing /lha95

'bre rje rwa co can bco brgyad kyi gdung rigs dang / 'bri mi 'gyur tha(ra ba'i gnas brgyad ces/ saskya dadzo' bri gung sogs kyi gdung rigs brgyad dbus gtsang dang bar khams sayod pa' modang / khams kyi gre rong lcags gsum khog dang / gser rong sogs la ñtsags mo'i gdung rigs mang du yod cing / bar khams su lhorong chen bco brgyad kyi nang tshan mgo log zer ba'i sar yang 'bri rigs mang dujiyod la/ bar skabs shig tu de naspogling gi yul du mi rje bran khol khyim bcu dang bcas te 'ongs nas/'bri klung gi nyin phyogs 'dzi 'gu kho lung ba zhesabya bar gzhi chags nas ring zhig lon pa'i tshe/ 'bri lha rgyagozhes pa'i khyi7sngags pa zhig byunge / des gnyan bza' zhig blangs pa'i bu mi'abum rgyal zer ba skyes/ de cher skyes pa'i tshe tsam nas/ sgrung rje dang rmem mthun par/ gling rjes bka 'a bkyon dang thugs gnag pa'i tshe na/ bran mi khyim lnga bcu tsam dang bcas yudzibud nas/ rdo rol dgongs dang bo dang / ma srid lte thang / skyid ya ga dang / gos kyi ma mo bzhi ma do rnams sabasdad/ de rjesamakhar gong lug sna ring mo yan chad dang / molug snamakhar sum mdo man chad bzung ste/ mkhar gong rgyal sa byas/ tsha lug sna mkhar sum mdor lha khang bzhengs pa dang / lha khang kha shas brtsigs/lha9khyo

lha rgyal/ lha rir mtshams la bzhugs/ bu4a 'bum smol dpon saralabaskos/ gong du bshad ba'i gnyug mar gnas paji gnyan 6mkhar ba gsum gyi mi sde rna5sa dang tshong 'bre la nye shagacibasdebs nasa'adug skabs/ 'bri lha rgyal —phajibu chotho'isrid gnyi sa characamatho bar gyur pas/ spunyan mkhar ba gsum gyi dpon rnams zagajidog skyes te/ mgo log 'gri lha rgyalajitshang la dmag brgyab dzosaco gnyan rtse'i dpon bsad/ gnyan mkhar ba gsum pham ste mgo skur/ spus phul/ bran du khas blangs so/ /bu a 'bum rgyal gyis sngar gling rje rigs kyi bu mo zhig blangasastepa lajibucagasu0skyiso/ che ba 'bum skyabs/ 'bring ba 'bum dge/ tshutha ba 'bus yag gsum yin/ de dus rmar shod du mkhar brtsigs nas der bsdad/ bu chung ba 'bum yage gisaganyan mo zhig blangs ba la bu phagacathar zor ba skyes/ phag thar gyi ring la/ rdo khog 'dzi ska rmarokhog gsum gyi bdag por gyur/ 'a skabs gigo la mgo log yi'i'abu ma lo go gsum lonastodus su zhodas/ phag thar gyis rang zhabs kyi 'phel —'dzisakhabaza'/ thar mo mtsho zer ba khab tu bsus/ de la bu bzhi skyes/ phag thar gyi ring la rmar rolalolag drug gi sa cha dang rdzi sde la dbang / rmar rol chen mo'i mda' gse ra gzhongs dang /297

kho le sgang thog tu mkhar rdzong gnyis brtsigs/ de'i skabs tā ming rgya rgyal gyis 'jam brid kyi srid jus bstar te grangs nyung mi rigs kyi dpon dag la dpon thob ster ba'i skabs yin pas/ tā ming zon tes phag thar la thang lo ye zhes khri dpon gyi lung byin/kho rang gi bu bzhi'i gcig ka thog bla ma chos 'bum yin/ che ba rdo rje 'bum la rdo rol gyi sa cha dang mi sde/ 'bring ba pad+ma 'bum la 'dzi ska'i khog chung ba pad+ma yag la rmar rol gyi sa cha dang mi sde byin/ rnga khog gi mi sde/ gser khog gi khral/ g.yu dang rtsang khog gi sa cha mi sde rnams thun mong du bzhag ste kho lo gya dgu la 'das/ rdo rje 'bum gyi bu che ba 'bum phyug rgyal dang / chung ba dbang chen 'bum yin/ pad+ma 'bum gyi bu che ba thar ba dang / chung ba mgo log dpon po byang chub rgyal mtshan yin/ pad+ma yag gi bu che ba khru 'u dang / chung ba gnyan thar red/ rdo rje 'bum gyi bu che ba 'bum rgyal gyis smug chen gad 'gor khang ba zhig brtsigs nas bsdad/ bu chung ba dbang chen 'bum pha mkhar du bsdad/ pad+ma 'bum gyi bu che ba thar ba chen mo gdong du pha khyim der bsdad/chung ba byang chub rgyal mtshan ka thog tu byon/ pad+ma yag gi bu che ba khru 'u gnyan grong gong mar bsdad pas sa der khru 'u nang zer/chung ba gnyan thar de pha khyim du bsdad par sa der gnyan nang 298

rīco— zer/ pad+ma yag gi bu chung ba rtag phan rgyud pa la/ bar skabasasnyo su mgo log snying bu mtsho zhes pa byung / de'i rgyud pa da lta'i mgo log dpal yul tshang yin zer/ 'di skabs dbal shul ban zhar gyis mgo log gi dpon rnams la sa zhig bslangs par rdo rje 'bum pha bu nas rdo rol rjes mda' byin/ rdo rje 'bum gyi bu che ba 'bum phyug rgyal la bu gnyis yod pa'i/ che ba mgo log a skyong dang / dpon mgo log rgyal mtshan nam rin chen 'bum gnyis yin/ pad+ma 'bum gyis 'dzi ska'i stod smad thams cad la dbang —bsgyur bas pad+ma 'bum tshang zer ba byung / pad+ma yag gi sha mdog nag smug yin stabs ban nag zer la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis de'i bu khru 'u dang gnyan thar gnyis kyi nang sde thams thad la ban nag tshang zer/ 'bum rgyal gyi bu che ba a skyong ni yar cang du mkhar brtsigs nas bsdad pas a skyong zer/ de skabs dbang chen 'bum tshang / a skyong tshang / pad+ma 'bum tshang / pad+ma yag tshang rnams kyis sa bgos/ nas/ sa mtshams su rdo brtsigs/ dbang chen 'bum gyi bu che ba tshe brtan yag 'di'i rgyud pa dbang chen smad pa red zer/ bu chung ba tshe mgon yag gi rgyud pa dbang chen stod pa tshang red/ a skyong / dbang chen 'bum/ pad+ma 'bum 'di gsum 299

la de skabs mgo log khag gsum ther/ a skyong la bu snying bu rgyal dang / khro bo rgyal gzhilad+kung ba'i ging bu rgyal ni’thi drag5rtsal can yin pas/ a skyong gi dbang des bzung zhing / thang mkhar du da lta'i khang rgan zene ba de blortsigs/ de dang rīdus༄mtshungs su pad+ma yag cigi bu rgyud mgo log nag ther bu bzhi byung / snying mu rgyalañtsha bu mgo log shākya —'bum/desad+kukhar gong ma bakhyugs/ de'i bu —tshe dbang 'bum gyis khang ba gsar ba brtsigs pa de la khang gsar zer/ de ltar mgo log kha ga gsus gyi dpon rigs rnams ni gtso cher r+sha.a lcags 'bri'i snarigs yin mod/ a spe ldo—nga gi rigs —spyang yod de/ —ldong rnardzog khuco brgyad dang / tsha chen bco brgyad kyi rigs kyang yod pa dang / sbra rigs kyangaci yod/ de dag ni rje rigs tsākyi rigs —rnamasangabashad pa yin la/ 'bangs mi ser la sna tshogs shispuru yod de/ mgo log stocad lta bu sngar —thang da—mag gis ma bzung ba 'i sar gnyug ma'i can 3gas yod de/ sngar bshad —pa ltar 'bri lha rgyal pha bus bcom pa'irgyaganyan rtse/ sakhar ba/ ba le gsum gyi dpon mi sde dang bcas pa'i rgyud pa yod la/ hone gling 'khrug pa'i skabs su yong ba'i dkar bo ldong gi rigs kyang gang sa gang du yod sa/ bod thang dmag 'khrug gi skabs kyi dmag 300 rī

rme'i rgyud kyang mang du yod do/ /mgo log gi skabs so / /rma khog po ti'i mdo sogs su dbal shul stod smad 'di dag sdong rigs yin te/ ri rtse mo gsum de ldong la thob/ ldong zhwa mgo mtho ba de 4don/ zer ba ltar mnga' thapache mdo khams ldong shul chen bco brgyad du gra7gas pa/ dbal shul/ ra ga shul/ phyag shul/ hor shul/ gnyan shul/ thal shul/nag shul/ dmag shul/ yon6shul/ sna shul/ rong shul/ka shul/ rgya shu la/ rgyo shul/ mkhar shul/ yag shul/ sngo shul/ draspu shul rnams dang / sdong tsha chen bco brgyad du gra g.yopa/ tog tsha/ rmog tsha/ 'go go ༅gatsha/ khroyotsha/ dmu tsha/ rkang tsha/ zam tsha/ 'tsha.oṃtsha/ rag tsha/ hurotsha/ stag tsha/gzi tsha/ rbu tsha/ smyag tsha/ g.yi tsha/ mtshur tsha/ rkyang tsha 'am tshang tsha rnams yod pa las/ dbadze+e shuskyilani/ ldong dbal skyabaspomimi rigs la skabs shig dbal shul phur0ba thar zer ba byung / de'i bu/ ge li/ ge tse/ ge 'phan gsum/ ge li daroge tse 'i rgyud pa 'bu ma skyabayoyag dang khrokho sogs yin/ getre'atha na gyi rgyud pa dbal shul ban dpon zer ba'i rgyud du kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa 'khrungs/ de'i rgyud pa tshan gcig lho phyogs kyi g.yu khogadhe rtsang khog sgog khog rnams bye01

bzung bas/ ge 'phan g.yu rtsang sgeg gsum ni/ gser stod dang snyi stod du chags pa de ge 'phan rnying ma dang / spra skor ma gnyis ge 'phan stod bza' tshang / ge tse'i rgyud pa ge tse ma lag thong gsum grags pa rgya che/ zla chu stod sde dge'i mnga' zhabs kyi dpon rigs rnams kyang ge tse'i mi rgyud red/ ge tse dpon po dang ge tse khro shul yang 'di las gyes/ ge rgyal gyi mi'i rgyud pa khams su yod kyang dpon ris/sa med/ phur ba thar gyi sngon mi rgyud mtsho sngon du mched pa chu yos dus 'khrug dus slar song ba li thang g.yon ru ma dang / sde gzhung ma zer ba'i dpon rigs/dbal shul khrom thal ma zer ba'ang yod/ ge li'i bu chung ba ban zhar gyi mi rgyud dbal shul stag skyabs kyis rdo stod rje mang ra'i sa mgo log la bslangs nas der mkhar gzhi bzung / 'di la bu gnyis yod pa'i che ba stag lha 'phan gyi bus/ shos khog tu ru ba byas nas bsdad pa'i rgyud gser thal dpon rigs/ ban zhar nas mi rabs 'ga' song ba'i mtshams khro kho zhes pa'i bu che bas rmar gyi mu nang du 'brog bzung ba'i rgyud pa la mu thal dang / chung bas khe stod du 'brog bzung ba'i rgyud pa khe thal dpon rigs dbal shul khro kho zer ba 'di yin no / /dbal shul bu chung gi rgyud pa bu chung rta yag chos gsum 302

'phan dang bzhi zer ba byung / a skyabs kyi mi rgyud gser thal ma'i mnga' 'og tu yod/ dbal shul sangs rgyas skyabs kyi bu 'bum skyabs yag de la rdo smad du bu mgon po lhun 'grub dang /rdo stod du er khe tha'i ji nam mkha' tshe ring / 'dzi ska'i mdar rnam rgyal bkra shis dang gsum/ tha'i ji la dpon 'ju nang gi bdag rkyen che/ mgon po lhun 'grub kyis si tu paṇa chen gdan drangs nas rdo smad du dgon pa zhig btab/ sangs rgyas 'bum gyi mi rgyud 'dzi ska'i wa 'bri mgo/ bsu mda'/ rdo stod skyi ra rdo smad rka mda' rnams su yod zer ro/ /da lta 'dzam thang zhes grags pa'i mi ser la ni ldong rigs/'bri rigs/ sbra rigs sogs rigs du ma zhig yod la de dag ni/ la la bod rgyal btsan po dag gi dus skabs kyi so mtshams srung dmag yin pa dang / la la ni phyis su 'ongs pa sogs sna tshogs shig yod 'dug bod sil bur thor ba'i rjes su re zhig tsong kha'i rgyal bos dbang bsgyur zhing / de rjes gling rje ge sar gyis kyang dbang bsgyur/ de rjes gong du bshad pa ltar mgo log gi dpon phag thar gyis rmar shod ma lag drug la dbang bsgyur ba'i gras su 'dzam thang 'dzi ska sogs yod de/ de drug ni gna' mi'i glu gzhas la/ rmar rol ma lagaju drug gi che ba yin/ rnga khog ba 303

lags skya mo rmar gyi lag rdogaṅgeg ri thang myug mo rmar gyi lag 'dzi ska lha mo dar thado rmar gyi lag g.yu khog stag mo 'phred nyal rmar gyi lag rtsang khog mdo ba kha bkal rma ra gyi lag sgeg khogi dhan dari gru ba zhi rmarogyi lag ces zer ba de rnams yin no/ /de rjes 7 phag thar phyi bu dze+ebum yag pad+ma 'bum 'dzi sna stod smad thams cad kyi sde thams cad dang sa cha'i bdag po byas pas —pad+ma 'bum tshang zer ba byung / pad+ma 'bum gyi bu nag thar gyis chen po gdoja mkhar mgo nag mar gser 'bum po ti bcu drug ma bris te/ rab gnas la 'dzam thang chos —rje gong ma dang / ri khrod pa dge ba rgya mtsho zer ba gnyis lhan rgyas garnan sgyudrangs te/ 'bul chen bzhag 'dzi ska'i myi nag shos mda' man cha da snar / bsi mda' yan chad kyi sajicha dang grwa ba rnams phul/rngos rje gong ma nas 'dzam thang sogs kyi bon 'ga' 'du la dgos gamung ba ltar phul/ de nas chos rje bla ma 'dzam thang phyogs kyi chos jisrid gnyis ldan du gyur/ rdo khog tu dab la shul mgon po lhun 'grub kyi rgyud pa rnams kyis dbaja bzung bar bshad 'dug go/ /'dzam thang gi skabs so/ /rnga khog ni/ rmar rol ma lag drug gi nang tshwan yin te/rnga khog ba lags skya mo rmar gyi lag ces zer ro/ /rmar rol 3'i4

ma lal/ drug gi sa thams cad la nges tshig yod pa'i nges pa med 5 de/ 'dod rgyal gyi ming du ma zhig yod nges la/ rnga ba 'di sa dbyibs kyi sgo nas btags pa yin zer/ sa dbyibs ni rnga 'dra ba'i rlum po zhig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar btags zer ba/sa dbyibs la ba ltasakhag bden pa 'dra/ 'ga' zhig gis sa 'di'i mi rnams mnga' risabyunas 'ongs pa yin pas mnga' ba zer ba brda 'gyur ba yin zer ba dang / chos rgyal 'phagasatsho pa'i dus/dga' ye shes dar rgyas dang ldong shul chen bco brgyad ni mnyam du stod mnga' ris phyogs /nas 'ongs pa yin zer ba sogs khungs med kyi gtam du 'a khums te mang 'a ris pa la mnga' ba dang /zhang zhung ba la zhang ba dang / spu rengs pa la spu ba dang / lha sa ba la lha ba dang / se ra ba la se ba dang / 'bras spungs pa la 'bras pa dang / dga'acildan ba la dga' ba zer ba lta bu'i bdag sgra can gyi tshig sdu da ni sngar ma mthong zhing bod kyi mkhas pa dag gis ma mdzadazul/ de lta bu'i tshig sdud ni/ rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang / brda sprod pa'i gzhung dang mi mthun pa dang /ldong shul chen bco brgyad ni/ ma spodheldong gi rigs las gyes pa mdozukhams stod smad kun tu sngar nas yod pa rus mdzod dag tu gsal zhing / dga' ye shes dar rgyas rini khri ral gyi dus su khral 305

bsdu ru mdo smad 'dir 'ongs pas bstan pa snga dar gyi dus yin pa dang / chos rgyal 'phags pa bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs yin pas/ de'i dus su dga' ye shes dar rgyas gsar du slebs pa min pas/ bshad tshul de dag ni rtog bzo 'ba' zhig go/ /des na sa 'dir sa gzhan dang 'dra bar gna' dus nas bod rigs yod nges/ bod thang 'khrug pa'i skabs su bod mi drag 'ded kyis/ thang dmag gis gzhi bzung ste/ mkhar brtsigs pa sogs kyi shul da lta'ang yod la/ bod rgyal gyi dpung gis thang dmag ded rjes/ rim gyis mi sde chags pa yin te/ so mtshams srung ba'i dmag mi'i rgyud kyang yod la/ tsong kha'i rgyal bo'i dus su'ang bod mi sde chags pa dang / gling rje ge sar gyi dpung 'di gar 'ongs nas re zhig bsnad de/ rnga smad 'dir khro thung gis mda' la zhing btab/ phu la phyugs skyong / ri sul du ri dwags rngon pa'i sa byas pa'i lo rgyus yod pa dang / de rjes rmar rol ma lag drug gi stod gnyan rtse'i sa dang / bar mkhar re'i sa dang /smad ba le'i sa yin/ 'di mdo smad chos 'byung du sa le zhes yod kyang rus mdzod 'ga' zhig tu ba le zhes bris yod pa dang / sa 'dir yang de'i rigs rgyud yod pa la ba le zhes 'bod par snang bas/ 'dir de ltar bris pa yin/ gnyan rtse sbra rigs 306

yin la/ mkhar re zer don spra dpon phran gyi mi rgyud las sbra lha thar zer ba la bu bdun yod par mkhar re re brtsigs pas mi rgyud la mkhar re zer/ ba le yang sbra ba le zer ba'i rigs rgyud red/ 'bri lha rgyal dang bu a 'bum rgyal gnyis kyis gnyan mkhar ba gsum bcom/ a 'bum rgyal gyis gling bza' zhig blangs pa'i bu 'bum skyabs/ 'bum dge/ 'bum yag gsum skyes pa'i chung ba 'bum yag dang / pha a 'bum/ a mye lha rgyal gsum khyim gcig byas te/ dpon g.yog 'bangs bcas rmar shod du spos te/ khob le sga mkhar dang / gnyan mkhar gnyis a 'bum— pha bu'i mkhar byas/ ru sngo mtsho kha'i dpon rnams dang sde rnams rnga khog sogs su bsdad/ chide skabs gna' mis glu gzhas 'then par/ stod gnyan rtse brnyangs pa brdal brdal red/ bar mkhar re mkhar rnga rdung rdung red/ smad ba le bal dkar gsed gsed red/ a 'dus dbang 'dus mgo btags red/ 'phel ke sil ke chu la bskur/'tshamasaciring kha ta nags la gab/ ba glang bong bu thang la bdas/ a brang sha rkyang ri la zhogs/ smad a 'khyams yanabyugacig rjes gnyis mthud mgo btags/ mgo log a 'bum de mtsho la dar chags 'dra/ bod la la ni mtsho kha'i sbrang ma 'dra/307

zhes zer ba byung / 'di dag ni mgo log bla ma chos 'bum gyi rnam thar du yod pa de/ mgo log o rgyan gyis bris pa/ mi'u gdung drug gi ru sa0〈da du bris pa las btu/sa pa yin/ 'di la bltas na/ rnga khog 'dir mi rigs gang yod gsal te/ gnyan rtse'i mi rgyud ni da lta'ang yod la/ mkhar re dang / ba le yang yod/ a 'dus dang / 'phel ke/ sil ke yang yod/'a tshams ring ni lo brgya phrag lhag gi sngon ska stod du 'brog sde chen po zhig byas nas yod mod/ de rjes sde 'thor byung nas deng skabs de'i mi rgyud rnga stod phyogs su yod/ ba glang bong bu zer ba de gling gi mi rgyud sa 'di dag tu yod paci la zer ba yin mod / 'on kyang ba glang zhes smade pa'i tshig sbyor byas pa 'dra/ a byang dang / shas rkyang ni gsal bor mi shes mod/ smad kyi a 'khyams yang pa de red/ gong gi mi rigs de daska nang spra rigs mang la/ ldong rigs kyang yod de/ ldong shul chen bco brgyad las/ sngo shul/ tha'akhashul/ ka shul/ sna shul/ yon shul/dmag shul/ rgya shul/ nag shul sogs dang / ldong tsha bco brgyad kyi nang gi stag tsha/ ra—ga tsha/ 'tsham tsha sogs yod/ dkar mo gling gi sde ba gling ru sogs rus rgyud sna tshogs shig yod/308

skobs re zhig bar du mgo log gi rje rigs rnams kyis dbang bsgyur mod/ dbus phyogs su sde srid gtsang ba rgyal bos dbang bsgyur te/ rdzong bcu bzhi ma gtogs pa'i rdzong dpon thams cad bcom ste/ yar lung dang / skyid shod sogs kyi dpon thams cad bcom pa'i skabs/ gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags lug (1631)lor na gzhon dus 'das mod/ de 'phral karma bstan skyong dbang bo khrir 'khod de/ sngar rgyun bzhin mi 'tsham pa'i las byas pas/ a mardo dgon lung gi dga' ru lo tsā ba dang / skyid shod bye ri stag rtse ba'i sde ba mtsho skyes rdo rje sogs dpon kha shas kyis gros byas te/ la mo chos skyong la lung bstan zhus par/ byang phyogs dpon gyis dgra mgo gnon thub pa'i lung bstan thob ste/gsang stabs kyis dga' ru lo tsā bas dpal ris kyi dmag kha shas khrid de/ o rod jun gar du song nas jun gar la dmag rogs zhus par brten/ o rod jun gar gyi dpon gu shrī han bstan 'dzin rgyal bos/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu pho rta'i lor (1642) bod khams yongs la dbang bsgyur/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa stag (1638)lo nas rim gyis gu shrī jun gar gyi ru sde rnams mtsho khar 'byor/ thog mar rgyal dbang 30 9

lnga bas gu shrī'i sras bkra shis pā thur mtsho sngon spyi dpon du bskos kyang / shing rta lor gshegs/ de rjes de'i sras bstan 'dzin wang spyi khyab byas/ dpon 'ju nang g.yas ru'i dpon byas te/ mdo smad tshang ma la dbang bsgyur/ de skabs mgo log la3jag pa mang bas dbus 'grul rnams bcom stabs/ dpon 'ju nang gis dmag drangs te/ mgo log btul nas mnga' 'og tu bsdus/de nas bzung mgo log gi chab srid la nyams rgud byung ste/ ra mdo ma gtogs rnga ba dang / 'dzam thang sogs rang mgo rang gis bzung / sde chung re la dpon phran re yod/ deng sang rnga ba la stod smad bar gsum phye mod/ sngar rnga stod dang / rnga smad gnyis su bye/ rnga smad la ma brlon shog bcu gnyis/ sngar rnga smad 'dir dpon phran kha shas yod la/ phyis su dme dpon phran rabs brgyud dbang thang cher gyur te/ dpon chen gcig pur gyur/dme 'di'i rgyud ni thog ma/ mdo smad chos 'byung las ‘‘dbang chen 'bum gyis smar nyin spu tsha'i sa cha chen po gdong du mkhar gyang khang bzhi brtsigs/ rdo khang ni yang thog can mkhar mgo nag ma zer ba brtsigs/ de'i bu nag ther dang / bla ma karma rin chen/ dang bo la nag ther bu bzhir grags pa'i rgyud pa bye10

mang du mched pas dme tshang sogs rgya che’’nes dang / mi'u gdung drug gi rus mdzod las/ ‘‘gsa' bza'i bu klu 'bum rgyal gyi bu mgo log rta thar rgyal yin/ 'dis mgo log a skyong gi yan mo'i bu klu 'bum rgyal rang gi nu bo klu 'bum skyabs kyis sog dmag gi sna khrid yod pa bsad pas dme rta zer/ de nas dme tshang du thogs/ 'di yi tshobu 'dzi rong gi sog po la rgol ba'i bu dme tshe rgyal byams yin/ 'dis sog dmag ('ju nang gi dmag yin 'dra) la mgo ma btags/ sog dmag gis mngon du ci nas kyang ma thub/ rjes nas ser log chu tshal du dmagaskung brgyab nas bsdad de/ bo'u 'jab kyis rmas nas gson por bzung ste rta rnga la btags nas rtas 'drud bcug ste bsad zer ro/ /'di'i rgyud pa la dme sog skor dang / gzhan dme nyin skor dang / dme gdong skor thams cad gsa' bza'i bu klu 'bum rgyal gyi rgyud pa yin/ ’ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog ma'i mi rgyud de ltar mgo log dpon gyi rgyud yin la/ phyis nas rigs rgyud yang yang chad pas/ nges pa cher med mod/ mi'u gdung drug gi rus mdzod las/ ‘‘pan yu ni lha dga'i rigs yin la/rnga ba'i dpon phran dme tshang ni sbra rigs shig yin/ 'di gnyis la phyis nas/ rgya dpon phran gong yes dang / zan tā lo yes 311

gnyis nas mngo' thang mabam̐ bar byas pa yin nes/ gna' mi'i ngagargyun dag khul las thos pa tsam las yig tshang 'dra ni ma mthong ngori’zhes gsungs/ des na 'di ba'i rgyud thog mar mgo log nas byung ba yin la/ mgo log gi dpon mang che ba 'bri lha rgyal gyi rgyud yin gshis/ a lcags 'bri yin mod/ phyis nas gnyen 'brel sna tshogs—kyi dbang gis/ a spo ldong gi rigs dang / sbra khra dang / sbra nag gi rigs kyang yod par mngon/dme tshang zhes pa'i 'bri tshul 'di ni/ kirti blo bzang 'phrin las kyi rnam thar dang blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsung gi/ kirti kun dga' chosa'aphags bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam thar/ mdo smad chos 'byung sogs rnam thar dag dang / mi'u gdung drug gi rus mdzod sogs rus mdzod du ma zhig tu'ang 'di bzhin bris yod pas de ltar bris pa'o/ / ngag rgyun la/ dpon gnam sa'i bkar shing gi ring la rgya thob blangs/ de nas dme thas chung don 'grub/ 'di 'phror cog tse'i tsha bu myi glen zhig de'i chung mar bsus pa yin nam zer ba'i dme rgyal mo a 'bos bza' zhes pas dbang yun ring bzung / de 'i 'phror a skyong bde sgron dang blon po dme dkon gnyis kas dbang bzung / de'i 'phror dbal shul rdo smad nas 31lha

— dbal shul lcags thar 'bum zer ba dmi tshang sgo bu skal du blangs nas/ de la cog tse rgyal bo'i bu mo zhig bag mar blangs/bdag mo skra dkar ma zer/ de gnyis kyi bu mgon po bsod nams/ des a skyong gong ma'i bu mo zhig blangs mod/ ga'agrig par skal ba byin nas phud/ de'i 'phror khang gsar bza' zhig blangs pa la bu mo zhig skyes pa de'i thog ma shi/ bu mo'i ming la dpal chen don 'grub mtsho/ de la mag pa 'bos spa bkra shis zhing skyong bzhag de'i bu byed dgos pa dpal mgon 'phrin las dang / bu mo don 'grub mtsho gnyis skyes/ dpal mgon 'phrin las kyis kirti'i myi rtsa tshang gi bu mo bkra shis sgron blangs pa la bu mo gnyis skyes/ don 'grub mtsho sngar khang gsar tshang la song yaja phyis su pha khyim du phyir log dpal mgon 'phrin las kyi blon gtso bo ja ma tshang gi mthu sto bas red/de min da dung blon kha shas yod/ dme ru ma'i dpon byed pa'i blon lha mo skyabs zer/ lha mo skyabs kyis dme ru ma'i nang du yod pa'i dme tshang gi su hrugapabadag do dam byed kyang / dus mtshungs su/ dme ru ma'i dpon byed cing / gyod sna kha mchu chung ba dag thagarugacod pa'i dbadzopi yod/ dpal mgon 'phrin las pe cin sogs su song shul du/ lha mo skyabs kyi sa rgyal tshab 313

k+shis so/ / dme dpon phran gyi dpon rabs nems dar zhing rgyas nas rigagyis rnga smad kyi dpon phran gzhan rnams med par btang ste/ma brlon shog bcu gnyis kyi dpon dme dpon gcig pur gyur te/ dme rgyal bo zhes yongs su grags/ lcags thar 'bum pha bu'i ring la lhag par dar zer/ dpon phran gzhan dag mgo 'dogs mkhan rnams la tsho myi re'i thob byin/ kho rang gisadame tshang la khral las dang khyim las sogs mi dgos par byas te ming la dar han zer/ dper na yag po byas nas mgo 'dogs mkhan ka shul tshang lta bu la/ dmigs bsal gyis khral mi khyim kha shas gyin/ mgo mi 'dogs mkhan la la bsad/ la la bzung nasarta rnga la btags nas 'drud gsod byas/ dper na tha ra tshang gi dpon bsad/ de'i gzhis ka'i sa zhing / sde ba des khral las kyis 'debs rdung byas te/ thog yong dme tshang la 'bul dgos/ mkhar ba tshang gis mgo legs par ma btags pas/khang mthar dmag gis bskor skabs bza' tshang gis bza' rta rgyung nas mgo log tu bros pa/ deng sang mi rgyud dpal yul dgon pa'i mtha' ba na yod zeri/ dme srihraklu mgon/ mnga' 'og tu sdud dka' ba byung mod/ mthar kho rang stag lung gi bu 314

mo zhig la chags nas/ de zur bdag byas te rgyun du de gar song / dme tshang gis bu mo de'i ming bo rnams la dngul 'bor chen byin nas/ bu mo des klu mgon ming bo rnams la sprad nas bsad de dme srib dbang du bsdus/ gsod sa deng sang rdo bong zhig yod sa de red zer/ klu mgon gyi shul dme srib khang rgan tshang red zer/ yang lcags thar 'bum pha bu'i dus/ mo ba tshang zer ba'i dpon phran la mo ba'i mgon po klu sgrub zer ba'i bu rgod cig yod/ de tshang gis khong la mthu mnan gtad byas yod zer nas pha bu gsum bsad/ de ltar dpon phran dag med par byas pas/ dpon gcig pur gyur/ ma brlon shog kha bcu gnyis ni/ shog stod ma la brgya shog bzhi/ bar ma la brtsashog bzhi/ smad ma la brgya shog bzhi ste bcu gnyis zer/ de la nang stong sde zer/ dme ru ma la dmag dpon gnyis/ shog stod smad bar gsum la dmag dpon gnyis re ste dmag dpon dar 'dzin brgyad/ ba dpon du ma zhig yod zer/ shog bcu gnyis kyis dme tshang la khral las khyim las bco brgyad dgos zer/ khyimi tshang yang rab/ khyim rab/ khyim 'bring / khyim tha/ yang tha ste rim pa lnga byas nas/ de'i tshod kyi khral 'u lag 'jogagana' me mda' rnying ba'i dus su/ rgyun du dmag res bo'u bye15

sman rgya ma lnga/ sbar thig 'dom brgyad/ mdel brgya tham nga// rkyal ba gnyis/ kha mda' rta'i srab mda' 'dom gnyis re/ rkyal thag 'dom gsum re'i rtsis len/ phyis me mda' gsar ba dar nas/ yang rab re la rta gsum me mda' gnyis dang mde'u sum brgya re'i khral/ gzhi rab re la rta gnyis dang me mda' gcig mde'u nyis brgya re/ gzhi 'bring re la rta gcig me mda' gcig mde'u brgya dang lnga bcu re/ gzhi tha re lu rta gcig mdung gcig re/ yang tha re la rta yod na rta gcig re dang / med na skad rgyag byed dgos/ rta gang dgos la sga srab cha tshang de dag thams cad kyis rkyal ba gnyis re/ kha mda' 'dom gnyis re/rkyal thag 'dom gsum re/ de dag gra sgrig byas te dmag la nam 'gro dgos pa bsgugs nas 'dug dgos la/ dung brda gcig gis grwa tshang / ki brda gcig gis dmag zer nas/ dmag brda nam thon na de dus dmag la 'gro dgos zer ro/ /dme ru ma ni nang sde yin la/ dme ru ma tsho ba bdun yod zer la/ tsho ba bdun ni hu ra ma/ a 'bos/ dmye dang/la/mo ba ru/ rong ba ru/ ra ru/ nag tshang ma ste bdun no/ /gca' ru/ kiti ma/ rme ba/ dbal shul rdo smad rnams dang pha chos dkar bo gcig pa byas zer/3 1‘

zhing skyong pha bu'i—ring la/ mgo 'dogs mkhan 'bos spa— tshang stod smad gnyis sogs sde che chung nyi shu tsam yod zer ro/ /zhing skyong gi ring la bla brang 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng lnga ba'i yab rgyal bo mgon po don 'grub zer ba rnga stod du bsdad nas/ rnga stod kyi dpon 'ga' re dbang du mi 'du ba re gnyis bsad zer / rgya stod rdor zhar dang ma 'grig de skabs dme rgyal bo dang yang ma mthun pas/ dme dmag yab kyi steng du rgyug rgyu gra sgrig byed skabs/ yab kyis tshor nas mtshan mor bros byol byas/ de'i don du bla brang gi dmag chen bud pa khang gsar tshang sogs dpon po 'gas bar chings byas te dmag rdzogs byin nas dmag phyir slog de rjes 'jam dbyangs bzhad sprul rin po che dbus phyogs su phebs skabs/ lam bar nas khang gsar paṇa chen dang / a mchog 'on po gnyis gzu ba byas te gyod bshad/ de skabs bla brang phyag mdzod mkhyen rab don 'grub zer bas dbang 'dzin pa'i skabs yin la khong gyod sna kha mchur thugs mi dgyes pa zhig yin gshis gyod 'grig thabs byas zer/ yab kyi gson stong la dngul rdo tshad sum brgya 'jal rgyu byas te gyod legs par 'grig 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i mchog 317

sprul rin po ches daswe blon 'khor bcas la tshi dbang gnang nas/dme tshang gis chos 'brel bzhag de rjegabla brang phyag mdzod rjes ma dbal mang tshang dang dme rgyal dpal mgon 'phrin las gnyis mna' mthun byas te/ dme blo brang gi mthun lam je legs la song zer ro /de rjes phyogs bzhir dgra mang gshis/ rgyab rtsa zhig dgos snyam nas/ dpal mgon 'phrin las zi ling du song nas mā chi tshang la mgo btags/ 1946lor dbal shul chu kha ma dang ma brlon dme tshang gi bar 'khrug ngan langs pa la/ bla brang phyag mdzod dang khang gsar paṇa chen gnyis kyis gyod bshad de/ phan tshun shi stong gson stong dang / rgyu rdzas dngos 'jal sogs gyod legs par bshad do/ /1947lor khro chu'i dmag dme tshang gi thog tu 'ongs te/dme tshang gis kyang gdong len gyi dmag phud de gtugs/1950lor dme tshang gis ma thu stobs sogs blon kha shas mngags te lan gru nas gung khran tang la mgo btags/ de rjes dme tshang dang dme skor ru ba gyod la thug nas/ dme dmag gis dme skor ru ba brgyab zer ro/ /1952lor mong shan du khron nub bod rigs rang skyong 318

srid gzhung btsugs// de'i skabs dpal mgon 'phrin las la kru'u zhi gzhon pa'i go gnas byin/ pe cin sogs su tshogs 'du dang lta skor la phyin/1953lor mong shan du tshogs 'du 'tshogs skabs gung khran tang srid gzhung gis/ dme tshang dang khro chu tshang gi gyod bshad de/ dpal mgon 'phrin las dang / rdo rje dpal bzang gnyis kyis kha dar rtse sprod byas/ rme ba dang khro chu'i gyod bshad nas tshe ring dpal ldan dang / kun dga' yar 'phel gnyis kyis/ kha dar rtse sprod byas nas gyod thams cad legs par 'grigs nas mi rigs mthun sgril chen po byung / rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul btsugs nas/ dpal mgon 'phrin las la khul gtso gzhon pa'i go gnas sprad/ zhing chen nas srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa'i go gnas yang gnang ngo / /dme tshang gi chab srid kyi skor 'di dag ni/ dpe thog nas mthong ba med pas/ gzhan gyi ngag rgyun dag la gzhi byas nas bris pa yin la/ khyad par du1987lo'i zla1tshes19nyin rnga ba rdzong srid gros khang gi rgyus yod kyi u yon bkra 'byor/ rgya mtsho/skal kho/ mkhas kho( zhis ko/ phur khornams dang / kirti dgon gyi drung yig a khu chos 'phel rnams gdan drangs te 319

bzhugs mol byas pa dang gzhan las thos pa dag la'ang zhib bsdur byas sdi yin mod/ spyir bdag la chab srid phyogs la rgyus med gshis/ dag mo yin min ci rigs yod nges pas/ gzigs pa bo dag gis zhib 'jug 'tshal/ kun spakhyen 'jigs med dbang bo rab byung bcu gsum pa'i’lcags khyi (1790) lor rnga stod du phebs skabs/ dme rgyal mo a 'bos bza' dang rdor zhar dpon gnyis kyi gyod bshad par mdo smad chos 'byung las bshad pas/ de skabs dme dpon mo a 'bos bza'i skabs yin 'dugayang kirti sku phreng bdun pa kun dga' chos 'phags thub bstan nyi ma'i rnam thar las/ ‘‘rnga ba'i dme dpon mos gdan drangs te/ me long thang nas ma brlon shog bcu gnyis la rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang gnang’’zhes gsungs/ de skabs khong dgung lo so gcika rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me phag (1827) lor khel 'dug de'i skabs kyi dpon mo de yang a 'bos bza' yin nam snyam/ yang kirti blo bzang 'phrin las rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i lcags sprel (1860) lor khong dgung grangs bcu gnyis thog rnga yul du phebs pa'i rnam thar las/ ‘‘'di dus dme'i dpon byilha0

rgyud rdzogs nas/ chab 'bangs rnams dpon mo a skyong bza' bde sgron dang / blon po dme dkon gnyis kyis 'dzin pa'i skabs/ yin stabs/ dme dkon nas rje nyid kyi drung du sngon skyabs rje gong ma bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis dme'i rgyal sa 'di chos skyong tshangs pa dang / gzhi bdag dar 'dzoms la gtad/de nas rgyal khang du khong gi dbu zhwa dang / tshangs pa'i rten mdos sogs bzhugs sungagasol nas mnga' thang 'phel rgyas su mdzad pa'i bka' drin bskyangs na yang / bar skabs 'dir lhung bab shin tu che bas dbu mnabs med skad dang / lha srung rnams kyang 'khu ldog sna tshogs ston pa'i gdug pa can zhig tu song bas/ 'ga' res chos skyong dngos med par 'dre ngan zhig gnas 'dug zer ba'ang yod pas/ de dag ji ltar yin gyi gsung gsal —dang / bcos rim gang dgos nyid nas cis kyang gnang rgyu'i bka' drin skyong dgos tshul yang yang zhus kyang re zhig lan ma gnang / nyin gcig yongs 'dzin tshang nas/ de la gsung lan zhig cis kyang gnang dgos pa 'dra zhus par/ sku gong ma'i dbu mnabs kyang yod/ chos skyong mi bzhugs pa min yang grib kyis mnol ba shin tu che bas/ yig brgya 'bum dang / tshangs pa'i bskang bshags khri bcas basmyabs na bcos thabs yod 321

gsungs shing dme dkon la yang de bzhin gsungs nas/ rim gro de dag gnad smin sgrub bcug de skabs rang gzhan thams cad rgyal khang de'i nang lta zhog nye 'khor du 'gro ba'ang dogs 'dzem byed pa'i skabs yin yang / nyin gcig rje nyid rgyal khang rnying ba'i nang du byon nas dbu mnabs ngos 'dzin mdzad cing /de dang sku thang rten mdos sogs rgyal khang gsar bskrun du spyan drangs te mchod bkur sogs kyi thugs bkod dang / da phyin chad sngar bzhin dar bo 'byung nges kyi brtse ba'i bka' mchid gnang’’zhes gsungs/ 'di skor la bshad tshul gzhan yod 'dug kyang / rnam thar nang du 'di bzhin 'dug des na rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i lcags sprelu skabs a skyong bza' bde sgron dang dme dkon gyis dbang bzung 'dug yang rnam thar de las‘‘rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags rta (1870)lo gsar tshes skabs/ bsang mchod legs byas rol mtsho ljags rtsom mdzad’’ces dang / ‘‘dme rgyal blon rnams nas yang yang gsol ba btab pa bzhin dgon gsar 'debs kyi sa 'tshol bar phebs ’zhes dang / ‘‘sa brtag bslangs sbyangs pa'i lto 'phye'i thig gdab pa sogs mdzad nas sa mig brko ba'i skabs me tog gi char bab/ dbal shul nas dme'i sras dod du blangs 32lha

pa dme rgyal lcags thar 'bum gyis 'di dus dung dkar chajigacig phulasmo zhes gsungs pas/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags rta lor dpal shul lcags thar 'bum dme rgyal bo byas zin 'dugayang rnam thar de las/ ‘‘rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags sbrul (1881)lo'i thad du/ bla brang dang khyo kho'i dbal yum(da lta dbal ban tshang zer) mi mthun pa'i gyod ngan de rgya je cher song ste/ khyo kho khag gsum dang / mgo log khang rgan/ rnga ba'i dme rgyal sogs dpung bsgril ba la/ sde dge'i phyag mdzod btsan po mas bla brang lha sde stod smad/ mdzod dge a mchog sog po tshun gyi dmag dpung bsdus nas g.yul bkyes pas/ mgo log gis gtsos pha rol gyi dmag mi grangs mang bsad cing /dbal yum sde rnams bcom pa sogs 'khrug tshabs che ba byung / zhes gsungs pas/ khyo kho khag gsum bla brang gi mi sder 'gyur ba/ rab tshes lcags rta (1870)lo yin 'dra/ dgung lo zhe bdun pa shing lug (1895)lor/ dme tshang dang mkhar gsar gyi gyod bshad ces gsungs/ dme skor sde ba ni/ dme rgyal khang bi thag nyer yod mod/dbang du bsdu ma thub/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ dme skor shog gis bla brang dang khro chu la mgo btags/ dme skor gyi don du so mang nga 323

zhes skra dkar ma'i dus slosu/ tsha chen so mang tshang gis rnga ba'i dme tshang gi thog la dmaji/ shom gcig byas/ so mang rgyal sa stong nas khro chu'i nga ro dbang chen gyis so mang gi mnga' 'bangs la dbang bsgyur ba'i skabs su/ yang khro chu'i dmag dme tshang gi steng du 'ongs par/ a mchog tshang sogs kyis bar 'dum byas te phyir log zer/ ngo stod rdor zhar dpon sogs tsho ba drug mnga' 'og tu bsdu ma thub/ rdod+ku zhar dang thengs du mar thug pa sogs skarti'i rnam thar sogs su yod/ phyis su rnga stod tsho druka bla brang gi lha sder gyur stabs mnga' 'og tu ma chud pa red zer/ rnga smad dme tshang sogs kyi skabs so / / rnga stod ni a ran lung ba yan chod rnga stod du brtsi zer/sngon dus su a ran tsho ba gsum zer la/ de gsum ni/ tsho druga.a 'dus/ spro tshigs gsum red la/ de rjes rnga stod tsho brgyad zer ba ni/ zi ba/ sna shul/ ra 'tsham/ sngo shul/ rgya stod/zhang nge skas bzhi/ a 'dus/ spro tshigs dang brgyad/ wa stod dpon phran nyer lnga yod zer/ de dag gi nang nas che shos rgya stod rdor zher tshang yin la/ dme tshang dang lan du mar thug mod/ dme tshang gi dbang du ma 'dus/ dme rgyal mo a 'bos bza'i skabs su/ rdor zhar gyi sde phal cher dme tshang gis phrogs 324

pa la brten kun mkhyon 'jigs med dbang bo la skyabs btsal ba yin 'dug ste/ mdo smad chos 'byung las/ ‘‘rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags khyi (1790)lor skyabs rje nyid ('jigs med dbang bo) phyogs 'dir chibs bsgyur mdzad/ rdor zhar dpon pos rang zhabs sde phal cher gzhan du shor bas skyabs 'tshol zhus/ dme rgyal mo a 'bos bza' la gsung gnang ste/ sngo shul dang / zi stod gnyis khyod la thob par byed/ sde lhag ma rnams phyir byin zhes gsung gnang yang mos dang len ma byas/ de'i don du sku tshab chun du phur btang bas zung 'phan gyi sa sgo byas/ a ran tsho brgyad kyi sde thams cad dme 'og nas blangs te sku zhabs kyi (kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbong bo) lha 'bangs su sbyar/ mchod gnas kyi dgon pa zhig dgos zhes zhu sa par/ rje nyid nas sras kyi thu bo gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bka' gnang ste lcags phag lor khong dang zung 'phan tā zhin 'ong ba zung 'brel gyis rgyud grwa btsugs ’zhes gsungs pas/ de dus rnga stod tsho brgyad kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i lha 'bangs su gyur/ phyis nas bla brang gi sku tshab 'ongs nas bcings 'grol bar du rnga stod kyi dbang bzung ba yin/ spro tshigs bar skabs shig nas dme 'og tu chud/ de rjes zhing skyong pha bu'i ring la a 325

'dus kyi dpon dag gis dme tshang la mgo btags/ de'i shulagyi rnga stod tsho drug ni/ bcings 'grol bar du bla brang gi lha sde byas mod/ bla brang yab kyi dus su rnga stod rdor zharadzādang bla brang ma mthun par/ bla brang gi dmag 'ongs nas phan tshun gsod rmas dang / phan tshun khang ba mer bsregs pa sogs mi ser la gyong rag mthar rdor zhar sgrub lo khro chu'i dpon kun dga' yar 'phel gyis khro chu'i khog tu khrid nas bsad pa sogs/ bai stod kyi sde gzar snyog gra che zer mod/ zhib cha ma nges so/ /rnga stod kyi skabs so/ /spruzhi 2/ nado snad nu zho rgyuska luska skyosko rdod gi sken/rnam dkar sa bon grung bo de/ /byin rlabs drod kyis nyer bskyangs pa/ /rgud pa kun sel yongs 'du ljon/ /slar yang dar ba'i dpal rgyas shog /'dir mdo smad kyi bod mi'i sa khul gyi bod mi dag gi 'byung khungs rags tsam gleng ba la/ deng dus bkan shan zhes pa'i grong khyer dang / lun khron zhes pa'i sa gnas 'di dag ni lo stong phrag du ma'i snga rol tu bod mi 'dus sdod kyi sa khul yin 326

la/ rjes sor thang rgyal rabs chos dar srid dar gyi dbang thang che bar gyur pa'i skabs su bod mi mtha' 'ded kyis/ thang gis sa khul mang bor dmag gi rten gzhi btsugs te/ sa 'di phyogs su grong rdal mang bo btsugs par grags/ de rjes bod kyi btsan po srong btsanartsosgam po'i mnga' thang rab tu rgyas nas bod dmag 'bum phrag du ma drangs te/ thang gi mtha' khul gyi grong rdal mang bo lhag med du bcom zhing / mtha' mtshams srung ba'i bod dmag 'bum phrag du ma gtan sdod byed pa'i sa gnas btsugs/de dus 'dzam gling du skad grags che ba'i dmag 'khrug byas pa'i sa cha/ zung chu(7stsa )zhes pa'i chu bo'i mjug dang nye ba'i ri sgang la sa rdo 'dres pa'i gyang brdungs pa'i 'thab rdzong mthon po mang bo yod pa deng sang da dung ma zhig par yod/ de dus su mtha' mtshams srung ba'i dmag mi gtan sdod byas pa'i bod mi ni/ rgyal mo tsha rong gi sa gnas kyi tsha kho zhes grags pa'i bod mi 'di dag yin te/ phyis su rgyal phran bco brgyad du gyes pa ni/bkan shan gyi lung dgu rgyal bo nas khams kyi lcags la rgyal bo'i bar gyi rgyal phran rnams yin/ rī rgyul rong rgyal khag bco brgyud ces grags pa'i bod kyi 327

motha' mtshams srung ba'i rgyal phran bco brgyad ni/1 lcags la(gloṭha7yozi7ske)/ 1 mgo smad dam ka la((ṭ+wāṣ+ṭha.oṃske〉/ tī mgo stod(mi 7ṣ+ṭha.oṃtha)/ 4 dge shis tsa(sasgolkoṣ+ṭha77) 5 pa wam(mokhulosbyo 7)/po brag steng (1khulozi77)/ 7 mu phyi(r+ṣasto 77)/8 mda' mdo(ṣ+pelkoṣ+ṭhami7 )/ 9 btsan lha(sgru/no༅྾mi7)/1༷ 'og gzhi(stsakhyiṭ+wāṃsgoṣ+ṭha'i7 )/ 11 lung dgu(mdo gling yang zer(7oṃzirtsa —spe))/ 11 rgyal kha(lkobi〉 7ma)/1lnga so mang (ṣ+ṭha྾ṣ+ṭhastu/7 )/ 1bhe cog tse(sgoṭ+wāṃzloṣ+ṭhatshiske )/ 15 rdzi 'gag(glolguṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha7 ) 1po bstan pa(ṭ+wāṃpoṣ+ṭha.oṃp+lu )/ 1gyi khro skyabs(yāmostoṣ+ṭha7sto) 18 chu chen(rki༅tsho7ma )/ te bco brgyad do/ /srong btsan dang thang 'khrugs te bod dmag gis bcom pa'i mkhar shul ni rnga ba'i mkhar shul dag yin te/ sa 'og nas thon pa'i so phag dang /— khro zangs sogs kyi thog thang rabs kyi yi ge 'dug ces zer/ gzhan yang lung zi'i mkhar chag ces grags pa'i mkhar shul dang / lung zi'i nyag ga'i lho ngos kyi chu dang 'om bu'i chu/ gser thang brgyud de 'ongs pa'i chu 'dres/ mtshams kyi gad thog gi rgya mkhar zhes grags pa'i sa de yang de 3lhabyi

dus kyi mkhar shul red/ de bzhin du mdzod dge ru rgya grong chags nas zhing btab shul gsal bo yod/ 'on kyang mkhar shul yod tshad srong btsan skabs bcom pa'i mkhar shul ma yin te/ bod rgyal gyi chab srid nyams nas bod sil bur 'thor ba'i dus su yang / rgya mkhar 'ga' zhig chags gagling seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyis gtan bcom byas pa yang yod de/ dper na/mdzod dge bzhag ldom gyi khang gsar dgon gyi mdun ngos/ bra bo sde ba'i dgun sa yod sa'i mkhar shul de ni/ gling seng chen gyi dus su bcom pa'i mkhar shul yin la/ de lta bu sa gzhan du'ang yod la ri sgang du rgya'i dgon shul yang yod do/ / rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi bod mi 'di dag gi rus ni sbra yin te/ mdo smad chos 'byung las gsungs pa ltar rgyal rong rgyal khag rnams kyi rus ni sbra yin te/ rigs der tsha kho rang skad la nga rtsi zer/ de yang bod kyi rigs la/ bswe/ rmu/ldong / stong dang bzhi/ rigs bzang rnams la sngar zhang bo zer la/ phyis su lha rigs sgo zer/ bswe rigs bzang rnams la bswe chung spra zer/ rmu rigs bzang rnams la dmu tsha sga zer/ldong rigs bzang rnams la a spo ldong zer/ stong rigs bzang rnams la a lcags dzabru zer/ rigs bzhi'i steng du 329

dba' dang zla gnyis te drug la mi'u gdung drug tu grags/ de'i nang nas bswe dang sbra gcig par bshad/ sngon gyi rgyal rabs rnams su bswe chung 'bras zhes pa'ang spra dang tha/cig gam gsungs/des na rgyal rong gi sa cha 'di rnams sbra rigs kyis bzung gshis/rus mdzod las/ 'gag dog mo gsum po sbra la thob/ spra dpa' rtsal che ba de don yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar mdo khams rong chen bzhi'i nang tshan/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi 'gag dog sa gsum spras thob ces gsungs so/ /sbra rigs de la spra dkar dang spra nag spra khra'i rigs sogs du ma yod de/ mi'u gdung drug gi rus mdzod las/ ‘‘shar rgyal mo rong gi rgyal bo sngon ma byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje'i sprul ba mdo bzher nag po zhes pa de sbra nag po'i rigs yin la/tsho bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi sprul ba lo tsā ba chen po pa gor bai ro tsa na yul rgyal mo rong der byon dus kyi rgyal bo de yin/ yul de'i rgyal rigs su 'khrungs pa g.yu sgra snying bo zhes pa/ lo tsā ba chen po de'i slob mar gyur pa rgyal mo g.yu sgrar grags pa sogs byung zhing / yul der bstan pa snga 'gyur gyi dam pa'i chos yang de nas bzung ste dar bar bshad do/ /de nas bzung rgyal bo mdo bzher nag po'i gdung rigs 330

der tshig bsdus dzis rgyal nag gdung rigs zer ba rgyung khrir tsho grags/ ’’ zhes gsungs so/ /rgyal bo mdo bzher nag po'i gdung rigs da dung yang yod de/ khyim de'i ming la rgyal nag lcags mgon tshang zer/ gzhan yang rgyal rong gi mi rgyud dang dpon rgyud dag ni mi'u gdung drug gi rus mdzod sogs rus mdzod rnams su rgyas par yod/ shes 'dod na de dag tu ltos/yul der/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong zer ba'i rgyu mtshan rong ston shes bya kun rig gi dngos slob/ bon gyi slob dpon shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar las/ ‘‘dang bo skye ba bzhes tshul ni/ /'khrungs yul shar phyogs rgyal mo rong / /dmu rdo lha gnyan nye ba'i gnas/ /’ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal mo'i dmu rdo zhes grags pa'i lha ri mtho zhing brjid pa de'i ri rgyud dang bcas yul lung chen po der rgyal mo rong zhes grags pa/ bod kyi sa gnas gzhan las tsha ba cung che ba'i sa yispyo gshis rgyal mo tsha ba rong zhes 'bod/ tshig bsdus nas rgyal rong zhes brjod par byed/ gro nas sran gsum sogs 'bru rigs 'byung ba'i rong khog yin stabs/ rgyal rong / the rong / dgu rong / rong bo reb gong bzhi la mdo smad kyi rong chen bzhi zhes grags pa dang / yang rgyal rong / the rong / dgu rong gsum la mdo smad kyi rong chen 331

gsum zhis bri sa pa'ang yod/ shar rgyalī mo rong / lho tsha ba rong /nub kong bo rong / byang a stag rong bzhi la bod gangs can gyi rong chen bzhi zer/ ci lha ri rgyal mo'i da mu rdo 'di la/ dmu rdo dbang phyug zer zhing / de'i 'khor du sku bla rnam gsum/ gnyan chen sde bzhi/ri bo drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis bskor ba/ sgrub gnas brgya dang rtsa brgyad sogs yod la/ sku bla rnam gsum ni/ 'og gzhi sku bla/ha nyung sku bla/ rtse mdo sku bla/ gnyan chen sde bzhi ni/ sho wo gnyan chen/ sa wo gnyan chen/ g.yu 'brug gnyan chen/ tho wo gnyan chen zer/ sku bla ni/ sngon rgya mi 'ga' zhig gis/ de rgya skad du bsgyur tshe/ yul skad de'i klog sgra la brten nas/ ‘‘si gos lang ’ ( ༅smoṭha)zhes bsgyur/ der brten 'ga' zhig gis rtog bzo'i sgrung gtam zhig kyang bzos par grags/ lha gnyan la sku bla zer ba ni bod mi'i gna' bo'i zer srol yin te/tun hong gi gter yig las thon pa'i mo yig las/ ‘‘thab lha ni dga'/ sku bla ni dgyes/ ’zhes sogs mang du 'byung ngo / /khri srong lde btsan gyi dus gye slob dpon bai ro tsa na rgyang 'phud btang skabs rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi (rdzi 'gag tu rgyal sa bzung bas rdzi 'gag rgyal bo'ang zer la/ gu ru mtsho rgyal gyi rnam 332

thar las/ gzi 'gag ces yod/ deng sang 'ga' zhig gis rdzong 'gag ces bris pa'ang yod) khams rgyal mdo bzher nag pos thog mar sbal dong dang shig dong du 'phen pa sogs ngan las sna dgu byas mod/ phyis su sku srog la cung zad kyang ma gnod pas dad pa skyes te/ sbyin bdag gi mthil mdzad nas rgyal sa'i nye 'dabs su mdo lugs kyi dgon pa gyi bo nor bu'i gling dang / khro chu'i mthil du sngags lugs kyi dgon pa bde chem/ gling zhes pa btab/ gyi bo nor bu'i gling ni rdzi 'gag rgyal bo na rim gyis bskyangs te/ rab byung bcu gcig bcu gnyis pa'i bar der/rdzi 'gag gi khams rgyal nga ci tshe dbang grags rgyal jo nang la dad pas/ 'dzam thang gi jo nang ba'i bla ma bsten nas/ gyi bo nor bu'i gling 'dir jo nang gi 'don cha 'ga' zhig 'don bcug pa dang / rje btsun tā ra na tha'i stong sku sogs bzhengs/ rjes sor mnakyiching chen lung gis dbang bsgyur skabs/ chu chen lha steng dgon pa dge lugs su bsgyur te/ rgyal rong yul gyi dgon sde mtha' dag gi lte ba byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ de'i skabs su gyi bo nor bu'i gling 'di'ang dge lugs su gyur te/ smon lam lnga mchod sogs kyang dge lugs pa ltar byas/ khro chu'i yul gyi bde chen gling ni phyis su chos lugs gsar rnying gnyis su gyur te/333

rang rang gi lugs ltar byed pa las phan tshun 'gog rgol sogs med/ de ltar bai ro tsa nas btagapa'i dgon pa gnyis kyang bcos bsgyur skabs su gtor bshig byung la/ khyad par rig gsar god chags kyi skabs su lhag med du bcom/ 'on kyang khro chu'i bde chen gling la rgyal khab kyis gsol ras gnang ste bskyar gso byed bzhin yod/ gyi bo nor bu'i gling gi dgon shul du grong sde chags nas yod la bskyar gso sogs byed kyin yod med ma shes/ 'bar khams nas yar spyi le bcu lhag song mtshams ri'i sked du bai ro tsa na'i sgrub phug yod/ bcos bsgyur sngon du der ri khrod pa bzhi lnga zhig yod/ deng sang skabs tsam rer 'dug mkhan yod/ bdag kyang der song nas zhag brgyad la bsdad/ mi ser rnams rgyun du mjal phyag byed du 'gro bzhin yod/ tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i rnam thar du rgyal rong khog tu slebs skabs bai ro'i sgrub phug tu bzhugs gsung ba'ang gnas 'di yin zer/ dmu dge'i smad kyi brag rgan zhes pa'i gnas rir yang bai ro tsa na'i sgrub phug yod pa dang / shar dung rir yang sgrub phug yod ces mdo smad chos 'byung las gsungs pa ltar deng sang mjal rgyu yod/ zung chu'i smad kyi se bo dgon pa'i thag 334

nyir yang bai ro'i sgrub phug yod pa der deng sang sngags pa gcig bsdad yod/ de dang thag mi ring bar rdo ma ṇi zer ba'i gnas su/ rdo nag gi pha bong thog tu rdo dkar gyi ma ṇi rang byon mang bo yod pa de yang bai ro tsa nas gter sgo phyes pa yin par grags shing yin 'dug la/ gzhan yang khro skyabs thugs rje chen po'i gnas/rdo rje khro long sgrub phug ka ki seng ge yang rdzong / phrag gnas/khyung khu gnas zer ba 'di rnams kyang bai ro'i sgrub gnas yin zhes sngon gyi yig rnying na 'dug go/ /des na bai ro tsa na rgyang 'phud gtong sa'i yul ni/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong yin pa las lho tsha ba rong min/ sog zlog pa'i 'bri gung dpal 'dzin dgag lan nang du rgyal rong yul min lho tsha ba rong yin gsungs pa/ khong mdo smad du phebs ma myong zhing bzhugs yul mdo smad dang thag ha cang ring bas rgyus ma lon pa red do/ /rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi yul mi rnams la tsha kho zhes 'bod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ skabs shig bod kyi lha btsan pos kho phan zhes pa'i blon po zhig mngags nas yul 'di'i mgo dpon dang dmag dpon byas/ 'di'i rgyal sa'i khang shul ni rdzi 'gag gi srib ngos na yod/ de la btsan po'i srid gzhung gis btang ba'i bka' 335

shog dang chab shog gi thog tu/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi kho phan la zhes dang / tsha ba rong gi kho phan la zhes dang / tshig sdud byas te/ tsha kho la zhes bris pa dag gi rkyen gyis mgo dpon de la tsha kho zhes thogs pa dang / 7 rim gyis yul mi la'ang tsha kho zhes thogs pa yin zhes rus mdzod 'ga' zhig las bshad pa bzhin du/ mdo smad chos 'byung du'ang bkod 'dug pa ltar red/mdo smad chos 'byung las/ ‘‘mdo smad lho byang gi mi rgyud phal cher bod chos rgyal gyis rgya bod so mtshams su bzhag pa 'tha mtshed pa sha stag yin pas skad rigs la'ang brda rnying ma 'gyur ba mang / ’ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi yul skad 'di la bod kyi brda rnying ma 'gyur ba shas che ba yin te/ si tu paṇa chen gyi sum rtags 'grel chen las/ ‘‘khams phyogs kyi a mdo dang rgyal rong sogs byang shar gyi sa cha rnams su 'khod pa'i skye bo dag la'ang gna' bo'i dus su bod yul dbus nas byung ba'i klog tshul ma nyams pa yin par grags pa'i yi ge 'don tshul dang / de dag gi yul skad bcas la'ang cung nyams che tsam las/ 'phul rten sogs sgra dag par 'don pa byung ba mngon sum gyis grub’’ces gsungs so/ / des na rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi yul skad kyi nang brda rnying ches 336

mong ba dang / sgra drag chi ba'i dbang gis 'gyur ba dang / 'argyur che ba dang / nyams che drag pa'i dbang gis 'gyur ba dang /'gyur che ba sogs kyi dbang gis mi 'dra ba lta bur gyur pa'ang yod la dbus gtsang skad kyang rim gyis 'gyur ba'i— stabs kyis mi 'dra ba lta bur gyur mod/ ma gzhi rgyal rong gi skad 'di bod skad rang yin pa nged cag bod rang mtshan pa dang / bod yig shes pa dag gis bltas na shin tu gsal/ bod skad dang bod yig mi shes shing / rgyal rong gi skad kyang mi shes pa 'ga' zhig gis byudz+wargyal du smra bas/ dngos don lcags lta bu dag bsgyur ga la nus/ rgyal rong khog gi chu de la rgyal mo'i rngul chu zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rgyal mo dmu rdo'i lha chen po de nyid/ sems can gyi don du phebs bzhud gnang bas sku ngal te rngul ba'i chu yin zhes/ mkhas pa dag gis bstod bsngags kyi ming gsol te/bsang mchod dang mchod chog kyang brtsams/ des na rgyal mo rngul chu'i chu rgyud rgyal mo tsha ba rong zhes grags pa'i ri lung kun ni/ sbra rigs kyis bzung / rgyal mo rngul chu'i chu mgo zangs dkar smad kyi mjug gi thad/ lha’rgyalartegling (sa 'di la rgya—mi dgagis bsra cin si(lo/)༅r+sha)zer te/ chos par lha khang zhes pa red/337

skabs su bod dmag gis blangs te/ bod dmag sbra rigs kyis bzung / dmag dpon bsod nams mgon zer ba mtha' mtshams slung ba'i dmag dpon byas te bsdad pa/ phyis su rgyal phran bco brgyad kyi nang tshan mdo gling rgyal bo'am lung dgu rgyal bo yang zer lha rgyal gling nas yag sha la zhes pa'i la chen brgal ba'i pha rol nas khro chu zhes pa'i chu rgyud lung lag dang bcas pa'i sa 'di dag ni srong btsan gyi dus su dbus nas 'ongs pa'i mtha' mtshams srung ba'i dmag sde gcig gis bzung ste gtan sdod byas/khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su de dag gis mgo dpon la gyen log byas stabs/ dbus nas lha btsan po'i srid gzhung gis/ mda' dar dkon mchog skyabs zhes pa dmag dang bcas pa mngags nas/ so mang rgyal sa yod sa der bsdad/ kho'i 'khor la mda' bzo mkhan zhig yod pa de dmag dpon du bskos/ dmag mi lnga brgya dang bcas pa khro chu'i yul du song nas ngo log bde 'jags su btang / mda' mkhan de nyid khro chu'i spyi dpon du bskos te rdo'i mkhar brtsigs nas gzhi bzung ba'i sa de la rdo mkhar zer/ sgra cung zad nyams te/ rdo kha zer ba dang kho tsho'i skad gdangs las glo kha yang zer/ mda' mkhan gyi dpon rgyud rnams kyis rim 339

bzhin gzhis ka dang ri sde bgos te khro chu'i yul la dbang bsgyur/rgyal phran bco brgyad kyi nang gi so mang rgyal bo'i mnga' 'bangs su gtogs/ rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i nang du khro chu'i smad kyi dpon/ ri ngar rtsa dang / nang so spun gnyis dbang thang che bar gyur te/ dge lugs pa'i bla ma rnams dang / mi ser la btsir gnon cher byas stabs/ 'bangs gyen log byung nas gnyis ka bsad/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i stod tsam la/ so mang rgyal bo'i rgyal rgyud chad de/ mda' mkhan tshang gi dpon nga ro dbang chen gyis/ so mang rgyal bo'i mnga' 'bangs yongs la lo gsum gyi bar du dbang bsgyur/ de'i bu nga ro dbang sdud kyi dus nas bzung re zhig gi bar du/ mda' mkhan gyi dpon rgyud rnams kyis ya nga zhing skyug bro ba'i nang 'khrug dang nang dme byas/ phyis su gyod bsdums te rdo rje dpal bzang gi sring mo nga zhi lha sgron mda' mkhan dpon nga ro dbang sdud kyi bu nga ro dgra 'dul la bag mar btang yang / cher ma 'gyangs par yang nang 'khrug langs te nga ro dgra 'dul bsad/ de rjes yang gyod bshad nas nga zhi lha sgron la khro chu'i stod kyi dpon po kun dga' yar 'phel mag par bzhag ste khro chu'i spyi dpon byas mod/ rdo rje dpal bzang blo rig rgod cing rigs rgyud mang bas dbang thang dang snyan 34lgi

grags che bar gyur te/ bcings 'grol bar dbang bzung /bcings 'grol skabs bcings 'grol dmag la 'gog rgol byas kyang / g.yul pham nas mgo brtags pas/ thog mar rang skyong srid gzhung gi drung chen gzhon pa'i go gnas byin pa dang / phyis su rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi srid gros khang gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa'i go gnas sprad/ 1957lor dbus mjal du dgongs zhu thob ste song / der bstun nas rgya gar du song ste lo shas bsdad/ de nas1973lor ca na tar song nas lo bdun lhag la bsdad/ 1980lo'i zla10bar rang yul du phyir 'khor te gtan 'dug bye da rgyu byas pas/ srid gzhung gis si khron zhing chen srid gros khang gi rgyun las u yon gyi go gnas gnang / 1981lo'i zla12tshes12nyin 'jig rten pha rol tu phyin/ gzhung sger gyis dge sgrub rgya chen po byas so/ /zangs dkar stod nas zhing khong la brgal te rta bo'i nyin lam gnyis tsam song ba na dmu dge'i yul yod/ dmu dge'i yul mi ni snga dus su phyogs 'dus kyi mi du ma zhig yul der 'dus sdod byas pa yin 'dug dmu dge zhes pa'i ming thogs tshul ni/dmu dge'i byang phyogs su a zhig sgom khang zer ba'i brag skyibs su/ bon po a zhig gi ri khrod pa zhig yod pa la 'tsho rten du ra 34/

ma kha shas yod pa dmu dge'i mi rnams kyis rgyun du brkus pa la/bon po a zhig dang snang zhig gnyi sa kyis zla sgril byas nas mthu basbrubs te dmod mo byas kyang / dmu dge'i mi rnams sngar las lhag par dar zhing rgyas stabs bon rnams kyis mi de dag la dmos na dge bar 'gyur 'dug zer ba la brten/ mi de dag la dmod dge nes pa'i ming chags/ phyis su brda 'gyur nas dmu dge zhes su grags so/ /de la sde ba bco brgyad yod/ stod tsho dgu dang / smad tsho dgu gnyis phyes shing / stod tsho dgu ni/nor ba ru('di 'brog las kho na yin)/ sog po ru/ wa tshang ru/ bya tshang ru/ khe tshang ru/ sde ba 'di bzhi la stod tsho bzhi zer/ chos ru/ a mgon ru/ a rngang ru/ a chu ru/ sde ba 'di bzhi la cha rngang tsho bzhi zer/ nor ba ru/ stod tsho bzhi/cha rngang tsho bzhi ste sde ba 'di dgu la stod tsho dgu zer/sngo ther ru/ bar zhing ru/ a gsa' ru/ shes rab ru/sde ba 'di bzhi la chu chung tsho bzhi zer/ rgyam kho ru/ dge yag ru/ brag shong ru/ smad pa ru/ sde ba 'di bzhi la smad tsho bzhi zer/ de'i 'og tu bla ro ru zhes pa'i sde ba gcig yod/ de dang / chu chung tsho bzhi dang / smadasmotsho bzhi ste sde ba 'di dgu la smad tsho dgu zer/ de ltar sde ba bco brgyad po 'di la/ dmu 342

dgi'i sde bco brgyad zer zhing grags/ ru ba zhis pa/ phyis su brda 'gyur nas ro zhes 'bod par snang ste/ deng sang / nor ba ro/ sog po ro zhes 'bod par snang / sog po ru'i steng gi ltem thog tu dmu dge'i dgon chen zhes grags pa de yod/ sa de ni tsha kho ngag dbang grags pas 'jigs byed gshin rje gshed kyi 'phrul 'khor skor sa yin stabs bkra shis 'khor lo'i sgang zer la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis dgon pa'i mtshan la yang bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon zhes grags pa'i dgon pa yod la/ de ni tsha kho ngag dbang grags pas btab pa yin payolo lnga brgya lhag song ba'i dgon rnying zhig red/ chos 'dul ba'i kun spyod gtsang zhing 'chad nyan 'phel ba'i dgon sde grags pa can zhig yin/deng sang gi sa khra'i thog tu/ a mgon ru la a dgan ro zhes dang / a rngang ru la/ a sngon ro zhes dang / mgo ba ro zhes pa'i gtan med kyi sde ba zhig bsnan pa sogs/ dngos tshul dang mi mthun pa'i gtam mi nyung ba re bris 'dug yul de ra ming thogs tshul bshad na/ dmu dge zhes pa'i ming thogs tshul gong du bshad zin pa ltar yin/ stod tsho dgu'i nang tshan nor ba ru niri/ 'og gi zhing ba rnams kyi phyugs rigs 343

'tsho skyong du rtswa chu bzang sa der 'ongs nas bsdad pa phyis su 3 gzhis chags pa la nor ba ru zhes ming chags/ nor zhes pa phyugs rigs kyi spyi ming du 'bod pa'i stabs kyis/ phyugs rigs 'tsho mkhan la nor ba/ zhes 'bod pa'i goms 'dris byung /de'i 'og gi sde ba sog po ru/ zhes pa sngar sog po'i phyogs nas mi bdun sprang 'khyams lta bur byas nas 'ongs te/ sa der thog mar 'dug sa'i sa de la/ sprang bo'i gad thog zer/ de nas sa der zhing las byas te dar zhing rgyas nas sog po ru zer ba'i mi sde 'di chags/ de'i 'og gi sngar sa stong skabs wa mo'i tshang yod sa de la zhing las byas te gzhi chags pa la wa tshang ru zer/ de'i 'og tu sngar sa stong skabs shing sdong sogs su bya'i tshang mang bo yod pa'i sa der yang sngar bzhin gzhi chags pa'i sde ba la bya tshang ru zer/de'i 'og tu gzhi chags pa'i sde ba khe tshong ru zhes pa ni/thog rīmar khe tshong byas nas phyug por gyur pa'i khyim tshang zhig gis gzhi bzung bas/ khe tshong ru zhes thogs/ nor ba ma brtsis pa'i gong gi sde ba bzhi la stod tsho bzhi zer/ dzode'i 'og gi sde ba la sngar bla grwa du ma yod pas chos dang dge ba la 'bad pas/ chos ru nes thogs/344
