de'i 'og tu a mgon zer ba'i mi zhig tshogis gzhi bzung jibs/ a mgon ru zhes thogs/de'i 'og tu mdzod dge'i a skyid smad kyi a rngang zhes pa'i dpon rgyud cig 'ongs nas sa der gzhi bzung ste/ ru sde chags/dpon rgyud de dbang thang che bar gyur nas/ yul de'i dpon du gyur/ de'i sde ba yang a rngang ru/ zhes 'bod/de'i 'og gi sde ba'i ming la/ a chu lung ba'i chu'i ming la brten nas/ a chu ru zer/ 'di la rgya mi bu mo spun gsum gyis gzhi bzung bas a lce zer zhes sa khra'i thog tu bris pa khungs med pa'i rdzun gtam red/ a chu lung ba de la deng sang shing ra zer zhing / lung ba'i kha stod la shing ra'i kha zer/ gong gi sde ba de bzhi la cha rngang tsho bzhi zer zhing / sde ba 'di bzhi dang stod tsho bzhi nor ba dang bcas pa'i sde ba 'di dgu la stod tsho dgu zer/zhing khong gi chu dang / dmu dge'i chu 'dres mtshams kyi ri sngo ljang gi ther khug tu zhing btab nas gzhi chags pa'i sde ba la sngo ther ru/ sngo ther dang de'i stod kyi 'brong tsha zer ba'i sa cha gnyis kyi bar du zhing sa gshin po yod sar gzhi chags pa'i sde ba la bar zhing ru zer/ zhing khong chu'i byang gi lung lag cig gi nang du/sdog mar shes rab zer ba'i mi zhig gis gzhi bzung —ste rim gyis 345

sdi bar chags pa la shis rab ru zer/ sa de'i g.yon phyogs kyi ltem thog cig la/ thog mar a gsa' zhes bya ba'i mi zhig gis gzhi bzung nas rim gyis sde bar chags pa la/ a gsa' ru zer/ sde ba de bzhi la chu chung tsho bzhi zer/rgyam kho zer ba'i mi zhig gis gzhi bzung ste chags pa'i sde ba la rgyam kho ru zer/ de'i 'og tu dge yag ces pa'i mi zhig gis gzhi bzung nas chags pa'i sde ba la/ dge yag ru zer/de'i 'og tu brag ri'i gshong yod sar chags pa'i sde ba la brag gshong ru zer/ de'i 'og gi sde ba la smad pa ru zer/ sde ba de bzhi la smad tsho bzhi zer/ de'i 'og tu bla ro ru zer ba yod la/sde ba de ni gna' dus su dmu dge'i stod kyi brag rtsa zer ba'i sa char bsdad pa la lo thog mi legs stabs/ deng dus yod sar spor nas bsdad/ sa der bla ro zer ba ni/ sngon gyi gtam rgyud la/ de la bon gyi bla ma zhig grongs nas/ gdung de gar sbas pas/ sa de la bla ro zer/ zhes pa'i bshad srol 'dug chu chung tsho bzhi/ smad tsho bzhi/ bla ro ru dang dgu la smad tsho dgu zer/spyor bod kyi ru zer ba ni dmag sde'i don yin zhing / dper na/ dmag gi dar dang mdung dar sogs la ru mtshon zer/'brog gi sde tshom la ru ba zer/ dmu dger yang sngar/ nor ba 346

ru ba/ sog po ru ba/ wa tshang ru ba/ bya tshang ru ba/ khe tshongaru ba/ chos ru ba/ zhes sogs su 'bod / phyis su ru ba zhes pa mgyogs brjod kyi tshig sdud lta bur gyur nas/ ru ba zhes pa ro zhes pa'i sgra dang 'dra bar gyur stabs/ deng sang sog po ro/wa tshang ro zhes 'bod pa lta bur snang /bcings 'grol sngon du zhib rtsis ma shes mod/ khyim tshang bdun brgya yas mas yod pa dang / mi grangs yang stong lnga lhag yod zer/ bcos bsgyur skabs su/ phyi nang gi rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis zing 'khrug byung stabs/ mi grangs je nyung du cher song / sngar rgya rigs tshong ba kha shas las/ gzhis chags kyi rgya mi med zer/ hos rigs yod skad ma thos/sngon dus su nor ba ru ba 'brog las kho na dang / gzhan rnams rong 'brog 'dres ma yin gshis 'tsho ba'ang ha cang skyo bo yang min la/ ha cang phyug po'ang min/ dgon pa'i nang rdzong khag gzhan nas 'ongs pa'i chos dang mtshan nyid/ rig gnas sogs slob mkhan grwa ba lnga brgya drug brgya yod gshis/ dge bshes/ sman pa/ lha bzo/ yig rigs/ rtsis rig la mkhas pa sogs shes yon can mi nyung ba yod/ grong sde'i nang du slob grwa med mod/ sger gyis dge rgan btsal nas yi ge dang / sman 347

rig rtsis rika lha bzo/ chos sogs slob mkhan mi nyung ba re yod gshis/ rig gnas 'phrod bsten sogs kyi thad du ha cang rjes lus min la/ ha cang sngon thon kyang min/ lag shes bzo las skor la/ rdo bzo/ shing bzo/ lcags mgar/ dngul mgar/ ko mnyed phying 'jog pags mnyed snam bu dang re ba 'thag las/ gos bzo sogs/ mi rigs rang gi 'tsho thabs la 'dang ba'i lag shes bzo las yod/ snam bu'ang shing gi snyeraphrul 'khor la brten nas bzo bas ha cang rjes lus min/yul de'i mi rnams kyi 'tsho rten ni zhing las dang 'brog las yin par ma zad/ nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa'i nang du sha ba dang gla ba dom dred wa sram sogs ri dwags sna tshogs pa yod pa dang / spang ljongs dang spang ri rgya chen po yod gshis/ de dag tu sman a nyi ṣa ( 'iyi)dang / spang spos/ lhum rtsa/spru nag dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu/ nags tshal du/ thang shing /stag shing / seng ldeng sogs shing rigs sna tshogs yod/ de'i stabs kyis 'brog nas skams lug mar chur/ pags pa dang tsha ru/ bal khul dang phying ba sogs khyer nas 'bru rigs dang /shing sna tshogs las byas pa'i bca' lag nyo ru 'ongs/ rgya yul nas gos dar dang ja sogs khyer nas a khyi dzi dang / spang spos 348

sogs sman/ sha ra/gla rtsi sogs nyo ru 'ongs/ rong phyogs nasagayer ma la cos shing thog sna tshogs khyer nas/ mar chur/ bal khul/ ja mar sogs nyo ru 'ongs nas nyo tshong rgyas shing / dgon pa'i 'cham sogs dus chen skabs lhag par tshong las sogs 'khrug po yod/gnam gaXs spyi/ spyi zla lnga ba yar mar nas ri thang thams cad sngo ljang nger 'gro/ khu byug grags/ spyi zla drug pa nas rtswa chu rab tu rgyas/ spyi zla bdun pa yar mar nas ri thang kun tu me tog sna tshogs rgyas te khra dmar tsig ge yod/ spyi zla brgyad pa yar mar skabs su 'bru rigs kyi snye ma ser shig shig yin pas 'breg ran/ grong ba rnams kyis/ zla rtsis kyi hor zla dang bo bya zla bar brtsi bas hor zla bzhi ba nas daphyid mgo tshugs te rtswa lo dang shing lo rgyas pas gtam dpe la/ byi ba ri sngo thang sngo/ glang rtswa spyo chu smyo/ stag khra dmar tsig ge/ yos bu nas zan/ zhes zer/dbyar dro grang mnyam pas skyid/ nags tshal mang zhing char chu mod pas than pa 'byung ba srid mtha' tsam/ stod tsho bzhi dang /chu chung tsho bzhi'i nang gi shes rab dang / a gsa' sde ba gnyis te sde ba drug po la/ lo 'ga' re'i mtshams su bad brgyab ste lo thog la sad 'byung dus yod/ smad tsho bzhi la btsa' byung ste 349

gnod pa 'byung dus yod/ skabs 'ga' rer ser ba'i gnod pa 'byung dus yod/ ser 'gog sngags pa lo ltar yod/ rang byung gi gnod pa de dag gtso bo red/ 'bu gnod dang / byi bas gnod pa dang / ri bong gis gnod pa sogs bdag gis shes rjes cher 'byung ma myong / ston rtswa brngas te dgun phyugs rigs kyis dgun dpyid brgal thabs byed pa dang / 'bud shing 'bor chen bsdu/ hor zla dang bor lo sar dus ston dang /dgon pa'i smon lam chos tshogs skabs mjal skor sogs byed/hor zla dang bo'i zla smad nas/ bong ba brdung ba rdul phung sreg pa/ lud skyel ba sogs zhing las kyi 'go 'dzugs/ hor zla gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i mtshams su zhing 'debs/ gtso bo nas yin la smad du kro sran yang legs/ zhing btab tshar nas/ skyes pa rnams ri dwags rngon pa dang / sman brko ru 'gro/ hor zla drug pa'i zla mjug yar mar la skyes pa dang bud med du ma sman brko ru 'gro/ zla bdun par dgon pa'i rigs grwa'i sha 'cham la mjal zhing / dus de yar mar nas zhing brnga/ de rjes ston rmo rdzogs nas/ rtswa sngon brngas te dgun rtswa gra sgrig byed pa sogs yul de'i goms srol yin/ sa khra'i thog tu dbyar bad mi 'bab dus med zer ba sogs 350

rgyus med kyi gtam sna tshogs shig bris 'dug stabs/ 'dir gnas tshul ngo ma ngo sprod byas pa yin/sa 'di dag ni gna' dus bod mi 'dus sdod kyi sa cha yin mod/ rgya nag thang rgyal bo stobs che ba'i skabs su/ thang gis sa cha 'di tsho bzung ste mkhar brtsigs pa'i shul tsam re yod mod/rjes sor lha btsan po srong btsan sgam pos dmag gis thang mtha' skrod btang rjes/ rim bzhin bod mi dag gis sa bzung ba yin la/ bod sil bur thor ba'i rjes su sde shog gi lam lugs dang / rgya nag rgyal bo sung gi dus mjug tu/ hor gur dkar gyi btsan 'dzul dmag gis re zhig tsam du sa 'di tsho bzung mod/gling che sar seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyis hor dmag pham par byas nas gling gis dbang bsgyur/ hor jing sgar (tsho.oṃska ) gyis dbang bsgyur skabs su sa skya ba dbang bsgyur 'og tu gnas/tā ming gi skabs ( 7mi )su rgya dmag we kru'u dang zung chu'i bar du 'ongs nas/ rgya bod kyi 'khrug zing thengs mang byung yang /dmu dge'i yul 'dir rgya dmag slebs pa'i lo rgyus med mod/ yul 'di'i bod dmag 'ga' rgya dmag gi gdong len du thengs shas song yod las che/stong skor gnyis pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ stong skor gsum pa 35lha

rgyal ba rgya mtsho gnyis sngar dmu dger phebs myong ba'i 'brel la brten/ dmu dge'i dge bshes bka' bcu shākya sogs dmangs kyis bkur zhing dbangasache ba rnams kyis stong skor mdo rgyud rgya mtsho gdan drangs nas dgon pa phul/ mdo rgyud rgya mtsho ni rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa yos (1639)lor stong skor rgyal ba rgya ma tsho rgya phrug lo bcu dgu can zhig gi ro la 'pho ba grong 'jug mdzad pa'i mkhas grub grags pa can zhig tu gyur pa yin zhes sku 'bum gdan rabs sogs rnam thar kha shas na 'dug gang ltar rgya sog bod gsum gyis dad gus byed sa zhig yin 'dug khong gis/ dgon pa'i 'du khang / byams khang / mgon khang sogs ba'engs pa dang / bzhi skor zhes pa'i gzim khang chen po bzhi thog ma bzhengs/ de'i ming la bzhi skor zer/ 'di bas dmu dge sde bco brgyad/ shar kha le tshe bco brgyad(zung chu'i phyogs kyi sde)/nags ri khag gsum(chu nag dang khro chu sogs)/ zangs dkar a mchog byams thang khro kho/ kha nag dbal shul/ rnga ba sogs la dbang bsgyur/ phyogs de'i rgyal bo lta bur gyur/ zhi drag zung 'brel gyi sgo nas/ de phyogs kyi bon phal cher ban der bsgyur/ sa gnas so sor gzhis ka mang bo brtsigs/ dgon pa'i gtor sgrub dang / 'cham la sogs pa btsugs/ zhes rnam 35lha

thar dang / mdo smad chos 'byung du'ang yod/ de'i sprul sku/stong skor bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dus/ zi khron nas rgya dmag 'ongs pa 'gog ma thub par/ dgon pa ha mtha' bla ma la gtad/snye thang gi gzhis ka sa zhing bcas bde tshang khri rgan la gtad de/khong nyid rang dgon du phebs so(zi ling stong skor)/ /de nas yul 'di ching rgyal rabs kyi dbang 'og tu shor te/'go dpon dag pe cin du song nas thob zhwa dang / thob gos len dgos byung mod/ lo re bzhin khyim gyi sa zhing mang nyung dang bstun nas mā leng (yī7)zer ba'i 'bru khral nyung shas shig 'bul rgyu las/ gzhan 'brel ba ci yang byed mi dgos/lcags phag lo'i gsar brje'i phyi lor rgya bod 'khrugs nas zung chu'i rgya mkhar nang gi khang ba thams cad bod kyis me la bsregs kyang / dmu dge de'i gras su ma song ba red zer/de nas go min tang gis dbang bsgyur ba'i skabs su'ang / zung chu'i rdzong dpon la sngar gyi man ching gi dus ltar mā leng zer ba'i 'bru khral nyung shas de 'bul dgos/ de las gzhan rta khral/zog khral/ dmag khral/ dngul khral sogs ci yang mi dgos/'on kyang dpon ngan za rngam can re 'ongs nas/ gyod btsal rgyu za'i gnas tshul thengs 'ga' re byung myong mod/ 'khrug zing 353

tshabs chen byung ma myong ba 'dra/ dpon pos gyod bshad na gzu zan zhes pa za rgyu las/ gtan khel gyi khral sogs med/dmar dmag rgyang bskyod skabs dmu dger krung dbyang chab srid cu sa kyi gros tshogs 'tshogs/ nga gnyis lor bdag pe cin nas rang yul du yong skabs da dung dgon pa ma gtor/ ma'o tse tung 'dug sa'i khang ba dang / rtsa 'dzugs pu'u/ dril bsgrags pu'u/ dmag u rnams 'dug sa'i khang ba'i kha byang dag kyang yod la/ dril bsgragasasna kyi yi ge yang khang ba'i phyi nang dang / shing sdong sogs la bris pa shin tu mang ngo /bcings 'grol byas nas nga drug par gzhung 'bru sngar las mang tsam 'bul dgos byung ba las gnas tshul la 'gyur ldog ma byung / nga drug lor sa zhing dang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas pa dang / nga brgyad lor dgon pa bcos bsgyur byas te/gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thugs rten mang che ba gtor bshig byas/ bcos bsgyur 'di dag ni dgos nges gal chen zhig yin mod/ byed thabs kyi nang du thal che ba'i nor 'khrul 'ga' zhig byung song zer/ de dag la brten nas lo shas la dmu dge'i yul 'di sogs su zing 'khrug 'jags dka' ba byung /de rjes mnyam las khang dang thun mong za khang sogs bye54

btsugs/ gzhung 'bru dang lhag 'bru 'bor chen 'bul ba—tsong dang / mchong skyod chen po zer ba'i srid jus kyi skyon dang /rang byung gnod 'tshe sogs rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas mu ge dang nad yams kyis mi du ma shi/ yul 'dir zing 'khrug kyang du ma byung / gong 'og 'di dag gi skabs su mi du ma btson 'jugagleng 'gel/ rdzun 'gel nor 'khrul yin pa'i gyod gzhi mang du byung / de rjes rig gnas gsar brje chen po zhes pa byung nas ta kre la slob sbyong byed pa dang / lha sa'i dgun gro 'debs bcug pa sogs las ka ha cang ljid la/ lto gos ha cang dka' ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal myong / dgon pa'i gtsug ltag khang dang / sku gsung thugs rten gyi lhag ro rnams rtsa med du btang / slar yang zing 'khrug byung ba sogs lo du ma'i ring la dka' tshegs bar ma chad pa byung ngo / /de rjes skabs bcu gcig pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs nas bzung rim gyis mi rnams kyi bsam pa dang thon skyed 'tsho ba je bzang la song / tang dang rgyal khab kyi tshogs 'du thengs re bzhin srid jus je bzang la song ba dang /thon skyed 'gan 'khur lam lugs dngos 'bab sogs dang 355

chabs ci ga mi rnams kyi mthun sgril dang thon skyed brtson sems kyang rab tu rgyas/ yul 'dir nags tshal ha cang mang stabs nags las khang gis shing 'dren gyi don du gzhung lam bzos pas/ khrin tu nas dmu dge'i bar du gzhung lam shar rgyug yod pa'i stabs dang / srid jus legs par 'khor nas lo ltar lo legs byung stabs/ 'tsho ba lhag par bzang / sngar srid jus ngan pa'i skabs/ rang gi skad yig la spyod pa dang chos dad sogs la rang dbang med/ da lta slob grwa so sor rgya bod kyi yi ge zung 'brel du slob bzhin yod pa dang / dgon pa slar gso byung ste chos dad la rang dbang yod/ bcos bsgyur sngon lta bu'i grwa ba mang bortemed mod/ sngar las lhag pa'i gtsang dgon du gyur yod stabs/ mi ser lhag par dad gus che/ sngar rang sger thon skyed dang / tshong las sogs la rang dbang med la/ da lta rang dbang yod stabs dpal 'byor 'phel tshad mgyogs/ gcig gis gcig la gleng 'gel ba dang / rkun jag dang ma rabs kyi ngan spyod sogs bsdams pa'i spyi tshogs bde 'jags kyi 'grig lam yod gshis ha cang skyid po red 'dug sngar yul khams so so'i bar du 'gro 'ong gi dgongs pa lon dka' zhing / bkag 'gog che mod/ da lta yul tsho so sor phan tshun 'gro 'ong byed 356

chog pas nyams myong dang rig gnas dang mkho dngos brje res dang / tshong las/ phan tshun rgyus lon/ skad yig gcig 'gyur sogs la phan pa chen po byung ba sogs kyi rkyen las mi rnams dga' zhing spro ba'i rang mdangs kyi nyi ma shar ro/ /bcings 'grol sngon bran g.yog lam lugs red zer mod/bran g.yog lam lugs kyi mtshan nyid tshang ma tshang brtag dgos/sa khra'i thog tu bris pa dag gi nang du/ nor 'khrul 'ga' zhig yod pa mthong nas 'dir cung zad rgyas pa bris so/ /dmu dge'i 'og tu bdag ge zhes pa'i yul tsho zhig yod la/mdo khams stod du bdag ge zhes pa'i ldong rigs shig yod pa de nas chad pa e yin snyam/ cha lugs goms 'dris chos lugs dmu dge ji lta ba bzhin yin/ mchod gnas dang grwa sa yang dmu dge'i dgon pa la byed/ bcings 'grol gong du zung chu'i khrims 'go ba'i mnga' 'og red/ bcings 'grol rjes su spyi lo 1963lo'i bar du dmu dge'i khongs su gtogs par byas/ de rjes khro chu rdzong gi khongs su gtogs par byas so/ / dmu dge'i yul de nas byung ba'i chu de la chu nag zer zhing /chu de'i smad kyi chu rgyud dang / lung lag rnams la chu nag khog gam/ chu nag gi yul zhes grags/ de dag tu yul sde/ dbo 357

to/ klu spong / tshas ru khag gsum/ kho tse thang / nur we/khri ci khri dgu/ ges ju/ shwa bed/ ra mgo'i khog g.yag mgo'i khog pa tse/ 'bos zhi sogs kyi yul yod/ chu nag gi yul gyi mi rnamasatshuni/ bod chos rgyal gyi dus su rgya bod kyi so mtshams su bzhag pa'i dmag gi mi rgyud yin la/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi las rigs bzang lnga bsal ba nas bzung rang rang gi bla zog yod de/ldong gi bla zog sha ba/ 'bri'i bla zog g.yag sbra'i bla zog rkyang /sga'i bla zog lug sgo'i bla zog ra yin la/ chu nag gi sgo yi rigs rnams kyi bla zog ra yin pas/ khang thog tu ra mgo 'bri ba'am bca'/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis de dag gi yul lung la ra mgo'i khog zer/ chu nag gi 'bri yi rigs rnams kyi bla zog g.yag yin pas/khang thog tu g.yag mgo 'bri ba'am bca' bar byed pas/ de dag gi yul la g.yag mgo'i khog ces grags so/ /deng sang chu nag dang khro chu gnyis zla sgril byas te khro chu rdzong zhes pa btsugs/ rgya mi dag gis he thos shan ( ṭha7khuspro )zer ba dang / khro chu la tā he thos(oṃtsho7khri )zer ba dang / chu nag la sho he thos ( 7/noṭhasmokhri)zhes pa'i ming btags/ khro chu'i khog gi chu de chu nag dang 'dres pa'i chu nag de dang zung chu'i chu 'dres mtshams la chu da kar chu nag 'dres mtshams zer/ deng sang der rdo zam 358

yod/ ( chu/7snu༄ne)de yar mar zhig nas/ rta dmag zer ba de yod/ deng sang de la khyang rigs (lkoṣ+ṭha)zer/ skad rigs khro chu dang chu nag gi skad dang 'dra/ ra ma mang bas ra lpags kyi stod gos phu dung med pa gyon pa shas che/ 'di yang bod kyi gna'i dmag gi cha lugs yin te/ bod dmag khri dpon gyis stag lpags kyi stod gos dang / stong dpon gyis gzig lpags kyi stod gos dang / dmag dkyug ma dag gis ra lug gi pags pa'i stod gos phu dung med pa gyon par sngon gyi yig rnying dang rgya'i lo rgyus dag las bshad/ chos lugs kyang yi ge med mod/ phas bu la blo thog nas slob pa lta bus/ gshin po'i gri 'dul/ gson po'i rim gro la/ sngags dang gto chog mi dang bca' lag la lha 'beb pa sogs byed/ de dag kun kyang yi ge med par blo thog nas byed pa red/ de dag ni gna' dus kyi 'khyar bon dang /rdol bon gyi lugs de yin par nges/ 'di dag deng sang khyang rigs yin zer yang khungs med/ bstan 'gyur dkar chag nor bu'i phreng ba'i co ni dpon gyi lo rgyus thad bltas na/nub byang phyogs su chang ming (choṭha)zer ba zhig yod pa ching gong ma khang shis rgya man bod gsum gyi dmag btang nas gtan med byas shing / bya ba de'i thad co ni dpon gyis lag rjes bzhag 3bya 9

pas/ dpon chen gyi go gnas thob par bshad pa las/ 'di phyogs su snade 'dra'i mi rigs yod par zur tsam yang med/ we kru'u (ṭha )// )phyogs kyi sa 'di thams cad srong btsan gyi dus su bod dmag gis bzung bar bshad la/ glang dar bkrongs rjes yang da dung sa 'di bod kyi dmag gis bzung yod par nges te/ thang yig gsar ma las byung ba'i bod chen po'i srid lugs dang 'brel ba'i deb ther seng ge'i nga ro zhes bya ba las/ ‘‘po li (tshotsha)nas ta hi (oṃ7)khri lo'i bar du/ bhod nas pho nya ba skyes 'bul du mngags/ ta hi khri lo lnga bar/ bhod kyi we kru'u sa srung dmag dpon stsan mo (sh+tsa jar+ṣa)bya bas mkhar dang bcas thang la phul te mgo btags/ can nan zhi khron gyi ce tu'u hri'i thabs yod pa li te yu bya bas mkhar de'i dpon rigs kyi tham ka dang go cha rnams rtsis blangs/ yu tshang can bya ba mkhar slung du mngags/ we kru'u lho phyogs ni rmin cang (speṣ+perku)gtsang bo dang / shar phyogs ni ri bo rmin hran dang 'brel/ nub byang nas ri bo lung hran( 7 )mthong thub/ phyogs gcig ri dang 'brel zhing / mtha' gsum rmin cang gtsang bos bskor/ bhod pas de la 'o yug mkhar zhes bya/ de thang gi lho nub phyogs kyi sa brtsan po zhig yin/ skabs der/ nyig zin ru'u (waṃ༈khri.au)bya360

bas rgyal srid gnyer gyem/ yod pas/ stsan mo bya ba dang 'o yug mkhar kyang bhod la phyir spradari’ces dang / stsan mo zer bas mkhar de thang la phul ba'i bar der rgya mi mang bo 'ongs nas mkhar der bsdad pa dag bod kyis rtsa med btang ba yin te/ yang thang yig de las/ ‘‘bhod kyis mkhar de'i mi rnams rabs dgu brgyud nas bcad de tsho ba gzhan dag la 'jigs bskul’’ zhes rgya mkhar dang rgya yul gzhan dag la'ang 'jigs snang bskul bar bshad/bod rgyal glang dar ma bkrongs rjes/ bod rgyal srid gzhung la jus nyes byung nas/ bod kha 'thor du 'gro grabs yod pa'i skabs su'ang / we kru'u sogs kyi sa 'di thams cad bod dmag sha stag gis bzung ba yin te/ thang yig de las‘‘bhod kyi dmag dpon zhang kho bzher(kho྾sa)bya ba lo min khron gyi tha'o ci hrir bskos/ de'i rus ni smon dang mtshan la/ nong legs zhes bya/bzher zhes pa ni rgya yi lang (khritsā)bya ba dang don mtshungs/ kho blo dang thabs la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin te/ ru sde gsum nas rta dmag khri phrag bdams te/ hran kru'u ce tu'u hri'i thabs yod pa zhang pe pe(tsholkolko)bcom du song / we kru'u la slebs pa na po han hran (dzi oṃ7)bya ba'i sa cha la blon chen zhang yu blo (lodze+eṣ+ṭha36 /

tsho) bya ba dang dmag 'thab byas/ zhang yu blo pham ste sung kru'u la log nas/ sum pa(smokhroji)dang / 'a zha (loci po)/zhang zhung (stoṭha) bcas kyi dmag mi brgyad khri bsdus nas tha'o hros gtsang bo'i (tshi7khri) rgyud du sgar btabari’ces dang / bod kyi blon chen rnams kyis nang 'khrug 'ba' zhig byed pa'i skabs su'ang we kru'u sogs bod kyis bzung ba yin te/ thang yig de las‘‘hun mo (ṣ+ṭhalko) la cin mo (baṣ+ṭhalko) zhes kyang bya/ de ni bhod kyi bran g.yog las grub pa zhig yin/ bhod kyi lugs srol ltar na/ dmag byed dus mi drag tsho'i khyim nas dmag bsdu ba la/ kho tshos rang gi 'khor g.yog rjes su khrid pa yin/ dmag khom dus g.yog 'khor tshos/ so nam dang phyugs kyi 'tsho skyong byed pa yin/ zhang kho bzher gyis 'khrug zing slong skabs/ g.yog 'khor rnams la bdag byed mkhan ma mchis pas kho tsho lhan du 'dzoms nas mi stong phrag 'ga' longs pa dang / kho tsho rang gis wun mo zhes 'bod/ de rnams kan kru'u/ su'u kru'u/ bkwa' kru'u/ hra kru'u/ hi kru'u/ we kru'u/ yīn kru'u/ ko kru'u/ de kru'u/ ting kru'u bcas kyi sa char sdod pa dang /btsan po'i gur dang thag nye ba rnams dpa' zhing rta yang mgyogs pa zhig yin skad’’ces bshad do/ / 36lha

gzhan yang khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su'ang rlu kru'u sogs skejibod kyi sa cha yin zhing / bod kyi 'bangs dang dmag gis bzung ba las mi rigs gzhan zhig med par gsal te/ bod kyi blon chen zhang rgyal btsan(lodzi7)dang / rgya'i dpon chen krang dbyi (74tshe ) gnyis kyis/ ching hros (tsho 74) sa cha nas mjal 'dum byas te/ sa mtshams thag gcod pa'i chings yig las/'di ltar thag bcad de/ thang yig de las‘‘thang gi sa mtshams ni cin kru'u (ṣ+ṭha ’khri) nub phyogs nas than krin zha(sa34༷ji)bar dang / lung kri (2n+t+ra) nub phyogs nas cin thos bar/ glin kru'u nub nas thung kru'u bar/ can nan (tram̐//tshe) gyi nub nas zhi hran (otshe) dang chu bo ta tu'u thos(lkoṣ+ṭha7khri)bar du yin/ bhod kyi sa mtshams ni lan kru'u (༅)spo) dang / we kru'u (tsho)khri/) /yon kru'u (ḍā 〉/ /)/ ho kru'u (waṃ 〉//) bcas dang / nub tu lin tha'o (/khrimyadi)/ shar khrin kru'u ('a ska/) nas can nan bar/ nub tu mo zhe rgyud kyi spyang khag(ṭhasprayāpha)rnams yod pa dang / chu bo ta tu'u thos lho nub rgyud du yin zhes bshad/ de ltar bod kyi lha btsan pos srid gzhung dang / thang rgyal rabs nas/ ching rgyal rabs dang go min tang gi bar du 'di gar rgya bod hor gsum las mi rigs gzhan pa zhig yod pa'i lo rgyus kyi yi ge mthong rgyu med par 363

ma zad mi rigs gzhan zhig yod dzi'i gtam tsam yang med do/ /sngar 'di dag la rta dmag zer ba las khyang zer ba gtan nas med/ lha btsan po'i srid gzhung yod pa'i skabs su sa mtshams srung ba'i rta dmag tu bzhag pa dang / bod kyi blon chen zhang kho bzher dang / zhang yu blo dang / stsan mo sogs kyis we kru'u la sdod pa'i blon chen byed skabs kyang de dag gi rta dmag yod par thang yig las bshad/ bcings 'grol bar du de dag gi ming la rta dmag dang / lung ba'i ming gi thog nas la bong zer/khyang zer ba'i sgra tsam yang med/ co ne'i bstan 'gyur dkar chag nor bu'i phreng ba las/ co ne dpon gyi lo rgyus bshad skabs/ nub byang phyogs su chang ming (lkoṭha) zhig yod pa la/ching gong ma khang shis/ man rgya bod gsum gyi dmag mngags te/rgya mir bsgyur ba dang / gsod gcod kyis rtsa med du btang ba dang / las 'gul de'i nang co ne dpon gyis lag rjes bzhag pas gzengs bstod bgyis te go gnas sprad/ de'i stabs kyis co ne dpon de'i mnga' thang rgyas/ de'i skabs su chang zhes pa 'ga' zhig bros byol byas pa'i lo rgyus med la/ byed kyang mi thub ste ching gi mnga' thang rab tu rgyas shing rgya bod gnyis kyi sa gnas kun dam du bcings pa'i skabs yin pa dang / khyad par du de'i 364

skabs si khron phyogs 'dir ching dmag gis bzung zhing skabs skabs su sngog bsher byed pa'i skabs yin gshis chang dum zhig 'ongs nas sdod pa'i skabs med kyang gnas med do/ / spyir bod yul ni sa cha rgya che zhing / yul sde dag phyogs phyogs su 'thor sdod mang gshis// yul skad dag kyang mi 'dra ba mang bo zhig yod/ des na/ khro chu dang / chu nag la bong rta dmag 'di rnams kyi skad gcig pa ni/ sngon bod thang 'khrug pa'i skabs su yul gru gcig nas rta dmag bsdus te 'ongs pa'i dmag yin stabs de dag gi yul skad gcig yin pa red/ der ma zad de dag gtsang gi yul gru zhig nas 'ong shul gyi yul skad cung zad 'gyur yod pa ma gtogs/ 'di dag gi skad dang gcig pa red ces bod mi kha shas kyis bshad pa thos/ de bden pa red snyam/bod kyi rus chen bzhi dang / mi'u gdung drug sogs gong du bshad zin la/ gzhan yang bod kyi mi'u gdung drug gi rus mdzod la sa/ ‘‘sngo na bod 'dir rus chen lnga 'di byung ba nas bzung / rang rang gi bla zog de ni/ ldong gi sha ba/ 'bri'i g.yag spra'i rkyang / sga'i lug sgo'i bla zog ra yin par bzhed srol de bzhin’’zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rta dmag yul 'di'i tsho ba bcu dgu'i bla zog g.yag yin pa/ tsho ba bco brgyad kyi bla 365

zog ra yin stabs/ gzugs ris kyang 'bri bcos bgyid srol yod pas/ tsho ba bcu dgu ni bod kyi a lcags 'bri'i rigs yin pa dang / tsho ba bco brgyad ni lha rigs sgo'i rigs yin par gsal lo/ /yul de dag gi tsho ba la la'i bla zog g.yag yin pa/ tsho ba la la'i bla zog ra yin stabs/ gzugs ris kyang 'bri bcos bgyid srol yod pas/ tsho ba de dag gi la la a lcags 'bri'i rigs yin pa dang / la la lha rigs sgo'i rigs yin par gsal lo/ /yang rus mdzod las‘‘rigs bzang ngan gnyis su dbye ba nas bzung ste/ rang tshan rang tshan de rnams rang tshan byas nas phan tshun ma 'dres par yun du gnas pa la/ chos kyi sbyin pa'i riskabs su rigs bzang ngan yang shes par mngon la/ de nas rigs bzang bo rnams kyis rang shugs kyis las rnams sgrub la/ des bod kyi yul lha rnams dwangs pa chen pos mchod pas/de dag rnams la zhing bo sgo zhes zer la/ phyis su de rnams kyi rigs la zhing bo lha rigs sgo dang / bswe yi na nga gi rigs bzang gtso bo rnams la bswe chung spra/ de bzhin du smu yi nang gi rigs bzang gtso bo rnams la smu tsha sga/ ldong gi nang gi rigs bzang gtso bo rnams la a spo ldong / stong gi nang gi rigs bzang gtso bo rnams la a lcags 'bri'o/ /’’zhes gsungs pa dang / yang 366

jus mdzid de las/ ‘‘rus chen 'di dag la don gyi ming yang 'di ltar yod la/ ldong che gnyan can zhes rgyal chen mi bzhi sogs byung ba che gnyan che ba/ 'bri byas pa can zhes dgra la rgod pa/ sga yig tshang can zhes slob gnyer la mkhas pa/ sbra mi sna can zhes phyug dpal che ba/ zhing sgo zhes pa lha rigs dang lnga la rus chen sde lnga zer’’zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bla zog ra yin pa'i zhing sgo'i rigs ni lha rigs yin pas/ lha dgyes sa yin snyam pa dang / bla zog g.yag yin pa'i a lcags 'bri'i rigs ni/ 'bri byas pa can zhes dgra la rgod/ ces zer ba ltar dpa' bo yin pas/ rigs de gnyis kyis rta dmag bsgrigs nas rgya bod so mtshams we kru'u sogs su bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ ming la'ang rta dmag ces grags so/ /dpa' bo yin par grags so/ /gzhan yang / rus mdzod las/ sgo'i bla zog ra dang me khams yin pa dang / 'bri'i bla zog g.yag dang chu khams yin pas/la bong gi ra g.yag gi shog gnyis la'ang de lta bu'i bshad tshul yod 'dugabod kyi goms gshis/ sa mthor phyugs 'tsho skyong gi skabs ra lug ske slorge paX khod yangs shing phu rung che ba gyon pa dang /dmag la 'gro skabs/ stod thung dor ma stabs bde'i steng du 367

bir dang khrab rmog gyon pa dang / khri dpon gyis stag lngags kyi stod thung / stong dpon gyis gzig lpags kyi stod thung / dmag dmangs kyis ra lug gi pags pa'i stod thung gyon zhing / nang gos la phu rung yod la/ stod thung la phu rung med pa ni/ gri mdung dbyug bde ba'i ched yin la/ thang mtshams su dmag la yong skabs nags tshal nang nas 'bud shing gcod byed gri thung dang / dgra la 'thab byed gri ring yod pa/ glo g.yas su me cha la g.yu byur gyi phras brgyan pa 'dogs pa sogs bod spyi'i goms lugs yin pa ltar/ la bong yul tsho'i goms gshis kyang de 'dra yin stabs/ des kyang bod rigs yin pa shes nus so/ /des na 'di skor la bdag gis dang thog rtog dpyod ma zhugs kyang / phyis rgya bod kyi lo rgyus dag la dpyod skabs/ la bong sa cha'i rta dmag de dag bod yin pa las khyang zer ba min par mthong mod/ 'on kyang rang skyong khul gcig gi nang du bod dang mthun sgril gcig gyur byas nas/ lab gleng med par bde 'jags ngang yod gshis/ gnas tshul de legs snyam nas lab gleng cung zad tsam yang ma byas mod/ da lor bdag lan grur yod skabs pe cin nas 'ongs pa'i de ga'i 'thus mi dag gi ngag las/rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi khyang rigs zer ba zhig gis 368

bam̐d dang mnyam 'brel mi byed/ khyang rigs kyi rang skyong khul/zhig 'dzugs dgos sogs kyi gtam mang zhig lab kyin 'dug par ma zad/ lkog tu khyang rigs yar rgyas mi 'gro ba ni bod kyi gnon shugs red zer ba dang / krung dbyang la yar zhu'i yi ge phul te logs su rang skyong khul 'dzugs dgos zer ba thos/ de'i rkyen gyis/ nged kyi sems la lo rgyus zhib 'jug byas pa'i 'bras bu dag bshad na cis mi chog snyam ste 'di ltar bris nas dpyad gzhir phul ba yin pas/ dgongs khrel mi mdzad par zhu/ yul phyogs de dag gi goms gshis kyang de 'dra yin par shes so/ /lda bu/ nado snad spya zho rgyuska luska ṭīd n+tuk+ki py-igaska ñtsa zho rgyuska/dmu dge nas/ la rtse'i kha zhes pa'i la brgal na/ mkhar lung du slebs/ la de la mdo smad chos 'byung du myi ro la zhes bris 'dug mkhar lung gi chu rgyud du mkhar lung / mkhar yagaganya' yas tsho drug shwa ded/ zhang rngu/ 'ba' ra steng / sa 'di sngon gyi sung kru'u zhes pa'i mkhar shul red zer/ chu rgyud 'di'i sde ba rnams ni/ sngon khrims 'go ba'i sde ba red/ chu de krin ca mkhar nas zung chu'i chu dang 'dres/ zung chu'i chuci'ago ni kun dga' la'i tshur nang nas bzhur ba'i chu de red/ kun dga' 369

la dang de'i phyogs kyi ri rgyud la rgyas rmin hran (tsheṣ+pel) zeral /de phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i chu la rmin cang (yāyo) zer/ kun dga' la'i tshur nang nas 'ongs pa'i chu dang / ka ring la'i phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i chu gnyis/ bar ru zhes pa'i sa char gcig tu 'dres(deng sang de la bar rung zer) pas/ de nas chu de la zung chu zer/ sngar chu de gnyis 'dres mdo la zung chu zer la/phyis su chu rgyud de'i lung khog la zung chu zhes pa'i ming thogs/zung chu'i stod la/ sngon gyi ha 'phen 'go ba/ khri me 'go ba/rkyang tshang 'go ba 'di gsum gyi ru sde rnams yod la/ de gsum la khri skyong khag gsum zer/ sngar bod thang 'khrug pa'i skabs so mtshams srung ba'i khri dmag gsum bzhag pa'i mgo dpon la khri skyong zhes btags/ zung chu'i smad du/ a stong 'go ba/ rtag brtan 'go ba/ khrims 'go ba gsum gyi ru sde rnams yod la/'di gsum la smad kyi yin thos gsum zer/ de dag gi smad du ta shin dang sho shin gnyis yod/ de'i dpon ta shin 'go ba red/ gong gi 'go khag drug dang ta shin 'go ba ste bdun la/zung chu'i 'go khag bdun zer/ de dag la bcings 'grol sngon tsam du dud tshang stong gsum lhag yod zer/ de'i 'og tu/ mkhar chags 'go ba zhes pa'i 'og tu/ lo kan tsho brgyad ces pa yod/370

'di yang bod red/zung chu'i bod mi 'di rnams la/ gna' nas da bar shar ba zhes 'bod/ de'i rgyu mtshan stod mnga' ris sa char/ shar ba zer ba'i bod kyi yul tsho chen po zhig yod/ (r+shasrong btsan dang thang rgyal 'khrug pa'i skabs/ yul de nas dmag ru chen po gcig drangs te 'ongs pa rnams sa mtshams srung ched/ zung chu'i chu rgyud du bzhag pa yin la/ de dag sa 'dir 'ongs nas lo stong gcig dang sum brgya yar mar 'gor ba yin yang / da dung yul skad la bod skad brda rnying mang / dper na/ dkar bo la/ ke ru/ dmar bo la/ dme ru/ nag po la/ ne gu/ ser bo la/se ru zer ba lta bu/ 'di dag ni brda rnying yin te/ sngon gyi yig rnying 'ga' zhig dang / ma ṇi bka' 'bum du'ang mchod rten ser bo la mchod rten se ru zer ba lta bu/ gzhan yang nyin gung gi bza' btung la/ 'dze ra kha zer/ de brda rnying yin par li shi'i gur khang las gsungs/ brda rnying 'ga' zhig yod pa las/skad ni bod kyi spyi skad yin gshis/ stod dbus gtsang dang mnga' ris nas/ smad a mdo'i bar gyi skad dang mthun zhing phan tshun go thub/ zas gos goms 'dris sogs bod spyi ltar yin la/ thon 371

skyed ni/ rong 'brog 'dres ma'i lugs yin/ rong zas 'brog zas kun yod/ rgya bod kyi mtshams la yod gshis tshong las kyi stabs bde bas tshong ba yod la/ sngar mgo log dang / mtsho sngon tshwa kha sogs su khal ma mang bo ded nas 'gro ba'i tshong ba stobs ldan mi nyung ba yod/ chos lugs ban bon gnyis ka yod/ chos la shin tu dad pa bod spyi dang 'dra/ des na zung chu'i yul gyi shar ba 'di dag yong sa'i shar ba ni stod mnga' ris kyi bod yin la/ 'di dag ni bod ngo ma yin no/ /zung chu zhes pa'i ming thogs tshul sngar ltar chu gnyis kyi ming gi cha nas thogs pa yin mod/ sgra tsam la brten nas bris pa'i yi ge la/ zung ju dang / zung ji sogs bris pa ni zur chag pa'i ming yig go/ /rgyas yul 'di la zung 'phan(7mi)zer/spyir gong du bshad pa ltar/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum/bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug sogs bod yul 'dir lo stong phrag mang bo'i sngon nas/ spre'u dang brag srin mo gnyis las brgyud de mi'i 'gro ba rim gyis chags pa yin pa lo rgyus dang deb ther mang che ba mthun pa gong du bshad pa ltar yin la/ zung chu'i sa 'di yang gna' dus mdo smad spyi bod kyis bzung ba ltar bod mi dag gis bzung ba yin mod/ rgya'i lo 37lha

rgyus 'ga' zhig tu bod la spyang dang shas spyang(krelko)zer ba 5 sogs ni 'ga' zhig gis rang snang 'ba' zhig las btags par zad de/ bod kyi ming la gna' snga mo nas bod ces 'dod rgyal nig yod pa 'dzam gling ku na tu grags so/ /des na de dag gi 'khrul gzhi ni/ gna' dusangabod kyi rus bzhi lasagyes pa'i khams kyi ming 'dogs tshul ni/ ye sang dkar bo/ ye smon nag po/ mon rdzi nag po/ spyang khrig ye shes te bzhi yod la/ spyang khrig gi rigs la/ spyang zhes 'bod pas/ de'i sgra las/ bod spyi la de ltar btags par mngon zhes 'ga' zhig zer ba ltar yin/ dper na bod la mdo dbus gtsang gsum yod pa'i nang gi gtsang kho na'i sgra la brten nas/ deng sang bod thams cad la gtsang gi rigs (saṭha) zer ba ltar/ gzhan yang bod rigs bzhi'i nang gi bswe rigs bzang la/ sbra rigs zer zhing / sbru la dkar nag gnyis yod pa'i gnyis ka'i bla zog rkyang yin ca stabs/ bod kyi blon po zhikhokyirgya'i rgyal bo zhig gi drung du song skabs/ rgyal bos bod blon rme khyod kyi bla—zog gang red cesadris par/ nged kyi bla zog rkyang yin zhes lastobatab—par/ 'o/ nga'i bla zog yang rta yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis pho brang dzisgo'i nang du'ang rta bris yod/ e cag gi tshi zog gcig pa red zer nas/ bod la 373

rkyang zer zhes pa'i lo rgyus ltar/ de'i sgra las rkyang zer ba 'dra/zhes zer/ gang ltar rgya'i yi ge 'ga' zhig las zung chu'i satsho 'di sngon spyang ta sa kyi (cholo) sa yin zhes bshad 'dug pa/ don la bod kyi sa red ze ra ba red/ thang gi rgyal bo'i thog ma u te'i (7ṣ+ṭha) skabs su mdo smad kyi sa phal cher thang gi lag tu shor te/ sung kru'u (glo///) zhes pa'i sa khul btsugs/ de'i lte ba'i mkhar ni/ zhang rngu'i sa khul gyi 'ba' ra steng yin zer/ de'i mkhar shul deng dus yang shes/ thang the tsung (oṃlko) gi skabs su/ mdo smad du kru'u brgya lhag btsugs te bod kyi sa rgya chen po bzung bas/ bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po thugs khros te/ khri dmag bcu phrag du ma btang ste thang la lo brgyad kyi bar du 'thab pas thang pham/ sa thams cad phyir blangs/ kong jo srong btsan la btsun mor phul te 'a—grig 'dum byas/ de mtshungs zung chu'i sa 'di yang bod kyis blangs nas/ mnga' ris kyi shar ba zhes pa'i bod kyi yul tsho chen po nas drangs pa'i dmag rnams sa 'dir gtan sdod byed bcug pa/ zung chu'i shar ba zhes 'bod pa 'di rnams yin/ de rjes bod dang thang gnyis lan du mar 'khrugs mod/ mdo smad 'di blon po mgar gyi bu bzhiso bzung /bu che ba blon chen dang / gzhan gsum dmag dpon red/ de bye74

dus 'di phyogs kyi bod blon gyis gzhi bzung ba'i mkhar gtso bo la/ 'phan kru'u (stsa〉/) zer la/ de yod sa ni/ deng dus kyi chos rje dgon pa'i gong gi 'a zha zhes pa'i sa de yin pas/ mkhar shul yang da dung yod zer/ de skabs su mdo smad phyogs 'dir/ 'a zha dang / sum pa dang / gru gu dang / mi nyag sogs yod mod/ sum pa ni gnya' khri btsan pos bod gong bu gcig gyur byed pa'i skabs su/ d+kudabang du bsdu bya'i bod kyi rgyal phran bcu gnyis kyi grangs su yod pas bod yin/ 'a zha yang / rus mdzod las/ ‘‘ldong la rus chen bco brgyad grol/ seng rgyal 'a zha bu dgu grol/ mi zhes gsungs pa ltar 'a zha yang bod yin mod/ bod kyi rgyal phran 'di tsho skabs 'gar/ btsan po'i mnga' 'og tu mi sgur bas dmag song ༄nas 'dul dgos byung4ba red/ gru gu ni bod yin par mi snang yang bod kyis btsan 'dul byas te/ bod rigs su thim par nges/ mi nyag ni/ sngon bod rgyal la spun gsum yod pa'i gcig ni bod kyi rgyal bo dang / gcig ni 'brug pa'i(rkoṣ+pe) rgyal bro dang / gcig ni bzhin nag po can zhig yin pa mnga' ris dang bcas pa logs su bsdad pa la mi nag zer ba/ phyis su brda 'gyur nas mi nyag ( lngaྈ) ces grags mod rtsa ba bod yin no/ /375

hor rgyal rabs(yo.oṃ)kyi skabs su/ hor rgyal gyis bod chol kha gsum sa skya ba lartedabang yon du phul stabs/—dzā sa skyas bskos pa'i bod dpon 'dug sa ni zung chu'i a stosagi sa cha yin la/ a stong dgon pa'i gong du/ brdohrang mkhar zhes pa'i mkhar shul yod la/ ṣ+kadadzonye bar gling ba sang zhes pa'i khyi ma tshang yod sa de/ de dus kyi btson khang gi shul yin pas/ khang ba bskyar bzo byed skabs khang ba'i sa 'og nas/ btson chas 'ga' zhig bud zer/ gang ltar hor gyi skabayosu sa skya bas dbang bsgyur bas sngar bzhin bod kyis bzung /zung chu'i sa 'di yang thang the tsung dus nas lo bdun brgya bzhi bcu'i bar bodasterkyang bas bzung mod/ tā ming rgyal bo(7mo )hung u(tshipha) dus su rim gyisabod kyi sa cha wusakhron dang we kru'u/ mung kru'u sogs la rgya dam ga slebs te 'khrug rtsod byed bzhin zung chur slebs/ sngar gyi sung kru'u dang / 'phan spu'u gnyis gcig sdud byas te zung chu'i chu thog tu mkhar brtsigs/cin the'i(dz+ra.oṃ)skabs su mkhar nang du lha khang bzhengs te dgon pa byas/ lcags phag (1911)lo'i gsar brje'i bar du/ bod mi ser dmag gis zung chu'i mkhar lan gsum bsregs pa'i lo rgyus snang / 376

bcings 'grol byas rjes mkhar 'arir bde 'jags ngang gyu'adzugs skrun byed bzhin la/ lhag par da skabs dar zhing rgyas bzhin yod do/ //mdzod dgeḍi sa 'di mdo smad sagashan dag ltar/ gna' snga mor bod chags pa'i sa yul yin mod/ sngar bshad pa ltar thang gi rgyal bo dar ba'i skabs/ yul 'di dag thang gis bzung ste/ kru'u mang bo btsugs/ snorjesasrongabatsan sogasaubogardzibatsa na po stobs ldan dag gi dus su/ rgya mi mtha' skyod byas rjeyos 'di sa stong du gyur/ mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi dus su/ka ci'i mchod rten dkar bordziyan chod bod kyi mnga' 'og yin gyu stabs/ dga' ye she sa dar rgyas zer ba'i bod blon zhig khral bsdu ru 'ongs/ des sa 'dir chu bo bo gsum 'bab cing /rtswa chu shin tu bzang bas/ sa stong du bskyur mi bra/ sa 'dir 'brog sde 'dzugs dgos zer nasas 'a dir gzhi bzung / de'i bu rgyud che ba dga' stag thul can dang / chung ba dga' spyang thul can gnyis yin/ dga' stag ris can nam dga' stag thulacan gyi bu rgyud la bla ma dge 'dun zer ba byung / de dpon dang rgya nag tu 'gro ba'i bla ma chen po dag gi phyag mdzod byas/ 'gro 'ong mang du byas pas/ phyag mdzod daṣ+ka'adun nam/ mdzod pa 377

dge 'dun zhes ming can zhig byung / de'i mi rgyud ru sde bcas la mdzod dge zhes pa'i ming thogs/ spyang thul can gyi mi rgyud ni mdzod dgemismad dam/ mdzod dge dme bo zer ba de darnga / co ne'i dponargyud rnams yin/ rigs 'di la dga' rigs zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sngon bod kyi rgyal rigs rgyal sa ma thob pa zhig la bu med nas/ thang lha sogasalhul lha rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkhar 'ja' tshon dang bcas te bu zhig byung bas shin tu dga' bar gyur/ de'i rigs la dga' rigs zer/ rus chen bzhi'i nang gi sga rigs dang mi gcig ces rus mdzod las bshad/ mdzod dge 'dir bod kyi 'brog sde chags nas yun ring 'gor rjes/ rab byung ma tshugs gong gi drug cu skor de'i nang gling seng n+den byud nas/ hor gling 'khrug pa'i skabs/ thog mar hor 'di phyogs su slebs nas sa mang bo bzung mod/ gling gis hor dmag pha ma par byas te rma stod smad bar gsum gling gi mnga' 'og tu gyur/ gling gi srid nyams rjes sde shog so sor gyes/ rim gyis mdzod dge shog bcu gnyis su gyur/ mdzod dge shog bcu gnyis ni/ 'bos bo tshang / bzhag ldom/ gling ba/ gza' ru'i 'brog pa/ a skyid 'brog pa/ mdzod dge 378

stod ma/ byams me/ pan yus/ rkyang tsha/ 'breng ba/ tshong ru/ gza' ru rnams so/ /snga ma brgyad ni 'brog sde dang /phyi ma bzhi ni rong sde red/ thang skor ni byams me las chad pa dang / sog tshang ni sog tshang bla ma'i su hrug pa 'phel ba dang /nang ba ni chos rje bla ma'i su hrug pa 'phel ba yin zer/ dga' ye shes dar rgyas kyi rgyud pa rnams mdzod dge'i dpon khag so sor gyes tshul las/ stod ma'e dpon po'i rgyud pa ni/ mdzod dge'i dpon sngon mas reb bza'/ stag ring bza'/ 'bal bza' gsum blangs pa'i mna' ma gsum ga la bu gsum skyes/ mna' ma che ba reb bza'i bus rme stod bzung ba'i rgyud pa deng sang gi mdzod dge stod mar grags pa red gsungs/ mna' ma 'bring ba stag ring bza'i bus rma rme ska gsum gyi bar nas sa bzung ba'i rgyud pa mdzod dge byams me dang /mtshams shig thang bza' zhigatshublangs pa'i hūṃd pa la thang skor thogs/ 'di'i dpon bkra shis dbang dang sog tshang dpon pos ska rma 'dres mtshams su ri khrod btab pa da lta'i sog tshang dgon red/ ska chu ska bar stag rtse nas 'bab pa'i stod du a mchog smra seng gling gi mchod gzhis ra khog tsho ba brgyad yod/ byams me dpon gyis spyin bdag byas te/ 'bras spungs sgo mang gi 'bul 379

sdud pa 'phan po sman pa ngag dbang sbyin pas byams me'i dgon pa btab/ 'debs mkhan gyi dbang gis 'bras spungs dgon/ du grags/ mna' ma chung ba 'bal bza'i bu blo gros bzang / de'i bu rgyud 'bos dpon po/ gling ba'i dpon po/ bzhag ldom dpon po / mdzod dge smad kyi shog kha lnga'i dpon rnams kyang blo gros bzang gisami rgyud red zer/ 'bosadapon po 'bal bza' bu rgyud kyi pha khyim yin pas 'bal zur chag zer/ gling dpon rab brtan gyi bu a 'brug gis rma rme 'dres mtshams su sa bzung / lo brgyad cu lhag la bsdad kyang dgra rkun dang gyod zer ba rna bas thos ma myong bar grags/ 'di la bu bdun yod pa'i rgyud nga so sor gyes/ bu che 'og lcags rgyal gyi sde khrod du the bo bum pa'i ru ba mang bas bum skor zer/ 'bring bo a snying la'ang rgyud pa yod/'bring 'og a klum pha khyim du bsdad/ des mda' dam ra gzhung gi sa bzung ba'i rgyud pa la phyi ra stod smad bar gsum du grags /hu ra stod smad bar gsum yang 'di'i rgyud pa red zer/ a klum gyi bu chung ba'i rgyud pa bla ma tshul khrims rin chen gyis gling ba'i rwa bong dgon btab/ mdzod dge a 'brug gi chun ma ho bza' la bu gsum yod pa'i rgyud par ho bza'i bu rgyud zer/380

bzhag ldom ni bzhag ldom gyi mes po gong ma zhig gis glings ba dang dme byas/ pha yul dme rkyen du bzhag ste ldom nas song bas('gro mkhan mdzod dge dme bo yin) de ltar thogs zer/bong tshang gi rgyud pa bong tshang bla ma zer bas/ de phyogs kyi rnying myo/ bsgyur te gsar ma byas so/ /mdzod dge'i dbon dag ni/ dag 'a ye shes dar rgyas kyi mi rgyud yin gshis dga' rigs yin zer/ mi ser la nges pa med de/ mdzod dge stod ma lta bu la'ang / mgo tsha/ stag tsha/ phur tsha/ rag tsha ste/ ldong tsha chen bco brgyad kyi nang tshan gyi rigs yod pa lta bu gzhan la'ang yod do/ / zung chu'i yul nas kun dga' la brgal nas song ba na/nan phen yin/ yu la de'i mi rgyud dag kyang zhang zhupadang shar ba'i mi rgyud yin zhipa/ gzi tsha sde dgu lta bu ldong tsha chen bco brgyad kyi nang tshan gyi rigs yod la/ dasatsha sga'i rigs kyang yod par bshad/chu dkar gyi stod du/ sngarakong po'i khog nas 'ongs pa'i dmatha/ ṣ+kargyud pa yod/ deng sang brda 'gyur nas khong po zer/de nas dwags po nas 'ongs pa'i dmag༄ bod so mtshams su bzhag pa la/ dwags po zer zhing / rgyas de la bod dmag (oṃpaṃkyi381

zer la/ de dgagi ṅgems 'dris chos lugs sogs kyang bod spyi dang 'dra'o/ / lke zung chu nas ka ring la bgol te nub phyogs su song na dbal shul rme ba'i ru dang thug de'i dpon rigs rnams kyi rus ni dbal shul yin la/ mi ser dag la ni rus sna tshogs shig yod parastomangon/ me ba ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i mgor mdo khams stod kyi nyag rong gi sa nas sa 'dir 'ongs te gzhi chags pa zhig yin la/ de'i lo rgyus ni tshe dbang dpal ldan gyis bris pa lcags par la btab yod pas/ 'dir bskyar zlos mi byed do/ /bcos bsgyur rjes su rme ba gzhi byas nas de'i khar a mchog khag gsum/ gung thang lha sde dmag gsar ma/ skya mgo/ rong ru/ tsha ru/ tsha lung ste sde bzhi/ zangs dkar khag gsum bcas bsnan nas hung yon rdzong (poḍāspro) btsugs/ a mchog khag gsum ni gtsang bkra shis lhun po'am/ gzhis ka rtse'i thag nye'i a mchog ces pa'i sde ba las/ bod chos rgyal skabs dmag tu 'ongs pa dag gi mi rgyud yin/ sngar a mchog rgyal bo zhes pa'i mgo dpon zhig yod la/ phyis su de'i mi rgyud chad nas a mchog sprul sku'i lha sder gyur/ tsha ru/ tsha lung sogs ni mi rgyud tsha khor gtogs/ sngar cog tse rgyal bo'i mnga' 'bangs su gtogs/382

zangs dkur khag gsum ni stod mnga' ris kyi zangs dkar zhis pa'i yul nas 'ongs pa'i mi rgyud yin la/ sngon khro chu'i mda' mkhan tshang gi ru sde red/ 'di dag kyang thang bod 'khrug pa'i skabs su 'ongs pa'i dmag yin no/ /rdzong gi lte ba'i grong rdal ni khyung mchur chags yod/ (da dung kha gya tsho drug 'bo ra a mchog zam tsha she'u tshang sogs dang / mtsho sngon/ reb gong / dpal ris/ bka' ma log sogs kyi lo rgyus 'bri 'dun yod kyang brel dbang gis re zhig mtshams 'jog dgos byung / ) ji sgyu 383

bod du rig gnas dar tshul mdor bsdus bshad pa/rmad byung thugs bskyed mtsho las legs 'khrungs shing / /lung rtogs rin chen rdul mang rab tu spungs/ /sku bzhi'i bang rim mchog tu mdzes pa yi/ / bshes gnyen lhun po rtag tu rgyal gyur cig /sngon byon mkhas pa'i 'phrin las rlabs kyi phreng / /blun rmongs byis pa skrag pa'i rgyur gyur mod/ /don ldan gzigs pa rno ba'i skyes bu dag /dga' bas lag pad snying ga'i ngos su zum/ /de lta'i byung ba phyugs rdzi'i gling bu'i sgra/ / rgan po skyo ba sangs pa'i grogs su sbran/ /skal mnyam khyod kyang rna ba cung gtod la/ /dga' ba'i 'dzum zhal cung zad ston cig ang / /de la 'dir bod kyi rig gnas dar tshul bshad pa la/384

sprusnyan da sda dan / sku2ska sgyu sdod du nig gnaska dan sgyulu/bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal bo'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po yin la/ de nas mu khri btsan po/ deng—gyibatsan po/ sho khri btsan po (so khri'ang zer) / me khri btsan po/ gdags khri btsan po/ srib khri btsan po ste gnam gyi khri bdun du gragasapa 'di dag gi dus su rig gnas sogs dar tshul gyi lo rgyus ma mthong / de nas gri gum btsan po/ rgyal bo 'dis blon po dang 'thab pa'i dus su khrab blangs pas khrab spyod pa'i thog ma yin ske zer/ de naspospu de gung rgyal/ de'i blon po ru las skyes ni 'phrul blon mdzangs pa'i mi bdun gyi thog ma yin la/ rgyal blon de gnyis kyi ring la thong gshol bzo ba dang zhing la chu 'dren pa sogs zhing las dar ba'i 'go tshugs pha dang / gser dngul zangs lcags kyi rdo'i gter kha phud de bzhu len sogs bzo las cung dar ba dang / chu la zam 'dzugs pa sogs 'grim 'grulagyi lam sogs la'ang yar rgyas che tsam byung ba dang / yang 'di'i dus bon sgrung lde'u gsum byung ba rig gnas kyi grangs su brtsi/bon ni dge sgrub lha mchod 'dre 'dul mo rtsis sogs dang / sgrung 385

ni/ ro langs gser sgrub kyi sgrung dang / ma sangs sgrung dang /mchil ba'i sgrung sogs nyan bshad dang / lde'u ni khed 'jog pa ste/ dper na/ them gnyer wa ba che (srang ) ci yin zhes 'dri ba lta bu'o/ / / de nas e sho legs/ 'di'i blon po lha bu mgo dkar ni/'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun gyi gnyis pa yin/ zhing la dor kha brtsis/ 'brog la thur rtsis byas/ phu chu mda' ru drangs te mda' zhing chu ma rgya cher bzos/ e sho legs/ de nas de sho legs/ thi sho legs/ gu ru legs/ 'brong zhi legs/ i sho legs te sa'i legs drug dang / de nas za nam zin sde/ lde 'phrul nam gzhung btsan/ se snol nam lde/ se snol bo lde/ lde snol nam/ lde snol bo/ lde rgyal bo/ lde sprin btsan te lde brgyad dang / de nas rgyal to ri long btsan/ khri btsan nam/ khri sgra dpung btsan/ khri thog rje btsan te 'og gi btsan bzhi/ de nas lha tho tho ri yin la/ 'di'i dus/ spang skong phyag rgya ba dang /mdo sde za ma tog gi glegs bam 'byor yang don ma go bar gnyan po gsang ba zhes ming btags nas phyag ma chod byas/yang rgyal bo 'di'i dus/ 'phags yul gyi sman pa snyan grags shin tu che ba sman pa bram ze rgyun shes nes bya ba'i slob ma/386

rgyal bo rnga chen po'i bu bi byi dga' byed dang / bram ze dril bzo ma'i bu mo bi lha dga' mdzes gnyis bod yul du byon te gso dpyad sman gyi rig pa spel bas/ snyan grags rgyas te rgyal bo lha tho tho ris gsan nas/ pho brang yum bu bla sgang du spyan drangs/bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas/ rgyal bo'i bu mo lha lcam yid kyi rol cha zhes bya ba/ sman pa bi byi dga' byed la yum du phul/ lha lcam yid kyi rol cha la sman pa dung gi thor cog can 'khrungs/ sman pa mkhas par gyur/ sman pa bi byi dga' byed dang / bi lha dga' mdzes gnyis kyis/ reg pa rtsa'i mdo/ 'tsho ba zas kyi mdo/ sbyor ba sman gyi mdo/ gtar sreg dpyad kyi mdo/rma chas bzo'i mdo rnams dang / gzhan yang rtsa 'grel 'grel bshad khog dbug sa dpyad lag len dang bcas pa gnang ste/ gso rig dar bar mdzad nas slar rgya gar du phyir bzhud/sman pa de gnyis/ rgya gar shar nub/ rgya nag li yul/bal yul rnams su phebs pa'i rjes su/ bod yul du phebs par g.yu thog rnam thar las gsungs pas/ khong gnyis kyis skad yig mang bo zhig mkhyen pa 'dra la/ de dus bod rang gi yi ge 'bri ba'i srol med gshis/ legs sbyar gyi yi ge dang / yig rigs gzhan gyi steng nas kyang gaglorigardzispel ba yin 'dug go/ /387

de nas khri gnyan gzungs btsan/ sman pa dung gi thor cog can rgyal bo 'di'i yang bla sman pa mdzad de gso rig gi rgyu na 'dzin spel gnang / de nas 'broroganyan lde'u/ rgyal bo 'di'i skyatshe'i sma da kyi bla sman ni/ durdogi thor cog gyisras blogrosachen pos mdzad/ de nas stag ri gnyanagazigs/ 'di chungadus dmus long yin la/ ming la dkon pa bkra zer/ phyis su bog kyi rgyal phran 'a zha zhesa'ipa'i khams rgyal 'a zha rje bya ba'i sman pashe mkhas pa zhig yod ba bos nas/ sman dbyad kyis spyan lobhāb sos/ mig long ba sos nas stag mo'i ri la ri dwags gnyan yod ba gzigs papo/ stag ri gnyan gzigs sugrags/ de nas rgyal sar 'khod dus sman ba blo gros mtshungs med kyi bu blo gros — — rab gsal bla sman ba mdzad/ 'di dus khri ngor snang gi bus blonabyas te bre dang srang bcog 'bru mar 'jal byed bzos/ lasasde ba dang tshong byed sogs dar rgyas btang / blona'adi dzimadzangs mi bdurtswagyi gsum pa yin/ de na rtswag nam ri srong btsan/ 'di dus dpa' snang bzher sogs kyis blon byas te/ mi kha shas rgya na ga ṭumangags nas rtsis dang sman bslabs/ byang gi tshwa gter phud/ blo gros rab gsal gyi bu blo gros rgyal mdzod rgyal bo 'di'i — bla sman pa mdzad/ sman rtsis kyi rig gnas dar rgyas byung ngo / /388

de nas srong btsan sgam pos rgyal srid bzung / blo gros rgyal mdzod kyi bu blo gros bshes gnyen rgyal bo'i bla sman pa mdzad/ thon mi sam bho ṭa dang / stag masade khrong sogs mi bcu drug yi ge slob tu btang / de rnams 'phags yul du slebs nas/ thon mi sam snyo ṭas bram ze li byin ka ra dang slob dpon lha rig pa'i ske seng ge sogs paṇa ḍi ta mang bo bsten nas skad yig mang bo dang sgra tshad sogs phyi nang gi rig gnas mang bo bslabs/ phyir bod yul du pheb sa nas bod kyi yig gzugs gsakhasabazo gnang ste/bod rang gi skad kyi steng nas yi ge 'bri ba'i srol btod/ dbyangagagasal sngon rjes mgo 'dogs sogs legs par gtan la phabage ste/ brda sprod la'i gshung brgyad mdzad do/ /de nas bzung ste yon tan gyi rtsa ba bod rang gi yi ge 'bri ba'i srol yod par gyur nas/ yul khams gzhan la yod pa'i rig pa'i gnas dag bod rang giskad yig blubasgyur ba'i mgo brtsams cas /de nas rgyal bo chenagyipo srong btsan gyis gtsug lag khang mang lhabazhengs na/sa/ lo tsā ba'i thog ma thon mi sam bho ṭas spyan drangs pa'i chos dang rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag bod skad la sgyur cig gsungs pa bzhin/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra 389

dang / bram ze shang ka ra/ slob dpon li byin / bal bo'i slob dpon shī la mazhu/ kha che'i slob dpon ta nu ta dang / gha nu ta/ rgya nag gi slob dpon hwa shang ma hā de ba tshe rnams spyan drangs te/ bod kyi lo tsā ba thon mi sam lha ṭa dang / de'i mchan bu snyarma ko sha a lo ka ye shes dpal sogs kyis lo tsā byas/ de rnams las rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra'i yon bdag bal bza' khri btsun gyis byas/ lo tsā ba thon mis byas/ bram ze shang ka ra'i yon bdag rgyal bos byas/ lo tsā ba snyarma ko shas byas/ rgya nag gi mkhan po'i yon bdag rgya bza' kong jos byas/ 'o/ tsā ba yang kong jo nyid dang lha lung rdo rje dpal gyis byas/ bal bo dang kha che'i yon bdag bal bza' khri btsun gyis byas/ lo tsā ba yang khri btsun nyid dang thon mis byas so/ / rgyal bo'i bka' bzhin/ slob dpon ku sa ras mngon pa'i sde dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i skor bsgyur/ bal bo'i slob dpon sogs kyis mdo sde'i sde dang / phal chen dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud rnams bsgyur/ bram ze sha nga ka ras 'dul ba'i sde dang kri ya'i mdo rgyud rnams bsgyur/ rgya nag gi mkhan pos sman dang dpyad la sogs pa bsgyur/ de dag gi skabs su lo paṇa rnams la gser dngul gyi 'bul ba sogs bsnyen bkur rmad 390

du byung ba byas so/ / skye bo blo dman pa rnams la lung gi chos go bar bya ba'i phyir gzungs kyi snye ma sogs sgrung bslabs/ rigs pa'i chos go bar bya ba'i phyir lde'u(khed) bslabs/ zhang zhung yul nas bon po zhang zhung lha sde spyon drangs nas/ bon po a ba rnam gsal zhes bya ba la slob tu bcug ste/ mo rtsis/ lhaci gsol/ 'dre 'dul sogs kyang byed du bcug go/ / gzhan yang thon mis dkon mchog sprin/ sher phyin stong phrag brgya ba yang bsgyur bar bshad/ gtso bo thugs rje chen po'i mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgyur ba bka' chems kyi lo rgyus chen mo ltar yin te/ 1 za ma tog bkod pa/ 3 phyag stong spyan stong gi gzungs/ 3 pad ma'i snying bo'i mdo/ tre zhal bcu gcig pa'i mdo/ 5 bcu gcig zhal gyi gzung sa/ a+yo don yod zhags pa/ 7 don zhags phyi ma/ 8 pad ma mchog 9 dbang bsgyur 'khor lo/ 1༷ cho ga sngags kyi rgyud/ 11 yid bzhin nor bu'i gzungs/ 13 snying rje chen po mi gshol ba/ 1tī 'od zer rnam bkod/ 14 pad ma cod pan gyi rgyud/ 15 yi ge drug pa'i mdo/ 1a+yo dam chos pad dkar/ 17 puṇa ḍa rī ka'i mdo/ 18 chu klung sna tshogs pa'i mdo/ 19 snang ba rol 39lha

ba'i mdo/ 1༷ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 11 mtshan rab yongs su bstan pa'i mdo rnams so/ / 'di dag lag 'od zer rnam bkod/ chu klu nga sna tsho gas /snang ba rol ba/ mtshan rab yongs su bstan params—dedz+was nga bka' 'gyur na mirtsasnang la/ ga zhanadon zhagaspocho ga zhib mo la cho ga sngags kyi rgyud/ ceyo pa lta bu 'gyur khyad—ma gtogs deng sang bzhugs/ zhes deb ther mkhas pa'i dga' ston las gsungs padzhaltar ro / /gzhan yang rgyal bo'i bka 'a ltar thon mis gnyan po gsang ba zhes pa'i sgromacegyi kha phyes te/ dpang skong phyag rgya ba/ mdo sde za ma tog tsin ta ma ṇi'i gzungs/ mdo sde las rnam par 'byed pa'i gzungs rnams blangs nas bsgyur/ ci dpang skong phyag rgya ba ni/ bka' 'gyur sde dge'i par gyi ya pod kyi thog mar/ dpang skong phyag rgya ba thon mi sam bho ṭa 'i 'gyur/ zhes dkar chag na yod pa de yin/ 'on kyang srong btsan gyi dus ma zad/ snga dar dang phyi dar skabs gang 'gyur thams cad da lta yod pa'i nges pa med de/ glang dar gyi byed spyod kyi dbang gis brlags stor dang / de min dpe rgyun stor nas garnyed—g.yang du ma zhig yod pa bka' bstano gyi dkar chag dag na gsal lo/ /39lha

ne de nas rgyal bo srong btsan rang gis kyang yi ge dang sgra snyan sogs rig pa'i gnas dang chos la brtson pa d+mer bskyed nas sbyangs pa mdzad pas mkhas pa chen por gyur te bstan bcos mang bo mdzad/ dper na/ bka' chems kyi lo rgyus chen mo rnams dang / thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs cho ga'i rim pa brgyad/mdo skor le'u sum cu rtsa drug sgrub skor che phran gnyis/ chen mo la drug skor dang gsum skor gnyis// de gnyis kyi bshod chos/ spyi'i khog dbug sgos kyi bshada'agrel/ ṭīka dang bsdus don rnams/skubabyuphran la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ gzhan yang / thon mi sam bho ṭa dang / lo tsā ba ar+ya a lo kas zhus pa sogs zhal gdams brgya dang lnga pacu yod/ 'di dag ma ṇi bka' 'bum du bzhu gas la/ lugs kyi bstan bcos mang bo mdzad pa rgyal rabs deb ther sogs na bzhugs so/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma bris klog gis/ /bod yul rmongs pa'i mun pa kun bsal te/ /chos dang srid kyi rgyal khams bsnobar mdzad/ /ces gsungs ba ltar/ rig gnas dar ba'i stobs kyis/ chab srid kyi bya ba'ang dar zhing rgyas te/ bka'i blon po sum brgya/ de'i nang du gtso bo 'phrul blonargodru ga 'bro la gyi ga na' chen rigs 393

bzang dang / zhang bo rgyal gyi khrom bzang sogs nang blono brgyasargonang gi bya ba byas/ byang gi khyung bo phun bzang btsan dang /lam khri bde blag btsan sogs phyi blon brgyas phyi yi bya ba thams tsad byas te/ shar phyogs rgya dang mi nyag gi yul nas bzo dang rtsis kyi rig pa blangs/ nub phyogs stag gzig bal bo sogs nas zas nor longs spyod drangs/ byang phyogs hor dang yu gur nas khrims dang las kyi da pe rnams blangs te phyi'i bya ba byas/ mkha sa pa thon mi sam bho ṭa dang / mgar stong btsan sogs blon po brgyas/ bar gyi khod snyoms pa dang chos dang srid khrims bskyangs/ thon mi sam bho ṭa ni bod kyi blon po mdzangs mi bdun gyi bzhi ba yin la/ mdzangs pa'i las bod rang gi skad kyi steng nas yi ge 'bri ba'i srol gsar du btod pa sogs rig gnas kyi bya ba rgya cher spel/ khri bzang yang ston snyags kyi bu ni mdzangs mi bdun gyi lnga ba yin te/ mdzangs pa'i las su/ sngar bod mi'i khang khyim ri la yod pa la/ 'dis klungs su phab/ mkhar brtsigs nas grong khyer bcos so/ / gzhan yang khrims med na 'bangs rnams sdug bsngal bar dgongs nas/ bka' khrims yig chen po drug mdzad pa dang /'khos drug kyang mdzad/ gzhan yang bka' gros chen po drug394

yig tshang drug bka'i phyag rgya drug rkyen drug dpa 'a mtshan drugade rnams kyi steng du khrims yig drug po bsnan pas bod kyi 'khos sum cu rtsa drug ces grags la('khos zhes pa thabs kyi don no)/gzhan yang mdzad pa gsum/ mi mdzad pa gsum/ bstod pa gsum/ smad pa gsum/ mi mnar ba gsum ste rgyal khrims bco lnga/ zhes pa yang mdzad/srog mi gcod pa'i khrims gshin stong dang gson stong / ma byin par mi len pa'i khrims brgya 'jal dang brgyad cu 'jal dang brgyad 'jal/ log par mi g.yem pa'i khrims smad 'jal dang byi chad (byi phrug gsos pa'i chad pa)/ rdzun spong ba'i khrims lha srung dpang du byas nas mna' spobs pa/ chang la tshod zin pa dang / kheng mi ldog pa(gyen rgol mi byed pa)/ bang so mi 'bru ba ste khrims chen bdun dang / mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims gnyis bcas shing / dang bo ni/ mi dge ba bcu spong ba'i steng du/ ma lamar 'dzin pa/ pha la phar 'dzin pa/ dge sbyong la dge sbyong du 'dzin pa/ bram ze la bram zer 'dzin pa (bram ze zhes pa 'phags yul du rigs bzhi'i ya gyal la go dgos shing / 'di'i skabs su yon tan can la zer ba yin no)/rigs kyi rgan rabs la bkur ba/ drin du gzo ba gzhan la ngan 395

g.yo spang ba ste bcu drug dang / phyi ma ni/ dkon mchog la gus pa/ dam chosposgrub ba/ pha ma la bkur ba/ yon tan can la gong du bkur ba/ rigs mtho dang rgan ba laphu dud (bkur sti)/ mdzarna bshes laka zhung bsring ba/ yul mi la phaga'adogs ba/ yid drang ba/ mi ya rabs la blta ba/ zas nor la spyod shes pa/ drin can la phan lan/ bre srang dzigayo sgyu med ba/ snyi snyo'akho che zhing phrag dog med pa/tshulamin bud med kyi kha la mi nyan pa/ ngag 'arngam zhing dz+ra mkhas ba / theg pa che zhing blokhog yangs blo ste bcu drug go/ / 'di dag ni srid kyi bya ba yin mod/ sbyi tshogs dang rid gnas 'phel ba'i tshad nges can zhig la ma slebs na/ 'di ltabu 'i khri'akho5)ga sogs kyang 'byung mi srid pas5 'dir mdo tsagazhig zha ra byung du gleng ba'o/ / srong btsan gyi sras gung ru gung btsan rgyal sar bzhag spyang lo bco brgyad thogakashegs pas slar srodz+wabatsan nyid rgyal sa ra bzhugs/ srong btsan dgung lo gya gnyisangapa la gshegs rjes/mang srong mang btsan gyis srid bzung / smanapa blo gros bshes gnyen gyi bu 'dre rje badz+ra gyis gung srong gung btsan dang mang srong mang btsan gnyis ka'i bla sman pa mdzad/396

de rjes 'dus srong mang rje rgyal sar bzhugs/ sman pa 'dro rdzi badz+ra gyi bu khyung bo rdo rje rgyal bo'i bla sman pa mdzad/ mang srodz+wadang 'dus srong gnyis ka'i dus su chab srid rig gnas sngar rgazhin dar zhing / 'dus srong mang rje 'di'i dus su/ bod du ja 'debs pa dag/ rol mo'i rnam grangs mang bo zhig dar la/rtsal bo che'i mi bdun byung ste/ rngog ring la nag pos glang bo che theg sngog gling khams kyis g.yag grus po chebetheg gnon rgyal mtshan gyis mda' ste kha mas bya khra'i sked pa bcad/ sbas ma dongs can gyis mig rgyang gsum la mda' rgyang sleb/ mgos g.yag chung gis sha ba'i rlid bu bye mas bkang ste klad la bskor/ cog ro 'brong gshor gyis 'brong thur du rgyug pa gyen du 'then nus/gnon khri bdun g.yu byin gyis rta bzang bo g.yang la mchongs pa— gyen la 'dren nus seka / 'di dag la dpag na/ rgyal bo 'di dag gi ring la/ slu gar dang zlos gar/ sgyu rtsal sogs dar rgyas che bar snang / blon bo mgar gyi bu btsan gnyan ldem bu dang dbas tangar khongajulod kyis blo na4gtso bo byas te ma/tha' bzhi dbang du bsdus tshul deb dmar sogs na gsal lo/ / de nas khri lde gtsug brtan rgyal sar 'khod/ sma ra yod pa397

dang bgres nyams che bas/ rgyal bo mes ag tshom zhes grags/sman pa khyung bo rdo rje'i bu g.yu thog yon tan mgon po gzhon— dus/rgyal lha 'di'i bla sman pa mdzad/ 'di'i ring la li yul nas rab tu3 byung ba mang be+ebyon pasgyudang / rgya nag nas kyang hwa shang mang bo byon/ chos 'ga' dang sman dpyad sogs bsgyur/ bran ka shu la ko sha dang gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra gnyis kyis mdo sde las brgya ba dang gser 'od dam pa dang kri ya dang / sman dpyad sogs bsgyur/ rgyal bos de dag bzhugs pa'i lha khang lnga bzhengs/ chos dang rig gnas sngar bzhin dar bar mdzad/ mnga' thang bla lhag tu 'phel to/ / de rjes rgyal bo khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su/ g.yu thog yon jitan mgon po snga ma/ tsho rgyal bo'i bla sman pa mdzad/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po rgya gar bal bo rgya nag sogs su lan du mar phebs te/ bod yul 'dir gso ba rig pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ bod kyi mkhas pa mi dgu zhes pa'i sman pa mkhas pa grags pa canathudagu byung / rgyal bo 'di gzhon dus yab kyis sang shi dang mi bzhi rgya nag tu chos sogs rig pa'i gnas len du mngags/ yab 'das nas khri srong lde btsan nar ma son pa'i skabs su/ blon po ma zhang grom pa skyes dbang che zhing chos py-i9byi

la gnag pas/ rgya'i hwa shang rnams rang yul du sgyu gas te/ chogobyas mi chog pa'i khrims bu chung mang bo zhig byas stabs/ sang shis rgya nag nas glegs bam bam po stong longs pa zhig khyer nas bod yul du slebs kyang / ma zhang la skrag nas glegs bam rnams mchims phu'i rdzaskaseb tu sbas/ phyis khri srong nar son pa'i tshe/ rgya nag nas khyer yong ba'i dge ba bcu'i mdo dang / rdo rje gcod pa/ sa lu ljang ba'i mdo la sogs pa sang shi dang rgya me mgo dang kha che a nan ta rnams kyis bsgyur to/ /gzhan yang / 'di dus rgya nag nas hwa shang ne le dang /dar chen ha ra dang / i pa bha bo sogs rgya nag gi mkhas pa mang bo bod yul du byon te/ bod kyi lo tsā ba bhi la shong kun dang /dar chen dpal sogs kyis lo tsā byas nas rtsis dang gso ba rig pa sogs kyi gzhung lugs mang bo bod skad du bsgyur/ gso ba rig pa'i phyogs la de'i skabs su bod 'dir phyogs rigs kyi sman pa grags pa can dgu yod de/ rgya gar ba shan ti gar bha/ rgya nag pa stong gsum gang ba/ li yul ba ma hā de ba/ bal bo ba da na shi la/ kha che ba khu na badz+ra/ sog po ba na la shan dir/dol bo ba khyom ru rtse/ gru gu ba seng ge 'od can/ khrom pa shi la na ste dgu yod la/ de dag gis rang rang gi lugs kyi sman dpyad kyi 399

rig gnas rnams spel zhing / g.yu rtswag pha chen po dang bgro gleng byas te/ g.yu thog pa rgyal nas kun gyis g.yu thogagos bkur bzo cher byas/ galu thog pa po bsko tekhob po'i yu'a'idu sman lung zhes bya ba'i sa tsār sman slob pa'i dgon pa bta ba ste/ dpon slob stong tsam der bzhugs nas rgyud bzhi rtsa'agrel cha lag khortso skong dang bcas pa dang / phyogs rigs kyi sman ba dgus bsgyur ba'i sman gzhung rnams dang / bod kyi mkhas pa mi dgusamadzad pa'i sman gzhung rnams dang / smastodapyad zla ba'i rgyal bo/ bdud rtsi bum pa/ yan lag brgyad pa'i snying bo bsdus pa/ drang srong snyan ba rgyud/ tshig don zla zer la sogs pa'i sman gzhung rnams la sbyangs pa dang spel mdzad pas gso ba rig pa 'di bod yul du ches cher dar ba byung ngo / / gzhan yang / rgya gar nas slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho dang /pad ma 'byung gnas rnam gnyis spyan drangs/ bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang chen pobazhengs/ de nasposlob dpon zhi ba 'tshos rgya gar nas dgoslong bcu gnyis gdan drangs/ mchims a nu'i bu shākya pra bha dang / pa gor he 'dod kyi bu bai ro tsa na/ sba khri bzher gyi bu sba rata na'am sang shi ta'am khri gzigs kyang zer/zhang nyang bsazang gi bu lha bu lha bse btsan/ shud pu khong sleb/4 00 tsho

'khon klu'i dbang bo bsrung ba/ ngan lam rgyal mchog gtsang legs grub/ 'jam dpal go cha/ pran ka mu tika glang ka ta gartsangs de wen dra/ rlangs khams pa go cha/ 'khon na gen/ rma rispubachen mchog la gsum rgyal ba byang chub/ sba gsal snang /sba khri bzher/ sbrang rgyar legs gzigs/ seng gong lha lung gzigs/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ shud pu dpal gyi seng ge / rtsangs sa le'i bu rin chen legs grub sogs la legs sbyar gyi skad yig dang / rgya nag dang bal bo za horokho tsheli yul sogs kyisnad yig dang brda sprod pa'i gzhung dang rig pa'i gnas du ma bslabs pas ches mang che ba mkhas ba chen po ra gyur nasalo tsā ba mang bo byon/ de dag las thog mar sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ba dang / de rjes yang rab byung gi sde cher 'uphel to/ /gzhan yang bod rang du ka cog zhang gsusasogs lo tsā ba 'bor chen byung ste/ bsam yas kyi sgra bsgyur lo tsā gling du chos bsgyur/ bdud 'dul sngagaspopa gling du dbang bskur/ rnam dag khrims khang gling du so thar gyi sdom khrims 'phog dga' ldan sems bskyed gling du byang sdom 'phog mi g.yo bsam gtan gling du rgya'i hwa shang la sogs pas bsagagatan byed/ brda sprod tshang ba'i gling du brda sbyor/ bai ro tsa na'i gling du chos 'chad/ dkor 401ho

mdzod bo har gling du nor bzhag go/ /rgyal bo 'di'i ring la khams yan chad du chos kyi grwa chen po bcu tha/nyis btsugs/ yer 6ba dang mchims phur sgom grwa btsugs/ rgya'i hwa shang ma ko la spyan drangs nas/ sba ratatrenas shes rab 'bum pa thog mar bsgyur/bran ka legs/ lha lung / klu gong / dbus gong / chung bo rtse sogs kyis rgya nag po'i lo tsā byas so/ /gzhan yang / rgya gar gyi slob dpone bi ma la mi tra dang /sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / shan ti gar bha dang / bi shud snya sing ha la sogs pa dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun dang / chos kyi snang ba dang / ban de nam mkha' dang / sgron rin chen sde/ rnam par mi rtog pa/ shākya 'od la sogs pas lo tsā byas te/ rgya gar rgya nag kha che za hor li yul sogs nas bka' dang bstan bcos shin tu mang bo bsgyur/ de nas pho brang ldan dkar na bzhugs pa'i sgra bsgyur ka ba dpal brtsegs dang klu'i dbang bo la sogs pas bod khams su 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi gzhung gi mtshan byang bcos te datha/ra chag bris pa la dkar chag ldan dkar ma zer ro/ /rgyal bo dang blon 'bangs lo tsā ba rnams kyis kyang dam pa'i chos sogs rig pa'i gnas la sbyang ba cher mdzad pas mkhas pa 402

chen por gyur te/ rgyal bo khri srong lde btsan rang nyid kyis/ bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma bam po bdun/ de'i mdor bstan bam po gcig de bzhin gshegs pa'i skad brda bam po lnga/ byams pa'i bstod chen bam po gcig lhag pa sogs bstan bcos gzhung tshad che ba dang / ('di sde dge'i bstan 'gyur gyi po ti co ba na bzhugs) grub pa'i mtha' dgrol ba/ dbu ma'i gzer bu/chorībasam gtan gyi dogs pa brgyad bsal ba/ lha btsan pos bkas bcad sogs dang / 'phags pa rnam snang / shākya thub pa/'jam dpal/ byams pa/ mi g.yo mgon/ byang chub sems dpa' brgya la bstod pa sogs gzhung tshad chung ba'i bstan bcos du ma mdzad do/ /yum stong phrag brgya ba'i 'grel ba 'bum rkyang ba'i gnod 'joms su grags pa yang khri srong gis mdzad pa dkar chag 'phang thang mar bshad pa ltar yin la/ dkar chag mchims ma dang ldan dkar mar bshad pa'i yum gyi 'grel ba gnod 'joms su grags pa rgya gar ma yin par bshad pa de ni/ rdatshe se na'am kha che mche ba'i sde yang zer ba des brtsams pa'i yum gsum gnod 'joms yin no/ /gzhan yang mu tig btsan pos mdzad pa'i dgongasangapa nges 'grel gyi 'grel ba dang / jo bo byang chub rje'i smon lam sogs 403

lha sras dang / btsun mosasgodzad pa dang / bai ro tsa nas mdzad pa'i don gsal sgron ma ('di yang sde bstan co bar bzhugs)/ rigs ba drug cu ba las mdorobasdus te bshad pa/ snang mtha'i ma tshagabarjod lasogs pa dang / dpalanabyangs kyis mdzad pa'i gces pa bsdus ba'i brin yig ka ba dpal brtsegs kyis mdzad pa/'i gsung—rab rin po che'i gtam/ phyi'i yul dran rgyud du yod par 'dod pa sel ba/ mtshan nyid gsum mdor bstan/ chos kyi rnam grangar+sā rtsa 'grel gnyis('di ldebastan sna tshogs skor du bzhugs)/ zhang ye shes sdes mdzad pa'i lta ba'i khyad par/bzang spyod kyi 'grel ba bzhi'i don—bsdus('di yang sde bstan cho bror bzhugs)/ 'jig rten pha ro la sgrub pa dgongs sdem dgongs bzhi'isnebarjed byang rnams dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dgongayopa nges 'grel gyilha cher 'grel('di yang sde ba stagacho bar bzhugs)/ ngesapa'i don dbu ma/ sher phyin mdor bsdus/ phreng ba'i rgyan/ chos gtan la dbab pa/dpal brtsegartswadang klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi brgal lan bzhi phrugs/gzhan yang dpal brtsegs kyis mdzad pa'i lta ba'i rim pa'i man ngag dang / gsung rab rin po tshe'i gtam rgyud dang shākya'i rabs rgyud ('di gnyis kyang sde bltan du bzhugs)/ slob dpon 404

shes rab snying bo'i dgongs 'grel byams le'i brjed byang / blo sha se na'i sher snying ṭīka slob dpon bkra shis kyi dbu ma rgyan gyi brjed byang dang / sdom pa nyi shu ba'i 'grel ba/ dpal gyi lhun po'i dge slong ma'i so thar gyi 'grel ba/ a tsar+ya ka la ya na dang /rin chen zla 'byung dang / kong ud pal ko dzi sogs kyi dris lan/ lce khyi 'brug gi sgra'i gnas brgyad rtsa 'grel dang('di yang sde bstan du bzhugs)/ ma byin len gyi skabs nas mkhan po bzhis dpyad pa sogs lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis kyang bstan bcos mang du mdzad/bai ro tsa na/ ldan ma rtse mang / kha che a nan ta ste lo tsā ba rgan gsum/ gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra/ 'khon klu'i dbang bo/rma rin chen mchog ste bar ba gsum/ ka ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ zhang ye shes sde ste gzhon gsum bcas dgu dang / phyis su brgya phrag lhag byung zhing / gzhan yang slob dpon ka ma la shi la sogs paṇa ḍi ta mang bo spyan drangs nas rgya gar sogs nas nang don rig pa sogs mang bo bsgyur bas dam pa'i chos sogs rig pa'i gnas dar zhing rgyas stabs chab srid dang dpal 'byor yang sngar las lhag par dar te mtha' bzhi dbang du 'dus tshul sogs deb ther rnams su gsal/ bka' 405

rigatsigs kyi yi ge dang khrims yig sogs mang bo bzos/ blon chenasmomagos rgan gyi bu mgos khri bzang yab lhag gis/ sngar zhal lce gsos thang stong thang du bcad pa med pa la khrims su bcad nas khrims yig chen mo bzos pas blon po phyi ma rnams la'ang drin che bas/ bod phrug mdzangs pa'i mi bdun gyi drug par 'dren no/ /blon stag btsan gdong gzigs gnyer gyi bu/ gnyer stag btsan gdong gzigs kyis kyang / 'bangs mi khyim re la rta glang mdzo g.yag sogs bgos nas/ —rtswa sngon dgun dus su bskam pa sogs kyi lag rjes bzhag pas/ bod phrug mdzangs pa'i mi bdun pa zer ro/ / de rjes khri srong gi sras che ba mu ne btsan po'i dus su/ lha sa/ khra 'brug bsam yas rnams su mchod pa chen po btsugs pashing / paṇa ḍi ta dang lo tsā ba dang dge 'dun pa rnams la bsnyen bkur mdzad de sngar bzhin dam pa'i chos sogs bsgyur zhing spel bar mdzad/ 'bangs kyi dbul phyug snyoms pha sogs mdzad do/ / de rjes khri srong gi sras tha chung khri lde srong btsan sad na legs mjing yon du grags pa rgyal sar 'khod/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i sras/ 'bum seng / dpal 406

'arbum/ dga' dga' gsum gyis/ mu no btsan po dang / sad na legs 'di gnyis ka'i bla sman pa mdzad cing 'phrin las kyang yab kyi gdan sa gnorge pa byung / 'di dus blon po glang sna can gyis bod kyi mkhas pa rnams la skyon phab/ g.yu thog pa btson du bcug de nas klo kha khra'i yul du sgyugs pa/ rgyal bo sad na legs 'dis klo yul nas gdan drangs/ rgyal bo'i pho brang du za 'og dgu brtsegs kyi steng du spyan drangs te/ rin po che'i 'bul ba mang bo phul zhing bod kyi rgyal bo brgyud pa nas brgyud par g.yu thog brgyud par bcas pa bla sman pa byed dgos pa'i bka' dang dpya khral gyi 'bul ba dang bcas pa thag bcad/ g.yu thog pas kyang sngar bzhin gso ba rig pa rgya cher spel te/ kasung rtsom yang rig gnas phyi nang zhes pa'i gzhung le'u so gsum/ de skor phyi nang gsang gsum zhes par le'u nga lnga/ rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad kyi 'grel ba kha skong dang bcas pa/ rgyud 'grel stong dang rtsa gcig la le'u stong dang sum brgya1/ man ngag phan byed dang gnod byed kyi gzhung phran mang bo/ dmar 'ded kyi man ngag le'u brgya dang dgu bcu/ ro bkra 'phrul gyi me long la le'u nyer lnga/ byang khog gsang dbye le'u brgyad/ thur dpyad gnad kyi lde'u mig la le'u so lnga/ mngon shes gnad kyi 'phrul 'khor la 407

li'u bco lnga/ gsang thig rin chin sgron mi la li'u bco brgyad/nag rtsis 'khor 'das gtan 'bebs la le'u brgya dang nyi shu/ 'bras rtsis la le'u nyer lnga/ dkar rtsis ri bo rdul 'bebs la le'u drug cu/ rgyud bzhi'i them yig gab pa gsal byed/ tho byang / rgyud kyi kha skong / dkar chag cha lag me rtsa mdo chod nag po/ gtar kha lag len 'phyugs med/ gyen 'dren lcags kyus nya 'dzin/ thur 'bebs ri bo rbab sgril/ nyams ldig mthong ba don ldan/ khrid yig brgya dang nyer gcig nad pa la gces pa srog 'tsho dpal skyed kyi gdams pa/ sman pa la gces pa bskrad pa lnga ldan gyi gdams pa la sogs pa mang bo brtsams so/ / bsam yas la zhig gso dang / bsam yas sogs kyi mchod pa mu ne btsan pos btsugs pa de bar skabs su re zhig nyams pa de slar gsos/ skyid spreshod du dkar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs/ paṇa ḍi ta bi ma la mi tra/ dzñā na se na/bal bo hūṃ ka ra/ pra dzñā dharma/ shākya sing ha/ su ren dra bo rnyi/dzi na mi tra/ da na shi la/ bud dha sing ha sogs spyan drangs/sngar gyi lo tsā ba rnams la'ang bsnyen bkur chen po byas te/ mtshan nyid dang / gsang sngags kyi bka' bstan bcos mang bo bsgyur/408

rgyal bo 'des yab mes kyi dus bzhin byed dgos pa'i thugs dam bzhes te/ dbu snyung bor nas/ bka' gtsigs kyi yi ge snga phyi shog gu mthing ga la gser gyis bris te/ rin po che khra men gyi sgrom du bcug nas bsam yas kyi yab khri srong gi bka' gtsigs chen mo'i 'gram du bzhag go/ / de rjes khri lde srong btsan sad na legs kyi sras/ khri gtsug lde btsan ral ba can gyis rgyal srid bzung / 'di'i ring la 'u shang rdo'i dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ gtsug lag khang du paṇa ḍi ta dang lo tsā ba rnams bzhugs nas/ mtshan nyid dang rdo rje theg pa'i bka' bstan bsgyur cing 'chad rtsom gyis dus 'da' bar byed/ sngar lha sras yab kyi ring la chos kyi brda bod skad la ma grags pa mang bo zhig byung zhing / rgya nag dang li dang rgya gar yul dbus dang za hor dang kha che sogs sna tshogs nas bsgyur pa'i brda mi 'dra ba dag mang bo mi go zhing bslab dka' bar gzigs nas/ drin can gyi lo paṇa rnam gsum zhes grags pa dzi na mi tra dang / da na shī la dang / zhang ye shes sde gsum sogs lo paṇa rnams kyis sngar bsgyur ba thams cad dag par byas shing gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab ste go bde bar byas/ gzhung tshad rnams kyang bam grangs 409

sogs nges par byas te/ dkar chag tu— bsnan nas/ spyir khri srong gi dus kyi dkar chag pho brang ldan dkar ma dang / phyis kyi mchims phu ma dang 'phang thang ma ste gsum byung ba dkor mdzod kyi zla la bzhag go/ /yang skad gsar bcad kyi skabs lo paṇa rnams kyis bye brag rtog byed che 'bring chung gsum mdzad/ chen mo dang 'bring ba'am sgra sbyor bam gnyis sde dge'i bstan 'gyur co ba'i nang sna tshogs skor du bzhugs/ ji ltar brtsams tshul sgra sbyor bam gnyis kyi dbur bshad pa yongasarurdzogs 'dir 'dren par bya ste 'di ltar/rta'i lo la btsad po khri lde srong btsan ('di yi ge nor ba yin te/ khri gtsug lde btsan yin no) / pho brang gi'i 'on cang rdo('u shang rdo dang gcig red) na bzhugs/ stod smad kyi dmag rnyid rjed dang rkun chen btul/ gar log gi pho nyas phyag btsal/blon chen po zhang khri zur ram shag dang / mang rje lha 'od la sogs pas rgyal sa gnad mang bo bcad de/ rnga rta dang ba mar mang bo phyag tu phul/ zhang blon so sor bya dga' bstsal ba'i ltan la/nyi 'og gi mkhan po a tsār+ya dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo rnyi dang / shi len dra bo khyi dang / da na shī la dang / bo khyi mi tra dang / bod kyi mkhan po rata na rak+ṣi ta dang / dharma ta shrī la 410

dang / lo tsā ba mkhas pa chud pa dzñā na se na dang / dza ya rak+ṣi ta dang / malja shi warma dang / rata nen dra shī la la sogs pas theg pa che chung las 'byung ba'i rgya gar gyi skad las bod kyi skad du bsgyur zhing ming du btags pa rnams dkar chag tu bris te/ nam du yang gzhung lugs de las mi bsgyur zhing kun gyis bslab tu rung bar gyis shib/ ces bka' bstsal nas/ sngon lha sras yab kyi ring la/a tsār+ya bo rnyi sa twa dang / ye shes dbang bo dang / zhang rgyal nyen nya bzang dang / blon khri bzher sang shi dang ('di yang yi ge nor ba 'dra ste/ khri bzher gyi bu sang shi ta yin la/ sang shi ni rgya phrug yin par gsungs) / lo tsā ba dzñā na de ba ko ṣa dang / khyi 'brug dang / lce bram ze a nan ta la sogs pas chos kyi skad bod la ma grags pa las ming du btags pa mang dag cig mchis pa'i nang nas kha cig chos kyi gzhung dang / byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang mi mthun te/ mi bcos su mi rung ba rnams kyang bcos/ skad kyi ming gces so 'tshal gyis kyang bsnan nas theg pa che chung gi gzhung las ji ltar 'byung ba dang / gna'i mkhan po chen po nā gyu rdzu na dang / ba saban sgye la sogs pas ji ltar bshad pa dang / byā ka ra ṇa'i sgra'i lugs las ji skad du 'dren pa dang yang bstun te/ mjal dka' ba/ rnams kyang tshig so sor 411

phral nas gtan tshigs kyis bshad de gzhung du bris/ skad rkyang ba bshad mi 'tshal ba sgra bzhin du bsgyur bar rigs pa rnams kyang sgra btsan par bgyis te ming du btags/ skad kha cig don bzhin du gdags par rigs pa rnams kyi don btsan par bgyis te ming du btags nas/ btsad po'i spyan sngar ban de chen po dpal gyi yon tan dang / ban de chen po ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yang 'tshogs te/ rje blon gdan 'dzoms pa la zhus nas snyarma bsgyur ba'i thabs dang / rgya gar gyi skad la bod kyi skad du ming btags pa rnams gtan la phab ste/ bkas bcad pa/ dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba'i lugs ni don dang yang mi 'gal la bod skad la yang gar bde bar gyis shig snyarma bsgyur pa la rgya gar gyi skad kyi go rim las mi bsnor ba bod kyi skad du bsgyur na don dang tshig tu 'brel zhing bde na ma bsnor bar sgyur cig bsnor na bde zhing go ba bskyed pa zhig yod na/ tshigs bcad la ni rtsa ba bzhi ba'am/ drug pa'ang rung ste/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig gi nang na gang bde ba bsnor zhing sgyur cig rkyang ba la ni don gang snyegs pa yan chad kyi tshig dang don gnyis ka la gar bde bar bsnor zhing sgyur cig skad gcig la ming du mar 'dren pa ni/ltag 'og dang bstun la gar snyegs pa bzhin du ming thogs shig4snyelha

gau ta mya lta bu go'i sgra las tshig dang / phyogs dang / sa dang / 'od dang / rdo rje dang / ba lang dang / mtho ris la so gas pa rnam pa du mar snyegs pha dang / kau shi ka lta bu'i rtswa ku sha thogs pa dang / mkhas pa dang / pad ma la dga' ba dang / 'ug pa dang / mdzod ldan la sogs pa'i sgra'i lugs las drangs shing bsgyur na sna grangs mang bo zhig tu snyegs la/ bsgyur pa rnams gcig gi nang du ni sna grangs de kun 'dur yang rma btub ste/gcig tu chad par byar yang gtan tshigs chen po med pa rnams ni mi bsgyur par rgya gar skad so na zhog cig gar yang drang du rung ba'i tshig byung na/ phyogs gcig tu chad par mi bsgyur par spyir snyegs su rung bar gyis shig yul dang / sems can dang / me tog dang / rtsi shing la sob/sa pa'i ming bsgyur na yid gol zhing tshig mi bde ba dang / 'ol phyir bsgyur du rung ba don de ltar yin nam ma yin gtol med pa rnams la/ mgo la yul zhe'am/ mi tog ces pa la sogs pa gang la bya ba'i ming gcig bla thabs su snon la rgya gar skad so na zhog cig grangs la rgya gar skad bzhin du bsgyur na dge slong brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum zhes 'byung ba la sogs pa ni/ stong nyis brgya lnga bcu tham par bod kyi skad bzhin bsgyur na don dang mi 'gal ba bod kyi skad la 413

yang bde bas grangs bsdom du rung ba rnams bod skad kyi lugs bzhin thogs shig pa ri dang / sam dang / u ba lta bu la sogs te/ tshig gicephrad dang rgyan lta bur 'byung ba rnams bsgyur na don dang mthun zhing 'byor ba'i thabs ni/ yongs su zhe'am/yang dag pa zhe'am/ nye ba zhes sgra bzhin du sgyur cig don lhag par snyegs pa med pa rnams ni tshig gi lhad kyis bsnan mi dgos kyis don bzhin du thogs shig rnam grangs su gtogs pa'i tshig rnams ni ma 'doms na ming gangathubod skad du spyir grags shing tshig tu gar bde bar gdags so/ /'doms na so sor btags pa bzhin du thogs shig sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos la sogs pa zhes dang sko long gi tshig gi rim pa ni sangs rgyas la zhe sa'i tshig tu bsgyur/ gzhan la tshig 'bring bo man chad tsam du byas te/ sngon lha sras yab kyi spyan sngar mkhan po dang lo tsā ba mkhas pa 'tshogs nas/ snyarma dkon mchog sprin dang / lang kar gshegs pa bsgyur te/ gtan la phab pa'i lugs bzhin sgyur cig skad kyi lugs 'di ltar bkas bcad pa las so so nas su yang 'chos shing 'og tu ming gsar du 'dogs su mi gnang gis/ bsgyur ba dang 'chad pa'i grwa so so nas skad gsar du ming gdagasari dgos pa zhig yod na yang / so 414
