so'i grwa grwar ming chad par mi gdags par chos kyi gzhung dang sgra'i lugs las ji skad du 'byung ba'i gtan tshigs dang / chos la ji skad du gdags pa dpyad de/ pho brang du bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs kyi 'dun sa dang / snyarma zhu chen 'tshal ba'i grwar phul la/ snyan du zhus te bkas bcad nas skad kyi dkar chag gi dkyus su bsnan no/ /gsang sngags kyi rgyud rnams gzhung gis gsang bar bya ba yin te/ snod du ma gyur pa rnams la bshad cing bstan du yang mi rung la/ bar du bsgyur zhing sbyod du gnang gis kyang / ldem po dag tu bshad pa ma khrol nas sgra ji bzhin du 'dzin cing log par spyod pa dag kyang byung / sngags kyi rgyud kyi nang nas thu zhing bod skad du bsgyur ba dag kyang byung zhes gdags kyi/phyin chad gzungs sngags dang rgyud bla nas bka' bstsal te/ sgyur du bcug pa ma gtogs pa/ sngags kyi tshig thu zhing bsgyur du mi gnang ngo / /skad kyi ming sngon gtan la ma phab pa dang ming du ma thogs me las theg pa che chung gi gzhung dang sgra'i gzhung las 'byung ba sbyar te bshad pa'i dang bo'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gong gi mchan bu dag bdag gis btab pa yin la/ bkas bcad 'di la dpag na sngon rig gnas ji ltar dar ba shes par 'gyur bas/ lung tshig 'di drangs pa yin no/ /rgyal bo 'dis bkas 415

bcad gsum mdzad de/ skad gsar bcad kyi bkas bcad dang / 'dul ba gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde las ga zhan pa'i sde ba dag gi sde snod mi bsgyur bar bkas bcad/ gsang sngags ma rgyud rnams ma bsgyur cig ces bkas bcad pa ste gsum mo/ /bre srang sogs kyang rgya gar yul dbus 'gyur tshul dang mthun par bcos/ bod 'bangs kyi khrims yig dang / yig tshang sogs zhig gso dang legs bcos mdzad cing / mnga' thang rab tu rgyas te nub phyogs stag gzig tshun chod dbang du 'dus/ bod 'bangs rab tu skyid pa tshobyung zer ro /lha tho tho ri nas rgyal bo 'di'i bar la skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu gsum zhes zer/ mu no btsan po yun thung bas phyed du brtsis/ mang srong ma bgrangs par de ltar grags la/ci mes ag tshom nas 'di'i bar la shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs lnga zhes snga rabs la grags so/ /de nas blon gdug pa can dbas stag rna can sogs/ kyis/rgyal bo dang / blon bran ka dpal yon bkrongs nas/ glang dar ma 'u dum btsan rgyal sar bzhag 'di ni chung dus nas gzugs ba lang gi sha tshugs dang 'dra zhing / blo rtul la rgyud gyong bas/ 'bangs rnams kyis glang dar ma zhes btags (glang 416

phrug)/ ming dngos ni/ 'u dum btsan zer/ rgya'i lo rgyus rgya'i lo tsā ba ba hu gyang ju zer bas bod yig tu bsgyur ba las/rgyal bo 'di chang la dga' zhing spyod pa ngan pas/ bod kyi rgyal khams thams cad 'khrugs/ si ha ce'u la bod dbang ba'i ri brtsigs yod pa 'gyel/ klu chu zhag gsum gyen la log ltas ngan byung zhing rgyal khams zhig pa yin no/ /zhes bshad do/ /de nas glang dar kho rang yang blo rmongs shing yon tan med par ma zad/ yon tan can la snying nas mi dga' bas/ chos byas pa bkra mi shis zer nas/ rma rin chen mchog dang nyang ting 'dzin sogs lo tsā ba chen po mang bo bkrongs/ paṇ+ḍi ta rnams sa mthar bskrad pa dang la la rang rang so so'i yul du bros/ rab tu byung ba la la sa mthar bros/ ma thar ba rnams khyim sar phab/mi nyan pa rnams bsad/ la la khrid nas rgyal blon rnams kyis rta la 'bab 'dzeg gi tshe sgur du bcug nas stegs byas/ la la'i lag tu mda' gzhu dang rnga gshang (ri dwags dkrog byed rnga dang si li)bzhag ste rngon pa byed du bcug lha sa dang / bsam yas bshas ra byas/ gtsug lag khang mang bo bshigs/ dpe cha rnams me la bsregs pa dang chu la bskur ba dang sa 'og tu gnon pa sogs byas/ 'bangs rnams kyi 'tsho ba'ang je sdug je sdug la 417

song / bod 'bangs rnams sdug bsngal gyi gnas su bcar to/ /de'i tshe lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yer ba brag lha ri snying bo zhes bya bko sgom gyin yod pa/ nyin gcig sgom khang phyi la phebs nas gzigs pas/ btsun pa'i mgo la bya sgro btsugs lag tu rnga gshang thogs te lings(rgya'am rnyi) byed pa mthong bas rgyal bos bstan pa bsnubs shing / 'bangs rnams sdug bsngal bar shes nas snying rje chen po skyes te/ rgyal bo ma bsgral na 'bangs rnams sdug bsngal gyis mnar zhing / rgyal bo rang nyid kyang las ngan pa bsags nas phyi mar dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur snyam nas/ rta bzhon mda' gzhu thogs te rgyal bo gsod du chas/ de'i tshe 'bangs ches mang bo 'dus nas ngu 'bod byed cing mya ngan byas/rgyal bo nub phyogs gla ba'i tshal na mig mang rtse zhing 'dug pa'i thag nyer song nas ngu 'bod byas te(khrom skor red) / rgyal bo chen po lags khyed kyis chos bsnubs pa sogs 'di 'dra mdzad pa shin tusanas kyang mi rigs te/ yab mes kyi yig tshang dang dkor mdzod kyi sgrom bu rdo ring gi yi ge thams cad la gzigs shig ces mgrin gcig tu ngu 'bod chen po byas pa'i 'ur sgra rgyal bos thos nas sems mi bde bar/ rdo ring gi rtsar song nas yi ge klog gin yod pa'i skabs/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje slebs te/ rgyul bo la 41'i

phyag 'bul khul gyis phu dung nang nas mda' gzhu blangs te lcagase kyi mda' 'phangs te rgyal bo'i snying khar phog nas tshe'i dus byas so/ /'dis rgyal srid lo drug la bzung / 'di man nas bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal bo zhig ma byu nga ze ra ro/ /de'i bu gnam lde 'od srung dang / bu rdzu na ma red zer rgyu'i khri yum brtan lde gnyis yod pas ma 'chams par yum brtan gyis dbu ru/ 'od srung gis g.yo ru bzung nas/ srid khag gnyis su gyes/ yab glang dar gyi byed spyod la 'bangs kha log pa dang /chab srid dang dpal 'byor gang thad nas nyam dmas su song ba tshor nas/ rgyal blon kun gyis gros thog nas jo bo rnam gnyis dang / byams pa chos 'khor ma sogs khri thog tu spyan drangs nas mchod pa byas/ la la btsun pa byed khul byas te/ 'chad nyan gyi gzugs brnyan tsam re byas/ 'on kyang / 'bangs rnams kyi snying nad ma zhi bar sa glang lo nas bzung kheng lo ga (gyen log) rnams rim par byung / de yang / dang bor/ dbas kho bzher legs steng zer bas 'go khrid de mdo khams smad nas kheng log byung / de rjes dbas lo pho lo chung gis 'go khrid de dbu ru nas kheng log byung / de rjes g.yon rur zhang rje gsas sne btsan gyis dpon g.yu sne bsad/ mchims kong mi drug gis 'go khrid de 419

'od 'bar kheng ldog(gyen log)tu grags pa byas pa sogs/ de nas kheng log lo dgu ba me bya la shud pu stag rtse sogs kyis gros byas nas bang so(rgyal dur)rnams bgo bsha' byas/ gnyags kyis don mkhar mda'i bang so bru sa/ shud pus seng ge can gyi bang so brus/ greng 'phyos khus 'phrul rgyal bang so brus pa sogs kyis/ d+nghabod rgyal gdung rabs kyi bang so thams cad med par bzos/ de nas bod sil buro'athor ba'i dus skabs byung ngo / /glang dar skabs bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum mdo smad du byon tshul ni/ klong chen chos 'byung las/ 'jad pa gtsang rab gsal/ bo dong ba g.yo dge 'byung / stod lungs pa dmar shākya mu ne dang gsum/ dpal chu bo ri la sgom zhing yod pa'i dus su/ btsun pa khyi khrid rnga gshang rdung zhing mgo la bya sgro btsugs sham thabs snga log phyi log byas nas ri dwags la mda' 'phen pa thab kha bas mthong bas/ ma byan(ja ma) nas ban rgan 'khrul lam btsun pa spyo zer zhing gzigs pas/ mthong ba bzhin smras so/ /slob dpon ma 'khrul btsun pa ma spyos/ rgyal bos chos bsnubs pa'i lo rgyus zhib tu bsnyad pas/ 'o na ban de 'dir bos dang gsungs nas/ gtam dris pas/ khyed la bka' chad kyis ma thogs pa kha rje che zer nas zhes gsungs/ 420

rgyal rabs gsal me las kyang 'di bzhin 'byung / deng sang 'ga' zhig gis/ mgo 'a bya spu 'dzugs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bod ma yin no zer ba ni/ bod kyi gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus mi shes par byung rgyal du smra ba'o/ /de nas gtsang rab gsal/ g.yo dge 'byung / dmar shākya mu no gsum gyis 'dul mngon sogs kyi dpe cha drel khal gcig bkal nas/ nyin yib mtshan 'gros kyis bros nas mnga' ris stod du slebs/ der yang sdod ma nus par byang lam brgyud hor yul du byon nas/ dge bsnyen shākya shes rab la brten te re zhig bzhugs kyang skad mi 'dra bas bstan pa spel ma nus la/ de nas slar mdo smad du phebs nas rma chu dang nye ba'i sa cha rma lung rdo rje brag ra an chung gnam rdzong dan tig shel gyi yang dgon sogs su sgom gyin bzhugs/ de gsum la bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum zer zhing snyan grags bla ru 'phags/ sku gdung sngar zi ling du bzhugs/ de dag gi slob ma bla chen po dgongs pa rab gsal ni/ bstanabyupa'i me ro smad nas gso ba bo yin zhes snyan pa dbyar skyes kyi rnga gsang rab tu ldir ro/ / 'di yan la snga dar gyi skabs su rig gnas ji ltar dar ba'i tshul brjod pa yin la/ lo tshigs sogs la deb ther rnams 421

mi mthun sa re yod mod/ gong du bsh-id pa 'di dag ni spyir bshad na deb ther rnams su mi mthun pa med/ deb ther rnying ba'i bshad tshul gyi tshig sbyor 'ga' zhig dang brda rnying 'ga' re sor bzhag byas yod/ de ltar ma byas par brda rnying rnams gtan bskyur byas na/ phyi rabs rnams kyis gtan nas mi shes par 'gyur bas/ cung zad re bed spyad na bzang snyam pa yin/snga dar gyi mgor ming dang tshig rnams kyi 'bri lugs de tsam sta gtan khel ma byung ba'i stabs kyis/ 'bri lugs la sna tshogs shig byung ba yin te/ dper na/ sba bzhed la/ sa sba dang ra rba dang / dpa' zhes bris pa yod pa dang / ral ba can gyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag gi pho brang chen po la/ 'u shang rdo/ 'on cang rdo/ gnyis ka yod pa dang / glang dar ming / u dum btsan/ 'u dum btsan bris pa sogs mi 'dra ba mang / phyis su rig gnas phyi dar skabs rim gyis ming tshig gi 'bri lugs rnams gcig mthun byung ba dang / khyad par du rje yab sras byon pa'i skabs snga phyi nas/ mkhas chen mang du byon zhing rtsom lugs kyang brda sprod pa'i gzhung dang mthun la bod kyi spyi 'gros skad dang mthun zhing / tshig sbyor legs la go sla ba sha stag byung bar ma zad/ shing pa ra yang 'bor chen dar stabs ming dang tshig gi 422

'bri lugs gzhi rtsa'i thog nas gcig gyur gtan khel byung ngo / /'on spyang bris nor la brten ma dag rgyun 'byams su song ba'ang mang ste/ dper na/ bu ston chos 'byung du sad na legs kyi mtshan la/ khri lde srong btsan zer rgyu la/ khri lde btsan/ zhes srong chad pa dang / ral ba can gyi mtshan la khri gtsug lde btsan zer rgyu la khri lde srong btsan zhes bris pa lta bu/ 'di ni yig nor yin te/gong du sde par shog grangs dgu bcu'i nyin la bod kyi rgyal bo khri gtsug lde btsan ral ba can/ zhes yod pa ltar yin no/ /yang gong du rba khri bzher/ sang shi ta zhes mi gnyis byas pa dang /'og tu/ 'ba' khri bzher sang shi ta/ zhes gcig byas ba rta/ bus mtshon/ yi ge ma dag pa yod la/ phyis su 'ga' zhig gis yi ge dag ma dag ma dpyad par/ kun mkhyen bu'i chos 'byung gi yig nor ltar bris pa yod/ bdag gis kyang sngar blo gsal dga' ston rtsom dus ma dpyad par/ khri lde srong btsan ral ba can zhes bris pa ni nor ba yin/ khri srong lde btsan gyi yab mes ag tshom gyi mtshan la/ khri lde gtsug brtan dang / khri srong lde btsan gyi sras sad na legs kyi mtshan la khri lde srong btsan dang / de'i sras ral ba can gyi mtshan la khri gtsug lde btsan zer ba yin te/'di ni bu ston chos 'byung / deb dmar/ deb sngon/ mkhas 423

pa'i dga' ston/ sa skya'i bstan pa spyi'i chos 'byung / klong chen chos 'byung / bka' gtsigs chen mo/ rdo ring gi yi ge/ tun hong gi gter yig sogs gcig mthun red do/ /sprusnyan0pu py-i dan / skubuska gu sdoki du nig /naska dan sum̐spu/bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su rig gnas dar tshul bshad pa la/ spyir snga dar dang phyi dar zer ba ni/ glang dar mas dbus gtsang du bstan pa bsnubs pa'i sngon la snga dar dang / des bstan pa bsnubs nas lo bdun cu yar mar zhig la/ rig gnas dang chos la sbyang brtson byed pa cher med la/ stod mnga' ris kyi dpon btsun lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi ring yar mar nas rim gyis rig pa'i gnas dang mdo rgyud kyi bstan pa ches cher dar ba man la phyi dar zer/ de yang dbus gtsang du yin gyi/ mdo khams sogs sa mtha' dag bod kyi rgyal bo dang sa thag rgyang gshis rig pa'i gnas dang mdo sngags kyi bshad pa sogs kyang nam dar ba nas bzung / da lta'i bar du bar ma chad par yod pa 'di yin stabs/ de'i dus su'ang mdo smad du bod rgyal gyis gnod 'tshe byed mi thub stabs/ bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum yang mdo khams 434

smad kyi gnas dan tig tu bzhugs/ de'i skabs tsong kha bde khams su mu zu gsar 'bar zhes bya ba'i byis pa rig pa can zhig 'khrungs pa nar son nas yig rtsis sogs rig pa'i gnas sbyangs te mkhas par gyur/ non 'jam dpal zhes bya ba'i slob dpon zhig yod pa'i mdun nas chos dang rig pa'i gnas du ma zhig gsan/ khang rin chen rdo rje zhes bya ba'i bla ma snyan grags can zhig yod pa de'i mdun nas sems bskyed zhus/ skyi rgyal ba'i gtsug tor zhes bya ba'i mkhas pa chen po zhig yod pa de'i mdun nas dbu ma dang tshad ma'i gzhung sogs la sbyangs/ de nas phyugs rdzi zhig gis bod dbus nas byon pa'i sgom pa ba gsum(mkhas pa mi gsum) yod tshul bshad pas/ der byon nas mjal bas dad pa skyes te rab tu byung / mtshan dge ba rab gsal du btags/phyis thugs rab shin tu che bas dgongs pa rab gsal zhes grags so/ /rab tu byung ba'i phyi lor bsnyen par rdzogs/ grum ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / snubs byang chub rgyal mtshan sogs mdo khams pa mang bo rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'dul ba dang mngon pa la sogs pa'i bshad pa mnos/ bla chen po dgongs pa rab gsal zhes snyan grags kyis bod yul khyab/425

de nas mdo smad du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yod pa'i gtam de dpus gtsa nga du khyab pas/ dbus gtsang nas mi bcu snga phyir 'ongs te bla chen gyi mdun nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ mi bcu ni/dbus nas klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/ 'bring ye shes yon tan/ sba tshul khrims blo gros/ rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/sum pa ye shes blo gros te dbus pa lnga/ gtsang gi mgur mo rab kha ba lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug shab sgo lnga'i tshong btsun shes rab seng ge/ bo dong ba u ba de dkar ba ste gtsang ba gsum/ mnga' ris pa 'od brgyad spun gnyis te bcu'o/ /klu mes kyis grum ye shes rgyal mtshan las 'dul ba gsan/ gzhan rnams dbus gtsang du byon/ phyi lor klu mes kyang yar byon nas rim gyis gnas gzhi bzung zhing / de bzhin du gzhan rnams kyis kyang gtsug lag khang brtsigs te dge 'dun gyi sde spel/ phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas dag la sbyang ba'i srol dbus gtsang mnga' ris sogs su khyab par mdzad/ brgyud pa 'di la smad 'dul ba zhes grags so/ /gzhan yang mnga' ris stod du lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis tho ling gi dpe med lhun 'grub gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgya gar shar phyogs nas paṇa ḍi ta dharma pā la dang / de'i mkhan bu sā rnyu pā la dang / gu ṇa pā la/ pra dzñā pā la ste pā la rnam gsum 4lha6

rdu grags pa dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas mang bo bsnyin par 5rdzogs/ zhang zhung ba rgyal ba'i shes rab kyis paṇa ḍi ta mang bo bsten te/ sgra dang skad sogs rig pa'i gnas mang bo la sbyangs nas mkhas pa chen por gyur pa des snyarma pā la'i mdu—na nas 'dul ba bslabs/ pra dzñā pā la las bsnyen par rdzogs/ phyis su yang khong / ne pa la ste bal yul du phebs nas 'dul 'dzin bre ta ka ra las 'dul ba'i lag len thams cad bslabs shing / kha che dzñā na shrī dang / kha chengapaṇa chen du grags pa shrī su ti sharnyi dang / sa man+ta shrī dzñā na dang / na ra ma de wa rnams las kyang 'dul ba gsan nas spel ba la stod 'dul ba zhes grags so/ /gzhan yang mnga' ris kyi lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rin chen bzang bo la sogs pa'i byis pa nyi shu rtsa gcig rgya gar du slob gnyer la btang ba las/ rin chen bzang bo dang legs pa'i shes rab lo chung grags 'byor gsum ma gtogs gzhan rnams sa ma thub pas shi/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang bo ni me mkha' rgya mtsho'i 'das lo224sa rta (958)lo la 'khrungs/ khong kha cher lan gsum byon/ paṇa ḍi ta bdun cu rtsa lnga bsten/sngags mtshan nyid kyi gzhung lugs mang bo la sbyangs/ mkhyen rab shin tu che bas mdo sngags kyi chos mang bo bsgyur/ 'di nas 427

bzung ste bsgyur ba'i sngags la gsang sngags gsar ma zer/gnas gzhi dang gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs/ gur shing brtson 'grus la sogs pa'i slob ma mkhas grub mang bo dang / zhu chen pher ba'i lo tsā ba yang bcu lhag byung / khong dgung lo gya lnga bzhes pa'i dus/ jo bo rje bod du byon/ spyir lo chen 'di'i phyag rjes gzhan las che/ dgung lo go brgyad thog sku mya ngan las 'das so/ /lo chen gyi slob ma mkhas chen mang bo byung ba rnams kyis gzhung lugs mang bo bsgyur/ khyad par du rma dge ba'i blo gros kyis tshad ma rnam 'grel dang / de'i rang 'grel dang /lha dbang blo'i 'grel ba dang / shākya blo'i 'grel bshad la sogs pa mang du bsgyur cing / 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab/ de las mched nas dbus gtsang gi phyogs su tshad ma'i 'chad nyan byung zhing / de'i tshe khyung bo grags se zhes bya ba mkhas par grags pa des tshad ma'i bshad pa mang du mdzad/ lo dag la tshad ma rnying ma zhes zer/ phyis lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab nas tshad ma gsar mar grags pa rnams byung bar grags la khyung bo de bo to ba dang dus mtshungs par snang gsungs so/ / yang lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus su paṇa ḍi ta smṛ ti dang phra la ring ba bya ba gnyis bal bo pad ma ru rtse ba zhes bya ba'i lo tsā ba 428

des gdan drangs 'ongs pas/ lo tsā ba bal bor pho log gis shi ste/ paṇa ḍi ta gnyis pos bod skad mi shes pas dbus gtsang na mar 'khyams te/ smṛ tis rta nag tu lug rdzi mdzad/ phyis dpyal se tsa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis sman lung du spyan drangs te chos zhus/ khams su byon nas 'dan klong thang du mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad pa btsugs/ phyis bod skad mkhas par mkhyen te/ gdan bzhi dang 'jam dpal gsang ldan la sogs pa 'gyur mang bo mdzad/ phyis ling chu gser khab tu byon te smra sgo mtshon cha zhes bya ba'i brda sprod pa'i gzhung de brtsams/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang bo dgung lo lnga bcur nye ba'i skabs su 'brog mi dang stag lo gzhon nu brtson 'grus gnyis rgya gar du chas/ de gnyis kyis bod du bi war ta la cung zad kyang bslabs/ bal bor lo gcig bzhugs nas shārnyi ba'i slob ma bal bo'i paṇa ḍi ta shārnyi bha dra las skad legs par bslabs/ khong gis zhal brda mdzad pa bzhin bi kra ma la shi la'i mkhas pa sgo drug shar na shārnyi ba/ lho na ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ nub na shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros/ byang na nā ro paṇa chen/ dbus na rin chen rdo rje dang / dzñā na shrī rnams bzhugs pa las/ shārnyi ba la gtugs shing stag lo rdo rje gdan du skor ba byed cing bzhugs te/ slob 4lha9

gnyer cher ma byas/ 'brog mis paṇa ḍi ta mang bo'i mdun nagagazhung lugs mang bor sbyangs/ lho bal du lo bcu gsum la slob gnyer byas te slar bod du phebs/ mkhas pa chen por gyur yod pas 'chad spel gyis slob ma shin tu mang bo bskyangs pa ni sa skya 'debasadzhapa bo 'khon dkon mchog rgyal bo sogs so/ / (jo bo bod du phebs dus 'brog mi lo lnga bcu)mnga' ris kyi rje bo lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang byang chub 'od kyi ring la rgya gar nas paṇa ḍi ta mang bo spyan drangs kyang bstan pa spyi la dag ther mtha' chod pa zhig byed mkhan ma byung bas/ lo tsā ba rgya brtson seng sogs mi lnga rgya gar du mngags nas bi kra ma la shī la'i paṇa ḍi ta chen po jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha mtshan dngos mar me mdzad dpal ye shes zhes bya ba spyan drangs/ khong ni rgya gar shar phyogs bhang ga la'i yul gyi za hor rgyal bo'i sras su rab byung gong gi chu rta (982)la 'khrungs/ dgung lo nyer gcig tshun la thun mong gi rig gnas sgra tshad bzo gso la mkhas par gyur nas lo bco lnga'i dus rtog ge ba mkhas pa zhig kyang rtsod pas tshar bcad/ de rjes rgyal srid spangs nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung la sbyangs/ rab tu byung ste bsnyen par rdzogs/ gser gling ba sogs bla ma mang bo bsten/ snyan grags kyis 'dzam gling khyab pa de nyid lha bla ma byang 430

chub 'od kyi ring la nag tsho lo tsā ba nyer bdun thog slar rgya gar / du mngags te spyan drangs/ byang chub 'od kyis bskul ngor chos mdzad yongs kyi lam yig lta bu'i byang chub lam gyi sgron ma mdzad/khu rngog 'brog gsum sogs slob ma shin— tu mang bo bskyangs/gsung rtsom kyang sman dpyad 'tsho ba'i snying bo dang dri ma med pa'i phrin yig sa dpyad las rnam 'byed/ lam sgron dka' 'grel/ dbu ma'i man ngag sogs mang bo brtsams/ dgung lo don gsum thog snye thang du gshegs te sku gdung de gar bzhugs/ jo bo la brten nas lo chen dang lo chung grags 'byor shes rab/ nag tsho lo tsā ba/ shākya 'od/ yol lcags rdo rje dbang phyug dge blo sogs kyis gzhung lugs mang bo bsgyur to/ /jo bo rje'i slob ma grags che ba ni/ gtsang na 'gar 'gos yol gsum/ dbus na khu rngog 'brog gsum zer/ gtso bo 'brom ston pa ni rten dge bsnyen yin la rab byung gong gi shing 'brug (1004)la 'khrungs/dgung lo bcu dgu'i thog khams 'dan mar byon nas jo bo se —btsun dbang phyug gzhon nu zhes pa lo nyi shur bsten nas gzhung lugs mang bor sbyangs shing / paṇa ḍi ta sgra'i tsher ma(smra sgo rtsom pa bo smṛ ti'i mtshan gzhan) las bi war ta sogs dang sgra la sbyangs/ 'di ba lo so dgu'i thog jo bo bod du phebs zer lo 431

zhe gcig gi steng jo bo dang mjal lo bcu gcig gi bar du bsten te jo bo'i gdams pa ma lus pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan nas jo bo'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs par mkhyen pa'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/ dgung grangs nga bzhi'i thog rwa sgrong dgon btab ste slob ma mang bo bskyangs pas bka' gdams sku mched gsum sogs mkhas pa shin tu mang bo byung ste jo bo bka' gdams pa zhes bya ba'i grub mtha' de byung / re gcig thog rab byung dang bo'i shing 'brug (1064)lor 'das so/ /jo bo'i slob ma khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gis kyang thang bo cher bzhugs nas slob ma shin tu mang bo bskyangs/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis gsang phu ne'u thog gi dgon pa btab/ de'i dbon po'am tsha bu ni rngog lo blo ldan shes rab bo/ /jo bo'i slob ma gtsang smad rta nag gi 'gos lo tsā ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas zhes grags pa de dang bor 'brog mi dang zur chen la gtugs shing thugs tshim pa zhig ma byung bas rgya bal du lan bcu gnyis byon/ lo mang bor bzhugs/ paṇa ḍi ta bdun cu rtsa gnyis bsten te gdams pa mang bo gsan nas bod du byon te 'dus pa sogs dar bar mdzad/ slob ma mdar seng rgyan sogs drug stod lung gnam gyi rdzing kha ba dang yol mched gsum sogs mang 432

la/ sa skya ba 'khon dkon mchog rgyal bos kyang bla mar bstinartsite 'dus pa'i skor sogs gsan no/ /byang chub 'od kyi spun zla mnga' bdag 'od sdes paṇa ḍi ta sukhya shrī spyan drangs/ de'i sras rtse ldes kha che dzñā na shrī spyan drangs te/ khyung bo chos brtson gyis lo tsā byas nas/ tshad ma rnam nges/ de'i ṭīka khong nyid kyis mdzad pa la sogs pa mang bo bsgyur/ gzhan yang tsan+d+ra rā hu la spyan drangs te lo tsā ba ting nge 'dzin bzang bos tshad ma kun las btus pa la sogs pa bsgyur/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis kyang dus 'khor sogs mang bo bsgyur/ lho brag mar ba chos kyi blo gros rgya gar du lan gsum phebs te nā ro/ me tri/ zhi ba bzang bo pham thing ba sogs bsten nas man ngag mang bo zhus shing bsgyur bas slob ma ka chen bzhi sogs byung ba grags che/ 'di ba rab byung dang bo'i gong gi shing byi (1024)lor 'khrungs/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab kyis kyang paṇa ḍi ta kha che dgon pa ba dang / te dza de ba/ pa ra hi ta bha dra la sogs pa bsten nas spyod 'jug gi 'grel chen dang yo ga sogs mang bo bsgyur/ gnyan dar ma grags rgya gar du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs te paṇa ḍi ta ma ti bsten/ paṇa ḍi ta sukhya shrī spyan drangs te spyod 'jug 'grel chen dang sgrol ma sogs bsgyur/ khye'u gad pa 'khor 433

lo grags dang / spang zho gsal ba grags/ rtsod ka mi nyag rtso mi sangs rgyas grags rnams kyis paṇa ḍi ta a snya ya tā ra bsten nas dus 'khor phreng ba skor gsum/ thub pa dgongs rgyan/ man ngag snye ma la sogs pa bsgyur/ kre bo lo tsā ba sges rab da pal gyis kyang a bha ya kā ra bsten nas gnad kyi zla zer la sogs pa bsgyur/ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags kyis paṇa ḍi ta don yod rdo rje spyan drangs te don zhags la sogs pa bsgyur/ klog skya shes rab grags kyis mtshan brjod dang dbu ma 'jug pa sogs bsgyur ro/ /pa tshab lo tsā ba nyi ma grags kha cher phebs nas lo nyi shu rtsa gsum la gzhung lugs mtha' dag la sbyangs/ bod du phebs nas paṇa ḍi ta ka na ka warma spyan drangs nas dbu ma'i skor rnams bsgyur/ bshad pa rgya cher mdzad pas slob ma pa tshab bu bzhi la sogs pa byudi ngo / / 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags kha cher byon te slob gnyer mdzad/ paṇa ḍi ta zla ba mgon po spyan drangs te dus 'khor cha lag rgyas pa dang / rdo rje snying 'grel/ phyag rdor stod 'grel la sogs pa bsgyur/ ba reg thos pa dga'/ rma ban chos 'bar/mtshur lo tsā ba rnams kyis rgya gar phyag na rdo rje bsten nas chos mang bo bsgyur/ dpyal lo tsā ba kun dga' rdo rjes b.lasmobo hang 434

du dkar bo bsten/ paṇa ḍi ta stong nyid ting nge 'dzin spyan drangs te man ngag mang bo zhus so/ /rwa rdo rje grags kyis bal bo bha ro bsten/ bal bo thugs rje chen po yagaspyan drangs te gshed skor dang he ru ka mngon 'byung gi skor sogs bsgyur/ de'i dbon po chos rab kyis paṇa ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī spyan drangs te dus 'khor sogs bsgyur/ zhang shes rab bla mas paṇa ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra spyan drangs te chos mang bo bsgyur/ rgyus lo tsā ba smon lam grags kyis paṇa ḍi ta gzhan la phan pa bsten te sdom 'byung sogs bsgyur/ lo tsā ba zha ma seng rgyal gyis paṇa ḍi ta nor bzang slung ba la sogs pa bsten nas tshad ma kun las btus pa rtsa 'grel sogs bsgyur ro/ /rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyi dbon po rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab ni/ lo chen rin chen bzang bo lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'i thog nag tsho lo tsā ba 'khrungs/ nag tsho lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i thog (1059) rngog lo blo ldan shes rab 'khrungs pa yin gsungs/khong gzhon nu'i dus nas khu bo legs pa'i shes rab kyi drung nas yon tan la sbyangs/ khong shes rab mchog tu gyur pa de la khu bo mnyes nas lo bcu bdun lon tshe kha cher slob gnyer la brdzangs/de'i tshe rwa lo/ gnyan lo/ snyekhyungajibo chos brtson/ rngo ston/435

btsan kha bo che rnams dang 'grogs nas kha cher byon/ paṇa ḍi ta drug tsam bsten nas slob gnyer gnang / bar skabs su rgyags chad nas mnga' ris su gser slong ba'i yi ge btang / rtse lde'i sras dbang ldes gser mang bo bskur/ tshad ma rgyan sgyur cig ces bskul bas paṇa ḍi ta skal ldan rgyal bo dang khong gnyis kyis legs par bsgyur/ kha cher lo bcu bdun du yang dag par sbyangs nas slar bod du phebs/ bod du yang paṇa ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang su ma ti tīti ཿ gnyis la yang chos gsan zhing /yang bal bor byon te/ a tu l+ya badz+ra dang ba ren dra ru tsi la sogs pa la gdams pa mang bo gsan/ slar bod du byon/'gyur mang bo mdzad pa yang dag cing shin tu bzang / 'gyur mdzad pa'i tshad ni gro lung ba'i gsung las/ dam chos bsgyur la mnga' brnyes pas/ /rgyal yum gnyis dang bstan bcos gzhung / /'bum phrag gcig dang khri phrag gsum/ /stong phrag bdun ni lhag bcas bsgyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /tshad ma/byams chos/ dbu ma sogs kyi rnam bshad sogs gsung rtsom mang / slob ma bu chen bzhi sogs shin tu mang / bu chen bzhi ni/ zhing tshe spong ba chos kyi bla ma/ zhing gro lung ba blo gros 'byung gnas/ khyung rin chen grags/ 'bri shes rab 'bar bzhi'o/ /436

gro lung ba blo gros 'byung gnas kyi slob ma cha ba chos kyi seng gi ni rab byung gnyis pa'i chu mo lug (1103)la 'khrungs/ khyung rin grags kyi slob ma rgya dmar ba dang gro lung ba chen po la sogs pa bla ma du ma bsten/ lung rigs kyis sgro 'dogs bcad/ gtsang ne'u thog gi gdan sa lo bco brgyad kyi bar du mdzad/ tshad ma rnam nges latshusogs pa'i gzhung mang bo la 'grel ba brtsams mdo sde ba'i rigs pa la bsten pa'i bsdus grwa zhes pa'i rigs lam gyi srol 'byed pa bo yang slob dpon 'di yab sras yin zer/ tshad ma'i bsdus pa yid kyi mun sel rtsa 'grel la sogs pa'i rang gzhung mang du brtsams/ snyan grags kyi gdugs dkar bo bla na 'khor ba de'i sras kyi gtso bo seng chen brgyad du grags pa ni/gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge/ dan 'bag pa smra ba'i seng ge/ 'bru sha bsod nams seng ge/ rma bya rtsod pa'i seng ge/ rtsags dbang phyug seng ge/ nying bran chos kyi seng ge/ ldan ma dkon mchog seng ge/ gnya la ba na tan seng ge ste brgyad/ 'khon jo sras(sa skya dkar bo rnam gsum gyi gnyis pa sa skya slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo yin la khong gtsang ne'u thog gi grwa sar lo bcu gcig la bzhugs gsungs) / rngog jo sras ra mo/ khu jo sra sa ne tso/ gnyos jo sras dpal le dang bzhi la jo sras bzhi zer/ (jo 437

sras rnams gos spu gu can de rab byung min 'dug)'gar ba dbang grub/ kong po 'jag chung / lho ba sgog zan/ bar phu ba dang bzhi la shes rab can bzhi zer/ gzhan yang 'dzad pa ston skyabs dang rdo rje 'od zer la sogs pa dang / karma dus gsum mkhyen pa yang slob ma yin/ khong no'u thog gi grwa sar lo dgur bzhugs/ gzhan yang bla ma zhang tshal ba la sogs pa slob ma shin tu mang ngo / /yang yar 'brog gi mar ba do ba chos kyi dbang phyug gis kyang gzhung mang bo bsgyur/ dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang bo rgya gar du lo bcur bzhugs/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa dang kha che paṇa chen sogs bsten/ chos mang bo bsgyur/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal gyis snga phyir shrī dzā ga ta mi tra ā nardo zhes pa mi tra dzo gi zhes grags pa dang paṇa ḍi ta bud dha shrī dzñā na/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī bha dra rnams spyan drangs te gzhung mang bo bsgyur/ paṇa chen shākya shrī la 'khor paṇa chung bi bhū hi tsan+d+ra dang da na shī la dang bal bo saṃ snya shrī dang su ga ta shrī la sogs pa dgu byon te/ bi snyu ti dang da na shī la gnyis bod du yun ring bor bzhugs/ bod kyi skad yig la yang mkhas par gyur nas rang 'gyur yang mdzad do/ /chag dgra bcom dang de'i dbon po chag chos rje dpal gnyis kyang rgya gar du byon paṇa ḍi ta mang bo 43byi

bsten nas slob gnyir gnang / gsar 'argyur dang 'argyur bcos mang bo byas so/ / g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po'ang rgya gar du lan drug phebs/ sman dang rig gnas spel ba'i lo rgyus logs su bris yod la/ phyis su bya nga zur rnam gnyis kyis kyang gso rig rgya cher spel ba'i lo rgyus logs su 'bri 'dun yod do/ / sa skya paṇa chen ni rab byung gsum pa'i chu stag (1182)la 'khrungs/ kha che paṇa chen dang da na shī la las sgra dang rnam 'grel bslabs te rnam 'grel la 'gyur bcos byas/ mkhas pa chen por gyur nas chos ma dag pa sun phyung ngo / khong gis rig gnas sbyangs pa ni/ rnam tharatrelas/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas dang / /dmar seng dang ni rgyal ba'i lha/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal la thos/ /rgyan gyi /bstan bcos daṇa ḍi dang / /dbyangs can mgul rgyan la sogs pa/ /dge 'dun dpal la legs par bslabs/ /mngon brjod bstan bcos 'chi med mdzod/ /de yi rgya cher 'grel ba bcas/ /mkhas pa gsum la legs par gtugs/ /nag mo khol gyi snyan ngag gsum/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i dpal gyis bshad/ /byang chub sems dpa'i skye ba'i rabs/ /bdag nyid chen po gnyis las thos /439

zhes sogs gsungs/ 'di dag gi gzhung ni de skabs bod du ma 'gyur bas legs sbyar gyi yi ge'i steng nas bslabs te dar bar mdzad na'ang de dag gi gzhung yongs rdzogs bsgyur pa ni med do/ /khong gi gsung rig gnas’dziyang dadzipa'i chos kyi lam ston pa/ sa skya'i legs bshad/ sgra 'jug sgra nye bar bsdu ba/sdeb sbyorad+ngha me tog chun po/ tshig gter/ rol mo'i bstan bcos/shes rab 'phro ba/ shes rab la 'jug pa/ mkhas 'jug snyan ngag mkhas pa'i kha rgyan/ zlos gar rab dga'i 'jug pa/ sku gzugs kyi bstan bcos/ bzo'i bstan bcos/ sa brtag pa/bstan rtsis/ sman dpyad bsdus don/ smra sgo'i bsdus don/ yi ge'i sbyor ba/ byis 'jug 'grel ba/ rigs gter sogs dang gzhan yang mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos mang bo brtsams so/ /shong lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan ni/ bal yul du byon nas paṇa ḍi ta ma hen dra bha dra lo lngar bsten nartswarig gnas chung ba lnga la bslabs/ khyad par sgra rig pa la shin tu byang bar mdzad/paṇa ḍi ta la dzi shrī spyan drangasi te snyan ngag me long / dpag bsam 'khri shing / klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ bstod pa brgya ba/ dus 'khor sogs gzhi 'gyur dang 'gyur bcos spyang mdzad de rig pa'i gnas shin tu dar bar mdzad/ de'i gcung 440

bo shong blo gros brtan rtsa/sa kyang gzhi 'gyur dang 'gyur bcos kyang byas/ yar lung grags pha rgyal mtshan gyis bya ba bsdus pa la sogs pa bsgyur to/ /bu ston rin po che'i bla ma nyi ma rgyal mtshan bzang bos bal bor lo bcu bzhir sbyangs pa mdzad/ ri'i kun tu dga' ba'i mdo la sogs pa lo bcu gsum tsam la paṇa ḍi ta ā nan+ta spyan drangs te bsgyur ba dang gzhan yang gzhi 'gyur dang /'gyur bcos kyang mang bo mdzad do/ /shong lo'i slob ma dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa ni rab byung lnga ba'i me byi (1276)la la stod lho ru 'khrungs/ gzhon dus nas stag sde ba sogs bshes gnyen du ma bsten nas rig gnas dus 'khor sogs la sbyangs/ lo bcu dgu'i thog lo tsā ba mchog ldan las sgra ka lha pa dang tsan dra ba bslabs/ snyan ngag me long yang gsan/ a tsa ra 'phrad tshad la 'phral skad bslabs/yud tsam gyis zhu chen gyi lo tsā bar gyur/ bal bor lan gsum byon/ rig gnas dang sngags mtshan nyid kye gzhung shin tu mang bo la gzhi 'gyur dang 'gyur bcos mdzad/ gzhung mang bo'i ṭīka yang mang du brtsams/ thugs rab shin tu che ste khong gi gsung las/ sngon tshe sbyangs pas skye ba 'dir/ /gzhung rnams rtsed mo'i zhar la shes/ /shong ston legs bshad lde mig blang sa/ /dhe 441

legs sbyar skad kyi gter kha phyi/ /sna tshogs gzhung lugs rin chen blangs/ /legs bshad dga' ston 'byed la dbang / /zhes gsungs pa dang / mdor na/ khong zhal bzhugs pa'i tshe khong las mgo 'phang mtho ba'i mkhas pa su yang med zer/ de'i dbon po lo tsā ba byang chub rtse mos kyang bsgyur bshad sogs kyis khu bo'i lugs legs par bskyangs so/ / bu ston rin po che ni rab byung lnga ba'i lcags stag (1290)la 'khrungs/ dang bor thar ba lo tsā ba las tsan dra ba bslabs nas lo tsā mkhas par mkhyen/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan sogs kyi mdun nas dus 'khor sogs mdo rgyud mtha' yas pa gsan/rtsis sogs la'ang legs par sbyangs/ dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel ba sum brgya drug cu ba yang bsgyur/ dus 'khor shong 'gyur la 'gyur bcos mang du gnang / bod du 'gyur ba'i gzhung mtha' dag la zhib brtag mdzad/ chos 'byung rin po che dang rtis gzhung mkhas pa dga' bskyed sogs gsung rtsom pod sum cur nye ba brtsams/ 'di ba'i gsung 'bum gyi par sngar med la rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa'i ring la rtse po ta la'i shod du dzir gsar bzhengs gnang skabs dge bshes rin po che 'bras sgo shes rab rgya mtshos zhu chen mdzad do/ /bu'i slob ma lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal 44lha

(sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal yang zer)gyis kyang gzhi 'gyurno dang 'gyur bcos 'chad spel sogs kyi sgo nas bu rin po che'i rgyun bskyangs so/ /gzhan yang snar thang lo tsā ba si snya shrī/ zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang bo (dag yigartsoza ma tog rtsom pa bo)/skyogs ston lo tsā ba ngag dbang rin chen bkra shis(smin grub lo tsā ba yang zer la li shi'i gur khang rtsom pa bo yin) / lo chen skyabs mchog dpal/ stag lo shes rab rin chen sogs rig gnas rgya mtsho'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'i lo tsā ba dang mkhas pa shin tu mang bo byung mod thams cad brjod kyis mi lang ngo khyad par du rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal byon nas mdo sngags rig gnas kyi bshad sgrub lhag par 'phel te/bod yul 'dir slob gnyer bas sa steng khyab pa byung / khong shar phyogs tsong kha'i yul du rab byung drug pa'i me bya (1357)la sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo gsum bzhes pa na karma pa rol ba'i rdo rje las dge bsnyen bsgrubs te/ mtshan kun dga' snying bor gsol/dgung lo brgyad pa'i dus shar phyogs rig pa'i dpa' bo zhes grags pa'i mkhas pa chen po chos rje don 'grub rin chen las rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te blo bzang grags pa zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ bla ma de nyid las klog dang rig gnas 443

mdo sngags kyi gdams pa mang du gsan nas/ dgung lo bcu drug gi thog bod du byon/ dam pa chen pos gezhan rdon byed pa la rig gnas mtha' dag sbyang dgos dgongs nas tshal gung thang nas tshe yi rig byed pa dkon mchog skyabasalas gso dpyad kyi gzhung la sbyangs shing / yan lag brgyad pa thugs la bzung /lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang pho las snyan ngag me long soges bslabs/ bo dong lo chen zham bzang ba las sgra kalnga pa dang /sgra tsan+d+ra pa dang / sdeb sbyor sogs la sbyangs/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen sogs las kyang bslabs/ tshal pa rtogs ldan ye sheyorgyal mtshan las rtsis kyi lag len mthar phyin par sbyangs so/ /rig gnas che ba lnga'i ya gyal tshad ma rig pa la thos pa mdzad tshul ni/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa red mda' ba dang / lo tsā ba don bzang las tshad ma'i gzhung rnams legs par gsan te sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa rnams la gzigs rtog mdzad cing /gung bsgrigs nas legs par gtan la phab/ bod kyi bshad srol phal cher 'grel ba dang mi mthun par gzigs nas/ tshad ma kun las btus kyi rang 'grel 'grel bshad dang bcas pa dang /rnam 'grel gyi 'grel ba lha shāka gnyis dang / bram ze gnyis kyi 'grel ba dang / rgyan gyi 'grel ba dang / de'i 'grel bshad gnyis 444

dang / rnam nges rang 'grel dang / de'i 'grel bshad sogs chos mchog gis mdzad pa dang / rigs thigs kyi 'grel ba chos mchog gis mdzad pa ste/ 'grel ba 'grel bshad gzhung phran dang bcas pa legs par gtan la phab nas thugs sbyang mdzad pas dgyis phyin par thugs su chud do / /nang don rig pa'i nang tshan phar phyin la thos pa mdzad tshul ni/ chos grwa chen po bde ba can’du byon nas/ snye thang ba bkra shis seng ge dang / slob dpon yon tan rgya mtsho/ bla ma rin po che u rgyan pa rnams las mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa gsan pa dang / bla ma 'jam rin pa las kyang byams chos rgyud bla ma/ mdo sde rgyan dbus mtha' rnam 'byed chos nyid rnam 'byed rnams gsan pa dang / nya dpon kun dga' dpal ba'i drung nas phar phyin gyi gzab bshad tshar gcig gsan pas thugs yid shin tu tshim pa byung bstadang / gzhan yang mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel ba 'grel bshad shin tu mang bo la sbyangs pas mkhas pa'i mthar son te 'grel ba legs bshad gser gyi phreng ba ljags rtsom mdzad do/ / nang don rig pa'i gzhung dbu ma la sbyangs pa mdzad tshul ni/ rje btsun red mda' ba sogs kyi mdun nas/ klu sgrub kyiri 445

rigs tshogs drug rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa4dang / dbu ma bzhi brgya ba rtsa 'grel/ dbu ma 'jug pa rtsa 'grel sogs klu sgrub lugs kyi gzhung mtha' di ga la sbyangs pas dgongs pa mthar thug pa thugasangasu chud nas/ dbu ma'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal/ rtsa she ṭīka chen drang nges legs bshad snying bo sogs mdzad do/ / gzhan yang / nang don rig pa'i sde snod 'dul mngon dang gsang sngags la sbyangs shing nyams su blangs pas/ mkhyen rto gas kyi rgya mtsho brdol/ snyan grags kyis 'dzam gling khyab ste rab byung bdun pa'i sa glang (1409)la dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling phyag 'debs mdzad do/ / rje'i gdan sa dga' ldan ni/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen nas bzung ste/ dga' ldan khri ba rim byon gyis bskyangs pa las rje rin po che la sprul sku blu ba'i srol ma byung / rje'i slob ma 'jam dbyangs chos rjes rab byung bdun pa'i me sprel (1416) la 'bras spungs btab/ byams chen chos rjes rab byung bdun pa'i sa phag (1419)la se ra btab/ paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyis rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos (1447) la bkra shis lhun po btab/ dgon chen 'di bzhi la gdan sa chen po bzhi zer ro/ /446

paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi gdan sa bkra shis lhun por yang de skabs sprul sku blu rgyu'i srol med stabs/ gdan sa skyong mkhan paṇa chen bzang bo bkra shis/ paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo rnams rim par bzhugs/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho rab byung brgyad pa'i me sprel (1476)lor sku 'khrungs/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo'i dus su/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho rje dge 'dun grub kyi sprulasku yin rgyu byas nas bkra shis lhun por bzhugs pa la/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mos phrag dog gi rnam r+bha mdzad pas der ma bzhugs par 'bras spungs su phebs/ mkhas tshul ches cher bzhes/ 'bras spungs thams cad mkhyen pa zhes grags shing snyan grags rgyas/ de nas chos 'khor rgyal gyi dgon pa btab cing 'phrin las shin tu rgyas pa'i skabs/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mos nan tan mdzad pa bzhin byon nas bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sar lo kha shas la bzhugs/ de nas phyir 'bras spungs su phebs/ dge lugs pa'i sprul sku'i thog ma 'di ba yin zer/ de nas bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sar/ mnga' ris chos lha btsun bstan pa'i nyi ma bzhugs/ de nas paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan bar du gdan rabs bcu song la/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyul mtsha/ na bkra shis lhun po'i 447

gdan sar sku mya —ngan las 'das reg gi bar du bzhugs pas/de nas bzung ste paṇa chen sku phring rim byospyo gyis bkra shis lhun po'i spudan sa bzudz+wa ngo / / paṇa chen blo n+dethong chosasgyu rgyan ni/ rab rgyude bcu blo'i lcags rta (1570) la 'a‘ngas/ dbe+en sa ba blo bzang don 'grub kyis sprul skur ngos 'dzin byas nas bkra shis lhun por slob gnyer gnang ste gzhon dus nas mkhas chen du gyur/ smyo dben sa paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen dzi zhes snyan grags kyis sa steng khyab/ dge lugs pa'i sprul sku gnyis pa 'di ba yispyo par grags/ spyir sprul sku blu ba'i thog rma karma pak+ṣi chos kyi bla ma nas byung la/ dge lugs pa'i sprul sku'i thog6ma rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho dadz+wa / de nas paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan yin 'dug mod/ 'on kyang de rnatshwa pa gnyis ka'ang 'bad pas btsa la te ang grangs bsgrigs nes gser bum dkrug pa lta bu deng dus kyi sprul sku ngos 'dzin lta bu min te/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgyajimatsho ni byis pa'i dus nas ludzo rtogs kyi yon tan phyir mngon pas/ kun gyis rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyi skye bar yid ches byas pa dang / paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis kyang byis pa'i dus nasatsholung rtogs kyi yon tan phyir mngon pas/ dben sa ba sangs rgyas ye shes kyis dben sa blo 448

bzang don 'grub kyi skye bar ngos bzung nas slob gnyer la mthun rkyen bsgrubs pas phyis su mkhas grags kyis sa steng khyab pa byung ba gong smos ltar ro/ / na ning / 1980lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i 〈〈bod ljongs ni spung go'i cha shas shig yin〉zhes pa'i dpe deb kyi shog grangs brgya bar ‘‘tā la'i bla ma yang srid phebs pa de ni/ tsong kha pas gtan la phab pa zhig red/ tsong kha pas srol gtod gnang ba'i dge lugs pa'i bstan pa ltar na gnyen bsgrigs nas bu rgyud spel mi chog par brten/ khong gis slob ma chen po gnyis la yang srid yong ste theg chen gyi chos lugs bshad nas chos rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'gan len byed dgos pa'i zhal chems gnang yod pa red’’ces bris 'dug 'di ni nor ba red/de lta bu'i zhal chems gtan nas med/ rje tsong kha pa yab sras kyi ring la dge lugs par sprul sku blu ba'i srol med/ rje 'das nas/rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa'i bar la lo ngo nga drug song / rje 'das nas paṇa blo bzang chos rgyan 'khrungs pa'i bar la lo ngo brgya dang lnga bcu song / ‘‘tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid phebs pa tsong kha pas gtan la phab pa red/ ’’ zer mkhan gyi bshad tshul la bltas na rgyal ba paṇa chen gnyis rje tsong kha pa'i 449

sras kyi thu bo rgyal tshab rje dang mkhas grub rje'i sprul sku red snyam pa yin 'dug de lta bu'i nor 'khrul gyi gtam sngon dus nas rgya'i yig thog la yod zer ba thos myong / rī — rje bdag nyid chen po de'i slob ma ni/ bla ma chos 'brel gsan pa bzhi/ snga tshar bzhi/ 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad/ sras kyi thu bo gnyis/ 'khor khyad par du 'phags pa bzhi/ nang thugs kyi sras gcig 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bu chin bzhi/ dbus gtsang bstan pa'i sgron me bcu/ gzhan don lhun gyis grub pa'i sems dpa' drug mi dbang gtsug na mdzes pa'i ti shrī gnyis/ rgya chen mang du thos pa'i dpon sras gnyis/sbyangs pa'i yon tan 'dzin pa'i cog che chung gnyis/ rnam dpyod phul du byung ba'i mkhas pa gnyis/ bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba'i dar chen drug skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba gnyis/ sa skyong chos rje drug gsung rab mang du mkhyen pa'i bstan 'dzin brgyad/ mdo rong gi mkhas pa bzhi/ mkha' spyod grub pa'icigadung rgyud gnyis/ skyes bu ya mtshan can gnyis/ spyan snga brgyad/ khri steng mdzes pa'i bla chen bzhi/ tshogs pa skyong ba'i mkhan po bzhi/ sde dgon phra mo'i chen po lnga/ chos sgo ba gnyis/'chad nyan gyi rgyal mtshan sgreng ba'i slob dpon bzhi/ rigs pa 450

smra ba'i dka' bcu ba bzhi/ tshig don 'dzin pa'i dka' bzhi ba bcu/ rnam par dag pa'i gnas brtan byeg tshe blos btang gi rtogs ldan lnga la sogs pa lung rtogs kyi yon tan la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas pa chen po snyan grags can mtha' yas pa yod do/ /slob ma de dag gi nang nas kyang mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang dang zhang zhung ba chos dbang grags pa gnyis ni snyan ngag gi tshig rgyan la ched du mkhas par grags shing mkhas grub rjes mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi bstod pa las/ 'di 'dra'i snyan ngag mu tig do shal gang gi kha las rab 'phyang ba/ /bder gshegs gsung gi legs bshad phreng bas lce rtse rnam par brgyan pa ni/ /blo gros shes bya'i pha mtha' la 'gran shākya'i dge slong dge legs dpal/ /bzang bo zhes bya 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs pad bsten la cimangon dga' yin/ /zhes dang / gangs can mkhas pa kun gyi mgo bo la/ /tshig gi gom pa 'god mkhas dge legs dpal/ /bzang bos tshig gi sbyor ba spangs te smras/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar snyan ngag gi rtsom ches mang / zhang zhung ba chos dbang grags pas snyan ngag rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod sogs gzhung mang bo brtsams so/ /de bzhin du rje'i slob ma slob rgyud 451

rmedang bcas pas nang don rig pa ma zad tha lhad rig gnas kyang ches cher dar bar mdzod do/ / —jo nang kun dga' grol mchog gi sprul sku tā ra na tha ste sgol ba'i mgon po ni rabasgyubyung bcu ba'i shing phag (1575)lor 'khrungs/ khong gis kyang rig gnas sogs kyi bstan bcosaḥmang bo brtsams/ 'phags yulgo nayosnyon pa'i paṇa ḍi3ta kha shas bsten pas/ legs sbyar gyi skad daja sgra rig pha la'ang mkhas pa chen por gyur/ sgra mdo dbyangs can ma bsgyur ba dang / 'grel ba mchog tu gsal ba/ zhes bya ba brtsams pa de la/ tā ra na tha'i sgra ṭīka zhes grags che/ gter bdag gling ba 'gyur med rdo rje ste smin gling gter chen du grags pa'ang kun gzigs lnga ba chen mos rig gnas kyi slob dpon du bsten/ rig gnaṅge rgya mtsho'i greng ba 'dzin pa smon gro ba yab sras zhes bsngags༈brjod cher mdzad/ khyad par du gter chen gyi gcung lo chen snyarma shrī bya ba mdo sngags gsar rnying / tha snyad rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa zhig byung bas bstan bcos mang du brtsams so / /rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po ni rab byung bcu ba'i me sbrul (1617) la 'khrungs/ khong gis mdo sngags gsar rnying dang /tha snyad rig gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs te bstan bcos ches mang 452

bo brtsams/ snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi gsung rtsom yang mang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos kyang bai dkar/ bai ser/ bai sngon sogs rig gnas kyi gzhung mang bo brtsams/ khyad par du sman la mkhas par grags so/ /rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dus su/ 'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun 'grub kyis/ paṇa ḍi ta bā la bhā dra dang / de'i gcung paṇa ḍi ta ko ku la nā tha mi shri gnyis la brten nas lo tsā ba khong dgung lo nyer lnga'i thog rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa khyi (1658) lo la dpal ldan 'bras spungs su sgra pā ṇi ba'i 'grel chen nor gyi shing rta zhes bya ba brtsams/ de rjes rgyal dbang lnga ba'i bka' bzhin/ paṇa ḍi ta sku mched dang lo tsā gsum rtse pho brang chen mor bzhugs te/ sgra mdo dbyangs can ma dang 'grel ba gsal ldan bsgyur ro/ / trī rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dngos slob kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje ni rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa byi (1648) la sku bltams/ khong gis mdo sngags tha snyad rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung mang du brtsams shing / mdo smad lho rgyud du chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil zhes yongs su dze 453

grags pa de nyid btab/ chos sde 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas te bod gangs can gyi bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi lte gnas su gyur/bdag gis spyang chos sde chen po de'i mthu la brten nas phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas dag la bag chags cung zad cig 'jog thub pa'i skal ba thob/ rgyal dbang bdun pa'i dus su/ khams sde dger si tu gtsug lag chos kyi snang ba byon te dpal spungs dgon btab/ sgra dang snyan ngag sdeb sbyor sogs kyi gzhung gsar 'gyur dang 'gyur bcos yang mang du mdzad/ slob ma mkhas pa mang bo byon/'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yang sprul kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bos mdo dbus kun nas slob dpon mang bo bsten te gsan sbyangs mdzad pas mkhas grags kyis sa steng khyab / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i dngos slob dbyig gya paṇa ḍi ta dang / bra ti rin chen don 'grub kyi dngos slob dge bshes blo bzang dge legs si tu'i dngos slob kun dga' sangs rgyas las kyang gsan te tha snyad rig gnas kyang dar spel mdzad pas/mdo smad lho byang sogs sa phyogs kun tu 'di ba'i khrid rgyun dang zhal rgyun gyi rig pa'i gnas kyi me tog dge mtshan gyi dri bsung 'thul ba da lta'i bar du gnas pa 'di bzhin lags so/ /dus 454

:phyis khams sde dge phyogs su'ang mkhas pa chen po 'ga' zhig byon te/ rdzogs chen dpal sprul/ 'jacha/ dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang bo/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ 'ju mi pham sogs byon te phyi nang rig pa'i gnas kyi legs bzhad kyi bdud rtsis skal ba dang ldan pa dag tshim par byas so/ /'di dag ni che rags tsam bshad pa yin gyi rgyas par ni/ rgyal rabs deb ther rnams dang / mkhas pa rang rang gi rnam thar las shes par bya'o/ / brod / ne+eg gnaska rgu ltasko du dan spyolu/ bod kyi rig gnas rgya yul du dar tshul ni/ chos rgyal mes dbon gyi sku ring la/ rgya nag gi btsun pa dang / rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa mang bo bod yul du byon nas/ chos dang rig gnas spel ba'i mdzad rjes rlabs che la/ dus rabs nyi shu ba'i 'go tsam nas bod kyi rig gnas rgya yul du dar ba'i 'go brtsams/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng lnga ba'i yongs 'dzin gtsang ba yongs 'dzin zhes grags pa'i mkhas pa chen po de rgya nag tu phebs te byang chub chos tshogs zhes pa'i tshogs pa btsugs/ tshogs pa de lho hrang he nas khrung ching dang khrin tu 455

bar dang / byang bai cin nas lan gru bar du dar zhing rgyas te tshogs mi mang che bas bod yig dang bod kyi sum rtags sogs rig gnas la sbyangs/ rgya'i btsun pa dang mkhas pa mang bo dbus gtsang gi se 'bras dang / mdo smad kyi bla brang sku 'thum sogs su phebasponas bod kyi rig gnas la sbyangs/ dper na blo bzang chos 'pha gas chos kyi bla ma zhes bya ba'i lo tsā ba chen 4spu de nyid 1902lor pe cin gro nga khyer nye 'dabs su sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas yi ger sbyangs dgung lo nyi shu'i skabs pe cin h+pha yon dgon du bzhugs/ de rjes u han nang bstan slob grwar zhugs/ de rjes bod yul khams su byon nas lo shas la bod kyi skad yig sbyangs/ de rjes dbus gtsang du phebs te 'bras spungs sogs su bzhugs/ brag dkar dge bshes bla mar bsten te bod kyi rig pa'i gnas mang boralasbyangs/ bstan bcos ma mongon rtogs rgyan/ lam rim chen mo/ drang nges rnam 'byed rgya yig tu bsgyur/ bod rigs kyi chos srid lo rgyus zhes pa dang nga 'gro sa'i bod yul zhes pa brtsams/ lo ngo bcu phrag lhag la bod yul du bzhugs/ de rjes rgya yul du phebs khrung ching rgya bod gzhung lugs slob grwa chen mo btsugs/ snga phyir rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal sngags rim chen mo rim lnga gsal sgron sogs rje'i ri 45khyo

gsung mang bo dang dbu ma bzhi brgya ba sogs bsgyur/ glodz+wa chen mdzod bdun yang bsgyur/ de rjes pe cin du phebs nasau‘bezhugag bye brag bshad mdzod chen mo bam po nyis brgya rgya yig nas bod yig tu bsgyur(oṃtshostsaṣ+ṭha3)/ nye char (1979dang1980) lo gnyis ring tshad ma rnam 'grel(r+ṣablostsar+ṣa)dang spyi don— rigs rgyan yang bsgyur/ khong lo tsā ba phyag rjes tsan zhig red/ spyo ning (1980)lo'i zla12pa'i tshes14la sku 'das/ btsunarupa kong khung(lkokya)zhes pa'ang bod yul du lo medza bor sbyangs nas nye char (1979dang1980) lo gnyis ring la rgya'i slob dpon wen tsheg(ar+sāspyo.oṃ7) gis mdzad pa'i mdo dgongs 'grel gyi ske 'grel ba rgya yig tu mi tshang ba bod yig gi thog nas bsgyur te kha bskangs/ lo tsā ba de da lta pe cin rdu krung go nangasabastan slob grwa chen mo'i slob dpon du bzhugs yod/ gzhan yang / krang yis sun(lkophya.oṃ)zhes pa'i dge rgan chen mo des/ bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo'i rmang gzhi dang bodawā shan sbyar dang / rgya bod skad tshogs rnams skad gnyis shan sbyar du bsgrig rtsom mdzad/ thu'u bkwan spub mtha'i dum gcig kyang rgya yig tu bsgyur/ khong da lta dgung lo gya brgyad red/ li'u li chan(smo/2tso)gyisari mi la ras pa'i rnam thar dang / thu'u bkwan grub mtha'/ rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me 451

long rnams bsgyur/ — khong da lta khrin tur ngal gsos nas bzhugs yod/ gzhan yang khrin tu dang / dar mdo/— mtsho sngon/ bla brang sogs su rgya'i mkhas pa mang bosu bod yig dang bod kyi rig gnas sbyangs so/ /da lta bod yul yongasta khyab tu slob grwa btsugs te rgya yig slob bzhin pa yin pame/ rgya'i rig gnas mtha' dag bod yul du dar ba'i 'go tshugs yod do/ /sdod / nig glunaska sgog gulu du dan spyoska / sog yul du bod kyi rig gnas dar tshul ni/ rab byung bzhi ba'i me yos lor/ rī sog rgyal stobs ldan ching gi si bod du byon nas stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ lho khams sgang gsum thams cad dbang du bsdus/ sa chen kun dga' snying bo dang yon mchod du gyur/ de rjes ching gi si'i tsha bo gu yug dang go tan gnyis kyis lang spu'u sogs khams kyi rgyal bo byed skabs go tan gyis sa skya paṇa chen gyi snyan grags thos nas/mi sna btang ste sa skya paṇa chen sog yul du gdan drangs/ de yan chad sog po la yi ge med pas/ sa paṇa gyis yi ge gsar ba bzo bar bzhed pa na bud med cig gis pags pa mnyed pa'i shing sog le'i kha lta bu zhig thogs pa gzigs nas sog yig de'i 458

dbyibs—can bzos te/ a e i/ na ni ni/ sa se si/ ha ke khi/ gha ghi snyi/ ma me mi/ la le li/ ra re ri 'a 'e 'i / ta te ti/ tha the thi/ tsa tse tsi/ tsha tshe tshi ya ye yi wa we wi rnams pho mo ma ning ngam grim lhod zhan gsum du bsdus nas klog pa'i srol btod/ de rjes rab byung lnga ba'i sa rta lor chos rgyal 'phags pas sog yig 'khor ma gru bzhi ma bzos/ 'on kyang 'di tham ka'i ngos la bed spyod pa las sog yig dngos gzhi ni sa paṇa gyis bzos pa'i pags shad kyi so dbyibs can deng sang gi bar bed spyod bzhin pa de red/ de rjes sa skya ba chos sku 'od zer sog yul du byon nas sngar sa paṇa gyis bzos pa'i yi ge la yi ge mjug ma can mang bo bsnan nas bod yig gi thog nas gzhung — lugs sogayig tu bsgyur ba'i 'go tshugs/ de rjes shi re thu gu shrīs yum gsum bod yig las sog skad du bsgyur/ cha har legs ldan ho thog thu'i dus su/ kun dga' 'od zer gtso byas pa'i lo tsā ba mang bos bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs sog skad du bsgyur/khang shi bde skyid rgyal bo'i dus sog yig gi bka' 'gyur zhu dag mdzad nas par du bsgrubs/ gong ma chen lung rgyal bo'i dus bstan 'gyur yongs su rdzogs pa sog skad du bsgyur nas par du bskrun/ 'di dus lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rjes sog skad du bsgyur 459

la med mi rung gi dag yig mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bod sog shan sbyar gyi ming mdzod de brtsams so/ /'on kyang sog yul du mtshan nyid kyi garkung bka' pod chen po lnga dang / rnya rgyud sde bzhi/ sgra rig sman rig skar rtsis/ snyan ngagacozlos gar sogs bod yig gi thog nas slob sbyong ged par ma zad su'u len gyi mnga' khongs pu rad sogs su bod yig gi shing par 'bor dar te/ hal ha(pho༅༅cha)rje btsun dam pa'i dgon par bka' 'gyur sogs kyi shing par 'bor yod pa dang / de ba zhin nang sog mkhar sngon po(tso.oṃstsa7) so gas sog lhul du bod yig gi rig gzhung mang bo'i shing par yod/ sog po'i mdzan nyid sogs rig pa'i gnas slob 'dod kyi btsun pa ches mang bo dbus gtsang dang / bla brang / sku 'bum sogs su byon nas slob gnyer byas te slar rang yul du log nayo'achad nyan spel ba da lta'i bar du yod/ de ltar sog po la rang gi yi ge yod mod/ de sngon rig gnas sna tshogs kyi rmang gzhi'i yi ge ni bod yig rang yin no/ / de bzhin du 'brug yul (nyo7)yang gzhi rtsa'i thog bod rigs yin gshis/ yi ge yang gzhi rtsa'i thog bod yig red/'bras ljongs(khyu༅)yang sngar bod rigs yin gshis skad yig 460

kyang bod kyi skad yig yin mod/ da lta ci yin ma shes/ ri bin sogs ya gling gi rgyal khab stobs ldan rnams dardza / nub phyogs kyi rgyal khab rnams su'ang bod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug byed pa'i grwa mang bo btsugs te dar rgyas 'byung bzhin par 'dugades na bod rang la/ legs sbyar dang sum rtags rtsasgobar bzung ba'i sgra rig pa phul byung satshang rang tshugagothub pa zhig yod /tshad ma rig pa'ang slob dpon chos grags yab sras kyi tshad yo rig pa rtsa bar bzung ba'i steng du/ bod rang gi mkhas pa rnams kyis gsar bskrun gyi rig pa bsdus grwa lta tsus phun sum tsho gas par byas te dar zhing rgyas nas rgyalakhab gzhan dang r+sharigs gzhan la med ba'i phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod/ gathorig kyang phyi'i gso rig dag gi khar rang gi nyams myodz+waribasagagapa'i sman skedapyad lag rtsalatshobla na thed pa zhig yod/ bar skabs su nyamasastomod/ 'on kyang da lta'ang rmang gzhi 'thug po yod/ bzo rig skor la bstan 'gyur khrod kyi bzo pa ṭa dang mi pha ma gyis mdzad pa'i bzo pa ṭa sogs gzhung mang bo yod stabs/ rdo bzo/ shing bzo/ lcags bzo/ dngul bzo/ gser bzo/ lha bzo/gos lham bzo ba/ snam phrug sa gdan/ phying 'jog par rko/ rdo rko/ shing rko mkhan sogs lag shes bzo las sna tshogs 46/

yod/ de dag deng dus kyi 'phrul 'khor gyi bzo las la bltas na rjes lus yin mod/ mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i thad la 'dang brgyab na mthong byed rin yod pa zhig red/ nang don nig pa rgyud sde bzhi dang sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyanacisogs deng dus 'dzam gling3 mi rigs gzhan las lhag pa zhig yod/ de dag ni rig gnas che ba lnga yin la/ chung ba lnga'i snyan ngag ni/ slob dpon dbyug pa can gyi me long ma'i thog tu bod rang gi blo gros kyi nor bsags pas phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod/ mngon brjod la ni/ 'chi med mdzod dang / bod rang gisabartsams pa'i mkhas pa'i rna rgyan sogs dge mtshan can zhig yod/ sdeb sbyor ni rinasachen 'byung gnas ltar legs sbyar gyi steng nas bsgrig pa dang / bod rang gi tshig sna tshogs bsgrig tshul 'jebs shing cha tshang ba zhig yod/ skar rtsis ni/ dus 'khor rgyud dang rgya nag gi rtsis rnying dgartsis gsar gyi steng du rang gis tshan rig pa'i dpyad pa sna tshogs kyi 'bras bu bsnan pa'i rtsis rig sngon thon zhig yod/ zlos gar ni/ deng dus 'cham bzhin pa'i zlos gar chen po brgyad gtsor byas pa'i sna tshogs shig dang glu gar yang kun gyi rna lam dang spyan lam du gyur pa 'di bzhin yin no/ /de dag ni rig gnas chung ba'o/ /463

bod du deng rabs can gyi tshan rig lag rtsal las rjes lusatshuyin pa smos mi dgos mod/ de dag rjes lus yin pas sngar gyi rmang gzhi'i rig gnas dag rgyang bskyur byas na/ gsar ba yang 'dzugs mi nus te sngar lo 'ga'i ring la bod rang gi skad yig rgyang bskyur byas nas rgya yig gi thog nas rig gnas bslabs pa yin te/ grub 'bras re los yod mod de/ bul la 'bur du thon mi thub pa 'di 'dra'o/ /des na bod rang gi skad yig gi rmang gzhi yod pa'i thog nas gsar ba bslabs na skyed thon zhing skyed thon pa cung zad myur bar 'dug snyam pas/ rnam par dpyod pasde blo gros kyi 'jug pa yangs pa rnams kyis dpyad par mdzod cig ces pa'ang bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i d+me gros su 'bod pas rab rgyal lcags bya (1981) lo'i dpyid kar sug las bgyis pa dza yasgru/ / 3 463ri

stag tsha bkra shis chos bzang gling gi gdan rabayodon ldan lha'i rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ska bucad dad’sdo/ dalkon budag rnanaska /zho n+tuska rkon/ 'gro kun gdung ba'i rtsa ba gcod pa'i slad/ /rgyal kun ye shes gzugs su shar ba'i sku/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i zlos gar gu ru rje/ /byang chub ma thob bar du spyi bor bsten/ /tshogs gnyis rin chen bye bas yongs bskrun thub dbang ri rgyal lhun po la/ /'khor tshogs rgyal srartswadagra bcom gser ri'i phreng bas kun nas mdzes par bskor/ /de yi bston pa rin chen yongs spel gser gyi shing rta che gnyis dang / /rgyan drug mchog gnyis zhes grags 'phags yul 'gro 'dren rnams la kun nas 'dud/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yid bzhin dbang rgyal ljongs 'dir 'dren 464

mkhas lo paṇa dag /yid kyi mi long la shar lus kyi ba spu kun nas g.yo bar gyur/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i 'od dkar yangs pa'i sa chen yongs su khyab mdzad pa/ /tsong kha pa zhes snyan pa'i gdugs dkar srid na 'khor bas dus kun skyongs/ /de yi ring lugs nyi ma'i 'od/ /'dren pa'i mkhas dbang mtha' dag dang / /khyad par kun mkhyen 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /bzhad pa'i rdo rje sras bcas rgyal/ /mtha' 'khob 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog /stag tsha sku phreng rim byon dang / /de yi thugs bskyed las grub pa'i/ /khrims gtsang chos sde rnam par rgyal/ /de yi gdan rabs gser ri'i phreng / /so skyes bsam brjod yul las 'das/ /'on kyang rang blos dpag tshod tsam/ /dad pa'i rten du dbul bar bya/ /de yang byang phyogs kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di la/ bod dang bod chen po gnyis su phye ba'i bod chen po de la/ a mdo/ chab mdo/ chu mdo zhes mdo gsum du grags pa las/ a mdo la mdo smad zer zhing rma chen gangs ri chen po'i mdun nas 'bab pa'i rma chu ste rma klung dal gyis 'bab pa'i byang rgyud la mdo smad byang rgyud zer zhing / de'i lho phyogs la mdo smad lho rgyud ces grags/ mdo smad lho rgyud kyi rma chen gangs mdun nas 'bab pa'i rma chu dang / ska bar stag rtse nas 'bab 465

pa'i ska chu dang / rmi khog nas 'bab pa'i rme chu dang / re khog nas 'bab pa'i re chu ste rma chu ska chu the chu re chu bzhi 'bab pa'i spang gzhung rgya chen po de/ gna' snga mo bod kyi btsan po mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi dus su/ ka ci'i mchod rten dkar bo yan chad bod kyi btsan po'i mnga' 'og yin gshis/ sa cha de dag tu khral bsdu ba dang / rgya bod kyi sa mtshams srung ba'i phyir blon po dga' ye shes dar rgyas zer ba sa 'dir bsdad pa'i bu rgyud la che ba dga' stag thul can dang / chung ba dga' spyang thul can gnyis byung / dga' stag ris can nam dga' stag thul can gyi mi rgyud bla ma dge 'dun zer ba zhig yod/ des bod kyi bla ma chen po zhig rgya nag tu phebs pa'i lam bar rnams su phyag mdzod kyi 'gan khur stabs/ ming la mdzod pa dge 'dun zhes grags/ de'i mtshan zur las/ de'i rigs la mdzod dge zer zhing / mdzod dge stod smad gnyis ka mdzod pa dge 'dun tshang gi rigs rgyud yin la/ dga' spyang thul can gyi mi rgyud ni a mdo co ne yin zhes rus mdzod me tog skyed tshal las gsungs/dga' ye shes dar rgyas kyi gdung rigs ni/ sngon bod kyi yul dbus su bod rgyal bo'i gdung rgyud rgyal sa ma thob pa zhig la bu med par/ thang lha sogs yul lha rnams la gsol ba btab pa'i ‘66

skabs shig tu nam mkha' nas mdun du 'ja' sne zug pa'i sne na bu chung zhig byung ba shin tu dga' nas bu skal byas pa'i rigs la dga' rigs zer ba de'i gdung rgyud yin pa las/ rmu tsha sga zhes pa'i sga rigs min zhes gsungs 'dug de rjes bod sil bur gyur pa'i dus/ gling ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gyis yul 'di bzung ba'i stabs kyis mdzod dge gling dkar stod ces grags/yul ljongs de'i chu bo chen po re chu'i 'gram ngos su stag tsha dgon zhes pa'i chos sde de chags/ der brten deng sang mdzod dge rdzong gzhis kyang dgon pa'i gsham du chags yod/ 'dir thog mar dgon sde 'di gang gi 'phrin las kyis grub pa'i stag tsha bla ma sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar brjod pa dang / chos sde stag tsha bkra shis chos bzang gling 'di'i gdan rabs brjod pa'o/ /dang bo ni/ spyir sku phreng rim byon rnams rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul yin pa dang / grub chen dā ri ka ba'i skye bar tshad ldan gyi bla ma du mas lung bstan par grags/de la sku phreng dang bo ni/ mdzod dge phyogs su 'khrungs pa'i skyes bu dam pa zhig ste/ nar son nas 'bri klog sogs la sbyangs pas tshegs med du mkhyen nas/ 'khor ba'i bde ba ni dug sbrul gyi tshang lta bur mthong zhing / khyim nas khyim med par 467

rab tu byung nas tshul khrims mig gi 'bras bu ltar spung ba ni thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam rang gzhan gyi don 'grub pa'i lam nyag gcig yin par dgongs te so sor thar ba'i tshigs snga byi'i sdom pa rnams rim gyis nod/ mtshan smon lam smyan grub gsol/ rang— blo shes bya'i gnas la ma sbyangs na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' ltar ring / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/rnam par grol ba'i lam bsgrub pa la thog mar rig pa'i gnas la sbyang dgos par dgongs nas rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs shing /khyad par du sman dpyad kyi rig pa la mkhas par sbyangaspo nas/ nad kyisajinyen pa'i 'gro ba ches mang bar sman dpyad kyis dbugs 'byin par mdzad pas 'phrin las shin tu rgya sa pa byung ste esarje bya btang chos rje zhes snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs bcur khyab/ mdo smad rang nas kyang dam pa'i chos kyi bgo skal mang du blangs mod/dbus gtsang ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'byung khungs su gzigs nas/ dbus gtsang phyogs su phebs te gnas rten so sor mjal phyag dang byin rlabs zhus/ rgyal dbang yab sras kyi gser zhal mjal zhing / mkhas grub kyi skyes bu dayopa mang bo las dam pa'i chos kyi bgo skal du ma blangs te nyams ba zhes su bstar/ bkra shis lhun por byon skabs/ paṇa chen 4spyobyi

thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang bo'i zhabs bsnyan pa'i tshul mdzad pa'i skabs su 'dzoms/ paṇa rin po ches/ de ring mjal ba su byung yang gzim spu ga tu gtong dgos gsungs pa ltar/ rje 'di ba mjal bar phebs dus/ de 'phral sku mdun du chud de gser zhal mjal nas byin rlabs zhus par ma zad/ paṇa chen mchog gis zhabs snyun la sman dpyad byed dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba bzhin/ gsol sman phul bas dwangs skyed byung ba la gsol ras gnang skabs/ gzhan mi dgos sku chos rten skal du bka' drin zhu zhes zhus par/ drung 'khor ba rnams kyis a mdo ba 'di tsho ham pa tsha bo red ces bkag cha byas mod/paṇa chen mchog nas sku chos/ lcam sring gi rten thang / mkhan chas cha tshang / dngos chas sna tshogs bcas stsal/ mar lam sku 'bum byams pa gling du phebs skabs/ chos sde de gar khri gegs bdo ba'i skabs shig dang 'phrad pas/ khri gegs zlog pa'i zhabs rim zhus pa ltar/ khri la zhabs sor bkod nas lha sngags ting nge 'dzino gyis khri gegs zhi bar mdzad pa dang / de'i skabs khri nang nas spyang ki dkar bo zhig bros par gleng / 'di sku 'bum gdan rabs su mi gsal mod/ bla ma so so'i rnam thar sa bon du ma the ba'i mdzad pa shin tu mang bo yod gda' bas dogs don 469

mi che/ khri gegs bzlog pa'i 'bul bar tsan dan gyi mchod rten brgyad dang / zi ling nas kyang chen por 'os pa'i 'phan gdugs sogs phul te gzengs bstod mdzad/ — rje btsun dam pa rin po cheromajal skabs rje des sku chos gnang ba dang / mtsho snying gahā de bar phebs nas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse lnga ba gter nas blangs te rwa gcig gter bdag laganang bar grags/ rang yul du phebs nas gnas skyo nga dgon zhes pa'i ri khrod 'debasatho bdag mdzad de sgrub pa 'i rgyaṅge mtshan 'dzin ba 'ga'ayadang —mnya.oṃ du bzhugs te gtso cher thugs dam nyams bzhesakatsor 'don mdzad par snang / sngar sku 'bum nas phul ba'i mchod rten brgyad kyang gnas skyong dgon der bzhugs mod/ phyis su zhugs byul zhen zer/ zi ling nas phul ba'i 'phan gdugs sogs dang /lcags kyi rdo —rje gter ma sogs god chags sngon du gdan sa stag tsha dgon du mjal rgyu yod/ bstan 'gro'i don mang du mdzad de/ mthar sku tshe de'i gdul bya rdzogs pa na the bo'i dpal shis steng khar gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan to / / skya sbeng gnyis pa ne/ sku phreng dang bo gnas skyong bla ma'i sprul skur ngos bzung ba yin te/ khong rgyal rje'i ha ra ha ra mar sku 'khrungs/ saskya'i bstan 'dzin gyi bshes gnyen du ma rigasdo 470

kyi cad pan du bsten nas madz+ran dngos grub mchog jin gso'i te/ bstan pa la rim gyis zhugs shing gsan bsam ci rigs mdzad pa dang / lhag lha du ma'i bsnyen sgrub la nyams len gyi mthilajidu mdzad de sbyin sreg dang / gter sbas pa dang gtor ma bsngo ba sogs kyis sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad dbang du bsdus nas mi 'dod nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi zhing mthun rkyen legs tshogs thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad pa'i rnam thar mang du yod par gor ma chag kyang / lo rgyus zhib par mthong thos su ma gyur la/ sku mya ngan las 'dasatshul bstan rjes pur zhugs la sbyangs pa'i gdung rus nang bzhugs kyi bkra shis sgo mnge gi mchod rten gdan sa rang gi 'du khang nang god chags gong du yod 'dug go/ / skya phreng gsum ba stag tsha ja ba tshogs gnyis rgya mcho'am mtshan gzhan mkhas grub bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho tshang zhes grags pa de nyid bzang skor dbang rdor tshang gi khyim du 'khrungs/ sbyor byung gi brtson pa'i go cha mi dman par bgos pas bstan 'dzin chen po'i mtshan nyid tshang zhing / rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad sgrub lung dang rtogs pa'i sgo nas nyams bzhes su bstar te/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por 471

gshogs/ gso dpyad sman lgu gzhung la sbyangs pas skye dgu'i sman yon dam par gyur/ sku phreng 'di gsum gnas skyong bshad sgrub gling du shas che4ra bzhugs shing / yas mas su phebs skabs/ re chu dang rme chu 'dres mdor ri khrod pa kha shas yod pa rnams kyis ba snyen bkur thugs mnyes pa bsgrubs pa'i stabs kyis/ der ni ri khrod chung ngu'i gzhi tsam zhig las/ 'dzin bdag mdzad pa'i chos sde med/ sku 'da' khar ri khrod pa rnams kyis yang sprul myur phebs kyi don skor snyan du gsol ba na/ 'o na stag tsha bkra shis —tshe brtan 4sa gsungs pa ltar/ de mdun du slebs par 'bras dkar yol gang dar gyis btums nas rum du bcug srung mdud stsal te/ khyed la bu gsum 'byung ba'i che ba de nged kyi yang srid yin gsungs nas/ de 'phral sku gshegs pa'i mdzad pa bstan to/ / sku zeng bzhi’ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho tshang / sku phreng gsum pa'i zhal bzhes ji lta ba bzhin du/ mdzod dge stod ma'i phyogs su yab stag tsha bkra shis tshe brtan dang yum sna tshang bza' gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas sna tshogs dang bcas te sku 'khrungs stabasu/ de nas bzung ltag tsha bla ma zhes grags par snang / stag tsha zhes pa rus kyi ming yin te/ spyir bod kyi rus de ni yig tshang mkhas pa dga' bskyed las/ nang gi mi'u 472

rigs bzhi ni gi shang rgya dang / gyim zhang hor/ kha li rmon/spur rgyal bod bzhi'o/ /de'i rgya la grol cha gnyis su gyes pa ni /rmu rus dang ke la'o/ /hor yang gnyis su gyes pa ni/ srin tsha dang / lha tsha'o/ /mon la rigs gsum byung ba ni/ mon rang rgyud pa dang / rgya bod mtshams kyi mi nyag dang / kongazupo gsum mo/ /bod la mi'u gdung drug tu grol te zhes gsungs pa ltar/gi shang rgya zhes pa de rgya gar rgya nag gi rgya la go bar mi bya ste/ 'di ni bod rang mtshan pa yin/ gi shang rgya'i rus las byung ba'i bo da rigs ni dper na/ lo tsā ba chen po rgya brtson 'grus seng ge/sngags 'chang chen po rgya zhang khrom/ rgya phur bu/ 'brug pa kun legs kyi rang rnam du/ rus bzhi'i nang gi rgya yin gsungs/ 'di dag ni rgya nag las chad pa'i rus min par/ bod rang gi rigs bzhi'i nang gi/ gi shang rgya zhes pa'i rus rgyud yin no/ /de bzhin du gyim zhang hor zer ba yang / sog po hor zhes pa dang mi gcig ste/ bod rang gi rigs la hor zer ba zhig yod pa ni/ gyim zhang hor gyi rigs rgyud las byung ba'i bod yin no/ /mon dang / mi nyag dang kong po gsum yang / kha le mon gyi rigs las byung ba'i bod yin zhing / mi nyag rgyal bo dang /'brug pa'i rgyal bo gnyis gnyen zla yin zhing / bod rigs yin 473

par deb ther du mar bshad do/ /'di'i nang spur rgyal bod ces pa ni/spyo thod kyi rgyal bo'i rgyud pa yin la/ de las kyang rigs mang bo cha da par bshad la/ gzhan/ dbas/ ku/ldongs/ stong gi rigs sogs gzhan du bshad do/ /de bzhin du hor la srin tsha dang lha tsha gnyis su gyes pa bzhin mdo smad 'dir yang / tsha rigs yod de/ dper na/ gzi tsha/ rkang tsha/ zamartsitsha/ sde tsha/ khyom tsha/ mog tsha/ mgo tsha/ stag tsha sogs yod/ ldong rigs la/ tog tsha/ smug tsha/ mgo tshasogs tsha chen bco brgyad yod zer/ des na sku phreng bzhi ba 'dini/ stag tsha bkra shis tshe brtan tshang la 'khrungs shing / skye mched kho lag rgyas pa na/ sku gong ma'i zhal slob dang sku 'khor rnams kyis yab yum gnyis la dngos rdzas sna tshogs byin te gdan sar bkod/ mkhan po su yin ma nges spyang / gang ltar tshigasasnasnga phyi'i sdom pa rim gyis mnos shing / gro paṇa ḍi ta sku phreng rim byon gyi gdan sa bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling du chos zhugs mdzad/rje ngag dbang 'phrin las lhun 'grub sogs bshes gnyen mang du bsten nas/ mdo sngags rig gnas kun la gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad/ khyad par du sman gyi rgyud bzhi phyogs gtogs dang bcas pa la sbyangs pas gso dpyad la mkhas pa'i grags pa rgyas/474

rje de nyid kyi sku nye 'on po bsod nams grags pa dang gros sgru mthun gyis re rme 'dres mdo'i ri khrod pa rnams da lta'i dgon gnas 'dir spos te stag tsha bkra shis chos bzang gling gi gzhi bting / 'on po 'di nyid dbus gtsang du lan gnyis byon pa'i snga ma'i dus rgyud stod 'dus grwar zhugs nas rgyud pa'i 'don rta dbyangs phyag bzhes rnams zhib bslab mdzad de rang gi gdan sar dag thon dang / rim bzhin gzhi gsum gyi phyag len/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod/ rgyal me tog thang dang gros mthun gyis dgu 'cham sogs dngos su btsugs/ stag tsha rin po che khong nyid rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i rtagayospyo su/ jo sku sogs sder bzo sna tshogs dang / chos rgyal dadzornam sras kyi zhal 'bag rang byon mar grags pa sogs mang du spyo bzhengs/ dad rdzas chud mi za ba'i phyir dpag bsam 'khri shing gi zhal thang gras mtshungs/ rgyal ba'i bka' rin po che 'argyur ro cog sogs sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhengs/ rong phyogs su phebs bzhud kyi skabs shig rgya mo zhig gis 'jigs byed kyi zhal 'bag dang 'cham lwa sogs phul mod 'bul mkhan de gar— skesong cha med du gyur 'dug thams cad kyis yum mchog tsa muṇ+ḍa yin pa 'dra zhes gleng / sngar co de'i mnga' 'og tu gartswags pa 475

rta shug mdor chags pa'i steng kha dgon phul ba bdag gir bzhes te rta mgrin gyi sku thog tshad tsam zhig bzhengs te mi mthun pa'i gnod pa thams cad zhi zhing mthunarī rkyen lhun gyis 'grub pa sogs r+pā/ka' drin tshadazhemed kyis bskyangs/ 'brog phyogs suphebs skabs shig la kha char ha cang che sgang zhig la 'bud shing ma rnyed par/ rje nyid nas lci ba rlon pa la me sbar te gsol ja bskol bar/ zhabs zhu rnams kyis lci rlon gyi phyogs gcig na sbu ba sob be 'dug pa dang / phyogs gcig na me 'bar ba dang ja khol ba mthor nas/ 'di 'dra ci lags zhus pas/ ye shes kyi snang ba 'bar ba'i me'i stobs yin gsungs/ yang sa 'bur zhig gi steng du gzim gur phub par/ khong cung gzims nas/ 'di spor dgos gsungs pa ltar spos te phyi nyin sa slog tshe sa 'bur de nas tshwa 'bum zhig thon pa dang / gzhan yang gso dpyad kyis mdze nad sogs nad gso dka' ba mang bo gsos pa dang / rim gro gnang ba dang / srung 'khor btags pa sogs kyis mi 'dod pa zhi zhing legs tshogs rgyas pa dang / dkar phyogs kyi mi ma yin mang bo bran du bkol cing / nag phyogs pa rnams zil gyis mnan pa so0/sa rtogs ldan gyi rnam thar shin tu mang / chos 'chad spel kyang mang du mdzad/ rong phyogs la byon pa'i lam 476

khar sbyin bdag gadzi/sa phung dpal rtse zer ba'i khyigatsha nga la klu slo 5nad dang chung sri'i gnod pa che tshul zhus par thabs gzhan gyis mi phan gsungs nas/ yo byad kha shas dang bcas zhal chems 'ga' zhig gsang stabs kyis gnang / rang gdan dkon tshe zer ba'i sar phebs skabs bsnyun tshul bstan pa'i brda 'byor 'phral rang dgon gyi grwa ba mang bo gdan zhur song dus gsung ci yang mi gnang / rang dgon du phebs nas zhag bdun la bzhugs kyang de'i ring la gsung 'byon pa dang bzhes pa gnang ba sogs gang yang ma mdzad par rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i chu phag lo'i sa ga zla ba'i nya la chos dbyings su gzhol tshul bstan par thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i thabs gang 'dzoms dang / gdung rten lha babs mchod rten bzhengs pa gdan sa rang gi 'du khang du bzhugs su gsol to/ / sku phreng lnga ba ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho gi/ a skyi da rong g.yas lung sde bar/ yab dpon dpal rtse sngo lung dkon mchog skyabs zhes pa ma ṇi dung phyur gsum bgrangs pa dge sbyor la brtson pa de dang / yum stag la mtsho zer ba lnga rabs kyi spyod tshul dang ldan pa gnyis la sras bzhi yod pa'i rgan shos kyi rnam par rab yid shing byi'i lor sku bltams/ yum gyi mnal 477

lam rdu btsun pa ru dar can zhig gis rgyun du srung ba rmis pa/ rang dgon gyi spung ma bse khrab can du gleng / mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i dge 'dun gyis bsu ba dang / yum gyi lus las 'od dkar bo 'byung ba gzhan gyis mthong ba sopo/sa yab yum rtsa 'jing so sor dngos dang rmi lam gyi rtags ya mtshan pa mang du byung / bltams nas ring bo ma lon par a ma zhes bos par ma yum nas/ a a kha lad po zhes smras pa nas bzung gsung cung mi gsal ba byung / skyabs rje shing bza' rin po che blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug tshul khrims phun tshogs dpal bzang bor/ yang sprul gyi don du lung zhu phul ba'i lan du/ rgyal ba'i chos sku mi 'gyur don dam pa'i/ /ye shes dbyings kyi pad+ma las bltams pa'i/ /mos pa ji bzhin 'char ba'i rmad byung sku/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug na rgyal gyur cig /dam pa rnams ni 'jig rten la/ /phan pa'i zlos gar kun tu dga'/ /brtson slad sems can khams kun la/ /thugs rje snang bas ma khyab med/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i mngon shes kyis/ /dri tsam ma bsgos deng dus kyi/ /lkog gyur ston pa'i khog zhugasdo dang / /mos pas kha tshon gcod pa dang / /phal cher ri mo'i sgron me ltar/ /gyur pas gzur gnas sun 'byin pa/ /mthong thos 478 ri

ming phyir dpyad dka' ba'i/ /gnas 'di smra la zhe 'tsher mod/ /'on kyang dbyu gus bskul ba yis/ /pa ṭa ha yang sgra 'byin na/ /mgon skyabs bor ba'i gdung bcas pas /yid bskyod rang mdangs sba dka' bas/ /dad gsum 'bigs byed rlung gis ni/ /yi dam thugs rgyud 'khri shing dag /legs bskyod dri bsung gzugs can bzhin/ /ngom pa'i rnamatsho'agyur dbyangs su len/ /'gyur med don dam bde ba che/ /brnyes pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba de/ /gnod sbyin dbang ldan phyogs mtshams kyi/ /rong sde che rigs nyams dga' bar/ /skyed byed ming yig dang bo stag /skrun byed ming thog sngo ldan pa'i/ /grags pa'i yi ge gur gum gyis/ /dbang gzhu'i ri mo bris pa bzhin/ /rab brjid de yi rigs de ru/ /khams gsum kun gyi gdung 'phrog de/ /bde 'byung cod pan gzhan pa bzhin/ /mtshan ldan zla tshes gsar ba ngom/ /lkog shal can gyi bgrarobya yi/ /hor zla drug pa'i yar tshes bzhir/ /chos 'khor dus chen dge nyin der/ /legs dar na bza' rgyan gsol zhing / /dpa' bo'i lo yi sa ga yi/ /dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i nyin/ /zhabs zung pad+mo bkra shis gnyen/ /'jigs bral chos khrir stobs na dge/ /gang zhig gzhan don la goms pa'i/ /47mi

kun la snyoms pa'i zer phreng can/ /mtshan mor byed dang rīdamanepa gnyas/ /mtshungs kyang bsnyengs bral 'di mngon 'phags/ /de ltar mgrin pa dbyangs can gter gyi rgya/ /rnam grol 'bras bu mu tig dkar bo ru/ /'dzab/sa pa'i rba rlabs rab tu 'thor ba'i dbyangs/ /rgyal dang shis pa brjod pas zhu ba bo/ /dpal ldan ngag gi 'byor bas ma pham pa'i/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo bzhad pa'i sbyor ba la/ /brtson ldan gsung gi rdo rje shing bza' ba'i skye bar 'dod pa'i btsun pa de nyid do/ /'dir 'bad dge ba'i da ge legs chen po'i spyan/ /lhag bsam kun gsal mdzes ma'i mgrin pa la/ /'khyud pa'i rdul thigs kha ba'i 'od dkar du/ /'khrul des mgon de'i gsang gsum rgyal gyur cig — //ces pa stsal/gsung shog 'di'i nang don ltar dgung lo gsum pa'i steng gdan sar zhu rgyu byung na legs lam che bar mngon yang blu yon la brten pa'i gleng brjod cung zad kyi dbang gis steng du ma khel/ de skabs stag tsha dgon nas gdan zhus kyi don du chos skyong so so'i bskang 'phrin sogs rim gro mang du bsgrubs par brten/ gdan saramagyogs phebs kyi cha rkyen du mchog sprul rin po ches bskun tshul bzhes par/ brtag mkhan rnams kyis stag tsha dgon du myur duphebs dgos tshul mol ba ltar phebs pas lam bar du snyun zhig 480

lhag med du dwangs/ dgung lo lnga'i steng rje gong ma'i chos kyi khri la zhabs sen bkod/ kun spangs legs bshad rgya mtsho tshango bsten nas klog bslabs/ klog bslab sa'i yongs 'dzin de nyid ring bo ma bzhugs stabs/ de rjes bla ma a lo ke zhes pa rta mchog rol ba'i sprul bar grags pa snang tshod la thugs ha cang gtum drag che ba de nyid dge rgan du bsten nas rgyud sde bzhi sogs 'don chos thams cad thugs 'dzin mdzad/ yan lag 'byung gi sprul par grags pa 'dul ba 'dzin pa dkon mchog gnas brtan las dge bsnyen dang / dgung lo bdun par skyabs rje shing bza' rin po che sku phreng gsum pa'i drung nas rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ rje de nyid las snga phyir mi kro rdor phreng / 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma dang dpa' cig rta mgrin rnam gnyis/ spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu/ tshe dpag lha dgu/ gdugs dkar lha mang sogs kyi spyi zur gyi dbang bka' mang bo/ rjes gnang dang lung sna tshogs bcas gsan/ bya bral ba dkon mchog rgya mtsho las spyi bka' brgya rtsa gsum gyi rjes gnang / rje blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma las rin 'byung brgya rtsa dang / gzhan yang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug kiti blo 481

bzang 'phrin las/ shing bza' sprul ba'i sku bshad sgrub dmachos rgya mtsho/ sgo mang mkhan sprul blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ ma mchog rin po che 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho/ dka' chen blorgyabazang dbang phyug 'bras dge bshes tshul khrims dar rgyas sogs theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang bo las snga phyir zab rgyas chos kyi gan mdzod bdag gir bzhes/ zla ba bzhi'i ring stag tshang dpal gyi lha mo dge ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar mtshan nyid kyi gsan sbyong mdzad/ gdan sa stag tsha dgon du grwa grangs brgyad cu tsam las mi bzhugs kyang / rje 'di'i thugs bskyed kyis nyis brgya tsam du 'phel/ sgo mang dge bshes tshul khrims dar rgyas las rgyud stod phyag len ltar bdun gsum gyi ring la gsang 'dus sgrub mchod kyi steng nas rtsa rgyud spya gtan tshigs dang / gsang 'dus 'grel ba'i 'chad nyan byed rgyu'i ljags bkod stsal/ rnyi tsha'i phyag len ji lta ba bzhin mdzod dge tshul khrims las mchod pa'i chos thog bdun gcig tshugs/ sngar cho 'phrul smon lam nyin gsum yin yang 'di bas bdun gcig tu rgya bskyed/ dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi phyag len ltar lcags mkhar zur dgu ba dang / mgon po'i gtor chen sogs gsar du btsugs/ nang chen du'ang stong mchod 4srilha rmi

gasbyag btsugs/ rje yab sras gsum dang / gzigs pa lnga ldan sogs 'bur sku che chung brgya lhag dang / tsong kha brgyad cu sogs bris thang mang bo dang / rta mgrin lha khang dang / gdugs dkar lha khang / mgon khang sogs gtsug lag khang du ma bzhengs/ bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis dang rje'i gsung 'bum tshar gnyis sogs glegs bam mang du bzhengs/ mchod rdzas yo byad je rgyas su btang / sdom gsum dag par bsrung ba'i steng nas rgyun gyi nyams bzhe sa dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs yi dam dang lhag pa'i lha/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong du ma'i ljags bsnyen mang bo gnang ba dang / shing bza' rin po che'i ljags bkod ltar chu mig brgya rtsa 'grims pa dang / dngos rdzas la 'dzin chags chupazhing gtong phod pa dang /dman la brtse zhing che tshugs med pa dang / spros pa chung zhing 'jig rten gyi mi dang sgo mi bstun pa sogs dam par 'os pa'i mdzad bzang mang bo zhig mthun snang du mnga'/ lo mang bor smon lam gyi mgon du phebs nas skyes rabs 'chad ba dang / 'jigs byed rnam gnyis dang rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ ma cig zhi khro sogasakyi dbang dang rjes gnang mi nyung tsam stsal ba dang / gzhisabyes so sor tshigs snga phyi sogs kyi bslab pa 'bogs pa sogs mang du gnang / shing bza' rin po ches bya me'i dpon bla thugs thag 483
