bcad skabs byadhe me dpon pos sprul sku 'khrul med cig min pani/ stag tsha bla ma lta bu'i rtsam pa brdzi mi shes pa zhig mi dgos zer bas/ shing bza' rin po che thugs khros te/ ngas yang sprudzi brgya deng bcu gsum sku thag bcad kyang stag tsha tshang 'di 'dra'i —rtags mtshan can zhig yod ma myong / de 'dra tshodagos kyang mi yong gsungs/ rang dgon gyi grwa rigs shig la 'byung gdon gyis gnod par bzhugs gdan rang ga ba zhig dang / pags gdan steng du bkab pas/ nad pas ri rab dang nags tshal can gyi ri bos gnon par lab pa dang / grwa ba tha ma khar rngam pa zhig gi ske la shug pa 'dzer ba can zhig btags pas dud khu bamyugs pa la— brten nas du ba gtan chod du song ba sogs dang / srung mdud— gnang ba dang / na bza'i tshal bu btags pa dang / ske phur dang bzhugs gdan sogs nad pa'i sngas la sbyan drangs pa tsam gyis nad na las grol ba sogs/ mthong thos dran reg do na ldan du mdzad pa'i rnam thar mang bar—gleng / rgyal rje'i sde khrod du sbyinazlabadag cig gi bu lha sa nas lo zla tshes 'di la 'byor bar gsungs pa steng du ji bzhin khel ba dang / ga'im gur du phaṭa drag po re gnang nas tshe 'das kyi ngang tshul gsungs pa daṭ+wāṃ /mtsho sngon du song ba'i grwa ba zhig brtag pa mkhan gyis lo kha shas la 484

mi yong par lung bstan kyang / dam pa 'dis de ring ri phra mo zhig gi sna la ja skol bzhin yod pas ma 'gyangs par sleb gsungs pa ji bzhin byung ba dang / 'das rtags rnams 'khrul med gsungs pa sogs mngon shes mnga' ba'i rtags mtshan shin tu mang / gcung bo 'on po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan rje nyid bcad rgyar bzhugs skabs phyi rol tu phebs bzhud mdzad par dngos su mjal zhing / nang du slebs dus thun gsar du grol ba dang 'dzoms pa dang / mtshan mor sgo dang sge'u sogs 'byed pa la ltos pa med par phyi rol tu 'byon pa dang / dbu sngas kyi sku brnyan rnams bsgyur bkod la ma ltos par yas mas su phebs pa dang / gzims pa'i tshe spyan mi btsum par gzims pa sogs grub pa'i rtags mtshan mang du yod pa dag sa bon du bkod 'dug go/ /sku na chung dus gsung cung mi gsal ba'i tshul bstan mod/ skabs shig bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi rigs grwa grub chen phebaso/ mchog sprul rin po che phyag tu bzhes te zhal du mda' gzhu bstan/ bla ma las sna so so'i khri kha dang chos skyong gi snyan shal nang du bzhag khyed kyis gsung gsal bo 'byon nam zhes yang yang dris pa'i mthar gsung byon/ de dag mdzad pa 'i don ni las sna so so'i khri gegs bzlog pa dang srung ma rnams bran 485

bzhin 'khor ba'i rtags su snang / dgung lo so dgu'i steng bsnyun tshul cung zad bzhes pa'i zhabs rim mang bo dang brtan bzhugs phul bar/ grwa ba mang bos tha ma kha 'then pa sogs sgo gang nas bsams kyang 'dug 'dod med tshul phebs par brten/ngan spyod sdig 'phro gcod pa'i khas lenasaphul ba nas dwangs rkyen byung / de tsam ma gtogs sku tshe gang bor snyung phra mo tsam yang bzhes pa med/ nyin re la nyin 'khyongs zhal 'don sha stag dang—khri nyin re la nangs snga mo gzim khang nang nas phar bcags tshur bcags dang / phyogs so sor la btsas dang / 'jag ma'i mda' gzhu re byas nas phyogs so sor bstan te 'jog par mdzad pa dgos pa che bar sems/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i mdun du mjal skabs/ khyed nas dge sbyo—ra dang bstan pa'i bya ba gang 'dra mdzad bzhin yod phebs par/ ngas gcod kyi 'du la 4dang 'dul 'don gyin yod/ ces zhus pa sogs drag zhanasu dang yang snang ba mi bstun par gsung gyong nge ba gnang ba zhig yod/ skabs shig sems dpa' a khu rin po che legs bshad rgya mtsho tshang gi 'dra sku zhig dbu sngas su khri chung zhig gi khar bzhag bzhes phud mang bo dang lha dar mang bo mdun du spungs nas bzhugs par/ ci yin zhus par/ nga la 'dis lam rim chen 486 —

mo'isakhrid tsag gnang gi yod gsungs pa dang / dgung lo ri gcig gi skabs shig rje yab sras gsum gyi mdun du bsdus grwa'i dpe cha rgyun du sku la mnab rgyu yod pa de bzhag zhwa mo zhig dbu la mnabayote thal skad btang nas/ da re'i rten 'di la 'di tsa ma las ma nus kyang skye ba phyi ma gzhung bka' pod lnga la 'chad nyan thos bsam mthar phyin par bgyi'i zhes pa'i thugs smon mdzad/ sngar gyi 'du khang de rgyud pa'i 'du /khang byed rgyu dang /mtshan nyid 'du khang gsar du bzheng rgyu'i ljags bkod stsalu kyang / grwa rgan re'i grwa tshang gcig la 'du khang gnyis mi dgos zhes steng du ma khel/ dus 'khor 'du khang zhig bzhengs te dus 'khor grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs byed rgyu thugs bzhed yod gsungs/gshin po la sbyangs chog sa/nas skabs dkyil 'khor khra lam mer 'char 'dug gsungs pa la dpag na/ lha dang bla ma'i gzigs snang yang yang byung tshod 'dug de ltar rang gzhan gyi don mang du mdzad de da gung lo re gnyis bzhes pa shing glang lo'i nag zla'i nang 'bam gyis snyun gzhi lci bar bzhes pa la/ zhabs brtan nyin mtshan khor yug tu bsgrubs nas/ mkha' 'gro'i bsu bzlog dang 'brel bar brtan bzhugs phul yang zhal bzhes ji bzhin ma thob/ gtor sgam nang gi gtor ma thams cad gshegs nas/487

dus 'khor gyi mchod gtor bsham bcug ste mtshams tho bslangs nas dus 'khor gyi bsnyen pa la bzhuges/ nye gnas rnams kyis rje nyid zha la ma bzhugs na 'das ma 'das kyi chos skyong rnams 'khu ldog dzhami 'byung ba sogs kyi thabs ci byed dang / mchog sprul myur du 'byon pa dang / 'phral yun gyi bya ba thams cad la gsung bkod 'dra zhus pas/ bstan srung 'jig rten pa rnams la gshegs gsol mdzad/ nga la rang dbang med kyang khyed rnams kyis sdig spong dge sgrub dang / 'dul ba'i bcas khrims dge 'dun gyi nang khrims srung ba la 'bad na/ mchog gsum la gsol ba btab ste sprul sku mig thag mi ring bar 'byung ba'i 'dun pa byed/ skyabs rje shing bza' rin po cher 'phral yun gyi ljags bkod rnams zhus te bka' bzhin bsgrubs na legs lam che tshul gyi ljags bkod stsal nas/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes brgyad la zhi ba'i dbyings su thim ste/ thugs dam gyi bzhugs grol la sogs pa'i rtags gzhung bzhin byung / de nas gdung mdun du rgyud sdetreso so'i bdag 'jug gzhung chen mang bo'i skyor sbyang / chos spyod smon lam gyi gsung sgrogs/ bla ma so sor bsngo zhus/ mchog dman gyi zhing la bsod nams gsog pa sogs dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa rgya cher bsgrubs/ gdung zhugs la phul te/ a mchog 48snye

rin po che'i gsung bkod ltar dngul dkar rdo tshad sum cu tsam las rnam rgyal mchod rten bzo khyad legs pa rab gan sa bcas —'grub par byas te 'du khang nang du bzhugs su gsol to/ / sku zeng drug ba bskal bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ne/ a/skyid stod ma tshang du yab rab 'byor dang —yum6 a khophu gnyis la/ sras bzhi yod pa'i tha chungajigi rnamalhabar rab— tshes name stag lo'i zla ba bcu gcig nyin sku bltams/ yumar+sā lanu'aja'— zug pa dang / sku gong ma'i gzim sngas kyibigasang bde 'jigs— gsum/ 'od dpag med/ mgon po nomes spu phreng bzhi bro'ici phyag bzo yin/ de dag g.yo 'gul byung bas/— grwa ba rnams skrag 4 nas gtsang bla ma dang / a mchog rin po cher zhus pas/ skrag— d+ngha mi dgos/ yang sprul 'khrul med cig 'khrungs pa'i rtags yin —gsungs/ de sogs ltas ngo mtshar ba du ma byung / khong gi khyim mtshes rgan mo zhig gi mig zhar nas mi mthong ba'i skabs/ rta sbangs shig gis mig la brgyab pas mo'i mig gis mthong bar gyur/ sku 'khrungs nas zhag bdun la ma'i nu zho ma bzhes par 'o ma rang bzhin pa cung zad re bzhes/ zla ba dgu tsam song skab r+sā/ —da ltos dang yong gi yod gsungs pa bzhin 'os tho bsdu mi 'byor /ngodagung lo gnyis pa'i dus ltad mo zhes pas tshem bu rgyag byedabyukhab 48 ba

cig khong gi zhal du bzhes/ phyi nyin dgung mo zhal nang nas blangs te slar gnang ba sgyudang / nub cig bor song ba/ nang bar sgo yol nang nas gad dang ba cas nga stag tsha dgon du song ba yin gsungs pa dang / gdan sa'i grwa ba gnyis mjal du 'ongs par/ khyed gnyis dgon pa'i g.yon ri'i ngos na 'ong ba rig thal zhes tha/sungs pa dang / rje gong ma'i thugs dam gyi ca 'dzin ma zhig la gzigs nas 'di ri 'i yin zhes ngos bzung ba dang / ngos 'dzin bstan skabs kyang rje gong ma'i phyag dril ma nor bar bsnams pa sogs rjes dran dang sngon gyi bag chags bzang bo sad pa'i mdzad sgo mang du bstar/ dgung lo bzhi ba'i dus 'on po blo bzang stobs rgyas sogs kyis mtshan tho bsdus tshe/ mtshan tho bsdu mi rnams a skyid du song nas/ a chab dbang grags sku gob ma'i sku nye yin pa la/ kho la bu glang lo ba zhig yod par thos nas/ de nas mtshan tho bsdu bo'i 'go 'dzin bsams te song skabs khyim du 'dug mi ma yod/ de nas rkyang dkar zhes pa'i lung mdor a skyid stod ma'i ru yod pas/ der song nas dris tshe/ —ar ma sang la bu stag lo ba zhig yod zer ba thos nas/ de'i khyim du song dus de gar zas sna bsgrigs yod pa sogs rten 'grel 'dzoms/ de'i 'asdo bzung nas mtshan tho brgya dang bcu 490

ro'i yod pa rnams sku gong ma'i gsung bkod bzhin/ r+shang bza' skya phreng bzhi ba bshad sgrub dam chos rgya mtsho dpal bzang bor phul te gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ sprul sku 'di dam pa gong ma'i yang sprul du thage bcad nas/ blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan gsol/ de skabs grwa ba 'ga' res ar ma sang gi bu 'a di yangaljul min/ a chab dbang grags kyi bu 'di yang sprul yin zhes rtsod gleng cung zad byas par/ shing bza' rin po che thugs rgyal bzhengs te/ 'di ni 'khrul med yin/ 'di ni nga la mgon po phyag drug pas gnang ba yin zhes dam can chos kyi rgyal bor ga nyer gtad byas te gsung shog tshigs bcad ma dang phyag mdud bcas stsal/ khyod tshos mtshan tho kha ma phye gong 'di 'dra bshad pa ma legs/ myur mdzad ma 'bum ther sgrub ma thub na bar chad chen po yong nges yin gsungs/ de nas cha/tshan tho rang dgon du ga dan drangs skabs char bab pa dang / zhal phye nyin mchog sprul rin po che'i dbur 'ja' 'od zug pa sogs rtags mtshan bzang bo ya mtshan pa byung / 'on kyang 'ga' zhig gis sprul sku'i don sogs la rtsod gleng 'ga' byas/ dpon tshang gis g.yo thabs sna tshogs kyis kyang gyod thag gcod du ma bcug sku gong ma'i rgyal tshab dge slong blo bzang skal ldan/ blo bstan/491

thunar+shatshogaso rgya mtsho/ skal ba zang smon lam/ rī ngag sto bas rnams t+masgyu skyid dumazhogro dgos byung nas lo gcig la bsdad / — de'i zu lo soso ko sog tshardoblari ma gyod bshad du gdan drangs/ khongarkegis 'onasto po blo bzang stobs rgyas kyis tshe gang la nang chen gyi bdag byedartsorgyu dang /— —mchog sprul rin po che sku nar son nas khong gis nadza chen bdag byed rgyu thag bcad/ de nas yang sprul ri nartsopo tshir mtshan tho dang dga' dar 'bul ba snga phyir byas te/ dgung lo lngo'i thog chen por 'os pa'i spros pa dang bcas nyin lung gser chu nas bsu ba ring byeng du ma bcas gdan drangs/ dge 'dun —mang gis ser sbrengs dang bcas zla brgyad pa'i tshes gsum nyin gzim khang du phebs/— de'i phyi nyin 'du khang chen mor chos kyi khri la bkod/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng lnga ba chen mo'i mtshan zhabs pa bla brang rdo rams pa mdzod dge 'jam dbyangs dang / blo rībazang don 'grub gnyis kyis tshogs gleng gnang / spyi sger so sos legs skyes phun sum tshogs pa byas stabs/ nya'adzi5 bzhe sa kyi rten dus 'khor gyi cho ga ngos bzung ba dang / 'od dpag med kyi sku brnyan zhig la gzigs nas 'di nga la bzhad gi 'dug nged kyi khang srung 'od dpag med yin gsungs/ mdzod dge 'go ba slebs dus/ rnam rgyal dbang chen khyod bde mo/ zhes 492

dang / yang skabs shig grwa rgan zhig yong nas nga e shes zhus pas/ blo bzang grags pa/ blo bzang grags pa gsungs/ sto da ma'i sna tshang a tshogs zer bas sku gong ma la khyed kyi sngon du shi na — zhes zhus pas/ nga'i sngon la shi rgyur dga' na/ da ran zhadug gsungs par/ a la yang sprul sku mjal thub na drag zhus par/ der thug thub gsungs/ kho mchog sprul mjal bar yo nga durtswartsed mo rtse zhor la/ a tshogs khyod bde mo yin nam gsungs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang bstan 'dzinarichos 'phel bcar —5 bzhugs ngos phral sbyor gyi klog slob pa'i dbu btsugs/ —khrog legs par mkhyen/ dgung lo drug bzhes skabs/ stag tshang dpal gyi lha mo'i dgon du/ rongayachenadzha ljags nag pa'i skye phreng bcu ba kirti ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa tshe ring dpal bzang bo'i gsan bzhes kyi ched du/ grub dbang 'jigs med bsam gtan gyi yang sprul mkhas dbang ‘8ji—gas med dam chos rgya mtsho yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal ldan bcas gdan zhus kyis phebs cho yod gnas tshul 'byor 'phral/ yongs 'dzin dang 'on po gnyis kyis gros mol byas tshe/ 'on po blo bzang stobs rgyas kyis/ bla ma kirti'i bla ma nyan na rang cag gi bla ma los nyan zer nas/ sprulnga ba'i sku ston 'khor bcas lha mo darigon du phebs te/ sa ga zla 49 3

ba'i yar tshes la 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga las dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung gi tshul khrims bzhes te/ mtshan sngar shir bza' rin po ches blo bzang tholtanapa'i rgyal mtshan gsol ba la/ skabs 'dir mkhan po'i mtshan sgra tshang bar byas nas/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes gsol / nyer gcig la bla ma lnga bcu ba'i bshad lung / 'jigs byed dpa' cig dang 'brel bar sta gon/ grub rgyal tshe dbang /phyi nyin nas dbang dngos gzhi rim pa bzhin 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ zhe dgu ma/ ro langs brgyad skor/ dgra nag gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma dang lha lnga/ 'phags lugs gsanga'adus/ snu lugs bde mchog 'khor chen/ rta mgrin/ kun rig mngon byang / sman lha/ gdugs dkar / spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal rnams kyi dbang / bde ba/sang 'jigs gsum gyi sngags btu/ 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongayo rdzogs dang ma nye'i gdan can/ rigs gsum spyi sgrub lugs gnyis/ 'jam dbyangs dkarastobo dang nag po/ dbyangs can ma dkar dmar/ gnas bcu/ sgrol ma dkar sngon/ rnam rgyal lha dgu/ rig byed ma/ phyag rdor u tsār+ya/rnam 'jom sa/ khyung khra/ seṅge sgra/ drag po sum dril/ gtum ‘94

yam̐ khyung lnga/ song gdong / lo gyon ma/ 'od zer can ma/ dzi dkar nag mgon po/ chos rgyal/ phyi nang gsang gsum/lcam sring / lha mo/ gur 'dra min bco lnga/ zhal rnam 'gyur bcu bdun/ legs ldan mched gsum/ rdo rje shugag 'jam dbyangaso chos skor las byung ba'i lhag lha rnams kyi rjes gnang /dngul chu'i tshem bu dmar khrid kyi steng nas lung khrid sbrags ma/ grub rgyal tshe khrid thugs thog ma/ lcang skya'i cho ga'i steng nas sgoladakar tshe khrid/ dpa' bo g.yul 'jug gi steng nas 'pho khrid/sngags rim chen mo/ byin rlabs spungs zhus/ thun drug rnal 'byor/ ngag byin rlabs 'jam dbyangs chos skor/ lnga ba'i dmigs brtse ma'i ṭīk+ka lam gtso rnams kyi khrid/ nyargo mgur dang / dge ldan bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam gyi bshad lung bcas nyin nyer gcig gi ring la bar ma chad par gsan/de nas nyin gsum la spro sangs byas pa'i mjug tu sems bskyeg mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas par gsan/ de dag gi bar gseng du 'jigs byed ser bo'i tshe khrid/ rgyan 'jug chos spyod rab gsal/ sngags phyogs po ti/ mdzod rtsa/ rtog bdun dang /rtog gsum/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud bcas kyi lung dang / 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i bshad lung bcas gsan/ yongs 'dzin blo bzasdu 495

ri dpal ba'i zhal snga las bde —lam dang / dge ldan phyag rgya chen po'i khrid legs bshad kyi skyes rīmang du gsan/ dgumi lo brgyad kyi dus —bcad rgyar bzhugs te skyabs 'gro dang / rigs ga sum spyi sgrub kyi bsnyen mtshams gnang / dgung lo dgu'i steng du 'ji/gas cibyed bcu gsum ma'i bsnyen mtshams gnang skabs nyin gcig thun bar la/ me tog ldum ra chung ngu zhig yod pa de'i 'khris su phebs skabs de nas 'od 'phro ba gzigs/ der bltas pas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i sku par gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa blangs/ lo de'i zla ba dgu ba'i nyer gnyis nas rigs lung zhabs zhu bcu gsum dang bcas mtshan nyid bka' pod chen po lngar sbyang ba mdzad pa'i dbu tshugs/ de nas bzung ste tshogs chen khrir bzhugs reg gi bar du/ rigs lung zhabs zhu dang bcas phas grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i lugs kyi tshogs chos grwarī 'a grims/ dpe khrid skyor sbyang sogs chag med byas te/ las sne lta dgongs pa ma zhus par bla 'bod cig thon rung mi phebs bshes gnyen bsten tshul dang zhi dul gyi spyod pa la kun gyi yid smon pa byung / dgung lo bcu'i steng 'jigs byed dpa' cig dang / sgrol dkar gyi bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs pa dang / thal bla ma blo bzang chos ldan gyi zhal snga las 'jigs byed chos skor 4 96

dang / bsnyen chen gyi skor sogs gsan/ dgung lam̐ bcu gcig thog snyigs dus kyi nye bar 'khor khong a mchog rin po che 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga las dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ de'i dbyar thog bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa rje btsun blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dge legs rnam rgyal dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga las dus 'khor dbang chen gsan/ de dus paṇa chen rin po ches bka' shog tham ga gnang ba ni/ 'jam dbyangs gnam bskos/ gong ma chen po'i bka'i lung gis paṇa chen er te nir bsngags shing / kun mkhyen bu ram shing ba'i ring lugs nyin mor 'dzin spel gyi lhag bsam snying stobs mchog tu dkar ba shākya'i dge sbyong blo bzang thub bsta na chos kyi nyi ma dge legs rnam rgyal dpal bzang bor 'bod pa'i gtam/ yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi lto bar 'gro ba'i skye rgu spyi dang / bye brag mdo khams sgang drug mtsho sngon/ a mdo/ mdzod dge shog che chung /zi khron/ mgo log bcas kyi char 'khod pa'i khri ba bla ma/mkhan po/ slob dpon/ las sne/ grwa rigs/ lung las kyis mtho ba'i rgya bod dpon rigs sogs bya ba las kyi sne mor mngags slebs rnams dang / gzhan yang dmag jag 'grim 'grul ba/497

dmangs kyi skye bo ji nyed pa sogs sir skya mtshog dmano bar mar bcas pha mtha' dag la bzlo ba/ mdzod dge phyogs kha bcu gnyisakyi nang tshan stag tsha bla ma blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya maphya — dang / dbon po bsod nams grags pa gnyis nas phyag btab dgon bkra shisachos bzang gling rten dang brten par bcas pa rje gongaphungabastan pa'i nyi mar phul sbyor nas bzung da lta'i bar sku tshab rla ma rim par mngag sa rdzong gi bkra shis lhun po'i dgon lagartsa—ga6togs shing / gong gsal bkra shis chos bzang gling 'dzin spel byed po dang chabs cig tu bsko gzhag song ba'i—bka' zhog rim par song 'dug pa ba zhin da lta'i bla ma tshang 'di bas 'khur skyong gi skabs su gnas bzhin pa ma zad/ da lam dbon po ngo ma dngos kyi mjal bcar thog dpal dang bo'i sangs rgyas kyi dbang lung gi man ngag zab mo nod de rdo rje slob mar gyur pa ring nas yon tan du 'brel zhing / — lhag par 'di bas bka' pod chen po rnayolnga 'i 'chad nyan gsar 'dzunogs kyi 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bzhed srol thun mong min pa 'di dag bstan 'gro'i — pha na bde spel slad ji srid rgyal bstan rin po che yun gnas de srid dar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gyur phyir da lta bka' shog srung yig chabs cig 'di bzhin dmigs bsal byin pa yin pas gong 498

'khodagadrag zhan mtha' dag nas spyi sgos kyi legs tshogs 'phel — sto sgrud mthun rkyen sri zhu phu dud gang zab dang / mchod rgyun rigawa5 rte dge 'dun bgres bar gzhon gsum byung 'byung gang cir phan cha mthu na 'gyu ra gang 'gro las/ ji lta bsgo ba bzhin dang du len pa rnams la 'di nasakyang kun tu dge ba'i skyabs 'jug bgyid pa yin/ zhe sa go bar bya ba'i yi ge 'dzin byed chu stod zla ba'i gral tshes dge bar mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi gzim chung du bris zhes pa gnang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas/ 'jam dbyangs ba zhad pa lnga ba chen po 'jam dbyangs ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la khong gi dgon pa 'di bkra shis lhun po dang ha cang thag ring bas phan mi thogs/ des na dgon pa 'di'i chos 'go khyed tshang yin zhes gnyer du gtad/ de nas bzung dasgorgan dbyangs dpon sogs mngags pa'i srol rgyun byung / dgung lo bcu gnyis steng kun rig dang chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum/ —r+shatshe dpag med gsum gyi bcad rgya gnang / lo der mdzodasnadage stod ma'i khyim tshang du mar zhabs kyis bcags/ mdzod da ge stod mas gdan drangs pa ltar/ 'o mtsho zhes pa'i mtsho khar mtsho bstod dang gter sogs gnang tshe/ sgra snyan po yid du 'ong ba sna tshogs grags pa/ lo der mtsho khar sngar med pa'i me tog yid du 499

'ong ba 'khrungs pa sogs kun gyis gleng / dgung lo bcu gsum steng slar yang 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs/ dgung lo bcu bzhi'i steng 'jigs byed dba' cig mgon po phyag drug pa/ bse khrab can rnams bsnyen sgrub gnang /bse khrab can bsgrubs pa'i bsnyen pa'i dus dang / gsol ja bzhis skabs nam rgyun phyag gi bsnyen phreng bor ba dang / gcan gzan sna tshogs mthong ba/ skabs 'gar brag dmar bosaspre'u mang bo rtse ba sogs kyi rtags mtshan mang bo byung 'dug lo—de'i ston dus kirti ngag dbang sa bzang bstan pa tshe ring las dus 'khor dbang chen gsan/ de'i dus so shing gyen 'greng du bsdad pa la kirti rin po ches bsngags brjod mdzad/ dgung lo bco lnga'i thog lha mo kirti nas gdan sa gong 'og gi bla sprul 'ga' dang mnyam du mkhas dbang 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho'i zhal snga las/ bde mchog rab 'byams/ rngog dkyil bdun/ rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum gyi lung / nyin bcu bdun ring la lam rim chen kāmo'i bshad lung / legs bshad gser phreng gi bshad lung /'jigs byed chos skor sogs gsan pa dang / 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros kyi zhal snga las skyes rabs so bzhi ba'i bshad lung gsan/ lo der bkra shis 'khyidze+egyi rdo rams pa the bo nag 500

ris zhesane pa mkhas grags can/ mtshan dngos don 'grub rgya mtsho zhu ba gdan drangs/ de nas bzung khong dang dgon pa gnyis char gyis tshul bzhin bsten nas ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas/ dge rmetshan gyi dpal la rol ba'i gzhi rtsar gyur/ dgung lo bcu drug thog gzhung rgyugs sprad/ 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs/ de nas bzung sngar gzigs ma myong ba'i dpe lan gnyis re gzigs pa tsam gyis thugs thog nas shar se gsung thub pa byung 'dug dgung lo bcu bdun thog yongs 'dzin rdo rams pa don 'grub rgya mtsho dang lhan du bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas/ mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag khong a lags bla go rdo rje 'chang la mjal/ tshe dbang sogs chos bka' ci rigs gsan/ khong gi dbu sngas su bzhugs pa'i rje rin po che'i sku brnyan zhig gnang ba dang / gsung lung 'ga' zhig gnang bar snang / dgung lo bco brgyad thog yongs 'dzin rdo rams pa don 'grub rgya mtsho dang lhan rgyas dmu dger phebs te/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi bla ma yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang rje skal bzang dpal 'byor bzang bo'i zhal snga las/ sgrub thabasarin 'byung / mi tra brgya rtsa/ thugs rje chen po'i dbang /gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed/ 'grel pa bzhi sbrags sogs 501

bka' chos mang du gsan/ de nas a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang tshur lam stag tsha dgon 'ditshor phe bas skabs/ rigs grwa'i nyin dang bor yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang dang hor tshang rnam gnyis tshogs dbu la phebs/ rje 'gi bas dge 'dun nyi shu'i tshogs gleng mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu'i thog 'khor chen dang rta mgrin gyi bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs/ tshogs chen 'du khang nang du 'khor chen sku thog tshad tsam zhig phyag bzo mdzad dus sku rang 'gu la byung ba sogs kyi rtags ya mtshan byung / dgung grangs nyi shu'i steng der bla brang nas/ a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gis mkhan slob sbrags ma mdzad/ yongs 'dzin rdo rams pa don 'grub rgya mtshos gsang ston dang / dge slong gi dus go ba yongs 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bsam 'grub/ dge tshul gyi dus go ba blo bzang mtha' yas/ kha skong ba a khu om 'khyil tshang rnams kyis mdzad de/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong si/ sdom pa bzhes te skal bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan dam par gyur/ dgung lo nyer gcig skabs/grwa ba rnams kyi nang nas 'ga' zhig gis/ gos log lham log gyon pa dang / tha ma kha 'then pa sogs la thugs skyo nas/ sku 502

snyung drag po bzhis tshul bstane/ blo ba bcu ba'i tshis gcig gi dgung mo ra/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sku phyag bris ma zhig yod pa dbu sngas su bzhag ste/ sku mya ngan 'da' grabs gnang / de skabs mdun 'dug pa dge slong blo bzang chos dbyings dang / dge slong skal bzang gnas brtan gnyis kyis yang yang gsol ba btab/ bla ma las sne tshang ma phebs nas brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs yang yang zhus/ gtsang bla ma dka' chen dge legs 'od zer gyis brtag pa byas te/ khyod sku lus la nad med/ thugs la mi bde ba gcig yod pa gsung dgos zhes yang yang zhus pa dang / dgon pa rang gis spyang zhabs brtan gtos chen bsgrubs/grub mtha' ris med kyi dgon sde dag la'ang zhabs brtan rim gro bcol ba sogs byas pas rten 'brel dang / gdul bya la thugs ba rtse bas bzhugs pa zhal gyis bzhes/ de skabs zhal gsung gnang ba ni/ 'di ltar/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo/ /rje bla ma bka' drin gsum ldan/ /seng brgyad kyis btegs dzi'i khri steng / /de'i mthar bskor dpa' po gcig pa/ /grangs khro bo bcu yi lha tshogs/ /dpal mgon po ma hā ka la/ /'khor gnod sbyin bzhi yis bskor nas/ /gnas 'di ru mngon sum byon pa/ /mi bdag nyid rjes su bzung nas/ /lha bla mas bar 503

snang gang ba/ /mi bdag gis mthong ba'i dga' spro/ /snying mi phyed dad pas gsol 'debs/ /e ma ho/ spyir mi rtag sgyu lus phung bo 'di/ /ma 'gro ba'i don du gtong nus bsams /snying rnam shes dkar dmar mdangs chags 'di/ /phaṭaḥ brjod pas spyi bo nas thon te/ /zhing bde ba can du skad cig mar/ /shing pad+ma'i dbus su rdzus te skyes/ /de 'dra ba'i rtogs pa med pa min/ /lus gtong ba'i snying stobs med pa min/ /gtong mi thub kha tshod che ba min/ /grogs dge ba'i bshes kyi bka' bzhin bsgrub/ /mi bdag gi bsam pa ma grub kyang / /khyed bla slob rnams rjes su bzung / /deng phyin chad thugs mthun tshul khrims gtsang / /nang bslab pa gsum po nyams su longs/ /phyi kun spyod gtsang ma'i cha lugs zungs/ /'di 'dra ba'i rten bzang thob pa'i dus/ /chos tshul bzhin nyams su blangs na legs/ /dus g.yo med bsgrub pa'i bka' drin mkhyen/ /des ldog phyogs chos min log pa rnams/ /dus nam yang ma bsgrubs bka' drin zhu/ /zhwa ser rang lugs mi 'dzin zhwa log dang / /rang gi grub mtha' mi 'dzin gos log gyon/ /rab byung mtshon cha thogs pa'i rigs la sogs/ /chos kyi rgyal bos sgrol cig sa ma ya/ /zhes lo de'i zla bcu ba'i tshes gcig gi dgung mo bka' 504

stsalo ba ltar/ 'on po blo bzang stobs rgyas kyis gtso byas 'grig bdag las sne rnams kyis tha ma kha 'then mkhan dag la mar rgya ma lnga bcu re'i khrims dang mna' skyel ba sogs bkag — sdom legs par mdzad pa sogs thugs dgongs ltar dgon pa'i 'grig lam dang 'chad nyan sogs la legs bcos dang do dam yag po byas pas sku rim gyis dwangs te sngar rgyun bzhin 'chad nyan gyi rgyun bskyangs/ dgung lo nyer gnyis steng a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gi gsung bkod ltar bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas/ gser khang chen mo dang / kye rdor 'du khang la skor tshad re gnang nas phyir phebs/ lo der rang dgon du phar phyin dam bca' bzhag bka' pod bzhi'i grwa skor dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi phyag bzhes ltar mdzad/ phar phyin pa rnams la mang ja dngul phogs sogs dang / grwa tshang la dge 'dun pa re re'i phyag tu dngul sgor gnyis re dang / mar rgya ma do re/mdzo phogs/ ja phogs sogs btang / yongs 'dzin rdo rams pa don 'grub rgya mtshos/ khong gi 'phror khyed tshogs chen khrir bzhugs dgos zhes gsung bkod yod pa dang / dgung lo nyer bzhi'i thog bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang la mjal bar phebs/ de skabs khong yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang 505

nas khyed rang dgon gyi tshogs chin khrir bzhugs dgos phyag lin thams cad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ltar byed dgos pa'i bka' gnang ste/ rigs grwa tshang dmu dger phebs pa dang 'grogs nas phyir phebs/ rang dgon du byon nas zla ba gcig tsam la gra sgrig byas te/ dgung lo nyer lnga'i thog rang dgon gyi tshogs chen khrir bzhugs/ khri ston rgya mi chung ba byas te/ grwa tshang gnyis kyi 'grig lam la dag ther phra zhib mdzad/ dgung lo nyer drug steng khri khur yod thog a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gi gsung bkod ltar dmu dger phebs nas/ dmu dge'i mgon po la skor tshad gcig gnang / khrir bzhugs pa'i ring la mkhyen rab kyi klong brdol ba'i 'bras rtags su/ 'dzin grwa bcu gcig gi brdzi bzhag thugs 'dzin gnang ste/ chos thog rnams su chos grwar rgyun phebs kyi brtsi bzhag gnang / chos mtshams rnams su rgyun gyi thugs dam dang / nangs ja gsol ma thag/ rnga brda rdung reg gi bar du dpe 'dzin dpe braltas kyis dus 'da' bar gnang / sngar dgon pa 'dir phyugs zog 'chang ba'i srol yod la/ dge rgan rin po che rdo rams pa don 'grub rgya mtshos/ phyugs zog 'chang na 'chad nyan la gnod gsungs nas/ phyugs zog nyung shas shig la rdzi bu gcig 'jog rgyu byas pas 'chad nyan dang mig ltos la 506

phan pa chen po byung yod mod/ rje 'di ba khrir bzhugs skabs nas phyugs zog gtan nas bzung mi chog par byas stabs/ chos 'chad nyan dang slob gnyer la phan par ma zad/ chos sde chen po'i mig ltos kyi rjes su phyi nang gi gzur gnas kyis bsngags brjod kyi rol mo bkrol/ sngar shing slong dang / ni ser lha tshes/chodus bzang / sems bskyed mchod pa sogs kyi skabs su skams lug bsha' ba'i chos log gi srol ngan pa zhig yod pa de gtan cagacod gnang ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs chen zhig yin te/ lha gsol ba'i skabs sems can gyi srog gcod pa ni phyi rol ba'i lugs yin pa dang / sems can tharmas cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed zer nas/ sems can gyi srog gcod padzhani sangs rgyas kyi gsung la ngo rgol byed pa'i phyi rol kla klo'i spyod pa las kyang thu ba yin te/ khong bla go rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal nas/ deng sang ra lug bsad nas mi ma yin mchod pa 'di ni/ phyi rol ba'i phyugayokyi mchod sbyin ngo ma 'gyur ba red gsungs/ rgyal khrims dog pa'i skabs su kha ton dang yon tan sogs slob 'dod yod pa'i bla grwa 'ga' rgyal khrims lhod nas khe tshong la gzhol zhing / nye char gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa mthar phyin par skams lug bshas te dga' ston byed pa mthong 507

bas nga sems gting nas kho chad pa zhig byung song / gzhan yang khong gis grwa ba rnams kyi nang nas/ sham thabs nag po gyon mkhan/ phreng nag dang phrengaci ba rgyan cha canartso'adzin mkhan/ skra dang kha spu ring bo 'jog mkhan rnams la bka' bkyon gnang nas 'dul ba'i kun spyod je dag tu btang / rgyugs brtsi bzhag dang /'dzin skyor sbyang sogs la nam yang lhod pa med par do dam mdzad/ rgyud pa'i chung rim rnams la shes rab kyi che chung dang bstun nas khag du ma bgos te/ yig rigs sna tshogs/ rtsis rig dang / snyan ngag sogs kyi rgyugs sprod du bcuka pa dang /zhi rgyas dbang drag dkyil 'khor sogs kyi thig dang / gtor ma'i bca' bzo sogs slob tu bcug dbu mdzad skad sgra ba rnams la'ang 'don rta dbyangs dang / rdung phyag len sogs la dag ther dang zhu dag mdzad/ mdor na khrir bzhugs ring la grwa tshang gnyis charo'agrig lam dang / chos 'dul ba'i kun spyod/mdo sngags gnyis kyi bshad sgrub gang thad nas yar rgyas gong 'phel byung / gung thang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis/ sprul sku bstan don du byon na/ bshad sgrub lag rjes shig 'jog dgos/zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi rnam thar rmad du byung ba'o/ /dgung lo nyer brgyad thog nyin bcu gcig la phogs gtong sgo sogs btang 508

nas khri ba'i las khur phog lo de'i zla bcu ba'i nang dmu dge nas/ khong a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gis phyag yig gnang ba'i gsung bkod ltar sku 'bum sogs su byang mjal du phebs/reb gong ba dpyi sa blo gros kyis bris pa'i gnas yig ltar mjal bskor zhib rgyas byas/ rgan gya'i brag dkar dgon du khong a lags bla go rdo rje 'chang gi bzhugs gnas a khu 'phrin las kyi nang du bzhugs/ rgan gya'i gnas khang nang du mjal bar phebs skabs/ pade mchog rang byon dang bla mtsho'i khar kha btags phul ba dkar shar gyis len pa byung / mkha' 'gro ma stong gi tshogs 'khor byed sa de nas mi'i brla mgo zhig rnyed/ de ru rkang brgyad dang lus sbyin gsungs/ a khu 'phrin las kyis/khong a lags bla go rdo rje 'chang gis gnas khang nang nas rnyed pa'i rdo la rus pa'i sprin ris yod pa zhig phul/ sku 'bum nas gser gdung chen mo'i mdun brkyangs phyag mang tsa ma 'tshal/ byang gi dgon chen bzhi sogs rten 'gangs chen rnams la mjal/ phebs lam du seng ge gzhung dang rdo sbis kyi dgon sde du mas ja thab sogs kyis phebs bsu dang bsnyen bkur zhus/ lo de'i zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang phyir gdan sar 'byor/ dgung lo nyer dgu'i thog zla ba bdun pa'i nang / khong ma lags yongs 'dzin 509

rdo rje 'chang gdan sar spyan drangs te/ spyi bka' dpang rdo rje phreng ba dang / rgyud sde gzhan rnams kyi zur bka' mang bo zhus/ zla brgyad par bla brang du phebs nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po lha mo tshul khrims tshang zhes yongs su grags pa'i ma/bas dbang de ba'i modun — nas snyan dngags dang sa dpyad sogs rig gnas du ma gsan/ tshodagung lo sum cu'i thog zla ba gnyis pa'i tshogs mchod grol nas miphyir rang dgon du phebs/ zla gsum par yang bla brang du phebs nas rgyal dbang rin po che bcu bzhi ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho tshang la mjal zhing thugs rje chen po'i dbang gsan/ paṇa chen rin po cher mjal zhing khong gis thugs brtse ba'i ngang na sa bka' shog dang tham ga gnang / phyir phebs nas/ a skyid yul skyong gi gtor chog rgyas pa brtsams/ mdzod dge stod ma'i sar gzigs/dpon tshang gi gter bum las mnan pa blangs/ de nas lha sar phebs rgyu'i gra sgrig gnang ste/ khong gi sked phur yongs 'dzin skal bzang bstan 'dzin chos 'phel tshang la gnang nas/ dgon pa grwa tshang la khyed kyis thugs mnyam zhog gsungs nas zla lnga ba'i tshes dgu'i nyin dbus su chibs sgyur gnang / dung ri'i mtsho nag khar bzhugs nyin shi bo zhig la khrus chog skur bzhin pa'i skabs gser skyems shig blugs nas 'di thab ts+tshan la zhog 510

gsungs kyang ma bzhag de nas glo bur du gnam 'khrugs nas sorā ba drag po bab ste ser rdel spungs 'dug khong shin tu thugs khros te jithams cad la brda brgyab nas/ khong gis gsur dkar dmar gnyis ri ltar spungs te/ gsur bsngo rgya chen po mdzad/de nas thams cad la lha bsang rgya chen po phud bcug thams cadarte la phyag dbang phyag mdud gnang / mi gzhan bcu gsum la phur mdud na bza' bcas gnang / khyim tshang 'ga' rer drug cu ba sogs rim gro mang du bsgrub bcug de nas bzung dgung mo thams cad du sgar phyir 'bud mi chog par go 'don byas nas 'dug dgos zhes bka' gnang / khrums zla'i tshes bcu gsum nyidz+wa 'brug gzhung du phebs nas rdo la phyag zhabs kyi rjes bzhag lha sar phebs/ rgyal dbang rin po che la gzim chung nang mjal kha zhus te/ mjal dar du dngul rdo tshad dgu phul nas/ mi grangs brgya lhag la dem ja drangs shing phyag dbang dang / 'phags bstod ma ṇi'i lung gsung bshad bcas gnang / thog mtha' bar gsum du thu gas shin tu dgyes nyams bstan pas/ khong dpon slob mjal phyag zhu mkhan tshang ma'i rgyud la dad pa dag snang gi dge sems khyad par can 'khrungs/ rgyal dbang rin po ches/ rten skal du gzim stas kyi thugs rje chen po'i sku/ rgyal dbang gong ma 51 /

'jigs byed bsnyen chen la bzhugs skabs kyi 'jigs byed dang ma ho'i sku/ nang rten gyi rten 'dus/ rgyal dbang rim byon gyi na bza' bcas gnang / 'bras spungs la dngul sgor khri gcig dang stong gnyis lhag gis mang ja 'gyed phogs btang / the bo khang tshan la yang gtong sgo tshogs chen las kyang che ba btang /sgo mang grwa tshang du gtong sgo dang bcas tshogs zhugs gnang /rtsod pa sngon song yin gshis 'dzin grwa don bdun cu nas zhugs/ sgo mang mkhan po gsar ba sog po skal bzang legs bshad tshang dge rgan du bsten/ sems bskyed kyi rtsod pa'i mtshams nas dpe khrid zhus/ zla ba bcu ba'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin shar ba chos rje'i khri gdan go sar gnang nas/ gdung gral gyi mgor khri gdan der bzhugs skabs/ nam mkha' nas kha dar zhig dkar shar gyis byung nas sku la phul ba kun gyis mthong ste ya mtshan du gleng /'bras smungs nas bka' gdams mchod rten dang / rje do kha ma khang bzang dang bcas pa gnang / sgo mang grwa tshang gis dge dbyug sogs rten byin rlabs can mang du gnang / dga' ldan la dngul sgor stong bdun/ se rar yang de bzhin du dge 'dun re re'i phyag tu dngul sgor gcig re phul/ lnga mchod spyi rdzas su rgya dngul rdo tshad bcu bdun bzhag smon lam chen mor phug gi 51lha

dge 'dun re rer ṭa ka bzhi dang / mdo'i dge 'dun re rer ṭa ka gsum re phul ba bsdoms pas dngul sgor stong gcig phul/bkra shis lhun por phebs nas/ paṇa chen rin po cher gzim chung nang mjal zhus/ mjal dar du rgya dngul rdo tshad dgu phul/khong ngo 'khor bcas la dem ja drangs shing thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i zhal gsung gnang / paṇa chen rin po ches khong gi sku par gcig dang na bza' rdul le na bubs tshang gcig paṇa chen sku gong ma chos kyi nyi ma'i sku sham bubs tshang gcig bcas rten skal du gnang / bkra shis lhun po'i tshogs chen gyi dge 'dun re re'i phyag tu dngul sgor gcig re phul/ stag mo khang tshan dang / co no khang tshan gnyis kyi dge 'dun re re'i phyag tu dngul sgor gsum re phul/ bkra shis lhun po'i gzhung nas thub dbang shar li ma gcig chos skyong bag tse'i zangs kyi ral gri dang btsan mdung / yum gdong dmar ma'i gri gug bcas gnang / stag mo khang tshan nas thub pa li ma gcig phul/ sde gzhung nang blon zhig gi lag nas/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong dang /mkha' spyod ma'i sku gser zangs las grub pa de gnyis la dngul sgor stong gnyis phul te blus/ gzhan yang lcags po ri'i gso rig grwa tshang dang / rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang sogs grwa tshang khag gi dge 513

'dun re rer dngul sgor re phul/ jo bo rin po che gtsor byas pa'i sku che chung drug cu rtsa grangs shig la zhasnal gser phul ba sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa bltan 'gro'i don du bsngos/ tshur lam phebs dus nub cig mtshan lam du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bar snang gang ba rnams gcig gcig la thim pa'i shul na mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis lung bstan 'di ltar gsungs 'dugadus gsum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dang / /yi dam srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor gyur cig rme /shar dung ri'i phrag pa g.yas pa na/ /rta bdun gyi rngog ma ring ba la/ /nub srin po sprel gdong kha gdangs can/ /lag g.yas kyi spar mo zin la nye/ /tshe yi lha la byin rlabs zhus/ /gangs seng dkar bo'i g.yu ral la/ /zhe sdang me dpung 'bar la nye/ /myur du zab zab 'bad na dga'/ /'phags dkor lha la rten ran 'dug /nya mo lcags kyus zin pa la/ /mi srin tshogs kyis gtongu ba med/ /rin chen glud gcig 'bul dgongs 'dug /rta ma/chog rol bas de la rdzongs/ /mdo smad skal bzang brgya stong sgrubs/ /—nga legs 'bras bum thogs bcu gnyis pa/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i bsu ma yin/ /yi dam srung ma'i bka' nyan yin/ /khrus kyi chu bo 'bum phyir byon/ /lung bstan mgrin gcig gsung 514 spyo

phyir byon/ /khyed ma 'khrul grogs dang 'bral ba med/ /dus kun tu dge ba ring nas bskul/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rmi lam lung bstan de dgon par bskur bas/ dgon pas kyang a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang la lung bstan zhus pa'i gsung bkod ltar mchod sbyin 'o ma'i rgya mtsho la rta mchog rol bas rdzongs te/ sku glud gnyis la na bza' chibs rta rin chen rgyan cha cha mtshungs dang / rta zog nyer gcig dngul sgor chig stong /gos phrug dar gsum/ 'bru drug sna lnga/ gser dngul zangs lcags sogs ma tshang med pa'i mdos chen dang / sku rim zhabs brtan tshad med pa bsgrubs/ de ltar gnang ba'i lung bstan de/〉 rjes 'jug dag gis khong lkesku sger gyi lung bstan du go 'dug mod/ spyi gegs kyi lung bstan yin pa phyis byung dang sbyar na shin tu gsal la/ yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gi gsung bkod de yang spyi sger gnyis ka'i zhabs rim yin nges so/ /dgung lo so gcig thog zla ba lnga ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin rang yul du phebs gnang skabs/ mtha' ba/ mdzod dge/ spra sar/ stod ma ste shog kha bzhi dang / sgar ba/ skyabs mgon/ chos 'khor/ mchod rten te shog tshan bzhi/ 'bras spungs bla ma/ rang dgon gyi spyi gzhung rnams kyi ja thab steng la rim bzhin phebs nas gdan sar 515

'byor bas/ dgon sde sbyin bdag dang bcas pa dga' kro'i bde dga' la rol to/ /dgung lo so gnyis thog yang sgrol dkar gyi sku mtshams shig la bzhugs/ lo de'i zla bcu ba'i nang sho ba dgon du phebs nas/ sho ba'i rta mgrin la skor tshad gcig gnang / dgung lo so gsum rab rgyal sa pho khyi'i (1958)zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i gunge tshigs 'tshogs la/ khong dang khri zur skal bzang lung rtogs gnyis kyis 'dul ba'i tshogs gleng gnang / de nas ring bo ma 'gor bar grwa mang bsdus te kha ta go bskon gyi gsung bshad mang bo gnang nas/ de ring nas bzung 'grig bdag med/ dka' ba ji 'dra byung yang rang rgyud kyi bslab pa la gces spras byed nges pa'i bsam pa yod phyin/ sus kyang bshig mi thub pa thag gis chod/ spyi rdzas sogs med kyang dka' ba med sems sdug mi dgos/ rang gi bstan pa rang gis skyong tshod yin/ rgya byed bsams na rang dbang yin la/ bod byed bsams na rang dbang yin/ zhes sogs mang du gsungs/de nas zla brgyad pa'i tshes nas khong lo mang bor mtshams la bzhugs dgos gsungs/ da ci byed zhus pas/ skyon med dgon pa 'di grwa ba bdun gyis bdag byed ang gsungs pa dang /nga la shig 'di 'dra mang gsungs nas shig sum cu so gnyis mnyam 516

du brton/ de ci yin bsams mod/ phyis su mi so gnyis mnyam du khri mon du bcug pa de bstan pa yin 'dug zer/ lo de'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer gcig la bcos bsgyur gyi las 'go bzung ste/khong khri mon du bcug tshe btson gyi khrims thag bcad/ lo gsum la mdzod dge rdzong gi btson khang du btson sdug mang bo myangs/nad kyang mang bo bzhes/ gso ma 'khel ba dang skyag khang phyags pa sogs las la bkol/ dgung lo so bdun steng 'bar khams su khrid nas/ slob sbyong tshogs chung gi 'go byed du bcug mi lnga bcu lhag khrid nas nyin gsum mam bzhi re'i nang 'bu khri tsho lnga drug re bsad nas 'bu ro rtsis sprod dgos byung / dgung lo zhe gnyis steng (1967)wun khron la khrid skabs yang slob sbyong dang gtsang sbra'i tshogs chung gi 'go byed du bcug pa dngarka tshem batho ba'ang mdzad/ dgung lo zhe lnga'i steng (1970)mong wun rdzong du khrid nas slob sbyong dang / lcags bzhu/ lcags skam brdungs/ mgar sna tshogs kyi las ka byas mthar tshe btson gyi khrims phab nas/ btson gyi dus tshad lo bco brgyad du thag bcad/ khrims ra phyi'i las kar song chog (pa dang / las ka cung zad je yang la song / dgung lo nga bzhi'i steng (1979)nag zla'i gnam gang gi dgung kha btson grol thob nas rang yul dzā17

du phebs te/ ru chen nang nas gyo mog dpar ba dang / sa srung byed po/ glog gis sman 'thag pa sogs kyi lasaka byas/ de'i zhor du 'phags bstod sogs snum par du brgyab nas bkram/ dgung lo nga lnga'i steng (1980) srid jus je yang du song yod gshis/ gong rim la yar zhu byas te/ grwa ba rnams la skul ma byas nas/ rang rang gi sa de nas dgu ba'i nyer gnyis nyin 'tshogs nas dgon pa slar gso byed pa'e dbu bzung / dgon pa'i nang du nye 'khor gyi grwa ba rnams kyis gso sbyong dang 'jigs byed dpa' cig gsungs/ ru gong ma na yod pa'i grwa ba rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong zhig 'tshogs te/ de nyin gnas bcu'i phyag mchod gsungs/ de nas khong gis gong rim la zhus te/ ru chen gyi thon skyed la mi gnod pa'i 'og nas yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong sogs 'tshogs te rim gyis je rgyas la song nas dus mchod sogs 'tshogs thub pa byung / dgung lo nga drug steng (1981)gong rim la lan mang du zhus te smon lam chen mo ske 'tshogs/ spyi rtsis kyi zla lnga ba'i tshes bdun la datho/na pa 'di le chos sgo phyes/ gong rim gyi chog mchan thob/ de nas dbyar gnas 'tshogs pa dang 'du khang chung ba zhig gso byed pa sogs la khong gis ru chen nang nas las ka'i skar ma thob pa sogs phyag 518

rdzas gang yod thams cad chud zos su cung zad kyang ma btang bar bzhag bka' bstan gnyis/ rje'i gsung 'bum tshar gnyis/ yum chen mo/ bskal 'phags gnyis/ lam sngags sogs dpe cha mang bo glus pa dang / rje yab sras gsum/ slogadapon pad+ma/ thub dbang / tshe lha rnam gsum/ sgrol ma sogasagaser zangs dang lugs sku che chung mang bo dang / mchod rten che chung ji yod/ thod pa a yig rang byon ma/ rgyal paṇa rnam gnyis kyi na bza' sogs dang / sbub chen bkra shis chos sgra/ rgya gling / dung chen dung chung sogs phyag tu gang byung blu yon la ltos pa med par blus/ grwa mang dang mang tshogs la rgan gzhon dar ma su yin kyang rgyal khab kyi khrims dang 'gal ba'i bya ba byed — mi rung ba dang / grwa ba rnams kyis chos 'dul ba dang bstun pa las rgyas spros dang khe tshong sogs byed mi rung zhes gsungs par ma zad/ khang ba'ang 'dul ba ltar rdul khrus gzhal nas bzo ba las khang chen byed mi rung gsungs nas khong rang nyid nas 'dul ba ltar gyi khang chung zhig phub nas bzhugs/ de'i stabs kyis dge 'dun pa rnams kyang chos bzhin 'dul bzhin bya nyung don nyung gis bzhugs yod pa mthong ba tsam gyis dang ba 'dren pa yong / grong ba rnams/ la rgyul khrims brtsi zhing rku jag 'chab 5rku9

gsum byed mi rung ba sogs chos dang srid jus sbrags nas rgyun du zhal ta gnang bas/ yul sde mang bos rku jag sogs bcad pas yul khams kyi bde 'jags la'ang phan pa chen po—byung / de'i stabs kyis gong rim rnams thugs dgyes shing / ser skya mang tshogs kyis kyang dad 'dun rtse sa/cig byedarī cing re sa gcig pur sems so/ ‘ khong rang nyid kung hre'i sman pa byas nas nad kyis gdungs pa dag gis re ltos 'cha' ba'i sman pa grags chen du gyur/ dgung lo nga bdun rab rgyal shing pho byi ba'i lor (1982) paṇa chen rim/ po che bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs pa la 'tshams zhu ru phebs/ de nas zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig la paṇa chen rin po che kiti dgon du phebs pa la dgon 'dir phebs rgyur snyan gsan zhus/ hor zla dgu ba'i tshes bdun gyi snga dro paṇa chen rin po che mdzod dge rdzong 'dir phyag phebs gnang ste/mdzod dge rdzong gi spang thang chen por chos dad mang tshogs dang mnyam du paṇa chen rin po che'i drung nas gsung chos gsan pa dang phyag dbang zhus/ phyi dro paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dgon 'di'i 'du khang nang du chos kyi khri la zhabs sen bkod pa sogs dgyes zhal lhan du 'dzoms pa byung / khong gi mi phyugs gnyis kyi sman khang gnyis la kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad 520

mkhyin pa gdan drangs/ de skabs shig tu 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi gling ba dus 'khor skyabs kyi lag tu rten 'phrin yig dang bcas bskur ba ni 'di ltar/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs dri bral 'dzin pa shar tshe rdo rje 'chang chen po zhabs stegs bsnyengs bral gdong lnga glal ba'i gser khre'i drung —du/ 'go brjod bkod pa'i 'og tu sor drug tsam 'bebs pa'i 'og khri drung zhes pa'i thad nas/ rab gus dang ba chen pos phyag bcas gsol ba 'debs snying / deng gi char yang thub pa'i bstan la thub dbang rdo rje 'chang dang bka' drin gnyis su med pa'i rigs gsum spyi gzugs la 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal bo slar yang rang bstan 'dzin slad bsam bzhin srid par byon pa dang gang khyed gzugs sku mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid rgyas shing / dge ldan ring lugs bdag gir bzhes nas gang zag sdod kyi khyad par dang sgo bstun pa'i mdo sngags gso rig zab rgyas man ngag ran par stsal bas thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bzang ci 'dod du ston bzhin 'tsho gzhes ni bka' drin bla na med par che/skyabs gnas dam pa rnams kyi thugs rjes gus ldan pa'ang na 'chis ma bslus tsam nas/ bgo skal sri zhur gus pa'i skabs su mchis lags/ mtshams kyi zhu don 'jam dbyangs bla ma khyed kyi 52/

sku par dang gsung 'phrin sgor brgya dang bcu bcas 'byor/ slad mar 'jam dbyangs dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang grags pa'i dpyad pa gsum gyis gtan la phab pa'i dri med dge ldan bstan pa'i bdag por chos 'khor bskor zhing zhabs pad srid pa'i ring mthar brtan pa dang / dal rten stong bar zad pa'i snying ril bo zhi bde'i go 'phang ma bgrod bar du 'bral med rjes su 'dzin pa mkhyen mamakhyen zhes gsol ba 'debs/ rten stod gangs ri nas dge dam chos rgya mtsho nas phul ba'i gser zangs kyi rje yab sras ji gsum/ yang rje mchod ma gcig yang rje rang nyid kyi phyag tsha par leb gcig yang rje rang gi phyag tsha a ta ma'i sāts+tsha gcig tsu gar dang bod kyi rten 'dus ril bu sna tshogs/ yang rgyal ba bskalo bzang rgya mtsho'i gzim chung gi sgrol ma'i thang ga gcig 'di'i lo rgyus rgyab tu yod ces bskur ba'i rten rnams da lta rgyud khang gi rten khrod du bzhugs/ thang ga'i lo rgyus rgyab na yod gsungs pa ni 'di ltar/ oṃ swasnyi/ gangs can mgon gcig bskal bzang rgya mtsho sde'i/ /yang gsang rnam thar mig gi bdud rtsi ru/ /bskrun 'dir gsang gsum rdo rje'i byin chen phobs/ /'bral med rjes bzung thugs su ro gcig shog /ces bka' drin 'khor med 7 ki'i gtso mo yid bzhin nor bu g.yu sgron mdzes sdug gi gzim 52lha

chung gi zhal thang bka' drin gsum ldan bskal bzang rgya mtshos gsung ba'i rnam thar 'dra mtshungs kyi rgyab byang smon tshig tu bka' bzhin snang mdzad rdo rjes sug las su bgyis pa rten 'brel 'grig pa'i rgyur gyur cig ma hā su kha sirnyi rir su/ zhes so/ /dgung lo nga dgu'i thog rab rgyal shing byi lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum nas lha mo'i a khu dar rgyas dbyangs dpon du gdan drangs te dus 'khor sgrub mchod ras bris kyi steng nas gsarartsodu btsugs/ lo de'i dbyar thog 'du khang chen mo gsar gso byas/ de'i nang bzhugs su 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi spyi gzhung nas mtha' ba'i dbus pa skal bsam sogs mi nyer gnyis yod pa'i lag tu/ 'phrin yig dang rten bskur ba 'di ltar/ mdzod dge stag tsha zhes sngar nas mchod yon gyi 'brel ba chen po mi rabs mang bo'i ring nas yod thog da lta 'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyin byed stag tsha spru la4ba'i sku shar ba chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa rin po che'i drung du/ gser zangs las grub pa'i thub dbang gi sku gcig chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i phyag tsha/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi ba gcig rje btsun rwa lo'i phyag tsha 'jigs byed dpa' dzhag khro bo bcus bskor ba par leb gcig jo bo rje'i sku byin can gciga'aphrin yig dang bcas bskur ba'i rten rnams da lta 'du khang nang 523

rten khrod du bzhugs/ lo der sngon nas a khu ngag lo'i lag tu lha dar bcas bskur te bdag stag tsha dgon pa 'dir yong dgos tshul gsungs pa bzhin/ lo de'i zla dgu ba'i nyi shu'i nyin nas khong rin po che'i thugs dgongs ltar dbang rjes gnang khrid dang lung sogs nyin bcu drug gi ring la bton/ rab rgyal shing glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig la mdzod dge steng ma shog kha gnyis dang gling ba'i 'brog ra sogs kyis khong rin po che dpang bor bzhag ste sku bcad/ lo de'i hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu gcig la gung thang sku phreng drug pa 'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang— phyug dpal bzang bo'i drung nas/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dpag med kyi dbang gsan/ rab rgyal me stag (1986)lo'i khrums zla'i nyer bdun nyin dbus gtsang du phebs nas se 'bras dge gsum dang bkra shis lhun po bcas la lha mjal byas shing 'gyed phogs btang / bkra shis lhun po nas rten skal du paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi gdung rten nang bzhugs gtsang ba dge legs ma/ 'bras spungs nas rje mi tri ba zhes pa rje'i bzhad 'phar ma dang sku babs 'dra ba zhig dang / 'jam dbyangs chos rje la bkra shis bum gter ma/ rgan tshul khrims rin po che'i chab ril sogs gnang / lo de'i zla dgu ba'i nyer bdun nyin dbus 524

gtsang nas khong rin po che phyir phebs te/ dgon pa gzhung la khong gis bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/ thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung 'bum/ rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/lcang skya ba'i gsung 'bum pone gcig pa sogs gnang / dgung lo redzhagacig steng hor zla dang bo'i tshes gcig nyin/ gling ba stod smad bar gsum la phyag dbang gnang ba'i mjal dar sogs phyag rdzas sgor bdun stong rwa bong dgon gzhung du phul/ zla ba de'i nyer gsum la pe cin du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'e gser zhal mjal bar phebs/ khong rnam gnyis dgyes tshor chen po'i ngang nas spyir bstan 'gro'i don dang / nang sgos su chos sde 'di'i chos srid kyi don la lung bstan mang du zhus lan mdzad/zla gnyis pa'i bcu drug la rang dgon du zhal 'khor/ rab gnas me yos dgung lo re gnyis steng / zla drug pa'i tshes drug gza' phur bu'i nyin byang chub mchod rten yongs su grub ste gzungs gzhug phul/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi rgyud stod phyag len ltar dgon pa 'dir rab gnas chen po gsar du btsugs te mchod rten 'di la rab gnas byas/ a mchog dgon 'jam dbyangs smra seng gling du a mchog rin po che la 'tshams zhu ru phebs/ khong rnam gnyis mjal zhing bugs dgyes pa'i nyams kyis gsung gleng 525

mang du mdzad/ a mchog rin po ches gsung bkod stsal te dar tshon sna lnga'i snyan shal phul ba ltar/ zla ba de'i tshes bcu gsum nyin bse khrab can la lha tho bzhag ste a mchog tshang gis phul ba'i dar tshon gyi snyan dar phul/ hor zla brgyad pa'i yar tshes la kun gzigs ye shes kyi nyi ma paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas la 'tshams zhu ru bis mdo dgon du phebs/ yar lam bla brang du phebs nas tshes dgu'i nyin stag tsha sku phreng bzhi ba tshang la phul ba'i dgon lag bkra shis bsam gtan gling gi bdag gnyer ba sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang mjal/ dgon pa 'di la thugs rjes gzigs dgos tshul snyan du gsol ba na/ 'o na ser skya de thams cad la re ba de ltar yod na ngas kyang bdag byed chog gsungs te skyong rgyu zhal gyis bzhes/ sngar sku phreng bzhi ba lan mang bor dgon pa der phebs te bdag skyong gnang nas da lta'i bar lo grangs brgya lhag song yod par mngon/ dgung lo re gsum bzhes pa rapa gnas sa 'brug lo'i zla dang bo'i tshes gcig la/ smon lam tshogs dbur phebs/ hor zla dgu ba'i bco brgyad la bla brang du mang ja 'gyed phogs btang / bcu ba'i tshes bcu gsum la 'bar khams su chos lugs nang bstan tshogs 'dur phebs/bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin dgon gzhung nas gnas 526

bocu'itshuphyag martsod dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs thul/ dgung lo re bzhi'i steng / sa sbrul lo'i zla dang bo'i nyer gcig la kun gzigs rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs su tshogs dbur phebs te mjug tu mchog sprul myur 'byon gyi gsol ba shugs drag tu btab/ de'i nyer lnga nas nyin gsum gyi ring la thos bsam gling gi bca' yig kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i gsung gi steng nas dgon pa 'di'i 'grig lam dang 'brel ba'i gsung bshad phra zhing zhib pa zhig gnang / zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes dgu'i nyin the bo dgon lag steng ga dgon bkra shis bsam gtan gling du zhabs btegs te/ tshes bcu'i nyin ser skya mang tshogs lnga brgya lhag la phyag dbang dang srung mdud stsal/ grwa ba rnams dang dud tshang du yod dang mnyam pa'i kun gzigs paṇa chen gyi sku par dang /'du khang gsar bzhengs la sgor stong gcig phul/ mjal da ra gyi sgor mo du yod gnang / rten skal du dgon pa gzhung la stag tsha sku phreng bzhi ba dang lnga ba rnam gnyis kyi gzim sngas kyi thub dbang nub li ma gcig rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod thang ga gcig bcas gnang / skyabs 'gro lha brgya ma/ lam mchog sgo 'byed/ thugs bzhed 'grub pa'i smon tshig skal ldan re ba kun skong / rta mgrin bsnyen pa/ ma ṇi sogs kyi ljags 527

lung dang / dge skul dang sdig spong dge sgrub kyi bslab bya mang du stsal/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga nas dus 'khor 'du khangakyigasar du bzheng rgyu mgo bzung ste bla brang bkra shis 'khyilagyi du sa 'khor 'du khang la zhib gzigs mdzad/ rang dgon du 'du khang che chung de ltar byed rgyu thag bcad/ khong gis 'du khang de'i nang bzhugs byams pa mgon po'i sku thog tshad tsam zhig bzhengs pa'i sbyin bdag byed rgyu yin gsungs/ hor zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu gcig la mdzod dge stod ma dgon thams cad la ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo nas brgyud pa'i tshe dpag med lha gcig bum gcig gi dbang dang thar mdo'i mtshan spungs sogs ljags lung sna tshogs dang / bod rgyal srong btsan sgam pos bcas pa'i mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims bzang de la bod rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi sku ring nas bod rang gi yul srol goms gshis thun mong ma yin pa de la nges par mthun dgos zhes nan gyis gsungs so/ /de'i nyin bdag thengs bzhi bar slebs pa dang zhal 'dzoms/ bdag gis zla gcig lhag la khong gi thugs dgongs bzhin chos bka' ci rigs 'chad khul byas/ de ltar rnam thar gyi gtso bo ni/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ dang bo rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal/ /bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par 528

sher/ /tha mar nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs/ /kun rkyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang bor thos pa rgya chen btsal ba'i tshul ni/ dang bor klog slob ba nas bzung ste bka' pod chen po lnga sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa sbyang ba'i tshul gong du rnam thar gyi dkyus su bshad pa las shes la/ de sogs yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen bston tshul ni/ klog slob pa'i slob dpon nas bzung bshes gnyen gang bsten gyi bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa yin te/ dper na/ the bo dge bshes rdo rams pa don 'grub rgya mtsho bshes gnyen du paste na nas ci gsung dang du blangs nas dgon pa'i chos don dang nang chen gyi srid don thams cad kyi dbang cha khong la phul/ dge bshes khong snang tshod la thugs kyi 'char sgo mang zhing mdzad spyod myur ba sogs bsten dka' ba'i tshod 'dra yang / khong 'di bas/ 'di phyi'i skyabs su bla ma bsten na'ang / /bden kha rang gis bzung ba yi re mug /gsungs pa ltar ma yin par spyi sger gyi don che phra mtha' dag gi —dbang cha bshes gnyen la phul te/ dge phrug dkyus ma'i lugs kyis sku gshegs pa'i bar du bsten pa'i tshul la gzur gnas kun gyis bsngags brjod kyi rol mo dkrol ba snga mo nas bdag gis 529

rkyang rna ba'i lam du lhan tu 'ardzobs pa byung / snga jir dbang bka' mnos pa'i bla ma dag la rdo rje 'chang dngos kye 'du shes —bzhag nas zang zing gi dngos po dang bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byas pa dper na/ khong a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang bla mar bsten nas bzung spyi sger gyi bya gzhag che phra mtha' dag khong la zhus nas bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa dang /rdo rje 'chang gis kyang rten 'brel 'ga' zhig gi dbang gis 'di ba'i sku mdzad pa la bar chad re yod par dgongs nas skabs skabs su ma zhus kyang gsung brtag gi phyag 'phrin gnang ste/ phyag skor dang mjal skor dang mtshams bsnyen sgrub/ rim gro gnang ba/ chad lus med par bsgrubs pa gong du bshad pas shes la/bshes gnyen tshul bzhin du bsten pa'i yon tan 'dis/ skyes chen du rlom pa phal mo che'i yon tan thams cad zil gyis ma nan cing / mkhas rtags dang / grub rtags kyi rnam thar gyi gtso bo 'di yin no/ /rje bdag nyid chen pos/ de nas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa'i/ /rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa'i rtsa ba ni/ /lam ston bshes gnyen 'bad pa du ma yis/ /bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten pa ru/ /mthong nas srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar/ /bka' bzhen sgrub pa'i 530

mchod pas mnyes par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul legs pa'i rten 'brel 'di'i stabs kyis sde dgon spyi sger gyi bya ba thams cad yar zla bshan du 'phel rgyas byung ste/ spyi mthun las kyi spyi gegs chen po ma byung gi bar du nang chen dang dgon pa'i chos dang srid kyi bya ba mtha' dag yar rgyas ha las pa byung / de ltar spyi gegs chen po'i bar du thos bsam rgya chen po byas par ma zad/ thos don gdams par shar te nyams su blangs pa ni/ mdo sngags kyi chos bka' thos lo dang shes lo tsam du ma bzhag par lo re bzhin bar ma chad par mtshams bsnyen sgrub la gzhol ba dang / dus rgyun du 'dul khrims gtsang ma gzhi bzhag gi steng nas thugs dam nyams bzhes lhod med ngos/ dgon pa'i chos don dang / dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag ser skya drag zhan mtha' dag gi tshe 'di'i gegs bar chad bzlog pa dang / phyi ma'i lam sna 'dren pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa rlabs chen gnang / kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i chen du bsngos pa ni/ dad rdzas dang phyag rdzas kyis nang chen rgya bskyed pa/ lha sde mi sde drisgrig pa/ kha mchu rtsod gleng gi don du gtong ba rang che rang mtho'i don du rgya drag bod drag mi drag sku drag sogs la ngo 'dzin 'tshams rtags la tshod med gtong ba lta bus 531

chud zos su gtan nas ma btang bar/ rang dgon du mkhan khrir bzhugs zur gyi skabs su snga phyir mchod gtong bla na med pa gnang ba sogs mdo smad 'dir bla ma dge 'dun btsas la dzabul gastong snga phyir —byas te kun kyang bstan pa rin po che rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos pa dang / khyad par du phyag rdzas mang che ba dbus gtsang du khyer te/ rgyal ba paṇa chen se 'bras dge gsum sogs la gtong sgo rgya chen po byas te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sems can gyi bde skyid kyi ched du bsngo bar mdzad do/ /gzhan yang sku tshe du mar mdo sngags kyi gzhung la goms pa'i 'bras rtags su rtogs pa brnyes pa'i yon tan dpag tu med mod/ bka' gdams gsar rnying gi skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar bzhin du/ yon tan tha mas cad bum nang gi mar me bzhin du sbed par mdzad/ 'on kyasmebyis pa'i mdzad spyod skabs sngon gnas rjes dran gyi rtags mtshan du ma zhig mngon par gsal ba gong du smos pa ltar yin la/ gzhan yang / 'o mtsho la mtsho bstod gnang bas/ mtsho nang nas rnga sgra dud sgra sogs sgra snyan po byung ba dang / sngar med pa'i me tog skyes pa dang / sngar mtshan tho kha 'byed pa'i tshe dbu lī'aja' zug pa sogs dang / mngon shes dang nus mthu che ba ni/sngar mdzod dge gling bar snyan grags ser myo/go tshang zer ba'i khyim 532

du shi sngas shitshi la phebs skabs khyed cag gi ro de'i ske la phur mdud cig yod pas 'pho ba mi thebs gsungs nas phur mdud len du bcug sog tshang dgon nang du'ang shi sngas shig la phebs skabs ro de'i ske la phur mdud cig yod pa sa de ma blangs na 'pho ba mi thebs gsungs pas bltas par phur mdud yod 'dug pa blangs/ yang gling 'dre che sang zer ba dang / bu khyim sang zer ba'i khyim dag la 'dre gdon yod par grags che bas/ gzhan dag rim gro sogs la de dag gi khyim du 'gro rgyur shin tu 'dzems mod/ khong gis gzhan la phan na rang nyid la ci byung yang rung dgongs nas de dag gi khyim du phebs nas thugs dam zhal 'don gsungs pas/ thugs byams pa'i stobs kyis 'dre gdon dgabatul bas phyis med par gyur/ yang skabs shig mdun 'dug pa'i lag tu yi ge sa rdo ri brag thams cad shig shig ces zer ba bzhag nas/ 'di byang shar mtshams kyi tshokhang gi ngos la sbyor gre phyi mig ma lta bar shog cig gsungs/ lha sa'i lam du nub cig sgarasmothog tu 'dre gdon gyis gnod 'tshe byung ba la thugs dmigs dang zhal 'don tsam gyis zhi bar mdzad pa dang / 'brug chu khar rdo la phyag zhabs kyi rjes bzhag pa dang / lha sar bzhugs yod dus/ zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu bdunarī gyi dgung mor rmi lam du/533

khong rang dgon du yod pa'i snang ba la/ nam mkha' naspo'od dkar shar se zhig yod pa'i nang la yar grwa ba zhig nga khyid kyi tshab tu 'gro zer nasa'agro ba la/ nga'i bsam par nga lha sa nas snyir tho na 5nas nga 'gro bsams mod/ grwa ba des khyed bzhugs dang— nga 'gro/ 'u gnyis myur du mjal yong gsungs nas lag gi spos kyi dud pa dkar shar se 'byung bzhin du mdzod dge'i ru nang du 'phangs nas song ba rmis/ nga sad dus spos dri zhim posacokhyab tsho 'dug gsungs pa/ lcags mkhar bla ma skal bzang kun dga' skurtegashegasu pa dang dus chomatshungs/ sngar sku 'bum na bzhugasarte dus nub cig dad ldan bkra kho shi song gsungs nas 'pho ba mdzad pa dang / nang ba'i mgon po zer bar/ khyod lha sa nas chus nub par nye ba na nga la ma bos mod/ khyod nga la ma dad pa yin nam gsungs pa dang / stod ma'i a rgya zhes par/ khyod khasgrusang nangs par 'gro dus lam nas grwa ba zhig la 'phrad pa de'i sems la/ nged chos rje'i bu rgyud 'di gzhan la shor 'dug 'di phangs che bsames pa ltar/ kho'i srung ma yang ma mnyes pas khyo da la gnod pa byung ba yin gsungs pa dang / rab gnas sa 'brug lo'i bdun pa'i nyer lnga'i nyin gyi nangs dus gsol ja bzhes skabs bzhes dkar nang du me tog pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad ldan 5bye4

da kar zhing gsal la/ lo ma/ yu ba darnga ldan pi shar yong rmebar/khong gis 'di ha cang yag po red/ 'dab ma gcig cung mi ga sal ba de ni da dung nga bsdad yod pa de yin gsungs pa dang /‘ sngar khri mon nas bzhugs skabs skal bzang me tog mang du yod pa dang 'dab ma brtsegs pa yang yang rmis pa de ni/ phyis su phyi rabs kyi grwa ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang bo skyong skul byed pa'i lung bstan yin rtse red gsungs pa sogs mang / mdor na mngon shes kyis dad ldan dag la rtag tu gzigs shing / dad ldan dag gi dad pa'i rten 'brel gyi dbang gis 'chi khar sku dngos ma phebs kyang zhal mthong ba sogs kyis gtam shin tu rtse ske mang / lha sar bzhugs skabs kyi mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan de/ spyi mthun las kyi spyi gegs kyi lung bstan yin la/ phyis byung dang rtse 'phrod byung 'dug pa bltas pas shes/ lha sar bzhugs skobaske 'ga' zhig gis rgya gar du phebs na bzang tshul zhus mod / gtan nas mi 'gro gsungs/ rang yul du phebs rjes/ nga zla ba spurgyad pa'i nang nas lo mang bor mtshams la 'dug pa yin gsungs tshul sogs gung bsgrig na/ mkhyen bzhin du sems can gyi don du khri mon du bzhugs rgyu'i 'dun pa sngar nas yod 'dug khong gis khri mon du bzhugs ne+ebs pham lhag srung thub kyang / nyung byed 535

dang nyis byed sogs srung thabs dka'/ des na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ spyir sdom pa 'bul ba dgag bya dang /dgos dbang gis bsgrub byar gnang yod pas/ dgos dbangapa 'di lta bu la dgongs pa yin 'dug dgongs nas/ 'dul ba ltar tha snyad lnga ldan gyi gang zag a no dang yag rtam gnyis la sdom pa phul te/ dbon rigs dang 'dri gcod mkhan dag gis gang dris pa la g.yo zol med pa'i lan dang / las gang bcol la'ang g.yo sgyu /dang ngo lkog med par rang nus gang yod phud nas bsgrubs stabs/ skabs kun tu tshogs chung gi 'go 'dzin la bzhag spyod 'jug las/ gzhan yang sdug bsngal yon tan ni/ /skyo bas dregs pa sel ba dang / /dge la dga' zhing sdig la 'ardzom/ /'khor ba pa la snying rje skye/ /zhes pa'i man ngag skyong bar gor ma chag la/ bdag la de dag sdig smin cing / /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ces gsungs pa ltar/bdag gzhan brje ba'i gdams ngag nyams su blangs par nges pa ni/sde btson grol byas ma thag ngas bdag gzhan mnyam brje sgom ma thub ces khengs myungs gsungs pas shes te/ gzhan bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sgra tsam yang rjod mkhan med par ma zad/chags sdung phyogs kyi gtam 'ba' zhig gleng bor byed do/ /de 536

ltar g.yo zol mid par drang bo'i lam la zhugs pa na/ chags sdang a 'thas su 'jig rten pa dag dang mthun lugs med pa chos nyid yin pas/ rang spyod dang ma mthu na tshe kha zer cal col dang zer zlos 'ga' yang snang mod/ de dag ni/ k+ṣa tas mi gtsang zos pa'i mchu/ /sa gtsang dag la 'bad de 'phyid/ spre /ces pa ltar yin no/ /des na/ dge ldan legs bshad las/mkhas pa gzhan dag ci zer yang / /don la bltas nas 'jug ldog byed/ /bram ze'i slob mas slob dpon gyis/ /rku bar bsngags rbe bzlog la ltos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'jug ldog ma nor bar byas pas/ btson zhabs su yod skabs ma zad/ khri mon las thar te/ rang yul du phebs rjes rim gyis 'jug ldog ma nor bar byas pas rim gyis bya ba legs lam du song ste/7— da lta'i bar du bstan 'gror phan pa'i phyag las yar zlar 'gran tsho : bzhin pa ni/ mkhas pa shin tu rgud na yang / /zla ba bzhin du yar ngo 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar byung ngo / /mdor na /dgung lo nyer gcig thog sku bsnyung tshul bstan skabs/ brtan bzhugs phul ba'i gsung lan tshigs bcad ma'i nang du/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dpag tu med pa'i zhal mthong ba dang / skye 'chi'i rang dbang thob spyang snying rje'i dbang gis/537

'khor ba'i sdug pasngal la skyo ba mid par/ godul bya'i don du/zhing 'dir bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i gsung las rtogs pa'i yon tan shes nus so/ /smras pa/ zla gzhon dbang phyogs ri rtser slebs pa na/ /zla gzugs 'bum phrag mtsho ru snang ba ltar/ /zla med ston pa sku bzhi'i bdag nyid kyi/ /sla bral sprul pa'i bkod pa dpag med 'char/ /skye phreng zla ba gzhon nu'i 'od snang gis/ /rgud pa'i smag chen yongs su bsal dang lhan/ /dge legs ku mud dkar bo'i mdzes zhal la/ /skal ldan skye bo yongs kyis longs su spyad/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyin byed 'od snang gis/ /'gro ba'i bde skyid pad+mo'i dga' tshal rgyas/ /rgud pa'i mun tshan nub dang chabs cig tu/ /log smra 'byung bo'i bya tshogs long bar gyur/ /g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal phyis 'dra'i spang gzhung du/ /g.yu 'brug sa la rgyu 'dra'i chu bo'i 'gre ma/ /rin chen phra tshom bkra ba'i sde chen por/ /'dul 'dzin dge 'dun gur gum 'bum phrag bkra/ /sde snod gsum 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshal chen po/ /yongs su skyong ba'i sna tshogs 'od can phreng / /bar mtshams med par shar ba'i dge mtshan la/ /bskal pa'i bar du spyod pa'i dpal thob shog /ces/ bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /538

ga 2can gahaṃska da/ skyoska lhazhi zho rgyuska rno na/ dgon sde 'di stag tsha sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i sku ring la btab ba yin te/ de'i ring la re the 'dres mdo'i ri khrod pa rnams da lta'i dgon gnas 'dir spos te dgon pa'i gnas gzhi bting / dgon pa'i mtshan la bkra shis chos bzang gling zhes gsol/ khong gi 'on po bsod nams grags pa dbus gtsang du phebs nas/ rgyud stod grwa tshang du tshogs zhugs gnang / rgyud stod kyi 'don rta dbyangs dang / phyag bzhes tshang ma bslabs nas/ slar rang dgon du phebs te/ bla 'on gnyis grogs mthun gyi sgo nas/ gzhi gsum phyag len/bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod rgyud stod kyi phyag rgyun ltar btsugs/ cho 'phrul smon lam dang / rgyal me tog thang gi dgu 'cham ltar dgu 'cham kyang btsugs/ 'du khang sogs sku gsung thugs rtsen yang 'bor chen bzhengs snang / dgon pa chags sa'i yul ni stod ma'i dpon po'i mnga' khongs yin stabs/stod ma'i dpon po dpal don gyis dgon mgo 'phrog rtsis snga mo 539

nas yod mod/ skabs shig na lha ba rdzun ma zhig gis stag tsha 'on po khyod la dmod zor gtong gi yod ces zer bas/ dpon pos dmag drangs te 'on3po'adzin bzung byas pa ma bzod pas/ 'bul sdud pa gtsang dka' chen blo bzang dbang phyug gdan drangs nas dgon mgo phul nas don bcol/ de ltar kun gzigs ye shes kyi nyi ma chen po paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma'i sku dus su/ gdan sa chen po bkra shis lhun gyis grub pa'i 'dus sde rin po che'i dgon lag gi gras su tshud pa zhal gyis bzhes pa nasabazung / dka' chen blo bzang dbang phyug gis gtsos da lta'i bar bla rabs dgu tsam song ba de dag gi ring la dgon ma lag gi 'brel je zab tu gyur/ rten skal du gzim sngas su bzhugs pa'i thub pa rdor gdan rgya gar shar li byin can gcig dang /paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi shangs khrag gis bzhengs pa'i bag tse lcatsosring gi brtsan thang / paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma'i sku sham bubs tshang / thel bka' shog lan du mar gnang / sku phring lnga ba ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho sku na gzhon pa'icidus/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi rigs grwa grub chen dgon pa 'di'i na nga du phebs te/ bla ma dge skos dbu mdzad sogs kyi khri gegs bzlog thabs su stag tsha mchog sprul sku na ha cang gzhon 540

rdzepa khri chung de rnams kyi khar bzhugs su bcug gsung ha cang mi — gsal ba'i snang tshul yod pas/ zhal la mda' dang ral gri gtad de gsung e 'byon zhus pas gsung gsal bar byon khri gegs bsal/ chos skyong gi snyan dar nang du'ang de ltar mdzad/gzhi brtan pa'i ched du rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhag stag tsha sku phreng lnga ba'i sku dus/ sngar grwa ba lnga bcu tsam yod pa de/ grwa ba nyis brgya tsam du 'phel/ sgo mang dge bshes tshul khrims dar rgyas kyis rgyud stod phyag len ltar bdun gsum gyi rija la sgrub mchod gtan tshugs dang / 'grel ba bzhi sprags kyi 'chadartonyan btsugs/ mchod pa'i chos thog rnyi tsha'i phyag len ltar mdzod dge tshul khrims kyis btsugs/ sku phreng lnga— ba khong gis smon lam bdun gcig la rgya bskyed/ khong gi sku ring la rta mgrin lha khang /rnam rgyal mchod rten/ gdugs dkar lha khang sogs bzhengs/dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi phyag len ltar mgon shos snyan grags tshang gi mdun na sa zhib slob byas te rang dgon du lcags mkhar zur dgu ba dang mgon po'i gtor chen sogs gsar 'dzugs gnang ste/ dgon sde 'dir dar rgyas che tsam byung /sku phreng drug pa skal bzang 'jigs medaskebastan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshang gi dus su bshad sgrub 'chad nyan gang sanas dar rgyas chen 541

po byung / khoje dgung lo dgu ba'i dus/ rab rgyal shing khyi (1934)lor smon lam khar sman pa ngag stobs kyis/ stod ma'i dpon po rta’mgrin 'bum la/ spyir dgon pa 'di la mtshan nyigakyi 'chad nyan cig yod na bzang tshul dang / lhag par stag tsha gong ma sku phreng lnga ba tshang la de 'dra'i thugs dgongs yod /dper na gang du phebs kyang bsdus grwa'i dpe cha zhig sku la bsnamasapiyod pa dang / rje tsong kha pa yab sras sogs kyi sku gzugs la rtsod partsobyed ba mthong mkhan yod pa dang / a khu legs bshad tshang gi'adra sku zhig gzim sngas na yod pa las lam rim chen mo dang bsdus grwa'i bshad lung gnang gi yod gsungs nas/ mchod mi phul te/ mdun du bzhugs 'dug pa sogs zhib tu bshad spus/— dpon pos kyang / mtshan nyid 'dzugs thub na bzang ngas rogs byed ces khas blangs/ lo de'i sos ka ngag stobs la dge legs kyis rogs byas te bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du song nas༈〉 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng lnga ba rje btsun bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo la rgyu mtshan zhus pas thugs shin tu dgyes/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku zhig dang /gzhung cibaka' pod lnga'i dpe dang bcas gnang sbyin du btsal nas/ a khu 'jam dbyangs ni khyed tsho'i dgon par bzhugs yod 542

pa rid/ khong ni nga'i rigs lung zhabs phyi'i gras red/ gzhan la mi bsko/ khyed tsho gal chen byas nas khyed tsho'i dge rgan sa bskos pa yin gsungs nas/ gsung shog phyag mdud/ kha dar bcas gnang ste/ da khyed gnyis phyir song la 'di bzhin zhu 'bul gyis la slar 'dir shog gsungs/ phyir 'ongs nas a khu 'jam dbyangs tshang la zhus pas/ khong gis lo gnyis tsam la dge rgan byed rgyu zhal gyis bzhes/ 'di ba pha yul mdzod dge stod nas ar ma tshang la 'khrungs/ phyis su bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs te grwa sar zhugs nas bka' pod po lnga sogayol sbyangs/ mdzod dge 'jam dbyangs zhes snyan grags rgyas/ mkhas btsun 'dzoms pa'i dge bshes de/ kun mkhyen 'japam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng lnga ba rje btsun blo bzang 'jam dbyangs ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i rigs lung zhabs phyi'i gras su bzhugs/ rin po che mchog gis bka' pod lnga'i gsan sbyang mthar phyin rjes/ 'khrungs yul mdzod dge stod 'dir phebs nas stag tsha dgon du bzhugs so/ /yang lo de'i dbyar thog ngag stobs la phun tshogs rgya mtshos rogs byas nas song skabs 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo sog po uger bzhugs pa dang mjal/ 543

khong gi sa bsdus grwa'i dpe cha tshar bco lnga par du 'jug rgyu yin/lo 'di'i dgu ba'i nyer gnyis la mtshan nyid rtsod grwa'i dbu 'dzu gas dgos gsungs pa ltar/ khong gnyis phyir 'ongs nas de tsogs zhus/ de nas khong stag tsha spru la pa'i sku rin po ches gtsos rigs lung ba bcu gsum la/ dge rgan rin po che a khu 'jam dbyangs tshang gi zhal snga las/ bsdus grwa'i dpe khrid dang /ri gas lung gtong tshul/ khas len 'dzin lugs/ rtsod pa'i rnam dpyod bcas grwa sa chen po'i phyag bzhes ltar khrid/ de'i phyi rdzodabyid ka ngag stobs gcig pu bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du song ste/r+sha skyabs mgon bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo la de lugs zhus pasabyushin tu dgyes/ khong la bya ba mang bas phan chen po mi thogs/ a lags brag dgon pa tshang ni/ dgon rochung ba tsho la phan thogs mkhan yin stabs khong la gtad na 'grig gsung/sa nas/ brag dgon pa tshang la bcol/ brag dgon pa tsharogis mkho ba gang yod dris te/ yar zhus bzhin bsdus grwa'i dpemecha tshar brgya tham pa yab rgyal bor zhus nas dpar bar ma ’ zad/ bsdus chen sogs dang mtshan nyid phyogs la gang dgos kyi dpe cha chos spyod sogs dpar/ de nas skyabs mgon rin po ches/ phyi lo stag bla'i tshes bco lnga la 'dzin grwa bcu gsum byas 544

te grwa mang la mtshan nyid kyi 'chad nyan tshugs gsungs pa ltar/ 'dzin grwa bgos te brtsi bzhag bzung / gzhung las pa skal bzadza stobs 'byor gyis khri tshab mdzad de brtsi bzhag gnang / de rjes yang ngag stobs bkra shis 'khyil du song dus/ a lags brag dgon pa tshang gis khong ni lo na rgas pas khom lung cher med/ de bas a lags yongs 'dzin rin po che la zhus na phan chen po thogs nges yin gsungs nas/ dngos skyes kha darobacas yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang la zhu bcol dang ngo sbyor mdzad/ de nas bzung khong yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gis rjes su 'dzin pa'i skal ba thob bo/ /khri tshab pa skal bzang stobs 'byor ni/ rab tshes shing bya (1885)lor yab stobs ldan dang / yum a bso gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ nar son nas bkra shis chos bzang glidzodu tshogs zhugs gnang / 'don cha thams cad thugs la byang bar bzung / rje'i lam rim chung ba tshogs rgyugs la phul/ stag rmasku phreng lnga ba'i yongs 'dzin legs bshad rgya mtsho'i sku'i skye bar grags/ dgung lo bcu dgu'i thog spyi ba bzung / nyer gcig thog chichab ril bzung / zhe gnyis thog dge skos bzung / zhe gsum thog bla ma gzhung las pa gnang / dgon pa'i 'ablo'ikhur thams cad lus chag med par khur/ shing bza' rdo rje 'chang /545

kirti blo bzang 'ophrin las/ a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang sor+ghas kyi zhal snga las/ spyi zur gyi dbang bka' rjes gan—nga khang bo— gsan te/ yi dam gyi bsnyen sgrub la nyin mtshan khon —mo yugardzo tu brtson par mdzad/ skal ldan du ma la rjes gnang sogasaci chos bka' du4ma gnang / dgon pa rang gi gzhi gsum gyi nyams len dang / rgyud mtshan nyid gnyis kyi tshogs chos grwa'i 'don parī dang lagaji rlun sogs phra zhib mdzad pa sogs bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don gyi sku tshe 'di'i mdzad pa mthar phyin nas/ dgung lo re dgu'i thog rab rgyal shing rta (1954) lo'i dbo zla'i tshes bcu gsum la mdzad pa'i tha ma bstan to/ / ——khri thog dang /bo/ rje bla ma blo bzang chos ldan bzang bo ni/ rte rta tshag rje drung yongs 'dzin zung chu'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho zhes pa'i dge bshes grags can de dang / de'i sku gnyen thal dge bshes tshul khrims rgya mtsho zhes pa gong ma'i dbu blar phebs pa sogs byudage cibashes du ma 'khrungs pa'i rigs rgyud du 'khrungs pa yin la/ — de yang dmu dge'i nor bar thal zhes pa'i khyim kha shas yod la/ de'i nang gi dge bshes tshul khrims kyi spun zla yab 'a jigs byed skyabs dang / yum ma cig skyid gnyis kyi sras su 'a ṣ+ṭhangs/ mtshan bla ma skyabs zhes gsol/ gzhon nu nyid nas/ 54sgo

chos kyi bag chags sahwapa'i dbang gis rtsed mo tshun chad rtse tshos sto kyi bya ba sha stag mdzad/ dgung lo bdun thog rgyal rong sgotsā —tshen pa'i yang sprul mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug khe tshang bla ma 3 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gtugs te/ klog dang mdo sngagase kyi gzhung du ma bslabs nas thugs 'dzin sogasaci mdzad/ de skabaso shig t+yā khe tshang rin po ches gtor gyig cig byed skabs rje 'di ba la gzan sham dang zhwa mo rngog rtse ma zhigashi lkeglumanab bcug nas/ ga zhan gyis dris na 'di chos 'khor gling gi khri bo /red ces shod gsungs nas gtor rgyag ‘gi sku 'khris su khride / de ni phyis su dgon kha shas kyi khrir bzhugs pa'i lung bstan du ne mngon/ dgung lo dgu'i thog rab tu byung zhing dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos te mtshan blo bzeng chos ldan du gsol/ dmu dge bkra shisari 'khore lo'i dgon du tshogs zhugs gnang ste chos mdzad btang stabs/ mtshan la thal chos zhes grags/ mgo log byams pa zhes pa'i dge bshes de gnas kyi slob dpon du bsten skecis/cho — mtshan nyid kyi bsdus grwa sogs rnam 'grel skor dang rgyan 'jug —4sogaso dang / 'jigs byed rnam gnyis gsang 'dus bdag 'jugi dang bcas pa/ kun rig sogs mdo rgyud chobro spyod du ma thuges ji'adzin gnang / yugs rab che ba'i tshod du 'dzin/ dge bshes 547

tsha kho 'phrin las dang a skar dge bshes 'jam dbyangs sogs las rnam 'grel dang phar phyin gyi gzhung du ma'i dpe khridazhus/sgo mang chos dar yang sprul sgo mang tshang blo bzang tshul khrims rgya mchadamu dge'i khrir phebs skabs dbang dang rjes gnang chos bka' mang du gsan/ 4gcod dbang zhus te chu mig brgya rtsa 'grims/ dgung lo bcu dgu'i thog bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas tshogs zhugs gnang / sngar khong gzhon nu'i dus/ khong 7gi khutshubo jidage bshes tshul khrims rgya mtshos a mchog mtshan nyid kyi khrid sogs mthar phyin rjes/ tshe blos gtang gi ri khrod pa gnang ste ri bo rtse lnga sogs su phebs khar rgyu nor thams cad dor/ bla r+ṣas 'di tsho bdag gyis dang bla ma skyabs 'di la dgos nyin zhig yod gsungs/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar bzhugs skabs/ khu bo'i khri 'dzin skabs kyi dbu zhwa po de mnabs pas/ dmu dge zhwa chen pa zhes grags/ jo mo khri ba zhes pa'i dge bshes de dge rgan du bsten/ gzhan yang / dge bshes dmu dge bsod bkra dang / sa dkar mig phrug ces pa'i dge bshes grags can dag gi mdun nas dpe khrid mang bo zhus te sbyangs pas snyan grags rgyas/ zhwa che ba/ skad che ba/ rnam dasnyod che ba ste che ba gsum ldan du 'bod/ sgo mang rdo rje 'chang 548

sogs kyi mdun nas dbang rjes gnang sogs chos bka' bong bo gsan pa dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ de rjes dbus gtsang du phebs te 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tsha nga du tshogs zhugs ga nang / gdams pa'i gter mdzod 'bul sdud rin sh+tsache blo bzang ye shespobastan pa'i rgyal mtshan dge rgan du bsten te phar phyin sogs la sbyangs/ 'jam dbyangs dkarobo'i sgyub gnas dang 'thil bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs pas/ 'jam dbyardzas dkar bo'i sku'i smin mtshams nas 'phel gdung bab pa sogs shes rab rgyas pa'i rtags mtshan byug/ 'jigs byed gzhi bsnyen gling tshang gi gsung them skas bcu gsum ma 'bul sdud rin zol+le — che'i drung nas gsan pa sogs chos bka' mang bo gsan/ gangs ri mkhan chen gyis rigs chen gtong lo la dge 'dun nyi shu'i 7 tshogs gleng mdzad/ dge bshes chestopo klu 'bum shes rasadang 'dzin grwa gcig yin/ lo shas bzhugs nas rang yul du phe bas te/ dgung lo so gnyis thog ṣ+kamachog mtshan nyid dgon gyi khrir bzhugs/sgyu 'grig lam srid sku'akharachad nyan sogs la do dam btsan po gnang bas/ thal chos / rīrag chos/ dgun chos gsum zhes btsan pa'i tshad du rtsi/ rag chos zhes pa dge phaskul gyi ming dang / dgun chos zhes pa grang ngar che sgang gi dgun 549

chos chen molidon du snang / a mchog rin po cheri'i zhal snga las chos bka' du ma gsan/ dmu dge bkra shis 'khor lo'i dgon gyi khrir snga phyi lan gnyis la ba zhugs/ grwa ba gzhan du bros pa la dmod pa'i dpe ngan bcad nas grwa tshab kyis 'thus pa byas/ par rko ba'i srol btod/ mdze nad kyis khyab pa gtan chod gnang /'chad nyan la'ang dar rgyas chen po byung / dus rgyun par rango dgon nas dpe khrid dang chos bka' mngabyubo gnang / rab rgyatshwa me byi (1936) lor stag tsha chos bzang sgrung 'dir phebs tetso khrir bzhugs/ dpe khrid gan nga ba dang / chos 'chad nyan rgyugs brtsi bzhag 'dzin skyor sbyang sogs 'phel rgyas su btang mod/ khri thog dang bo yin zhing mtshan nyid gsar tshugs yin pas/ yu la bab dang bstun nas ha cang gi btsan po ma gnang gsung sa/ yul srol goms 'dris la bltas te/ gnase skabs kyi bca' yig cung zad gu yangs shig mdzad/ lotreganyis mtshams nas sku 'bam gyi snyun gzhi byung stabs khri bzur nas rang yul du phebs/ gzhi tshang sprul ba'i sku rin po che dang rnam ga nyis nas dbyen skum mchod rten chen mo'i nang du/ byams sku thog tshad gnyis pa bzhengs/ khong gis rje tsong kha pa brgyad cu sogs sku gsung thugs rten du ma bzhongs te grwa tshang la spyi 'jog gnang / 550
