rang dgon nas snga phyir 'jigs byed gzhi bsnyen chen mo sogs yi dam du ma'i bsnyen mtshams mang bor bzhugs/ sku skun bzhes skabs zhal chems snyophyag rdzas gang yod chos phyogs su thong sa/ sprul 8 'dra blu rgyu ma dran/ grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i lugs kyi slob gnyer ba zhig gi skye ba blangs na snyam yod gsungs/ sku tsha dge bshes bde chen gyis/ 'o na dbus gtsang zhig tu skye ba bzhes nas/ se 'bras sogs su zhugs na legs sam zhus pas/ de bzang mod/ mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag dkyus gcig lapho ba pa bla brang bkra shis 'khyil las lhag med gsungs/ 'o na ba sang khog lta bu zhig nas skye ba bzhes na zhus pas/ de thag nye song / pha yul dang thatshi nye na mi bzang gsungs/ 'o na kho tshe nas skye ba bzhes na zhus pas/ 'o de tag tag red gsungs/ de nas dgung lo re lnga'i thog sku 'das/ zhag nyer gcig la thugs dam ma grol/ zhag nyer gcig nas thugs dam grol tshoba'i rtags ga zhung bzhin byung nas/ de rjes sku gdung rin po che zhugs la phul/ sngar khong rang nyid kyis zhal bkod gnang ba ltar sku rus la sku mang bo dpar te/ dgon pa'i rgyab ri'i ri nyag tu tsha khang bzhengs nas bzhugs su gsol to/ / khri thog gnyis pa/ rdo rams pa don zhagyab rgya mtsho ni/ bla 55/

brang bkra 'is 'khyil gyi themobo dkon mchog ces grags pa daṅge bshes de'i tsha bo yin la/ 'di ba yang khu bo'i rjes su 'brangs te/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du rmad byung thos bsam gling gi chos grwar zhugs/ gzhung bka' bod chen po lnga la sbyangs pas/ the bo nag ras zhes pa'i dge bshes grags can zhig tu gyur/ mdo sngags gnyis char gyi grwa skor mdzad pas/ rdo rams pa'i dam bca' dang / sngags rams pa'i dam bca' rtser son byung /chos dpal zhing bla ma dkar bo'i dgon pa'i mtshan nyid dge rgan du phebs/ rab rgyal lcags 'brug (1940)lor dgon 'dir gdan drangs te/ stag tsha mchog sprul rin po che dang grwa tshang gi dge rgan du bsten pa dang chabs cig mtshan nyid dang rgyud pa gnyis ka'i khri gnyis 'dzin mdzad/ sngar gyi rmang gzhi'i thog dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi phyag lenaciltar/ tshogs chos grwa'i 'don pa/ phebs bzhud sogs gang cha nas zhu dag phra zhing zhib pa gnang / phyugs zog 'chang ba sogs 'chad nyan la gnod pa thams cad bkag sdom gang thub gnang / dbyar chos/ston chos/ dgun chos/ dpyid chos rnams zla chos dang bar chos rnams kyang phyag len ltar gsar 'dzugs dang / bdun pa'i rigs grwa'i chos thog gsar du btsugs te/ tshogs gleng 552 )

ning / rtsod rgyugs/ tshig rgyugs sogs 'grig lagagadz+wathad nas dam 'dzin gnang / chos grwa sogs su khong dngos su phebs te rtags gsal gtong zhing blo rgyugs sogs len par mdzad cing skabs 'gar bka' bkyon dang phyag 'bebs gnang / skabs 'gar skyor sbyang skabs sgo la sgo lcags brnab nas song ba dag gi sgo lcags kyang gcog par mdzad nas bka' bkyon chen po gnang / skarmas 'gar khyed rnams kyis slob gnyer yag po mi byed na nga 'gro rgyu yin zhes 'bros stabs su phebs pa la/ grwa ba rnams sku rjes su song nas phyag 'tshal zhing slob gnyer legs par byed pa'i khas len dang bcas phyir gdan 'dren par byed pa sogs/skabs 'gar thugs ha cang gtum pa'i tshul mdzad/ de ltar ha cang btsan drag gi sgo nas 'grig lam legs bcos dang / gsar sgrig gi mdzad pa gang bstan kyang / mchog sprul rin po ches gtsos dge 'dun pa tshang mas dad log spyod log gang yang ma byas par bshes gnyen bsten tshul phyin ci ma log par byas pa'i rten 'brel gyis chos srid gang cha nas yar zla ltar byung / khong gi thugs dgongs bstan 'gro spyi dang khyad par chos sde'i 'chad nyan kho nar thugs gtad pa las rang don ngo 'dzin mdzes chos gtan nas ma gnang ba red/ skabs/ 'gar/ ngas 'di 'dra'i btsan 553

shed byas na'ang bla grwa 'di tshos da dung nga la 'di 'dra'i dad gus byed 'dug pa ya mtshan gsungs nas spyan chab bsil bar mdzad/ de ltar legs tshogs kun gyi rtsa ba brtan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis chos ldan gyi bya ba thams cad yar rgyas byung ste/ grwa tshang yang bzhi brgya yas mas su 'phel/ dge 'dun rnams kyang thugs mthun zhing khrims gtsang ba'i ngos nas thos bsam bshad sgrub la 'bad pas/ mi ser dag gi dad 'dun lhag par 'phel te mchod 'bul sogs kyang cher 'phel stabs/ dge 'dun rnams kyi 'tsho ba'ang sngar las bzang bar gyur/ sngar mtshan nyid gsar tshugs skabs rnying zhen bag 'khum gyi bsam blo can gyi mi rgan 'ga' zhig yid la mi 'bab par/ kun rig bton pas gtong sgo gtong mkhan yod pa las/ kha dog dkar dmar brtsad pas gtong sgo gtong mkhan mi yong zer zhing / ngag stobs dang phun tshogs rgya mtsho la'ang kha zer mi nyung tsam byung yang / 'di dus su mi snyan pa'i khā ta'i skad kyang / snyan pa'i khu byug gi skad du rgyur 'dug de ltar dge bshes chen po rdo rams pa don 'grub rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo lo ngo bcu gcig gi bar du dgon sde 'di nyid mas bu bzhin du bskyangs te/ rab rgyal lcags stag lo'i zla drug par sku mya ngan las 'das so/ / 554

khri thog gsum pa/ chos sde 'de'i brton bdarga )go tsha sprulaba'i sku rin po che skal bzang 'jigs med bstan ba'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo yin la/ khong gi rnam par thar ba rags rim zhig gong du brjod zin pa tsam las 'dir gsar ba brjod rgyu ma mchis mod/ khong dgung lo dgu'i thog dgon 'dir 'chad nyan gsar tshugs nas bzung / bshes gnyen tshul bzhine du bsten te/ gzhung bka' pod lnga la phu thag chod pa sbyangs/dgung lo nyer lnga'i thog tshogs chen khrir bzhugs te/ dgon pa'i 'grig lam sogs sngar las dag thon dang / skams lug bsha' ba dang / sgar du phyugs rigs 'dzin pa sogs chos dang mi mthun zhing / 'chad nyan la gnod pa'i bya ngan mtha' dag gtan gcod gnang ste/ 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba dang / chos /dang zang zing gi cha nas bskyangs te lo gsum la khrir bzhugs pa'o khri thog bzhi ba/ skal bzang lung rtogs tshang ne/ mdzod dge stod ma'i nang / yab a khyi dang yum pad+ma skyid gnyis kyi sras su/ rab tshes chu glang (1913)lor sku 'khrungs/ gzho na nu'i dus nas stag tsha dgon bkra shis chos bzang gling du tshogs zhugs gnang / yi ge klog sogs la sbyangs nas/ tshogs 'don 555

tsha nga ma thugs 'dzin mdzad/ dgung lo nyer gnyis thog stag tsha mchog sprul rin po che'i rigs lung zhabs phyi zhus te mtshan nyid la sbyangs/ rgyan 'jug dang grub mtha' rtsa ba sogs tshogs rgyugs phul/ dgung lo so bzhi'i thog chab ril gyi 'gan bzung / de rjes bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du tshogs la zhugs nas mtshan nyid la lo shas sbyangs/ rab rgyal chu sbrul (1953) lo'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin dgung lo zhe gcig thog khrir bzhugs/ lo 'khor bzhi'i ring la khri ba byas te 'chad nyan gyi 'phro bskyangs/de rjes spyi mthun las kyi spyi gegs byung rjes/ rang yul du bzhugs nas dge sbyor gyi 'phro bskyangs/ rgyal khrims lhod yangs kyi lam du slar 'khor nas/ rab rgyal lcags sprel lo dgon pa slar gso byung skabs/ khri tshab mdzad pa'i mthar rab rgyal shing byi lor sku 'das so/ /khri thog lnga ba/ dge bshes dge blong skal bzang rgyal mtshan tshang ni/ rab tshes me 'brug lo mdzod dge stod ma'i yul du/yab a chos dang yum a ka gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nas stag tsha bkra shis chos bzang gling du tshogs zhugs mdzad/ gzhung las par blo bzang ar+ya las bar ma rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdomawā bzhes/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma bsam sbyor 556

gnyis kyis slob dpon du bsten te mdo sngags gnyis la mkhyen rgya che ba'i tshod du 'dug gzhon nu nas zhi dul bag yod kyi brtul zhugs dang ldan zhing brtson 'grus dang shes rab zab pa sogs skye bo mchog dman kun yid smon byed/ dgung lo bcu dgu nas mtshan nyid kyi 'dzin grwa'i skyor dpon byas te thos bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ dgung lo nyer gsum thog a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gi zhal snga las bsnyen rdzogs kyi risdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer dgu'i thog chab ril bzung / so dgu'i thog skyabs mchog stag tsha rin po che dbus phebs skabs khong gi zhabs phyi gnang ste rgyal dbang yab sras kyi gser zhal mjal zhing byin rlabs zhus/ dgung lo zhe gnyis thog tshogs chen khrir bzhugs te lo gcig lhag gi ring la grwa tshang gnyis chos srid 'grig lam — gang cha nas skyong skul tshad med gnang yod skabs/ spyi mthun las kyi spyi gegs thog tu babs te khri mon du bzhugs/ khong gi khrims grogs rnams tsha nad kyis gdungs pa dag la shin tu byams shing / bdag las gzhan gces par bzung ste thugs brtse bas nad g.yog byed pa dang / khong gi bzhes skal ji yod nyam thag nad pa rnams la bsngos pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa re da ces kun gyis bsngags brjod kyi me tog thor/ snye mabyār bcings 557

'grol thob nas rang yul du ngal rtsol la zhugs/ me lug lo'i zlabyub dang bor sku gshegs tshul bstan to/ /'di'i mtshams nas bsten pa'i me ro slar gso byed skabs/ rab rgyal lcags sprel (1980)lo gong smos khri thog bzhi ba skal bzang lung rtogs kyis lo 'khor bzhi'i ring la slar yang khri tshab mdzad de/ chos grwa'i brtsi bzhag dang srod chos/ smon lam gyi tshogs dbu dang gsung chos/ gso sbyong gi mdo 'don pa sogs sngar yod brjed gso dang nyams pa sor chud pa gnang nas sku gshegs bar du bzhugs/ de nas dge slong skal bzang bzod pas lo bzhi'i ring la khri tshab byas te 'grig lam gyi 'phro bskyangs/ smon lam rigs grwa sogs chos thog che chung thams cad kyi 'gan khur te chos 'chad nyan/ 'dzin skyor sbyang gang thad nas da lta'i bar gnas pa gong 'phel du btang ste las don mthar phyin to/ /spyi mthun las kyi spyi gegs chen po byung nas bstan pa rin po che nyam dmas su gyur skabs/ 'dul 'dzin chen po dge slong blo bzang rgya mtsho dang dge slong skal bzang rgya mtsho rnam gnyis kyis lo bcu gsum ring la dgon pa 'di ga'i gser zangs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig dus gsum sangs rgyas/ ltung bshags lha so lnga/ gnas brtan bcu drug khru gang yas mas kyi sku 'dra brgya 558

phrig bgol ba/ chos po ti nyis brgya lhag gsasda bas byas pa dang / gzhi gsum gyi nyams len dgon pa rang gi phyag len ji lta ba bzhin du 'phro ma chad par lkog 'tshogs byed pa thabs gang yod kyis srung 'dzin byas/ khong blo bzang rgya mtsho ni/ mdzod dge stod ma'i yul du yab bkra shis dang yum bzang mo gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug gi thog rab tu byung ste dgon pa 'di'i chos sgor zhugs/ yi ge sbyor klog dang 'don cha mthar phyin par bslabs/ dgung lo bcu bdun thog mtshan nyid la zhugs/ sum cu'i thog bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi mtshan nyid grwa tshang la zhugs/ bla go rdo rje 'chang gi mdun nas spyi zur gyi dbang bka' sogs mang du gsan/ mdo sngags zab rgyas kyi chos tshul mang du gsan/ yongs 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bsam 'grub dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dang gsung 'bum du ma'i ljags lung sogs gsan/ lo 'khor dgu'i ring bla ma de dag las bka' chos gsan pas gsan rgya che tshod du gleng / dgung lo bzhi bcu'i thog dbus phebs mdzad skabs lam bar du'ang lhung bzed chu tshags dang ma bral zhing yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong sogs 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams phra rags dang ma 'gal par byas/ dgung lo zhe gnyis 559

tshothog dmigs brtse ma'i bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs/ spyi mthun las kyi spyi gegs byung nas lo bcu gsumu la rang yul du bzhugs nas sgrub pa snying bor mdzad/ dgung lo nga lnga'i thog khri mon du phebs pa'i bar du bstan pa'i 'gal rkyen sel ba'i khur chen khong la ma phrad bar du mi gtong ba'i dam bcarme mdzad/ dgung lo nga lnga'i thog khri mon du bcug ste khong rin po che dang mnyam du bzhugs/nga drug thog dgongs pa chos dgyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan to/ /de ltar du ma zad/ kun mkhyen sku phreng bzhi ba skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug shar dung ri'i gnas mjal phebs skabs/dgon pa 'di la chibs bsgyur te zhag 'ga' bzhugs nas khong gis dgon pa 'di'i chos srid 'phel ba'i lung bstan mang du gnang ba dang / yar phebs dus dar 'bog byed du bcug treng gis kyang chibs kha lan gsum 'khor te/ ma—tha' ba nas yar bud med dad+ku ma zhig gis zo ba zhig khyer yong ba de ci yin dris pas/ nang du dar ba yod zhus pa'i rten 'brel 'grig gsungs nas thugs dgyes dgyes mdzad pa dang / kun mkhyen sku phreng lnga ba'i bka' lung bzhin mtshan nyid gsar 'dzugs dang / mtshan nyid btsugs rjes gung thang rin po che sku hreng drug pa snga phyir lan gnyis phebs nas chos grwar gzigs rtogs gnang ste phyag nas 560

'thor ba dang / a lags yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang gis gzigs rtogs yang yang mdzad de/ khong nyid nas brtsi bzhag gnang ba dang tshogs gleng bslangs pa dang 'phros gnang ba sogs dam pa de dag gi thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi mthu grub cing / rab rgyal lcags bya (1981)lo'i zla ba lnga ba'i tshes bdun nas dgon pa 'di la chos sgo 'byed chog pa'i bka' grol bar brten nas/ 'du khang chung ba zhig rgya bskyed/ sde dge nas bka' bstan 'gyur dang rje'i gsung 'bum/ sku 'bum nas rje yab sras kyi gsung 'bum dang a kya yongs 'dzin sogs kyi gsung 'bum/ bla brang nas mtshan nyid skor sogs sku gsung thugs rten blus pa dang / dbyar dgag sogs gzhi gsum gyi nyams len/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ kun rig sman bla/ thugs rje chen po sogs kyi sgrub mchod sngar yod rnams dang / mtshan nyid chos thog gang yod nyams pa rnams rim gyis sor chud byed rgyu grwa tshang gnyis kyi 'grig lam gang cha nas sngar yod dran gso zhig byed pa'i 'go brtsams/ rab rgyal chu pho khyi (1982)lo'i hor zla dgu ba'i tshes bdun la/ kun gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng bcu ba chen po gdan drangs te chos kyi khri la zhabs sor bkod/ skyabs 'gro lha brgya ma/ lam mchog sgo 'byed byin rlabs spungs zhus ma/ khong gi 7 561

zhabs brtan gsol 'debs/ rigs gsum mgon po/ rdzi lha rnam gsum/ rta mgrin sogs kyi bsnyen pa/ sirnyi bcas dang /sham bha la'i smon lam/ sangs rgyas bstan 'bar ma/ dge ldan bstan 'bar ma sogs kyi ljags lung / gsungo ba shad bslab bya zhal 'phros/ phyag dbang phyag mdud bcas stsal/ rab rgyal shing pho byi (1984) lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum nas a khu dar rgyas dbyangs dpon du blangs te dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub mchod thog mar btsugs/ tshogs chen 'du khang zhig gso byas te/ dzam dkar gter dang 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/dung dkar cha ma dar tshon gyis brgyan pa/ zangs kyi ral gri bcu gsum/ rgya khab brgya phrag du ma/ bang mdzod kyi rdzas dang becas shes rab 'phel ba'i cha rkyen mang bo gter du sbas/ lo de'i hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin bdag 'di gar slebs te/ tshes nyi shu'i nyin bstan pa'i sgron me'i skyabs khrid kyi steng nas skyabs khrid dang skyabs 'gro'i lung / nyer gcig la gung thang blo gros tshang gi sdom gsum bslab bya'i steng nas dge tshul slong gi sdom pa'am so thar sdom pa'i khrid dang / bstan pa'i sgron me'i tshe gcig nyams len gyi sdom gsum bsngo ba grangs las — sdom ba phyi chim gnyis kyi khrid dang / 'chad nyan g.yang 'bod lung 56lha

bcas nyin tha/nyis la bton/ )ra gsum la lam mchog sgo 'byed bla mchog dang 'grel ba'i bshad lung / bstod pa don ldan ma'i lung bcas bton/ nyer bzhi la dpal rdodhe rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang gi sta gon dang sman thung gi lung / nyar lnga la rdo rje 'jigs byed bcu gsum dbang / nyer drug la dpa' cig gi dbang dang dpa 'a cig gi lung / byang chub lam sgron/ kun mkhyinasabazhi ba'i gsung gi 'khor chen mngon rtogs/ rnamadzha'ajoms gzungs ring /gcod pa bsdus pa sogs kyi lung / nyer bdun la phyag rdor 'khor chen dbang / nyer brgyad la skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang / 'jiges med dbang bos mdzad pa'i rta mchog rol ba'i dgongs rgyan/ thu'u bkwan pa'i rta mchog rol ba'i zhal lung bcas kyi lung / nyer dgu la mi bcu bzhir dge tshul gyi sdom pa phog gnam gang la sgrol ma dkar ljang gnyis kyi rjege gnang / sgrol ma legs bris ma snyogs dang sgrol dkar bstod pa bcas kyi lung / hor zla bcu ba'i dzes gcig la rigs gsum spyi sgru ba kyi rjes gnang / dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang lung /she ra phyin gyi stong nyid le'u dang / ting nge 'dzin rgyal bo'i dzig don/ tshul khrims bsrung ba'i smon tshig rnam rgyal ma'i gzubar+sā ring bcas kyi lung / tre— tshes gnyis cil 'jam dbyangs dkar bo — 56rgya

dang dbyangs can ma dkar mo gnyise kyi rjes gnang / bstod pa don zab ma/ rje'i gsung gi 'jam dbyangs bstod sprin rgya mtsho dang / dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa/ kun mkhyen bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'jam debyangs dkar bo'i sgrub thabs/ bstagaba'i sgron me'i 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i sgrub thabs/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ rgyal mkhan gyi rjes bsam lhun/'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo/ so thar mdo bcas pa'i lung / tshes bzhi la gsung ba'i 'jigs byed dang chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rjes gnang bzhi/ tshes lnga la mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang / drag po gsum sgril gyi rjes gnang / bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung gi drag po gsum sgril gyi sgrub thabs kyi lung / gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud dang smon lam/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi le'u dang bo dang le'u rjes ma gnyis/ bzang spyod pacas kyi lung /tshes drug la gnas brtan bcu drug gi rjes gnang dang / rgyan 'jug gnyis/ bdag gi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs don gnyis lhun 'grub ma dang bdag gi rjes 'dzin smon tshig dbyar skyes rnga gsang gnyis bdag gis sbyar ba/ shes bya'i rnam grangs blo gsal rigs sgo las dge ba bcu'i sems byung bag yod kyi mtshan nyid bar gyi lung bton/ 1984lo'i zla drug pa'i tshespolo4

bcu gcig nyin gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug/ gdan drangs nas tshe dpag med lha gcig bum gcig gi dbang dang phyag dbang stsa la/ a mchog rin po che dang kiti rin po che sogs snga gzhug tu phebs/ zla drug pa'i tshes nyer gsum la bdag slar slebs nas/ grwa ba bcu drug la bsten rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog mjug tu kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bos mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i sgrub thabs dang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang / sgrol dkar tshe sgrub rnams kyi lung bcas bton/ rab rgyal me stag lo'i zla brgyad pa'i nang bdag slar yang dgon pa 'dir slebs/ tshes bcu'i nyin bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i dbang dang / byin rlabs spungs zhus kyi khrid bton/ bcu gcig la dus 'khor spyi bka'i dbang dang 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi lung / bcu gnyis la gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang / bcu gsum la kun rig gi dbang dang / drag po gsum sgril gyi rjes gnang / ri khrod pa mdzod dge bsnyan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i rgyal yum sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs bum mchog dang bcas pa'i lung / tshes bcu bzhi la dpal mo'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang / thugs rje chen po rtsophyag bzhi ba'i rjes gnang / tshe mdo'i lhang / rnam rgyal ma'i lke 565

gzungs ring / gtsug tor dri med gzungs sogs kyi lung /tshes bci lnga la mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dbang dang / seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i rjes gnang bton/ 'di'i skabs su yang dge tshul slong du ma zhig bsgrubs/ rab gnas me yos lo'i dbyar thog rgyud pa'i bla ma dbu mdzad sogs bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du mngags te rgyud stod phyag bzhes rab gnas chen mor zhib bslab byas te/ drug pa'i tshes bzhi nas drug bar nyin gsum la dngos gzhi'i chos thog gi phyag len gtan tshugs byas/mtshan nyid chos thog las zla chos kyi tshab tu nyin bdun gyi dngos gzhi dang nyin lnga'i skyor sbyang byed rgyu dang / bar chos shig la dngos gzhi nyin lnga dang skyor sbyang nyin gsum la byed rgyu gtan la phab ste 'tshogs/ sa 'brug lo dus 'khor sgrub mchod sa chog rdul tshon dang bcas kha tshang byas/ sa sbrul lo'i zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu gcig la slar yang bdag chos sde'adir slebs nas tshes bco lnga la gso sbyong gi mdo bton/ tshes bcu drug nas bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung gi bde lam snying bo tshigs bcad ma'i khrid nyin lnga'i ring la bton/ nyer gcig narme bstan pa'i sgron me'i tshe gcig nyams len gyi khred nyin gsum la bton/ nyer lnga la dge slong sum cu dang dge tshul bcu bdun la sdom pa phog nyar bdun la 566

kun rig dbang / nyir brgyad la 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang / nyer dgu la rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa lha dgu'i dbang / zla ba drug pa'i tshes gcig la rnam 'joms ser mo lo gyon ma ljang sngon/ rig byed ma spyi sgrug seng ldeng gtso 'khor gsum sogs kyi rjes gnang / tshes gnyis la bde mchog lnga i ba lha re gnyis kyi dbang / mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang /tshes gsum la chos rgyal mthing nag lha mo dmag zor ma/ rnam sras ser chen rnams kyi rjes gnang / bdun la gzhi gsum cho ga'i bshad lung / brgyad la theg ts+tshan gso sbyong / sman bla bde gshegs bdun dang / zha nga blon rdo rje bdud 'dul gnyis kyi rjes gnang / tshes dgu la gzhi gsum cho ga'i mjug rdzogs/tshes bcu gcig nas nyin gsum ring la sngags kyi sa lam gyi khrid dang / a lags bla go rdo rje 'chang gi gsung lhag lha dang dbyer med pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lung bton/ de dag gi tshe nyin bcu bzhi'i ring la bsdus grwa'i dpe khrid dang dam bca' rgyun ring tshugs te 'chad nyan la phan pa ci thogs byas so/ /lo de'i zla bdun pa'i nyer gnyis la gung thang bstan pa'i dbang phyug gdan drangs te/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ byin rlabs spungs zhus/dpal ldan yon tshogs ma/ lha dang mi bcas ma/ yon tan 567

dkyil 'khor ma/ sangs rgyas bstan 'bar ma/ dge ldanamabastan 'bar ma sogs kyi lung dang phyag dbang gnang / chos grwar gzigs zhib gnang ste phyag nas thor /si khron zhing chen gyis sgor khri sum cu byin te zhing chen gyis srung skyob byed pa'i dgon pa rnams kyi gras yin zhes gong rim nas kyang brtse gzigs gnang bzhin yin/ 'di yan gyi dgen pa'i gdan rabs rags rim zhig bris pa 'di ni/ de ltar stag tsha bkra shis chos bzang gling 'di/ stag tsha rin po che sku phreng drug pa bskal bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs la brten nas/ dar zhing rgyas pa'i skabs la gnas pa yin te/ dge 'dun pa rnams kyang rgyu nor gyi spros pa la mi dgyes shing tshul khrims rnam par das/ pa'i gzhi bzung nas 'dod chung chog shes kyi grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i lugs kyis gzhung bka' pod lnga'i 'chad nyan dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i sgrub mchod nyams len sogs la 'bad bzhin yod la/ grong chog dang khyim pa mgo skor sogs kyis rgyu nor bsdu thabs la thugs mi dgyes shing / deng dus kyi dgon sde 'ga' zhig ltar chos kyi dga' ston sogs la skams lug gi srog gcod pa gtan spangs gnang ba dang / grwa ba du mas sha khrag mi gsol/ de'i stabs 568

kyis tshogs—thug la'ang dkar thug las/ sha thug sputan spangs mdzad/ dad ldan sbyin bdag rnams la ri ma gro dang gshin dge byed pa'ang gzhung nas tshags btsugs te 'gro ba las rang 'dod kyis 'gro mkhan med/ bka' gdams gsar rnying gi rnam thar bzang bo phyi gtsang nang gtsang pad ma'i spubs lta bur gnas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ nye ring gi dad ldan rnams kyang dad pas yid drangs te/ mchod sbyin dang bsnyen bkur bar mi 'chad par 'byung bzhin yod pa dang / rten bzhengs kyi skor yang / tshogs chen 'du khang / rgyud pa'i 'du khang / dus 'khor 'du khang nang rten dang bcas phun sum tshogs pa bzhengs pa dang bzheng bzhin yod pa dang / gzhan yang rje'i lha khang / mgon khang /bse khrab brtsan khang / mchod rten gsum/ ma ṇi 'khor lo 'khor khang bcas gong nas gong du 'phel bzhin yod pa dag phyi nang mtshungs pa dngos gtsang zhing gra dag pa mngon gyur du yod pa 'di bzhin lags/ rab rgyal shing pho byi ba'i (1984)lor ngag stobs kyis blo bzang don 'grub brgyud bdag lacidagon 'dir yong nas 'chad spel re byed dgos tshul yang yang lab pa dang / dbyar thog bzhag ldom slob grwa'i nang rang skyong khul gyi dus thengs sbyong brdar 569

'dzin grwa bzhi ba btsugs skabs/ stag tsha rin po ches a khu ngag lo'i lag tu kha dar bcas bskur nas dgon 'dir yong dgos tshul gsungs pa dang / de rjes sman pa ngag stobs dang / dge slong skal kho gnyis slebs nas dgon 'dir yong dgos tshul/yun mi thung tsam la 'dug dgos tshul sogs nan cher brjod stabs/ lo de'i hor zla dgu bar bdag chos sde 'dir yong nas lung khrid dang dbang rjes gnang ci rigs 'don khul byas pa gong du smos pa ltar la/ bdag gis dge tshul bcu bzhi bsgrubs pa'i nang gi bcu tshogs zhugs byas pas dge 'dun brgya phrag longs pa byung / rab rgyal shing glang (1985) lo'i zla drug pa'i nyer gsum la bad ga yang 'di gar slebs nas grwa ba lnga la dge tshul dang bcu gcig la bsnyen rdzogs kyi bslab pa byin pa sogs chos bka' ci rigs bton/rab rgyal me stag lo'i hor zla brgyad par yang bdag dgon 'dir slebs te chos bka' ci rigs dang / dge tshul gnyis dang bsnyen rdzogs dgu bsgrubs/ sa sbrul (1989) lo'i hor zla lnga bar bdag 'dir yong nas gong smos ltar chos bka' du ma dang / dge slong sum cu dang dge tshul bcu bdun bsgrubs/lo de'i hor zla dgu bar bdag bla brang nas dgon sde 'dir 57 0

slebs te/ grwa tshang la klu dbang rgyal bo dang / dzam dkar lha lnga'i rjes gnang dang / thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung gi drag po gsum 'brel gyi cho ga sbyin sreg bcas pa'i lung bton/ nyung bsdus shig la gong lnga gza' gdong dang / be+eg tse'i srog gtad bcas bton pa dang / 'ga' zhig la lung kha shas bcas bton/dge tshul gsum bsgrubs/ da lta grwa grangs brgya dang drug cur 'phel to/ /smras pa/ sa lam rtogs pa'i yongs 'du rab rgyas pas/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu g.yur du za ba yis/ /las nyon gdung ba'i bkres skom sel mdzad pa/ /byang chub bar du spyi bo'i rgyan du 'dzin/ /de yi 'phrin las 'od snang 'bum shar bas/ /'gro ba'i rmongs mun yongs su sel ba'i thabs/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i chos sde rab rgyas par/ /lha dang bcas pas bstod bsngags rol mo 'khrol/ /blo dman byis pa'i 'dam gyis gos pa dang / /ma rtogs log par smras dang go rim 'chol/ /tshig sbyor nyams pa'i skyon sogs gang mchis pa/ /mkhyen ldan tshogs kyi spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags/ /'di yi byung ba lha yi rnga bo che/ /yongs su brdung ba'i dge tshogs ci mchis pa/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum dge tshogs mtha' dag dang / /chabs cig byang chub chen 571

po'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes stag tsha bkra shis chospobazang gling gi gdan rabs don ldan lha'i rol mo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dge slong skal kho sogs kyis sa bon gtad de nan tan gyis lha dar sogs dngos skyes du ma bcas snga phyir bskul ba ltar/ bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros sa'abod pas/ rab —rgyal shing byi(1984)lor bcos bsgyur sngon yan chod bris shidzo/ de phyin chad rab gnas sa sbrul lo'i hor bla bcu ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dgalab dang bo'i nyin mjug rdzo/ka par was pa'o/ / 57lha —

rgyal dge dgon gyi byang rim gser sna / ri pa gyir+sā rda bo che zhes bya ba bzhugs so //oṃ susti/ (—/bshad sgrub chos kyi 'od snang 'bum phrag gis/ /'gro ba'i rmongs mun sel ba'i dpal yon can/ /bka' drin byang chub bar du gzhal dka' ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma 'bral med spyi bor bzhugs/ /blo bzang chos kyi bshad sgrub mdzad bzang gis/ /thub bstan sprang rtsi'i rgyal mdz+wan rgyas mdzad pa/ /gang de'i 'phrin las sa chen yongs la khyab/ /bka' drin dran pas snying nas phyag bgyid do/ /de yi skye phreng nor bu'i phreng ba 'bum/ /'phrin las 'od chen 'bum phrag rab spros las/ /skye 'gro'i gdung ba smag chen rab bsal te/ /brdu skyid chu skyes dga' tshal rgyas par mdzad/ /dngos slob yang slob dka' chen skar tshogs kyis/ /gangs ljongs rmongs chen rab tu bsdo/la byas — 573

nas/ /'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang du ma yis/ /'gro ba yongs su skyob pa'i mdzad 'phrin bsngags/ /rwa chen rdo rje grags pa'i man ngag gis/ /ngan rong nyon mongs dug chen rab bcom ste/ /dasdu chos bdud rtsis 'gro ba smin mdzad pa'i/ /grags pa rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab la 'dud/ /de yi 'phrin las nor 'dzin la chags pa'i/ /'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dpal las legs 'khrungs pa'i/ /tshul ldan pad+mo'i dga' tshal chos sde yi/ /khrims ldan ngang mo'i tshogs rnams rnam par rgyal/ /de nyid 'dzin skyong spel ba'i skyes bu mchog /rim par byon pa'i bka' drin gzhal las 'das/ /dam chos tshul bzhin skyong ba'i srung ma sogs/ /dgon sde skyong mdzad rnams la yongs su 'dud/ /mdo smad nor 'dzin lto bar yongs smin pa'i/ /rnam rgyal bshad sgrub la gzhol dge 'dun tshogs/ /'dus pa'i dgon sde de yi byung ba zhig /rnga la dbyug gis skul bzhin cung zad brjod/ /de yang rkyang tsha'i rgyal dge dgon pa bkra shis rab brtan —gling gi byung ba brjod pa la/ sde 'di chags pa'i yul ni bod chen po la chol kha gsum byas pa'i dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ mdo smad rta'i chol kha gsum yod pa'i mdo smad la rma klung dal gyis 'bab pa'iridabang gis byang rgyud d+ngha 574 ri —mo

stori sdoje sto rgyud gnyis yod pa'i lho rgyud la yang kha gya tsho drug gi sde ba bla brang bkra shis 'khyil dang / de'i lho phyogs kyi 'bo ra dang a mchog sogs rong chen rnams dang / co ne dang the bo'i rong chen sogs yod pa las dgon sde 'di ni the bo'i rkyang tsha'i yul du chags yod la/ spyir the bo'i mi rgyud ni mdo smad kyi yul gru gzhan dang 'dra bar yul dbus nas chad pa yin te/ mdo smad chos 'byung deb ther rgya mtsho las/ mdo smad lho byang gi mi phal cher bod chos rgyal gyis rgya bod so mtshams su bzhag pa las mched pa sha stag yin pas skad rigs la'ung brda rnying ma 'gyur ba mang zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon rgya'i rgyal bo thang gi dus su/ sa 'di rgyas bzung stabs/ rnga ba sogs su rgya mkhar mang bo yod mod/srong btsan gyi dus bod dmag khri mang bo btang ste/ rgya cham la phab/ 'di phyogs kyi rgya'i kru'u mang bo bcom nas/ rkyang tsha'i chu rgyud dang / chu dkar rgyud/ chu nag rgyud/ tsha chu'i rgyud sogs su bod dmag rnams banag ste/ sa mtshams srung du bcug pa'i mi rgyud ni sa de dag gi bod rnams yin la/ the bo'i sa 'di yang de'i skabs nas bod kyis bzung ba dang / slar yang khri srong gi dus su ngan lam ta ra klu gong dmag dpon du bskos te dmag btang / bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa bcom/ rgyal bo dharma pā la dang /rī — 575

g.yu'i thub pa rang byon/ bse 'bag smug chung sogs rdzas dang yo byad thamasabyucad khyer/ de'i skabartswadamag nang nas skyen po btus pa'i dpa' lhami dgu dmag dade bcas pa sa mtshams rtsa —bzhag ste rgyal bo 'i bka' yolog bar du yar yong mi chog pa'i bka' phab/ de'i stabs kyis de dag gi mi rgyud la ka ma log tu grags shing / dengasgesang gi dpal ris dang / sos nan sogs mdo smad byang phyogs kyi bod rigs phal cher de las mche da pa red/ the bo'i sa 'dir yang khri srorogi dus su so mtshams srung ba'i dmag bzhag pa gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar las gsungs/ mdo smad chos 'byung las/ de yang khri ral ba can gyis tsong khar dmag gi gzi byin bskyed pa'i dar bo che phyar/dmag rtsis dang go bsher mdzad dus dar ba zer bas g.yag po gnyis mchan khung du bcug ste sa la ma reg par khyer bas/ cen dar ba g.yag khur zhes ming thogs pa dang / dmag sde thams cad las de bud pas/ de bud du thogs/ rgya bod kyi sa mtshams gnon pa'i dmag daspun du bskos/ theb jus brag dkar gnyan gyi pho brang la btsan mkhar brtsigs te/ mdo smad kyi mi dpon byas/ zhes gsungs pa dang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar las/ de phud g.yag khur du grags pa rgya'i kha 576

gnon du bzhag ste theb ju brag dkar gnyan gyi pho brang du mkhar bzung nas bsdad pa'i lho phyogs the bo stod smad gnyis su grags pa las/ the bo stod ma zhes pa ri brag gi sa char gnas shing /dpa' rtsal ngom pa'i dud tshang khri phrag brgal ba'i yul gru de las 'breng ba zhes pa chad/ ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas the bo'i mi dag gi 'byung khungs de 'dra yin la/ the bo zhes pa'i ming thogs tshul ji 'dra yin zhes 'dri na/ de ni 'di ltar thogs pa yin te/ sngar bshad pa ltar/ dar ba g.yag khur ni/ dmag sde thams cad las de bud pas/ de'i ming la de bud dam de phud du thogs/ de'i dmag sde chen po de'i ming la'ang de phud du grags/ de dus dang da lta'ang de phyogs kyi gdangs la de dang the gnyis sgra shin tu nye ba'i stabs kyis/ phyis su brda 'gyur nas the bo zhes 'bod cing bris pa red/ dgon sde 'di the bo'i rkyang tsha'i sde'i gong du gnas/ mdzod dge'i 'brog ru bzhag ldom dang nye ba'i sa mtshams su rkyangadzitsha'i chu rgyud de/ 'brug dkar gtsang bo zhes pa'i chu rgyud du chags yod la/ 'di 'debs pa bo ni rwa rong chos grags rgya mtsho zhes grags pa kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rnam thar las yul gangs can gyi snyan ngag mkhan ngag dbang chos grags dkon mchog grub pa'i sde zhes bsngags pa'i 577

mkhas chen de nyid yin la/ rwa rong dpon slob ngag dbang chos grags dkon mchog grub pa'i sde ni 'khrungs sa sog sngon/ dgung snying sa yos/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ mkhas pa mi nyag rdo rje bzang bo/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/ rjo ngag dbang chos grags/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dge ligs dpal bzang rnams bsten nas gsan bsam mdzad/ dbyangs can mas rjes su bzung bas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes/ yang 'di ba mnga' ris ra grong bya bar 'khrungs/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan la zhus te mdzod dge'i bla mar sa/nang / de dus gangs ti se dang / ma pham g.yu mtsho sogs su sgom la bzhu gas/ mkhas grub nyis 'dzoms kyi skyes chen dam pa de nyid jo rngo gangs dkar du sku mtshams la bzhugs skabs shig tu paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i zhal las/ khyed mdo smad du song la bstan pa spel cig gsungs pa bzhin mdo smad du phebs/ lam skabs gnas tshang zhig tu bzhugs yod pa'i skabs lha mo zhig gis rmi lam du zhal bstan te/ khyod kyi dgon sa ni 'bring rgyas zer ba na yod/ brag dmar bo mgo spang gis bkab pa zhig yin zhes lung bstan/ mar phebs skabs 'bos kyi 'brong khas brgyud de bzhag ldom du phebs te/ phyugs rdzi zhig la 578

'bring rgyas zer ba'i sa de gang na yod ces dris pas bzhag ldom gyi 'bring rgyas la kha bstan te 'di red ces lan btab/ khong gis 'ur rdo 'phen byed cig gi nang du ka pā la bzhag nas 'phangs pas gad song cha med du gyur/ phyis su lha mo nyin gyi dgon pa btab nas byams khang bzhengs skabs/ ka pū la de nas rnyed pa red zer/ lha mo nyin gyi sa de la sngon dus 'bring rgyas zer bas/ sa ngo ma de yin rgyu red zer srol yod/ de nas bzhag ldom gyi 'bring rgyas kyi sa der dgon pa btab ste/ dgon pa'i mtshan la bsam grub rab brtan gling zhes gsol/ tsā grwa ba nyis stong lhag 'dus kyang yun ring ma gnas par thor 'thor rkyen 'brog pa'i grwa ba zhig dang sog po'i grwa ba gnyis 'dzing res shor te/ sog po grwa ba de bsad pas sog dmag la skrag nas thor ba red ces zer srol yod 'dug de nas rwa rong chos grags rgya mtsho'am ngag dbang chos grags dkon mchog grub pa'i sde zhes bya bas rgyal dge dgon bkra shis rab brtan gling zhes bya ba'i 'os sde 'di rab byung bcu ba'i lo rabs bzhi bcu ba yas mas su btab/ khong dgung lo zhe gnyis pa lcags sprel (1620)lor mdzod dge'i yul chos grwa chen po bkra shis rab brtan gyi gtsus/ lag khang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i gzim khang du rtogs brjod thub 579

bstan rin rdzoche'i mdzes rgyan snyan ngag me tog chun po mdzad ces pa rgyal dge dgon gyi gtsug lag khang yin/ mdzod dge dbon sangs rgyas bzang khu dbon gyis bla mar bkur/ rdzodage khung nyal ma dang shes rab seng ge sogs slob ma 'dul 'dzin kha shas byung / dran ba dge gsar gyi bla ma snyarma kirti yang 'di ba yin/ dam pa de nyid kyis bla mar bsten na rung ngayosnyam du dgongs pa na 'od dpag med dge slong sgotshul bzung ba dang mjal ba'i mtshan lam byung / han stag lung nang sos gdan drangs te 'bum gling sogs subyon/ co ne dgon chen gyi khri lo gsum mdzad/ khri chos gnyer grags pa/ gnas brtan byang chub bzang bo sogs slob ma mkhas pa du ma thon/ de dus stong skor yon tan rgya mtsho co ner byon/ khong gis rje 'di'i drung nas bde gsang / 'khor chen/ kyai rdor/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug sogs kyi dbang / rjes gnang dang lung mang bo gsan/gsung rtsom yang gong du bshad pa'i rje'i bstod pa dang / rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dngos grub sprin bzang / rten 'brel bstod ṭīka bde mchog smon ṭīka rab dkar dge tshogs ma'i bsdus don sogs snang / gsung rtsom 'ga' re rgyal khang rtse ba sogs dbus kyi mkhas pa mang bos gzigs/ pas bsngags 580

brjod mdzad/ sku gshegs pa'i gdung stong skor sprul pa'i skus zhugs 'bul gnang / gdung la dung dkar gsum thugs ljags spyan gsum/ ring bsrel mang du byon/ de nyid kyi sprul sku kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i dngos slob mdzod dge sku skye mdzod dge spyi nas blus/ yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa tshad du things/ bkra shis 'khyil du kun mkhyen mchog gi zhabs la gtugs te mi tra sogs gsan/ ba lung phur dgon pa btab pa yun ring ma gnas/ de'i rjes rgyal dge dgon gsham du bkra shis rab brtan gling btab/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rnam thar las/ yul gangs can gyi snyan ngag mkhan ngag dbang chos grags dkon mchog grub pa'i sde'i yang srid du grags 7pa do rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor ba chen po mdzod dge sku skyes shangs len dang bsnyen bkur gzab par zhus/ zhes gsungs/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa chen po dgung lo don gcig pa sa pho khyi'i lo the bo'i chab tshan du phebs skabs mdzod dge sku skyes bkra shis rab brtan du gdan drangs nas 'bul ba dang zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs te chos bka' ci rigs zhus pa dang / spo tshang chos mdzad/ bra bo sman rgan rnams kyis 'phen skyes tshangs pa'i ludz+wa bstan ltar steng thog gi bkra shis rab 581

ribartan gling dang / gsham gyi dgon gsar gnyis gcig byas na 'grig min zhus pas/ kun mkhyen mchog gis tshangs pa'i lung bstan ltar byed gsungs/ tshangs pa'i lung bstan ni/ phu lung/ sum mdo yi man chod na/ /dus tha mar bong lu'i rna ba tsam/ /ri mchod rten 'dra ba'i bang rim na/ /rgyan phra mo'i ba dan brtsigs na brtan/ /zhes pa ltar/ dgon gas/ra rnying gnyis gcig tu bsres/ rgyal dge sprul sku zer ba mdzod dge khri ba zhig gi sku skye byas nas blus kyang da lta skye rgyud med/ rten gtso thub pa tshul khrims ma/ kye rdor lha dgu bum sku ma/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma rgya li/ dung gi thugs rje chen po/ g.yu'i 'jigs byed/ byi ru'i tshe dpag med/ sgrol dkar dngul sku/bra bo sman rgan gyis bzhengs pa'i phyag rdor stong rang byon du phebs pa/ rnyo khyim gyi bde mchog paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi phyag dpe brgyad stong pa sogs phal cher bkra shis lhun po nas spyan drangs shing rwa rong ba'i thugs dam rten kyang mang / gnas bcu khang du spo tshang mgon por grags pa'i mgon po phyag bzhi ba/ paṇa chen chos rgyan gyi shangs khrag gis bzhengs pa'i rje yab sras gsum/chos rgyal dang bcas pa'i zhal thang / stong skor gong ma'i dbu zhwa sogs dang / thong dgon pa'ang 'di dang bsres pas bka' 582

'gyur co par sogs rten rnams kyang 'dir bzhugs/ 'du khang du sgo tshang chos mdzad kyis bzhengs pa'i bka' bstan dnguladzā bris/ rnam rgyal mchod rten byin can/ mdzod dge lha khang du gser gyi bka' 'gyur sogs rten gsum 'gangs can mang /beg tse chos skyong la btsan khang yang yod/ ces mdo smad chosa'abyung deb ther rgya mtsho las gsungs/spyir dgon pa 'di gnas yul rkyang tsha yin la/ rkyang tsha ni the bo'i mi rgyud yin mod/ phyis su mdzod dge'i khongs su gtogs te/ mdzod dge la 'brog shog kha brgyad dang / rong shog kha bzhi ste shog bcu gnyis byas/ rong shog kha bzhi ni/ rkyang tsha/'breng ba/ gza' ru/ tshong ru bzhi yin stabs de bzhi the bo yin kyang / mdzod dger brtsi bar byed pa'i phyir/ rgyal dge'i dgon 'di'ang mdzod dger brtsi zhing / mdzod dge'i dgon pa thams cad kyi snga shos dang ma dgon du brtsi zhing / dgon pa 'di'i khri ba bkra shis lhun po nas btang ba rnams la'ang mdzod dge'i khri ba zer/de nas dgon sde 'di ni bkra shis lhun po nas khri ba rim mngags kyis bskyangs pa yin te/ gdan rabs dang bo dgon pa 'debs pa bo rwa rong chos grags rgya mtsho'am ngag dbang chos tsu83

'id+dhag grags dkon mchog grub pa'i sde yin la/ de'i 'phror go rim ji rnya bzhin mi shes mod/ sku mdun pa sangs rgyas bzang bo mnga' ris pa legs pa rgyal mtshan/ khri mdangs can pa blo bzang don grub/ har gdong ba dka' chen ye shes dpal 'byor ni tshul khrims dag pa nyams len gyi mthil du bzung nas thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral ba byas pa'i mkhas zhig yin zhing / paṇakyachen thams cad mkhyen pas mdzod dge'i khri b.ralamangags te/rgyal dge dgon 'dzin skyong gnang nas bzhugs/ skabs shig 'brog phyogs kyi gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi zhing du dmigs nas 'brog phyogs su phebs te khang gsar nyin gyi dgon pa btab/ de phyin chad rgyal dge dgon 'di dang / 'brog gi khang gsar dgon gnyis bkra shis lhun po nas mngags pa'i mdzod dge'i khri ba rim byon gyis bdag gir mdzad/ tshogs bsags pa blo bzang dpal ldan/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi rnam thar las/mdzod dge'i khri ba pa she ba tshogs bsags pa blo bzang dpal ldan gyis tshogs dbur spyan drangs te zhabs brtan phul/ zhes gsungs pa 'di ba yin 'dra/ 'di ba dang dka' chen brag nag pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin 'di bas 'cham yang btsugs/ dka' chen ye shes dpal ldan 'di dag gi ring la smon lam chen mo dang 584

lnga mchod gsar 'dzugs mdzad zer/ tshogs bsags pa blo bzang sbyin pa/ gnas brtan ba ku la'i sprul ba dka' chen bsod nams stobs rgyas/ gzhan yang nom chi chos rje dka' chen bstan 'dzin chos grags 'di bas 'khor lo bde mchog gi cho ga cha lag tshang ba lnga mchod chen mor bdunatshochos su btsugs te spyi rdzas sogs bzhag khri ba bla ma mer gan mkhan po/ nom chi mer gan mkhan po dka' chen brtson 'grus sogs rim par byon pa dang /deng sang dka' blo bzang sbyin pa lags 'tsho zhing bzhugs tso pas 'grig lam do dam sogs thugs khur gnang bzhin yod/'di'i bar khri rabs sum cu yas mas shig song 'dug zer/paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyis thugs khur che bzhes kyis chos sde —'di la bka' shog rim par gnang ba ni/ thog mar bsam 'grub rab brtan gling gi skabs paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis gnang ba'i bka' shog thel can gyi nang bris 'di ltar/ paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi sku ring nas bzung ste mdzod dge'i shog bcu gnyis dang yon mchod du gyur nas ngag dbang chos grags rgya mtsho bla mar mngags te bsam 'grub rab brtan gling gi dgon pa btab/ grwa ba stong phrag tsam tshogs pa la dpon blo gros bzang bos mchod 'bul bsnyen bkur rgya cher mdzad pa d+ngha585

dang / mdzod dge'i sa mtshams/ zung chu'i shar kha thur chad/ lge mo chu'i sa sngon yan chad/ slang ma'i rdo skas tshun chad/ mi thang ho sga yan chad/ spang ri gser sga tshun chad yin pas/ de dag gi rtswa chu shing sogs la grwa slob tshang mas longs spyad pa'i bdag rkyen gyi gnang ba byin pa'i yi ge sa stag lo'i zla gsum pa'i tshes dge ba'i nyin bris pa lags/ 'dir thel tshe brgyab 'dug yang bka' shog gcig la/ deng yang sku 'tsho'i 'dab brgya brtas shing / chos spyod 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pa'i ge sar rgod bzhin par yod pa ni yid spro/ ngos kyang 'du ba snyoms shing /'gro phan gyi lhag bsam dge bar mchis/ nye lam khri ba bla ma mer gan mkhan po ngo g.yog ched rdzong song bar yul babs kyi phan cha rogs ram gang zab yod pa dang / 'di nas kyang thun mong gi gegs rber zhi zhing mthun rkyen 'grub pa sogs kyi dge sbyor skyabs 'jug bgyid pa thugs 'jags nas/ slad mar/gsung 'os kyang 'tshal/ rten sngags mdud bcu/ ngos kyi lag bstar ma'i bane' gdams lha bzhi'i snang brnyan/ dam rdzas le tshan bcas tshes dge ba la/ thel rtags/ yang bka' shog cig la/ yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi khyon la spyod pa'i skye 'gro spyi dang /bye brag tu mdo khams/ mtsho kha sogs kyi sa'i char 'khod pa'i bla 586

ma slob dpon/ grwa rigs/ rgyal bo rgyal phran/ ja'i sang /mi bzang bya ba zhi drag gi sne mor mngags slebs/ mdzod dge'i dpon che chung sogs ser skya mchog doman kun gyis dgongs shing mnyan par bya ba la/ mdzod dge'i dgon 'di bkra shis lhun po'i dgon lag bla ma yang 'di kha nas bsko gzhag byed pa nas/dus ja'i thebos kyi mi ser rkyang tsha tsho gsum la sgrub chag snga srol gang yin las mi 'os pa'i khral gsar 'gel rigs mi byed pa dang / rnam dkar dang 'brel ba'i 'gro 'dug ci byed kyang mthun 'gyur phan grogs su gang 'gro ma gtogs gnod 'gal du 'gro ba gtan ma byed/ smras pa don ldan bgyid pa'i dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba yin/ zhes go bar bya ba'i yi ge shing sprel lo dbo zla ba'i tshes dge ba la rgyal ba'i chos tshul ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun po'i gzim khang rgyal mtshan mthon po nas bris/ thel tshe brgyab 'dug yang bka' shog la/ deng lang tsho'i bus pa chos spyod kyi bdud rtsisartagatams bzhin par yod dam/ ngos kyang 'du ba snyoms shing / rgyal bstan 'dzin spel gyi lhag bsam dar la drag par mchis/ nye lam zhu mos bzhin bla ma dka' chen bstan 'dzin chos grags slar yang mngags rdzong song bar phu dud rim gro'i 'grog lam mi dman pa 587

nas/ slad mar dge ba'i 'phros 'os kyang 'tshal/ zhes rten sngags mdud bdun/ sherme rdzas le tshan/ dri bzang gi chun po bcu tham pa bcas/ tshes dge ba la/ thel rtags 'dug yang bka' shog cig la/ 'dzam gling nor gyi blo gros ma'i dpal dzolongs su spyod pa'i skye rgu spyodang / khyad parañtsazung 'phan/ cang lar/ tho cu/ ga cu/ zi ling / co ne/ pan yul/ mdzod dge shog bcu gnyis sogs kyi sa'i char gnas pa'i bla ma/ slob dpon/ grwa rigs/ nor 'dzin la dbang ba'i dpon che chung dmag dang el chi'i 'grim 'grul ba/ dmangs kyi skye bo ji snyed pa sogs ser skya mchog dman bar ma bcas pa mtha' dag la bsgo ba/ mdo smad rgyal dge dgon bkra shis rab brtan gling dang /khang gsar dgon bshad sgrub nor bu gling gnyis su zhugs pa'i blabyugrwa rnams nas mdo sngags 'chad nyan gyi rim pa rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i sri zhu zhabs 'degs dang / 'gro kun phan bde'i dpal du smin pa bcas yod 'dug pas dgon gnas 'di gnyis kyi bla grwa sbyin bdag dang bcas pa'i mi nor la/ khyod gong 'khod drag zhan su thad nas lugs gnyis khrims dang mimathun pa'i 'os min snyad gtser rigs ma byed par 'gro 'dug gnas lam byed 'jug pa dang / gzugs med lha 'dre'i tshogs nas kyang rnam 588

kun phan grogs yang dag bgyid pa las/ kun slong phrag dog ngan pa'i rigs skad cig kyang ma byed/ de ltar sgrub pa rnams 'di phyir dge ba'i skyabs 'jug bgyid cing / gal te 'galabar spyad na dam can rgya mtsho'i bka'i chad pas mnar ba gdon mi za bas bag yod bsten 'tshal/ zhes brda sprod pa'i yi ge sa sbrul nā tshesna dge bar chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun po'i gzim khang rgyal mtshan mthon po nas bris/ thel tshe brgyab 'dug yang bka' shog cig la/ rkyang tsha tsho gsum/ sgrub sde khag gsugasogs kyis mtshon pa'i ser skya drag zhan mtha' dag nas nges dgos/ skye rgu'i phan bde sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa de 'dzin skyes chen dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas par ltos shing / lhag par phyogs der zhwa ser gyi bstan pa dang / sbyin bdag ser skya 'khor 'bangs rnams la 'phral yun phan bde spel ba'i byed por 'di kha bkra shis lhun po nas bla ma khag rim par zhu gtong gis mchod yon dam tshig 'brel lam shin tu che ba blo mngags bcas/ des na bzhag ldom dpon gtso gyur gyi bla mar nom chi mer gan mkhan po dka' chen rnam rgyal brtson 'grus slar yang mngags skerdzong song ba 'dis mtshon phyogs der bla khag ngo g.yog byung 'byung tshang mar chos srid gnyis ka'i ngos nas sri zhu grogs dan du gang 589

'gyur las brku 'phrog gnod 'gal du 'gro rigs phra mo tsam mi 'byung ba nges par byed dgos dang / dang du len pa rnams la ngos’nas kyang 'di phyi'i 'dod don legs 'grub yong phyir mchog gsum srung mar bcas la gsol 'debs 'phrin bcol gyi skyabs 'jug rgyun mar bgyid pa yid 'jags 'tshal/ zhes chu khyi zla tshes dge ba la/ thel rtags 'dug yang bka' shog cig la/gnam bskos gong ma'i lung gis paṇa chen er te nir bsngags shing / bstan 'gror phan bde spel ba'i lhag bsam gyi snying stobs dge ba shākya'i dge slong blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma dge legs rnam rgyal dpal bzang bor 'bod pa'i gtam/ yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi khyon la spyod pa'i skye 'gro spyi dang / bye brag lan gru/ zi ling / zi khron/ mtsho sngon/ a mdo/ mdzod dge sde shog che chung / mgo log sogs kyi sa'i char 'khod pa'i bla ma/slob dpon/ grwa rigs/ lung las kyis mtho ba'i rgya bod kyi dpon rigs spyir dmigs/ khyad par khen ye lha chen sogs mdzod dge shog kha bcu gnyis kyi dpon po/ gzhan yang dmag jag el chi'i 'grim 'grul ba/ dmangs kyi skye bo ji snyed pa sogs ser skya mchog dman mtha' dag la bzlo ba/ mdzod dge ma dgon rgyal dge dgon bkra shis rab brtan /gling 'di nyid rje 590

gong ma blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bos phyag btab pa nas bzung da lta'i bar mkhan po khri ba bla ma 'di nas rim bzhin mngags rdzong bgyid mus gdan sa chen po bkra shis lhun po'i dgon lag tu gtogs par ma zad/ grwa slob rnams kyang bslab khrims gtsang zhing / rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i cho ga phyag len gyi rim pa paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' srol nyams med 'dzin cing / phyogs der bstan 'gro'i phan bde sgrub pa'i lta grub rnam dag yin 'dug gshis khyod gong 'khod drag zhan rnams nas dgon gnas rten brten par bcas pa mi nyams gong du 'phel ba'i bkur bzos bdag rkyen gang che dang / mkhan po khri ba/ grwa slob bgres bar gzhon gsum byung 'byung nas 'gro 'dug spyod lam ji ltar byed kyang phan cha mthun 'gyur gang 'gro ma gtogs/ gnod 'gal log par 'gro ba nam yang ma byed/bsgo ba bzhin dang du len pa rnams 'di nas kyang rnam kun dge ba'i skyabs 'jug bgyid pa yin/ zhes go bar bya ba'i yi ge shing byi hor n+d+ra gral tshes dge bar zhing chen lan gru'i pho brang lu hi than nas bris/ thel tshe brgyab 'dugasnga sor 'du khang gi khyams su sbyar ba'i ras gzhi'i ngor bris pa'i dgon pa'i rten yig dkar chag skor tshad dang bcas pa yod 591

pa/ dbur mchod brjod sdeb sbyor suyorkang bsgrigs pa mjug tu mjug sdud kyi tshigs bcad smon tshig nor 'dzin pa tra bcas pa/ rab 'byams smra ba dkon mchog bstan pas bris zhes pa zhig yod pa'i nang rten rnams sngar yod lo rgyus shes pa'i don du 'dir cha tshang 'god par bya ste/ 'du khang gi steng gi li ma lha khang na/ thog mar sku'i rten ni rgya gar nas phebs pa'i mnyam med thub pa'i dbang bo'i sku brnyan gser bzang las grub pa byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che ba dang / thugs rje po phyag bzhi ba gnyis tshul khrims kyi dri dang ldan pa byon shin tu legs pa dang /dus chen la bdud rtsi 'bab par grags pa'i bcu gcig zhal/paṇa gyi rna chog sprul rin po che blo bzang dpal ldan bstan —pa'i nyi ma phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi thugs dam gyi rten byams sku byin rlabs can/ dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i bum sku bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa/ rje rin po che'i sku brnyan byin can/ ṣ+pedam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku brnyan byon legs pa/ sgrol dkar gyi snang brnyan dngul las grub pa/ pad dkar 'chang phyag bzhi ba/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ 'od dpag med/ thub dbang rnams kyi sku brnyan zung re/ don yod grub pa'i sku brnyan khru tshad tsam pa/ sman bla/ tshe dpag med/ rin chen 'byung ldan/592

gtsug tor can/ bla ma shangs/ phyag na rdo rje/ sgrol ma/ mgon po phyag drug pa rnams kyi sku brnyan gser bzang las grub pa byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ a ka ru nag po las bzhengs pa'i thub pa grong khyer ma 'khor bcas/ se'u lha khang du rgyal dbang lnga ba chen mo'i pur tshwa las grub pa'i rje rin po che dang / 'dod lha sna tshogs kyi sku brnyan paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyi phyag nas ma rnams bzhugs/ thang ga'i rim pa ni/ mdzod dge sku skye'i dus su bzhengs pa'i thub pa gnas brtan bcu drug gi thang sku/ 'brom rim po che'i rnam thar/ paṇa chen bzang bo bkra shis kyi yin zer ba'i phyag zhabs kyi ri mo dang bcas pa'i dbus thang sogs bzo dbyibs legs pa bzhi bcu skor tsam bzhugs/gsung gi rten ni/ dpon blo gros bzang bo'i dus su/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtshos gnang bar grags pa'i brgyad stong pa'i glegs bam nam mkha'i kha dog la co 'dri ba'i mthing shog bzang bo'i ngos la gser btso ma rab tu sbyangs pa'i khu bas legs par bris pa glegs shing gi gdong la pa tra ris 'bur du dod pa/steng du dbyangs gsal gyi lañdzas bskor ba/ se ta hu khra slas kyi glegs thag 'dom dgu dang bcas khyad par du7'phags pa/ gser gyis bris pa'i ting 'dzin/ dngul gyis bzhengs pa'i 593

dpag bsam 'khri shing / dngul gyis bris pa'i ting 'dzin/lam rim che chung sogs glegs bam ngo mtshar ba sum cu skor bzhugs/ thugs kyi rten ni/ a ka ru dkar bo las grub pa'i mchod rten bde gshegs brgyad byin can dang bka' gdams mchod rten me'i grangs can/ 'khar gsil byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che bar grags pa rnams bzhugs so/ /mthong thos dran reg don dang ldan pa'i 'du khang chen mo 'di nyid du bzhugs pa'i rten gyi rim pa la/ thog mar sku rten ni/ 'du khang gi dbus su lha sa'i jo bo dang sku tshad mnyam pa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku brnyan bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa/ de'i mdun du 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i ldem sku byin rlabs can mi tshad tsam/g.yas phyogs su thub pa 'khor bcas la/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad dang mdun du gnas brtan bcu drug bcas mi tshad ma/gong gi 'jam mgon bla ma de la 'jam dbyangs gtsang pa bdun brgyud kyis bskor ba/ de yang gang zhe nadze/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang bo/ rje zha lu ba legs pa rgyal mtshan/ rje blo grosachos skyong / ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rje blo gros bstan pa/ rje smon lam dpal ba rnams so//gsang 'dus/ rigs gsum mgon po bcas bzhugs pa 'di 594

rnams mnga' ris pa'i sku ring la bzhengs pa lags so/ /yang mnga' ris pas bzhengs pa'i thang sku che legs mang bo dang bcas thang ga nyis brgya dang nyi shu skor bzhugs so/ /g.yon phyogs su rgyal ba byams pa la nye ba'i sras brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gsung gi rten ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de nyid kyi bka' rin po che dang / paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis bstan bcos mtha' yas pa gsungs pa rnams lo tsā ba sku drin can dag gis bod kyi skad du bsgyur ba yongs rdzogs/ bsod nams kyi stobs kyis mngon par mtho ba'i spo tshang chos mdzad kyi dus su/ nam mkha'i mdangs can gyi mthing shog bzang bo'i ngos la dngul dkar rab tu sbyangs pa'i khu bas legs par bris pa'i dbu khang dang bo rnams su bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong rnams kyi snang brnyan bzang gos sha stag gi zhal khebs/ na bza' ser bo/ glegs shing / glegs thag rnams gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i bka' 'gyur glegs bam brgya dang bzhi lhag bstan 'gyur glegs bam nyis brgya dang bcu phrag skor bcas phun sum tshogs pa thames cad kyi gzhi rten du bzhugs/ so/ /yang bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis/ gser btso ma dang dngul las bzhengs pa'i yum 'bum pa tshar gcig dang bcas/ khyon glegs 59bya

bam stong phrag brgal ba bzhugs pa ni phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas mthar thug lags so/ /thugs kyi rten ni sku mdun pa sangs rgyas bzang bo dang / mnga' ris legs pa rgyal mtshan sogs kyi sku gdung mchod rten bzhi/ rnam rgyal mchod rten chen mo mi tshad gnyis ldan pa 'di'i nang rten gyi rim pa la'ang / yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel gyi rigs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa glang bo'i gdung dang / 'khor ba 'jig dang / shākya thub pa gsum gyi ring bsrel bzhugs/ chos sku'i ring bsrel gyi rigs la/ rgyud sde kun gyi rtsa ba dang / mdo sde kun gyi za ma tog tu gyur pa/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud sogs rgyud 'bum cha tshang dang / gzungs chen sde lnga/ gtsug tor sde bzhi sogs rgyud mdo rgyud kyi gzungs rigs dpag tu med pa bzhugs/sku gdung dang sku bal gyi ring bsrel gyi rigs la/ rdo rje gdan gyi ma hā bho ti sa twa'i bzhugs khri'i shing gi tshal bu/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam bha ba'i dbu lo dang na bza'/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku ber/ slob dpon bai ro tsa na'i phyag dpe/jo bo rje'i phyag tsha'i dum bu dang snam sbyar/ gdung tsha/ mi la ras chen gyi dbu skra/ mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i ras gos/ ras chung rdo rje grags kyi gdung rus/ jo bo rje'i tshe sgrub ril bu/ bu bya96

ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i snam sbyar dang bum chu nyams medacakyi ri la bu/ rje sa paṇa gyi na bza'/ kun mkhyin chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha pa chen po'i dbu lo dang / yapa sras sogs kyi na bza'/rgyal tshab rje'i bzhugs gdan/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che sku gong ma'i na bza' dang dbu lo/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ da pal 'byor lhun grub kyi na bza'/ zha lu grub chen gyi gdung rus/ rje rin po ches dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sbyin sreg gnang ba'i thig tshon/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i dbu rgyan rtsa chen dang phyag sen/ rje gling yags pa'i dbu lo na bza' gdung rus/ paṇa chen sku gong ma'i phyag nas/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang bo'i na bza' dbu lo phyag nas/ thos bsam gling grub chen pa'i dbu skra/ rje yab sras kun gyi bsang chen kun 'dus/ stong skor rin po che'i tshe sgrub ril bu/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu/ sangs rgyas byang sems mang bo'ithu'aphel gdung gis rgyu byas pa'i rten 'dus ril bu byin can/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis rdzogs rim rnal 'byor chen po'i byang sems ril bu 'phel ma myur grol/ de nyid kyi bsang chab 'phel ma ngo mtshar can/ stod rgyud spyo tshang gi ma ṇi ril sgrub/ stong skor rin po che'i tshe sgrub ril bu 597

dang bdud rtsi chos sman/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i mi tra brgya rtsa'i chos skor gyi bdud rtsi bum chu yongs rdzogs kyi ril bu/ de nyid kyi bsang chen bsang chab ril bu/ dpon slob skal ldan rgya mtsho'i sgrub pa'i ma ṇi ril bu bdud rtsi ril bu nyams med/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i ljags chab/ sku khrus zhal zas/ bkra shis lhun po'i mgon khang chen mo'i lo gtor gyi gtor sgam/ gnas 'dir gtor sgrub kyi skabs su bdud rtsi rang babs/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjesasbyin sreg gnang ba gsum gyi rdul tshon dang thal ba/ paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag nas brgya rtsa 'dus pa/ don slad mtshan nas smos te mkhan rin po che ngag dbang dkon mchog nyi ma'i dbu zhwa dang cod pan/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i dbu zhwa dang phyag 'khar smad g.yogs bzhugs gdan/ dpon slob bsod nams grags pa'i dbu zhwa/ khri rin po che bka' 'gyur ba'i phyag phreng / sngags chen rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi thugs phreng / rig 'dzin stobs ldan dbang bo'i gdung rus/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang bo'i sku drag mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi rdo/ rgya gar gnas chen brgyad kyi sa sna/ gangs te se'i gangs thug dang sid+dha ra/ ma pham g.yu mtsho'i sgye la dang bye 59byi

ma/ rgya gar nag gi gnas chen thams cad kyi sa sna dang grubadzachu tshe chu sgrub mtsho rnams kyi sa sna bye ma ril bur bsgril ba/ tsa ri'i gnas chen gyi sa sna chu sna shing sna thams cad 'dres pa/ tsa ri'i sin dhu ra/ dag pa shel ri'i shel rdo/ rdo rje phag mo'i 'ja' rdo/mtsho macadros pa'i bye ma lnga ldan/ rgyal ba blo bzang don grub kyi sgrub phug gi sa sna/ byang sems skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i blo gros bzang bo'i sku chos/ dam can chos rgyal yab yum gyi sku brnyan/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang bo'i phyag tsha ma bcas legs par bzhugs/ 'jigs byed khro bcu/ gdugs dkar/ sor 'brang / dzasnya la yab yum gyi 'khor lo tshad ldan dang / rnam sras kyi 'khor lo khyad 'phags/gzhan yange bsam 'phel nor bus gtsos pa'i 'khor lo tshad ldan mang du bzhugs/ de ltar na yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel/ chos sku'i ring bsrel/ sku gdung gi ring bsrel/ sku bal gyi ring bsrel bzhi dang bcas byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba mtha' yas pa bzhugs so/ /steng gi gnas bcu lha khang na/ sku'i rten gyi gtso bo ni sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung nang rten du bzhugs pa'i thub pa'i sku gser bzang las grub pa/ mgon po phyag bzhi ba/ sman bla/ mar me mdzad/ rje rin po che'i sku brnyan sogs 599

li ma mang bo dang / mtshungs med chos rdzi ngag dbang chos grags rgya mtsho'i lder sku nang rten nyid kyi dbu lo bubs spyag sen bubs rje yab sras kyi tshems dbu lo/ gnayobacu tsharasgeganyis dang bcas ldem sku mang bo dang / paṇa chen blo bzang dpadze+eldan ye shes kyi sku brnyan nyid kyi phyag nas ma dang / mdzod dge sku skye'i thugs dam gyi rten sgrol dkar gser thang dang / rje'i rnam thar tsong kha brgyad cu zhes grags pa'i gser thang chen mo/ lcam sring gi thang sku byi na rlabasasacan sogs zhal thang nyi shu skor dang / gsung gi rten brgyad stong pa shan sbyar godage'i par ma/ co ne bka' 'gyur tshar gcig dang bcas pustikaḥbargya dang bzhi bcu skor bzhugs/ thugs kyi rten bka' gdamayomachod rten sogs zla ba nor gyi grangs ldan bzhugs/ gshan yang paṇa blo bzang chos rgyan dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i skabs kyi zhabs chags/ stong skor yon tan rgya mtsho'i sku 'gag yu ring / khri rgyal mtshon seng ge'i dbu zhwa sogs bzhugs pa lags so/ /mgon khang du/lajigs su rung ba bzod parodaka' ba'i gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i yi dam gyi lha dang / chos skyong srung ma rnams bzhugs pa'i tshul ni/ gtso bo dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po 'khor bcas/lha chen ma hā kā la 'khor bcas/ bka' sdod las kyi gshin dze600

mab yum/ ma cig dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ mgon po zhal bzhi ba yab yum 'khor bcas/cho rgyal bo chen po rnam thos sras rta bradag brgyad dang bcas pa/ sngon sangs rgyas gser thub 'jig rten du byon pa'i dus su bstan pa bsrung bar smon lam mdzad pa'i mthus/ rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi dus su byang shar ma ru rtse'i dur khrod du rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa bzhugs pa la/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bos/ chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi sde chen po bsrung bar bka' bsgos shing gnyer du gtad pa nas bzung / skyabs mgon rin po che'i dgon che phra thams cad bu bzhin skyong pa sdig pa can gyi srog gi shan pa gnod sbyin bag tse lcam dral gri thogs brgyad shan pa nyer gcig rgyal bo sku lnga dang bcas bzhugs/ zhal thang 'di rnams rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor ba chen po mdzod dge sku skye'i dus su bzhengs/ thang lha ngag dbang dpal bzang nyid nagagadan drangs pa'i mgon po'i ldem sku byin rlabs can/ yang mgon po dang / srid gsum bdag mo gnyis kyi ldem sku/ bra bo sman rgan gyis rgyu'i sa la rta mgrin yun ring bsgrubs nas bzhengs pa'i lcam sring gi sman sku brjid bag can rnams bzhugs so/ / rī 601

dpon tshang lha khang du/ sku'i rten rje rin po che'i sku brnyan khru tshad ma/ rje rin po che'i snang brnyan byin rlabs can/ de'i nang rten gyi rim pa'ang / sku 'bum tsan dan yig drug rang byon can/ khri nam mkha' bzang gi chos gos tshal bu/ khri rgyal mtshan seng ge'i snam sbyar tshal bu/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i sku lhug paṇa chen blo bzang dpal sgrun ye shes kyi sku 'gag cha tshang /phyag phring / yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi dbu zhwa/ sems pa rin po che'i sku 'gag tshal bu/ khri rgyal mtshan seng ge'i yang sprul rin po che'i dbu lo dang phyag phyis rnams bzhugs/ gzhan yang thang sku nyi shu lhag dang / gsung gi rten bka' 'gyur tshar gcig paṇa chen blo bzang dpa9shaṃ ldan ye shes kyi gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig dang bcas khyon glegs bam brgya dang bzhi bcu skor dang / thugs kyi rten du sgo mang mchod rten dang bcas bzhugs pa lags so/ /de ltar dkar chag 'di'i nang du bzhugs pa'i rten ngo mtshar ba bzhugs pa ni/ dgon sde 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas pa'i dan rtags yin la/ sngar gyi lo rgyus shes pa'i don du mgo mjug gi tshigs bcad mdzad byang bcas dor nas rten gyi rnam grangs ji bzhin bkod pa yin la/ 'gangs che ba'i rten de rnams ni/ dus 602

'gyur bcos bsgyur dang / hre co zhes pa'i las 'gul dang /rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i god chags chen po'i skabs su gtor brlag chen po byung / da lta lhag mar lus pa/ li ma khang gi rten cha tshang / rnam rgyal mchod rten gyi nang rten cha tshang sogs rten 'gangs can kha shas dad ldan rnams kyis srog la ma 'dzems par sbas skung byas nas lus pa red/ sngar gyi 'du khang ni sde shog gis mdzod khang byas stabs phyi khog lus pa las nang rten gyang ris sogs tshang ma lhag med du bcom/ gong gi dkar chag nang du ma the ba'i rten/ mkhas grub rje'i phyag bris yin zer ba'i gdugs dkar gyi par shing dang / gnas brtan yan lag 'byung gi zhabs chags/ rwa rong chos grags pa'i gsol tog dkar yol yu ring / shar skal ldan rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa/ rwa rong chos grags kyis mtsho ral ba can nas gter las bzhes pa'i rol mo'i cha ya/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyis gnang ba'i mgon po gur thang sku bzos drub can rgya nag ma/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba chos kyi nyi mas gnang ba'i byams pa'i sku li ma 'di rnams da lta bzhugs yod/ srid jus gsar ba byung nas rab rgyal chu pho khyi'i (1982)lo snga gzhug tu chos sgo phyes pa'i skabs grwa rgan drug yod mod/ da lta gsum las med la gsar zhugs bzhi bcu lhag 603

yod/ de dag gis rgyud chos spyod 'don rta dbyangs sogs slob bcidang / yi ge rig gnas sogs la sbyangs shing / tshul khrims rnam bar dag pa srung bzhin pa'i steng 'grig lam kun sbyod 4sogs legaso bar srung sdo'i grwa tshang spus dag tu gyur yod la/ dge 'dun gamongs kyis hur brtson thog 'du khang steng 'og tu sangs rgyas stong sku gnyis rje yab sras gsum/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ gnas brtan bcu drug thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi ba sogs sku4brnyan dang / gsung rten/ bka' 'gyur tshar gnyisga bstan 'gyur tshar gnyis/ rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum tshar gcig gzhan yang lam rim sngags rim gnyis tshar du ma dang / ting 'phags bskal gsum sogs dpe cha po ti du ma sogs bzhengs 'jog byas yod/ rgyal dge sbrul sku'i sku gdung mchod rten sogs gsar bzhengs du ma yod/ bkra shis lhun po nas gdan drangs pa'i paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi 'dra sku/paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng bcu ba sku dngos phebs nas/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ skyabs 'gro ma ṇi sogs kyi lung gnang ste thuga.oṃ' gan bzhes pa'i gsung bshad mang bo gnang /'du khang sogs su phyag nas 'thor/ rjes sor pe cin nas mdzod dge khri rin po che blo bzang snyin pa'i phyag cu paṇa chen sku phreng dgu caspu4

ba'i na bza' cha tshang / zhabs chags bcar+sā bskur gnang mdzad/ de'i phyi lor yang khong gi na bza' bubs gcig sku par phyag bris can tham rtags brgyab pa bcas gnang ba dang / de rjes bkra shis lhun por shar mchod khab bkra shis rnam rgyal rab gnas skabs paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba'i sku par dang / khong gi sku par bcas gnang / gzhan yang rje btsun byams pa'i gos sku chen po zhig kyang bzhengs/ rta mgrin lha khang dang / seng gdong lha khang gnyis kyang bzhengs te/ rta mgrin lha khang du rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa lha dgu dang / 'od dpag med stong sku/ mi 'khrugs pa stong sku dang de'i nang du rgyal bo'i brtsan khang yod pa'i nang —du kirti blo bzang 'phrin las kyi shangs khrag gis bzhengs pa'i rgyalabo dpa' rtsal zhi drag gnyis kyi thang sku dang / rgyal bo'i gdung rus kyang bzhugs la sku gsob kyang legs par bzhugs/ seng gdong lha khang nang du seng gdong gtso 'khor gsum gyi 'ahrasku dang / slob dpon pad+ma'i stong sku dang / yum dag tshar bcas bzhugs/ da lta smon lam dang lnga mchod kyi dus mchod dang gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ kun rig mi 'khrugs pa ste rgyud sde lnga'i sgru ba mchod yod la/ chos spyod dang bskang gso dang / gdugs dkar bzlog chen/ dgu gtor 'cham bcas sor chud yod do/ /sto 605

'dir smras pa/ 'gro ba'i bde skyid pad+mo bzhad pa'i gnyen / /bstan pa rin chen nyin mor byed pa'i gzhi/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa zla ba'i ma ma che/ /brtan dang 'phel pa nyid la rag las so/ /de phyir chos kyi rdo rje mi yi gzugs/ /paṇa chen snang mtha' yas pa'i 'phrin las kyi/ /byed po chos grags rgya mtsho zhes grags pas/ /skye dgu'i bsod nams zhing du 'dus sde bskrun/ /dam chos 'o ma'i rgya mtsho rgyas pa la/ /dge 'dun ngang mo'i tshogs kyis nyer bsten te/ /mdo sngags chos kyi mgrin rnga cir yang brdung / /thugs rgyud bslab gsum nor gyis yongs gtams pa'i/ /bkris lhun dka' chen nyi zla'i phreng ba yis/ /sde 'di rim par bskyangs pa'i bka' drin la/ /gzur gnas skye bos bstod bsngags rol mo dkrol//mdzod pa dge 'dun rgyud 'dzin sde chen sogs/ /ris med skye 'gro'i bsod nams zhing 'di la/ /bsnyen bkur bsod nams 'bras bu 'o ma'i mtsho/ /bla med byang chub bar du zad mtha' bral/ /dgon sde 'di yi byung ba gser gyi rnga/ /yongs su brdung ba'i nus pa ches phra yang / /dge bskul bka' lan bablog par ma nurme par/ /byis blos theg tsam 'di ni 'bad pas bskrun//'dis mtshon bdag gzhan dus gsum dge tshogs kyi/ /mthu 606

las rgyal bstan dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shog /bye brag sde 'der mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyis/ /thugs rgyud gtams pa'i dge 'dun 'du bar shog /ces mdzod dge smad kyi rgyal dge dgon zhes grags pa dgon rnying 'di'i byung rim gser gyi rnga bo che zhes bya ba 'di ni/ snga mo nas chos sde 'dis grwa ba kha shas mngags te bskul ba ltar mdor bsdus shig bris mod/ slar yang grwa ba kha shas snga phyir mngags te nan gyis bskul ba'i ngo ma bzlog par tha snyad pa bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas rab gnas lcags lug lo'i hor zla dgu ba'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang bo dang bo'i nyin mjug rdzogs par bsgrigs pa'i yi ge ba ni dgon de ga'i dge tshul 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ / — 607

— —rgyal dge dgon bkra shis rab brtan gling gi byung rim mdor bsdus/rnam 'dren gsung gi rdo rje nyi ma'i 'od/ /gcig hūṃ 'khyil ba snang mtha' yas pa che/ /mi yi gar du rtsen pa rigs brgya'i bdag /mi shigs thig le'i dbus su rtag bzhuspus mdzod / /rgyal ba'i 'phrin lartswadage mtshan bkra shis 'bum/ /'gro ba'i phan bde'i 'od stong rab spros pas/ /'gro ba'i bde skyid brtan pa'i dpal mnga' ba/ /chos sde 'di yi byung ba mdo tsam 'bri/ /de yang rkyang tsha'i rgyal dge dgon bkra shis rab brtan gling 'di nyid rwa rong chos grags rgya mtshos rab byung bcu ba'i lo rabs bzhi bcu yar mar zhig tu btab/ khang sar dgon dang 'di gnyis bkra shis lhun pos dka' chen rim par mngags te bskyangs/ rwa rong chos grags rgya mtsho dgung lo zhe gnyis pa rab byung bcu ba'i lcags sprel (1620)lor rgyal dge dgon bkra 608

gis rab brtan gyi gtsug lag khang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i gzim khang du rje'i rtogs brjod thub bstan rin po che'i mdzes rgyan snyan ngag me tog chun po ljags rtsom gnang / 'di ba dgongs pa rdzogs skabs stong skor rin po che yon tan rgya mtshos gdung zhugs 'bul gnang / gdung la dung dkar gsu ma/ thugs ljags spyan gsum bab/ ring bsrel mang du byung / de'i sprul sku kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa ngag dbang brtson 'grus kyi dngos slob mdzod dge sku skye zer ba de mdzod dge spyi nas blus/'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa tshad du things/ rbe lung phur dgon pa zhig btab kyang yun ring ma gnas/ de rjes rgyal dge dgon gsham du dgon pa btab/ rab nyi chu pho 'brug gi (1712)lor kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa ngag dbang brtson 'grus dgon pa 'di gnyis su gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas zhus/ gsar btab kyi dgon pa de dang / sngar gyi rgyal dge dgon gnyis gcig tu bsres/ bla ma 'di la spru pa sku ma byung / mdzod dge khri ba zhig gi sku skye byas nas/ rgyal dge sprul sku zer ba blus kyang deng sang de la skye rgyud med zer/ dgon 'dir bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen rim byon gyis dka' chen bstan 'dzin chos grags/ khri ba bla ma mer gan mkhan po/ nom 609

chi mer gan mkhan po dka' chen rnam rgyal brtson 'grus sogs rim par mngags gtoje mdzad de bskyangs/ tshogs bsags pa blo bzang dpal ldan/ brag nag pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin/dka' chen ye shes dpal ldan rnams kyis/ smon lam chen mo dang / lnga mchod sogs sngon med gsar tshugs dang / sngar yod gnas pa gong 'phel byas shing / nom chi chos rje khri rin po che dka' chen bstan 'dzin chos grags kyis 'khor lo bde mchog gi cho ga cha lag tshang ba lnga mchod chen mor bdun chos su btsugs te spyi rdzas sogs bzhag paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan nas bzung ste/paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma'i bar sku phreng rim byon gyis bka' shog gnang ba da lta yang ma nyams par yod/ gtsang bkra shis lhun po nas mngags pa'i gtsang gi bla mas bzhag ldom gyi khang sar nyin dang / rgyal dge dgon 'di gnyis bdag byas nas bcos bsgyur bar du gnas la rten khyad par can shin tu mang bo yod/'du khang dang rten 'gangs can kha shas lhag yod pa las gzhan thams cad lhag med du gyur / rab rgyal chu pho khyi'i (1982)lo snga gzhug tu chos sgo phyes mod/ da lta grwa rgan gsum las med la/ gsar zhugs sum cu tsam re yod 'dug rgyud sde 'don rtagadabyangs sogs sngar yod 610—

sor e chud lta bzhin 'dug dgon rnying yin pas byin rlabs che/gtsang dgon zhig tu gnas thub na legs snyam/ dgon pa 'di btab nas rab gnas sa sbrul (1989) lo 'di'i bar lo bzhi brgya dang bzhi bcu lhag song yod par nges la/ mdzod dge'i dgon pa thams cad kyi ma dgon yin zer/ zhes pa 'di ni dgon de nyid nas lha dar dang dngos skyes du ma bcas bskul ngor/ bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas/ rab gnas sa sbrul (1989)lo'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i dkar phyogs kyi stong ba gnyis par sbyar ba'i ye ge ba ni dge slong shes rab rgya mtsho'o/ / 611

bod kyi sman rig byung tshuladze mdor bsdus/deng dus tapre krungabyudabyang gis dbu khrid mdzad 'og mes rgyal gyi chab srid dpalasku'abyor rig gnas sogs gang cha nasarke —— dbyar mtsho 'phel ba bzhin gong 'pheldosong ba dang mabs cig tu tang gi lugs rnying sman pa'i srid jus kyi 'od zer 'phros 'ogabod kyi sman rig yang gong 'phel du 'gro bzhin yin/ bod kyi sman rig yang mes rgyal gyi sman rig gi grub cha zhig yin gshis/ ji ltar byung tshul gyi lo rgyus gsal tho zhig kyang nges par dgos mod/sa bon gyi dpe mi 'byor zhing sngar yang ma mthong la/ g.yu thog gsar rnying rnam thar/ gso rig chos 'byung shes bya rab gsal/lhas/stan /re/ /de/ /khye/ lhas//bsdi ::rdo ne byang smad pa ba da nams —sa rgyal mtshan — ga ga sa 'byung pad tshal bzhad pa'i ltin byed/ rin chen steng ba blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gso rig chos 'byung drang srong dgodwas rgyan/ tsha rong 612

ba'i skawaṃrig chos 'byung skal bzang 'gro ba'i myur sdum/ zur mkhar ba'i shes bya spyi'i khog dubug sde srid kyi gso rig spyi'i khog dbyāg sogs/ gso rig lo rgyus 'ga' re yod 'dug mod dpe rgyun dkon pas mthong ba'i yul du ma gyur/ lo rgyus thor bu 'ga' re la brtem/ nas cung zad brjod na/ spyir bod kyi sman rig dar tshul la snga dar/ bar dar/ phyi dar gsum yod la/ snga dar ni bod rang gi dmangs khrod du rim gyis byung ste ngag rgyud du dar nas gnam ri sror btsan gyi bar du gong 'phel byung ba yin la/ gnam ri srong btsan gyi dus su rgya nag nas yar dar ba dngabyu/ phyi dar ni rgyal bo khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su rgya gar nas dar ba yin/ dang bo snga dar ni bod rang gi dmangs khrod nas rim gyis gcig shes gnyis shes kyi tshul du byung zhing / rimasgegyis gong 'phel byung ste/ rgyal bo lha tho tho ri'i dus su sman pa mkhas pa bi byed dga' byed sogs byung / bi byed dga' byed kyi bu dung gi thor cog ni sman pa grags can du gyur te/ bod rgyarmā gyi bla span par gyur pa sogs sman pa mkhas pa mang du byung snang mod/ 'on kyang de dusabod la yi ge med stabs/ngag rgyud rdzonas dar ba yin/ dper na phyugs kyi sman dpyad 613

phal che ba deng dus kyi par du ngag rgyud kho nas dar ba lta bu yin la/ dar ba'i lo tshigs ji bzhin brjod du med kyang / lo nyis stong yar mar song yod par mngon/ bar dar ni gtso cher rgya nag nas dar ba yin la/ bod rgyal gnam ri srong btsan dus su rgya nag gi thang gi rgyal rabs kyi rgyal bo thog ma'i dus yin/spyi lo drug brgya dang nyi shu yar mar yin la/ de'i skabs su rgya bod kyi rgyal bo gnyis kyi bar du 'brel ba bzang bo btsugs/ rgya nag nas sman rtsis kyi rig pa sogs bod la dar/ sman rdzas mang bo rgya nag nas drangs/ bod rang gi sngar gyi sman rig dang / rgya'i sman rig 'des te lhag par dar bar gyur mod/ de'i skabs su bod la yi ge med gshis ngag rgyud dang kha shas kyis rgya yig thog nas yang bslab par mngon/ bar dar de nas da lta'i bar lo stong dang sum brgya dang nyi shu sum cu yar mar song / gnam ri srong btsan gyi bu srong btsan sgam po'i dus nas bod la yi ge byung / gsum pa phyi dar ni/ bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan spyi lo bdun brgya dang dgu bcu go gsum tsam lcags rta lor 'khrungs/'di'isadus su rgya gar nas chos sde snod mang bo bod skad du bsgyur te/ bstan pa dar ba mdzad pa dang chabs cig tu rig gnas kyi gzhung mang bo bsgyur nas bod lugs dang / rgya nag lugs/ rgya sgo14

ger lugs kyi sman rig gsum chu bo gcig 'dus su gyur nas /sman dpyad shin tu dar rgyas byung / khyad par du sman pa shin tu mkhas pa g.yu thog pa zhes bya ba chu yos (823tsam)lor stod lung skyid sgar 'khrungs/ de la phyis su g.yu thog rnying ma zhes grags/ rgyal bo khri srong gi bla sman pa mdzad/ bod lugs kyi sman rig gzhi byas te/ rgya gar nag gi sman rig gis kha bskangs nas sman gyi rgyud bzhi zhes pa'i sman gzhung bzhi brtsams/ sman gzhung chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i ched du/ rgyud bzhi bsam yas dbu rtser gter du sbas/ rang nyid kyis sman dpyad dang / slob spel gyi sman rig shin tu dar bar byas pa/ rgyal bo khri ral ba can gyi bar du yar rgyas byung mod/ chu bya (733)lor rgyal ngan glang dar ma rgyal sar 'khod/ rgyal bo 'dis sman rtsis sogs rig gnas thams cad bsnubs nas dpe thams cad mer bsregs stabs sman yig sogs med par gyur pa dang / sman dang rig gnas thams cad nyams par gyur nas lo drug cu bdun cu zhig byung mtshams slar dar ba'i mgo brtsams te/ lo chen rin chen bzang bos rgya gar nas mgon po klu sgrub/ slob dpon dpa' bo/ kha che zla ba mngon dga' sogs kyis mdzad pa'i sman gzhung bsgyur ba sogs rgya gar gyi sman gzhung 'ga' zhig bod du 615

bsgyur ba sogs kyis gso rig cung zad dar/ khyad par du gter ston grwa ba mngon shes zhes pa'i mkhas pa chen po rab byung dang bo'i chu byi (1072)lo la g.yo ru gra'i skyid ces pa'i sa char 'khrungag mkha sa pa chen po des dgung lo nyer bdun thog sa ltag (1098)lo la bsam yas dbu rtse'i ka ba bum pa can nas gso rig rgyud bzhi'i dpe cha gter nas blangs/ phyis su dge bshes khu ston dar ma grags la gnang ba/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos gsan/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po ni sngon gyi sman pa mkhas pa chen po g.yu thog pa'i gdung rgyud du nyang stod rgyal rtse'i phu sgo bzhi re thang zhes bya ba'i yu la du 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nas yon tan la sbyangs/ dgung lo bco brgyad thog rgya gar du gshegs nas chos dang yon tan mang bo bslabs/ snga phyir rgya gar du lan drug rgyan pa de la g.yu thog gsar ma zhes grags/'di bas rgyud bzhi cha lag dang bcas pa khyab spel gnang bas/'di nas bzung sman rig slar yang dar rgyas byug/ phyis su zur mkhar ba dharma swa mi'am mnyam nyid rdo rje khu dbon dang byang bdag rnam rgyal grags te/ byang zur gyi mkhas pa rnam gnyis kyi rgyud bzhi dang cha lag brgyad kyi 'grel ba ci rigs mdzad pa sogs mkhas pa du mas rgyud 'grel dang sman gzhung du ma mdzad 'dug khyo1sgo

pa dang / gzhan rgyal dbang lnga ba'i sku tshe'i mjug tsam du sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos sman gyi rgyud bzhi'i 'grelab bai sngon dang /man ngag lhan thabs sogs mdzad pa dang / dar mo sman ramartswapas gsang ba man ngag bka' rgya ma zhes grags pa sogs mdzad ba yod zer/ de'i phyis su de'u dmar dge bshes kyis sman yig shel gong shel sbeng mdzad ba dang / rnga rgod nam seng gis nad brtag thabs dang / gtsos a brtan gyis sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung sogs mkhas pa so sos man ngag sdeb sbyor gyi sman gzhung phran bu gsungs pa mang du yod pa dag la par du 'khod ma 'khod ci rigs yod par snang / dus phyis su'ang kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho dang 'ju mi pham gyi sman gzhung kha shas yod pa phar yang yod zer/ rgyal dbang bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i dus tsam du sku 'bum byams pa gling du sman pa grwa tshang btsugs pa dang /man ju gong ma chen lung gi dus su rgyal bo dang lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje zung 'brel gyis/ pe cin g.yung hwa gung du sman pa grwa tshang btsugs/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang bo dgung lo nga bdun thog shing 'brug lo —(1784)la bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du sman pa grwa tshang btsugs/rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtshos spyi lo 1915la 617

lha sa sman rtsis khang btsugs/ gzhan yang rwa rgya sogs dgon pa 'ga' re la'ang sman pa grwa tshang yed par snang / bod kyi sman rig bod yul tsam ma zad sog yul du yang ches dar te/u ru si'i khongs su gtogs pa'i pu rad ces pa'i sog yul dang / hal ha ste mong gol rgyal khab dang / rang rgyal gyi nang sog rang skyong ljongs sogs yul kun tu bod kyi sman rig da lta'i bar du dar nas yod do/ /de ltar bod kyi gso rig ni gna' dus snga phyi b.racagasum gyi brgyud pa gcig 'dres su dar nas/ glang dar gyi dus su nub pa/ slar yang mkhas pa du ma'i 'bad rtsol la brten nas bod yul nas bzung ste sog yul tshun chad du dar rgyas tsam byung na'ang / log spyod dbang bsgyur gral rim gyi lam lugs ngan pa'i 'og nas rgya che'i dmangs khrod du rgya khyab tu 'phel ma nus te/ yul tsho rer sman pa gcig re gnyis re las med pa dang / gtan nas med sa yang mang bo yod la/yod pa dag kyang sman pa rang nyid la 'byor ba rgya chen po med pa dang / kher rkyang du gyur gshis sman dpe mang bo nyo mi thub pa dang sman nyo bsdu shin tu dka' ba dang / rgya gar nag sogs yul gzhan nas 'dren dgos pa dag kyang lag tu 'byor dka' zhing /'byor na'ang nyung zad re las sto mi nus shing / sman sdeb tshe yang 618

sman rin thang che ba dang / dkon pa dag nyung shas re las bsri mi nus shing / skabs 'gar gtan nas med par tshab tsam re bsre ba dang / skabs 'gar tshab yang med par sdeb sbyor kha ma tshang ba'i sman sbyin pa la brten nas nad pa la phan thogs yang ches zhan pa dang / sman pa phal cher kher rkyang du gnas gshis/ril bu/ lde gu/ khaṇ+ḍa/ thang / sman mar sogs gzhung nas bshad pa'i sman sna tshogs sbyor ba'i nus pa zhan zhing yo byad kyang cha mi tshang ba dang rtsol ba'ang zhan gshis sman gyi phan pa chung stabs/ rgya che'i mi dmangs la'ang yid ches chen po med par gyur/ bcings 'grol rjes su/ tang krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhi mchog gi lugs rnying sman pa'i srid jus kyi 'od zer 'phros 'ogabod rigs dmangs khrod kyi sman pa rnams rang nyid bsgyur bkod kyis mi dmangs dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi zhabs 'degs par gyur/ rim pa so so'i srid gzhung gi 'go khrid 'og sman pa rnams rtsa 'dzugs dang / slob gso rogs ram la brten nas sman pa rnams kyir+shago rtogs dang brtson sems ches mthon por gyur/ srid gzhung gis sman khang dang 'phrod bsten pa sogs su bod rigs kyisman pa rtsa 'dzugs byas te sman nyo bsdu dang skyel 'dren rogs ram gnang ba dang / skabs skabs su tshogs 'du bsdu ba sogasdokha619

bya rim de dag la brten nas bod kyi sman rig la yid je ches su gyur/ sngar snan pa dag gis man ngag gsang nas rang kho na la rnyed bkur dang grags snyan 'byung thabs sged pa dang / da skabs phan tshun gros bsdur dang / nyams myong brje res byas te/ sngar thag ma chod pa du ma gsar du thag chod pa dper na khyi spyon la khag 'khyag pa'i nyams myong rnyed pa dang / sngon sma/na pa gcig gi sman rgyab khug gang gis lo gcig gnyispol 'dang ba dang / deng dus mdzod dge rdzong gi sman khang gcig pu la'aja lo re sman rgya ma brgya stong mang bo 'dren dgos pa/ sngar sun pa gcig gis nyin khoshar+sā kyi nang du mi re gnyis la blta ba dang / deng dus bod lugs sman pasto gcig gis nyin rer mi brgya phrag brgal ba la blta ba dang / sngar gtan nas lag tu ma 'abhor ba'i sman/ deng dus dmangs byings la dbang ba'i lam lugs khyad 'apags kyi 'og nar+sā gang dgos lag tu 'byor ba dang / sman pa rnams kyang brtson sems 'phel te/ci dper na da lo mdzod dge'i sman khu rnams zung chu'i shar dung rir song nas sman bsdus pas sngar gtan nas ma rnyed pa'i sman dkon pa mang bo rnyed pa sogs gong 'phel gyi rnam 'gyur gsar ba thon te/ bod kyi sman rig 'di nyid mes rgyal gyi sman rig grub cha gal chen zhig tu gyur te gong 620
