'phel du 'gro bzhin yod pa yin no/ /bod kyi sman rig byung tshul mdor bsdus 'di ni1962lo'i zla ba10nang rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi rgya lugs bod lugs phyi lugs sman pa rnams kyi bzhugs mol tshogs 'du 'tshogs skabs/ bod lugs sman pa ngag stobs blo rgyal sogs kyis 'di 'dra zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ dmu dge smodziganyan nasaglo buradu brisauba'o/ /bod kyi sman rig byung tshul 'di la gdul bya thun mong ma yin pa'i dbaja du byas nas bshad tshul mang du yod pa gzhir bzhag gdul bya thun mong gi dbang du byas pa'i bshad tshul yang du ma zhig yod snang ste/ dper na sman gyi rgyud bzhi yang rgya gar nas 'gyur zer ba dang / bod gzhung yin zer ba dang / rgya nag nas 'gyur zer ba sogs yod la/ rgya gar nas 'gyur zer ba la'ang bshad tshul mi mthun te/ sde srid kyi bai sngon du mkhan po krimiṇa zhes pa'i paṇa ḍi ta dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba ban de chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur ba sogs kyi don rgyud bzhi yin la / zhes gsungs pa dang / karma yon tan rgya mtsho'i mngon grwa'i rnam thar du/ rgyud bzhi bai ros bsgyur ba bshad pa dang / klong rdol bla ma rin po ches/ rgyud bzhi g.yu thog gong ma'i gsung yin par bshad pa sogs la / rang re'i spekha ma ba du mas rgyud kyi brjod bya rjod byed dang tshig nyams sogs la dpag na rgya gzhung gi nyams med par bod gzhung gi bzo 'dug gsung ba sogs yod—la/ g.yu thog gong ma'i gsung yin pa'i phyog ru'ide bde snyam mo/ /je2ram̐

gab tshig dang khed gnyis kyi khyad par brjod / pa drang srong tshangs thig ces bya ba/gang 'dul gser ldan bu mo'i lto ba ru/ /so rig rig byed 'od kyis 'khyud pa na/ /kun phan khye'u'i rol ba 'bum 'char bar/ /byed po zla med drang srong khyod kyis skyongs/ /'dir snga mo zhig nas dogs gnas kyi dri ba mang bo zhig 'byor bas/ gab tshig dang / khed gnyis kyi khyad par mdo tsam brjod pa la/ 'byung khungs kyi khyad par/ dus kyi khyad par/ngo bo'i khyad par/ tha snyad kyi khyad par bzhi las/ dang bo/ 'byung khungs kyi khyad par ni/ gab tshig gi rgyan ni/ gtso bo 'phags yul gyi snyan ngag dag las byung ba yin te/snyan ngag me long las/ 'di rnams gab tshig bcu drug ste/ /sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis bstan/ /zhes dang / gab tshig 622 —

darge gi rnam pa yi/ /lugs kyang rab tu bstan par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /me long ma bod du ma 'gyur ba'i sngon gyi bod gzhung dag na gab tshig gi rgyan gyi tha snyad mi 'byung bas kyang /gab tshig gi rgyan gyi 'byung khungs ni snyan ngag gi gzhung rnams yin pa shes so/ / khed kyi 'byung khungs ni/ gtso bo bon yin te/ bka' chems sogs las/ bon/ sgrung / lde'u gsum/ zhes pa'i lde'u ni khed yin te/ deb ther mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ mngon pa'i sde snod 'byung ba'i ltas lde'u spyod/ ces pa'i mchan du/srang la them gnyer wa ba can ci yin/ zhes 'dri ba dper bzhag pa lta bu dang / gzhan yang / rgyal blon 'di gnyis kyi dus su zhang zhung nas bon sgrung sde'u gsum dar zhes dang / chab srid sgrung dang lde'u bon gyis bskyangs/ /zhes pa'i lde'u ni khed yin la/ rgya nag gi ta'o ja'odzozer ba'i ston pa lo kyun gyi rang lugs pa rnams la'ang khed dar zhing / chos lugs su brtsi zhes rgya mi dag gis zer ro/ / gnyis pa/ dus kyi khrad par ni/— gab tshig gi rgyan ni rig gnas chung ba lnga'i ya gyal gyi snyan ngag dar nas byung ba yin/spyir snyan ngag tsam ni bod 'dir snga mo zhig nas yod mod/ rig 623

gnayochung ba lnga'i mi gyal gyi snyan ngag ni/ 'dzigs yul gyi mkhas pa dag gi lugs bzhin du/ shar lho'i lam lugs so so dang / thun mong la'ang / don rgyan sgra rgyan gab tshig gi rgyan skyon seladang bcas pa'i rnam bzhag ston pa'i gzhung dang mthun par rtsom pa de yin la/ de bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su byung ba yin te/ g.ya' sel las/ 'on kyang sgra snyan ngag sdeb sbyor/mngon brjod/ zlos gar te/ rig gnas chung ba'am tha snyad rig pa'i gnasalngar grags pa/ sa paṇa yan la ma dar zhing / de nartswathar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan yan la dar yang bod skad du gzhung yongs rdzogayom 'gyur ba la/ zhes sogs ltar yin/ gzhung yongs rdzogs shong ston lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / dpang lo yab sras sku drin can rnams kyis me long rtsa 'grel/ dpag bsam 'khri shing sogs bsgyur pa la brten nas/ snyan nga ga shin tu dar ce/ bod 'grel shin tu mang mod/ grags che ba ni/ rin spungs pa'i seng ge'i nga ro/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen mo'i dbyangs can dgyes glu/ bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal gyi dan ḍi'i dgongs rgyan dang / dpe brjod sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs sogs yod la/ derīdag gi skabs su gab tshig gi rgyan bcu drug gi dpe brjod dag kyang shin tu legs shing mdzes 624

par bkrod yod pas gab tshig gi rgyan zhis yongs su grags pa / 'di byung ngo / /khed ni/ bstan pa snga dar ma zad/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ma dar ba'i sngon nas byung ba yin te/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba'i deb ther las/ 'di yan gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun du/ chab srid sgrung dang lde'u(khed)bon gyis bskyangs zhes dang / bod rgyal spu de gung rgyal dang / blon po ru las skyes gnyis kyi dus su byung bar bshad de/ lo'ongs sngags dang 'dul ba 'byung ba'i ltas/ /gnam rgon gshen po ste dang bon gzhung byung / /zhe sa dang / de'i thad kyi mchan las/ mdo sde 'byung ba'i ltas su sgrung rnams dar/ ro langs gser sgrub kyi sgrung dang / ma sangs kha sgrurodang / mchil ba'i sgrung sogs nyan bshad dang / mngon pa'i dze+esnod 'byung ba'i ltas sde'u(khed)spyod/ srang lacethem gnyer wa ba can ci yin/ bor mgo mgo can skyed cing rgyags ci yin zhes 'dri ba sogs te/ bon sgrung lde'u gsum gyi tshul lha sa'i gdung rnams la bris nas yod skad/ces dang / ma ṇi bka' 'bum las/ srong btsan gyi dus su/skye bo blo dman pa rnams la lung gi chos go bar bya ba'i phyir — gzungs kyi snye ma sogs sgrung bslabs/ rtogs pa'i chos go bar bya 625

ba'i phyir lde'u(khed)bslabs/ zhes gsungs pa dang / deb ther gzhan las kyang gsungs yod/ don 'dra bas/ 'dir mang dogs nas ma drangs/ gsum pa/ ngo bo'i khyad par ne/ gab tshig ni/ snyan ngag gi tshig rgyan yin te/ snyan ngag gi 'grel ba thams cad /las/ gnyis pa thun mong gi rgyan la don rgyan dang / sgra rgyan/ gab tshig gi rgyan dang gsum zhes gsungs shing / gab tshig ni snyan ngag gi rgyan gzhan bzhin du/ brjod bya dang ldan pa'i tshigs sabacad pa'i lus la snyan ngag gi rgyan du 'gro nges shig las/khed bzhin du gang byung smras pa dag ni rgyan du mi 'gro ste/ sngon gyi slob dpon 'ga' zhig gis gab tshig bcu bzhi bshad pa de la/ gab tshig gi mtshan nyid ma tshang gsungs nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta slob dpon dan ḍis khas ma blangs pa'i phyir/ snyan ngag me long las/gab tshig ngan pa gzhan dag kyang / /bcu bzhi de dag rnams kyis brjod/ /ngan pa mtshan nyid med gang de/ /skyon gyis yongs bgrangs bya min par/ /rig nas slar yang bdag cag gis/ /legs pa kho na brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ngan pa mtshan nyid med gang de/ /zhes bcu bzhi bo de la ga ba tshig gi mtshan nyid ma tshang bar bshad pa'i phyir/ des na 626

gab tshig ni/ snyan ngag gi tshig rgyan yin par ma zad/ kun gzigs lnga ba chen mo dang / bod mkhas pa sogs sngon gyi snyan ngag pa mkhas dbang sus kyang / gab tshig gi dper brjod la tshigs bcad kho na las/ tshig lhug bzhag pa gcig kyang med pa'i phyir/ khed ni/ snyan ngag gi rgyan ma yin te/ de ltar 'dod mkhan sngar su yang ma byung la/ don la'ang tshig rgyan yin par 'dod mi rigs te/ gzhung lugs dang rig gnas la sbyangs ma sbyangs la ltos pa med par khyim pa dag dang / lhag par byis pa dag gis ku re byed ched/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ srang ste rgya ma la/ them gnyer wa ba can zer ba lta bu/ pha rol pos e shes lta ba dang / ri zhig gi ngo na zo ba gnyis kha thur du bstan nas yod/ de ci red/ sna/ ra ba dkar bo'i nang du ba li ma dmar mo zhig 'phag gi 'dug de ci red/ lce/ zhes pa lta bu/rtsed mo'i dgos pa tsam las/ tshig gi rgyan du 'gyur tshul med pas/ sngar gyi mkhas ba sus kyang tshig rgyan du gsungs pa med pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin no/ /des na gab tshig dang khed gnyis kyi ngo bo mi 'dra ba yin no/ / bzhi ba/ tha snyad kyi khyad par gi/ gab tshig gi ming la rgya 6lha7

bod kyi snyan ngag gi gzhung gang na'ang gab tshig ces pa las khed dang / lde'u'i tha snyad btags pa gang yang med pa'i phyir/ sngar ma grags kyang / khedacadang don 'grabaspokhedarīces btags chog go zer na/ de gnyismokyi dogagyi ngo ra mi 'dra ba gong du bshad pa de ltar yin mod/ gal te brtag pa mtha' bzung gis de gnyis don 'dra ba'i dbang du bstong g.yang / de gnyis kyi tha snyad bsre mi dung ste/ 'dus byas mi rtag gnyis don gcig yin kyang /dngos ming so sor go bya'i chos yin pas/ ming gi tha snyad dang mtshan nyid sogs so sor 'jog dgos ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi dgongs pa yin no/ /de gnyis tha snyad gcig tu bsres na rig pa'i gzhung rmugs dang mi mthun par ma zad/ snyog gra bzo ba yin/ don gyi phyogs 'dra bas gcig gi ming de gcig la 'dogs na/ lug gi ril saul lug gi skyag pa dang / rta lud la rta'i skyag pa dang / lci ba la g.yag gi skyag pa sogs smos shig dang / rig gnas la sbyangs pa dag ma zadañtsakhyim pa ma sbyangs pa dag kyang bzhad gad thag ge 'gro'o/ /khed kyi tha snyad la yang / sngar gyi lo rgyus deb ther dag na lde'u zhes brjod kyang / phyis su khed ces tshang mas smra ba las/de 'i ming la gab tshig ces gang du'ang ma grags pa'i phyir/ khed 628

de/ lde'u zer ba de min no ne na/ 'o na lde'u de gang la byed smos shig dang / bka' drin che zhes zhu'o/ /des na khed ces pa de/ mi rnams kyi rtog ngo na yod pas/ khed ces brjod rung rmeb yinachote/ ri bong can la zla ba zhes brjod rung yin pa bzhin no/ /khed la gab tshig ces brjod rung ba sgrub byed kyi rtags/rtog yul na yod pa'i grags pa'i rtags 'god mi rung ste/ sngar de ltar ma grags pa'i phyir ro snyam mo/ /de gnyis gcig tu byas pa'i deb chung zhig yod zer ba las/ mig gis ma mthong yang /snga phyir dris pa'i lan du/ ban rgan mgo dkar des rtsed mo'i zhar la smras pa'o/ / 629

ko kri la'i bden gtam / rnam par dag pa'i blo gros kyis/ /rnam par dge ba'i lam ston zhing / /rnam par bden pa'i yang dag gtam/ /rnam par smra mkhas de dag rgyal/ / 'dir bsil ldan ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i bod gangs can gyi ljongs zhes snyan pa'i rol mo phyogs kyi bu mo'i nyan byed kyi rgyan du 'chang ba 'di'i snod bcud kyi chags rim mdo tsam bshad par bya ste/ 'di ltar sngon gling 'dir sa'i dkyil 'khor chags pa'i rjes su bod kyi ljongs chen po 'dir/ rin po che'i snod bdud rtsis gang ba bzhin du rim gyis mtsho chen po chags te/ mtsho de nyid dar zhing rgyas nas nya dang chu srin dang rus sbal la sogs pas chu la gnas 'cha' ba'i srog chags dag gi gnas dam par gyur to/ /de nas dus ring mo zhig nas 'dus byas thams cad 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i mtshan ma mngon du gyur te/630

mtsho skyor ba'i ra ba dag gi kha ral nas mtsho chu rnams mtha'i rgya mtsho chen po'i phyogs su 'bab par gyur pas/ sa gzhi chen po de nyid skam sa chen por gyur te rim gyis rtsi shing dang nags tshal rgyas nas/ ri dwags gcan gzan dang / spra dang spre'u'i gnas dam par gyur to/ /de nas spra dang spre'u dag rgyas shing blo rno bar gyur pa dang khyad par du rtsed thang kong po ri la gnas pa'i spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang / brag srin mo gnyis las sprel phrug mang du 'phel te shing 'bras dang ri dang thang la skyes pa'i 'bru dag gis 'tsho zhing gnas pa la/ rim gyis 'dus byas so na mi gnas pa'i rang gshis mngon du gyur te/ nags tshal dag nyams shing rgud par gyur pa dang / ri skyes kyi 'bru rnams kyang nyung bar gyur te/ 'tsho ba'i zas kyang dka' ba'i skabs/ spre'u blo rno ba dag gis rtsed thang sogs—su shing thur gyis sa brkos te sa khung nang du rgod skyes kyi 'bru 'phangs pa skyes te rim gyis zhing sar gyur pa yin te/ zhing la snga ba zo dang zhing zhes grags so/ /de nas spre'u rnams rim gyis blo rno zhing lus stobs rgyas te mir gyur nas ya ra lungakhog tu mi'i 'gro ba chags pa yin te yul la snga ba lung sogs zhes grags so/ nagazhan yang rgya gar gyi rgyal 631

bo ru pa ti zhis pa gaphul pham snyi dpung dang bcas pa bros nas ri kha ba can du zhugs pa sogs phyi'i mi 'ga' yang ljongs 'dir lhags te/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i sprel rigs kyi mi rnams dang 'dres te/ gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir mi'i 'gro ba yongs su 'phel nas phying ba stag rtser brang khang bzos te grong sde chags pa/ grong la snga ba9 phying ba stag rtse zhes grags so / / de nas yul so sone 'dus sdod dag phan tshun rtsod pa dang /nyam chung ba dag btsan pos brnyas pa sogs byung rkyen mgo 'dren zhig nges par mkho bar gyur te/ spyi snyoms che zhing blo rno gzhung drang gi mi mgo dpon du bskos nas/ sde tsho sde tshor mgo dpon yod par gyur/ rim gyis sde shog chen por gyur te gnya' khri btsan po spyi'i rgyal bor 'gyur ba la mngon du phyogs pa'i skabs su/ bod la rgyal phran bcu ga nyis yod par grags shing / de nas lus stobs dang blo stobs gzhan las phul du byung ba'i rje gnya' khri btsan po de nyid bod yongs kyi rgyal bor gyur pa yin te rgyal bo la snga ba gnya' khri btswan po zhes grags so/ / de nas gnya—'a khri btsan pos bod khoms yongs la dbang bsgyur zhing / pho brang yum bu bla mkhar babyugs pa yin te/ mkhar la snga ba yum bu bla mkhar zhesi grags shīng / bod kyi rgyal sa dang 632

mkhar rdzong dag ri brag gi gdong snar brtsigs pa'i srolatshudus de nas byung ba yin te/ dper na rtse po ta la dang / rmo rgyalakhurtse/ gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse/ 'phyongs rgyas rdzong / sne'u gdong pho brang sogs ri brag gi gdong snar brtsigs pa dang / rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi rgyal khag bco brgyad du grags pa'i rgyal phran dag gi pho brang yang gdong snar yod par ma zad yul mi'i khang— khyim phal che ba gdong snar yod la/ bzo dbyibs dang sgo dang sge'u khung sogs yul dbus kyi rgyal bo'i pho brang gi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin da lta'ang ma 'gyur bar yod la/ da lta gsar du phub pa'i khang khyim dag de ji lta ba bzhin du bzo bzhin yod do/ / de dag gi khungs dang shes byed ji ltar yin zhe na/ sa'i chags tshul ni/ gna' bo'i bod mi rig pa rno ba dag gis brtags shing dpyad pa dang / 'phags yul sogs yul khams gzhan gyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs la rten pa gnyis zung du 'brel te ce gtan la phab pa'i bshad rgyun yang dag pa de ni mes po dag gis mang tshogs la bshad pa dang / phas bu la bshad pa lta bu'i sgo nas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i bar du byung mod/ de'i sngon du bod la rang gi yi ge'i gzugs med gshis yi ger bkod pa med la/ srong btsan sgam po'i dus 633

spos bod rang sgo yi ge 'bri ba'i srol byung nas/ srong btsan rang gi bka' chems rnams su bris yod pa 'di dag yin no/ /bshad tshul de ni yang dag pa yin pa'i bden dpang gang yin zhe na/ dgu ning lor pe cin nas sa gshis zhib 'jug tshogs pa dbus gtsang sogs su song nas zhib 'jug yang dag pa byas pa'i grub 'bras ni/ bod yul de ni sngar chus gang ba'i shul red ces sdom tshig bris te thag bcad pa ni sngar gyi bshad rgyun tshan rig pa dang mthun pa'i bshad srol yin par bden dpang bla na med pa byas so/ /'ga' zhig gis bod kyi sa gshis chu chags yin pa gsar du shes pa yin no zer ba ni ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i gtam yin te/ chu chags yin pa'i bshad rgyun de sngar nas rlung ltar grags shing / deb ther lo rgyus ha cang mang bo'i nang du nyi zla ltar gsal bar yod do/ / bod mi'i rigs rus kyi 'byung khungs spre'u yin pa'i khungs dang sgrub byed ji ltar ce na/ bod kyi mes po snga ma dag gis lar skyes pa'i mi'i rang gi skye rgyud ma shes na nags kyi spre'u 'dra/mi rang gi cho 'brang ma shes na/ g.yu 'brug zol ma 'dra bsams nas/ rang gi rigs rus gang yin blo gros zhib mos yang yang 634 ske

dpyad de/ mthar mjug sdom gyi bshad tshu' 'di rnyed nas/gcig gis gcig la bshad/ phas bu la bshad/ bus rang gi bu la bshad de ngag rgyun ma nyams par chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus nas bod rang gi yi ge yod gshis/ chos rgyal de nyid kyis bka' rtsom rnams su yi ger bris nas bzhag yod pa 'di ltar yin la/ shes rab go chas mdzad pa'i lha las phul byung gi bstod 'grel las/ ru pa ti dpung bcas ri bo gangs can du bros par bshad pas kyang gnyug mar gnas pa'i mi dang phyi nas thon pa'i mi yang yod pa shes so/ /'di ltar sprel rigs las byung ba'i bden dpang ji 'dra yod ce na/ bshad tshul 'di lo stong phrag mang bo'i sngon nas byung ba yin la/ nye ba'i dus rabs shig nas 'dzam gling 'dir tshan rig pa'i sgo nas mi'i 'byung khungs brtag dpyad byed pa'i srol dar nas brtags shing dpyad pa'i mthar sdom tshig bkod pa ni/mi'i 'byung khungs spra dang spre'u yin par bshad de/ bod kyi mes po dag gi bshad tshul la bden dpang bla na med pa zhig byas so/ /de dag tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bsnyad par bya ste/rab yid ches pa'i lung gi mdzod/ / shin tu lkog gyur gsal ba'i gnyen/ /635

— dngos pos stobs shugs rigs mdzod kyis/ /cung zad lkog gyur yid mkhar 'dren/ /— mthong ba mngon gyur ri bo che/ /long bas mi mthong rang gi gshis/ /ma mthong yid kyi yol go ru/ / ma chud pa dag med do lo/ /phra rags rgyu yi dngos po dag / yid kyi me long la shar ba'i/ /drang srong 'dren pa'i ded dpon zhig / gna' bo'i thang la bag yangs rgyu/ /rdzi bo'i byed thabs bla med kyis/ /phyugs lug dpag med bde thang du/ / 'tshos pa'i snyan par grags pa'i rnga/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu ldir/ /mthun pa'i rgyu las legs grub pa'i/ /bod khams gser gyi gzhongs chen de/ / gtsang ma shel la rab 'khu ba'i/ /bdud rtsi chab kyis yongs su gang / /rgyu rkyen du mas byas pa'i dngos/ /khya36

rtag pa'i tshul las rab 'gongs pas/ / btson du bzung ba'i chu bo dag /grong khyer phyi yi rgya mtsho yi/ /rin chen sna dgu'i ngo mtshar la/ /ltad mor blta phyir rim gyis bzhud/ / sa gzhi gser gyi gzhon nu de/ /lha chab bu mos btang na yang / /nags tshal mdzes pa'i bu mo da / /rab dga'i grogs su khab tu bsus/ / gzhon nu gser gyi sa gzhi dang / /nags tshal dga' mdzes bu mo gnyis/ /yun ring dga' mgur 'grogs pa las /rigs sras bskrun pa'i dpal yon shar/ /de yang rigs sras glang chen dang / /spra dang spre'u ri dwags sogs/ / ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i ltad mo bzhin/ /sa chen 'di ru rgyu zhing bskyod/ / mes po spra dang spre'u yi/ / bya ba 'tsho ba'i nags tshal las/ / 837

blo gros me stag phra mo de/ /rim gyis 'bar bas me chen gyur/ /blo gros me chen rab 'bar bas/ /mi yi zas la rim gyis spyod/ /de lta'i rten 'brel mthu nyid las/ /rim gyis spu dang rnga ma dag /thung bar gyur pa'i 'gyur lugs de/ /sngon gyi deb ther dag las gsungs/ /gzhan yang spra sprel 'di dag gi /phyi nang rgyu rkyen las skrun pa'i/ /shes rab rta ljang dbang bo de/ /yid kyi mkha' dbyings ngos su shar/ /brjod pa mi yi gtam smra zhing / /brjod bya don gyi ngo bo go /de lta'i smra zhing don go'i mi/ /pha rigs rnams ni blo rno zhing / /ma rigs rnams ni ro gyong ba'i/ /gdong dmar can gyis yul 'di gang / /rus chen bzhi dang gdung drug sogs/ /638

rim gyis 'phel ba'i dpal yon gyis/ / dpyid kyi dpal mo'i dpal yon la/ / zhum pa med par rab tu rgol/ /skyid pa'i sa/dung nabs bcu gsum gyis/ /tshangs pa'i snyan pa nyams par byas /'phrul blon mdzangs pa'i mi bdun gyi/ /blo gros nyi ma 'od che bas/ / rgud pa mun pa'i dpung tshogs de/ / na kra'i grong gi 'og tu yib/ /sngar dar ka rtsog zhang gsum dang / /phyi dar lo chen rin bzang dang / /blo ldan shes rab la sogs kyi/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i 'od chen po/ /ma bzod sna tshogs 'od can de/ /chu lha'i phang bar yang yang byol/ /da lta blo rtsal can yod na/ /mes po dag gi rjes 'brangs nas/ /gsar rnying rig pa'i do shal de/ /rgyun du 'dzin pa 'os lags so/ /6bye 9

mgo bo spra ba'i me tog can/ /bdag kyang bgrang bya'i rtser son mod/ /rig pa nor gyi gter chen po / /rang gi skal bar yongs su 'dzin/ /'di ltar smra mkhan shes bya'i mdzes ma la chags shing / /kha yi pad mor snyan ngag sbrang rtsi rab chags pa/ /drang srong chen po'i rjes 'jug bsam gtan rgya mtsho'am//mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros nas bya'o/ /rgo40

smon tshig bung ba rgan po'i gshog sgra/ ge lhag bsam chu 'arten dbyings su 'khrigs pa las/ / legs 'ongs rig gzhung sgrang char mthu dpal gyis/ /rig pa lo tog gsar ba'i dpal rgyas nas/ /skye dgu'i gdung ba lhag med gzhom gyur cig / rta ces shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gi me tog sil ma sngon du gtor te gleng bar bya ba ni/ spyir bod gangs can gyi bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyis bsdus pa'i rig gnas dag ni/ rgya dkar nag li bal sogs rgyal khams gzhan gyi rig gnas kyi bcud 'dus shing / rang yul gyi khyad chos las byung ba'i rig gnas rmad du byung ba zhig yin la/ de nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa'i mkhas chen/ snga dar gyi skabs su ska cog zhang gsum sogs byon pa dang / phyi dar skabs/ lo chen— rin bzang / rngog lo chen po/ sa skya paṇa chen/ shong dpang yab srag/ kun mkhyen bu/ rje yab sras sogs mkhas — khya44

zam mi 'chad pa byung la/ di dag gis bod kyi rig gnas thams cad je legs dang cha je tshang la btang nas gya rnam pa zhig tu gyur pa'i stabs kyis deng dus su'ang 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab gzhan gyis spyang bod kyi rig gnas zhes rig gnas 'gangs can zhig tu brtsis te/ zhib 'jug dang slob sbyong sogs byed bzhin yod/ 'on kyang bar skabs shig nas rkyen sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis/ rgya skad kyi shan shor ba dang / bod rang gi brda sprod pa'i gzhung dang kha skad gnyis ka dang mi mthun pa'i rtsom lugs rna bar mi 'jebs pa re byung dang 'byung mus red/ da lta 'di lta bu'i dus deb gsar du bskrun na de lta bu'i skyon cha phran bu dag sel zhing / na gzhon rnams kyis bod kyi rig pa'i gnas phul du byung ba rnams dang rtsom lugs snyan zhing 'jebs pa dag shes shing byang bar 'gyur ba'i dgos pa khyad par can yod/ spyir dpal 'byor dar zhing rgyas par byed pa dang tshan rig lag rtsal gong du spel ba la rig gnas ni med mi rung ba yin pas/ na gzhon slob gnyer ba rnams kyis/ mes rgyal deng rabs can du 'gyur ba dang / khyad par mi rigs sa khul gyi rjes lus rnam pa gtsang sel byed pa'i ched du/ dus deb 'di rang gi slob deb tu brtsis 64lha

te/ brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten nas/ lus rten dpag bskum ljon pa la rig gnas kyi me tog rnam par bkra zhing / spyi sger la phan pa'i 'bras ba g.yur du za ba la skye 'gro yongs kyis ༄ longs su spyod par gyur cig gu/ zhes smon tshig bung ba rgan po'i gshog sgra 'di ni/ rgan po mgo se dmu dge bsam gtan zhes bya bas sgang char dus deb gsar skrun gyi dga' ston smon tshig tu bris pa'o/ / — — ri / 643

dwags po'i mi rigs kyi gnad don —skor / 'dir bod kyi lo rgyus rang gi mthong thos ltar cung zad bkod na/ srong btsan sgam po sogs bod rgyal rnams kyis mtha' bzhi dbang du bsdu ba'i skabs su/ bod rgyal dang thang rgyal ma mthun par lo ngo du mar dmag 'khrug langs te/ bod rgyal gyis dmag 'bum phrag du ma mngags nas 'thab pas/ thang dang bod gnyis bar 'dum byed dgos byung / de'i skabs su da lta'i si khron phyogs kyi chu dkar rgyud (nan phen dang phen wu'i phyogs) /chu nag rgyud (chu nag dang khro chu) / tsha ba rong sogs bod rgyal gyi dmag gis bzung / bar 'dum byed skabs rgya bod bar du rdo ring btsugs/ rgya rgya yul du sdod rgyu dang / bod bod yul du sdod rgyu las/ phan tshun dmag 'jug byed mi chog pa thag gis bcad/ bod rgyal gyis/ bod dmag rnams phyir log mi chog par rgya bod bar gyi sa mtshams srung ched dmag mi rnams gzhis chags nas sdod dgos pa'i bka' phab/ dwags po nas 'ongs 644

pa'i dmag mi dang / kong po nas 'ongs pa'i dmag mi rnams chu dkar phyogs su 'dug tu bcug de phin lu'i dwags po dang /nan phin gyi khon po rnams yin/ dwags po ni brda cung zad kyang ma 'gyur bar deng sang yang dwags po zer la/ kong po ni brda cung zad 'gyur nas deng sang khon po zer/ stod shar ba nas 'ongs pa'i dmag mi rnams zung chu'i chu rgyud (rgyas lorkuzer) du bzhag pa /deng sang gi zung chu rdzong gi bod mi rnams red/ deng sang yang ming ma 'gyur bar shar ba zer/ bod kyi rus chen pazhi'i ya gyal spra rigs las byung ba'i dmag 'bor chen zhig da mag dpon kho phan gyi bkod 'doms 'og rgyal mo rngul chu'i chu rgyud sogs su gzhis chags nas bsdad/ rigs 'di la bswe rigs kyang zer/ sbra rigs dang bswe rigs gcig yin zhes mdo smad chos 'byung las gsungs/ rgyal mo rngul chu'i chu rgyud sogs rong khul gyi ming la rgyal mo tsha ba rong zer/ bod rgyal gyis bka' shog 'bebs tshe/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi kho phan la/ zhes bris pa rjes sor tshig sdud byas te tsha kho zer ba phyis su yul mi'i ming du gyur te deng sang tshacerong gi yul mi spyi'i ming la tsha kho zer/ rgyal mo rngul chu'i chu mgor yod pa'i 'brog sde zangs dkar khag gsum yang stod kyi zangs dkar nas 'ongs pa yin stabs — 645

ming yang ma 'gyur bar yod/des na the bo dang / phin wu sa cha'i dwags po nas bzu nga ste/ khams kyi lcags la'i bar gyi mi rigs 'di dag srong btsan sgam po'i dus su 'ongs shing / khri srong gi dus dang khri ral gyi dus su'ang skor gcig kha snon brgyab par gsungs/ rma chu'i chu rgyud kyi bod rigs 'bor chen zhig srong btsan gyi dus su 'ongs pa'i ldong rigs kyi dmag mi yin par bshad/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'gag dog mo gsum po sbra yis bzung / /spra dpa' rtsal che ba de don yin/ /ri mthon po gsum po ldong gis bzung / /ldong zhwa mgo mtho ba de don yin/ /zhes rus mdzod du gsungs/ de dag ni sa 'dir 'ongs snga zhing / bod kyi sa mthar song gshis bod yul dbus su chos lugs ban der 'gyur yang yul 'di dag tu bod kyi gna' chos bon po byas nas yun ring bor bsdad/ dper na/ dwags po/ khon po/ zung chu'i stod/chu nag gi yul gru kha shas/ rgyal rong gi khro skyabs kyi sde kha shas sogs bcings 'grol byed khar yang chos lugs bon po red/rgyal rong gi chu chen sogs sde mang shos shig man ching chen lung gi skabs ban der bsgyur/ 'bar khams phyogs ban der gyur 646

nas lo brgya yar mar ma gtogs ma 'gor/mdzod dge stod smad dang co ni sogs kyi bod mi bod rgyal khri ral gyi dus su blon po dga' ye shes dar rgyas 'khor 'bangs bcas 'ongs nas gzhis chags par co ni'i bstan 'gyur dkar chag na gsal/'di dag gi khungs ni/ 〈〈bod kyi rus mdzod chen mo〉〉〈〈rus mdzod za 'og ma〉〉〈〈rus mdzod thor bu〉〉〈〈rgyal rong gi dpon cog rtse〉〉〈〈so mang gi lo rgyus〉〉〈〈mgo log a skyongapyigi rus mdzod〉〉〈〈co ne dpon tshang gi rus mdzod〉〉(rgya yig) 〈〈gshen rab mi bo'i rnam thar〉〉〈〈brag bya rgod dkar chag〉〉〈〈bstan 'gyur dkar chag nor bu'i phreng ba〉〉〈〈deb ther rgya mtsho〉〉sogs su/ thor bu thor bur yod/ da lta dpe cha yang ma 'byor ba dang /khom long yang med pas/ sngon mthong ba las da lta lta rtog ma thub/ des na deng dus 'ga' zhig gis rgyal rong dang dwags po sogs bod rigs ma red ces smra ba ni/ khungs med byung rgyal du smra ba yin la/ si khron phin wu sa khul gyi dwags po ni/ rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul dang / men dbyang kron chus kyi sa matsams su yod la/ phin wu rdzong gi khongs su gtogs/ 'on sgo47

spyang lan phin gyi bod rigs dang 'dabs 'brel zhing / goms 'dris gshis lugs chos lugs tshang ma nan phin rdzong dang zung chu rdzong gi bod rigs ltar yin par ma zad/ gna' dus nas bod rigs su brtsi ba la skad cha cung zad kyang med mod/ nye lam dwags po bod rigs ma red/ tis rigs red ces pa'i khungs med kyi gtam zhig bsgrags yong bar ma zad/ da dung khams kyi bod mi zer ba'i bod rigs skor gcig bod rigs ma red/ bod mi mi rigs red ces logs su bkar/ rmu li sogs kyang sdod rigs min par byed rtsis kyi bya ba hur brtson gyis sgrub bzhin gda'/ 1978lo'i zla8pa'i nang krung go sbyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi mi rigs zhib 'jug khang dang / si khron zhing chen dngos mang bshams ston khang sogs 'brel yod kyi mi sna zhugs yod pa'i zhib 'jug tshogs pa zhig dwags po'i sa khul du song ste zla gcig tsam la zhib 'jug byas/ tshang ma'i lta tshul gcig pa min yang zhib 'jug gi yar zhu'i yig cha zhig sde khag so sor bkram/ de'i nang don ni dwags po bod rigs min pa'i sgrub byed bkod nas/ tis rigs red ces thag bcad mod/ tis rigs yin pa'i sgrub byed tshig gcig kyang med/ bod min pa'i sgrub byed rnams kyang /648

bod rigs yin pa'i sgrub byed du song 'dug ste/ rim bzhig bshad na 'di ltar/ — gcig dwags po'i skad kan lho'i gtsos kyi skad dang mi 'dra bas bod ma red zer/ de la 'di ltar brjod par bya ste/spyir bod skad la rtsa ba gcig yin na'ang sa cha rgya che zhing mi sde 'thor bkram che ba'i dbang gis sgra mi 'dra bar gyur la/ sa cha la lar bod skad brda rnying gi thog nas sgra gdangs je zab dang je lcir song ba'i steng nas 'gyur yod pa rgyal rong gi skad lta bu dnge / 'ga' zhig brda rnying gyi thog nas brda gsar du 'gyur ba dbus gtsang gi skad lta bu/ 'ga' zhig rang sa nas 'gyur tshabasdo che ba mgo log nya mtsho'i skad lta bu dang / 'dzam thang rdzong gcig gi nang du'ang bod rigs yin na'ang phan tshun skad mi 'dra bar gyur nas go brda 'phrod dka' ba kha shas yod/ de dag e bden ltos dang shes/ kan su'u sha hu rdzong gcig gi nang du'ang 'brog skad la sngon rjes kyi sgra gdangasajigasal zhing dag cha che ba dang /rong phyogs la sngon rjes kyi sgra gdangs ha cang gsal bo min zhing /mtho dman ring thung gi khyad par cung zad yod pa lta bu red/des na kan lho'i bod sde 'ga' zhig gi skad dang mi mthun pas/bod skad min no zhes bshad ga la thub/ bod skad mi shes pa'i 649

mi zhig gis zla gcig lhag gi ring la bod skad kyi rang bzhin khong du chud do zhes bshad rgyu ni dka' snyam la/ kan lho'i gtsos kyi skad dang mi 'dra ba'i bod skad mang / dwags po'i skad kyi nang du kan lho'i skad dang mi mthun sa mang na'ang / nan phin dang /zung chu'i bod mi'i skad dang mthun sa mi nyung / ltos dang shes/dwags po'i mi mang shos kyis bod yig mi shes pas bod ma red zer ba la 'di ltar/ yi ge yang bod kyi sa cha mang che bar slob grwa med pas/ yi ge dang rig gnas slob mkhan gtso cher bla grwa dang chos lugs pa yin pa las/ mi ser gzhan pa phal cher gyis yi ge mi shes shing / gsung rab kyi don mi go/ dwags po'i yul du'ang de dang 'dra bar bon po dang sngags pa rnams kyis slob pa las/ mi ser gzhan pa phal cher gyis mi slob/ bod kyi sa cha mang che bar sngon dus bod yig ni chos kyi bya bar bed spyod pa las/ gzhan du be+ed spyod mkhan nyung / dwags po'i sa char yang de dang 'dra/ khyed cag gis bshad pa 'dis kyang dwags po'i mi'i goms gshis de bod spyi dang mthun pa shes thub bo/ /gnyis/ thon skyed bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi 'brel bar gtogs pa dang / gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi lhag 'phro yod pas bod min zer ba la 'di ltar/ mtha' mtshams kyi bod rigs 650

mang che ba'i sar/ thon skyed bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi thon skyed 'brel bar gtogs pa dang / gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi lhag 'phro cung zad tsam yang yod de/ dper na/ dmu dge dang /rnga ba/ zung chu sogs su/ sa bdag dang / zhing phyug gis bshu gzhog byed stangs gtso bo ni bun skyed min la/ gla bkol yin pa dwags po dang 'dra ste/ rgyun gla las gzhan/ dpyid gla(dpyid rmo'i gla ba)/ ston gla(ston bsdu'i gla ba)lta bu dus thung gi gla ba yod pa dwags po dang 'dra ba yin/ rmod zog gtso cher mdzo yin pa dang / khyim bgos la zhing skal dang phyugs skal ster ba/ gnyen sgrig rdzongs pa la'ang ster’ba/ nags tshal dang rtswa sa sde ba spyi la dbang ba/ sa rgod brkosacichog pa sogs kyang gong smos kyi bod rigs 'dus sdod sa cha rnams su dwags po dang 'dra 'dra red/zhing 'debs skabs kyang bod rigs 'dus sdod kyi sa cha dag tu sde bas mnyam las byed pa dang / khyim kha shas kyis mnyam las byed/ khyim gnyis res las sdeb byed pa/ rmod phyugs yod pa dang med pas las sdeb byed pa sogs dmu dge/ shar khogata khog sogs mtha' mtshams kyi bod sde tshang ma yang de 'dra yin la/ dwags po yang de 'dra yin pa khyed cag gis bshad pa ltar 651

red/ cho dwags po tsam du ma zad/ mtha' mtshams kyi bod rigs 'dus sdod kyi yul du ma zhig tu thon skyed byed stangs rjes lus —yin pas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs ha cang smin pa'i tshod du ma slebs pa mang bo yod/ dper na/ 'dzam thang mtha' khul gyi bod rnams lta bu'o/ /gsum/ gyod bshad lugs kyis bod ma red zer ba la 'di ltar/ zung chu'i sa cha kha shas dang / dmu dge chu nag sogs su/kha ba 'go ba dang / mi rgan grags can gyis gyod bshad pa dang /gzu zan mgo rdung zer ba'i tshorgyu zas spyod rgyu dang / khrims lugs kyi yi ge med pa sogs dwags po dang 'dra 'dra red/ yin min ltos dang shes/ bod rigs 'dus sdod kyi sa cha yin pa 'dra'ang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs dar ba dang / sde shog gi lam lugs yin pa sogs 'dra min sna tshogs yod de/ dper na/ dbus gtsang gi lam lugs dang / a mdo mtha'i lam lugs mi 'dra ba dang / zung chu rdzong gcig pu la mtshon na'ang mkhar gyi thag nye'i lam lugs dang / mkhar las cung zad ring ba'i ga cha'i lam lugs mi 'dra ba 3 bu red/bzhi/ dwags po'i rgyan cha dang bza' btung khang ba bzo 652

skrun sogs/ phying zhwa rgyan pas bod ma red zer ba la 'di ltar/phying zhwa ni bod spyi'i lugs yin te/ lha rma chen —gyi sku phying zhwa can bzo ba ni/ bod rang gi cha lugs yin par deb ther dkar po dang klu sgrub dgongs rgyan las bshad/ 'brog pas phying zhwa mgo mdong gyon pa dang / rong bas phying zhwa rlum po mtha' shan can gyon pa red/ dwags po'i zhwa dang 'dra ba gyon mkhan sngar dmu dge dang ta khog sogs la yod par ma zad/ dbus kyi dwags pos spyang phying zhwa de lta bu gyon pa red/ zhwa thog tu bya sgro 'dzugs pas bod ma red zer/ zhwa thog tu bya sgro 'dzugs pa'ang bod kyi lugs yin te/ slob dpon pad+ma'i dbu zhwa bya sgro can gyon pa'i sku 'bri ba'ang bod rang gi lugs ltar bris pa dang / gling seng chen gyi sku 'bri tshe bya sgro can gyi zhwa gyon pa 'bri ba dang / sku rten dang lha ba'i rmog zhwa'i thog tu bya sgro mang bo 'dzugs pa ni bod rang gi cha lugs red/ gna' srol dpa' bo la rgod kyi sgro dang / sdar ma la khwa ta'i sgro 'dogs pa'i srol yang yod / dbus kyi bla ma rig 'dzin rgod 'phru can zer ba'ang zhwa las btags/des na phying zhwa gyon pa dang / mgo la bya sgro 'dzugs pa'ang bod kyi lugs yin pa bshad ma dgos/ gso ma'i lwa gyon pas bod ma red zer/ gso ma'i lwa ba 653

gyon pa'ang bod kyi cha lugs yin te/ rong khul gso ma thon pa'i sa char gso lwa gyon pa dang / phyugs lug cung zad mang ba'i sar phyugs spu'i lu ba gyon pa dang / 'brog khul du phying ba'i gos dang slog pa gyon pa red/ dwags po'i pho'i rigs kyis gos cung zad bab chags pa dang / mo'i rigs kyis gos dang rgyan gzab mchor byed pa'ang bod spyi'i lugs red/ skyes pa'i rum che ba dang bud med kyis ral mthud 'phen pa/ sked rags khra bo dang ras sked bcings pa/ dung dang 'gron bu 'dogs pa/gos kyi phu thung yangs pa dag mdo smad kyi the bo dang hor gtsa nga sogs bod yul so sor yod par ma zad/ bod yul dbus kyi cha lugs kyang red/ rkang dkris bcings pa yang sa rong rtsub sa'i bod mi dag gi cha lub/sa yin te/ mdo smad kyi dwags po ma zad/chu nag rgyud dang / rgyal mo tsha ba rong sogs dang gzhan pa sa rong lhub sa/ dper na/ dbus kyi dwags po/ kong po/ spo bo sogs kyis kyang bcings pa red/ skra la snuma'abyug pa'ang bod kyi goms srol yin te/ 'brog pas mar 'byug pa dang /rong bas phag zhag 'byug pa lta bu'o/ /zas kyang yug po dang / bra bo/ yung ma/ tshod ma sogs za ba ni bod kyi rong khul rgya chen po'i goms gshis red/ da 654

skebs kyang zung chu'i smad rgyud/ chu nag rgyud/ rgyal mo rngul chu'i rgyud sogs kyi bod mi'i sa char ltos dang shes/ bod kyi 'brog phyogs su sha za rgyu mod pa dang / rong phyogs su sha za rgyu nyung ba dang / rta sha bong sha khyi sha mi za ba ni bod spyi'i goms gshis red/ 'brog phyogs grang ngar che sar sha rjen za yang rong phyogs su dwags po ltar sha rjen cher mi za/ mar chur la dga' mi dga' rong 'brog dang stod smad la khyad par yod/ shar ja mi 'thung bas bod ma red zer/ shar ja ni khams dang dbus gtsang gi bod mis kyang mi 'thung / rgan gzhon gyi brtsi 'jog dang / pho mo'i brtsi 'jog kyang bod rigs kazhan dag dang dwags po 'dra/ dkyil krung gis 'dug pa dang / sha phos gtub pa dang / phye mos bsno ba sogs kyang bod spyi'i goms srol red/khang ba rdo khang gru bzhi/ lho phyokas su kheb thog gam nyin ra yod pa/ shing gi kher skas yod pa/ khang 'og tu phyugs dang khang steng du mi 'dug pa dag bod kyi lugs srol yin pa zung chu/chu nag dmu dge/ rnga ba/ mtsho sngon sogs la ltos dang shes/khra sgam gyi steng du mchod pa bshams pa/ khra sgam nang du dkar yol dem sogs sgrig pa/ dkyil du me thab lcags sgyed rkang gsum dang / thab ka'i gong ngam byang du bza' dpon 'dug 655

pa dang / khang thog tu mchod khang / yang thog tu rtswa dang phub ma 'jog pa/ nub mo bza' dpon dang rgan pa las gzhan rnams thab kyi mthar nyal ba/ khang thog gshags ma ste gshags pa'i shing leb kyis 'gebs pa sogs bod lugs red/ the bo/ co no/ zung chu/ dmu dge sogs su da lta'ang de ltar red/ 'go ba dang / phyug po las gzhan la ong stegs dang mdun cog kyang med pa bod gzhan dang 'dra/ gnyen sgrig dang / dur 'debs kyang dwags po'i lugs de bod spyi dang 'dra/ dper na/ dmu dge dang / shar khogamatsho sngon gyi sa cha 'gar yang dgun mer sreg pa dang / dbyar sa dur dang chu dur byed pa red/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang dbyar ro bsregs na yul lha gzhi bdag gi thugs mi dgyes pas lo tog la gnod zer nas sa dur chu dur byed/dwas/sa po'i chos lugs kyang bod kyi gna' chos bon po red/bon po la snga dar dang phyi dar gnyis yod/ snga dar la khyim sngags dang phyi dar la rab byung yang yod/ dwags po'i stod la rab byung yod pa red/ bod kyi rab byung dgon par 'tshogs tshe gzan sham gyon nas chos 'don pa dang / tshogs chos grol rjes grong du song nas zhing las byed mi de shar ba sogs dang dwags po 656

'dra/ yul 'de phyogs nas bon po mkhas pa mang bo byung smyong ba'i skor gyi lo rgyus shar khog gi bon dgon rnams kyi gdan rabs bstan rtsis dag na'ang gsal/ ri brag sogs mchod pas bod ma red zer/ gna'i bon lugs la/ nyi zla skar gsu/ ma mchod yul du byed par ma zad/ ri brag nags tshal la sogs par gnas pa'i lha mchod pa yin pa o rgyan gling ba'i bka' thang shel brag ma las kyang rgyas pa zhig gsungs so/ /ri mgor lab rtse brtsigs nas lab rtse bstod pa dang / tshobasang3gtong ba sogs kyang dwags po dang 'dra bar bod spyi la dar so shin tu che/ dmar mchod byed pa'ang gna'i bon lugs yin te/ gna' dus zla gnyis pa'i nang dmar mchod byed pa yin mod/ chos dar nas chos dar ba'i yul du dmar mchod byed pa mtshams bcad zin pa yang bka' thang na gsal/ zla dang po nas smon lam chen mo 'tshogs pa dang mnyam du/ khyim pa rnams kyis rkyang phyag mchod bskor ba sogs kyi dge sgrub byed par bsgyur/ 'on kyang dwags po'i yul der chos rags rim tsam las ma dar bar bod kyi gna' lug sa ltar zla gnyis pa'i nang dmar mchod dang / zla lnga ba'i bco lnga'i nyin lha mchod pa red/ dwags po ma zad/ shar ba dang khams kyi sa cha 'ga' 657

zhig dmu dgi sogs bod kyi sa cha gzhan du'ang de ltar yin te/sde ba 'ga' zhig gis de'i nyin zog bshas te dmar mchod byed/zla bdun pa'i nang ston bsdu'i sngon zog bshas nas lha mchod cing spro skyid byed pa gna' srol yin/ bcings 'grol rjes su'ang / ston bsdu'i sngon du phyugs lug bshas te/ spang thang du nyin shas la spro skyid byed pa rnga ba dang bla brang sogs su da dung yang yod/ston bsdu'i rjes su zla bcu ba yar mar la ston bsdu rdzogs pa'i dga' ston du lha mchod byed pa'i srol yod pa bzhin du/ phyugs lug bshas nas ri mgor spro skyid byed pa'i srol rnga ba sogs su da lta'ang yod/ des na dwags po'i lam lugs de yang bod kyi goms gshis shig re da/ rgya'i goms gshis kyi shan zhugs pa'i dus ston gcig dang gnyis re yod pa dwags po ma zad/ bod spyi dang khyad par du zung chu sogs mtha' mtshams kyi bod la'ang yod/thab dang mchod lha la gtsang sbra byed pa dang / nad pa khyim du yod dus 'grul ba 'ong du mi 'jug pa dang / gal te yong dgos byung tshe gdon 'dre 'gog pa'i ched du/ mdun du mi ro 'phen pa dang / nad pa khyim du yod tshe/ nye gnas dang / rang gi khyim mi thag ring nas 'ongs tshe/ yang mdun du me ro 'phen pa 658

sogs kyang / bod spyi'i goms gshis red/chab srid kyi go gnas la ma bltos par/ lo na rgan pa la brtsirī bkur byed pa/ rngon pa dag gis rngon khyi la gces spras byed pa/ khyim las gtso bor bud med kyis byed pa/ bud med kyis zhing las byed kyang / rmod las skyes pas byed pa sogs kyis bogam yin pa bsgrub mi nus te/ bod spyi'i goms srol yin par ma zad mi dpa' bo dang ya rabs/ yon tan can la brtsi bkur dang bya dga' ster ba/ gshis ngan dang ma rabs la chad pa gcod pa/bud med kyis khyim las tsam zhig bsgrub rgyu las chab srid kyi las ka la kha grag mi chog pa sogs srong btsan dang khri srong sogs kyi khrims yig tu'ang gsal bor bkod yod pas/ dwags po'i lam lugs tsam zhig ga la yin/ cha lugs ni yul so sor mi 'dra ba cung zad re yod mod/ gzhi rtsa'i thog gcig pa ltar/ dwags po'i cha lugs gzhi rtsa'i thog bod kyi cha lugs red/ rang bzhin 'jam pas bod ma yin zer ga la rung / bod mi dag rang bzhin 'jam po red/ rang bzhin ha cang 'jam pa'i bod mi gzhan yang yod/ glu tshig ni bod kyi yul gru so sor khyad chos re yod pas/ glu tshig ma zad skad kyi gdangs la'ang yul so sor yang lci'i khyad par yod/ rus mi brjod par ming nas 'bod pa bod 659

byings kyi lugs red/ goms gshis la mi rigs gzhan gyi shan shor nas 'dres1pa'i rang bzhin bod rigs gzhan la'ang yod de/ byang phyogs kyi rgya bod mtshams kyi bod mi'i skad kyi nang dang goms gshis la byang rgya'i shan yod pa dang / lho phyogs kyi rgya bod mtshams kyi bod /mi'i skad dang goms 'dris nang / de dag gi de tsho 'dres nas yod pa lta bu red/de ltar༄ bod rigs min pa'i sgrub byed rnams bod rigs yin pa'i sgrub byed du song 'dug chos lugs thad bon po zhes pa'i bod yig de/ bod kyi yul gru so so'i sgra gdangs la khyad par yod de/ dper na/ 'brog khul dag tu/ bon po zhes pa de/ rgya yig ‘‘lkod+ku’’'di'i sgra dang cung 'dra bas/ rgya yig la de 'a/ bri ba mang / nan phin/ zung chu/ chu nag khams kyi rong khul sogs su bon po zhes pa'i sgra ride/ rgya yig gi‘‘4khyi.oṃ zhes pa'i sgra dang thag nye/ der brten zhib 'jug pa 'gas/chos lugs bon po ma red‘‘4khyi.oṃ’’red ces thag bcad/ de lta bu'i chos lugs de'i ston pa su red/ spel mkhan su red/ thog mar sa gang nas dar ba red/ 'o na zung chu dang / nan phin gyi bon dag kyang chos lugs de red dam/ de dag gi ngag lam nas/ bon po zhes pa‘‘4'i.oṃ’’zhes pa'i sgra dang thag nye ba dwags 660

po'i sgra dang 'dra 'dra 'byung ba'i phyir/ des na 'di'i zhib 'juke byed tshul ni/ rtsod sgrub kyi dngos gtso smra ba'i lugs shig ga la yin te/ zla gcig tsam gyis tshang ma khong du chud khul byas te thag bcad 'asag tha na dwags po dang nye ba'i nan phin dang zung chu sogs kyi bod kyi goms gshis lugs srol dag kyang ma mthong ma shes 'dug ste/ de dag dang gcig pa gcig rkyang gi goms 'dris lugs srol rnams khyer yong nas/ bod rigs min pa'i sgrub byed byas 'dug gzhan go thos khungs ldan la zhib 'jugari pa rnams kyis dwags po'i sa cha na rdo ring yod pa'i ngos la rgya yig ma yin pa'i yi ge yod pa dang / bod yig gi glegs bam rnyed pa red zer/'on kyang yar zhu'i yig cha'i nang du sgra tsam yang ma bshad/ de dag gi par blangs nas khyer yong na/ deng dus lo rgyus zhib 'jug la ma kho yang / ma mthong ma rig pa'i tshul du 'jam mog ge 'dug rdo ring gi yi ge de yang bod kyi gna' yig yin rgyu red snyam/mdor na/ rtsod sgrub kyi rigs pas mi rigs kyi khyad par 'byed pa'i rtsa ba'i rtsa don la bstun te/ gong du bshad pa'i zhib 'jug gi dpyad gzhi la brten nas dbye 'byed byas na/ dwags byu 66lha

po'i mi'i skad lugs/ goms gshis/ rgyun srol/ thon skyed rnam pa/ spyi tshogs kyi rtsa 'dzugs sogs gang thad nas bod rigs dang thun mong ba shas che bas/ dwags po bod rigs yin pa'i sgrub byed dang khungs btsun la/ tis rigs yin pa'i khungs cung zad kyang thewa do/ / 66lha

dwags po'i mi rigs kyi skor la lta stangs bshad pa/ deng sang phen wu rdzong khongs su yod pa'i dwags po zhes pa'i bod rigs kyi skor la/ rang gis dpyad pa'i rtsom yig gnyis bris shing / gnyis ka si khron zhing chen mi rigs zhib 'jug khang gi dus deb thog rgya yig tu bkod 'dug bod yig ni mtsho sngon mi〈〈sbrang char〉〉1981lo'i deb2pa'i thog bkod 'dug da skabaṣ+kayang de la zhib 'jug byed kyin yod par thos pas / slar yang rang gis shes tshod 'ga' zhig bri bar bya ste/'ga' zhig gis de bod ma yin pa'i sgrub byed la mgo la bya spu btsugs pa bkod 'dug des na mgo la bya spu btsugs pa ni bod kyi gna'i cha lugs yin te/ rgyal rabs gsal me'i lcags par shog grangs236gi thig phreng gnyis pa naslogayo dge 'byung /gtsang rab gsal/ dmar shākya mu ne gsum sgom gyin yod pa 663

la/ btsun pa gcig gis sham thabs brdzis/ lag tu mda' gzhu thogs/ mgo la bya sgro btsugs nas 'phral du khyi khrid nas ri dwags gshor gyin 'dug pa g.yo dge 'byung gis mthong nas zhes dang / klong chen chos 'byung las mdzad pa gtsang rab gsal/ bo dong ba g.yo dge 'byung / stod lung ba dmar shākya mu ne dang gsum dpal chu bo ri la sgom zhing yod pa'i dus su btsun pa khyi khrid rnga gshang brdungs shing mgo la bya sgro btsugs/sham thabs snga log phyi log byas nas ri dwags la mda' 'phen pa thab kha bas mthong bas ma byin nas ban rgan 'khrul lam btsun pa spyo zer zhing gzigs pas mthong ba bzhin smos so/ /slob dpon ma 'khrul btsun pa ma spyos/ rgyal bos btsun pa skya sar phab pa red zer zhes gsungs pa ni glang dar mas btsun pa rnams skya sar phab pa'i rtags la mgo la bya sgro 'dzugs dgos par bshad/ yang mi la'i mgur 'bum ras pa zhu ba 'od kyi skor tsho las ldem bya rgyal rgod kyi 'phru do btsugs/ /zhes ras pa zhu ba 'od kyi mgo thog tu bya rgod kyi sgro btsugs yod par bshad/ de ltar lo brgyad brgya'i sngon du yang bod kyi gzhon nu dag gi mgor bya sgro btsugs yod par bshad/ phyis su rim gyis cha lugs de nyams na yang sa cha 'gar cha lugs de da dung yod par mngon/664

ge sar gyi sgrung du'ang mgo la bya sgro btsugs yod tshul gyi sgrung glu mang / lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi nang sgo'i g.yas phyogs kyi gyang thang ngor gna' dus kyi lus rtsal sbyong ba'i ri mo bkod yod la/ de'i lus rtsal pa dag gi mgor yang bya sgro btsugs yod pa bris 'dug pa bdag gis mthong / phyis su bod ljongs kyi dmag rtsed dang dus chen/ gtor rgyag sogs kyi skabs su bya sgro can gyi zhwa gyon pa'i srol bcings 'grol bar du yod/ der ma zad rgyal rong sogs bod kyi sa cha 'ga' zhig tu gtor rgyag so/gas kyi skabs su dmangs dmag gis lus la go khrab gyon/ mgo la bya sgro can gyi zhwa gyon pa'i srol lugs yod/ rgyu mtshan de dag gis rnam 'phel dang than wu sogs kyi dwags po'i mi'i mgo la bya sgro 'dzugs pa ni bod kyi gna'i cha lugs dngos gnas yin no/ /de ni dwags po'i mi rnams bod rigs yin pa'i rtags mtshan yang dag cig yin/ ming 'dogs tshul ni bod kyi dmag rnams rgya bod sa mtshams su bzhag pa thang yig gsar rnying las shin tu gsal/des na 'di dag ni dwags po nas 'ongs pa'i dmag mi shas che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis bod kyis dwags po zhes 'bod/ rgya mi dag gis derakhyaphoste pe ma bod rigs zer/ de ni bod dmag ces 665

pa'i sgra bris pa yin te/ zung chu dang chu nag dang rnam 'phel phyogs kyi skad kyi gdangs la bod ces pa'i gdangs ni pe dang /dmag ces pa'i gdangs ni ma zhes pa'i sgra gdangs dang 'dra/ da dung yang de dag gi skad kyi gdangs la bod dmag ces pa pe ma stekhyaphezhes pa'i sgra dang mtshungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis rgya mi dag gis pe ma bod rigs(zipaṃsaṭha)zer/goms 'dris gshis lugs kyi thog nas/ zung chu'i shar ba zhis pa'i bod dang nga rang gi pha yul dmu dge zhes pa'i bod sogs dang goms 'dris gshis lugs 'dra la/ der ma zad khang ba phub lugs/ lha mchod lugs/ dur 'debs lugs sogs kyang 'dra ba yin la/ bud med dag gi cha lugs ni bod ljongs kyi cha lugs dang mtshungs/ skad lugs kyang bod kyi gna' skad yin gshis/ des kyang 'di dag ni bod rigs yin par shin tu 'grub/ chos lugs kyang bod kyi gna' chos bon po shas che/bon zhes pa'i sgra ni de dag gi skad gdangs la pe zhes pa'i sgra dang 'dra/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis de dag gis chos lugs ni pe po'u zhes pa chos shig yin par 'dod pa ni bla rdol lo/ /yi ge yang bod yig las gzhan pa'i yi ge med/ chos 'don pa dang dom yig sogs la'ang bod yig bed spyod bzhin pa red/ de ga'i 666

sngon gyi rgya bod sa mtshams kyi rdo ring ngos su'ang rgya bod kyi yi ge gnyis ka yod par grags/ sngar 'ga' zhig gis zhib 'jug byas pa'i snyan zhu'i yi ge risnga phyi gnyis bris pa ngas mthong mod/ de dag skabs su bshad pa'i yul de'i goms 'dris gshis lugs sogs ni bod yin pa'i sgrub byed sha stag las/ tis tso zhes pa'i mi rigs yin pa'i sgrub byed gcig kyang mi 'dug go/ /sngar gyi snyan zhu gnyis ka la dpyad gtam bris zin pas bskyar zlos mi byed/ sngar dwags po yin min gyi dogs pa ma byung la/ nye char tis tso zer ba'i mi rigs red ces pa'i gtam zhig bsgrags byung ba'i rkyen gyis do snang byed mkhan je mang du song / bod ljongs nas bzung ste a mdo'i mtha'i bar gyi bod mi dag gis 'di dag sngar bzhin bod yin par ngos 'dzin gyin yod/ khyad par du khong tsho'i yul gyi bod mi dmangs mang che ba kho tsho bod ma red zer ba la khong khro lang gin rong gi mi dang 'dra'o/ /zhes bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas rab gnas 1987lo la/ rnga stod sgo mang nas brtsams shing yoge ba ni shes rab ral gri'o/ / 667

ngo sprod phran bu/rnam par dkar ba'i zer phreng gis/ /byu rnam dkar kun dga' mdzes zhal phyes/ /rnam mang rig pa'i mdzod phyes nas/ /rnam bkra bdag blo gter du bsgrubs/ /'dir gleng bar bya ba ni/ deng sang rgya mi 'ga' zhig gis/rgyus med rgyus gtam gyis bod kyi mtha' mtshams kyi mi rigs ske 'di dang 'di bod min no zhes dum gcod dum gcod kyi bya ba la zhugs te/ 'brel med ltar snang gi sgrub byed sha stag bkod nas lung rigs rnam dag gi rtsom pa dag la tshan rig dang shin tu mi mthun no zhes gshe bar byed pa'i yig rdzob nyin re las nyin rer mang bar 'gyur bzhin pa dang / tha na bod la gling seng chen lta bu'i dpa' bo dang / thon mi sam bho ṭa lta bu'i mkhas pa/lo rgyus yang dag pa rtsom mkhan gyi mkhas pa byung ma myong ngo zhes smod la/ rang rigs kyi mi mgo yang 'ga' zhig gis kyang chu sga gar myusgobyi

khrid kyi tshul du me thog tu shing snon par byed do/ /des na 'dir the bo rong gi mi'i byung tshul la'ang log gtam 'ga' thos pa'i rkyen gyis/ re zhig de 'i byung tshul tsam brjod par bya ste/mdo smad chos 'byung deb ther rgya mtsho zhes bya ba las mdo smad lho byang gi mi phal cher bod chos rgyal gyis rgya bod so mtshams su bzhag pa las mched pa sha stag yin pas skad rigs la'ang brda rnying sta 'gyur ba mang zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon rgya'i rgyal bo thang gi dus su/ sa 'di rgyas bzung stabs/ rnga ba sogs su rgya mkhar mang bo yod mod/ srong btsan gyi dus bod dmag khri phrag mang bo btang ste/ rgya cham la phab/ 'di phyogs kyi rgya'i kru'u mang bo bcom nas/ rkyang chu'i rgyud dang / chu dkar rgyud/chu nag rgyud/ tsha chu'i rgyud sogs su bod dmag rnams bzhag ste/sa mtshams srung du bcug pa'i mi rgyud ni sa de dag gi bod rnams yin la/ the bo'i sa 'di yang de'i skabs nas bod kyis bzung ba dang / slar yang khri srong gi dus su ngan lam ta ra klu gong dmag dpon du bskos te dmag btang / bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa bcom/rgyal bo dharma pā la dang / g.yu'i thub pa rang byon/ bse 'bag smug chung sogs rdzas dang yo byad thams cad khyer/ de'i skabs dmag nang nas skyen po btus pa'i dpa' bo mi dgu dmag dang 669

bcas pa sa mtshams su bzhag ste/ rgyal bo'i bka' ma log bar du yar yong mi chog pa'i bka' phab/ de'i stabs kyis de dag gi mi rgyud la ka ma log tu grags shing / deng sang gi dpal ris dang / sos nan sogs mdo smad byang phyogs kyi bod rigs phal cher de las mched pa red/the bo'i sa cha 'dir yang khri srong gi dus su so mtshams srung ba'i dmag bzhag pa gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar las gsungs/ mdo smad chos 'byung las/ de yang khri ral pa can gyis tsong khar dmag gi gzi byin bskyed pa'e dar bo che phyar/ dmag rtsis dang go bsher mdzad dus dar ba zer bas g.yag chen po gnyis mchan khung du bcug ste sa la ma reg par khyer bas/ cen dar ba g.yag khur zhes ming thogs pa dang / dmag sde thams cad las de bud pas/ de bud du thogs/ rgya bod kyi sa mtshams gnon pa'i dmag dpon du bskos/ theb jus brag dkar gnyan gyi pho brang la btsan mkhar brtsigs te/ mdo smad kyi mi dpon byas/ zhes gsungs pa dang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar las/ de phud g.yag khur du grags pa rgya'i kha gnon du bzhag ste theb ju brag dkar gnyan gyi pho brang du mkhar bzung 670

nas bsdad pa'i lho phyogs the bo stod smad gnyis su grags pa las/the bo stod ma zhes pa ri brag gi sa char gnas shing / dpa' rtsal ngom pa'i dud tshang khri phrag brgal ba'i yul gru de las 'breng ba zhes pa chad/ ces sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na the bo'i mi dag gi 'byung khungs de 'dra yin la/ the bo zhes pa'i ming thogs tshul ji 'dra yin/ zhes 'dri na/ de ni 'di ltar thogs pa yin te/ sngar bshad pa ltar/ dar ba g.yag khur ni/ dmag sde thams cad las de bud pas/ de'i ming la de bud dam de phud du thogs/ de'i dmag sde chen po de'i ming la'ang de phud du grags/ de dus dang da lta'ang de phyogs kyi skad kyi gdangs la de dang the gnyis sgra shin tu nye ba dang / phud dang bud dang po rnams kyang sgra shin tu nye ba'i stabs kyis/ phyis su brda 'gyur nas the bo zhes 'bod cing bris pa red/ 'di la 'khyog bshad srid kyang don dngos gnas ming thogs tshul 'di red/ de ltar brda 'gyur ba ni the bo ma zad gzhan yang mang ste/dper na pra sti ni pra sde brda 'gyur ba thu'u bkwan rnam thar las gsungs pa dang / dmu dge la sngar dmod dge zer yang / phyis su brda 'gyur nas dmu dge zhes 'bod pa dang / kha mas kyi sa'i cha mgar thar la de ga'i rong khul gyi yul skad kyi dbang gis 67tsā

'ga' tha zer ba/ 'brog pas gdangs de ni dag 'don gyi tshul du 'ga' dag zer ba lta bu mang / dpon gyi ming yul sde la thogs pa'ang mang ste/ dper na/rgyal mo tsha ba rong du sdod pa'i dmag sde chen po'i 'go dpon gyi ming la kho phan zer zhing / de la bod rgyal gyis bka' gnang tshe/rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi kho phan la zhes bka' shog gnang bar byed/phyis tshig sdud byas te/ tsha rong kho phan la zhes chab shog bskur/de'ang tshig sdud byas te tsha kho la zhes chab shog bskur ba sogs kyi dbang gis/ yul sde la'ang tsha kho zhes ming chags te/ deng sang gi bar tsha kho zhes 'bod pa de lta bu red/ rgyal rong zhes pa rgyal mo tsha ba rong zhes pa'i ming tshig sdud byas pa red/ de'i stabs kyis sngon gyi chos 'byung rgyal rabs rnam thar tshang mar rgyal rong zhes rgya'i rjes 'jug la la yig yod pa las med pa gcig kyang mthong rgyu med/ da lta 'ga' zhig gis rgyal rong zhes pa'i rgya'i rjes 'jug gi la bcad nas/ rgya rong zhes pa mi rgya rigs yin pa dang rong khul yin pas de ltar brjod ces rjod mkhan yang yod/ ming de thogs don ni yul 'dir rgyal mo dmu rdo zhes pa'i gnas ri grags pa can zhig yod/ rgyal mo rngul chu'i chu rgyud kyi ri thams cad ri de'i ri rgyud red/ ri de'i ri rgyud dang chu rgyud 672

kyi tsha ba cung che ba'i yul chen de la rgyal mo tsha ba rong zer/bod yul 'di la tsha ba rong zer ba gnyis yod pa las/ mdo smad kyi tsha ba rong 'di la rgyal mo tsha ba rong zer zhing / stod kyi tsha ba rong de la lho tsha ba rong zer/ bai ro tsa na rgyangs 'phud gtong ba'i tsha ba rong ni rgyal mo tsha ba rong red/ khong btson du 'jug mkhan gyi rgyal bo mdo bzher nag po'i rgyal rgyud ni rgyal nag lcags mgon tshang zer ba da lta'ang yod/ khong gis phyag 'debs mdzad pa'i mdo'i dgon pa chu pho nor bu'i gling ni rdzi 'gag rgyal sa'i thag nye na yod/ sngags kyi dgon pa bde chen gling ni khro chu'i khog na yod/ khong5gi sgrub phug 'bar khams kyi gong du spyi le bcu nyag cig gi mtshams su yod la mjal mkhan yang mang / dmu dge'i smad dang / shar dung ri sogs su yang khong gi sgrub phug yod/ deng sang rgyus med rgyus gtam la dga' mkhan cung mang gshis/ rgan po khom bar zhig la zhar byung du 'di dag ngo sprod phran bu byas so/ / 673

ra ma r+ṇa'i rtsogs brjod las stsom da der rjo ( / ra / war / no gleng bar bya ba/kharnam dag shes bya'i gnas la dbang 'byor zhing / /legs bshad 'od snang snang ba'i shis pa yis /'jig rten dkar chab gtong ba'i sngon byon la/ /gzur gnas 'dren byed glog gi zhags pa 'phen/ /zhang zhung dpal gyi rigs las legs 'khrungs pa/ /chos dang rig pa'i gnas la rang dbang spyod/ / grags pa sprin gyi rnga sgra rgod pa der/ /gusalhan yid kyi mdongs mthas mig 'bur gartod/ /gang gi dpal gyi mgul las legs thon pa'i/ /rtogs brjod dri za'i rgyud mang stong gi zla/ /dka' 'grel nyi ma 'bar ba'i 'od gzi yis/ /dka' gnad pad ma stong gi sbrubs rgya grol/ /de ltar shis pa brjod pa'i snyan tshig gi me tog dkar bo'i —674

sil ma gtor bas sdun bsus te gleng bar bya ba ni/ ji skad du/rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ mkhas pa nyid ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min/ /mtshungs med rgyas pa'i snyan ngag med na mkhas pa nyid ni ne tso'i klog dang mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar snyan ngag med na bstan bcos dag ne tsos cal col smra ba dang mtshungs pas/ rig gnas chung ba lnga'i ya gyal/ che ba lnga'i sgra rig pa'i phyogs su gtogs par gsungs pa'i snyan ngag gi rig pa ni/ med du mi rung ba zhig yin te/ snyan ngag gi tshig rgyan sbyor tshul sogs legs par shes na/ sngon rabs kyi lo rgyus dang / rig gzhung rtsom pa sogs la tshig don yid 'asbog pa'i ngag gi sgo yangs por 'byed nus pa sogs la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po 'grub cing snyan pa'i grags pa nam yang mi nyams pa sogs kyi phan yon yod la/ snyan ngag ma shes na/ rang gi bstan bcos rtsom mi shes shing / gal te rtsom khul byas na'ang rna bar snyan zhing 'jebs pa zhig mi 'ong ba dang /gzhan gyis brtsams pa'i snyan ngag gis brgyan pa'i bstan bcos kyi don mi go zhing 'grel mi nus la/ tha na log par go ba dang log par bkral nas rang gzhan phyin ci log tu 'khrid cing /675

gzhan gyis tshar gecod pa'i gnas su 'gyur ro/ /des na snyan ngag la mkhas par 'gyur ba'i rgyu ni/ skyes sbyangs kyi shes rab che ba dang / shes rab ha cang che ba min yang sngon byung gi lo rgyus sogs rig gnas spyi dang / bye brag snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhung dag la sbyang ba dang blta klog dang 'don pa sogs byas na myur du snyan ngag la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhung gi brjod bya ni/ snyan ngag me long las/sngon byung gtam las gyur pa'am/ /cig shos legs pa la brten pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon byung gi gtam rgyud la sbyar ba dang /cig shos te da lta'i bya ba dang dngos po sogs kyi brjod don la brten nas rtsom pa yin no/ / des na snyan ngag rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod 'di'i brjod bya ni/ sngon rgya gar du grags pa'i rig byed kyi gtam rgyud rā ma ṇa ste dga' byed kyis srin po'i rgyal bo btul ba'i gtam rgyud de yin la/ 'ji/ ni bha ra ta zhes bya ba'i gzhung la brten nas/drang srong grog mkhar zhes bya bas brtsams par grags/ 'di'i rgya dpe ni sngar sne 'u gdong gi gtsug lag khang du yod par mngon 676

brjod 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel ba'i 'gyur byang rmes bshad/gtam rgyud de 'dzamagagling du snyan grags che ba'i gtam rgyud cig yin gshis/ dbyin yig dang / rgya nag gi yi ger yang bsgyur yod 'dug la/ bod 'dir yang sngar rgya gzhung dngos 'gyur yod par nges te/ go thos la/ tun hong nas 'gyur mi 'dra ba gnyis phyi rgyal gyis khyer song zer/ da lta 'gyur gzhung dngos mthong ba'i yul du ma gyur mod/ mkhas pa rim byon gyi ngag rgyun la lo rgyus phal cher tshang yod pa dang / gtam rgyud de la sbyar ba'i snyan ngag gi rtsom mang po yod/ dper na/ kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rang rnam rtogs brjod ke ta ka'i phreng mdzes las/ tshig spyi'i ri dwags snyegs min rnam dpyod kyis/ /ha nu man thari 'phrul brten legs bsgom pas/ /dngos 'dzin 'bod grogs phra rags mang 'char mgo /mtha' bral ral gris bcad/ / ces tshig spyi ri dwags kyi gzugs su bkod/ rnam dpyod ha nu man tha'i gzugs su bkod/ bden 'dzin srin po'i rgyal bo'i mgo bo'i gzugs su bkod/ zab mo'i lta ba nyag phran gyi gzugs su bkod pa'o/ /677

gtam rgyud 'di ni/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bos ke ta ka'i phreng mdzesakyi rnam bshad tshig don gsal ba/ zhes pa'i nang du khungs ldan mdor bsdus pa zhig gsungs yod/rgyal bo rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud las brtsams pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos dri za'i bu mo'i rgyud mang zhes bya ba 'di rtsom pa bo ni/ zhang zhung ba chos dbang grags pa yin la/ 'di ba rje tsong kha pa chen po'i slob ma mkhas chen brgya phrag mang bo'i nang gi snyan grags can zhig yin te/ mus sad pa blo gros rin chen seng ge dang / 'di ba gnyis la/ rnam dpyod phul du byung ba'i mkhas pa gnyis zhes grags/ 'di ba rab byung bdun pa'i shing sprel (1404)la 'khrungs/ rab byung brgyad pa'i sa glang (1469)la 'das/ rtogs brjod 'di khong dgung grangs so lnga bzhes pa/sa pho rta'i (1438)lo la rje tsong kha pa'i gdan sa dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du sbyar ba red/rtogs brjod 'di'i 'grel ba dri med shel gyi 'bab stegs zhes bya ba 'di rtsom pa bo ni zhal shul ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgya mtsho yin la/ 'di ba mdo smad kyi rma klung dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram gyi 'brog khul khro kho zhes pa'i yul du 'khrungs(deng sang kan lho'i rma chu rdzong)/ khong chung dus nas dge bshes khe tha tshul 678

khrims kyi sprul skur ngos 'dzin byas na'ang / gzhon dus nas za brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos grwar zhugs/ grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i lugs kyis slob gnyer gnang ste/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pas/ mkhas pa'i grags pa 'bar/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i mjug tsam la 'das/ rtogs brjod 'di la bkra shis lhun po'i par zhig yod 'dug kyang / bris par gang la'ang ma dag rgyun 'byams su song ba mang ba dang / tshig don kha shas go dka' na'ang 'grel ba med stabs/ dpal ris dge bshes blo bzang chos 'phel gyis zhal shul tshang la 'grel ba zhig rtsom skul gnang bar brten/ zhal shul tshang gis 'grel ba 'di brtsams pa red/ khong gis sreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du yi ge ma dag pa bcos shing / dka' gnad rnams legs par bkral bas/ 'grel ba rmad du byung ba zhig byung / sngar par yod med cha ma 'tshal/ da lam yig nag bris ma mi dag pa mang ba zhig bdag gi lag tu 'byor ba si khron mi rigs dpe skru na khang gis par du skrun rgyu byas tshe phran gyis mgo nas mjug bar zhu dag byed khul byas mod/ spyir phran skyes sbyangs kyi blo gros dman zhing / mig kyang mi gsal bas/ nor ba dang shor ba yod nges pas/ mkhye na ldan rnams kyis zhu chen679

yang dag pa mdzad par zhu/ rnam dpyod bdud rtsi'i mtsho la nyer chags pa'i/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i 'dab ma 'bum grol te/ /dge mtshan bye ba'i dpal ldenatrī dri bsung gis / /yangs pa'i 'jig rten 'di kun khyab gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rtog ge ba bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas rab rgyal lcags sprel lo'i tsha dus su sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni ras chung ba dkon mchog shes rab bo/ / 680 ri

gling seng chen gyi byang ba mdor bsdas/ ra ༄na mo gu ru bh+ya/ sna tshogs sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor la brten nas/ /sna tshogs spros pa'i snang ba 'bum 'char zhing / /snatshogs duḥ kha'i dgra bo bcom dang lhan/ /sna tshogs bde dga' rgyas pa'i dpal de bsngags/ /'dir gling seng chen nor bu dga'adul 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal bo zhes grags pa de'i dngos don gyi lo rgyus 'ga' zhig brjod par bya ste/ gling ge sar 'di ni mdo khams su sku 'khrungs te/ dpa' rtsal rab tu rgyas nas phyogs bzhi'i dgra 'dul mkhan gyi bod kyi mi dpa' bo zhig yin pas snyan pa'i grags pa yongs la khyab/ de ni mi ngo ma yin min gyi dogs pa/ sngon gyi mkhas mchog su la'ang skyes ma myong3 / 'on kyang / bar skabs shig nas bzung / dngos don la zhib 'jug med pa'i gtam sna tshogs shig smra ba rna ba'i lam du son pa 'ga' zhig brjod na/kha cig gis/ 'di lha smung zhig yin pa las/ don dngos 681

la 'di lta bu'i mi zhig mid do zer/ de ni mi 'thad de/ gling mi re'i kha na sgrung re zer ba ltar/ g.yul 'gyed re re'i skabs su dmag mi rang rang gi snang tshul dang lta tshul cung re mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis sgrung glu dag la khyad par cung re yod pa dang / mkhas pa so sos legs bcos byas pa dang / lha sgrung bsres pa 'ga' re yod pa ma gtogs/ gzhi rtsa'i thog sgrung gi nang du bshad pa bzhin/ mi dpa' bo lag rjes can zhig yin pa ni/ de'i lag rjes dang / rjes shul gyi dngos rdzas/ pha yul/ mi rgyud/ mi sde dang bcas pa da dung mngon sum du yod pa 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /yang kha cig gis deb ther du bkod pa ltar na/ bod kyi ge sar zer ba de ni mi rigs gzhan zhig yin te/ bod kyi byang phyogs kyi mi rigs shig yin pa dang / drag rtsal can gye ming red/mi rigs de ni rgyun par bod la btsan 'dzul byed mkhan zhig red/ deb ther mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ rgya nag rgyal bo shing la sbrul 'khyil 'dra/ci /ge sar rgyal bo shing la rta btags 'dra/ /zhes dang / pad ma bka' thang du rgya gar/ rgya naga.o rgyan/ stag gzig ge sar sogs za hor la song zhes bris/'di dag gi nang du ge sar ni byang phyogs kyi ru dpon gyi spyi ming 682

red/ srong btsan gyis rgya bza' kong jo slong dus yang ge sar dmag gi rgyal bo yod ces bris te/ mthong rgya dang zhib 'jug med par kha tshon gcod pa la dga' nas/ srong btsan dus kyi sog po ge sar dmag gi rgyal bo dang / bod sil bur 'thor ba'i dus kyi bod mi ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gnyis gcig red snyam pa'i ri bong gnam rdib kyi dogs pa 'dra ba zhig skyes 'dugade ni ra mgo lug sbyar yin te/ sngon mkhas mchog su la de gnyis gcig red snyam pa'i 'khrul blo ma skyes shing / skye don yang med de/ ge sar dmag gi rgyal bo ni byang phyogs sog po'i yul gyi rgyal bo dmag shed can zhig yin pas/ ge sar dmag gi rgyal bo zer la/ de'i rgyal rgyud ni sog po'i o rod tsho drug gi rgyal rgyud rnams yin zhing / rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dus su bod yongs la dbang bsgyur nas/ bod srid rgyal dbang lnga bar 'bul mkhan bstan 'dzin chos rgyal zer ba'ang de'i rgyud yin te/ sde srid gtsang ba'i lo rgyus las‘‘stag gzig nor gyi rgyal bo ni/ rgya gar kha che'i mtha' yi sog po phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po las nor bu lon pa 'di rnams yin zhing / bha ta hor gyi rgyal bo ni sog po gzhung drug tu grags pa de yin pa dang / ge sar dmag gi rgyal bo ni/o rod cho drurga/ gi rgyal rgyud/ bstan 'dzin chos rgyal ni 'di'i 683

rgyud pa yin ’zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gna' dus bod mi dag gis byang dang nub kyi mi rigs gzhadz+wa pa rnams la sog po zhes spyi ming du 'bod pas/ stag gzig la'ang nub phyogs kyi sog po zhig ces 'bod do/ /ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul la ge sar zhes pa'i ming thogs tshul dang bod mi yin tshul sogs 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur la/ des na ming gi thog ma 'dra ba'i mi thams cad gcig yin par ma sems shig yang yi ge ma mthong yang rgyus med kyi mi rigs gzhan pa kha cig gis/ gling ge sar ni khri srong lde btsan red zer gyin 'dugaces pa'i gtam thos so/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ de lta bu'i dogs pa sngon gyi mkhas mchog su la'ang skyes ma myong zhing / skye don yang med de/ khri srong dang gling seng chen gnyis byung dus dang skye yul dang / phyag rjes dang / ming dang / srid kyi khyab khongs sogs gtan nas mi 'dra ba yin te/ byung dus/ khri srong ni bstan pa snga dar bod khams gcig gyur gyi skabs yin pa smos ma dgos/gling ge sar ni bod sil bur thor nas/ dpa' bo btsan shed can dang / mkhas pa snyan grags can gyis tsho shog gi mgo bsdu ba tsam las/ bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal bo med pa'i dus su byung ba yin pa ni/ des bsten pa'i bla ma dang / de'i sde shog gi lam lugs/684

lha la 'bod skul dang mchod gsol gyi sgrung glu sogs kyis shes la/sngon gyi lo rgyus rnams las kyang de 'khrungs dus rab byung dang po —yas mas su btsal ba las/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su byung ba yin min gyi dogs pa sngon gyi mkhas mchog su la'ang ma skyes shing /skye don yang med do/ /skye yul/ khri srong dbus kyi yar lung bsam yas phyogs su 'khrungs pa ni rtsod med mgrin gcig yin la/ gling seng chen ni mdo khams su 'khrungs pa la bod kyi mkhas chen dag la rtsod pa med cing / mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig yin no/ /phyag rjes/ khri srong gi phyag rjes gtso bo ni/ mkhan slob gnyis sogs rgya bal gyi mkhas pa mang bo spyan drangs/ rab byung gi sde gsar du btsugs/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ sgra bsgyur khang btsugs te/ chos dang rig gnas kyi gtsug lag pod brgya phrag mang bo bsgyur te/ bstan pa dang rig gnas shin tu dar bar mdzad pa de yin la/ dus mtshungs su mtha' bzhi dbang du bsdu ba'i g.yul las kyang mdzad do/ / gling seng chen gyi phyag rjes gtso bo ni/ bod kha 'thor du song ba'i skabs su/ phyogs kyi rgyal bo dag gis bod kyi rgyal srid nyams nas/ gcig gyur med pa shes te/ bod la brnyas gtse 68bya

dang btsan gnod byed pa yino la/ gling ge sar gyis gnas tshudze+ede mthong nas/ gzhon ge sar gyi dus nas blo rno zhing dpa' sems mkha' la 'phyur te/ gling gi dpa' rtul(dpa' thul yang zer)mang bo rang dang soms kyi 'char sgo mthun pa'i grogs su bkug nas/ rnam par rgyal ba'i g.yul las sha stag byas te/ btsan gnod byed pa'i phyi'i rgyaldokhab kyi rdzong chen bco brgyad sogs bcom pa dang / bod nang gi mi ser gyi bde 'jags gtor bshig byed pa'i jag dpon stobs ldan bdud rgyal zer ba sogs bcom nas/ bod 'bangs bde la bkod pa las gzhan rgya bal gyi mkhas pa gdan drangs nas/ rab byung gi sde gsar du btsugs pa/ sgra bsgyur khang btsugs nas gtsug lag mang bo bsgyur ba sogs ni/ sgrung yig dang rnam thar lo rgyus gang na'ang med/slob dpon pad ma spyan drangs tshul re yod kyang / de ni dag snang gi brgyud pa zhes pa de yin tshul sgrung rang gi gsung tshul la bltas na shin tu gsal/ de lta bu'i lha sgrung bsres pa yod/ming yang / khri srong gi mtshan la/ khri srong lde btsan zhes gsol ba las/ ge sar dang / seng chen dang / nor bu dgra 'dul zhes ming sus kyang ma btags la/ sus kyang de ltar mi 'bod cing / sus kyang lo rgyus su bris med/ de ltar med kyang 686

khri srong gi mdzad pa rnam thar la sgro btags nas lha sgrung bris pa red zer na/ de yang mi 'thad de/ khri srong gi mdzad pa la sbyar na/ mtshan dang de'i mdzad pa'i gtso bo la sbyar nas sgro 'dogs dgos te/ dper na/ thang sin nub skyod kyi sgrung lta bu la mtshon na/ thang sin gyi mtshan snyan de gzhir bzung nas/ de nub phyogs su chos len du song zhing / nub phyogs nas chos gdan drangs pa'i mdzad pa'i gtso bo la sgro btags nas lha sgrung chen po bris pa lta bu dgos kyi/ 'brel med kyi sgrung zhig khyer 'ongs nas/ btsan shed kyis khri srong dang 'brel ba byed pa ni/ rna bar 'ong ba'i gtam min no/ /de bzhin du gling ge sar la'ang / khri srong lde btsan zhes pa'i mtshan yod pa sgrung dang lo rgyus gang na yang med la/ming 'di khri srong la sbyar na e 'grig snyam pa tsam yang med/srid kyi khyab khongs kyang / khri srong gis bod spyi la dbang bamyur cing / srid kyi gzhi sa gtso bo ni dbus gtsang yin te/rgyal sa'i shul dang / phyag rjes kyi bsam yas sogs de gar gnas/ mi rgyud kyang bod kyi rgyal rgyud tshang ma red/ gling seng chen gyis gtso cher mdo khams su dbang bsgyur cing / srid kyi gzhi sa yang gtso bo de gar gnas pa yin te/ de'i rgyal rgyud gling 'gu zi rgyal bo da dung yod la/ seng chen khong dang / dpa' 687

thul dag gi pho brang gi shul dang / go mtshon dag kyang mdo khams su yod do/ /des na khri srong dang gling ge sar gcig par 'dod pa long bsnyab yin pa shes par gyis/ rang rigs gzhon nu thos chung mgo yang 'ga' zhig kyang de'i rjes su g.yam rgyug byed kyin yod/ ces thos so/ / spyir deng dus/ mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas cung zad re sbyangs pa'i rang rigs 'ga' zhig gis/ bod kyi rig gnas dang bod kyi mkhas pa sngon ma dag la skyon 'tshol byed pa'ang mthong / sngon gyi lo tsā ba rnams phyi rgyal du phebs nas lo du mar sbyangs te/ rang rigs kyi rig gnas dar rgyas gtong ched/ de dus phyi rgyal so sor dar ba'i rig pa'i gnas mang bo bod yig tu bsgyur cing spel ba'i dpe cha po ti brgya phrag mang bo brag rtsig rtsig byas yod pa 'di tsho la ltos/ deri ma zad bu ston rin po che/ rje yab sras/ rgyal ba paṇa chen sku phreng gi gsung 'bum sogs dang /bo dong ba phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi gsung 'bum la pod brgya dang sum cu rtsa grangs yod/ nga lta bus mkhas pa re re'i gsung 'bum tshe gcig la klog mi tshar ba'i tshad red/ ngas shog nye kha shas re dus deb re'i thog la bkod de nga rgyal byed rgyu med snyam/ khyed cag gis kyang yig rigs gzhan shes pa ni rab dang phul byung 688

red/ da khyed rnam pas deng dus kyi rig gnas/ tshan rig lag rtsal/ tha na 'phrul 'khor sna tshogs bzo bcos byed pa'i dpe cha tshun chad kyi dpe deb mang bo bod yig tu bsgyur nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas dang dpal 'byor rgyas pa la nus pa bton rī na/ da gzod sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams la 'gran pa dang 'phyas gdags pa'i ma rtsa yod song ba red/ de min da dung ma rtsa med pas/ 'gran 'phyas kyi sku tshegs mi gan nga bar zhu/yang 'ga' zhig gis/ bod kyi mkhas pa sngon ma tsho ni chos la zhen pa'i stabs kyis/ de dag gis brtsams pa'i lo rgyus sogs la yang dag pa gcig kyang med/ des na bod la bod rang gi lo rgyus yang dag rtsom mkhan gyi mkhas pa gcig kyang byung med stabs/bod kyi lo rgyus kyi khungs ni phyi rgyal dang / rgya yig dang / tun hong gi yig cha kho na las btsal dgos so/ /zhes mdo med kyi gtam smra ba'ang yod/ sngon gyi lo rgyus dag la cung zad nor ba dang / yi ge ma dag pa re los yod/ 'on kyang de dag rtswa ltar dor nas gzhan zer kho na'i rjes su 'brangs na/ pha shul bus zin rgyu lta zhog pha mes kyi bla 'tshong mkhan du e 'gro snyam pa'i dogs pa che/tun hong gi gter yig mang bo zhig la bltas myong / de dag dpyad gzhi'i yig cha mkho gal che ba re los yin/ 'on 689

kyang / de'e nang du dag mo red snyam pa yod/ dpir na/ rgyal tho 'u dum btsan gyi smon lam zer ba'i shog grangs kha shas mthong /de ni de'i dus la bltas na cung zad dag mo red snyam/ rgyu mtshan khri srong sogs kyi dus skabs kyi rdo ring dang dril chen gyi thog gi yi ge dag gi rtsom lugs dang dag cha sogs 'dra mo 'dug yi ge la la ni/ khri ral gyi rjes su bris pa zhig yin pa ni/ glang dar gyi bshad pa yod pas shes mod/ 'on kyang khri ral dus kyi skad gsar bcad dang mthun rgyu phar zhog de'i sngon gyi khri srong sogs kyi dus su bris pa'i rdo ring dang dril chen sogs kyi thog gi yi ge dang brjod tshurnyespa dag cha gang thad nas mi mtshungs/ yig gzugs kyang gzab gshar gang yin cha mi 'byed pa yod/ tha na kha dang ga gnyis/ ca dang cha gnyis/ pa dang pha gnyis sogs khyad par med par lag tu gang thon bris pa dang / kha dang cha'i sngon 'jug la ga dang ba bzhag pa sogs shin tu mang / brda rnying mang ba ni de dus kyi spyi skad red/ yi ge ni cung zad mkhas pa zhig yin tshe de dus kyi bod spyi'i 'bri lugs dang mthun pa zhig byed shes rgyu red snyam/'di'i stabs kyis/ mi rigs gzhan pa 'ga' zhig gis sum cu ba ni thon mis brtsams pa ma red/ de dus kyi yig cha 690

tun hong gi yig cha dang mi mthun 'dug ces mon yul rdor gcod kyi dpe ru 'gyur nyen yod/ tha na thon mi sam bho ṭa zer ba zhig med/ de rgya'i lo rgyus na med do zer ba dang / de ni tshogs pa zhig gi ming red mi gcig ma red zer ba dang / sngonagyi yig cha dag rdog brdzis gtong byed sngar ma grags pa'i gtam re yig long re'i nang nas rnyed do zer ba dang / phyi rgyal ga gemo nas rnyed do zer ba sogs phar ded na/ spyang khu skya yog se'ilo rgyus lta bur 'gyur/ sngar bshad dang gsar bshad gang yinakyang / da gag bya med la dgos pa yod na khas los len/ dgosapa dang khe phan med na bskyur bar 'os snyam/ mdor na bod kyilo rgyus la rgyus med kyi rgyus gtam smra ba mi nyung / rang rigs sengege'i 'gying bag dang ldan pa nyung zhing / khyi tshogs nang dmur gyidape yang snang /ngas dbus su gtam zhig gi skabs// 'di dang phyogasamatshungs shig bshad nas tun hong gter yig khyer yong nas sdon gyi mkhas pa dag gi phyag rjes bad kyis bsub pa la/ nga yid mthun min zhes bshad pa yin/ de'i lan la/ gser la btsa' chags kyang gser ni gser yin zhes lan yoda'adug de ni yi ge ma dag kyang don la 'khrul ba med pas gser slad med lta bu red 69lha

zer ba yin tshod 'dug he ho/ chosdo tshul zab pas thag gcod mi snga zhing / zer ba ltar da rung brtag dpyad re btang na bzang rgyu red snyam/ — 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyi lung bstan khas mi len na/ de ni rmongs dad red ces bshad na los chog bod rigs brgya cha go lnga yan la phog e 'gro snyam nas/ de'i don ni gzham/ zhig red do/ /de'i don ni ches gzhan zhig red do/ /zhes mdzub mo 'dzugs sa med pa'i bshad dri mi bro ba zhig bshad pa la khong 'dzum 'chor gyin 'dugangs ni bod rang la gzhan la ngo gnong mi dgos pa'i rig gnas shig yod pa 'di/ sku drin can srong btsan dang bka' drin can thon mi sam bho ṭa gnyis nas bzung / rang gi bla ma'i bar gyi mkhas dbang rnams kyi drin red bsams yod/ rig gnas 'di lta bu zhig med na/ mi rigs cung zad chen po 'ga' zhig ltar rgya min gzhan min du 'gyur ba dang / yang na mi rigs kha cig ltar rig gnas dpal 'byor gang thad nas rjes lus tha chad du 'gyur ba dang / yang na mi rigs kyi ming tsam las lhag med rgyu red snyam/chos lugs yod pa'i stabs kyis yar thon du ma song ba yin 693

na/ 'jar pan yang yar thon yin mi srid/ chos med pas yar thon du 'gro rgyu yin na/ dbyis rigs kyang yar thon bla na med pa zhig yin chog dpyad pa zhib mo re thongs/deng skabs srid jus ni legs pa bla na med pa zhig yin gshis/ mi rnams kyi rang dbang dang 'tsho ba shin tu bzang ba mthong nas/ dga' spro skyes te mes rgyal gyi can bzhi 'dzugs skrun la tshe mjug 'dir zhabs 'degs gang thub re zhu snyam yod/'di dag ni spyi don la bsams nas ngo dga' zol 'jog med par sems la dran tshod smras pa yin/ kun slong gzhan med lags/ de yang gling gi mi rgyud ni/ bod mi'u ldong drug gi nang tshan las/ spug po ldong gi rigs rgyud red/ ldong ra khra rgan po la bu gsum byung ba rnams kyis rma chu'i stod smad bar gsum du gzhi bzung nas bsdad pa la mi rgyud mang du 'phel te sde chen por chags/ de nas bzung bu skyes pa stag shar dpa' bo sha stag byung /ldong chos 'phen nag po la ma mi gcig pa'i bu gsum byung ba las/ gling che rgyud/ 'bring rgyud/ chung rgyud gsum byung nas mi rgyud rab tu 'phel te/ sde shog che zhing btsan phyug 'dzoms pas snyan grags shin tu che ba byung / lhag po ldong gi mi rgyud 'brog sde chemasgo93

po 'di la gling ru thogs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ btsan phyug 'dzoms pas yul khams rnams su snyan grags dang lab gleng shin tu che ba byung stabs/ ming la gleng ru zhes thogs na'ang phyis su yi ge 'gyur nas gling ru zhes grags pa byung / gling gi bu rgyud skya lo zer bas/ byang bza' zer ba bag mar blangs pa la rga skya lo'i seng lcam 'brug mo zer ba/ phyis seng chen gyi btsun mor gyur pa de 'khrungs/ gling gi seng blon zer bas/ rgya bza' lha skyid sgrol ma dang / 'gog bza' gnyis bag mar blangs pas/ rgya bza' la dpa' bo rgya tsha zhal dkar 'khrungs/ 'gog bza' la gling rje ge sar 'khrungs/ 'khrungs yul ni khams kyi skyid sos yag gi kha mdo red zer/ 'khrungs pa'i lo tshigs ni mdo smad chos 'byung deb ther rgya mtsho las/ ge sar rgyal bo 'khrungs lo ni lcags byi dang chu sbrul la 'dod mkhan gnyis snang ba gang yin kyang rab byung dang po tshugs kha ma'i drug cu skor der gtogs la/rlangs byang chub 'dre 'khol dang smṛ ti dzñā na kirti spyan drangs te/chos zhus pa dang / gtsug lag khang bzhengs pas kyang shes nus/zhes sgrub byed nus ldan bkod pa ltar ro/ /yang rab byung dang po'i sa stag la 'khrungs par 'dod mkhan byung ba dang de gnyis kyi bar khyad/ snga ma'i lcags byi dang deng 'di'i bar la lo ngo so 694

dzigyid dang / snga ma'i chu sbrul dang de'i bar la zhi lnga tsam las khyad par chen po med/ 'di dag ni mkhas pa'i gsung yin phyir dpyad gzhir 'os/ srong btsan gyi sngon dang / de'i dus e yin bsam zer ba sogs blun po'i gtam la tshad bzung med pas dpyad kyis ga la lang / ge sar 'khrungs rjes bu chung de rgya tsha'i mdun du khyer bas/ rgya tsha rang gi nu bo zhig 'khrungs pa la shin tu dga' nas/ a re dga'/ da nga'i bsam pa grub song ba yin sogs gsungs/ khye'u rgya tsha la dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis jor se bzhugs pas/ rgya tshas nu bo'i ming la jo ru zhes thogs shig gsungs pa bzhin re zhig gi bar du jo ru zhes grags so/ /de nas jo ru cung zad lag chags pa'i skabs su/ gling sde'i dpon khro thung gis jo ru blo rig can zhig yin pa mthong ste/'di cher skyes dus dpon sa 'phrog nyen yod snyam nas/ 'gog mo 'dre red zer nas/ 'gog mo ma bu gnyis rma smad g.yu lung sum mdor rgyangs 'phud btang / de nas jo ru lag chags yag gi skabs shig tu/ gling gi rta rgyug byed pa'i ched du/ tshogs chen zhig 'tshogs te glu len gar rtsed sogs kyi ston chen zhig byas/ de'i skabs jo ru gling yul du slebs te glo bur du tshogs chen du zhugs/ khro thung gtsor byas/ gling che rgyud/ 'bring 695

rgyud sanyis mi dga' yang / rdzo ru chung rgyud tshang yin pas/ chung rgyud tshang dga' spro'i nam mkha' langs/ 'brug mos gnyen 'dems kyi mda' mo nam mkha' la 'phangs pa jo ru'i thog tu lhung / jo ru dang gnyen bsgrig byung / jo ru rang yul du phebs/ de nas rta rgyug byed rgyu gros 'cham byung ste dus btab nas/ dus thog tu gling chung rgyud tshang dang mi mang gi kha thog tu song ste jo ru yang gdan drangs/ mkhar stag rtse'i mdun du sgar btab/ gling gi dpa' rtul rnams dang mi sde rnams der 'dus pa sa'i rtsi shing bzhin du gyur/ gling gi rgyal srid/ pha zog yod dgu/ sku gsung thugs rten dang bcas pa rta rgyug gi skug la bzhag nas/ lha bsang bcu gsum btang ste rta rgyug byas/ jo rus sngar nas kha lo btul zin pa'i lha rta rkyang rgod la bzhon nas gcig bsgyur gnyis bsgyur gyis sngon la slebs te khri khar gzi brjid dang ldan par bzhugs so/ /de nas dar 'phyar dung 'bud sogs dga' ston rgya chen po byas shing / gling che rgyud/ 'bring rgyud/ chung rgyud kyi dpa' rtul rnams dang dpon thams cad 'dus nas bu jo ru la mjal dar/ rta rkyang rgod la mgyogs dar phul/ de dus khro thung gis rgya dar dkar bo dri mas ma gos pa zhig bzhag nas/ sems 696

la mi dga' yang / ngo 'dzum mdangs dga' ba'i rnam 'argyur gyis/ he he/ nga'i tsha bo la de ring / ge 'di 'dra sar 'dug zer/ de nas jo ru kho rang gis nga rang gi ming rang gis ma thogs par/ de ring nga la a khus ge sar btags pa de rten 'brel legs/ ge sar sar sdang ba'i dgra la sar/ don 'grub 'grub khra mo gling la 'grub/ ces gsungs shing / ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul lam/ skyes bu don 'grub kyi mtshan gsol nas/khra mo gling gi rje bor gyur to/ /ge sar zhes pa'i ming de ltar thogs pa red/ spyir sgra gcig don mang la 'jug pa/ go sgra don dgu la 'jug pa lta bu yod/ ge sar zhes pa'ang don kha shas la 'jug pa yod mod/'dir ge sar zhes pa gzhon dar dpa' bo la 'jug ste/ khro thung gis nga'i tsha bo la ge 'di 'dra sar 'dug ces pa'i don ni/nga'i tsha bo de ring 'di 'dra'i gzhon nu dar ma dpa' bo zhig tu gyur 'dug ces pa'i don yin la/ khong gis yang ge sar sar sdang ba'i dgra la sar/ don 'grub 'grub khra mo gling la 'grub/ces pa'ang gzhon dpa' bo sdang ba'i dgra thog la dpa'/ gzhon nu dpa' bos/ rang gi sde chen khra mo gling gi don 'grub par byed ces pa yin/ des na 'dir ge sar gyi sgra don legs sbyar 697
