tshun chad khyir yong nas rnyog ldur mi smra bar zhu/ de dus kyi sa cha rdza gu ra'am/ kur ri'i rdza skya mthon po dang / rdo pha bong zur bzhi ba'i bzhugs khri da lta'ang yongs su grags pa red/ rgyus len snyam na song la ltos/bdud btul zhes pa de ni/ sum pa ye shes dpal 'byor gyis gsungs pa ltar red/ de ni lha sa'i byang ngos kyi gnam mtsho phyug mo'i phyogs su yod pa'i gre ba nang tshan gyi sa'i char gtogs pa/ gu ru dang mon ru'i sa mtshams su skyes pa'i mi stobs rtsal can zhig yod pa des rkun jag gi mgo gtso byas nas/ mi rnams la rku 'phrog gsod bcom gyis gnod 'tshe mang bo btang bas/de'i ming la bdud zer/ de lha sa'i byang ngos kyi 'dam zhes pa'i sa char phyin nas/ ri dwags gsod pa dang rku 'phrog sogs byas te sa der bsdad/ sha ba'i rwa dang rus pas mkhar brtsigs nas bsdad pa'i sa de la/ sha rwa gnam rdzong zer/ gna' dus rkya dbus pa dag gi lam yig ritu'ang yod/ de skabs bod kha 'thor gyi dus yin stabs/ khos 'khor mang bo bsdus te sde chen zhig chags/ kho sde chen de'i rgyal bo byas nas gzhan la dmag 'jug byas/ skabs shig kho mdo khams gling yul du slebs te/ ge sar btsu na mo me bza' 'bum skyid dang / nang mi gnyis phrogasaspyo698

༵'i rkyen gyis ge sar gyis dpung btegs te g.yul bkyes pas/bdud rgyal bsad/ sde 'bangs mnga' 'og tu bsdus pa'i yun la lo gnyis dang zla ba gsum 'gor zer/ de rjes ge sar bdud yul nas rang yul du ma slebs pa'i skabs shig hor gling 'khrugs te 'brug mo 'phrog pa sogs kyis rkyen byas te/ hor gling g.yul 'gyed chen po byung ste/ mthar ge sar gyis hor yul cham la phab/ hor la de'i skabs gur dkar dang / gur ser/ gur nag gsum yod/ a chen lung ba'i gangs chags dkar bo'i smad du rdza chen po'i nye 'dabs su/ hor gur dkar gyi ya tse'i mkhar shul yod la/ der deng sang yang hor rgyal bo'i sde lhag gi mi rgyud yod/ 'a stod shug sha'i chu nas rgya'i khu'u kru mkhar gyi tshu rol gyi bar du/ hor gur ser gyi rgyud pa sha ra yu gur zer ba'i cha lugs mi 'dra ba'i mi sde yod/thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i dgon lung dkar chag las/ mkhan po sum cu ba mkhyen rab dbang phyug ngag dbang dge legs rgya mtsho ni/ bde dgu che ba dpal ldan rgya mtsho'i sku skye gsum pa yin la/ 'khrungs yul sha ra yu gur du grags pa/de ni ge sar gyi lo rgyus su hor gur ser zhes 'byung ba de yin zhing / zhes gsungs pa dang / yang de las/ rgyal bo sku lnga 699

bod du byon pa'i lo rgyus su/ bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa bcom zer ba'i hor gyi yul yang 'di nyid yin zhes mang bo zhig gis gleng ba bden pa 'dra ste/ sog skad la sha ra ur ge zhes pa gur ser bo zer ba yin pas/ ur ge sgra log pas/ yu gur zhes bos sam snyam zhing / bha ta ru ba zer ba'i pha tsho gcig dang / sgom grwa'i shul yin zer ba'i gyang ro 'ga' zhig da dung yang ston rgyu 'dug la/ rgyal bo'i rigs kyi dkor bdag gdug pa can mang zhing / de rnams mchod lugs kyang rgyal gsol dang dbyibs 'dra bar snang ngo / /zhes gsungs so/ /mtsho sngon phyogs kyi hor spra khra zer ba'i sde shog de yang gur dkar gyi sde lhag yin la/deng sang ci yin ma shes/ bcings 'grol sngon du sde tsho de rnams su mun rub khar rta rkyang rkyang bzhon mkhan gyi 'grul ba slebs na ltas ngan du brtsi zer zhing / rgyal bo'i mdung lha phab pa'i lugs srol yang yod zer ro/ /'jang yul ni/ yun nan zhing chen gyi khongs su yod/sngar stobs 'byor che yang / bod chos rgyal gyi dus su bod rgyal gyis dbang du bsdus/ bod sil bur 'thor ba'i dus su/ bod la rkun jag sogs brnyas gtse sna tshogs byas pa'i dbang gis/'jang gling g.yul 'gyed byung / de'i stabs kyis 'jang gi stobs 700

'byor nyams shing / mi sde 'ga' zhig bod du rgyur na yang mi sdetshudang dpon rgyud da dung yang yod/ 'jang sa dam rgyal bos bcos bsgyur gong du gser dngul drel khal brgyad khyer nas phyi rgyal du bros song zer stag gzig ni phyi rgyal skad yin gshis/ 'bri lugs sna tshogs yod de/ stag gzig ta zig ta zhig ces bris pa yod/ phyis su bod kyis gar log zer ba yang de yin zhes lo rgyus 'ga' zhig na snang / tā ra na tha'i slob dpon pad ma'i rnam thar du/ tu ru k+ṣa dang stag gzig gnyis gcig yin gsungs/ deng dus thur chi zer ba de yin tshod red/ bod kyis stag gzig zer ba ni dbyi lang dang / thur chi/ chos lugs hos hos dang 'dra ba de dag yin zhing / gna' dus rgyal khab phyug po stobs dang ldan pa yin gshis/ stag gzig nor gyi rgyal bo zer/ ge sar sgrung du'ang stag gzig nor rdzong bcom/ zhes pa'i nor rdzong ni grong khyer dang pho brang phyug po'i brda chad red/ bod chos rgyal gyi dus su bod la btsan 'dzul du ma byas kyang / mthar g.yul pham ste bod rgyal la dpya khral 'bul dgos byung / bod kha 'thor gyi dus su/ bod kyi srid nyams shing mgo 'thor du song ba shes nas/ bod la rkun jag sogs gnod pa 701

byas na yang / de'i skabs dbus gtsang du sde dpon stobs ldanadamag shugs can med gshis/ dbus gtsang gi che gtso 'gas mdo khams kyi dpa' bo stobs ldan dmag shed can gling ge sar rgyal bo skul slong byas pa sogs kyi rkyen gyis/ stag gling g.yul 'gyed byung ste/ stag gzig nor rdzong bcom ste rgyal kha blangs/de dus bod la gnod pa byed pa'i rgya nag gi grong dang grong rdal 'ga' zhig bcom pa'i mkhar shul rnga ba/ zangs dkar/ mdzod dge dang / kan lho phyogs su'ang yod/de dag la sogs pa g.yul chen bco brgyad sogs bgyis pa dang / rma stod smad bar gsum sogs mdo khams yongs la dbang bsgyur cing / bod yul phal mo che la lung 'bebs pa byung ngo / /gling ge sar 'das rjes rim gyis mnga' thang nyams par gyur na'ang gdung rgyud dang mi sde'i lhag ma du ma yod/ sde dge phyogs kyi sde dpon gling tshang rgyal bo ni gling seng chen gyi rgyal rgyud red/ gling 'gu zi'i rgyal bo zer la/ sras dgra bla rtse rgyal nas brtsis pa'i gdung rabs zhe dgu song / zhes sngon gyi gling tshang rgyal bo'i rgyal rabs lo rgyus su yod 'dug gling tshang rgyal bo'i rgyal sa de na sngon gyi gling ge sar gyi sbra shul yone pa dang / ge sar sogs kyi go mtshon dang / ba so'i —phyag tham sogs yod/702

sde dge'i lcang ra na khro chu'i dngul rdzong gi shul yod 'dug la/mtsho skya rengs dang sngo rengs gnyis kyi bar du 'brug mo'i gser mkhar dang / 'brug mo'i chu 'khur sa'i rdo/ skya lo'i g.yag rnga'i lab rtse/ pho brang stag rtse'i mkhar shul yod/ 'dan khog gi sa skyid sos g.yag gi mdo na/ ge sar gyi lha khang yod kyang /god chags skabs gtor brlag byas yod pa gzhir bzhag yin kyang gyang ro re lhag yod las che/ de na ge sar gyi red zer ba'i khrab rmog go mtshon sga srab sogs sngar yod/ da skabs ci yin ma shes/ mgo log gi gling bla ma chos rdor yang gling gi rgyud pa yin gshis/ gling bla ma zhes 'bod/ de ga'i gliri skor zhes pa'i ru sde de yang gling gi sde lhag yin 'dug sde dge'i phyogs kyi rdza khog gi tshab btsa' dgon pa'i g.yon zur du a mye khra rgan gyi spra shul yod/ rdza dkar nag gi phyogs su gling gis mda' rtsal sbyang sa'i pha bong gru bzhi ma pha ri tshu ri gnyis ka na yod/ khra gling dgon pa'i thag nye sa/ rgyu dar gyi sa nag lung mdo na/ ge sar gyi mkhar shul yod/ rma smad g.yu lung sum mdo zer ba'i sa de red zer/ rma chu dang kho chu 'dres mtshams kho mdo zer ba'i sa cha na/khro thung gi pho rog snying rdzong gi mkhar shul yod la/ go 'jo na seng stag a dom gyi mkhar shul yod/ mgo log pad ma rdzong na 703

gi sar/ 'brug mo/ 'dan ma rnams kyis khrus byed sa'i chu —tshan yod/ nga rang yang de gar song nas bdun gcig la bsdad de khrus byas myong / mgo log phyogs skyong gi sa cha na gling khya yi ri bshol zer ba'i ri'i ngo nas/ gling gi dus kyi lcags kyi mde'u mtho gang re yod pa rnyed rgyu yod zer/ mgo log mi ra zer ba'i sa na/ ge sar gyi lha rta rkyang li'i rngog ma 'breg sa brag zor yod pa der/ deng sang yang rta'i rnga rngog mchod srol 'dug mgo log dkar bo'i khog na ge sar gyi bzhugs khri rdo khri rgyab yol can zhig gda'/ sa de na 'jang gi so de'u zer ba'i 'jang gling 'khrugs skabs su 'jang dmag e yong so byed sa'i so khang ri rtse na yod pa/ rdo pha bong chen po gsum gyi steng du/ rdo gru bzhi rgya khyon khang mig che ba'i tshad tsam gyis bkab yod pa/ de'i mthar rdo gru bzhi ma rnams kyis bskor yod pa zhig yod/ rnga ba'i yul gyi rnga stod rtsi mda' man na ge sar gyi rta 'dogs sa red zer ba'i brag rdo/ rnga ba'i rme skor gyi sa cha/ stod na sha yu 'khor sa/ bar na phyugs rigs skyong sa/ smad na 'bru rigs 'khrungs sa/ zer ba'i sa de a mye khra rgan gyis bzung ba'i lo rgyus yod/ska chu'i stod du gling mkhar stag rtse'i mkhar shul yod pa dang / de man gyi a mo'i khog tu 'brug mo'i rta ra yin zer ba'i brag ra thum 704

po zhig yod/ deng sang hong yon rdzong zer ba'i sa khongs brgal mtshams/ zung chu rdzong gi khongs kyi sa sne zin mtshams su ston mo lung zer ba'i sa cha zhig yod/ sa der hor gling g.yul 'gyed skabs gling gis rgyal kha chen po zhig lon nas/ sa der dga' ston chen po zhig byas pas/ ston mo lung zhes ming thogs pa red/ de dang sa thag nye sar mda' sbyangs rgod yul zer sa der/ gling gi dpa' bo rnams kyis mda' rtsal sbyangs te/ bya rgod la mda' 'phangs pas sa de'i ming la de ltar grags/dmu dge dgon pa'i rgyab ri'i kha na 'obs chen po zhig yod pa'i ming la hor skung sa zer/ sngar hor gling 'khrugs skabs hor dmag skung sa red/ dmu dge dgon pa'i dkyil du 'obs chen po mi rta brgya phrag chud se zhig brkos pa/ hor gyis sa srog bcad pa red zer yang / 'thab ra'am mi rta brgya phrag du ma skung sa bzos pa red/ deng sang de'i dkyil du sa rdul gyis bsubs yod kyang / sne g.yas g.yon gnyis da rung kha ma gang bar lus yod/ dmu dge'i mchod rten snar 'brug mo'i spra shul yod/ de dang mi ring ba na ra phug zer ba'i sa char mo de'u zer ba'i de'u chung zhig yod pa de gling seng chen gyis mo 'debs sa yin zer/dasu dge dang mkhar lung gi bar du sa rdo gru bzhi ma leb mo mtharo7pyi5

'obs kyis bskor nas yod pa zhig yod pa de/ gling dpon rnams kyis sho rtsed byed sa yin zer/ de nas shar phyogs su song mtshams gnyang rkyal kha zer ba'i la kha der/ gling dmag 'gro skabs a mye khro thung gi khog pa ma bde nas/ khro thung bshal gnyang byas stabs/ gnyang rkyal kha zhes ming thogs pa red zer/ de nas phar song na zung chu zer ba'i chu'i phar kha dang / tshur khar gling gis dmag sgar brgyab pa'i shul dang / zung chu'i kren cang kon man chad du dpa' ches gdong zer sa de gling gis dmag rtsed byed sa yin la/ seng chen gyi mda' zug shul yin zer ba'i brag ngo zhig tu mda' shul yod/ zung chu'i stod a gling zer ba'i sde ba de gling dmas/ bsdad pa'i sde shul yin zer ba dang / rgya rtse zer ba'i sde ba de rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi sde 'thor zhig yin zer ba dang / de'i bar du gling gi dmag ru bar ma bsdad pa'i sa der bar ru zer mod/ deng sang brda cung zad 'gyur nas bar rung zer/ de yan chad cig na/ rta ra rte'u ra zer ba'i brag ra zhig yod pa de/ gling dmag der bsdad dus 'brug mo'i rta ra byas pa red zer/ sa de nas byang phyogs su brgal ba mdzod dge zer ba'i sa/ ska chu rma chu rmi chu 'dres pa'i chu rgyud du/ hor gling g.yul 'gyed chen po zhig byas nas/ hor dmag khri phrag 70sgo

brgal ba bsad de/ gling gis rgyal kha chen po thob pa'i lo rgyus yod la/ sgrung yig tu'ang yod/ mdzod dge'i sa der/ sngon mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi dus su/ blon po dga' ye shes dar rgyas zer bas gzhi bzung nas/ 'brog sde chags pa yin mod/ hor gling 'khrugs nas gling gis dbang bsgyur pas/mdzod dge gling dkar stod kyi sa cha/ zhes pa'i ming de chags/gling gi sde lhag cig yod pa'i sde ba de la gling ba zhes ming ma 'gyur bar yod/ mdzod dge bzhag ldom zhes pa'i sar gling gi dpon 'dug sa'i sa ston rgyu yod/ mdzod dge sde gi chos rje na gling gi 'brug dga' bde zer ba'i sde skor 'brug sde zer ba yod/ kho tsho la ma bgos spyi nor du khro chu'i gser rdo/ 'brug mo'i rnga sogs yod zer/ de nas byang phyogs su song ba'i bla brang dgon pa'i g.yas phyogs kyi spang gzhung chen po der gling gi dpa' thul dmag dpung dang bcas pas lha bsang chen po zhig btang ba'i stabs kyis/ spang gzhung de la bsang gzhung zer zhes bla brang gdan rabs sogs lo rgyus 'ga' na yod/ de nas 'bab pa'i chu bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi mdun brgyud de/ hor tshang khog tu 'bab pa de la bsang chu zer/ 'on kyang / go min tang gi rgya mi kha shas kyis chu bo de'i ming la zha hu zhes btags 707

nas btsan shed kyis rdzok+ṣiri de'i ming la'ang zha hu rdzong zhes 'bod ‘ dgos byung / deng sang der mthud de sa khra dang / bod yig tshags par thog la de bzhin dgos pa'i bka' shed bzhin byed kyin 'dugabla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan rabs bcu ba/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gling dpon slob don 'grub rgya mtsho ni gling gi dpon rgyud yin gshis/ gling ge sar gyi gri ring sogs yo byad 'ga' yod pa/ sngar a 'a/gas gling tshang gi nang chen gyi tshoms chen lha khang du bzhugs yod/ dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur dang / rig gnas gsar brje zer ba'i god chags skabs/ nang chen gyi gna' rdzas la gtor bshig chen po byung yang / gling seng chen gyi gri ring de ni bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi tshogs chen 'du khang thog gi 'grem ston khang gi nang du bzhag 'dug nga rang gis lag tu blangs nas zhib lta byas/ dus de skabs kyi dmag chas ngo ma red snyam/de nas byang phyogs su song ba na/ a rig chu tshan dang phyogs mtshungs 'dabs chags pa'i sar/ sngon hor dmag gis bzung ba'i ab chu dug thang der hor dmag pham nas gling gis bzung / ge sar gyi bzhugs yul lha lung g.yu mdo/ mdzo 708

'dogs sa yin zer ba'i ri de'u zhig gi nye 'gram du spang sngon po la brag dkar bo srog chags kyi rnam pa 'bur du dod pa'i sa 'dzin yod ces pa sogs/ 'di dag mdo smad chos 'byung du gsal bor yod/ de phyogs kyi rwa rgya dgon gyi sa cha ni/ kha rgyun la/ rma pha ri dro la tshu ri dro/ /rma dro dro lu gu'i mkhal khug na/ /rlung bsil mas rtswa khral 'ja la sa/ /chab chu bos shing khral 'jal sa/ /glag rog mos sha khral 'jal sa/ /zhes pa gling sgrung du yod pa'i gling gis sngon bzung ba'i sa yin zer/rma smad dan tig man chod kyi za lar khog gi rma chu'i nyin gyi lam khar gling ge sar gyi mda' gzhu 'jog sa red zer ba'i rdo gru bzhi ma zhig dang / chibs rta bzhon dus kyi zhabs stegs red zer ba'i rdo gru bzhi ma zhig kyang 'dug gling gi rjes shul 'di dag phal cher rang gis dngos su mthong ba da nga / 'ga' zhig ni yid rton rung ba'i mi'i ngag las thos pa yin/ des mi tshad mdo khams kyi sa cha gzhan dang / rma stod smad bar gsum du gling ge sar gyi dngos rdzas dang / rjes shul mang bo yod zer ba bden mod/ bdag gis sa cha 'ga' zhig la gom pa ma bor zhing / ngag rgyun 'ga' thos na yang khungs ldan yin min the tshom can rnams ni ma bris/ rma stod smad bar gsum dbang du bsdus 709

zhes pa ni/ rma chu'i chu mgo nas bzung ste/ za lar khog yar mar ni dbang bsgyur yul rma chu'i rgyud yin 'dug de la phyis su gling gis sa char cha bgos nas srung dmag 'jog yul ni/ mdzod dge stod yan chad rma stod du brtsi ba yin te/ gling dkar stod zer ba ni gling gis bzung ba'i sa yin pas/ gling dkar dang rma stod du brtsis pas/ stod zer ba yin 'dug rwa rgya dgon yar mar la rma sked du brtsi/ za lar yar mar la rma smad du brtsi/spyir rma chu ni shar phyogs su bzhur te rgya mtshor 'dres pas/ rgya yul du bzhur ba'i rma chu/ bod rang gi skad du rma chu'i mjug zer yang 'dir bshad pa ni gling gis dbang bsgyur pa'i sa'i cha bgos pa red/ 'ga' zhig gis rgya yul du bzhur ba'i rma chu la bod kyis kyang hwang hu zer/ zhes bshad pa ni lo rgyus yig cha gang gi thog tu med la/ bod mi su'i kha skad la'ang med do/ /rgyal rong khog gam rgyal mo tsha ba rong du/ a mye khur tung ('di ni sgra tsam bris pa yin/ yig thob la nges pa mi 'dug)zer ba de'i lo rgyus yod kyang / sa cha so sor bshad tshul mi 'dra ba 'dug la las gling gi sprul ba yin zer/ la las thab lha yin zer nas lha sgrung ring bo re bshad kyin 'dug deng sang lis shan zer ba'i sa cha'i rgyal rong gi mi'i gtam rgyud cig la/710

a mye khur tung ni khro thung red/ sngar khos hor dang g.yul bkyis pas/ kho pham ste hor dmag rgyal rong khog tu khyab/ phyis su gling dmag gis hor rgyal rong yul nas phud pa'i g.yul las kyi rgyal kha thob pa'i dus tshigs dga' ston ni/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin rgyal rong yongs la byed kyin yod/ de dus ston rtsa chen zhig tu brtsi la/ rgyal rong gi sa cha'i mi ser la las de ci'i dus ston yin mi shes zer/ la las a mye khur tung gi rjes6dran yin zer/ lis shan bkra shis gling gi dpon rgyud/deng sang rnga ba khul srid gros kru'u zhi gzhon pa/ lo don bzhi lon pa'i shes yon can ming la bkra shis rnam rgyal zer ba des bshad don/ de ni hor gling 'khrugs skabs rgyal rong nas hor pham/ bod rgyal ba'i dga' ston red zer/ yang khos zer ba/ kho'i skye yul kan pho sde shog gi goms srol la/ dus ston de'i nyin (hor zla 11pa'i tshes 13nyigyedapon 'bangs mnyam du 'tshogs nas/ dga' ston gzab rgyas byed/ glu len/bro rdung / phye ril snum du btsos nas dgra bo hor gyi mig yin zer nas za/ bdal thug ring bo btsos nas dgra hor gyi rgyu ma yin zer nas za/ nang rtsam pa dang snum bsres nas phyi gro phyes btums te 'khur ba snying dang 'dra ba bzos nas hor gyi snying 711

yin zer nas za ba'i srol bcings 'grol sngon dus yod pa dang /de ga'i mi rgan tsho'i gtam rgyud la/ hor dmag rgyal rong yul nas pham ste/ zung chu phyogs su bros/ de nas mdzod dge phyogs su bros pa bshad rgyu yod zer ba'ang / hor gling 'khrugs phyogs kyi spyi bab la bltas na bden shas che snyam/mdor na/ gling seng chen ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul ni/mi dngos yin pa/ 'khrungs yul mdo khams yin pa sogs la sngon gyi mkhas mchog rnams la 'dod pa mi mthun pa byung ma myong /da lta mi re res rang snang gang shar re bshad kyin 'dug snyam nas/rang gi mthong tshul thos tshul/ bsam tshul cung zad re rnam g.yeng gi kha snon du mkho med ban rgan mgo se des bris pa lags so/ /lharngosnyi

bcu phrag nor bu'i 'od zer/ bgrang yas kun bzang lhan skyes dga' ba'i dpal/ /gcig gyur rmongs pa'i dgra gyur de yi mthu/ /snying la sim pas dpal ldan 'bras bzang gis/ /yangs pa'i sa chen yongs su khyab gyur cig /ces shis par brjod pas smra ba'i sgo phyes te gleng bar bya ba ni/ ji skad du kun gzigs lnga ba chen po'i zhal nas/dpyid kyis bskyangs pa'i chu 'dzin lang long dbus/ /dbyar skyes rnga gsang dal gyis sgrogs pa'i tshe/ /rma bya'i sgro gshog rlum por legs byas nas/ /zlos gar bsgyur ba rang gi ngang tshul yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar deng skabs dge mtshan dpyid kyi dpalaci mo'i 'dzum zhal slar yang ngom pa'i tshe rgan po'ang dga' ba'i 'dzum mdangs dang bcas te smra ba la 'jug go/ / de yang bsil ldan kha ba'i yul ljongs chen po 'dir yongs su grags pa'i rig gnas bcu phrag gcig yod pa'i che ba lnga ni/sgra rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/713

nang don rig pa ste lnga'o/ / de'i dang bo sgra rig pa ni rang re'i bod skad kyi dbang du byas na sgra rig pa'i gzhung ni thon mi bka' drin can gyis mdzad pa'i thon mi'i mdo rdzi'i sgra mdo la sogs pa'i brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos brgyad yod pa yin mod/ rgyal bo glang dar ma'i log par spyod pa'i byed shāsdos kyi dbang gis bstan bcos gzhan rnams nub nas da lta med la/ sum cu ba dang rtags kyi 'jug pa gnyis ni da lta rang re'i brda sprod pa'i gzhung gi rtsa ba yin no/ /de gnyis kyi dgongs 'grel yang / zha lu ba chos legs kyi 'grel ba mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog lo chen nam bzang gi 'grel ba bstan pa'i sgron me/ snar thang lo tsā ba'i sum rtags mchan ṭīka sogs shin tu mang la deng dus grags che ba pra snyi rin chen don grub kyi 'grel ba kun bzang dgongs rgyan/ si tu paṇa chen gyi 'grel ba mu tig phreng mdzes sogs dang / dag yig skor la yang zha lu lo chen gyi dag yig za ma tog dpal khang lo tsā ba'i dag yig ngag sgron/ sogs dag yig skor yang shin tu mang / sgra rig pa slob pa la gzhung de dag cha lag dang bcas pa la slob dgos par ma zad/ sngon gyi mkhas dbang dag gis bod rang gi spyi skad kyi lam las drangs ji7/4

pa'i gzhung rnams la'ang ligs par brtags lhang / mig gi bsgrig tshul/ rnam dbye tshig phrad/ rtsom gyi nyams dod tshul/rgyan gyis spras tshul sogs rim gyis nges par byas te de nas sgra rig pa'i yan lag snyan ngag la'ang sbyang bar bya'o/ /sgra rig pa slob pa'i tshe rang skad spyi 'gros kyi sgra rig pa'i gzhung la sbyang dgos par ma zad/ bod kyi brda sprod pa'i rig pa de brda sprod pa'i gzhung gang gi rig pa la brten nas bzos pa'i rigs 'gre byed sa'i gzhung ka tsan dbyangs gsum sogs legs sbyar gyi sgra gzhung la'ang sbyang dgos te/ de ma sbyangs na brda sprod pa'i skor la rig pas brdar sha mi chod pas don go ba la'ang shugs rkyen nges can zhig yod pa dang / rang re'i sman gzhung /lo rgyus/ rtsis rig mngon brjod/ snyan ngag nang don rig pa'i mdo dang sngags kyi gzhung rnams su legs sbyar gyi skad dang sgra sgrub mi nyung ba re yod pas/ legs sbyar ma shes na de dag la thos bsam zhib 'jug byed pa'i mthun rkyen ma tshang bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa tshad ma rig pa ni 'phags yul du phyi rol ba'i tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung mang bo yod la/ nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i paṇa ḍi ta chen po slob dpon phyogs kyi glang bos mdzad pa'i tshad 715

ma kuni btus dang / slob dpon chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i tshad ma sde bdun/ de dag gi 'grel ba 'grel bshad shin tu mang bo lo paṇa bka'e drin can rnams kyis bod skad du bsgyur nas da lta bstan 'gyur/ khrod du pod nyi shu yas mas yod la de dag gi dgongs 'grel bod rang gis brtsams pa ni sa skya paṇa chen gyi rigs gter sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis brtsams pa'i gzhung mang mod/ khyad par du rje bdag nyid chen pos mdzad pa'i sde bdun yid kyi mun sel/ rgyal tshabarar ma rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rnam bshad thar lam gsal byed/ smra ba'i nyi ma mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang bos mdzad pa'i ṭīka chen rigs pa'i rgya mats+tsha dang / sde bdun yid kyi mun sel/ rje dge 'dun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel spyi don rigs rgyan/ da dag gi rjes 'brang grwa sa se 'bras dge gsum gyi grwa tshang so so dang / mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi mkhas pa so sos mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung shin tu mang / de dag ni rgya gzhung dang bod snga ma'i gzhung dang mi 'dra bar kha gsal zhing zhib cha can yin/ tshad ma'i gzhung gi dgongs pa cung rtogs dka' bas de'i dgongs pa rtogs pa'i thabs dam pa bsdus grwa zhes pa 'di ni cha ba chos kyi seng ge yab 716

ṅges kyis gsar gtod mdzad pa yin zhing / 'di ni tshad ma rig pa ste gtan tshigs rig pa'i dgongs don bde blag tu lon thub pa'i thabs dam pa yin no/ /des na tshad ma rig pa ste gtan tshigs rig pa la sbyang tshe gzhung 'di dag la sbyang dgos mod/thog mar bsdus grwa'i gzhung kha gsal nyung bsdus shig la sbyang dgos pa dang / de nas bsdus grwa'i gzhung rgyas pa dgag gzhag spang gsum dang ldan pa zhig la sbyang brtson gyis rigs lam la cung zad byang chub par gyur rjes tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel ba rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang / tshad ma'i spyi don sogs la sbyangs te go ba gting tshugs par bya'o/ /de ltar gtan tshigs rig pa'am tshad ma rig pa sbyang ba'i dgos pa ni gnas skabs rig pas brdar sha chod cing / blo gros kyi 'jug pa gsal zhing myur bar gyur nas gzhung lugs gang la thos bsam gyis 'jug pa na dgongs pa bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /mthar phyi'i dngos po dang nang gi sems kyi rang bzhin gshis lugs la dpyod par byed pa na blun po zer sgros kyi rjes su 'brang ba lta bu ma yin par rang gi rig pa'i rtsal gyis phyi nang gi dngos po'i gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs te rang gi blo ngor lung rigs gang rung la brten nas de las gzhan du 'da' 717

med pa'i grub mtha' 'jog nus so/ /log smra tshar gcod sgra dang tshad ma dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar log par smra ba'i tshig gi 'khrul ba sel ba la sgra rig pa nges par du dgos pa dang / don gyi 'khrul ba sel ba la tshad ma rig pa nges par dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis log smra tshar gcod pa'i yan lag sgra rig pa dang tshad ma rig pa zhes sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams la rlung ltar grags pa yin no/ /gsum pa bzo rig pa ni bzo las kyi rig pa yin la de'i gzhung ni bstan 'gyur khrod kyi bzo pa tra zhes pa'i gzhung dang /'ju mi pham gyi gsung gi bzo pa tra sogs dang / gzhan yang bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur gyi gzhung rnams su bzo las kyi skor thor bu thor bu yod pa/ dper na dus 'khor rgyud du 'bru mar gyi skyogs bzo tshul/ rkyal gru bzo tshul/ me tog lhum rar chu 'dren byed kyi shing gi spu gu bzo tshul sogs yod pa dang /gzhan yang gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dang lcags zangs la gser chu byugs tshul sogs/ be'u bum dang / dkyil 'khor/ mchod rten/ sku gzugs sogs kyi thig 'debs tshul/ rin po che brtag pa/ rta sogs dud 'gro brtag tshul sogs kyi gzhung dag la sbyangs nas lag len dang 'grel ba'i zhib 'jug byas te dgos 718

mkho dang bstun nas lag len byed pa gale chi'o/ / 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho dang mthun pa'i bod kyi lag shes bzo las dag ni deng dus kyi 'phrul 'khor bzo las la bltas na rjes lus yin mod/ 'on kyang mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho dang bstun na med du mi rung ba zhig yin te/ dper na/ rdo bzo/ shing bzo/ lcags bzo/ dngul bzo/ gser bzo/ lha bzo/ gser rtsi rgyag pa/ tshon rtsi rgyag pa/ par rko ba/ yul thabs kyi ar las/ 'dam las/ snam phrug dang ther ma bzo ba/ sa gdan dang rkyong gdan kha gdan bzo ba/ko pags dang tsha ru mnyed pa/ bal las phying 'jog sogs ni med du mi rung zhing / gal che ba'i bzo las yin pas bzo rig de dag dar rgyas gtong 'os pa yin/ de'i steng du deng dus kyi 'phrul 'khor bzo las dang lag rtsal sna tshogs pa dag la bslabs nas yul thabs dang phyi thabs zung 'brel gyis dpal 'byor gong du spel te mi dmangs mang tshogs phyug por 'gyur ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos pa'i bzo rig pa ni gal che'i rig pa zhig yin no / /bzhi ba gso ba rig pa ni phyi nas bsgyur ba'i gso ba rig paske gzhung bstan 'gyur khrod du pod bcu phrag tsam yod pa de dag dang / bod gzhung la mtshon na'ang mdo dbus gtsang gsum719

gyi mkhas pa shin tu mang bos sman gyi rgyud bzhi gzhir bzung ste rang gi nyams myong dang sbrags nas brtsams pa'i gzhung shin tu mang ste/ dper na g.yu thog garmer rnying gis brtsams pa'i gzhung ni bdag gis brtsams pa'i g.yu thog gsar rnying gi rnam thar nang du bkod yod pa de ltar la/ gzhan yang byang zur gyi mkhas pa rnam gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung rnams dang / bai sngon sogs rgyud bzhi'i 'grel ba 'grel bshad mchan sogs dang / man ngag lhan thabs dang / zin tig la sogs pa rang gi nyams myong dang sprags pa'i sman gzhung mang bo brtsams yod/ de ltar gzhung mang yang dpe khrod du rdul gyis khebs nas yod pa tsam la dgos pa cher mi 'dug pas nges par sbyang dgos pa gal che/ de la thog mar rgyud bzhi blo la bzung nas byang chub par byed dgos te/ rje bdag nyid chen pos sman sbyang skabs rgyud bzhi blo la bzung ba rnam thar du gsal ba ltar red/ de ltar blo la bzung ba tsam gyis mi chog par slob dpon mkhas pa bsten te/ dngos shugs kyi bstan bya man ngag dang bcas pa khong du chud par byed cing /man ngag gi gzhung gzhan dag la'ang sbyong ba brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten na ming dang don mthun pa'i lha rjer gyur te snyan grags kyi dri bsung phyogs su 'thul bar 'gyur ro/ /720

bod kyi gso ba rig pa 'di ni bar skabs nyam dmas su rgyur te sman rdzas bsdu len/ sdeb sbyor/ lag rtsal sogs gang thad nas lag len ji bzhin ma nus pa ma gtogs gso rig 'di'i ngo bo tshan rig pa yang dag pa zhig yin te phyi lugs kyi sman dpyad kyis bcos ma thub pa/ bod kyi sman pas dpyad kyis thag bcad pa du ma zhig mthong / phyi lugs kyi sman dpyad dman zer ba ga la yin te/ 'on kyang dal ba'i rang bzhin can gyi nad du ma zhig la phyi lugs kyi sman las bod lugs kyi sman gnad du 'gro ba du ma zhig yod par snang ngo / /des na rang lag gi nor bu lta bu'i rig pa 'di'ang don med du lag nas mi 'chor bar brtson sbyang byi dor gyis 'od 'tsher ba zhig byed par zhu zhes lag pa'i pad mo snying gar zum ste zhu'o/ /bzo rig pa dang gso ba rig pa 'di gnyis ni skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i yan lag yin gsungs pa ltar bzo las kyis skal ba dang ldan pa'i rang bzhin rnal du gnas pa'i mi dang mi dmangs/ mi rigs dang rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor dang 'tsho ba gong du spel te bde zhing skyid pa'i gnas su bkod nas mthar spyod bzang sems bzang bla na med pa'i go 'phang du 'god pa dang / gso ba rig pa ni skye 'gro'i nad kyi zug rngu thams cad 721

'arjoms par byid cing / dus min 'chi ba'i 'ching zhags bcad de lus sems kyi bde ba mthar thug pa la 'god pa'i thabs dam pa yin no/ /lnga ba nang don rig pa ni gtso bo nang sems 'dul ba'i thabs te/ 'di la gzhung sde snod gsum yod pa ni 'dul ba'i sde snod/ mdo sde'i sde snod/ mngon pa'i sde snod de gsum yod/'dul ba'i sde snod kyi brjod bya ni tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa ste/ lta sgom spyod gsum la sbyar na spyod pa gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung yin/ mdo sde'i sde snod kyi brjod bya ni ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa ste/ lta sgom spyod gsum la sbyar na sgom pa gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung yin/ mngon pa'i sde snod ni shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa ste/ lta sgom spyod gsum la sbyar na lta ba gtso bor ston pa'i gzhung yin/ des na sde snod gsum ni gzhung yin la bslab pa gsum ni sde snod gsum gyi brjod bya yin no/ /'dul ba'i sde snod ces pa nges tshig gis bshad na/ rang sems 'dul ba'i thabs ston pa'i gzhung yin pas 'dul ba'i sde snod ces bya la sde snod ces pa'ang gzhung la bya ste brjod bya la sde khag gsum byas pa'i nang gi tshul khrims kyi sde ston pa'i snod lta bu'i gzhung yin pas sde snod ces bya ste gzhan 722

gnyis la'ang rigs 'gre/ 'dul ba'i sde snod la slob sbyong byas te tshul khrims kyi bslab pa khong du chud par byed dgos/ tshul khrims zhes pa ni tshul dang mthun pa'i khrims shig la go dgos/rang nyid tshul dang mthun pa'i khrims la gnas pa ste spyod stangs bzang bo la gnas te rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa la 'jug dgos/ spyir tshul khrims zhes pa phyi rol pa dka la'ang rang rang lugs kyi tshul khrims re srung lugs yod rno da/ 'dir nang b.risangs rgyas pa'i dbang du btang na so thar gyi tshul khrims dang /byang sems kyi tshul khrims/ gsang sngags kyi tshul khrims te gsum yod do/ / mdo sde'i sde snod la thos bsam rnal ma byas te ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam gzhag khong du chud par byas nas rang sems 'dul ba'i thabs kyi gtso bo ting nge 'dzin sgom pa la 'jug par byed/rang sems ma zhi ba skad cig ma gcig dang gnyis la'ang gnas mi thub par rta rgod 'phyo ba bzhin du 'phro bar 'gyur ba de nyid zhi bar gnas pa'i thabs sems gnas kyi gdams ngag slob dpon las blangs te bsgoms nas rang sems la dbang 'byor te sems ci 'dod du gnas thub pa na sgom bzang bo grub pa'am zhi gnas thob zer/ tshul khrims tshul bzhin bsrung ba'i steng nas gzhung 723

lugs la thos bsam byas te ting nge 'dzin sgom pa la 'jug par bya ba yin te/ tshul gnas thos dang sems ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes gsungs so/ / mngon pa'i sde snod la thos bsam yang dag pa byas te shes rab kyi bslab pa khong du chud par byas nas rang sems 'dul ba'i thabs mthar thug pa chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa'i shes rab rang rgyud la skye bar byed pa'o/ /spyir shes rab la kun rdzob rig pa'i gnas lnga shes pa'i shes rab dang / don dam gnas lugs shes pa'i shes rab gnyis las 'dir ni phyi ma'o/ /bslab pa zhes pa ni bslab bya'i yul de la bslab pa zer zhing / shes bya'i yul de la shes bya zer ba yin mod/ deng sang 'ga' zhig gi bshad tshul la yul dang yul can gnyis go log nas shes byed kyi yon tan la shes bya zer te/ shes bya yod mkhan gyi mi zer ba lta bu/ shes bya med mkhan gyi mi med de gzhi grub na shes bya yin pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa rnams su nang don rig pa de gzhung po ti lnga'i nang du bsdus te slob par byed de rnam 'grel/phar phyin/ dbu ma/ mdzod/ 'dul ba ste lnga la sbyang bar byed/ rnam 'grel gyi skabs su tshad ma rnam 'grel rtsa bar byas 724

te tshad ma rig pa la brten nas rig pa'i sgo yangs bor phyes te legs nyes 'byed pa'i rig pa rno zhing gsal bar byed/ de nas mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa bar byas te phar phyin slob pa la zhugs te mdo sde'i sde snod kyi brjod bya ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa sogs rgya che ba'i lam gyi rim pa la slob par byed/ dbu ma 'jug pa rtsa bar byas te mngon pa'i sde snod dbu ma'i gzhung la sbyangs nas chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mthar thug pa rtogs pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba gtan la 'bebs/ chos mngon pa'i mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa rtsa bar byas te mngon pa'i gzhung la sbyangs nas khams kyi rab dbye gtan la 'be+ebs/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa rtsa bar byas te chos 'dul ba'i gzhung la sbyangs nas so thar gyi tshul khrims gtan la 'bebs par byed do/ /rig gnas chung ba lnga ni/ snyan ngag sdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod/ zlos gar/ skar rtsis te lnga yin la/ dang bo/ snyan ngag ni legs sbyar las bsgyur ba snyan ngag me long / dpag bsam 'khri shing / skyes rabs so bzhi ba sogs dang / bod rang la mtshon na kun gzigs lnga ba chen po sogs kyis mdzad pa'i me long ma'i 'grel ba dang / dpe brjod sogs snyan ngag gi gzhung rgyus bsdus sna tshogs pa yod pa dag la sbyangs nas tshigs 725

bcad dang / tshig lhug bcad lhug spel ma dag rtsom pa la byang bar byed dgos/ snyan ngag med na grong tshig tu song nas mi mdzes shing mkhas pa'i mdun sar rtsis su med de zur mkhar blo gros rgyal bos/ rgyal bo lang tshos dregs gyur kyang / /rgyan med pa na skye bos gleng / /de bzhin snyan ngag mi ldan pa'i/ /bstan bcos mkhas la rtsis su med/ /ces gsungs/ gzhan yang gong 'og tu yi ge bskur ba lta bu la mtshon na/ dngos su bshad na mi 'grig pa shugs la ston dgos pa dang / zur gyis go dgos pa dang / tshig gi nus pa 'don dgos pa sogs la snyan ngag med na de tsam gyi nus pa mi thon/ snyan ngag gi rgyan dang ldan na lta mkhan dang nyan mkhan gyi sems kyang spro seng nger 'gro ba sogs kyi yon tan yod la snyan ngag chen po shes par ma zad cung zad sbyangs pa dag la'ang snyan grags yod pa dang / mkhas pa'i grangs su 'gro ste/ snyan ngag me long las/ snyan ngag chung ngu la yang ngal byas mi/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sa dag tu 'dug la dbang / /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa sdeb sbyor ni sgra ste legs sbyar gyi brda sprod pa'i gzhung ka lā pa dang dbyangs can ma lta bu bamebs nas de rjes sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyi 'grel ba kha gsal zhig gi 726

sting nas ligs sbyar skad kyi sdeb sbyor bsgrig tshul bslab/ sde nas bod rgya shan sbyar gyi steng nas sdeb sbyor lci yang bsgrig ste lami dang wartu bod yig bcas sum rkang bsgrig pa ni sdeb sbyor gyis mdzes par byed pa yin pas snyan ngag gi yan lag yin la/ gzhan yang sngon gyi lo tsā ba rnams ltar legs sbyar las gzhung mchog tu gyur pa rnams bod skad du bsgyur ba/ sngar bsgyur zin pa dag la sgyur bcos byed pa lta bu'i sgo nas rig pa'i gnas dar zhing rgyas par byed pa de yin no/ / bod rang skad la mtshon na/ bṛt+ta dang dzā ta'i sdeb sbyor ji lta ba bzhin med mod/ bod yig la lci yang yo da de lci yang gi khyad par ni/ sngon gyi mkhas pa dag gi lugs bzhin du kho bos snyan ngag yang gsal snang mdzod du bkod yod/ ngal gso'am 'jog mtshams ni dper na/ pad+ma yi lte ba ru/ /ge sar gyi lang tsho ngom/ /rkang drug gi gshog glu de/ /rna ba yi dpal du grub/ /ces pa'i gor rtags can rnams ni ngal gso yin la/ mgur tshig tshig ring la sbyar ba/ dper na/ sprin dkar lang long g.yo ba yi gseb nas/ /g.yu 'brug gad mo lhang lhang du bsgrags pas/ /mdongs mtha' dga' ba'i sgro gur de phub nas/ /bro gar bsgyur ba'i ltad mo la blta'o/ /zhes pa lta bu 727

dang / yang ngal gso mi zer kyang tshig ya gcig tshig mgo la thon pa dper na/ dgung sngon mo'i dbyings rim na/ /bya rgod pos gshog rtsal 'gran/ /thang yangs mo'i thang dkyil na/ /rta mgyogs po'i bang rtsal 'gran/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gzhan yang yi ge 'jam pa shas che bas tshig mnyen pa'i nyams dang ldan pa rje'i gsung gi thub bstod skabs gsum pa lta bu/ yi ge myub pa shas che bas tshig brjid pa'i nyams dang ldan pa chos rgyal bstod pa brkyang bskum ma lta bu'o/ /de ltar gang la gang 'tsham gyi tshig sdeb pa ni snyan ngag gi char gtogs sdeb sbyor yin no/ /gsum pa mngon brjod ni ming gi rnam grangs mang bo yod pa la zer te/ dper na nyi ma lta bu la'ang ming bcu phrag du ma yod/ sgra/ snyan ngag sman rtsis sogs gzhung thams cad kyi nang du mngon brjod kyis bcings pa'i ming dang tshig mang bo yod pas ma shesake na gzhung de dag shes pa'i ge4/sa su 'gyur/ dper na/ nyi ma zhes pa kun gyis shes mod/ rta bdun dbang bo dang / sna tshogs 'od can zhes pa yod pa'i tshig dang 'phrad tshe/de nyi ma'i ming yin par ma shes na tshig de'i don go ba'i gegs su 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang rang gis snyan ngag gi rgyan dang ldan pa'i gzhung rtsom pa la mngon brjod med du mi rung ba yin te 728

daspir na/ tshig de'i nang du pad+ma zhes brjod tshe de tsam mi mardzos na mtsho skyes zhes brjod chog pa dang / des kyang tshig gi kha ma gang tshe de las ring ba'i pad ma'i ming sbrang ci'i rgyal mtshan zhes brjod chog pa lta bu'o/ / mngon brjod kyi gzhung ni legs sbyar las bsgyur ba mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod dang / bod rang gi mkhas pas brtsams pa mngon brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/ mngon brjod mkhas pa'i rna cha sogs yod pas de dag lta gzhir bzung ste sbyang dgos/ sbyong tshul yang gzhung gzhan ltar ched du gnyer nas ma sbyangs kyang snyan ngag gi gzhung dang / snyan ngag gis bcings pa'i gzhung dag sbyang ba dang lta klog byas na de dag gi nang du mngon brjod mang bo yod pas rim gyis byang bar 'gyur ro/ /de mtshungs gtam rgyud dag kyang shes dgos te/ gtam rgyud la sbyar nas brtsams pa'i snyan ngag mang bo yod pas de dag shes pa la phan pa dang / rang gis kyang snyan ngag rtsom pa la mkho'o/ /dper na/ khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu dang / rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud lta bu/ bstan 'gyur khrod kyi khyad par 'phags bstod dang /lha las phul byung gi bstod pa'i 'grel ba'i nang du phyi rol ba'i gtam rgyud mang bo yod pas der blta bar bya la nang ba sa ngas 729

rgyas pa'i gtam rgyud dag la'ang sbyang bar bya'o/ /bzhi ba zlos gar ni sngar sa skya paṇa chen gyis gsungs pa'i gzugs kyi nyi ma dang / bha ra ta la sogs pa dang phyis su yang legs sbyar las bod skad du bsgyur ba klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar dang / 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar sogs yod la rgya gzhung gi khungs dang ldan pa dag la bod rang gis legs bcos byas nas 'cham bzhin pa chos rgyal nor bzang / dri med kun ldan sogs dang / bod rang gi blos gar srong btsan sgam po/ khri srong lde btsan/ seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyi skor sogs yod pa rnams da lta slar gso byed bzhin pa'o/ /lnga ba skar rtsis ni dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa'i skar rtsis kyi rnam par gzhag pa la bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis legs par brtags shing dpyad de gtan la phab pa'i rtsis la bod rtsis zhes grags pa dang / rgya nag gser rtsis las bsgyur ba bod rang gi brtsi lugs su bcos te rang sa'i gnas tshul dang mthun par gtan la phab pa la rgya rtsis zhes grags/ rtsis de dag la brten nas nyi zla gza' skar 'khor tshul/ dus bzhi dang dus tshigs nyer bzhi/ nyi zla gza' 'dzin sogs la mi 'chug pa'i gzer thebs pa'i tshan rig gi lag len 'di lags la rig pa'i 730

gnas 'di sbyong tshe sa ris kyi ri mo byang ba tsam ma yin par go don dang sbyar nas zhib 'jug byed pa gal che'o/ /de ltar rig gnas 'gangs chen 'di dag la sbyangs te rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi 'thug po btings nas tshan rig lag rtsal gong du spel te mes rgyal dar zhing rgyas pa la 'bad dgos so/ /legs byas nyi ma gzhon nu'i rtse dab/'a yis/ /bde skyid pad mgazhon nu'i 'dab grol te/ /sde bzhi'i ge sar gzhon nu'i zil mngar la/ /skye dgu bung ba gzhon nus rol gyur cig / 73rku

mun sel sgro na ma/ bde chen blo gros 'od zhags rnon po yis/ / log smra mtshan mor 'khun pa'i 'dren byed la/ / smag mun stug po'i gos bzang sbyin mkhas pa/ /dran dbang bye ba'i gtsug rgyan de yis skyongs/ /de la 'dir bod gangs can gyi mi'i 'gro ba dag gi ming thogs tshul las brtsams te gleng bar bya ba ni/ sngon gyi lo rgyus smra ba'i bod kyi mkhas dbang bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ nol pa paṇa ḍi ta/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa/ stag tshang lo tsā ba sogs mkhas pa mang bos bod mi rigs 'di ston pa shākya thub pa 'jig rten du ma byon pa'i snga rol gyi lo stong phrag mang bo'i sngon nas grub par gsungs yod mod/bod rigs gsar bu 'ga' zhig gis deng dus phyi rgyal nas bod kyi mes po dag la dma' 'bebs par ci mi snyam zhing / bod rang gi nang khul gyi mthun sgril dang chab srid la phan e thogs mi 73lha

lta bar/ rang nyid mkhas par rlom 'dod kyi ri bas bskul te/sngon bod rang gi lo rgyus rtsom mkhan thams cad kyis ston pa shākya thub pa'i rjes su bod mi byung bar bshad ces gang dran byung rgyal du smras nas/ pha bsad nas rgyal rnga brdungs pa'i 'bras bu la deng dus ban bon mi mthun pa dang / mdo dbus mi mthun pa sogs bod nang khul gyi mthun sgril dang bde 'jags la gnod pa byung / bod kyi lo rgyus smra mkhan gtso bo rnams kyi bzhed pa gong smos ltar lags kyang / de dang mi mthun pa'i bshad tshul re gnyis yod srid/ 'on kyang de dag ni bod kyi mkhas pa tshang ma'i bshad tshul du byed rgyu ga la yod/ bod kyi lo rgyus smra ba'i mkhas pa kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po dang / dbal mang paṇa ḍi ta/ brag dgon bstan pa rab rgyas sogs ches mang che ba ni gong du bshad pa'i mkhas pa dag gi rjes su 'brang mkhan sha stag yin pa ma zad/ bod kyi lo rgyus smra mkhan de dag gi gsung tshul la da dung bden dpang gsar ba yod de/ deng dus gsar du rnyed pa'i chab mdo kha rab kyi rig gnas shugla rgyun las lo lnga stong lhag gi sngon rdo chas gsar ba'i skabs su'ang bod kyi sa char mi'i 'gro ba yod pa'i bden dpang byung ba dang / gzhan yang tsong kha'i yul gyi grong srin ca sde ba las sngog 'don byas pa'i kha yo'i rig 733

gnas shul rgyun te rdo chas gsar ba'i skabs kyi gna' mi'i rig gnas dang / mgo log sogs mdo smad kyi sa gnas kha shas nas sngog 'don byung ba'i gna' mi'i rig rdzas de dag kyang kha rab dang kha yo'i dus skabs dang mtshungs shing / gzhan yang kong po'i khog nas rnyed pa'i gna' rdzas sogs dbus gtsang phyogs nas rnyed pa dag kyang rdo chas skabs kyi dngos rdzas yin pa sogs kyis— kyang / sngon gyi mkhas pa de dag gi bzhed par bden dpang byas yod/ mi rigs gzhan pa la las/ bod kyi 'byung khungs ni lho nas byung ba yin pa'i bshad tshul de bod kyi chos lugs pa dag gis bshad pa red zer ba ni/ ma brtags byung rgyal du smras pa yin te/ bod kyi deb ther la snga ba bka' chems ka khol ma nas bzung ste/ mdo smad chos 'byung sogs kyi bar du byung ba'i lo rgyus deb ther/ rnam thar brgya phrag lhag gi nang du/ bod kyi rgyal bo'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po ni mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal bo'i rgyal rgyud yin par bshad yod pa las/ bod mi spyi'i 'byung khungs lho phyogs nas byung ba yin zhes bshad med/ 'on kyang phyis su rgya dkar nag dang / li dang / sog po sogs nas 'ongs pa'i rigs 'ga' zhig yod de/ phyis kyi 'phyongs rgyas pa za hor gyi rigs yin pa dang / rgya nag dang sog po'i rigs 734

kyang bod yul du gzhis chags pa yod mod/ 'on kyang de dag ni bod rigs kyi rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs yin par dpyod ldan sus smra ste smra mi nus so/ /de min nub phyogs kyi rgyal khab nas byung bar bshad pa dang / byang phyogs kyi rgya bod mtshams nas byung bar smra ba dag la khungs gang yang med/ bod kyi mi rgyud byung tshul dngos ni sngon gyi deb chither rnams zhal mthun par gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ lo stong phrag ches mang bo'i sngon dus su/ lho kha yar klung gi brag mgon po'i ri zhes pa'i brag dang / nags tshal la gnas nga/'i spre'u dang / brag srin mo 'dus pa las phru gu mang du 'phel/ la la ni pha dang 'dra/ la la ni ma brag srin mo dang 'dra/ rim gyis spre'u dang brag srin 'dus pas spra mang bo 'phel zhing / shing thog dang rgod skyes kyi 'bru rigs kyis 'tsho/ rim gyis smra zhing don go ba'i mi'i 'gro bar gyur te/ stod mnga' ris/ bar dbus gtsang / smad mdo khams stod smad rnams kyi sa chen po 'di dag mi'i rigs kyi 'gro ba des khyab par gyur/skabs shig nas mi rigs de'i ming bod ces 'dod rgyal du thogs par gyur to/ /de nas thog mar rus chen bzhir phyes pa'i khams ni/ ye sang / ye smon/ spyang / mon bzhi dang / de dag la che 'bod byas pas/ ye sang dkar bo/ ye smon nag 73bya

po/ spyang phrug ye shes/ mon rdzu nag po zer la/ phyis su rus de dag la bod mi dag gis ming so sor btags te/ ye sang dkar bo gnam gyi 'ju thag can/ ye smon nag po chu'i pha bong 'dra ba/ spyang phrug ye shes lha'i sgron me/ mon rdzu nag po khyi'i rnga ljang can zer ba byung / de dag btags pa'i rgyu mtshan yang /ye sang ni gnam gyi lhas skyob par byed pa dang / ye smon ni chu nang pha bong lta bu'i rang tshugs thub pa dang / spyang phrug ni mkhas pa mang bas lha'i sgron me lta bu dang / mon rdzu ni phyugs rigs dang sgo khyi mang bas khyi'i rnga ljang can/ zhes brjod par grags/des na thog ma'i rus chen bzhi ni/ ye sang / ye smon/ spyang /mon bzhi yin la/ ye sang ni bod kyi grub thob phal cher ye sang gi rigs yin zer zhing / dpon rang tshugs can rnams ni phal cher ye smon gyi mi rgyud yin pa dang / spyang gi rus rgyud deng sang dngos su grags che ba ni/ stod mnga' ris kyi byang phyogs ri bo gangs can nam gangs ti se zhes pa'i 'dabs su yod pa'i 'brog sde chen po de yin zer zhing de'i rus spyang yin stabs deng sang yang spyang zhes 'bod/ bud med kyi cha lugs sogs mdo smad kyi rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi cha lugs dang gcig pa yin zer la/ ra lug mang bas ra lpags kyi gos gyon mkhan mang / de min da 736

dung spyang gi rus rgyud mdo dbus gtsang gsum la yod par mngon mod/ phyis sga 'bri sbra ldong bzhir phyes pa dang 'dres te grags mi che bar gyur/ mon ni deng dus rgya gar dang bod kyi sa mtshams su gnas pa'i mon pa rigs su 'bod pa de/ bod kyi thog ma'i rus chen bzhi'i nang gi mon yin no/ /de rjes bod mi yang rus chen bzhir gyes pa ni/ sga 'bri spra ldong bzhi yin te/ de re ri la'ang dbye ba mang du yod pa/ dper na/ spra la dkar nag khra gsum/ de re re la che drug chung drug btsan drug gi rigs so sor yod pa dang / ldong la ldong shul chen bco brgyad dang / tsha chen bco brgyad sogs yod pa bzhin no/ /de dag la yi ge 'bri tshul sna tshogs shig yod pa ni/ bdag gis gzhan du bshad zin la/ dper na/ 'bri la'ang / 'bri dang 'bru gnyis ka yod /'bru 'di 'bri mkhan cung mang mod/ rus mdzod 'ga' zhig gi nang du 'bri rwa co can zhes bris yod gshis/ deng dus 'bri g.yag gi 'bri la gi gu can 'bri ba gtan khel zin pas de e bde snyam/de la 'dir thog mar rus chen bzhir phyes pa'i rus ming la brten nas/ mi rigs gzhan 'ga' zhig gis bod kyi mingabatags tshul brjod par bya ste/ rus chen bzhi ni/ ye sang /7bye7

yi smon/ spyang / mon bzhi yin la/ mon deng dus kyang pa'i mon pa zer ba de red/ de'i nang gi spyang gi rus kyi sgra la brten nas/ bod mi thams cad la spyang (lko)zer ba ni/ dper na/ deng sang bod mdo dbus gtsang gsum nang gi gtsang gi sgra kho na la brten nas bod mi thams cad la gtsang (sa)gi rigs zer ba bzhin no/ /deng sang (lkos)zer ba'i rgya yig 'di'i 'byung khungs ma shes par 'di bod yig tu sgyur skabs chang dang cha'ang dang 'jang sogs yi ge sna tshogs shig 'bri mod/ de'i 'byung khungs ni spyang zhes pa 'di yin/ 'jang zhes pa ni/ yun nan phyogs kyi 'jang rigs zer ba de yin zhing /bod rgyal gyis dbang du bsdus nas bod rigs dang 'dres te/cha lugs chos lugs goms 'dris sogs gang thad nas bod dang 'dra bar gyur mod/ deng sang yang ming la 'jang zer 'jang sa dam rgyal bo zer ba'i dpon kyang phyi rgyal du yul byol nas yod cing / deng sang 'jang dgon lnga yod/ bod yul ni sngon gyi deb ther rnams las/ stod mnga' ris kyi sa ni gangs dang g.ya'i ra ba yod pas rdzing dang 'dra/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi yod sa ni brag dang chu 'thab pa yur ba dang 'dra/ smad mdo khams ni nags dang na'i ljongs zhing dang 'dra/ zhes gsungs 738

pa ltar/ nags dang na'i ljongs zhes pa'i nags kyi ljongs ni shar rgyal mo tsha ba rong sogs mdo smad kyi rong chen dag yin zhing / na'i ljongs ni/ 'brog pa'i spang ljongs rnams yin pas/ des na/ tsong kha'i smad kyi rong khul/ reb gong phyogs/co no/ the bo/ zung chu'i phyogs/ chu nag dang khro chu'i phyogs/ rgyal rong phyogs dang mdo stod khams kyi rong khul sogs su bod kyis khyab nas yod/ rgya nag chen po'i yul la ltos te/ nub dang lho kun tu bod mis khyab yod pas skabs shig ring bod dag la shi spyang ( krelko)ze—ra zhing / mdo khams kyi sa dma' sa'i rong khul bod rnams la ti spyang ( calko)yang zer/ rjes su bod mi'i ming la bod ces 'bod kyin yod pa thos nas/ bod spyang ('ilko)zer/ de rjes bod ces pa'i sgra gdangs rgya yig tu phab ste thu bod(lotshi)ces zer ba dang / bod btsan po'i rgyal sa yod sa dbus gtsang la dmigs pa gtso bor bzung nas dbus gtsang phyogs kyi bod mi la thu bod(lozo)ces 'bod/ mdo khams kyi dma' sa'i bod rnams la sngar bzhin ti spyang ( zlalko)dang / yang skabs shig la shi bod(skrur+sā)kyang zer/ rgya'i lo rgyus phal cher gyi nang du(tshi)dang (tshi)gnyis kyi gna' rabs kyi sgra'i gdangs ni(⑫)'di'i klog sgra dang 'dra zhes bris 'dug 739

pas/ bod ces pa'i sgra/ bris pa yin 'dugayang mtha' mtshams kyi bod sde 'ga' zhig gis rang la bod mi zer bar brten deng sang bod mi rigs zhes rigs gzhan pa zhig yin par byas/ bod kyis bod rang la bod mi zer zhing rgya la rgya mi zer/ de snga shar phyogs kyi rgyal bo dag gis bod kyi sa mtshams la rgya bskyed pa'i dbang gis dmag 'khrug yang yang 'byung skabs/ bod kyi dmag rnams rgod cing gtum pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ bod mi la man tsi(phacha)zhes 'bod/ dus yun ring bo'i bar du de ltar thogs/ mgar btsan gnyan ldom bu sogs mgar sku mched bzhi yang sa mtshams su bzhugs te/g.yul bkyes nas dasngi rnams pham zhing so mtshams srung ba'i lo rgyus grags che/ de'i yab sras la rgya'i yig rigs su bod blon(d+kutshocha)zhes 'khod/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ si khron nub rgyud zung chu phyogs kyi chu nag sogs kyi bod mi rnams la bod blon rigs(d+kutsholo)zer/ de rjes shar phyogs rgyal bos nub phyogs su rgya bskyed pa'i skabs/ lho phyogs sa rong rtsub pas dmag lam mi bde bar/ byang phyogs mtsho sngon phyogs nas dmag bskyod byas te thog mar gtsang la slebs/ de nas mdo dbus gtsang gsum nang gi gtsang gi ming de bod spyi'i ming yin par 740

byas nas bod mi thams cad la gtsang rigs(lkoṣā)zer zhing /dbus gtsang la nub gtsang ( os)zer/ mi ring ba'i sngon dus su mdo khams stod kyi mi dang yul la nub khams( ojo)zer/ deng skabs hor dkor mdzes kyi ming de mdo khams stod kyi mi dang yul la btags te/ mdo stod kyi yul gru tshang ma la dkar mdzes zer ba dang / mi thams cad la dekar mdzes mi zer gyin 'dug mdo smad kyi zung chu mdzod dge chu nag khro chu rgyal rong sogs la rnga ba zhes ming btags/ rnga ba ni yul shog gcig yin la/ de'i ming yul gru du ma zhig la btags nas/rnga ba'i zung chu'i mi rigs/ rnga ba'i lis shan/ rnga ba'i chu nag gi mi zhes sogs 'bri bzhirno 'dug rnga ba zhes pa'i sgra yang ji bzhin 'bri mi thub par/ a pa zhes bris/ gzhan yang ming 'gyur ba mang ste/ dper na/ btsan lha la sngar mi mgo(ṭhamo)zer/ mang go zer ba sgra ma dag pa yin 'dug de rjes zha'o cin (sh+lau/nowaṃ)zer/ chu chen rdzong la sngar cing hwa(tho.oṃ )zer/ de rjes ta cin(oṃ༅)zer/ deng sang cin khron(༅)// )zhes 'bod pa sogs dus thung ring ming du ma zhig 'gyur te lo rgyus la rnyog gra bzos/ bod rang gi skad la gna' nas da bar de dag gi ming la 'gyur ba ma byung bas lo rgyus 'tshol bde/ de ltar rus bzhi'i 741

nang gi rus gcig gi ming la brten nas spyang (lko)zhes 'bod pa dang / yul bye brag pa zhig gi ming la brten nas gtsang (7)zhes 'bod pa red/ deng sang bod thams cad la gtsang rigs (saṭha)zer mod/ lo rgyus kyi dus yun ring tsam song rjes/gtsang gi mi de bod yin pa las de min thams cad mi rigs gzhan zhig red zer nas mi rigs gzhan zhig gi ming mi 'dogs pa'i nges pa med/ deng sang 'ga' zhig gis spyang (lko)zhes pa'i mi'i 'byung khungs dang ming thogs tshul sogs mi shes par rang 'dod sna tshogs shig bris pa la snying po yod med brtag na legs/ rgya'i lo rgyus kyi yig rigs dag tu spyang zhes par thog mar yi ge(lko)'di bris yod pas/ de ni mi'i yi ge dang ra lug gi yi ge gnyis brtsegs nas bris pa zhig yin stabs/ ra lug 'tsho ba'i 'brog pa la go zer/ yang yin hrang (lo.oṃ)gi dus su/ sog mo 'debs pa'i sog rus kyi steng du‘‘ḍi’’'di bris yod pa ral ba dang thag pa'i gzugs 'dra bas/ ral ba can dang / g.yul du bzung ba'i btson ma la go na chog spyang (lko)yig 'di rnyog gra che ba'i ming zhig ste/ skabs 'gar rgyal khab re'i ming 'dra ba/ yang skabs 'gar mi rigs shig gi ming 'dra ba/ skabs 'gar mi rigs shig gi nang gi gral rim zhig la 742

go chog pa/ skabs 'gar bya tshig tu gyur nas bsad pa dang 'dul ba'i don dang 'dra/ lo bcu phrag 'ga'i ring la bshad tshul sna tshogs shig byung yang / da bar bshad tshul gtan khel ba zhig med/ ces deng sang gi rgya yig gi lo rgyus dag las bden gtam bshad/ yang (pholko)zer ba zhig yod/ de rta 'tsho mkhan gyi mi rigs shig gam yang na rta bla zog tu rtsi mkhan zhig yin pa red ces dang / yang hrang gi dus su hrang gi rgyal bos/hrang gi rgyal srid la spyang (lko)gi gnod pa yod med dang / spyang (lko)la 'thab na rgya'/ kha lon mi lon zhes mo btab pa'i lo rgyus yod stabs/ spyang (lko)zhes pa de mi rigs stobs ldan zhig yin pa 'dra zhes kyang 'khod 'dug bshad tshul 'di dag la bltas na/ 'ga' zhig gis spyang (lko)zhes pa'i ming de 'dogs yul dang / nges tshig rigs sogs mdzub mo 'dzugs sa zhig ma rnyed par/ rang rang gi snang bar gang shar bris pa shin tu gsal /des na mong lun gyi rta dmag la bcings 'grol sngon du/ rta dmag zer zhing khro chu dang chu nag gi mi dang 'dra bar bod rigs su brtsi ba las/ spyang (lko)rigs zhes pa'i mi rigs gzhan pa yin pa'i sgra tsam thos rgyu med/ chu nag sogs dang skad dang goms 'dris yang 'dra zhing / la bong sa cha'i rta dmag ces bod 743

rang du brtsi/ dper na dmu dge'i sar de ga nas 'ongs pa'i khyim tshang kha shas yod pa tshor la bong bod mi zhes bod du brtsi ba las/ spyang (ṭha)zhes pa'i sgra tsam yang med/ bcings 'grol rjes su spyang (lhu)rigs zhes pa'i mi rigs shig logs su btsugs pa der dge mtshan ci yang ma mthong ste/ kho tsho bod dang yul tsho gcig mi byed zer ba sogs lab gleng je mang du song nas mthun sgril la bar chad byung yod/ mdor na/ mdo smad na dang nags kyi ljongs zhes pa'i nags kyi ljongs ni/ mong wun gyi yul tshud pa'i rong khul dag yin la/ de dag tu sprel rgyud kyi bod mis khyab nas yod pa sngon gyi bod rang gi rang rus bshad pa dang mthun/ rjes su shar phyogs thang gi stobs shugs rgya bskye da kyis bod mir ka ci(azlorke)mi dang / ti spyang ( khyazo)zer ba sogs ming sna tshogs shig btags mod/ 'on kyang bod rgyal srong btsan gyis bod dmag 'bum phrag du ma mngags nas thang dmag mtha' 'ded byas te/ so mtshams spung ba'i dmag du ma brgyab pa'i lo rgyus yod/mong wun gyi rta dmag zer ba 'di yang de dus kyi rta dmag gi rgyud yin gshis/ ming la rta dmag zer la/ ru dmag kyang zer/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni bod kyis dmag gi ming la rtswa ba zer 744

zhing / dmag gi mtshon cha mdung dar sogs la ru mtshon zhes deng sang yang yi ge de bzhin du 'bri/ de'i phyir 'di dag gi ming la'ang ru dmag ces kyang 'bod/deng sang rgya yig gi lo rgyus yig rigs 'ga' zhig nang tshizung chu'i stod rgyud kyi spyang rigs rnams la 'byung khungs sna tshogs bshad rgyu yod mod/ gcig gyur gyi bshad tshul ni kho tsho'i mes po nub byang gi sa cha'am 'bri g.yag mang ba'i sa cha zhig nas zung chu'i chu rgyud du thon pa yin zer/ des na nub byang gi spyang (ṭha)dang zung chu'i chu rgyud kyi spyang mi 'di dag la mi rgyud kyi 'brel ba yod pa gsal zhes 'khod 'dug pa ni zhib 'jug legs par byas pa'i rtags red/bdag gis rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi gnas tshul mdor bsdus zhes par cung zad dpyad par bya ste/ de las zung chu'i chu 'gram gnyis su spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs bzhi ba'i mjug tu ti spyang ( ṣālko)gis phyugs 'tshos nas yod/ ces bod rigs las gzhan pa zhig yin khul byas kyang / de ni bod mi yin te gong du bshad pa ltar sngar bod mi la spyang ( lko)dang /phyis mtho khul gyi bod mi la shi spyang (poṭha)zer ba dang / dma' khul gyi bod la ti rmya nga ( zlalko)zer bas bod yin pa gsal lo/ /745

de min na di 'dra'i mi rigs shig gang nas 'ongs pa dang / de'i 'byung khungs gang yin shod cig yang han rgyal rabs nas bzung rang rgyal nub byang gi spyang rigs rnams gzhis spor chen po gnyis byas nas zung chu'i chu stod rgyud lda thon pa yin zer/ 'o na de'i nub byang ni gang red/ zung chu'i chu ni mdo khams kyi sar yod la/ dbus gtsang nub byang du yod pas/ dbus gtsang la ngos 'dzin rgyu e yin/ yin na dbus gtsang nas 'ongs pa'i bod mi yin pa thag gis chod/yang der nub byang gi spyang rigs gzhis spor chen po gnyis byas pa'i snga ma ni rgyal khab gsum gyi skabs yin pa dang / phyi ma ni su'e dang thang gi skabs yin zhing / skabs der zung chu'i chu bo'i stod rgyud du zhis hran gyi gnyug mar ba/nas pa'i spyang rigs zer ba'i ru sde zhig yod zer/ des na shi spyang ( khrolko) stematho sgang gi bod rnams phyis su gzhis spor byas pa tsam ma zad/ snga mo nas sa de dag tu spyang ste bod yod par bshad pa yin pas/bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther rnams su mdo dbus gtsang gsum du bod mis gang bar bshad pa la bden dpang byas pa ma red dam/su'e thang rgyal rabs kyi skabs su bod kyi rgyal bos shar phyogs su rgya bskyed pas zhes zer rung / don du shar phyogs 746

rgyal bos nub phyogs su rgya bskyed de/ bod yul mdo khams smad kyi mtha' khul zung chu sogs kyi bod mi yar ded nas sa cha de dag thang dmag gis bzung ste kru'u mang bo btsugs par/ bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po thugs khros nas bod dmag 'bum phrag du ma btang ste thang dmag rnams zung chu dang we kru'u sogs nas bskrad de so mtshams srung dmag bzhag lo ngo brgyad kyi bar du bod dang thang 'khrugs nas mthar thang pham ste/ rgya bza' kong jo bod la byin pa sogs kyi skor dkar chag nor bu'i phreng ba sogs sngon gyi deb ther rnams las bshad pa don la gnas/ 'ga' zhig gis bod thang 'khrug skabs bod pham nas rgya bza' bod la byin pa red zer ba su'i rna bar 'gro/ yang bod rgyal gyis shar phyogs su rgya bskyed pas rang rgyal nub byang gi ho hung sa cha'i spyang rigs rnams nang khul du gzhis spor byas/ de'i nang gi skor gcig zung chu'i chu stod kyi zung kru'u dang ma'o kru'u la yong ste/ de nas rim bzhin zung chu'i chu stod kyi spyang rigs rnams rim gyis chags pa red/ ces zer ba ni gong du zung chu'i chu stod du gnyug mar gnas pa'i spyang sde yod par bshad pa dang / de'i steng du nub byang gi spyang rigs rnams gzhis spor byas nas yong bar bshad pa gong du shog lho gcig tsam ma song bar rang tshig snga phyi 'gal bar 747

song ba'i gtam du zad/rnga ba khul gyi bod rnams ni bod rgyal gyis shar phyogs su rgya bskyed pa'i skabs sa de'i ti spyang ( ṣālko)gi sde ba dang 'dres nas rim gyis chags pa red ces zer ba yang mi 'thad de/ thang gis nub phyogs su rgya bskyed pa la brten nas bod thang 'khrug pa'i snga rol nas sa cha 'di dag bod kyi sa cha yin zhing bod mi yod pa yin te/ khyed kyis ti spyang ( zla〉)zer ba de bod yin pa gong du bshad zin to/ / yang 'brog pa'i bod rnams kyis rang la a mdo ba zer zhes bshad mod/ a mdo ni a chen gangs la dang mdo la ring mo man chod kyi sa la a mdo/ mi la a mdo ba zer bar mdo smad chos 'byung dang rnam thar sogs su gsungs pa ltar/ mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi bod mi dang mi rigs gzhan dag gis kyang zer bas/ 'brog pa rnams rang nyid kho nas zer ba ga la yin/yang de las/ de ni (a mdo ba zer)su'e thang gi skabs su deng sang gi si khron dang / kan su'u/ mtsho sngon dag gi mtshams su phyugs las gtso bo dang zhor du zhing las byed pa'i 'a zha'i rgyal khab yod cing / de'i rgyal rgyud ni sog po mu'u rong gi rgyud red/'a zha'i rtsa ba ni phal cher gnyug mar gnas pa'i spyang sde yin pas/748

goms srol thad spyang gi shan zhugs yod ces zer/ de yang sog po yin zer ba dang gnyug mar gnas pa'i spyang sde yin zer ba nang 'gal du gyur pa dang / 'a zha ni bod yin/ bod la rus chen bzhi yod pa'i nang gi smu tsha rga yin te/ mi bu gdung drug gi rus mdzod las/ yul mi nyag nas ldong rigs/ de bzhin du sum pa nas 'bri rigs/ zhang zhung nas spra/ 'a zha nas rga byung ste/ zhes dang / yang de las/ me dang rta sbrul seng 'a zha/ /lcags dang bya sprel sbra zhang zhung / /sa dang gshed bzhi rgyal drang rje/ /chu dang byi phag ldong mi nyag /ces dang /rus mdzod dpe rnying las/ ldong la rus chen bco brgyad grol/ /seng rgyal 'a zha bu dgu grol/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'a zha ni bod kyi btsan po'i mnga' 'og gi rgyal phran zhig yin/ skabs skabs su rgyal phran dag gis btsan po'i srid gzhung la ngo log byed pas/ btsan pos dmag btang nas drag 'dul byed dgos byung / srong btsan gyi skabs su thang gi dkrug shing 'og 'a zhas btsan po'i srid gzhung la ngo log brgyab par srong btsan thugs khros nas dmag mngags te 'a zha'i rgyal phran btsan 'dul byas/yang bod kyis shar phyogs su rgya bskyed skabs 'a zha rtsa med du btang zer ba'ang mi 'thad de/ 'a zha ni phyis su gnas yod de/749

glang dar ma bkrongs rjes/ zhang kho bzher gyis/ zhang pe per dmag drangs skabs kyi lo rgyus thad thang yig las‘‘zhang yu blo pham ste zung kru'u la log sum pa/ 'a zha/ zhang zhung bcas kyi dmag mi brgyad khri bsdus nas tha'o thos gtsang po'i rgyud du sgar btabami ces 'khod pa dang / deng sang yang yod de/ mdzod dge'i chos rje dgon pa'i gong gi 'a zha sde ba lta bu'o/ /sum pa ni bod yin te gnya' khri btsan pos bod gcig gyur byed pa'i skabs kyi rgyal phran bcu gnyis kyi grangs su sum pa dang zhang zhung gnyis ka yod pa lho brag chos 'byung du 'khod yod la/ tun hong gi gter yig tu'ang 'khod yod/ mi nyag gi rgyal bo dang 'brug pa'i rgyal bo'i thog ma gnyis bod mi spun gnyis yin pa rgya bod yig tshang du 'khod pa dang / 'brug pa'i rgyal bo'i lo rgyus nang du'ang yod/ 'brug pa ni bod sil bur ma thor bar btsan po'i mnga' 'og gi rgyal phran zhig byas pa ma zad/ phyis su'ang bod srid gzhung la dpya khral 'jal dgos kyi yod/ mi nyag ni bod rgyal btsan po dang gnyen nye mna' mthun byas nas bsdad pa las/ phan tshun dpon 'bangs byas pa'i lo rgyus ma mthong mod/'on kyang de'i dpon 'bangs thams cad bod rigs yin pa rus mdzod dag tu gsal/ gru gu zer ba de bod rgyal btsan po'i srid 750

gzhung gis btsan 'dul byas te bod rigs kyi nang du thim mod/ma gzhi bod rigs min las che/ tang zhang gi spyang rigs zer ba de bod kyi rus chen bzhi'i nang gi ldong rigs yin la/ phyis su mi nyag tu grags par bshad/ 'on kyang / gzhis ma spar ba'i tang zhang spyang rigs kyi ming la bod kyis mi 'og zer zhing mi zhol mar brtsi/ zhes bris par khungs ma mthong zhing / bod kyi lo rgyus gang du'ang de 'dra med/ der brten bod dang tang zhang spyang dang pe'e lan spyang / sog po 'ga' 'dres pa ni/ deng sang gi 'brog pa'i bod rnams red/ zer ba ni ma brtags nyam nga ba'i gtam red/ 'brog pa'i bod rnams ni rnga ba dang khro kho lta bu ldong shul chen bco brgyad kyi nang tshan yin la/ dbal shul/thal shul/ sngo shul sogs ming ma 'gyur bar yod pa dang /mgo log rnams ni a lcags 'bri yin pa'i rus mdzod du ma yod/mdzod dge'i 'brog pa rnams ni dga' ye shes dar rgyas kyis 'brog ru bzung ba sogs mdzod dge'i lo rgyus skabs su bdag gis bshad zin/yang / rgyal rong gi bod rigs kyis rang la rgyal rong ba zer zhes pa dang / rgyal rong gi dbang sgyur gral rim mi nyung ba re ni bod ljongs nas 'ongs pa red/ bod skad la rgyal ni rgya'i 751

don dang / rong ni grog rong gi don yin la/ rgyal rong cho/sa pa ni rgya rigs dang thag nye sa'i grog rong du yod pa'i sdod dmangs red/ ces bris pa dag ni rgyus med rgyus gtam kho nar snang ste/rgyal rong zhes pa ni rgyal rong ba rang nyid kyis zer ba tsam ma yin par/ bod gangs ljongs yongs su grags pa zhig yin te/ shar rgyal mo tsha ba rong zhes bod kyi rong chen bzhi'i grangs su bgrangs pa gong du bshad pa ltar red/ yang / rgyal ni rgya'i don dang /rong ni grog rong gi don yin zhes bris pa ni dgod bro ba'i gtam 'ba' zhig tu zad de/ rgya rigs kyi rgya la rjes 'jug med pa dang / rgyal rong gi rgyal la rjes 'jug yod pa'i khyad par tsam yang ma shes pa 'di ni bod yig lta ci bod skad dag po zhig kyang rgyag mi shes pa'i rgya min bod min zhig la dris nas bris par zad do/ /shar rgyal mo tsha ba rong zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi don ni/ bod kyi shar phyogs yin pas shar/ lha chen rgyal mo dpu rdo'i ri rgyud du yod pas rgyal mo/ bod yul gyi tsha ba cung che ba'i sa yin pas tsha ba/ gro nas sran gsum thon pa'i rong khul yinapas rong zhes grags pa yin/ grog rong zhes pa ni mi mi thar sa g.yang che ba/ der lhung na shi rgyu yin pa'i gcong rong gi don red/ rgyal rong de lta bu zhig yin na gro nas sran gsum ga 752

la thon/ shar rgyal mo tsha ba ru+o nga la de las lhag pa'i dma' 'bebs byed rgyu gang zhig yod/ rgyal rong gi lo rgyusari 'khod pa'i yi ge sngon dus kyi slob dpon bai ro tsa na'i rnam thar kha shas/ lho brag chos 'byung sogs deb ther du ma/ slob dpon g.yu sgra snying po'i lo rgyus/ btsan lha'i sum mdor 'khrungs pa'i tsha kho ngag dbang grags pa'i lo rgyus kha shas/ bon gyi slob dpon shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/rong ston shes bya kun rig gi rnam thar/ rong ston blo bzang grags pa'i rnam thar/ mkhas grub rje'i dngos slob chos kyi grags pa'i rnam thar/ rgyal ba 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin bod kyi rgyal bor bzhugs pa rgyal rong mkhyen rab dbang phyug gi rnam thar/ ('di la rgyal rong ho thog thu zer zhing rgyal bo mgo dkar zhes grags che) khri thog don bzhi ba byang rtse blo bzang lhun grub kyi rnam thar/ dga' ldan khri thog don brgyad pa rgyal rong ye shes chos 'phel gyi rnam thar/ khri gya gsum pa rgyal rong dbang phyug nam mkha'i rnam thar/ khri gya bzhi ba rgyal rong blo bzang tshul khrims kyi rnam thar/ gzhan yang rgyud stod mkhan po 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las/ rgyud smad kyi mkhan po blo bzang tshul khrims/ mkhan po rgyal mtshan bstan dar/ ma/khan po 753

'angom dbyangs dam ts+tshas/ si ra byes pa'i mkhan po blo bzang shes rab/ mkhan po bsod nams dar rgyas/ mkhan po blo bzang dam chos/ ser smad mkhan po blo bzang dpal ldan/ngor ba mkhan po blo bzang tshul khrims/ rgyal rong mkhan po blo bzang don 'grub/ pha bong kha ba'i mkhan po bstan 'dzin blo bzang / mgar thar mkhan po blo bzang mkhas grub/ mgar thar mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ yang de'i mkhan po blo bzang chos 'phel/ sog tsan dan gyi mkhan po ngag dbang dpal ldan/shi ri dar rgyas gling gi mkhan po bstan pa chos 'phel/ yang de'i mkhan po rgyal rong rab 'byams pa/ spyi smad mkhan po bsod nams rdo rje/ dbus stod byams pa gling gi mkhan po blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ mal gro mkhan po 'phrin las/ de'i mkhan po grags pa dpal ldan sogs kyi lo rgyus dang rnam thar ci rigs dang / mdo smad chos 'byung sogs chos 'byung mang bo dang /kun mkhyen 'jigasdo/ med dbang bo/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me/ bod sde pa gzhung gi gzhung yig se 'bras dge gsum gyi rgyal rong khang tshan gyi lag deb/ rdo ring paṇa ḍi ta/ kiti bsta na pa'i rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' chos 'phags kyi rnam thar sogs yi ge khungs dag rnams su rgyal rong zhes bris pa sha stag 754

yin/ de dag tu bltas na gsal bor yod pas bsnyon ma ldang zhig khyed cag gis bod kyi lo rgyus dang bod yig mi shes na'ang /bod yig dang bod kyi lo rgyus la mkhas pa dag gi ngag la brten nas zhib dpyod byed par zhu zhes gsol lo/ /de min bod yig dang bod kyi lo rgyus mi shes pa'i mi rdzun rkyal re'i kha la nyan pa dang / rgya yig kho na la brten nas bod kyi lo rgyus lag tu gang yong bris na rdzun gtam du gyur nas phan pa gang yang med par 'gyur ro/ /bod yig gi thog tu'ang rgya'i lo rgyus mi nyung ba re yod mod/ rgya'i lo rgyus la rgya yig gtso zhing khungs thub/ bod kyi lo rgyus la bod yig gtso zhing khungs dag pa yin/ rang rang lo rgyus yod med kyi khyad par ro/ /yang rnga ba'i khul gyi hos dang rgya ni thang rgyal rabs kyi rjes —nas 'ongs pa red/ sung rgyal rabs kyi mgor rgya rigs mi nyung ba zhig spyang yul du thon/ zhes bris pa bden 'dug de ni shar gyi rgyal bos nub tu rgya bskyed pa'i khungs ma red dam/spyir rgya rigs 'ga' zhig gis ming 'dogs tshul la nges can gyi gzhi 'dzin sa mi dgos te/ 7 bod kyi rus chen spyang la brten nas/ bod spyi la spyang zhes 'bod pa dang / bod kyi yul bye brag pa gtsang la brten nas bod spyi la gtsang zer ba 755

dang / yang rnying ma ba la chos dmar bo('i7)dang / bka' rgyud pa la chos dkar po( dze+em)/ sa skya ba la chos khra bo (7ma)/dge lugs pa la chos ser po(r+sā7)zer/ bka' rgyud pa la chos dkar bo zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bka' rgyud pa zhes pa de dkar rgyud pa zer ba yin rgyu red snyam pa'i log rtog shar te btags pa dang / sa skya ba la chos khra bo zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/khang ba khra bo zhig mthong nas sa skya ba thams cad de 'dra snyam pa'i log rtog cig skyes nas btags par zad mod/ sa skya ba thams cad kyi khang ba khra bo min la/ bka' rgyud ces pa'i bka' dang dkar gyi yi ge dang sgra gnyis ka mi gcig pa ma shes la/ karma pa zhes pa'i karma de nyid saṃ skṛ ta'i skad yin la/ bod skad du bsgyur na 'phrin las zhes pa yin pa sogs ma shes pa'o/ /yang bod skad du slob dpon dang bshes gnyen la bla ma zer ba la brten nas/ bod kyi nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i chos la bla ma'i chos(glolko7)zer/ bod kyi chos ni bla slob gnyis ka'i chos yin pa mi shes/ yang dge skul lcags dbyug can mthong nas/ dge skul lcags dbyug can yin min kun la lcags dbyug bla ma(ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhaskalko)dang / dbu mdzad la kha grag bla ma (〉 ṣ+ṭhatshelko)zer/ bod rang gis dge skul dang dbu mdzad la tsho756

bla ma mi zer la/ tshogs chen dge skul las gzhan pa'i grwa tshang so so'i dge skul gyis lcags dbyug mi 'dzin la/ dbu mdzad ma yin pa dag gis kyang kha grag rgyu red la 'don pa yang 'don rgyu red/ yang nged cag gi sar ska bar stag rtse zhes pa'i gnas ri zhig yod pa de'i mdun nas 'ong ba'i chu bo de ska khog brgyud mdzod dge sog tshang dgon pa'i mdun nas rma chu dang 'dres kyi yod/ bcings 'grol skabs skad sgyur zhig la chu de'i ming dris pas/ ska chu zer zhes brjod par/ 'o/ dkar chu zer ba yin rgyu red snyam nas rgya skad la deng sang dkar chu( phyad+ku)zhes brjod bzhin yod/ de ltar ming gang byung du btags nas lo rgyus la rnyog gra bzos pa shin tu mang ngo /de ni bod kyi chos 'byung dang deb ther dag gi dgongs don bzhin bshad na/ stod mnga' ris dang / bar dbus gtsang /smad mdo khams kyi thams cad bod kyi mis gang nas yod par bshad la/ de bzhin du mdo khams smad kyi rong 'brog gi sa kun tu bod kyi mi sde chags nas yod/ de rjes shar phyogs kyi rgyal bo dag gis mtha' nas rim zos kyis dmag gi rten gzhi mang bo btsugs shing / khyad par du thang lu te'i(salko)skabs nas bzung dmag 'bor chen bod rgya'i sa mtshams su drangs nas bod 757

mi rnams gsod rdung dang mtha' 'ded kyis/ mkhar dang dmag gi rten gzhi mang bo btsugs/ mdo khams smad kyi sa'i cha rnga ba/medzod dge/ the bo/ zung chu/ rgyal rong sogs su kru'u zer ba'i dmag srid kyi las khungs brgya lhag btsugs/ bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus bod dmag 'bum phrag mang bo mngags nas/ thang gi dmag dang lo mang bor g.yul bkyes/ mthar thang dmag mtha' sgrod dang thang dmag gi rten gzhi mkhar rnams gtor nas so mtshams srung ba'i dpon dmag mang bo bzhag ste chogatan sdod byas pa'i mi rgyud ni deng sang gi rgyal rong / khro chu/rta dmag zung chu sogs kyi bod rnams yin/ mdzod dge sogs 'brog pa'i sa char sngar yod bod mi rnams thang dmag gis bsgral 'ded byas shing / de rjes thang dmag gis gzhis btsugs nas yod pa rnams srong btsan gyi skabs su mtha' skrod btang bas/sa cha de tsho re zhig gi bar du sa stong du lus/ khri ral ba can gyi skabs su thang gis kyang nub phyogs su rgya bskyed pas g.yul 'khrug du ma byung / khyad par du tsong kha'i g.yul 'gyed chen po zhes grags pa'i g.yul 'gyed kyi rjes su thang gis bab phul te chings bzhag nas/ rgya'i rgyal sa khrang an/bod kyi lha sa/ sa mtshams gung gu rmi ru gsum du rdo ring gsum 758

btsugs/ mchod rton dkar bam̐ yan chod bod kyi mnga' khongs byas/ de'i skabs shig tu dga' ye shes dar rgyas zer ba'i bod blon ka ci'i mchod rten yan chod kyi mi ser la dpya khral bsdu bar 'ong skabs mdzod dge'i 'brog sa sa stong yin pa mthong nas/chu bo chen po gsum 'bab cing rtswa chu phun sum tshogs pa'i sa cha 'di legs pa'i 'brog sar 'dug snyam ste bod 'bangs du ma khrid nas 'brog sde btsugs pa ni deng sang gi mdzod dge dang de'i rgyud pa mdzod dge dme bo dang / co ne rnams yin zhes rus mdzod dang / mdo smad chos 'byung sogs su yod/ gzhan dzi/nga tsong kha'i g.yul 'gyed skabs kyi dmag dpon chen po de bud g.yag khur zer ba dmag dang bcas pa so mtshams srung phyir 'theb kyi brag dkar du bzhugs pa'i rgyud pa deng sang gi the bo zer ba 'di dag yin par gsungs so/ /des na 'di dag gi khungs bod kyi lo rgyus ma zad rgya'i lo rgyus rnams su'ang yod de/ thang yig gsar ma las‘‘thu bhod ni nub kyi spyang (ṭha )gi rus su gtogs la/ der yang rigs brgya dang lnga bcu mchis/ rma chu/ tsong chu/ zung chu'i 'bab yul du bkram ste gnas/ de la'ang bod spyang dang thang mo la sogs pa mchis te/ krung go dang 'brel ni ma byung / sdod sa zhi kri chu 759

bo'i rgyud du byed/ mis por spur rgyal du 'bod cing / dpa' zhing mdzangs la/ spyang kha shas bsdu rub kyis der gzhi btsugs/bod dang / bod ces pa'i sgra yong ched de'i rjes rabs la thu bod du grags shing / rus ni spur rgyal du bya/ ’zhes dang /thang yig rnying ma las‘‘bod kyi shar phyogs su leng kru'u dang / sung kru'u/ ma'o kru'u/ sos kru'u 'brel zhing / lho bal bo dang 'brel/ nub tu thang gi chig tshi dang thi'u li sogs sde bsdi bcom ste bzung / byang phyogs su gru gurko dang 'brel yod pas mnga' ris le dbar khri phrag lhag mchis/ han rgyal rabs dang we rgyal rabs kyi dus nas bzung / nub phyogs kyi mi rigs rnams kyi khrod du stobs 'di ltar che ba ni byung ma myong ’’zhes sogs rgya bod lo rgyus kyi khungs mi nyung ba yod do/ / mun sel sgron me zhe sa bya ba 'dini/ bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas sbyar/yi ge ba ni lung rigs smra ba dge slong 'jam dbyangs blo gsal dang / skad gnyis smra ba shes rab ral gri'o/ /760

mdo smad tsong kha'i bod rgyal jo sras sam rgyal sras zer ba'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ tsho mdo smad kyi lo rgyus la/ rgya nag sung gi deb ther dang bsdur nas dpyad na/ tsong kha'i rgyal bo zhes mdo smad lda dbang bsgyur ba'i rgyal bo stobs ldan zhig byung 'dug rgya'i yig char de'i mtshan la‘ sprur+sātsho77zer/ 'di jo sras zhes pa yin nam zer ba dang / rgyal sras zer ba red ces zer ba'ang 'dugagang yin thag mi chod kyang / gang ltar bod kyi rgyal rgyud cig yin pa rgya'i lo rgyus kun mthun 'dug rgya yig srid phan me long du shin cang gi go khrang gi sa nas ling ye shan zhes pas spyan drangs par bshad/ gang ltar khos mdo khams smad de a mdo yongs rdzogs la dbang bsgyur/ kho spyi lo997la 'khrungs nas1065la 'das par bshad/ bod kyi lo rgyus la gzhigs na/ thu'u 761

bkwan ts+tshas kyi nyi ma'i rnam thar gyi rus chen bra 'bru ldong gsum las bra yin/ khri srong gi sras chung ba sad na legs mjing yon gyi sras dar ma/ 5 de'i sras gnagalde 'od srung / de'i sras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/ de'i sras khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal/ de'i sras 'od lde/ de la sras bzhi byung ba'i gnyis pa khri lde/ khri lde 'bangs ha cang mi mang tsam dang bcas mdo smad du byon/ de dus bra lde'ang rgyal bo dang lhan du mdo smad du thon cing / mtsho khri shor rgyal mo'i 'gram bod kyis bzung ste/ chos rgyal gdung rgyud des khri dpon mdzad cing zhes gsungs/ rdog rabs gsal ba'i me long las/ rdog gi rgyud pa 'di mdo khams shar tsong kha'i yul dang nye ba na rdog gi sde chen po chags/ de la rdog ye shes 'byung gnas ni/ yul de na 'khor dang longs spyod lha'i dpal la 'gran pa lta bu yod pa la/ sngon gyi las sad pa'i stobs kyis/ 'khor ba'i chos la yid byung / rgyal bu don 'grub lta bu 'du 'dzi blos btang gi thugs dgongs skyes nas/ 'khor rnams la bka' bstsal pa/ spyir 'khor ba 'di la gzhigs pas snying bo ci yang mi 'dug sgos 'jig rten gyi bya ba 'di la blos gtong thub pa 'i rigs su mi 'dug rang/ re rje 'bangs kyi khul na'ang chos phyogs su go cha dang snying rus bskyed pa'i dad brtson 762

yang dkon par 'dug pas/ da ni dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du chos yod par 'dug pas der chos la 'gro ba'i dus la bab bo gsungs nas rgyal srid blos btang ste/ dbus su phebs par gsungs/ lo rgyus de dag la gzhigs na/ jo sras sam rgyal sras zer ba de/ khri sde yin pa dang / rgyal srid 'bul mkha na ling ye shan (khritā༅ṣā)zhes pa de rdog ye shes yin nam snyam mo/ /thog mar rgyal sras tsong kha'i rgyal sa g.yu kong mkhar du spyan drangs/ de rjes spyi lo1006lor li lis tsun(stsan+t+rastsa)gyis tsong kha'i mkhar du spyan drangs rgyal bor mnga' gsol zhing 3 li lis tsun kho rang blon po byas/ li lis tsun gyi bu mo gnyis pa rgyal sus kyi btsun mor phul nas dbang bzung mod/ rgyal sras dang ma mthun pas de'i rjes li lis tsun gyi spun zla bun po go zer bas rgyal sras ma'o khron du gdan drangs/ spyi lo1032lor bun po gos rgyal sras la rogs byas nas/ li lis tsun med par btang ste ma'o khron rgyal sa byas te/ bun po go rang blon po byas te dbang bzung / de rjes rgyal sras de rang lo bzhi bcur nyer slebs shing /chab srid rmang gzhi cung bzang bar gyur/ blon po bun po go ni ham sems can zhig yin gshis/ rgyal srid 'phrog bsam ste 763

rgyal sras la ngo log nas rgyal sras btson du bcug mod/ btson srung dag rgyal sras la dga' bas btson las btang / rgyal sras kyis rang la dga' ba'i 'bangs rnams khrid de bun po go bsad nas ngo log bde 'jags ba—tang / spyi lo1034lo rab byung dang bo'i shing pho khyi lor ching thang (oṃṭha)ste deng sang zi ling mkhar du rgyal sa spos/ de nas dbang bsgyur te kho bu rgyud dang bcas lo brgyar nye bar mdo smad kyi rgyal bo byas/rgya'i yig cha sna tshogs nang jo sras sam rgyal sras kyi mnga' khongs cikyi bshad pa gang du yod pa dag la bltas te/ bod kyi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis zhib 'jug byas pa ni/ sung gi skabs kyi hran zhes pa'i sa cha dang / tsong kha/ go'u/ ho'u/ dbya/rmin/ the bo/ a'e sogs spu'u dang ci hri cen rnams 'dus yod kyang / shar nas chen kru'u(deng gi kan su'u zhing chen gyi then hros red)dang mtshams 'brel/ byang nas mi nyag dang mtshams 'brel/ nub tu co ni dang zung chu sogs brgal/ lhor mtsho sngon brgal yod la/ de gsal bor bshad na/ a mdo'i sa cha phal cher 'dus yod/ rgyal sa'i lte ba ni tsong chu'i sa khul deng sang gi zi li nga sa khul red ces bshad chog zer/ de rjes 764

dpal ris lung drug sde ba'i bod blon gyis mi nyag dade 'thab nas/ bod blon pham/ sung dang 'brel nas mi nyagacho la rgol rgyu de rgyal sras kyi thog tu bab/ de nas lo mang rabs shig gi ring rgyal sras dang mi nyag 'thab/ sung gis mi nyag gnon ched/ rgyal sras la thob ming dang rgyu nor mang bo byin pas/ dbang stobs dang rgyu stobs sogs je cher gyur nas mi nyag dang rgyal sras bar gyi 'khrug zing yang je cher gyur/de rjes sung gi rgyal bo rin tsung (neṭha)dang mi nyag gnyis kyis chings yig bzhag stabs/ rgyal sras dang sung gi 'brel ba je zhan du gyur/ rgyal sras rang gi bu rnams dang yang ma mthun stabs phyi nang gi rkyen gyi dbang gis rgyal sras kyi stobs je zhan du song yang / mi nyag gnon pa'i nus pa 'don bzhin yod/ spyi lo1065lo rab byung dang bo'i shing mo sbrul lor mi nyag gis ma'o khron 'dabs su dmag drangs nas/ rgyal sras kyi 'bangs khyim tshang lnga brgyangaphrogs/ de'i dgun khar rgyal sras grongs/ dgung lo drug cu re bdun yin 'dug kho'i bu gsum pa tung kran zhes bya bas pha'i rgyal sa bzung /rgyal sras la bu gsum yod pas rgyal sras grongs rjes/ bu gsum 765

gyis sa cha so sor bzung nas bsdad la/ bu chung ba tungadzhakran gyis ni ching thang ste zi ling mkhar du bsdad nas pha'i rgyal sa bzung / bu gsum gyi stobs che ba de yin zer/ tung kran gyis sung dang 'brel nas mi nyag la rgol/ spyi lo 1081lor tung kran gyis khri dmag bcu gnyis khrid nas mi nyag la rgol rdung byas pas/ sung dga' nas thob dang rgyu nor byin/spyi lo1087lo rab byung gnyis pa'i mgo me yos lor tung kran 'das/ bu dod a li go( phyotshosmi)zer bas tung kran gyi bu dmag dpon tshe ring btsan po bsad nas khos rgyal sa bzung /sung gis de la'ang rgyab skyor byas/ spyi lo1096lor rgyal bo a li go 'a das/ de'i bu zha kran zer bas rgyal srid bzung / spyi lo1127lor sung byang ma nub/rgyal sras kyi bu rgyud rnams gang sa gang du 'thor bkram byas nas bsdad/ gzhan sa zhig na rgyal sras kyi nu bo'i yang tsha zhig yod pa de'i ming la nyi ma bstan 'ji na/ rgya ming la kro han en zer/lung dbyi cen wang gi cho lo thob ste khrin tur bsdad/ jo sras mnga' 'og gi mi ni gtso bo bod yin pas/ thu bod (lor+sā )zer/ sung gi mis spyang (༅)zer/ rgya dang hor mi yang yod/ mnga' khongs su mi grangs khri brgya lhag yod zer/766

rgyalasras ni 'bangs dang dmag mang ba'i rgyal bo stobs ldan zhig red/ rgyal sras kyi pho brang gi mdun du mkhar sgo yod la/ phug tu pho brang yod/ mkhir gyi nub sgo'i 'gram du rgyal sras kyi srung dmag rnam sa byang nas lhor 'khor nas khor yug tu bsdad yod/mdun sgo ru nyis thog dang de nas dbus sgo brgyud de byang phyogs su phyin na mgron bsu'i sgo yod/ sgo de nas byang la song na shar nub gnyis su rgyal sras kyi btsun mo bza' mi rnams 'dug sa yod/ mgron bsu'i sgo'i byang ngos ni srid don thag gcod sa'i khad chen yin la/ de'i thog rgya phibs dang ka gdung la tshon khras spras/ khang chen de'i ma gzhi khru tsi brgyad dgu zhig mtho/ de'i nang rgyal bo'i khri dpangs che zhing mtho tshad la khru tsi bcu lhag yod la/ khri'i mtha' ni so phag g.yu mdog can gyi ra ba dma' mos bskor/ 'khor blon rnams kyis ra ba de'i phyi rol nas zhu ba 'bul dgos/ khang chen de'i 'gram du gser gyi sku 'dra khru tsi dgu bcu can/ mu tig gi rgyan dang / rma bya'i gdugs dang ldan pa zhig yod/ de'i mdun ni blon po rnams kyis gzhung don sgrub sa red/ de dag la bltas na rgyal sras ni mdo khams rgyal bo chen po zhig yin pa shes bubyā/767

mdo smad tsong kha'i bod rgyal/ jo sras sam rgyal sras zer ba'i lo rgyus 'di ni/ bod kyi lo rgyus zhib 'jug byed pa la gal che ba zhig red snyam nas/ bdag gi slob ma skad gnyis smra ba bsang chu rdzong gi hru'u ci gzhon pa 'brug thar la skul slong byas te/ khos rgya yig gi thog tu rgyas pa zhig bris yod pa/ skad gnyis smra ba shes rab ral gris bod skad du'ang bsgyur yod pa las mdor bsdus shig bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas spyi lo1986lo'i zla12pa'i tshes21la sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni skad gnyis sma ba thes rab ral gri'o/ / 76 8
