bod kyi lo kyus dang spyi tshogs skor rags tsam gleng ba/ bod du chos lugs byung tshul/ thog mar bod chags tshul mdor bsdus bshad na/ bod rang gi skad du sngon nas bod zer/rgya gar ba rnams kyis bod ces pa zur chag nas bho ṭa zer/ rgya nag pa rnams kyis sngon dus su thu bhod zer/ de'i rjes mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi nang gi gtsang gi ming la brten nas bod spyi la gtsang zer/ deng sang dbus gtsang phyogs la shi gtsadza zer zhing / bod mi thams cad la gtsang tso'u(saṭha)zer/bod du mi'i 'gro ba ma chags pa'i sngon du/ stod mnga' ris kyi cha ni glang bo che dang ri dwags kyi yul/ bar dbus gtsang gi cha ni ri dwags spre'u yul/ smad mdo khams kyi cha ni spre'u dang brag srin gyi yul yin/ de yang / stod g.ya' ri dang gangs ri/ bar brag dang spang ljongs/ smadagyirtsi shing dang nags tshal gyis gang / gzhung thams cad chus gang nas yod/ mi'i 769

'gro ba byung tshul ni/ spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las sprel —phrug mang du byung / sprel phrug rnams nags tshal du gnas te shing tog gis 'tsho ba byas nas mang du 'phel/ bar skabs shig nas gzhung gi chu rnams chu bor babs/ chu bo rgya mtshor babs te spang gzhung rgya chen po byung / spang gzhung de dag tu nas/ gro/ sran ma/ so ba (ma rmos lo tog)rnams 'khrungs te ma rmos pa'i lo thog lnga zer/ spre'u rnams nags nas spang gzhung du 'ongs nas 'bru rnoms la longs spyad/ rim gyis spu je thung 4dang rnga ma yang je thung la song / skabs shig nas rnga ma med pas mi'i 'gro bar gyur/ pha rigs rnams 'char sgo myur zhing/ khog grim/ ma rigs rnams gdong dmar la ro gyong / rim par 'phel bas bod yul mi'i yul du gyur te/ rus chen bzhi byung ba ni/ ye sang dkar bo/ ye smon nag po/ spyang khrig ye shes/ mon rdzu nag po dang bzhi'o/ /thog mar shing thog dang rgod skyes 'bru rigs rngon byed pa sogs kyis 'tsho thabs byas lī/ rim gyis 'brog las kyis 'tsho thabs su 'phel/ sde shog gi lam lugs kyang dar la/de'i skabs shig nas phyi'i rgyal khab kyi mi 'ga' zhig kyang 'ongs te chos lugs 'ga' re byung ba 'dra yang / dar khyab ma byung bar mngon/ de nas bod la rgyul bo snyang tshul ni/ rgyu gar gyi 770

rgyal bo dmag brgya ba zhes bya ba la bu zhig btsas pa la migachi masegyi 'gribs su yod pa/ smin ma ljang khu/ so 'khor mar skyes pa/sor mo'i bar dra bas 'brel ba zhig byung ba de/ 'dre'i ri gas yin bsams nas skrag ste zangs kyi ga'u'i nang du bcug nas chu bo gaṅgā ru 'phangs pa zhing ba 'ga' zhig gis rnyed nas/ gsos pa cher skyes dus sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams bshad pas yid skyo ste bod gangs can gyi phyogs su bros/ rim gyis lha ri yol ba'i rtse brgyud de btsan thang sgo bzhir byon pa na/ bod kyi phyugs rdzi bcu gnyis dang 'phrad/ phyugs rdzi rnams kyis khyod gang nas byon zhesadris pa na bod skad mi go stabs nam mkha' la mdzub mo bstan pas lha las chad pa yin snyam ste/ bod khams kyi rgyal bor 'os zer nas shing gis khyogs khri bzos te mi bzhi sa gnya' bar khur nas 'ong ba bod thams cad kyis lha rigs yin snyam nas gus 'dud lhu ra blangs/ rim gyis rgyal bor mnga' gsol/ gnya' bar khri byas te 'ongs pas ming la gnya' khri btsan po zhes btags/ rgyal bo 'dis pho brang yum bu bla sgang brtsigs/ de nas rim pa ltar/mu khri btsan po/ ding khri btsan po/ so khri btsan po/ mer khri btsan po/ gdags khri btsan po/ srib khri btsan po rnams la gnam gyi khri bdun zer/ srib khri btsan po'i/ sras gri gum btsan 771

po de la bu gsum skyes/ blon po lo ngam gyis ngo log byas te rgyal bo gri gum bsad/ sras/ gsum kong po phyogs su bros/ blon po lo ngam gyis rgyal srid bzung / bod du gyen log gi 'khrugs pa'i thog ma 'di yin/ 'di'i sngon la bod du khrab med la 'di dus smar khams nas khrab blangs/ mi ring bar blon po ru las skyes kyis lo ngam bsad dedzispo kong po'i yul nas gri gum gyi sras bya khri gdan drangs te yar klungs su rgyal sar bzhag mtshan la spu de gung rgyal zer/ 'phying yul dar thang du yab kyi bang so brtsigs/'di bang so brtsigs pa'i thog ma yin/ ru las skyes dang de'i bu mgo dkar blon po byas/ rgyal blon 'di gsum gyi ring la spang rmos nas zhing byas/ zhing la chu drangs/ shing bsregs nas sol ba bzos/ ko ba skol bzhu byas nas spyin bzos/ lcags rdo/zangs rdo/ dngul rdo gsum bzhus nas/ lcags zangs dngul gsum bton/ gnya' shing dang thong gshol bzos nas dor gyis zhing rmos/ chu la zam pa 'dzugs pa sogs byas/ gri gum dang spu de gung rgyal gnyis la bar gyi steng gnyis zer/ spu de gung rgyalagyi sras e sho legs/ de'i sras de sho legs/ de'i sras thi sho legs/ de'i sras gung ru legs/ de'i sras 'brong zher legs/de'i sras i sho legs/ de rnams la sa'i legs drug zer/ i 772

sho legs kyi sras za nam zin lde/ de'i sras 'phrul nam gzhung btsan lde/ de'i sras se snol gnam lde/ de'i sras se snol po sde/de'i sras lde snol nam/ de'i sras lde snol bo/ de'i sras lde rgyal bo/ de'i sras lde sprin btsan/ de rnams la lde brgyad zer/ lde sprin btsan gyi sras rgyal to ri long btsan/ de'i sras khri btsan nam/ de'i sras khri sgra dpung btsan/ de'i sras khri rje thog btsan/de bzhi la 'og gi btsan bzhi zer zhing 'di yan gyi rgyal rabs nyer bdun ring chab srid bon gyis bskyangs zer/ khri rje thog btsan gyi bu lha tho tho ru/ rgyal bo de'i dus su/ chos sems 'tsho sogs mi kha shas rgya gar du phyin nas/ rgya gar gyi skad yig bslabs/ de dus bod la yi ge med stabs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams bod yig tu bsgyur ma btub cing spang skong phyag rgya ba/ mdo sde za ma tog tsin+ta ma ṇi'i gzungs te chos kyi glegs bam kha shas dang / gser gyi mchod rten bcas khyer 'ongs nas rgyal bor phul bas/ rgyal bos don ma go yang ya mtshan du bzung nas pho brang yum bu bla sgang gi yang thog tu bzhag ming la gnyan po gsang ba btags te phyag mchod byas/ de la chos kyi dbu brnyes zer/ rgyal bo 'dis lo brgya dang nyi shu thub par grags/lha tho tho ru'i sras khri gnyan gzung btsan/ de'i sras 'brong gnyan 773

lde'u/ de'i sras stag ri gnyan gzigs/ de'i sras gnam ri srong btsan/ 'di'i ring la rgya nag nas rtsis dang sman byung /pho brang khri brtsigs 'bum gdugs zhes bya ba brtsigs/ rta bzhon nas rngon du song ste ri dwags 'brong zhig bsad pa'i sha rta sga'i sha thag la btags pa sa la lhung ba tshwa dang thug nas tshwa gter rnyed de tshwa gter thog mar bton/ gnam ri srong btsan gyi sras srong btsan sgam po/ rgya nag gi thang rgyal rabs kyi rgyal bo gnyis pa thang the tsung me khyi lo la rgyal sar 'khod/ (spyi lo629) sa glang lor pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling du srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs/ spyi lo630de nas bzung da lta'i spyi lo1961'di yan la lo stong dang sum brgya dang so gcig song / shing rta lo nas bzung ste lo brgyad la rgya dang bod gnyise 'khrug pa byas/ de'i skabs su a mdo'i sa'i cha phal che ba thang dmag gis bzung ba la bod dmag gis bcom ste bod kyis bzung / lcags glang lor srong btsan sgam po lo bcu gsum thog rgyal sar 'khod/ po ta lar pho brang brtsigs/ rgya gar nag stag gzig hor/ mi nyag sogs phyi'i rgyal khab du ma la dpung 'jug dang zhi drag sna tshogs kyis dbang du bsdus/ thon mi sasto ṭa rgya gar du mngags nas rig gnas bslabs te bod yig gsar du bzo bcug phyi 774

nang bar gsum gyi blon po dang bcas pa'i gros thog nas mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims yig gtan la phab/ thon mi sasto ṭas rgya gar nas chos bsgyur/ dgung lo bcu drug thog bal bza' khri btsun khab tu bzhes/ — de'i rdzongs par jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje gdan drangs/ slar yang po ta la'i pho brang rgya bskyed/rgya nag nas rgya bza' kong jo khab tu bzhes/ de'i rdzongs jo bo shākya mu ne gdan drangs/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dang / mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang brgyad la sogs pa bzhengs/ slar yang / ru yong bza' dang / zhang zhung bza'/ mong bza' khri lcam rnams khab tu bzhes/ mong bza' la sras gung ri gung btsan 'khrungs/ gung ri gung btsan lo bcu gsum thog rgyal sar bkod cing lo bco brgyad thog gshegs/ slar yang / rgyal bo rang nyid rgyal sar bzhugs/ lcags pho khyi'i lo dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis thog gshegs/ gung ri gung patsan gyi sras mang srong mang btsan rgyal sar bkod/ de'i dus su rgya dmag 'ongs/ blon po mgar gyis bod dmag mang bo khrid de rgya rnams bcom/ mgar yang dmag thog tu grongs/ slar yang rgya dmag 'ongs te bod yul du ma bcom/ po ta la'i pho brang me la bsgegs/ mad srong rgyal bo gtsang gi bar snang sgang du gshegs/775

de'i sras 'dus srong mang rje/ 'di'i dus su rtsal bo che'i mi bdun byung / de'i sras khri lde gtsug brtan de la sras 'jang tsha lha dpon 'khrungs pa ga rgya rje yag 'jam li khri bzher ma'i srasagyim shing kong jo khab tu bsus kyang bod du ma 'byor gong rgyal sras gshegs/ kong jo khri lde gtsug brtan rang gi btsun mo byas pa la/ lcags rta lor (790) khri srong lde'u btsan 'khrungs/'di'i dus su rgya gar nas mkhan po bo ti sa twa dang slob dpon 5bad+ma 'byung gnas gdan drangs/ bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgya gar nas chos sde snod gsum bsgyur/ rab byung gi sde btsugs/ bon bsnubs/ lcags 'brug lor tshad pa'i nad kyis bsnyun nas 'das/ de'i sras mu ne btsan po/ mu rug btsan po/ mu tig btsan po gsum las snga ma rgyal bor bzhugs nas bod kyi dbul phyug lan gsum bsnyams/ de'i ming la mu khri btsan po yang zer/ mu ne btsan po cher ma 'gyangs par gshegs pa'i rjes su/ mu rug btsan po bsko bar brtsams yang thog tu ma khel bas/ mu tig btsan po'um sad na legs mjing yon dgung lo bzhi'i thog rgyal sar bzhag de la sras gtsang ma/lha rje/ lhun 'grub/ dar ma/ ral ba can te lnga yod pa las/ dang bo rab tu byung / gnyis pa lo bco lnga'i thog 776

gshegs/ gsum pa chung dus gshegs/ bzhi ba log spyod lodaga' bas/ lnga ba khri ral ba can rgyal sar bkod/ rgyal bo 'di me khyi lo (866) sku bltams/ 'dis dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byas/ bod yig skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/'di'i dus su rgya nag gi rgyal bo dzung dzung zhes bya ba yin la/ rgya bod tsha zhang nang ma mthun par blon po lha bzang klu dpal gyis dmag dpon byas te dmag song nas rgya yul shing kun dang / sman tse'i bi ce'u sogs blangs nas bzung / phyis su ce'u mkhar nyi shu rtsa bzhi thams cad bod kyi lag tu shor/ rgya nag rgyal bo dzung dzung lo bdun rgyal sar bsdad nas de'i bu che ba tha'i dzung rgyal bo zer ba shen chur bros/ de'i shul du bod rnams kyis rgya'i blon po ga'u hi bsad de slar yang rgyal srid bzung / bod kyi mchod gnas lo paṇa rnams dang / rgya'i hwa shang rnams kyis dpang bo mdzad de rgya bod kyi bar 'dum mdzad/ rgya'i gung gu rmo ru (ka ci'i mchod rten dkar bo yin zer)zhes bya bar rgya bod kyi sa mtshams phyes te bod rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang dang / rgya rje'i gtsug lag khang brtsigs/ der rdo ring zhig btsugs te sa mtshams nas phyi rol tu dmag gis g.yul bsham pa sogs byas mi chog pa'i yi ge brkos/ dus der rgya bod gnyis mthun zhing 'brel ba bzang 777

bor byung bas/ gnam la nyi zla zung gcig dang / sa la btsan po dbon zhang zhes h+phang skad do/ /rgyal bo 'dis chos dang rig gnas shin tu dar bar byas/ chos la mi dga' ba'i rlas stag sna sogs kyis chu mo bya'i lo la bkrongs/ de'i gcen dar ma rgyal sar bkod/ 'dis chos dang rig gnas kun bsnubs/ rgya gar nag nas 'ong sa pa'i paṇa ḍi ta dang lo tsā ba rnams yul gzhan judu bros shing ma byon pa 'ga' zhig bkums/ rab byung phal cher rab byung gi cha lugs dang bral bar byas/ mi nyan pa rnams rngon pa byed du bcug dpe cha phal cher sa'i 'og tu sbas shing 'ga' zhig mer bsregs shing 'ga' zhig chu la bskur /gtsug lag khang rnams kyi sgo la zhal ba byas/ mthar lha lung dpal rdor gyis lcags kyi mda' 'phangs pa snying gar phog rgyal bo'i lag pa gnyis kyis mda' la 'ju zhing yang na lo gsum gyis gsod pa sngas/ yang na lo gsum gyis 'phyis zhes smra ba'i mu la 'das so/ / glang dar ma'i btsun mo chung ba'i sras 'od sru nga dang / che ba'i sras yum brtan gnyis mnga' thang la ma 'chams par 'khrug long chen po byung / 'od srung gis g.yon ru dang / yum brtan gyis spu ru bzung / de nas bzung ste bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyul 778

bo ma byung / de nas mi ring bar 'bangs gyen log byung / snye gye na log dang bo mdo khams smad nas byung / der brten gtsang g.yas ru nas/ de nas dbu ru dang g.yas ru nas gyen log byung / rim gyis yul phyogs kun tu gyen log byung / rgyal bo'i pho brang rnams kyang bsregs/ bang so rnams kyang bshig ste bod khams sil bur thor/ 'od srung gi sras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/ de'i sras bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gtsang stod du bsdad/ skyid lde nyi ma mgon mnga'u ris su song ba la sras gsum skyes pa'i che ba dpal gyi mgon gyis mang yul bzung / bar ba bkra shis mgon gyis spu rengs bzung / chung ba sde gtsug mgon gyis zhang zhung bzung / bkra shis mgon la sras 'khor re dang / srong de gnyis/ snga mas rgyal srid bzung ba'i sras nā ga rā dzā dang / de wā rā dzo gnyis yod/ 'di pha bu gsum ga rab tu byung nas yab kyi mtshan la lha bla ma ye shes 'od zer/ srong de'i sras lha sde/ de la sras gsu ma 'khrungs pa'i/ che ba 'od lde/'bring ba lha bla ma byang chub 'od/ chung ba pho brang zhi ba 'od/ de sogs rim gyis byung ba ni bod kyi rgyal bo'i rgyud pa yin/ khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal la sras bzhi byung bas/ khri sde 'bangs dang bcas pa mdo smad du byon/ mtsho khri shog rgyal mo'am mtsho 779

sngon por grags pa'i 'gram du bsdad de khri sdes khri dpon byas/ de ma gtogs bod kyi rgyal bo'i gdung rgyud med par bod khams kun tu sde dpon dang mi chen so sos rang rang gi sa cha la srid kyi dbang bzung / de ltar sil bur song nas lo sum brgya lhag song zer/de'i mtshams su/ rab byung bzhi ba'i me yos (1207) lo hor jing gir rgyal bo bod du byon/ stod mnga' ris tshun chad dbang du bsdus/ gtsang du mi sna btang nas sa chen kun dga' snying bo la 'bul nod bgyis te mchod yon du gyur/ slar sog yul du gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ rten gsum 'ga' zhig gdan drangs/ de la brten nas sog po rnams bstan pa la dad pa'i 'go tshugs te dge bsnyen sogs kyis sdom pa len pa yang byung /jing gir gyi sras o go to'i bu go yug dang go tan gnyis kyis khams kyi rgyal bo byed pa'i skabs/ go tan gyi dus su dor rta nag pos gtsos hor dmag bod du mngags te/ bod khams dbang du bsdus/ rgyal bo go tan gyis sa skya paṇa chen hor yul du gdan drangs/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis rgyal bo 'khor bcas la kye rdo rje'i dbang gnang / sog yig gsar du bzos/ go tan gyi gcung se chen rgyal bo mnga' thang shin tu che zhing / rgya bod hor gsum dang rgya gar gyi phyed tsam dang kha che'i mtha' tshun la dbang 180

bsgyur/ 'grodzhamagon 'phags pa rgyal khab tu gdan drangs/ bod chol kha gsum dbang yon du phul te sa skya ba bod spyi'i bla dpon du gyur/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa bla ma byas/ nye gnas shākya bzang bo dpon chen du bskos/ bla mas bla ma'i bya ba byas shing / dpon pos chab srid bskyangs/ dbus gtsang du bod khri skor bcu gsum byas te/ khri skor re la khri dpon re bskos/ de mthun mdo khams smad sogs su'ang dpon dang dpon tshab ci rigs bzhag snang / bod khri skor bcu gsum ni/ 'bri phag rgya ma g.ya' bzang ba/ /tshal ba bya yul lha 'brug gsum/ /bsdeb pas dbus kyi— khri skor drug /mnga' ris la stod lho byang gnyis/ /chu mig zha lu byang 'brog bcas/ /bsdeb pas gtsang gi khri sgor drug /gtsang min dbus min yar 'brog gi/ /khri skor dang bcas bcu gsum mo/ /sa skya paṇa chen rab byung gsum pa'i chu stag (1182)la 'khrungs/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa rab byung bzhi ba'i shing lug (1235)lor 'khrungs/ de nas bzung ste sa skya bas lo bdun cu don lnga'i ring bod kyi spyi dpon mdzad la/ 1 dpon chen thog ma shākya bzang bo/ de nas rim par/ 1 kun dga' bzang bo/ kā zhang btsun/ te phyug po rgang kha ba/ me byang rim/ phyo kun gzhon/ gyi gzhon nu 78 /

dbang / 8 byang rdor/ 9 ag len/ 10 slar yang gzhon dbang / 11 leb/sa par/ 1phre seng ge dpal/1kā 'od seng / 1bhe kun rin/ 1me don yod dpal/1smo yon btsun/ 1gyi slar yang 'od seng / 18 rgyal bzang /19 dbang phyug dpal/ 30 bsod nams dpal/ 11 slar yang rgyal bzang / 31 dbang phyug brtson 'grus sde ste slar ldab dang bcas dpon rabs nyer gnyis kyi ring lo bdun cu don lnga la sa skya bas bod spyi la dbang bsgyur ba yin kyang / tha ma 'di'i skabs su phag gru khri dpon gong du shor dogs nas/ yar klungs su khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag lan mang du drangs kyang / phag gru khri dpon ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis gyen log byas pa ma thub par/ dbus kyi sa cha phal che ba phag gru'i lag tu shor/slar yang sa phag 'khrugs te sa skya ba pham nas rab byung drug pa (1349)sa mo glang nas bzung ste/ ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi bdag por gyur/ phag gru'i dpon rabs ni/ ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan/ lha btsun gu shrī shākya rgyal mtshan/ lha btsun spyan snga grags pa byang chub/lha btsun spyan snga bsod nams grags/ lha btsun gu shrī grags pa rgyal mtshan/ lha btsun spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas/ lha 78lha

btsun spyan snga ngag gi dgang bo/ lha btsun spyan snga chos kyi grags pa sogs dpon rabs brgyad dang / bkra shis grags pa/ 'gro ba'i mgon po/ ngag dbang grags pa/ kar rgyud rnam rgyal/bsod nams dbang phyug spyan snga ngag gi dbang bo/ rin chen rdo rje'am dbang gi rgyal bo/ spyan snga grags 'byung ba/ rin chen bzang bo/ drung grags pa/ drung nam mkha' bzang bo/ drung nam mkha' dpal 'byor/ drung grags pa dpa la bzang / / drung dpal 'byor rgyal bo/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal bo/ ngag dbang bsod nams lhun 'grub rnams so / /dpon phyi ma gnyis kyi dus su rin spungs rdan yod kyis 'bangs gyen log byas te phag gru'i pho brang sne'u rdzong dang dpal 'byo—ra lhun po bcas bcom/ bod kyi chab srid rin spungs sde bas bzung / rin spungs sde ba'i mi rgyud ni/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' rgyal bo / rnar bu bzang bo/ kun bzang /don yod rdo rje/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang 'jigs grags kyi bar du mnga' thang che bar byung mod/ phyi ma'i skabs su rang gi 'bangs karma tshe brtan gyis 'bangs gyen log byas te/gtsang gi sa cha phal cher phrogs/ de'i sras phun tshogs rnam rgyul/de'i sras karma bstan skyong ste gtsang ba rgyal bo gsum byung / rab 783

rgyung bcu ba'i shing rta (1594)la bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis mgo dkar bcom/ me rta (1606)la bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis khal kha dang o rod gzhung 'dum par mdzad pas man ju gong mas gu shrī'i cho lo byin/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me glang (1637)la bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis man ju gong ma'i bka'abazhin chog thu bcom nas dbus su btegs/ lcags 'brug lo'i zla ba bcu gcig par bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis bar khams kyi be ri rgyal bo bcom/ chu rta lo'i zla ba dang bor bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis gtsang ba'i pho brang bsam 'grub rtse blangs/ gtsang ba rgyal bo dbang bcas tshar bcad/ bstan 'dzin chos rgyal rang nyid bas ma 'grub rtser bsdad/ gtsang rgyal karma bstan skyong bzung nas khri mon du bcug dbus gtsang mtha' dag mnga' 'og tu bcug bod khri skor bcu gsum rgyal dbang la phul/bstan 'dzin chos rgyal rang nyid rgyal bo byas te rgyal bo dang sde srid zung 'brel byas nas bod michabagasrid bzung / rang nyid kyis bod kyi rgyal bo lo bcu gnyis mdzad/ de'i 'phror rgyal bo nyid kyi tsha bo lha bzang gis bod kyi rgyal bo byas/ de dang 'brel ba'i sde srid ni/ grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtshos lo brgyad/zangs ri ba blo bzang mthu stobs kyis lo drug grwa tshang gnyer ba 784

blo bzang sbyin pas lo gsum/ de nas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos lo sum cu so gcig bar du sde srid mdzad/ sde srid 'di dang lha bzang gnyis ma mthun par sde srid kyis lha bzang smyugs/lha bzang bas slar dmag khrid de 'ongs nas sde srid bsad nas pad dkar 'dzin pa dang lha bzang zung 'brel gyis lo bcu gsum/ lha bzang ba jun gar gyis bsad nas sde srid stag rtse ba lha rgyal rab brtan dang jun gar zung 'brel gyis lo gsum/ jun gar man ju gong ma'i dmag gis bdas/ sde srid stag rtse ba bsad nas/ khang chen ne dpon du bskos nas des lo bdun/khang chen ne nga lam sbyar gsum gyis bsad nas bka' blon nga phod pa sogs kyis lo gsum/ bka' blon gsum pho lha bas bsad nas des lo nyi shu/ de'i sras tā le pā thur gyis lo bzhir rgyal bo byas/ de man ju gong ma'i khrims la thogs te bsad nas bka' blon bzhi bskos/ de'i 'phror rgyal dbang bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho gshegs nas/ rgyal tshab dang am bhan zung 'brel byas nas sdod pa'i srol btod/ de nas bzung rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho'i bar du dga' ldan pho brang bas bod kyi srid bzung / spyir bod la dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ mdo stod mi'i 785

chol kha/ mdo smad rta'i tshol kha gsum yod lo/ mnga' ris gungo thang nas sog la skya bo yan chad dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha dang / de nas rma chu'i khug pa yan chad mdo stod mi'i chol kha yin/ mdo smad la a mdo zer zheng / 'bri chu'i se bo'i lung ciring brgal ba'i ba yan ha ri'i shar ngos a chen gangs rgyab kyi ri dang / mdo la ring mo gnyis kyi ming bsdoms pas de man chad la a mdo zhes grags pa yin la des na a mdo dang mdo khams smad gnyis gcig go/ /mdo smad kyi yul du bod chags tshul mdo tsam bshad na/ mdo smad lho rong rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi mi rnams ni/ srong btsan sgam po'i dus su bod nas chad pa yin/ de'i dus su rgya bod gnyis 'khrugs pa'i skabs su dbus kyi khyung bo dkar ri nag ri gser tsha gsum gyi nang gi khyung bo dkar ri nas bod kyi blon po zhig dmag dang bcas rgya bod kyi sa mtshams srung du mngags pa rgyal mo tsha ba rong du slebs te/ chu chen la co ru rdzong brtsigs nas/ tsha ba rong gi sa'i cha thams cad bod dmag gis bzung ste gzhis chags/ de dag gi rigs ni bod kyi rigs la/ bse/ mu/ ldong / stong bzhi yod pa/ ji de'i nang gi bse'i rigs yin/ bse rigs bzang rnams la bse khyung spra zer stabs/ 'di dag spra rigs yin la/ mdo khams rong chen 7tsho86 mo

bzhi'i nang tshan gyis rgyal rong 'gag dog mo gsum po sbo la thob zer/ bod kyi kha rgyun la/ 'gag dog mo gsum ste sbra la thob/ /spra dpa' rtsal che ba de yi don/ /zer/ de'i sngon du mdzod dge rnga ba sogs su rgya sde chags te mkhar brtsigs sa zhing btab pa'i shul da dung yod/ zangs dkar gyi rgya mkhar thang dang lung zi'i mkhar chag rnga ba'i rgya mkhar rnams ni de dus su thor ba'i shul yin/ de dag tu sa brkos na dngos rdzas 'bud rgyu yod/zhang zhung sbra rgyal dang kho 'phan sogs rgyal bo byas/ tsha rong rgyal bo kho 'phan gyi dus nas bzung / tsha rong dang kho 'phan tshig sdud byas nas tsha kho zhes grags/ the bo dang zung chu tshun chod/rma chen gangs tshun chod/ khams kyi lho rgyal tshun chod/ rgyal rong gi rgyal khames su gtogs/ skabs shig tu rgyal rong gi rgyal bo mdo bzher nag po zhes bya ba byung / 'dis rgyal rong gi yul khams kun tu dbang bsgyur/ gzi 'gag tu pho brang brtsigs/ khri srong lde btsan gyi sku tshe'i smad du yang rgya bod gnyis 'khrugs te/bod dmag gis rgya pham/ bod kyi rgyal rgyud tshe mgon legs zer ba zhig rgyal rong sde dpon du bzhug khro chu dang chu nag sogs su ru sde du ma yod pa rnams sngar rgyal rong gi mnga' khongs yin yang de skabs mnga' 'og tu ma sgur ba la/ tshe mgon legs kyi 787

'khor du mda' bzo mkhan gyi dpa' bo zhig yod pa dmag dpon du bskos nas/ des dmag khrid de song nas khro chu sogs mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ mda' mkhan khro chu'i dpon du bzhag tshe mgon legs kyi rgyud pa stsa paṇa thar la sras gsum yod pa las/gcig so mang nor bu'i gling dang / gcig cog tse stag mo rdzong dang / gcig gzi 'gag phun tshogs rdzong(deng sang rdzi 'gag zer) / gsum du so sor bsdad nas dpon bzung / 'di gsum la tsha ba khag gsum zer/ de dag gi mi rgyud cig gis bstan pa'i dpon bzung ba la tsha ba khag bzhir yang grags/ bod kyi rgyal bo glang dar ma'i rjas su bod la 'bangs gyen log byung nas bod kyi rgyal sa bsnubs te/ bod 'bangs thams cad sil bur 'thor ba'i skabs nas bzung / rgyal rong gi yul khams yang sil bur thor te rim gyis dpon khag mang du gyes/ phyis su dpon khag bco brgyad gyes pa la rgyal rong rgyal khag bco brgyad du grags/ yul 'di hor rgyal bo dang tā ming gi dus su'ang mnga' 'og tu ma chud par grags/ man ju'i dus su'ang chen lung rgyal bo'i bar du sngar ltar bsdad nas chen lung gi dus su/nga shī tshe dbang gtsor byas nas gong ma la ngo log byas/ tshe dbang rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu sprel (1752)lor rgyas bsad 788

pa'i rjes su rab brtan rgyal bo gtso bor byas nas mu mthud de ngo log byas/ rgya'i dmag dpon a cang jun dmag dang bcas pas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du 'thab nas mthar mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ rgya kha dpon med par byas pa'i shul du hru'u pe lnga bzhag btsan lha dpon bsad nas hru'u pe bzhi bzhag chu chen la hru'u pe gnyis bzhag dpon khag gzhan rnams la bab bstun gyis go sa byin nas rang sor bzhag btsan lha khag bzhi'i nang tshan gyi/ bsod nams yag hru'u pe nga ro 'brug thar dmag dpon gtso bo byas te/ rgyal rong gi dmag la phyin pa sogs lo rgyus mang / mdo smad kyi mi rgyud gzhan dag ni/ mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi dus su byang gru gu'i rgyal khab tu dmag drangs nas bcom pa'i skabs su dmag nas skyen po btus pa'i dpa' bo mi dgu dmag dang bcas pa hor bod kyi mtshams su bzhag ste/ rgyal bo'i bka' ma byung bar du ldog tu med gsung bas dpa' bo mi dgu'i rgyud pa la/ ka ma log tu thogs shing / mdo smad lho byang gi mi rgyud phal cher de dag gi rgyud pa yin no/ /de yang mgo log gi mi rgyud ni/ khams mgo log gi yul nas 'bru rigs kyi dpon zhig 'ongs te/ dpon rabs mang bo'i bar du 'gu kho'i lung bar bsdud pa'i rgyud pa la/ 'bru lha rgyal/ de'i bu a 789

'bum ni yul dpon gling rje dang 'gal nas yul bud de smar gyi sngo mtsho khar 'ongs/ de'i bu 'bum skyabs/ 'bum dge/'bum yag gsum yod pas so sos khyim bzung bas mgo log khag gsum byung / 'bum skyabs kyi bu phag thar la tā ming zon te nas khri dpon gyi thob byin/ de la bu bzhi yod pa'i che ba rdo rje 'bum la rdo rol gyi sa cha/ 'bring ba pad+ma 'bum la 'dzi rka'i khog 'dzam thang chung ba pad+ma yag la smad rol gyi sa cha dang mi sde byin/ rnga khog gi mi sde/ gser khog gi khral/ g.yu dang rtsang khog gi sa cha sde rnams thun mong byas/ rdo rje 'bum gyi bu che ba 'bugaphyug rgyal la/ bu gnyis byung ba'i che ba a skyong / de la bu bdun byung ba ni/ dpon gang khang rgan/ khang gsar/ rme nyo tshang / sde nang mtsho 'gram pa/ sde nang rag pa mda'i dpon rigs thams cad a skyong gi rgyud pa yen/ a skyong gi nu bo rgyal mtshan gyi rgyud pa tshe rgyal 'bum la dpal bza' bu drug byung bar mkhar ri dpal skor zer/ smad rol 'dzi mda' man dang /smar rong smug mda' yan gyi dpon rigs rnams 'di'i rgyud pa yin/ smar khog po ta'i mdo sogs kyi dbal shul stod smad sogs ni/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi'i nang tshan ldong rus yin te/ri rtse mo gsum ste ldong la thob/ /ldong zhwa mgo mtho ba de yi 790

rnon/ /zhis grags/ ldong la ldong shul chin brtso brgyad grags/pa byung / shul chen bco brgyad kyi nang tshan dbal shul ni/ ldong dpal chen skyabs kyi mi rgyud yin la/ de'i mi rgyud la dbal shul phur ba thar zer ba byung / phur ba thar gyi bu ge li/ ge tse/ ge 'phan gsum/ ge li dang ge tse'i rgyud pa 'bum skyabs yag dang khro go sogs yin/ ge 'phan gyi rgyud pa dbal shul ban dpon zer ba'i rgyud du kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa 'khrungs/ge 'phan gyi rgyud pa tshan gcig rwa rgya chu khar song bas rgyud pa dbal mang sogs yin/ yang tshan gcig lho phyogs su chad pa g.yu khog rtsang khog sgeg khog gser stod/ snyu stod rnams yin/ ge tse'i rgyud pa ge tse ma lag thong gsum/ zla chu stod/ sde dge'i mnga' 'og rnams dang khro shul sogs yin/ ge li'i bu chung ba ban zhar gyi rgyud pa gser thar dpon rigs rnams/ mu thar/ khe thal/ dbal shul/ khyo kho rnams yin no/ /dbal shul sangs rgyas 'bum gyi rgyud 'dzin rka'i wa 'bri mgo bsi — mda'/ rdo stod skyi ra/ rdo smad rka mda' rnams su yod la/chos shul dang phyag shul yang 'di'i rgyud pa dang / tog tsha rmog tsha mgo tsha spu tsha rkang tsha sogs tsha chen bco brgyad du grags pa ldong yin no/ / 791

thur ba thar gyi sngon du mi rgyud mtsho sngon du chad pa/ mats+tsha sngon gyi dbal shul rnams ni/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu yos (1723)lor mtsho sngon gyi sog po'i dpon po rnams kyi gong ma g.yung ṭing rgyal bo la ngo log byas nas rgya dmag mtsho ltar brdol nas mtsho sngon du 'khrug chen byung skabs slar lho phyogs su song ba/ li thang dang nye ba'i g.yon ru ma dang / sde gzhung ma sogs yin no/ /kha gya tsho drug yang ldong yin la/ de la tsha chen bco brgyad yod pa'i nang gi g.yu tsha yin te/ khri ral ba can rgya yul du dmag la phyin skabs/ dmag dpon du bskos pa'i g.yu tsha dmag dpon sogs kyi mi rgyud las rma phar kha'i ba yan sogs dang / kha gya tsho drug sogs chad pa yin no/ /mdzod dge stod smad kyi dpon dang mi phal cher ni dga' rigs yin te/ mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi dus su blon po dga' ye shes dar rgyas dpya khral bsdu ba'i phyir du mdo smad du byon/ da lta'i mdzod dge'i stod kyi sa cha 'di yangs shing rgya che ba/ rma chu/ the chu/ ska chu sogs chu klung chen po gsum 'bab pa/ spang ljongs dang ne'u sing du mas brgyan cing yid du 'ong bar mthong nas/ sa cha der 'brog ru bzung nas bsgrud/ rim gyis mdzod dge smad kyi sa char yang 'brog ru bzung / dga' ye shes dar rgyas kyi bu sprung shī dang 792

nong zlo gnyis kyis gros byas te/ mdzod dgi stod smad kyi sa cha phyugs skyong ba'i sar bzang yang / zhing sar mi bzang bas zhing sa bzang bo zhig 'tshol snyam nas/ co ne'i sa char phyin te gzhis bzung nas zhing las byas/ de ltar na mdzod dge stod smad dang co ne'i dpon rgyud rnams rus gcig pa yin no/ /mdo khams stod smad kyi hor zer ba'i mi rgyud rnams ni/ hor jing gir rgyal bo'i dus su bod hor rgyal gyi mnga' 'og tu tshud skabs/ hor dmag dang las byed pa sogs yong nas bsdad pa'i mi rgyud yin la/ lo bdun brgya lhag song stabs skad rigs dang goms 'dris sogs kyang bod ji bzhin du gyur zin/ sog po mda' bcu gcig sogs byang phyogs kyi sog po zer ba'i sde 'bangs rnams ni/ gu shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal sogs kyi rgyud pa yin la/ bod yul du slebs nas lo sum brgya bzhi brgya las ma 'gor stabs da dung yang nang logs su sog skad smra bzhin yod do/ / bod la 'bangs gyen log byung ba'i rjes su gling ge sar zer ba byung la/ chu sbrul la skyes par bshad pa dang / lcags byi la skyes par bshad pa gnyis yod/ gnyis ka gang yin yang rab byung ma tshugs gong gi drug cu skor de'i nang du yin pa deb ther rgya mtshor gsungs/ dang bo ltar na spyi lo1053yin/ phyi ma ltar 793

na spyi lo1060yin/ 'khrungs sa ni rdza chu'i rgyud yin zer/'bangs mi dpa' bo zhig yin la/ grogs dpa' thul so gnyis dang mna' mthun byas te/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi bya ba byas pas mnga' thang che ru rgyas/ dpa' bo dmag mi mang du 'phel te gling rje ge sar zhes snyan grags rgyas/ lho phyogs 'jang sa dam rgyal bo pham par byas/ de nas dmag dang bcas zung chu dang /mdzod dge sogs su 'ongs te dmag ru bzung ba'i sa cha gling dkar stod du grags/ de dang nye ba'i rgya dang ma 'chams par rgya mkhar du ma cham la phab/ de nas byang phyogs su chas te hor gur dkar dang gur ser gnyis la ma 'chams par lo du mar 'khrugs te/ gur dkar cham la phab/ gur ser yang pham ste rjes su 'grig 'dum byas par grags/ de dag la brten nas gling rje ge sar zhes snyan grags kyis 'dzam gling khyab/ dbus phyogs su yang dmag btegs te lho phyogs kyi ri bor ba zhig btul ba la bdud btul zhes grags/ mdo smad yongs rdzogs la dbang bsgyur/mgo log tu pho brang brtsigs te rgyal sa de nas 'dzin grabs byas kyang ma grub pa 'dra/ de skabs shig nas gling rje khyis bsad/dpa' thul gzhan dag kyang shi 'thor gson 'thor du gyur nas shāmanga' thang nyams so/ / 794

de ltar rgyal rong ni bod nas chad snga zhing bar skabs su 'grim 'grul chad pa sogs la brten nas/ bod byings dang skad mi 'dra bar gyur pa ni bod skad shin tu brda rnying dag sor gnas pa dang rang sa nas kyang rim gyis 'gyur che ba yin la/ ji ltar 'gyur tshul sgra gdangs draka che ba'i dbang gis 'gyur bar mngon te/ mig la tir myig sna la tir sna/ rna ba la tir rna/ kha la tir kha/ mchu la tir mchu/ do shal la phreng ba/phreng ba la lag phreng / dor ma la rkang snam/ lag gdub la sgrogarus pa la ris pa/ sha tshil la sha tshil/ khug ma la ta khug(snod yang zer) gzab pa la ga zab/ dman pa la ki man/ khyi la khi/ phag 'tshopheg khyim la khyim/ sogs 'gyur gzhi gcig pa gsal bo can shin tu mang la/ phan tshun gang rung zhig 'gyur ba'i dbang gis gtan nas mi 'dra ba shin tu mang / de bzhin du a mdo'i skad la brda rnying mang ste/ slog pa la slag pa/ slob la stsob/ sla la rtsa/ 'gro la 'gyo/ 'grigs la 'gyigs /skrag la skyag grags la gyags/ sogs mang la/ khams dang a mdo thun mong gis brda rnying 'bod pa ni/ me la mye/ mig la myig sogs yod/ spyir bod kyi skad shin tu 'gyur bar mngon te/ thon mi sasto ṭas rjes su skad gsar bcad kyi sgo nas yi ge 795

gsar bcos thengs gsum re byas par bshad/ srong btsan sgam po'i dus/ yu gur mnga' 'og tu bsdus pa'i skabs kyi khral yig cig shin cang gi sa 'og nas rnyed pa dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi deb ther dkar po'i nang du bkod 'dug mod/ yi ge bod yig yin pa ma gtogs/ bod skad yin min gtan nas mi shes pa zhig 'dug der bltas na/ de dus kyi bod skad deng sang gi bod skad dang mi 'dra bar shes so/ /de ltar bod chags tshul mdor bsdus shig bshad nas/ da ni chos lugs ji ltar byung tshul bshad par bya ste/ spyir bod du dar ba'i chos lugs la bon po dang / ban de gnyis/ ban de la rnying ma ba dang gsar ma gnyis/ gsar ma la bka' gdams pa/ bka' brgyud pa/ zhi byed pa/ sa skya ba/ jo snang ba/ dge lugs pa ste drug yod/ de'i nang gi bka' brgyud pa la shangs pa bka' brgyud dang dwags po bka' brgyud gnyis yod/ thog mar bon po byung ba yin la/ bon ni ston pa gshen rab kyi bstan pa ste/ gshen rab ni rgya nag gi ta'o si'i ston pa lo'u kyun dang gcig pa yin par bshad/ rgya'i skad du skyes mchog la sh+yan shing zer ba'i sh+yan gyi sgra zur nyams nas bod sogs kyis gshen zhes bos par thu'u bkwan grub mthar gsungs/ de byung yul ni 796

stag gzig 'ol mo lung zer ba yin/ de 'ga' zhig gis zhang zhung gi yul bye brag pa zhig yin par byas mod/ nub phyogs kyi rgyal khab gzhan zhig yin pa 'dra ste/ srong btsan sgam po'i lo rgyus su stag gzig nor gyi rgyal bo zer ba'ang yul de ga'i rgyal bo yin par mngon/ de'i lo rgyus su statreg gzig gi yul khams kyang dbang du bsdus par bshad la/ bon gyi lo rgyus 'ga' zhig tu stag gzig gi mkhas pa du ma bod du byon par yang bshad/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyis stag gzig ni u ru si'i yul zhig yin par bshad/ tā ra na tha'i slob dpon pad+ma'i rnam thar du tu ru k+ṣa dang stag gzig gnyis gcig yin par bshad la/ de ltar na/ tu ru k+ṣa ni thur chi yin par ta sa'i dag yig la sa bshad pas gnyis ka ni deng dus kyi thur chi zer ba'i rgyal khab de yin dgos mod/ ta sa'i dag yig tu stag gzig ni po si ste dbyi lang la ngos bzung 'dug la/ dpe la lar ta zig dang / la lar ta zhig ces bris yod kyang / phyi rgyal gyi skad yin gshis bod yig tu 'bri dus lo tsā ba so so'i 'bri tshul tsam las don gcig yin no/ /zhang zhung ni deng sang stod mnga' ris kyi gras su zhang zhung zer ba zhig yod pa de yin no/ /stag gzig 'bru sha'i yul/ kha che/ zhang zhung rnams ni bon dar 797

snga shos yin/ gshen rab ni stag gzig 'ol mo lung zhes bya par byung nas bon bstan/ bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal bo gnya' khri btsan po ma byon pa'i sngon tsam du gshen rab zhang zhung dang bod kyi 'on mda' gser khang rtse/ (mnga' ris grwa tshang gi sa)ri bo rin chen spungs pa/ kong yul bu chu lha khang gi shar phyogs bon ri sogs su 'ongs nas bon gyi bstan pa spel/ de'i gdung tshab mu cho ldem drug stag gzig gi mkhas pa ma tsa tra he se/ khri thog bar tsam/ 'gu hu li spar ma/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa lha bdag sngags dro/rgya nag gi mkhas pa legs tang smangs pa/ khrom gyi mkhas pa gser rdog lce 'byams/ bod kyi mkhas pa ldem gyin tsha smad dge/ mi nyag gi mkhas pa lce tsha gar gu/ sum pū'i mkhas pa mu srungs gsang tang / zhang zhung gi mkhas pakyishir bu chen sogs rjes 'jug mang du byung ba rnams kyis bon dar bar byas/ rgya gar du dar cha che ba ma byung ba 'dra la/ rgya nag tu ta'o si zer ba bon yin la dar so mi chung tsam byung / bod du bon po byung mtshams kyi lo tshigs ji bzhin brjod mi nus mod/ spre'u mir gyur nas rim gyis 'tsho ba 'brog las su gyur rjes/ dpon g.yog dang sde shog sogs kyi lam lugs dar nas bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal bo ma byung gong gi bar mtshams shig tu dar bar snang / gnya' khri btsan po byon dus 798

bon yod de/ bon sogs phyugs rdzi bcu gnyis kyis gnya' khri btsan po gdan drangs par bshad/ gnya' khri btsan po'i ring la yang tshe mi gshe na gyi rmu rgyal gyis don bsgyur bar bshad/ de dus bod la yi ge med stabs tshig ji bzhin bod yig tu bsgyur rgyu med kyang / don bod skad du bshad bcug pas don bsgyur zer ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin nam snyam/ de dag ni stag gzig nas zhang zhung dang bod du dar ba'i bon yin no/ /gnya' khri btsan po'i rjes su dar ba'i bon la/ rdol bon/ 'khyar bon/ bsgyur bon gsum yod/ dang bo ni gnya' khri btsan po nas brtsis pa'i rgyal rabs drug pa'i dus su dbus 'am shod ces pa'i sa char gshen rdol zhes bya ba byung nas/gsol mchod dang yas stag gtong lugs sna tshogs bstan/ de'i rjes 'jug rnamasdo rdol bon yin/ de'i dus kyi bon po rnams la mar 'dre srin gnon pa dang / yar lha mchod pa dang bar khyim thab 'don pa gsum tsam las bon lugs kyi lta ba grub mtha'i tha snyad med/ gnyis pa 'khyar bon ni/ rgyal bo gri gum btsan po blon po lo ngam gyis bsad pas gri ru shi/ 'di'i sdon bod kyi rgyal bo gri ru shi ba med la/ 'di rgyal bo gri ru shi ba'i thog ma yin stabs/gri 'dul ba'i ched du kha che dang / 'bru sha dang / zhang zhung 799

gsum nas bon po gsum bos/ bon de gsum gyis mo btab nas legs nyes bshad/ gson po la rim gro bsgrubs/ gshin po'i gri 'dul ba sogs byas te bon rgya cher dar bar byas/ de phyin chad bon gyi lta ba grub mtha' zhig kyang bzung ste/ rgya gar gyi mu stegs dbang phyug pa'i grub mtha' 'khyar bon dang 'dres pa yin zer/ de yan gyi bon po ni rgya nag gi ta'o si dang 'dra bar sngags 'chang lta bu las rab tu byung ba'i rtags can med/ deng sang spyang rigs zhes brjod pa sogs kyi sa char rnga phyed ka brdungs nas gto bucos sogs byed mkhan dag ni de'i rgyud pa yin/ de la bon chab nag zer ro/ /gsum pa/ bsgyur bon ni/ snga phyi bar gsum las/ dang bo ni/ rgya gar gyi nang ba'i dge slong zhig nub mo smad 'tshong ma yod sar song ste nang snga bar sham thabs nor nas smad 'tshong ma'i sham thabs sdon po gyon te dge 'dun gyi tshogs dbus su song / dge 'dun pa gzhan gyis bud med yod sar song bar shes nas gnas dbyung byas/ kho'i sems la yul 'dir bsdad na bsnyen bkur mi 'thob/ yul mtha' 'khob tu 'gro snyam ste bod yul du 'ongs// de'i ming la paṇa ḍi ta sham thabs sngon po can zer/ khos chos mang bo brtsams nas gter du sbas pa yang kho rang gis bton pa bon 800

dang 'dres pa rnams ni bsgyur bon snga ma zer/ gnyis pa bar du bsgyur ba ni/ rgyal bo khri srong lde btsan gyis bon gyi bstan pa bsnubs te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar byas/ bon rnams chos la 'jug dgos pa'i khrims byas te/ rgyal ba'i byang chub zer ba la/ rin chen mchog las chos nyon byas pas khos ma 'dod pa la rgyal bos khrims bcad/ kho khros te bon rnams dang bsdebs nas sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab 'ga' zhig bon du bsgyur/ de rgyal bos thos te sangs rgyas kyi chos bon du sgyur mkhan rnams kyi ske chod zer bas mi mang rabs kyi ske bcad/ bon rnams skrag nas bsgyur 'phro dang bcas pa gter du sbas pa rnams phyis su gter nas bton pa la bon gter ma zer zhing de ni bar du bsgyur ba'i bon yin no/ /gsum pa tha mar bsgyur ba ni/rgyal bo glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs rjes gtsang nyang stod nas gshen sgur klu dga' bya bas dar yul sgro lag bya ba dbus kyi bon gnas shig tu sangs rgyas kyi bka' mang bo bon du bsgyur te/ yum rgyas pa la khams chen/ nyi shu lnga ba la khams chung / gtan la dbab pa la bon mdo/ gzungs lnga la klu 'bum dkar nag bcas btags/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bsgyur ba yin gshis/bad chad dang ming mi 'dra ba sna tshogs btags kyang mang don byi0/

phal cher 'dra la/ brda chad 'dra ba yang mang bo yod/ lha sgrub thabs dang gto mdos sogs chos dang gtan nas mi 'dra ba mang bo yod par snang ste/ 'khyar bon sogs kyi lugs kyang yod par snang ngo / /chos bon du bsgyur ba'i bon gyi bka' 'gyur yang sangs rgyas kyi bka' 'gyur 'dra ba phal cher yo/da/ mdo sngags gnyis ka yod la/ bon rang gzhung du mdo phyogs skor la chab nag srid pa rgyud kyi bon dang / sngags phyogs skor la chab dkar sngags kyi bon zer/ bon gyi bka' 'gyur par ni rgyal rong gi khro skyabs yul du po ti bdun cu tsam zhig gi par yod pa las/gzhan du par yod pa ma thos/ bsgyur bon sogs dar nas bon la rab byung dang dge slong sgrub pa sogs kyang yod la/ rim gyis nang ba sangs rgyas pa las chos nyan mkhan dang / nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i grwa sa sogs su slob gnyer byed mkhan yang mang bo byung nas/ chos 'ga' zhig bon gyi brda skad du bsgyur/ 'ga' re ma bsgyur pa sgra sor bzhag gis nyams len dang 'chad nyan byed pa sogs chos dang mang bo 'dres/ rim gyis dgon sde so so'i sgrig lam/ bla slob kyi 'chad nyan lam lugs/ sgom sgrub byed lugs/ sbyin bdag 'tshol lugs/ mnga' 'bangs la dbang bsgyur lugs/ sprul sku blu ba sogs phal cher ban de dang 'dra bar byi02

gyur/ dper na/ bon gyi rgyal ba gnyis par grags pa/ mnyam med shes rab rgyal mtshan zer ba/ rje tsong kha pa dang dus mnyam pa'i bon gyi bla ma de yang / sa skya'i dgon pa nā len dra sogs su sa skya'i bla ma mang bo bsten te/ nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs la sbyangs/ phyis su sangs rgyas pa'i yig cha la brten nas kho rang gis yig cha brtsams pa/ bon gyi khungs byed pa lta bu chos bon du bsgyur ba'am 'dres pa sha stag tu snang la/ dus phyis yang ban de'i lam rim gyi mgo mjug cung zad re bsgyur nas bon gyi lam rim byed pa lta bu shin tu mang / bod du chos lugs dar ba'i snga shos ni bon yin la/ srong btsan sgam po'i sngon gyi bod kyi rgyal blon rnams ni bon mchod gnas su bzung stabs/bod kun tu bon rgya cher dar/ srong btsan sgam po'i dus su chos dar yang bon la ched du dgag pa ma btang / khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su rgyal bos chos lugs byed pa las/ bon lugs byed mi chog pa'i bka' bsgrags te bon bsnubs/ 'on kyang mdo smad rgyal rong sogs/ sa mtha' dang lung kyog 'ga' zhig tu nub ma thub pa yang yod nges/ glang dar gyis chos bsnubs nas slar yang chos dar ba dang chabs cig tu bsgyur bon sogs slar yang dar nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ltar rgya khyab tu dar ma thub/803

dbus gtsang du ban de ha cang dar rgyas che ba'i dbang gis bon po shi na tu nyung bar gyur/ bon dgon chung ngu re chags na'ang phal cher 'thor zhig tu song nas shul tsam las med la/ cung zad grags tsheb ni gtsang du mnyam med shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi dgon pa sman ri/ 'di chags nas lo lnga brgya lhag song zer/mdo smad lho rgyud kyi bon po snang zhig zla ba rgyal mtshan zer ba gtsang du song nas sa skya'i dgon pa 'bras yul skyed tshal du slob gnyer byas te cung zad mkhas par gyur/ des btab pa'i dgon pa g.yung drung gling / 'di lo brgya yar mar tsam song zer/ khams phyogs su yang bon po shin tu nyung la/ mdo smad byang rgyud sogs khri srong lde btsan gyi rjes su chad pa yin stabs bon po re gnyis las med/ mdo smad lho rgyud kyi rgyal rong phyogs ni bod nas chad pa shin tu snga bar gong du brjod pa ltar yin gshis/ bon po cung tsam mang ba'i sa cha ni de kho na yin/ rgyal rong phyogs su sngar thams cad bon po yin la/ khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su dbus nas slob dpon bai ro tsa na rgyal rong yul du phyin nas/ rgyal rong rgyal bo mdo bzher nag po chos 'og tu bcug ste/ yul sde du ma zhig ban der bsgyur kyang da dung shin tu mang ngo / /de nas rab byung bdun pa'i nang rje tsong kha pa'i dngos slob 804

(tsho kho ngag dbang grags pa dbus nas mdo smad du phebs te/ rnga ba nas bzung chu chen dang btsan lha'i bar gyi yul kun tu bskyod de bon po du ma bsnubs/ dgon pa brgya rtsa brgyad btab/ de rjes rje'i dngos slob rong chen ljags nag pa mdo smad du byon/bon po du ma bsnubs/ chu 'brug lor kirti'i rong dgon btab/de nas bzung 'di phyogs su ban de shin tu mang bar gyur kyang da dung yang bon po mang / man ching gong ma g.yung ṭing gi dus su 'dzam thang gi jo nang chos rje sprul sku rgyal rong phyogs su byon nas bon po kha shas ban der bsgyur/ jo nang dgon pa rgya kha rtag brtan gling btab/ mchod rten chen mo bzhengs/ de rjes tshe dbang rgyal bos yang mchod rten der zhig gso dang jo nang la bsnyen bkur cher bgyis/ de rjes chen lung gi dus su rgya tsha gnyis 'khrugs te tsha kho pham rjes/ chen lung rgyal bos bon dgon cung zad che ba lha steng dge lugs par bsgyur/ der dbus nas mkhan po rim par btang nas rgyal rong gi dge dgon thams cad lha steng mkhan pos bdag byed rgyu byas stabs/ chu chen dang btsan lha sogs su bon po gtan nas med par gyur/ gong ma chen lung gis bon po byas mi chog pa'i bka' khyab yam tsam bsgrags kyang khro skyabs dang / 'bar khams sogs yul 'ga' zhig tu da dung 805

bon po ma 'gyur bar gnas pa byung / de da—nga dus rags mtshungs par/ a mchog dpon po gzungs skyabs yag zer ba'i bu a mchog dge bshes brasod nams chos 'phel zer bas a mchog khag gsum dang zangs dkar khag gsum ban der bsgyur/ a mchog dkar chen dgon pa btab/ de rjes cog tse dpon sras dga' ldan gser khri blo bzang lhun 'grub kyi sprul sku cog tse gser khrir grags pa de/ lha steng mkhan por byon rjes cog tse dpon dang zung 'brel byas nas 'bar khams dgon ban der bsgyur/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu sbrul (1893)lo la 'bar khams dgon pa'i 'du khang gsar du brtsigs/ 'bar khams sprul sku sogs bon po'i bla grwa kha shas zung chu'i khri rkyang du song ste khri rkyang gis dmag lan gnyis drangs/ snga ma'i skabs su cog tse dang 'bar khams kyi khang ba du ma bsreg mi kha zhas bsad/ phyi ma'i skabs su khri rkyang gi dmag pham nas phyir bros zer/ de ltar rim gyis bon po rnams ban der 'gyur na yang da dung bon po yod pa ni/ rgyal rong gi khro skyabs/ rnga bar rtogs ldan dgon dang snang zhig gnyis/ zung chur khri rkyang yongs rdzogs/ zho ngu /kho spo/ mdzod dge ru mda' chen/ spyang tshang rnams bon po yin pa ma gtogs/ sa cha gzhan dag tu bon po cher med do/ /kha 806

cig gis/ ban de'i yum ni/ khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su bon po'i khams chen bsgyur ba yin zer ba ni shin tu mi 'thad de/yum ni khri srong lde btsan gyi ches sngon nas rgya gar du yod par ma zad/ rgya nag sogs sa cha gzhan dag tu 'gyur yod do/ /yang kha cig gis/ bod yig ni thon mi sasto ṭas bzos pa mi 'thad de/ srong btsan sgam po'i sngon gyi rgyal rabs dag gis chab srid bskyangs 'dug pas/ chab srid skyong ba la nges par yi ge dgos so zer ba ni/ shin tu ma nges pa'i gtam yin te/hor jing gir rgyal bo yan chad du hor du rgyal bo du ma byung mod yi ge med la/ hor go tan rgyal bo'i dus su sa skya paṇa chen gyis sog yig gsar du bzos pa dang / man ju'i rgyal rabs su yang de dang 'dra la/ gzhan yang yi ge med pa'i mi rigs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs ji ltar dar ba ni gsal bas so/ /yang kha cig gis/ bod yig ni stag gzig gi yi ger dpe byas nas bzos pa yin zer ba ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ de lta bur dpe byed pa'i/ yul stag gzig gi yi ge dang / yi ge des bris pa'i gzhung dang de spyod pa'i yul dang de la brten nas bod yig bzos na/ dbyangs gsal la phri snon byed dgos mi dgos/dgos na phri snon ji ltar byas tshul sogs brjod rgyu gtan nas byi07

mid pas so/ /bod du nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i chos dar tshul ni/ lha tho tho ri'i ring la gong du bshad pa ltar/ spang skong phya ga rgya ba/za ma tog bkod pa/ tsin+ta ma ṇi'i gzungs rnams kyi smregs bam 'byor ba la/ chos kyi dbu brnyes zer yang / chos nyams su len pa ma byung / de nas gdung rabs so gsum pa srong btsan sgam po'i dus su bod la yi ge med pas/ blon po thon mi sasto ṭargya gar la yi ge slob tu btang / des yig mkhan bram ze li byin ka ra dang / paṇa ḍi ta lha rig pa'i seṅge gnyis las yig rigs dang sgra legs par bslabs/ bod du 'ongs nas rgya gar gyi yi ger dpe byas te bod yig gsar du bzos/ bod kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos brgyad brtsams// rgyal bos kyang thon mi las yi ge yun ring bslabs/ thon mis mdo sde dkon mchog sprin rgya gar gyi skad yig las bod skad du bsgyur/ 'di chos bsgyur ba'i thog ma yin/ gzhan yang / rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra/bram ze shang ka ra/ bal bo shrī la malja/ rgya nag gi slob dpon ma hā de wa tshe rnams spyan drangs/ lo tsā ba thon mi dang de'i slob bu dharma go sha sogs kyis lo tsā ba byas nas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa bsgyur cing gtan la phab/rgyal bos po ta la'i pho brang gi rtser spyan ras gzigs kyi sku sogs 80byi

bzhengs/ bal bza' khri btsun gyi rdzongs skal du jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang / rgya bza' kong jo'i rdzongs skal du jo bo shākya mu ni sogs sku gsung thugs rten mang bo gdan drangs/ bal bza' khri btsun gyis ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dang / rgya bza' kong jos ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang sogs gtsug lag khang mang bo bzhengs/ rgyal bo rang gis kyang spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs la sogs pa brtsams te/ dkon mchog la mchod pa dang / ma ṇi 'don pa spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma sogs la gsol ba 'debs pa sogs chos shin tu dar bar byas kyang / rab byung gi sde ma tshugs/ srong btsan sgam po rang lo brgyad cu gya gnyis pa la 'das pa'i rjes su/ rgya dmag 'ongs pa sogs kyi rkyen gyis/ jo bo shākya mu ne ra mo che nas gdan drangs te/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi glo 'bur du sbas/ de rjes khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom gyi dus su/ lha sa mkhar brag mchims phu gnam sral/dar 'phru mkhar ltag mdo smad ling chu khri tse/ brag dmar du sga chu shar sgo/ 'phang thang ka med/ ka chung ban chung / brag dmar mgrin bzang la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ bran ka mu la ko sha dang / gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra'i mdo sde las brgya ba dang gser 'od dam pa gnyis bsgyur/ rtsis dang sman dpyad 809

la sogs pa yang bsgyur te chos dang rig gnas srol rgyas par byas/ rgya nag nas rgya rje'i sras mo gyim shing kong jo khab tu bsus/kong jo'i jo bo shākya mu ne rgyal rabs du mar mun par bzhugs pa lho sgo me long can nas bton te/ gtsang khang dbus mar bzhugs su gsol nas mchod pa'i yo byad du mas mchod pa byas/ ('di'i bar dum bu zhig chad) gnyis ka'i bshad pa rgya cher mdzad/ dbang dang sgrub pa'i lag len du ma mdzad de bstan pa dar bar byes/yang rgyal bo de'i ring la/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta snyarma pā la/de'i slob ma'i gtso bo sā rnyu pā la/ gu na pā la/ pradzñā pā la ste/ pā la gsum dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ chos mang du zhus/ de dag las zhang zhung ba rgyal ba'i shes rab kyis sdom pa blangs/ slar bal bor byon te 'dul 'dzin bre ta ka lar 'dul ba'i lag len dang bshad pa zhus/ de'i slob ma dpal la 'byor dang / zhang mo che ba byang chub seng ge la sogs pa nas brgyud pa rnams la stod 'dul ba zhes grags/ gzhan yang / ye shes 'od kyi gcung srong de'i sras mnga' bdab/ lha sde'i dus su khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal gyis kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī spyan drangs/ mdo dang bstan bcos mang du bsgyur te bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ de las brgyud pa'i sdom rgyun la paṇa chen sdom rgyun zer ro/ / cibyi10

thugs rje chen po'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus pad dkar chun po/ rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs spyan ras gzigs/ /'gro ba dpag med 'dul phyir sprul ba'i gar/ /dpag tu med pas zhing khams rab 'byams khyab/ /'gro ba dpag med 'dren mdzade der phyag 'tshal/ /byin rlabs zer brgya 'bar ba'i 'od snang gis/ /'gro ba'i sdig sgrib 'joms dang chabs cig tu/ /snyigs dus rgud pa lhag med sel mdzad pa/ /mtha' 'khob nyin mo'i mgon po khyod min su/ /'dir khro skyabs thugs rje chen po zhes mtshan snyan g.yu 'brug gi rnga sgras nam mkha' nyageng ba/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'geng ba'i las can gyi dad ldan dag gi skyabs yul dam pa 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus mdo tsam 'god pa la/ sku 'di nyid blon chen lo tsā ba chen po thon mi si bho ṭa zhes yongs su grags pa des/ 'phags yul gyi mi 'jigs rin chen bye ma spung 811

ba'i gling nas spyan drangs par bshad di/ 'di'i gter yig las/ sngon tshe rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po yis: thon mi sa bho rgya gar yul du btang: paṇ+ḍi ta lha rig pa'i seng ge'i mdun: nā ga ra 'am lami dper byas nas: yig rigs mi 'dra sna tshogs bod la bsgyur: sum rtags la sogs bstan ba cos bco brgyad mdzad: sher phyin snying bo rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum mdzad:sangs rgyas phal chen 'dul ba ka ri ka: spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyer gcig dang: mi 'jigs rin chen bye ma a drung gi: lnga ldan jo bo 'di nyid bod du drangs: zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rgyal blon thams cad kyis brtan bzhugs dang rab gnas mdzad/ de'i tshe sku'i zhal nas 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros/ ma dag 'khor ba'i gnas thams cad khyab/ 'od zer tshur 'dus nas sku la thim/ sku'i zhal nas gsung byon te/ nga ni rigs drug 'dul ba'i dpa' bo che: bod khams srin po 'dra ba'i yang mtha' na: pre ta yi dwags 'dra ba'i grong khyer dbus: nga 'gro lung bstan gdul bya'i dus la bab: ces gsung byon/ de nas blon po mgar gyis gnas 'dir gdan drangs te/ phyi rabs kyi gdul bya'i don du gter du sbas te/rgyal ba rigs lnga'i phyag rgya lngas rgyas btab pa'o/ /gnas ri 812

bor thugs rje chen po 'khrungs pa'i rnam thar las/ bod rje lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyis lung bstan srong btsan sgam po dang blon chen mgar gyis bzhengs pa'i jo bo rnam lnga'i nang tshan/ sa 'og klu yi 'gro don skyong nus mthong grol lnga ldan jo bo zhes pa de yin zhing dgos pa'i dbang gis sa 'og nas re zhig bzhugs na'ang rjes su bla ma shes rab rgyal mtshan zhes pa'i dbus nas bong bu zhig la ma ṇi bka' 'bum bkal te/ rgyal rong du byon tshe bong bu ri 'dabs kyi sa spung nang nyal/ bla ma de 'gram gyi khyim tshang klu 'khyil tshang du slebs tshe spun gsum yod/ gnyis bla ma gcig skya bo yin/ skya rgyud des sa zhing la mdzo dor rmos nas zhing dkyil du slebs tshe/ jo bo'i dbu la thong gshol thogs nas thong so lam gnyis chag slar khyim du 'ongs nas de ltar smras pas/ bla ma shes rab rgyal mtshan dga' nas sa 'og nas jo bo blangs zer/ de'i sngon du bai ro tsa na byon nas gnas 'di byin gyis brlabs te gnas mchog bde chen gling gi ming btags/tsho zhes gnas ri bor thugs rje chen po 'khrungs pa'i rnam thar mdo tsam zhes pa na yod la/ lha sa'i rang byon lnga ldan/ lho mtsho'i thugs rje chen po/ khro skyabs thugs rje chen po gsum ni spunagasum/ zhes gsungs so/ /gter nas byung ba'i lo tshigs dzi813

bzhin mi shes mod/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum gdan drangs par bshad pas/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum ni gter ston chos 'grub dang mnga' bdag nyang ral gyis gter nas bton pa yin pas/ de la bltas na rab byung bzhi ba'i nang zhig tu e yin snyam/ lo rgyus gsal bo zhig ma mthong ngo / /'di ni skabs 'gar zhal mdzes shing gzhon pa'i rnam pa can du mthong zhing / skabs 'gar sku sha nyams shing cung zad rid pa'i rnam pa can du mthong / 'jig rten 'dir bde sdug gang gi rtags thon pa dang / khri chen gung thang rin po che sku phreng drug pa/ rje 'jigs med bstan pa'i dbang phyug phebs skabs/ zhal nas bdud rtsi mang tsam bab pa mjal ba kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa dang / dga' ldan byang rtse'i mkhan po blo bzang sbyin pa phebs skabs yang zhal nas bdud rtsi bab pa bsres pa'i sman sku zhig kyang bzhengs 'dugarig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i chag sgo chen po'i skabs/mi ser snying stobs can rnams kyis sbas pa/ slar blangs nas nyams gso byas te sngar gyi go sar bzhugs dus 'ja' shar ba pisogs dge mtshan shar/ deng skabs phyogs mtha' dag nas mjal ba rgyun mi 'chad par 'ongs nas mjal ba dang / gnas ri khyad par can 'di phyag skor byed bzhin yod do/ / 'di ni rnga 814

khrol srid gros khang gi las rdon pa bstan pa rgya mtshos 'de lta ba stozhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar/ bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros zhes bya bas brel zing du glo bur bris pa'o/ / — wa15

spyi nor phun tshogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// lkernam kun mkhyen pa'i 'od kyis rmongs mun sel/ /mtshan dpe'i rgyan ldan sku yis 'gro kun 'dul/ /legs gsung 'phrin las 'bum gyis 'gro kun 'dren/ /skyabs kun 'dus zhal bla mar snying nas 'dud/ /khyod skyu thugs rje lcags kyu rnon po yis/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun nam yang mi gtong bar/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las myur drongs la/ /thar ba'i skam sa che der bzhugs su gsol/ /dam chos 'od snang 'bum gyi rtse dga' yis/ /rig pa chu skyes gzhon nu 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /rab tu phye ba'i dga' ston bla na med/ /blo ldan skye bo'i gzigs mor 'grem par bya/ /de yang dam chos nyi ma'i 'od rkyas bsil ldan ljongs 'di ma khyab pa'i gong du/ bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas zhes yongs su 816

spags pa de nyid ji bzhin mid la/ dam pa'i ts+tshas ma dar ba'i sngon gyi rgyal rabs rnams bon sgrung lde'ugasum gyis bskyangs zhege pa'i tha snyad tsam grags pa 'di lta ste bon ni lha mchod 'dre 'dul/ mo rtsis phywa g.yang 'gug pa sogs te/ dper na deng dus rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul zhes btags pa'i mnga' khul wun khron rdzong gi khongs su yod pa'i sngar rta dmag ces 'bod kyang deng dus spyang rigs sam ching rigs zhes 'bod pa'i sa cha'i la bong sogs kyi yul du yi ge med kyang rnga phyed g.yogs can brdung zhing lha 'bod klu 'bod sogs byed cing / rim gro dang gri 'dul sogs byed pa/ cog tse dang mda' mdung yo byad sogs la lha phab ste 'gul skyod sogs byed 'jug pa dang / mar nag gdu khel nang du sngags btab nas lag pa bcug kyang mi sreg pa dang / lcags mes bsregs te dmar sang du gyur pa la lces bldags nas sngags 'debs pa sogs byed pa'i khyim sngags de dag ni gna' dus bon zer ba de yin pa las/ de dus kyi skyabs gsum dang las 'bras khas len pa'i rab byung yod pa'i bon dang gtan nas mi 'dra/ khri srong gis lha 'dre dmar mchod byed pa'i bon dag med par btang yang mtha' khul du cung zad lus yod pa de lta bu red/ skyi17

cing ni ro langs gsir sgrub kyi sgrung dang / ma sadzis sgrung dang / mchil ba'i sgrung sogs mi rnams kyi rig pa je gsal dang / sems 'dul ba'i don du nyan bshad byed pa de yin la/deng sang yang byis pa rnams phyogs 'dus byas nas/ sgrung sna tshogs bshad pa dang nyan pa la shin tu dga' ba lta bu yin la/ rgya byunag gi ta'o jo zhes pa'i lugs 'dzin gyis kyang sgrung sna tshogs dhe nyan bshad byed la/ bod rang la'ang lo rgyus dngos dang lha sgrung sogs nyan bshad byed pa/ mi rigs so sos sgrung la brten pa'i slos gar dang glog ba rnyan bzo ba sogs deng dus/ dar ba lta bu'o/ /de dag ni rig pa gsal byed dang / dran sgo 'byed pa dang / slob gso gtong byed yin pa/ deng sang yang de dag bed spyod bzhin pa yin no/ /lde'u ni khed 'jog pa ste/ them gnyer wa ba che(srang)ci yinagyuzhes 'dri ba lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ mi rnams kyi blo rig je rno la 'gro ba'i phyir rig pa 'gran pa dang / ta'o jo ba dag gis de ni yang dag pa'i chos su brtsi ba red ces sdor ro/ /deng sang yang bod kyi sa cha rnams su na gzhon rnams kyis khed 'jog res kyis rig pa 'gran bsdur byed bzhin pa'o/ /'di dag gi skabs su 'ga' zhig gis sngar la mi bstun pa'i sngon med 818

gsar btod yin zhes/ rang nyid grags 'dod kyi kun slong gis cal col smras pa 'ga' mchis mod khungs med rdol gtam 'ba' zhig tu mchis pas/ dgag 'os su mi che/ gong gi 'di dag kyang rig gnas kyi grangs su 'gro mod/ 'on kyang yongs su grags pa'i rig gnas bcu'i grangs su mi 'dren no/ /gzhan yang / mda' 'phong 'gran pa dang / rta sogs bzhon rgyugaglu dang gar bro sogs yod de/ srong btsan sgam po gzhon dus yi ge med mod/ mda' 'phong gi rtsal/ mchong rgyug gi rtsal/ glu dang gar gyi rtsal/ rol mo 'bud dkrol gyi rtsal sogs rig rtsal che bar bshad/ 'on spyang de dag kyang bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi grangs su mi 'dren no/ /rig gnas dngos gzhi dar ba ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus yin te/ de'i tshe rgyal srid rab tu dar zhing rgyas nas mtha' bzhi'i rgyal bo rgya gar dang rgya nag li dang bal sogs phan tshun bka' 'phrin yang yang byed dgos byung / de dag la rang rang gi yi ge yod pas rang gi yi ge'i steng nas 'phrin yod la bod rgyal rang la yi ge med pas/ mi rigs gzhan gyi yi ge shes pa'i drung yig bzhag nas 'phrin sogs 'bri dgos/ de'i tshe rgyal bo srong btsan gyi thugs dgongs la/ mtha' bzhi'i rgyal bo rnams ni dam pa'i chos dang yi ge zung du yod pas 819

k+ṣ-ibaka' 'phrin yang rang gi yi ge la rdzong ba zhig na/ rang cag tsede med pas dman pa'i gras su 'gro ba dang / gzhan dag gis spyang 'phya ba'i yul du gyur pas/ da ni mi las lhar sgrub pa'i thabs dam pa'i chos dang / de nyid rtogs par byed pa'i thabs su 'phrul gyi yi ge 'tshol du gtong dgos dgongs nas/ blon po'i mchog rig pa can mgar stong btsan yul bzung g.yog dang bcas te btang ba ta la wa ti rnam gsum du byon pa na g.yog phal cher nad kyis gum ste slob dpon mgar stong btsan yang gum par dgongs te the tshom nas slar log go/ /de nas gnyal thu mi snang grags kyi bu a nu zhes pa'am thu mi bu chung yang zer ba g.yog dang bcas pa brdzangs pa bal bor chu bsnyams shing bsil sman khyer nas phyin pas nā len drar bgrod de ma hā mi ṭa'i slob ma lha rig pa'i seng ge zhes bya ba lo bdun bsten nas yi ge dang sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos sogs mang bo bslabs/ gzhan yang yig mkhan li byin ka ra sogs paṇa ḍi ta mang bo bsten nas rig gzhung dang mdo rgyud mang po bslabs pas mkhas pa chen por gyur pa la paṇa ḍi ta rnams kyis sasto ṭa zhes bla thabs su btags te bod yang dag par zer ro/ /phyir phebs nas sku mkhar ma ru rnyar(deng dus kyi pha bong kha)lo gsum la sku mtshams bcad de saṃ skṛ ta'i yi 820

ge dper blangs nasartsobod kyi dbyangs gsal bsgrig bzo mdzad/saṃ skra ta'i dbyangs gsal nas 'dor len byas shing / yigarigazugs bzos/ brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos brgyad mdzad/ de nas thon mis yi ge 'bri tshul dbyangs gsal 'god sgrig gsar snon bcas legs par grub pa'i yig phud du rgyal bo khri srong btsan la bya dka' ba'i lam nas drangs pa'i bstod pa phul ba yongs su grags pa ltar yin no/ /deng dus 'di dag gi skabs su khungs med byung rgyal du smra ba mang yang / tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ log pa'i lan la mtha' med phyir/ /de dag 'di ni spro bya min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar spro byar mi 'os pa'i gnas so/ /bod gangs can gyi rig pa'i gnas bcu zhes mkhas nga/ rnams kyi ngag tu yongs su grags pa ni/ log smra tshar gtsod pa'i rig gnas sgra dang tshad ma gnyis/ skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i rig gnas bzo dang gso ba gnyis/ bdag nyid kun shes par byed pa'i rig gnas nang don rig pa ste lnga la rig gnas che ba lnga zhes zer/ snyan ngag mngon brjod/ sdeb stor/ skar rtsis/zlos gar lnga la rig gnas chung ba lnga zhes zer ro/ /skede nas thog mar chos dar ba'i stobs kyis sgra rig pa dar tshul ni/ de nas bzung ste yon tan gyi rtsa ba bod rang gi yi ge 821

'bri ba'i srol yod par gyur nas/ yul khams gzhan la yod pa'i chos dang rig pa'i gnas dag bod rang gi skad yig tu sgyur migo brtsams so/ /de nas rgyal bo chen po khri srong btsan gyis gtsug tsholag khang mang bo bzhengs nas/ lo tsā ba'i thog ma thon mi sasto ṭas spyan drangs pa'i chos dang rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag bod la sgyur cig gsungs/ de nas thon mi sasto ṭas rang gi mchan bu slob ma mang bo la bod kyi brda sprod pa'i gzhung dang ka tsan sogs sgra gzhung mang bo bslabs/ rgyal bo khri srong btsan chos la shin tu dad pas/ chos bsgyur ba'i don du skad gsar bcad byas pa yin par sgra'i bstan bcos smra ba rgyan gyi me tog ngag gi dbang rgyug grub pa las bshad do/ /de'i tshul ni/ de'i skabs su bod yul sa rgya che zhing / 'brog sde bkram nas yod pa shayoche bas yul gru re la yul skad re yod gshis/ re re'i rjes su 'brang na mtha' mi chod cing gcig sdud mi yong ba gzhan yang chos kyi tha snyad mang bo zhig gsar du thon pa sogs rkyen du ma'i dbang gis/ yul dbus kyi skad la gtso bor brten dgos zhes pa sogs skad gsar bcad dang bo byas par gsungs so/ /de nas rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra dang / bram ze shang ka ra/ slob dpon li byin/ bal bo'i slob dpon shī la malja/83lha

kha chi'i slob dpon ta nulhata dang / sgo nu ta/ rgya nag gi slodzo dpon hwa shang ma hā de wa tshe rnams spyan drangs te/ bod kyi lo tsā ba thon mi sasto ṭa dang / de'i mchan bu corma ko sha a lo ka ye shes dpal sogs kyis lo tsā byas/ de rnams las rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa ra'i yon bdag bal bza' khri btsun gyis byas/ lo tsā ba thon mis byas/ bram ze shang ka ra'i yon bdag rgyal bos byas/ lo tsā ba dharma ko shas byas/ rgya nag gi mkhan po'i yon bdag rgya bza' kong jos byas/ lo tsā ba yang ko—nga jo nyid da nga lha lung rdo rje dpal gyis byas/ bal bo dang kha che'i yon bdag bal bza' khri btsun gyis byas/ lo tsā ba yang khri btsun nyid dang thon mis byas so/ /lo paṇa de dag la gser dngul gyi 'bul ba sogs bsnyen bkur bla na med pa zhus te/ sde snod gsum dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs bod skad du bsgyur/ de ltar rig gnas che ba lnga'i ya gyal sgra rig pa'i gzhung lugs gsar du dar ba'i mgo yang dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba dang dar ba'i don dang 'brel ba yin no/ / mang srong mang btsan dang / 'dus srong mang bo rje gnyis kyi dus su yang mes po srong btsan gyi dus bzhin du chos srid gnyis char zung 'brel du dar nas mtha' bzhi dbang du bsdus/823

chos dar ba dang mnyam du sgra rig pa yang sngar bzhin dar ro/ /khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom can gyi dus/ gangs te se nas paṇa ḍi ta sangs rgyas gsang ba dang sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis gdan drangs kyang / gdan ma drongs/ 'on kyang pho nya bas theg pa chen po'i mdo sde lnga blo la bzung nas 'ongs pas/ glegs bam lnga bzhengs te bzhugs khang du/ brag dmar mgrin bzang /brag dmar ke ru/ gsang mkhar brag mchims nam ralda/ ma sa gong gi lha khang dang lnga bzhengs/ rgya yul kong shi nas gser 'od dam pa dang / 'dul ba las rnam par 'byed pa dang / sman dpyad kyi rigs kha shas bsgyur/ li yul nas rab tu byung ba spyan drangs nas gus mchod bsnyen bkur mdzad cing / bod mi rab tu byung ba ma byung / 'on kyang si skṛ ta dang / li dang / rgya nag sogs kyi skad yig dang / brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs sbyong ba ni mang bo mchi sa stabs sgra rig pa dar byung / de ltar sgra rig dar ba yang chos kyi phyir yin gshis/ de'i skabs sgra rig dar ba yang dam pa'i chos 'brel to/ / khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su/ mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho dang /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang rjen po bzhengs/ mchims a nu'i bu shākya bra bha dang /824

pa gor he 'dod kyi bu bai ro tsa na/ sba khri bzher gyi bu sba khri gzigs/ zhang nyang bzang gi bu lha bes btsan dang / shud pu khong sleb/ 'khon klu'i dbang bo bsrung pa/ ngan lam rgyal mchog gtsang legs grub/ 'jam dpal go cha/ bran kha mu tig glang ka ta na/ rtsangs de wen dra/ rlangs khams pa go cha/ 'khon na gen/ rma rin chen mchog la gsum rgyal ba byang chub/ sba gsal snang / sba khri bzher/ sbrang rgyang legs gzigs/ seng gong lha lung gzigs/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ shud pu dpal gyi seng ge/ tshangs sa le'i bu rin chen legs grub sogs la sgra rig pa legs sbyar dang / rgya nagali/ kha che/ bal bo/ za hor sogs kyi skad yig brda sprod slob bcug pas mang che ba mkhas pa chen por gyur nas lo tsā ba — mang bo byon/ de dag las sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung zhija /de rjes rab byung gi sde 'phel/ lo tsā ba mkhas pa rgan gsum/'bring gsum gzhon gsum sogs lo tsā ba mang bo 'phel bsam yas kyi sgra bsgyur lo tsā gling du chos bsgyur/ bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du dbang bskur/ rnam dag khrims khang gling du so thar gyi sdom khrims phog dga' ldan sems bskyod gling du byang sdom phogami g.yo bsam gtan gling du rgya'i hwa shang la sogs pas bsam 825

gtan byed/ brda sprod tshangs pa'i gling du brda sbyor/ bai ro tsa na'i gling du chos 'chad/ dkor mdzod be har gling du nor bzhag go/ /khams yan chad du chos grwa chen po bcu gnyis btsugs/ yer ba dang mchims phur sgom grwa btsugs/ rgya'i hwa shang ma ko la spyan drangs nas sba rad na zhes pas shes rab 'bum pa thog mar bsgyur/ bran ka legs/ lha lung / klu gong / dbus gong / chung bo rtse sogs kyis rgya nag gi lo tsā byas so/ /gzhan yar rgya gar gyi slob dpon bi ma la mi tra dang / sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / shan ta gar bha dang / bi shud dhu sing ha la sogs pa dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba sad mi mi bdun dang / chos kyi snang ba dngaci/ ban de nam mkha' dang / sgron rin chen sde/rnam par mi rtog pa/ shākya 'od la sogs pas lo tsā byas te/ rgya gar dang / rgya nag kha che za hor li yul sogs nas bka' bstan bcos shin tu mang bo bsgyur/ de ltar chos bsgyur ba'i stabs kyisawā rig pa rab tu dar te/ mkhas pa mang du byung zhing rgyal blon sogs kyis bstan bcos mang du brtsams/ 'ga' zhig deng sang bstan 'gyur khrod du bzhugs so/ / de rjes mu ne btsan po'i dus su/ dbul phyug lan gsum snyoms par mdzad/ lha sa/ khra 'brug bsam yas rnams su 826

mchod pa chen po btsugs shing / paṇa ḍi ta dang / lo tsā ba dang / dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur mdzad/ de ltagasngar yab mes kyi dus bzhin dam pa'i chos sogs bsgyur zhing spel bar mdzad de chos dang sgra rig pa dar zhing rgyas so/ / khri lde srong btsan sad na legs mjing yon gyi dus bsam yas la zhig gso dang / bsam yas sogs gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod pa byed/ bar skabs su cung zad nyams pa slar gsos/ skyid shod du dkar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs/ paṇa ḍi ta bi ma la mi tra/ dzñā na se na/ bal bo r+ghaṃ ka ra/ pradzñā d+marma/ shākya seng ha/ su ren dra bo rnyi/ dzi na mi tra/ da na shi la/ bud dha sing ha sogs spyan drangs/ sngar gyi lo tsā ba rnams la bsgren bkur chen po byas te/ mtshan nyid dang / gsang sngags kyi bka' bstan bcos mang bo bsgyur/ mib’mes kyi dus bzhin byed dgos pa'i thugs dam bzhes te/ dbu snyung bor nas bka' gtsigs kyi yi ge snga phyi shog gu mthing ga la gser gyis bris te/ rin po che khra men gyi sgrom du bcug nas bsam yas kyi yab khri srong gi bka' gtsigs chen mo'i 'gram du bzhag go/ /rgyal bo 'di'i dus su'ang chos dang rig gnas shin tu dar la/ chab srid kyang bla na med par gyur/ dkar 8lha7

chag 'phang thang ma dang / dkar chag ldan dkar gnyis kyang rgyal bo 'di'i ring la bzhengs par gsungs so/ /de rjes khri gtsug lde btsan ral ba can gyi ring la 'u shang rdo'i dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/paṇa ḍi ta dang lo tsā ba rnams gtsug lag khang du bzhugs nas/mtshan nyid dang sngags kyi bka' dang bstan bcos mang bo bsgyur cing 'chad rtsom gyis dus 'da' bar byas/ sngar yab mes kyi ring la chos dang rig gnas kyi brda skad bod la ma grags pa mang bo zhig byung zhing / rgya nag dang li dang bal bo rgya gar yul dbus dang kha che za hor sogs yul du ma nas bsgyur ba'i brda mi 'dra ba dag mang bos mi go zhing bslab dka' bar gzigs nas/ drin can lo paṇa rnam gsum zhes grags pa dzi na mi tra dang / da na shi la dang / zhang ye shes sde gsum sogs lo paṇa rnams kyis/ sngar bsgyur ba thams cad dag par byas shing skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab ste go bde bar byas/ gzhung tshad rnams bam grangs kyis nges par byas te/ dkar chag tu bsnan nas/ sngar gyi dkar chag gsum gyi zla la bzhag 'di la skad gsar bcad gnyis pa zhes/ smra ba rgyan gyi me tog ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa las bshad do/ /skad gsar bcad kyi skabasdo lo paṇa rnams 828

kyis bye brag rtogs byed che 'bring chung gsum mdzad/ de'i tshul ni sgra sbyor bam gnyis kyi sa bcad gsum par yod pa/ yongs rdzogs bdag gis bod du rig gnas dar tshul mdor bsdus zhes bya ba'i nang du drangs yod/ 'on kyang sgra sbyor bam gnyis su khri lde srong btsan zhes pa yig nor yin te/ khri gtsug lde btsan zer dgos so/ /de ltar khri gtsag lde btsan ral ba can gyi dus su ༄chos srid gnyis ka shin tu dar/ chos dar ba'i stobs kyis sgra rig pa shin tu dar ba de ltar lags te/ sgra sbyor bam gnyis las/ chos kyi gzhung dang sgra'i lugs las ji skad du 'byung ba'i gtan tshigs dang / chos la ji skad du gdags pa dpyad de/zhes gsungs so/ /de rjes blon gdug pa can dbas stag sna can sogs kyis rgyal bo dang / blon bran ka dpal yon bkrongs nas/ glang dar ma 'u dum btsan rgyal sar bzhag 'di ni chung dus nas gzugs ba lang gi sha tshugs dang 'dra zhing / blo rtul rgyud gyong bas 'bangs rnams kyis glang dar ma zhes btags/ ming dngos ni 'u dum btsan zer/ rgya'i lo rgyus rkergya yig rgya'i lo tsā ba hu gyang ju zer bas bod yig tu bsgyur ba las/ rgyal bo 'di chang la dga' zhing spyod pa ngan pas/ bod kyi rgyal /bams thams cad 'khrugs/ si ha ce'u la bod dbang ba'i ri brtsigs yod pa — 829

'gyel/ klu chujizhag gsum gyen la log ltas ngan rgyung zhing rgyal khams zhig pa yin no/ /zhes bshad do/ /de nas glang dar kho rang yang rmongs shing yon tan med par ma zad/ yon tan can la snying nas sdi dga' bas/ chos byas pa bkra mi shis zer nas/rma rin chen mchog dang nyang ting 'dzin sogs lo tsā ba mang bo bkrongs/ paṇa ḍi ta rnams sa mthar bskrad pa dang rang rang so so'i yul du bros/ rab tu byung ba la la sa mthar bros/ ma thar ba rnams khyim sar phab/ mi nyan pa rnams bsad/ la la khrid nas rgyal blon rnams kyis rta la 'bab 'dzeg gi tshe sgur du bcug nas stegs byas/ la la'i lag tu mda' gzhu dang rnga gshang bzhagatsāste rngon pa byed du bcug lha sa dang bsam yas bshas ra byas/ gtsug lag khang mang bo bshigs/ dpe cha rnams me la bsregs pa dang chu la bskur ba dang sa 'og tu gnon pa sogs byaso/ 'bangs rnams 'tsho ba'ang je sdug je sdug la song /bod 'bangs rnams sdug bsngal gyi gnas su bcar to/ /yon ton can thams cad med par byas/ bod rang gi brda sprod pa dang sgra rig pa'i skor gtan nyams byas so/ /'ga' zhig gis mar le dngos gtso rtsod sgrub kyi rig pa smra ba yin khul gyis sna tshogs smra ba dang / chos bsnubs pa ni dmag don gyi 'gro song las 830

chos kyi 'gro song che ba'i stabs kyis red zer ba sogs btang snyoms su bzhag go/ /glang dar gyi sras rtsod med 'od srung sde dang / sras dogs pa can yum brtan sde gnyis rgyal sar su 'jog blon po rna mas ma mthun zhing phyogs gnyis su chad de/ 'od srung rgyal sar bzhag spyang yum brtan gyis dbu ru bzung / 'od srung gis g.yo ru bzung ste 'khrug pa byas/ gzhan yang yab glang dar gyi durtswa 'bangs gnon btsir dang / khral 'u lag sogs dang /'bangs kyi 'tsho ba'ang je sdug je sdug song stabs bod 'bangs— yongs mi dga' bar gyur/ sras gnyis kyis kyang yab4kyi byed tshul nor bar shes nas/ jo bo rnam gnyis dang byams pa cho sa kyi— 'khor lo gdan drangs nas khri khar bzhag 'on kyang rig gan sa dang chos slar gso byed ma thub/ 'bangs gyen log byung ste kheng log thog ma mdo khams nas byung / 'od srung dgung lo so gcig thog stagi rtse gnyags kyis bkrongs/ de'i sras bkra shis brtsegs pha dpal dang / skyid lde nyi ma mgon gnyis mnga' ris —su song / de gnyis spyod pa bzang zhing blo gros che bas mnga' ris kyi rgyal bor rī gyur/ de dag gi rgyud pa mnga' ris rgyal bo rnams kyis stod kyi sa mtshams legs par bsnyangs te/ gar log bal bo/ rgya 03/—

gar sogs btsan 'dzu la bkag nas stod kyi sa mtshams brtan —por bsrungs/ gzhan yang / khri bkra shis brtsegs pa'i sras 'bring ba 'od lde la srasad+kuzhi byung ba'i gnyis pa khri lde 'bangs bra sde dang bcas pa mtsho khri shor rgyal mo'i khar byon te gzhi bzung / tsong kha'i rgyal bo zhes pa'i rgyal bo stobs ldan du gyur te kan su'u hra'an zhi yan chod mnga' 'og tu bsdus te smad kyi sa mtshams brtan por bsrungs/ bod dbus sil bur thor yang / stod smad kyi rgyal bo de gnyis kyis chos dang rig gnas slar gso bar mdzad/dper na/ stod kyi mnga' ris rgyal bo lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis tho lding gi dpe med lhun 'grub gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgya gar shar phyogs nas paṇa ḍi ta r+harma pā la dang / de'i mkhan bu sā rnyu bā la/ gu na pū la/ pradzñā pū la ste pā la rnam gsum du grags pa spyan drangs chos dang rig gnas zhus/ zhang zhung ba rgyal ba'i shes rab kyis paṇa ḍi ta mang bo bsten te sgra dang skad yig sogs la sbyangs pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ phyis su khong ne pa la ste bal yul du phebs nas 'dul ba'i lag len sogs chos dang rig gnas du ma bslabs/ gzhan yang lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rin chen bzang bo la sogs pa'i byis pa nyi shu rtsa gcig slob gnyer la 83lha

btang ba las rin chen bzang bo dang / legs pa'i shes rab / lo chung grags 'byor gsum ma gtogs gzhan rnams sa ma thub par shi/ lo tsā ba rin bzang bo dgung lo dgu bcu go brgyad la bzhugs/ slob ma zhus chen pher ba'i lo tsā ba bcu lhag byung /khong gi slob ma rnams kyis rig gzhung mang skebo bsgyur/ lo tsā ba chen po blo ldan shes rab kyis rig gzhung 'bum phrag mang bo bsgyur/ dag yig brtsams/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus su/ paṇa ḍi ta skṛ ti dang / phra la ring ba gnyis byon/ smṛ tis gzhung bshad mang bo dang gdan bzhi sogs bsgyur/ smra sgo mtshon cha brtsams/ rgyal ba 'brom ston pas kyang 'di ba'i mdun nas sgra bslabs/ de skabs 'brog mi lho bal du lo bcu gsum la bzhugs nas paṇa ḍi ta mang bo bsten te slob gnyer gnang / bod du phebs nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa 'chad spel gnang / mar ba lo tsā bas 'di ba'i mdun nas sgra bslabs/slob ma shin tu mang / rnying ma'i zur chen dang / sa skya 'debs pa bo 'khon dkon mchog rgyal bo sogs so/ /mnga' ris kyi lha bla ma khu dbon gyi dus rgya gar sogs nas paṇa ḍi ta mang bo spyan drangs/ khyad par du dpal mnyam med jo bo ji dpal ldan a ti sha mar me mdzad dpal ye shes spyan drangs pa sogs shin tu — 833

grags che zhing phyag rjes rlabs che/ jo bo rje'i slob ma grags che ba ni/ gtsang na 'gar 'gos yol gsum/ dbus na bu rngog 'brom gsum/ gtso bo 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis rwa sgrong chos sde btab/ bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ slob ma bka' gdams sku mched gsum sogs shin tu mang / khu ston brtsona'agrus g.yung drung gis kyang thang bo cher bzhugs nas slob ma shin tu mang bo bskyangs/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis gsang phu ne'u thog gi dgon pa btab/ de'i dbon po'am tsha bu ni rngog lo blo ldan shes rab bo /jo bo'i slob ma gtsang smad rta nag gi 'gos lo tsā ba 'gos khug pa lhas btsas ni rgya bal du lan bcu gnyis byon lo mang bor bzhugs/ paṇa ḍi ta bdun cu don gnyis bsten te gdams pa mang bo gsan/ bod du byon nas zhal gzigs ri khrod du gsang 'dus bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs shing / mkhas grub nyis 'dzoms kyi 'phags chen du gyur/ 'dus pa sogs dar bar mdzad/gsang 'dus kyi rgyud 'grel chen mo sogs gsung rtsom mang / slob ma mdar seng rgyan sogs drug stod lung gnam gyi rdzong kha ba dang yol mched gsum sogs mang la/ sa skya ba 'khon dkon mchog rgyal bos kyang bla mar bsten nas gsad 'dus skor sogs gsan/byi34

rdog rabs kyi gsang 'dus grub thob rnamasajikyang 'di ba'i slob rgyud yin/ rje bdag nyid chen pos kyang rje red mda' ba'i mdun nas 'gos lugs kyi gsang 'dus kyi dbang sogs gsan/ tshos skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis/ sgra 'jugardzosgra nye bar bsdu ba/ sdeb sbyor me tog chun po/ tshig gter sogs brtsams te sgra'i skor la'ang 'chad nyan mang du mdzad/shong ston lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan ni/ bal yul du byon nas paṇa ḍi ta ma hen dra bha dra lo lngar bsten nas rig gnas du ma bslabs/ khyed par du sgra rig pa la shin tu mkhas par sbyangs/rig gnas mang bo 'chad spel mdzad pa dang / gzhung mang bo bsgyur/ chag dgra bcom dang de'i dbon chag chos rje dpal gnyis kyang rgya gar du byon/ paṇa ḍi ta mang bo bsten nag slob gnyer gnang / gsar 'gyur dang 'gyur bcos mang bo mdzad/bka' drin che bar brtsi/ snyan grags che/gzhan bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa sogs sgra rig pa'i skor la bka' drin che ba'i mkhas pa ches shin tu mang bo byung ba rnams brjod kyis mi lang / thams cad kyang chos kyi bla ma mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa sha stag yinari no/ /bcom ldan rigs ral gyis ma dzad pa'i sgra'i bstan bcos smra ba rgyan gyi me tog ngag gi dbadz+wa 835

phyug grub pa zhes bya ba las/ bkas bcad gsum pa ni/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus kyi sgra bsgyur rin chen bzang bo nas bzung ste kho bo'i bla ma mchog lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal yan chad kyis byas pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skad gsar bcad gsum de ltar yin no/ / gzhan yang / dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa/ thar ba lo tsā ba/ lo tsā ba byang chub rtse mo/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ shong blo gros brtan pa/ yar lung grags pa rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal(sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal yang zero)/ snar thang lo tsā ba saṃ snya thi/ zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang bo(dag yig za ma tog rtsom pa bo) / skyogs ston lo tsā ba ngag dbang rin chen ba kra shis/ 'di ba'i mtshan la smin grub lo tsā ba yang zer la/ li shi'i gur khang rtsom pa bo red/ lo chen skyabs mchog dpal/ stag lo shes rab rin chen/ rje bdag nyid chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis/ lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang bo las snyan ngag bslabs/ bo dong ba rin chen zham bzang ba las sgra ka lnga pa dang / tsan dra ba ngang / sdeb sbyor sogs bslabs/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen sogs las kyang sgra gsan te dar spel mdzad do/ / rī836

jo nang kun dga' grol mchog gi sprul sku rje tā ra na tha ste sgrol ba'i mgon po mchog gis kyang 'phags yul nas phebs pa'i paṇa ḍi ta kha shas bsten nas dbyangs can sgra mdo rtsa 'grel bsgyur rtsom gnang ba de la tā ra na tha'i sgra ṭīka zhes grags che/ kun gzigs lnga ba chen pos sgra'i slob dpon sde ba zhang mkhar ba 'jam dpal/ rin po che sman lung ba/ mang yul lo tsā ba/ mon gro ba yab sras rnams bsten nas sgra rig pa la sbyangs/ mon gro ba la rig gnas rgya mtsho'i phreng ba 'dzin pa mon gro ba yab sras zhes bsngags brjod cher mdzad/ mo na gro ba ni sngar jo nang dgon gyi grwa ba yin la/ phyis su dgon pa nas bud de rig gnas sogs la sbyangs pas mkhas grags che/ smin gling gter gyi gcung lo chen snyarma shrī bya ba mkhas grags che la sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyi 'grel ba rmad du byung ba brtsams/ kun gzigs lnga ba chen po'i 'phrin las la brten nas/ 'dar lo ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun 'grub kyis dbyangs can sgra mdo rtsa 'grel bsgyur ba dang / pa ṇi ba'i 'grel chen brtsams/ karmarisi tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis ka tsan dbyangs gsum sogs rig gnas skor mang bo bsgyur/ 'di bas bsgyur ba rnams khong gi gsung 'bum khrod du bzhugs/ kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs 837

bzhad pa'i rdo rjes ka lā pa'i 'grel chen nag po 'gro shos brtsamasapa dang / pa ṇi ba'irimachan 'grel dang / mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod 'gyur bcos gnang ba sogs sgra'i skor kyang du ma mdzad/kun mkhye na 'jigs med dbang bos kyang sgra sogs rig gnas skor dar spel mdzad par bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du paṇa ḍi ta mang bo byung ste/ rje shes rab rgya mtsho dang / brag dgon bstan pa rab rgyas sogs dge bshes mang bo'i sgra'i zin bris yod la/ kha sha sa kyi zin bris phyogs bsdus byas pa sgra mchan chen mo ni/ bdag gis snum par brgyab pa lta bu mang / bdag gi slob dpon rin po che oṃ 'khyil ba 'a jam dbyangs legs bshad dpal bzang bos dbyangs can sgra mdo'i byings sgrub dang / shan sbyar kā li'i phreng sgrig sogs brtsams pa yin la/ bdag gis gros mgo bton pa bzhin 'di ga'i bod rigs rang skyong khul bod yig rtsom sgyur cu sa kyis saṃ bod shan sbyar bsgrigs par byas so/ /de ltar sngon gyi mkhas grub rnams kyis sgra rig pa la shin tu don gnyer byas pa ltar/ rang cag rnams kyis kyang rig gnas 'di la don gnyer byed rigs te/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ sgra la sbyangs pa mthar son pa na rigs lam spyi daji gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i don phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa yin te/838
