sgra shes—na don la mi rmongs zhes bya ba bod blun rnams kyis phyi jig gnas/ nang mdo rgyud gang la'ang bod skad rkyang ba'i steng nas go ba btsal te 'bru gnyer zhing rang nyid kyis kyang don gyi phyogs tsam ma rtogs par skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang bo rnams la dgag sgrub phyin ci log tu byas nas rang gi blo gros kyi mthil zang mar ston pa'i snyigs dus kyi 'chad nyan dang thos bsam gyi spyi srol de ltar ma yin par/ zhes gsungs pa dang / yang de las/ deng sang gi dus 'dir phal mo ches legs sbyar ni chos bsgyur rgyu yod na ma gtogs ha cang mi mkho zer ba'am/ lung la thos bsam byed pa la shes brtson gyi sbyor ba gzhan yod pas chog gi legs sbyar shes ma shes med zer ba sogs mang du snang ba ni tshong 'dus su ras pa'i rnam thar 'khrab pa ltar phyugs dang mtshungs pa'i blun po'i dbus su log rtog la zhen pa'i blun po dag 'dug ste mig ma tshang ba'i ngo gnong med par lag pa yod pa'i mtshang 'bru brjod pa na blun po gzhan rnams kyis kyang de de bzhin no zhes the tshom tsam yang med par yid ches pas sgrogs pa ni snyigs dus kyis bslad pa'i bod rgan mang bo'i rang rtags te/ dper na bong bus phub ma kho na za ba la rgyu mtshan ci yangartemed pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ deng dus lhag par mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa rnams khya39

su/ mtshan nyid shes na rig gnas shes ma shes med zer ba dang /slob grwa 'ga' zhig gi nang du 'ga' zhig gis sgra shes ma shes med rgya yig dang dbyin yig shes dgos zer ba dag gis bod kyi rig gnas kyi 'byung r+ṣangs dang / de'i yon tan ma shes pa red snyam mo 'dir smras pa/ rmongs pa'i smag chen 'thib pa'i gangs ljongs 'dir/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang srong btsan sgam po yis/ /'phrin las 'od dkar zegs ma 'bum spros pas/ /rmongs mun lhag med bcom pa'i dga' ston dar/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i ye shes 'od rnon las/ /'jam dbyangs thon mi'i 'od snang 'bum shar te/ /bod yul rmongs pa'i rgud pa kun bsal nas/ /chos dang srid kyi lo 'bras g.yur du za/ /de lta'i byung ba brjod ba'i gling bu'i sgra/ /skal mnyam rgan po'i skyo ba sangs byed du/ /'bul lo nyan byed gtad nas nyan par zhu/ /phrag dog can rnams ca co'i dbyangs mdzod cig /ces pa bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa gtan tshigs rig pa dar tshul ni/ spyir gtan tshigs rig—pa ni/ phyi rol rig byed pa sogs la sngon nas dar ba ste/ dper na rtog ge'i tshig don bcu drug ston pa'i gtan tshigs 840

ris/ pa'i gzhung yod mod/ de dag ni don med don log snon dang ldan/ /thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bya rog so rtog gi bstan bcos lta bu don med pa dang / bdag shes rig gi skyes bu dang / spyi gtso bo sgrub pa lta bu'i don log pa dang / thos rgya che ba tsam gyi ched dang / gzhan la rtsod pa tsam gyi ched yin pa las ldog ste/ nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i gtan tshigs rig pa ni/ skye dgu mtha' dag sdug bsngal las grol ba'i ched yin pas don dang ldan pa dang / de'i don du lam sgrub pa lhur len pa'i khyad par gnyis ldan la/ de lta bu'i khyad par gnyis ldan gyi gtan tshigs rig pa ni thub ba sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis sde snod kyi nang du thor bur gsungs pa/ dper na mngon pa'i sde snod kyi nang du sdug bden mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba'i rigs sogs mi rtag bcu drug sgrub pa'i rigs pa lta bu mang la/ de bzhin mgon po klu sgrub yab sras kyi gzhung rig tshogs kyi skabs su chos rnams kyi chos nyid gtan tshigs rig pa'i sgo nas bam+mubs pa yin/ rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang de'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa ste/ thal 'gyur dang sbyor ngag sun 'byin sogs kyis dgag sgrub byas pa lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du 'phags pa thogs med yab sras kyis gtan tshigs rig pa'i sgo nas phyi don med par 841

gtan la phab ste/ sems tsam pa'i grub mtha'i rkang btsugs pa dang / bye mdo gnyis kyi grub mtha' la dgag pa btang ba sogs gtan tshigs rig pa ni rang rang gi grub mtha'i dgag bzhag gi mtshon cha lta bur byas so/ /'on kyang tshad ma'i gzhung lugs kyi rkang 'dzugs mkhan ni slob dpon dbyig gnyen la slob ma rang las mkhas pa bzhi yod pa'i nang gi tshad ma rang las mkhas pa slob dpordzon phyogs kyi glang bo de nyid yin la khong gis rigs sgo sogs tshad ma'i gzhung brgya rtsa gsungs shing phyis su de rnams kyi rigs lam phyogs gcig bsdus pa/ tshad ma kun 'dus sam tshad ma mdo zhes bya ba brtsams/ de rjes phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i mkhas pa chen po cho sa kyi grags pas tshad ma sde bdun zhes yongasasu grags pa de nyid mdzad/ de dag ni lo tsā ba chen po dge slong dge ba'i blo gros dang / rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab sogs lo tsā ba mkhas pa mang bos bsgyur ba'i tshad ma'i gzhung ni/ sde dge'i bstan 'gyur gyi (ce)ba la slob dpon phyogs kyi glang bos mdzad pa'i tshad ma kun las btus pa sogs le tshan bcu phrag lhag dang / (che )ba la rnam 'grel rang 'grel dang / lha dbang blo'i 'grel ba gnyis/ (je nye)gnyis la tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel bshad dang / lha dbang blo'i 'grel ba'i 'gel bshad 44ཿ

gnyis/ (te the)gnyisajil tshadad+ku rnam 'gril gyi li'u gnyis pajiman chad kyi 'grel ba rnam 'grel gyi rgyan zhes bya ba/ (de ne)gnyis la tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rgyan gyi 'grel bshad rgyal ba can gyis mdzad pa/ (pe)ba la rnam 'grel gyi 'grel bshad bram ze bde byed dga' bas mdzad pa dang le'u gnyis pa'i 'grel ba nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa gnyis/ (phe be)gnyis la tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel ba las/ le'u gsum pa'i bshad pa nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rgyan gyi 'grel bshad mkhas pa dza mā ris mdzad pa gnyis/ (me)ba la tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi mngon gsum le'u'i 'grel ba dza mā ris mdzad pa/ (tse)ba tso rnam 'grel gyi rgyan gyi le'u bzhi ba'i 'grel ba dza mā ris mdzad pa/ (tshe)ba la slob dpon chos mchog gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma rnam nges kyi 'grel ba 'thad ldan zhes bya ba dang / tshad ma rnam nges kyi 'grel bshad slob dpon ye shes bzang bos mdzad pa dang gnyis/(dze)ba la chos mchog gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma rnam nges kyi ṭī ka'i 'grel bshad le'u gnyis pa'i 'grel ba 'gyur byang med pa/ (we)ba la rigs thigs kyi rgya cher 'grel slob dpon dul ba lhas mdzad pa dang / rigs thigs rgya cher 'grel slob dpon chos mchog gis mdzad pa/ rigs thigs kyi phyogs snga mdor bsdus 843

slob dpon ka ma la shī lasardzimadzod pa/ rigs thigs kyi don bsdus mkhan po dzi na mi tras mdzad pa/ gtan tshigs thigs pa'i rgya cher 'a grel dul ba lhas mdzad pa rnams so/ /(zhe)ba la 'brel ba brtag pa'i rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon dul ba lhas mdzad pa dang / 'brel ba brtag pa'i rjes 'brang zhes bya ba bram ze shaṅka rā nardos mdzad pa/ rgyud gzhan grub pa'i 'grel bshad slob dpon dul ba lhas mdzad pa/ rtsod pa'i rigs pa'i 'grel ba don rnam par 'byed pa slob dpon chen po shān+ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ rtsod pa'i rigs pa'i 'grel ba slob dpon dul ba lhas mdzad pa gsham ma tshang ba gcig dmigs pa brtag pa'i rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon chen po dul ba lhas mdzad pa/ rigs pa grub pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang / phyi rol gyi don grub pa zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon dge spungs kyis mdzad pa/ thos pa brtag pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang / gzhan sel brtag pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ dbang phyug 'jig pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa rnams slob dpon dge srungs kyis mdzad pa/ tshad ma brtag pa che chung slob dpon chos mchog gis mdzad pa/ gzhan sel zhes bya ba'i rab byed chos mchog gis 844

mdzad pa/ 'jig rten pha rol grub pa slob dpon sngos mchog girtswamadzad pa/ glegs bam bklag pa'i thabs paṇa ḍi ta dā na shrī las rang 'gyur mdzad pa/ skad cig ma 'jig par grub pa slob dpon chos mchog gis mdzad pa/ skad cig ma 'jig par grub pa'i rnam par 'grel ba slob dpon bramaphre mu tig bum pas mdzad pa/ lhan cig dmigs pa nges par grub pa ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ sel ba grub pa zhes bya ba dge bsnyen dam pa mkhas pa chen po bram ze shaṅka rā nardos mdzad pa/ 'grel ba grub pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po shaṅka rā nan+das mdzad pa/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i ngo bo grub pa dzñā na shrī mi tras mdzad pa/ rnam par rig pa nyid du grub pa rin—chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ nang gi khyab pa rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ gtan tshigs kyi de kho na nyid bstan pa dzi tā ris mdzad pa/ chos dang chos can gtan la phab pa rdo tā ris mdzad pa/ byis pa 'jug pa'i rtog ge dgra las rgyal bas mdzad pa/ rtog ge'i skad dge slong thar ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ rigs pa'i sbyor ba kha che'i grub brnyes slob dpon chen po rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams so/ /(ze 'e)gnyis la de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon zhi 'tshos mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i dka' 'grel 845

slob dpon chen po ka ma la shī las mdzad pa gnyis so/ /(ye)ba la yangs pa dang dri ma med pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i tshad ma kun las btus kyi 'grel bshad slob dpon rgyal ba'i dbang bo blon po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar tshad ma rig pa'i skor la bod chen po nyi shu le tshan brgya phrag longs pa rnams paṇ+ḍi ta dang lo tsā ba sku drin can rnams kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab nas bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis/ de dag la sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad par ma zad dgongs 'grel gyi gzhung mang bo brtsams so/ /sa skya'i gdan sar sa skya paṇa chen gyis rigs gter gsungs/ de la sbyangayopa'i mkhas pa mang bo byung bciyin la/dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po nas tshad ma sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen ches mang bo la mkhas pa'i mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta mang bo byung ste/ dkar bo rnam gsum/ dmar bo rnam gnyis/ g.yag gzhon rnam gnyis/ rje yab sras gsum sogs byung ba dang /gtsang bde gung gsum/ dga' skyor zil gsum sogs kyi grwa sa rnams su tshad ma sogs shin tu dar te/ cha ba chos kyi seṅge gtsang no'u thog gi gdan sar lo bco brgyad du bzhugs nas/ tshad ma sogs shin tu dar bar byas te/ chad ma'i rigs pa phyogs bsdus kyi bsdus grwa'i srol btod/ slob ma rigs pa'i seng chen brgyad 846

dang / jo sras bzhi sogs mang bo 'byung / dpal mnyam med ri bo dge lugs pa'i bstan pa dar nas se 'bras dge gsum — sogs su shin tu dar/ rje bdag nyid ts+tshan pos sde bdun yid kyi mun sel dang / rgyal tshab rjes thar lam gsal byed/ mkhas grub rjes ṭīka chen rigs pa'i rgya mtsho dang spyi don sde bdun yid kyi mun sel/ rje dge 'dun grub kyis spyi don rigs rgyan/ stag tshang ra ba stod pa'i dge bshes dag gis ra stod bsdus grwa/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas bsdus grwa'i rtsa tshig dang / bsdus gzhung che chung rnam 'grel le'u gsum gyi mtha' dpyod/ bswe ngag dbang bkra shis kyi bswe bsdus grwa dang rtags rigs rang lugs rka sogs/ mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtshos bsdus gzhung chen mo brtsams pa sogs thams cad brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /phyis su mdo stod smad du nang bstan dar nas bzung tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung mang bo dar te/ dper na/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du mdo sngags rig gnas kun dar nas bsdus grwa sogs rtsom mkhan mang bo byung / de ltar mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa rnams su tshad ma rig pa'i 'chad nyan shin tu dar te/ de ltar dam pa chos kyi dgon sde rnams med na/ rig gnas che ba lnga'i ya gyal tshad ma 'di yod thabs med do/ / 847

'dir smras pa/ de ltar mkhas dbang gser gyi ri bo yis/ /rigs pa'i rang mdangs 'bum gyi 'od spros te/ /log smra 'byung bo'i bya rnams long bar byas/ /shes bya'i gnas lugs gsal ler mthong brngo byas/ /gangs ljongs rigs pa smra ba 'bum phrag gi/ /blo gros nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od shar tshe/ /rig gzhung chu skyes gzhon nu'i 'dzum mdangos rgyas/ /bde skyid sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston lhug par stsol/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i rig gnas gnyis kyi dang bo bzo rig pa ni/ spyir bzo rig pa khang bzo shing bzo sogs dkyus ma tsam zhig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ma dar ba'i sngon nas yod mod/bzo las cher dar ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba nas yin te/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus nas bzung ste rim bzhin dar ba yin te/ de nas lha'i thig rtsa/ mchod rten gyi thig rtsa/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig rtsa/ yi ge'i thig rtsa sogs dar ba yin/ dper na ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dang /mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang sogs kyi bzo las kyi lag rtsal dar ba dang / de dag gi nang rten sku gzugs dang mchod rten sogs bzhengs pa'i lag rtsal gyi bzo las dar ba dang / bal 848

bza' khri btsun gyis dmar bo'i rir pho brang dgu thog lcags re dang bcas pa bzhengs pa lta bu dar rgyas che ba byung / lha khang dag la gser zangs kyi rgya phibs bzo ba'i bzo las dar bar brten/gser dngul zangs lcags kyi bzo las dar ba dang / lha khang dag la shing brkos rdo brkos mdzes rgyan dar bar brten shing brkos dang rdo brkos kyi lag rtsal ches legs par dar ba dang /mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi gsung rtsom dang / bka' bstan 'gyur sogs kyi shing par rko ba'i rig pa phun sum tshogs pa dar zhing rgyas/ de ltar mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis rgya dkar nag li dang bal bo kha che sogs kyi bzo las kyi rigs mang bo bsgyur nas dar bar byas te/ dper na/ bstan 'gyur gyi (ngo)pod kyi nang du dngul chu grub pa'i bstan bcos dang / gser 'gyur gyi bstan bcos/ mchod rten gyi mtshan nyid/ spos sbyor gyi bstan bcos sogs le tshan nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod de/ bzo rig bstan bcos phyogs mthun bcas pa'i gzhung / /bcu phrag gnyis la gnyis kyis brgyan par bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lha bzo ba'i thig rtsa dang lag rtsal ni/ dbus thang dang / karma sgar bris dang / reb gong gi lha ris gser rtsi dang tshon 'dul ba'i gdams pa khyad 'phags dang / gos sku bzhengs drub sog/ sa da rte 'ang dar 349

gyis su yod/ — rgyal rong yul gyi lha ris pa dang darngul bzo sogs kyi rgyun da lta'ang yod/ dad ldan dag gis lha khang gtsug lag khang mang bo bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis/ phyi'i rtsig pa rdo rtsig dang /nang gi shing gi ka gdung rgyan bcas bzos stabs rim gyis de dag gi lag rtsal dar zhing rgyas par gyur/ der brten mi ser mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho'i rigs bzo ba'i rig pa yang dar te snam phrug ther ras/ sa gdan phying gdan pag sa tshar/ko rtsid sogs kyi lag shes bzo las dar te/ deng sang yang ras gos rigs ma gtogs/ gtso cher lag shes bzo las de dag la brten pa yin/ dam pa'i chos dar sar bzo las kyang dar zhing rgyas par yod do/ / — gnyis pa gso ba rig pa ni/ sngar lha tho tho ri'i dus su rgya gar gyi sman pa bi byi dga' byed dang / bi lha dga' mdzes gnyis bod rdu byon nas gso dpyad sman gyi rig pa spel mod/ de skabs bod rang skad kyi yi ge 'bri ba'i srol ma byung gshis/ legs sbyar gyi yi ge dang / mi rigs gzhan gyi yi ge'i steng nas spel mod /bod rang gi yi ge 'bri ba'i srol yod pa'i dus rim bzhin dar khyab po ma byung bar mngon/ khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su mkhan slob chos gsum gyis dam pa'i chos rab tu dar bar 850

mdzad/ der brten sad mi mi bdun sogs dge slong mkhas pa mang du byon nas/ rgya gar bal bo sogs su phebs te chos mang bo bsgyur ba dang / de'i zhor la sman rtsis sogs kyi gzhung mang bo bsgyur/ bstan pa snga dar la lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na sogs dang / ka cog zhang gsum sogs dang phyi dar gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang bo sogs kyis byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas bslangs te/ gso rig gi gzhung sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa sogs sman gzhung mang bo bod skad du bsgyur te/ bstan 'gyur du bzhugs pa sde dge'i bstan 'gyur gyi (he)ba'i nang du sbyor ba brgya ba sogs sman gzhung lnga dang / (e)ba'i nang du yan lag brgyad pa'i rang 'grel du grags pa'i yan lag brgyad pa'i snying bo zhes bya ba'i gzhung chen mo dang / (ko)(kho)(go)ste pod gsum gyi nang du —yan lag brgyad pa'i snying bo rnam par 'grel ba tshig gi don gyi zla zer zhes bya ba sogs sman gyi skor la pod chen po lnga dang gzhung tshan bdun yod pa rnams kyang chos lugs la mkhas shing sbyangs pa'i dge slong paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis bsgyur ba yin no/ /khyad par du sde snod gsum dang gsang sngags zab mo sbyangs shing bsgrubs pas grub pa thob pa'i g.yu thog yon tan mgon po mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis/ sman dang rtsis kyi gzhung du ma brtsams 851

shing / slob ma stong phrag mang bo skyed bsrings te bod yul sogs su nad kyis nyen pa 'bum phrag mang bo nad las thar bar byas pa dang mnyam du dam pa'i chos kyis 'gro ba rnams rnam grol thar ba'i lam la bkod do/ /sman gzhung chen mo rgyud bzhi cha lag dang bcayopa brtsams pa/ deng sang sman pa rnams gzhung 'di kho na la brten par snang /bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs suskegayu thog yon tan mgon po gsar ma zhes bya ba byung nas/ gsang sngags gsar rnying la sbyangs shing grub pa thob ste g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos rnying ma'i chos rgyun bskyangs te/ sman rtsis kyi gzhung mang bo brtsams/ sman gzhung rgyud bzhi cha lag dang bcas pa dar spel gnang ste gso rig dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ g.yu thog gsar rnying gi rnam thar bdag gis logs su bris yod pas 'dir mi spro'o/ /sman pa mkhas pa de dag gi rjes 'brangs mkhas pa mang du 'byung ba las shin tu grags che ba ni byang bdag rnam rgyal grags bzang dang / zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rje gnyis la byang zur rnam gnyis zhes grags/ sman gzhung mang bo brtsams// de gnyis kyi rgyud 'dzin mkhas pa mang du byung / kun gzigs lnga ba chen po'i dus/ dar mo sman rams pas rgyud kyi 'grel ba dang / sman ngag bka' rgya 852

ma sogs brtsams/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bai sngon dang /man ngag lhan thabs sman gyi khog dbug brtsams pa sogasporkin tu mang bas brjod kyis mi lang / gzhan yang lcags po rir sman pa grwa tshang yod pa dang / sku 'bum byams pa gling dang / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil sogs su'ang sman pa grwa tshang yod pa sogs sman dpyad dar zhing rgyas pa'ang chos lugs dang 'brel ba kho na'o/ /rig gnas che ba lnga'i ya gyal bdag nyid kun shes par byed pa'i nang donadzirig pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong / de tshur bsdus na gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis/ de tshur bsdus na sde snod gsum gyi nang du 'du bas/ de dag gi dgongs pa 'phags yul gyi rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs paṇa grub rnams kyis legs par gtan la phab pa bzhin/ bod 'dir bka' pod chen po lnga'i nang du bsdus nas mdo phyogs la sbyangs pa mthar phyin nas sngags phyogs la sbyang bar byed pa'i srol da lta'i bar du grwa sa chen po rnams su yod pa 'di la gas so/ /rig gnas chung ba lnga'i dang bo snyan ngag ni/ grong tshig gi glu dang / 'bol rtsom tsam re gna' dus nas yod mod/ snyan ngag gi mtshan nyid/ rnam grangs/ dper brjod bcas/ kyi yan lag 853

cha tshang ba ni phyis su dar ba yin te/ lo tsā ba chen po shong ston rdo rje rgyatshwamatshan gyis snyan ngag gi rtsa ba me long ma bsgyur ba dang / snyan ngag chen po dpag bsam 'khri shing dang / skyes rabs so ba zhi ba sogs du ma bsgyur/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pas spyang 'gyur bcos dang 'grel ba brtsams pa sogs snyan ngag gi lam 'di ni rgyas par byas/ der brten bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi 'grel ba dang mchan 'grel dper brjod sogs brtsams pa shin tu mang / dper na rin spungs 'jig rten dbang phyug grags pa'i seṅge'i nga ro'i rgyud dang / kun gzigs lnga ba'i dbyangs can dgyes glu/ bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs kyi daṇi'i dgongs rgyan/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas dbyangs can dgyes glu'i don 'grel sogs brtsams/ gzhan yang dge bshes rnams kyis mdo dang sngags kyi yig cha mang bo'i mchod brjod dang bar skabs tshigs bcad sogs snyan ngag gis bcings pa dang 'phrin yīg chab shog dang / gsung mgur sogs snyan ngag gis brgyan pa/ dper na rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho dang kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo'i chab shog khyad par du 'phags pa sogs snyan ngag mkhas pa mang che ba bla ma dge ba'i —bshes gnyen rnams yin no/ / 854

gnyis pa mngon brjod ni/ mngon brjod 'chi mid mdzod yar lung grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba dang / de'i rgya cher 'grel zha lu lo tsā ba dge slong chos skyong bzang bo'i 'gyur dang /bod rang gi mkhas pas brtsams pa mngon brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan dang / mkhas pa'i rna cha sogs yod la mngon brjod 'di ni shin tu mkho che ba'i rig gnas shig go/ /gsum pa sdeb sbyor ni/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas ni/ lo tsā ba chen po byang chub rtse mos bsgyur ba sogs mang bo yod pa dag gi khrid rgyun kyang da lta ma nyams par yod do/ /sde dge'i bstan 'gyur dkar chag las/ rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur legs sbyar nas/ /don la brda krod gzhung gi bstan bcos dang / /de yi yan lag mngon brjod snyan ngag sogs/ /ston pa'i bstan bcos sum cu rtsa dgu bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / bzhi ba skar rtsis ni/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud dang / dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las gsungs pa'i rtsis kyi skor/ bod kyi mkhas pa dag gis gtan la phab ste dar bar byas/ dper na/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i mkhas pa dga' byed dang / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i dus 'khor ṭīka chen dang / rgya mtsho rnalo855

gsum gyis pad dkar zhal lung ma bu sogs dang / sde srid kyis bai dkar/ sum pas dge ldan rtsis gsar/ thu'u bkwan gyis mkhas pa'i snying nor/ brag dgon pa'i rigs ldan mchod pa'i 'od snang brtsams pa sogs dang / sde ba tshang gi 'on po a khu thub bstan gyis rgya nag nas brgyud pa'i rtsis gzhung brtsams pa sogs da lta'i bar du dar zhing rgyas pa ni chos pa rnams kyi drin no/ /lnga ba zlos gar ni/ dge slong lo tsā ba dag gis/ 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar dang / klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar sogs bsgyur/ bod rang gi mkhas pa dag gis/'dul ba lung gi nor bzang gi skyes rabs la brten nas/ chos rgyal nor bzang gi blos gar bzos pa —dang / ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi spyan ras gzigs kyi skyes rabs shig la brten nas dri med kun ldan gyi zlos gar bzos pa dang / paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes sku gzhon nu'i dus su skyes rabs dran tshul gsungs pa la brten nas don yod dang don grubabyukyi zlos gar dang / stag phu gar gyi dbang byug gis sku gzhon nu'i dus su skyes rabs dran tshul gsungs par brten bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i zlos gar bzos pa dang /ka chen ka khol ma dang ma ṇi bka' 'bum la brten nas srong btsan sgam po'i zlos gar bzos pa sogs da lta yang 'phel bzhin 856

yod pa 'di lags la/ 'bag leb gyon zhing smad du tha gu'idhedo shal can lha mo'i zlos gar zhes pa grub chenajithang stong rgya la bos srol btod par grags so/ /de ltar rig gnas che ba lnga dang /chung ba lnga ste bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas zhes grags pa 'di dag ni/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'dzin cing spel ba'irteskyeg dam pa sha stag gis mi nyams gong 'phel du btang ba yin la/mkhas pa paṇa ḍi ta de dag gis dka' spyad dpag tu med pa gnang nas rang rgyud 'dul phyir thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral bar gnang ste/ grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por slebs pa na/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du/ — gzhung lugs ches shin tu mang bo saṃ skṛ ta sogs gzhan gyi skad yig gi thog nas/ bod rang skad du bsgyur ba dang / rang gis brtags shing dpyad nas dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos po ti bcu phrag du ma brtsams pa la brten nas/ gangs ljongs bod kyi rig gnas zhes bya ba'i spyi nor phun sum tshogs pa 'di yod pa yin no/ /sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis dka' spyad sdug rus kyis deng dus su 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir dar ba'i rig pa'i gnas du ma bod gangs can gyi mi'i rigs la yod par byas pa de bzhin du deng dus gsar skyes gzhon nu rnams kyis/ sngar gyi rig gnas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dag lag nas ma 857

sker ba gzhir baṅgegagi sting naso/ gsare dar gyi rig pa mtha' dag bslabs shing sbyangs nas/ rang gi skad yig thog tu bsgyur cing blangs te gzhan la 'gram chu ldang mi dgos par byas nas/bod mi rigs 'di sngar mi grangs nyung rung 'bur du thon pa zhig yin pa ltar/ phyin chad kyang de ltar 'gyur bar byed pa la brtson dgos so/ /'dir smras pa/ phyag na pad+mo'i 'od dkar thigs phreng gis/ /bsil ldan yul gyi mun stug lhag med bcom/ /rig pa kun da gsar ba'i mdzes zhal ngom/ /chos dang srid kyi snang ba dkar bos khyab/ /de lta'i yul gyi dge mtshan 'bum/ /bden gsung dam pa bud dha yis/ /'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las ni/ /'gyur med gsung gi sgra dbyangs bsgrags/ /gna' dus mes po 'bum phrag gi/ /mkhyen rab 'jam dpal dbyangs la za/ /dpa' bo 'bum gyi snying stobs che/ /lag na rdo rje'i dpal la 'khu/ /thabs dang shes rab 'gran pa la/ /mes pos gdong bzhi sprul nas lta/ /rig pa'i me tog rab rgyas par/ /ko ki la yi dbyangs kyis bstod/ /chos srid dpal gyi mdza' na mo/ /bsod ldan bsil ljongs 'gro bas thob/ /dge bcu'i dpal gyi mngal khur bzung / /mngon mtho nges legs gzhon nu btsas/ /858

de yis byang chub ljon shing btsags/ /byang chub spyod pa'i lo ༄'dab rgyas/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu g.yur za bar/ /bsod ldan skyes ba yongs kyis spyod/ /ces spyi nor phan tshogs zhes bya ba ri ri ri ji 'di ni/ chen po 'asa' zhig gi bkas bskul ba bzhin bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas rab gnas lcags rta lo'i hor zla dang bo'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa dang bor sbyar ba'o/ / — —ci 85wa—

—zlu zer rtsom sgrig dag gi zhu ba/rnam par dpyod pa'i zer brgya yis/ /rmongs mun stug po 'joms mdzad pa/ /gu ru mchog gi zhabs skyes rdul/ /byang chub bar du gtsug tu 'dzin/ /'dir zla zer ba dag gi 'dod mos bzhin/ chos sde chen po dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil du mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa ji ltar dar ba'i tshul mdor bsdus te brjod pa la/ bsod nams stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba 'ju nang ching wang gis kun mkhyen chen po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dbus 'gyur chos kyi zhing nas spyan drangs te/ bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi chos sde 'di nyid phyag 'debs mdzad/ gzhung bka' pod chen po lnga'i 'chad nyan dang / gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad sgrub kyi sde btsugs/mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas par gnang ste/ thugs sras mkhas grub chen po bswe ngag dbang bkra shis mchog la bstan pa gtad de bswe ngag dbang bkra shis dpal 860

bzang bos lo sum cu'ijibar du gdan sa bskyangs pajinas bzung gdan rabs gser gyi phreng bas rim par bskyangs/ slar yang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje mchog gi yang sprul kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo mchog gdan sar bkod de/thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin par mdzad/ dgon sde 'di nyid kyi mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa bdag gir mdzad pa dang / tshig rgyugs dang / rtsod rgyurgos 'don rgyugs sogs rgyun ldan du len par mdzad de/ sngar yod kyi 'chad nyan mi nyams gong 'phel du btang / paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes dpal bzang bo'i bka' lung bzhin e waṃ chos 'khor gling phyag 'debs mdzad de 'don rta dbyangs/ gar thig dbyangs gsum sogs dang /sgra snyan ngag sogs rgyugs sprod rgyu btsugs/ gzhan yang rig gnas che ba lnga'i ya gyal gso ba rig pa dar spel gtong dgos dgongs nas gso rig gzhan phan gling phyag 'debs mdzad/dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing sa nas slob dpon spyan drangs te rgyud bzhi cha lag man ngag dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo de nyid kyis/ dbyig gya paṇ+ḍi ta slob dpon du bsten te/ rgyal dbang lngab chen po dang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa nas brgyud pa'i rig 861

gnas sgra snyan ngagaldeb sbyor sogs gsan/ bra sti rin chen don 'grub kyi dngos slob bra lta blo bzang dge legs kyi mdun nas bra snyi rin chen don 'a grub nas brgyud pa'i rig gnas gsan/ mdo smad— 'dir phebs nas/ de skabs si tu paṇa chen rig gnas phyogs la mkhas grags che bas khong dgon pa 'dir gdan 'dren zhus mod/ khong sku na smin pa'i dbang gis phebs ma thub/ slob ma kun dga' sangs rgyas gdan drangs te/ de'i drung nas khong 'jigs med dbang bo slob ma dang bcas pas si tu nas brgyud pa'i rig gnas mtha' dag bslabs te/ dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil 'di rig gnas kyi gter mdzod du gyur nas mdo smad yongs dang / sog yul yan chod kyi rig pa'i gnas kyi 'byung khungs gcig pur gyur to/ /gzhan yang / mdo dbus gtsang gsum gyi bla ma mang bo'i zhal nas grub mtha' ris med nas brgyud pa'i dbang lung man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan te/ gsan yig ma dros klung chen mdzad de dam chos 'chad spel rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad/ tshogs chen 'du khang dardza gser khang chen mo sogs lha khang rten dang brten par bcas pa mang bo bzhengs/ a mchog dgon sogs phyogs yas mas su dgon pa mang bo phyag 'debs mdzad do/ /de bzhin du sku phreng gsum pa 'jigs 862

mid rgya mtsho dang sku phreng bzhi ba rje skal bzang thub bstan dba'ami phyug sku phreng lnga ba 'jam dbyangs ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi bar du dar zhing rgyas mod bar skabs su re zhig rkyen dbang du song na yang / legs bshad las/ mkhas pa re zhig rgud gyur kyang / /de la gduje ba skye mi dgos/ /zla ba re zhig gzas zin yang / /de ma thag tu grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungasatsho ga ltar/ skyabs mgon sku phreng drug pa chen po'i 'phrin las kyi 'od brgya 'bar bar brten/ 'chad nyan dbyar mtsho bzhin rgyas bzhin pa 'di lags so/ / ri 'dir 'chad nyan byed lugs ni/ spyir thos bsam gling la kha dog dpo/ra dmar gyi 'dzin grwa nas/ dka' rams bar 'dzin grwa bcu gsum yod/ chos thog zla chos bzhi dang bar chos bzhi yod/ zla chos ni zla ba gcig gi yun dang bar chos ni nyin nyi shu'i ring 'tshogs pa shas che/ gzhung bka' pod lnga'i 'chad nyan dang rī rtsod pa hor khong du mi lus pa'i sted du bca' yig bzhag yod stabs/ rang rang gi thad kyi gzhung tshad gang yin chos mtshams su blor 'dzin pa dang / rang rang gi dge rgan gyi mdun nas dpe khrid zhu ba dang 'phros pa dogs gcod dpe char lta ba sogs byas te/ chos thog tu 'bel gtam tsod pa byedamo rgyu ga sgrig byas te/86bye

chos thog tu rang rang gi thad ka'i gzhung de'i thog nas rtsod pa — byed cing / dge bskul gyis 'dzin grwa 'og ma rnams/ 'dzin grwa gong mar dam bca' gtong ba dang / 'dzin grwa gong 'og bsres tedzārigs lam brdar sha chod pa yong bar byed/ spyir nyin re la zhogs kha'i chos grwa/ gung tshigs chos grwa/ sku rim ste gsum yod/gung tshigs chos grwa dang / sku rim yar tshogs la/ rang bsam gyis gnyis re cha byas te/ 'dzin grwa gong ma dag tu dam bcar 'gro/ dpon slob khri rin po che skabs 'gar chos grwar phebs te brtsi bzhag gnang / dbyar chos skabs khri rin po che phebs nas lam rim chen mo 'chad/ dbyar chos chen mo'i mjug gi nyin bco lnga'i ring rigs grwa'i tshogame langs pa rnams dam bca' bzhag nas rtsod pa shog chen po gnang / ston chos chen mo'i nang /rtags rigs gsar rtsod/ don bdun cu gsar rtsod/ chos 'khor gsar rtsod de gsar rtsod gsum yod/ de gsum la dam bca' yar gtong mar gtong sogs kyi sgo nas rtsod pa shog chen po byed pa ma zad/ 'dzin grwa res mtshan phud gsum bzhi re byas te rtsod pa brdar sha chod pa byed do/ /'dir chos grwar thog mar zhugs skabs khri rin po cher ngo ston zhus nas/ khri rin po ches dge rgan zhig gnang / dge rgan des zhal ngo / dge bskul 864

be+egs kyi mdun du ngo ston la khrid/ de nas tshogs dang chos grwar zhugs/ khri rin po ches gnang ba'i dge rgan de dang / de las gzhan rang gang la dad pa'i dge bshes re dge rgan du bsteg nas dpe khrid zhu/ rtsod pa sngon song yin na don bdun cu nas zhugs chog de min kha dog dkar dmar 'dzin grwar zhugs/ de nas kha dog gong / bsdus 'bring / bsdus chen tobasdus grwa'i 'dzin grwa bzhi'i skabs su tshad ma rnam 'grelo gyi rigs lamashu spyo —gnad bsdus pa bsdus grwa zhes grags pa de la slob gnyer yongs su rdzogs par byed/ de nas rtags rigs gsar rtsod byas te rtags rigs 'dzin grwar slebs nas rtags rigs blo rig gnyis —la slob gnyer byed/ de nas ston don bdun cu gsar rtsod byas te dgun 'dzin grwa gzhung gsar 'dzin grwar spo/ gzhung gsar/ gzhung gong / skabs dang bo/ skabs bzhi ba ste/ phar phyin 'dzin grwa bzhi'i skabs sgye phar phyin gyi slob gnyer byed/ dgun chos chen mor 'dzin grwa spo skabs/ skabs bzhi ba'i 'dzin grwas phar phyin dam bca' 'jog de nas dbu ma gsar ba dang dbu ma rnying ba'i 'dzin grwa gnyis kyi skabs su dbu ma la slob sto —gnyer 'chad nyan byed/ 'di man gyi 'dzin grwa rnams lo re yin mod/ mdzod 'dzin grwar slebs nas mngon pa mdzod la slob rī byi65

gnyir byed/ 'dzin grwa 'dir lo bzhir bzhugasatsā red/ de nas dka 'a rams su slebs nas 'dul ba la slob gnyer byed/ dpe cha ba bzang shos dag la/ bla brang dang tshogs khri/ rin po che gang rung gis rdo rams pa'i mdud pa 'dogs/ de nas rdo rams pa rnams rgyun du dam bcar 'gro ba sogs chos grwa'i rtsod pa'i 'gan 'khur/ de nas rgan gzhon go rim ltar dbyar dgun gyi rdosnyerams pa'i dam bca' 'jog dam bca' 'jog pa'i gong du bla brang nang du song ste rin po che'i sku mdun nas 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i rgyugs sbod/ 'dzin grwa bcu gsum re rer dam bca' la 'gro dgos/ dbyar yin na rigs grwa'i mjug dang / dgun yin na smon lam gyi mjug tu/ tshogs dbus su gzhung po ti lnga la nyin lngar dam bca' 'jogo dam bca' bzhag tshar nas bla brang gzim chung legs bshad dga' tshal du rin po cher mjal kha zhu zhing /gdan cha'i steng du bzhugs nas blaju brang mos dem cha phul ba bzhes shing rin po che'i zhal snga nas lha dar dang phyag smodud ser bo gnang ste bla ma'i go sa gnang / de gyin chichad dam bca' thon zin pa'i dmigs bsal du sngar bzhin chos grwa chad med byed mi dgos/ de nas rgyud stod smad dus 'khor kyai rdor grwa tshang gang rung du zhugs nas sngags la sbyangs te lo shas nas sngags kyi dam byisgosgo

bca' 'jog cing sngags rams pa'i ming btags len/ de nas rang rang gi yon tan bab 'os sogs dang bstun nas grwa tshang so so'i khri ba dang bla ma dbu mdzad rdo rje 'dzin pa tshogs chen khri sogs la bzhugs pa'i srol yod do/ /gzhung bka' pod lnga sngags dang bcas pa ldoslob gnyer byed pa5gzhir bzung nas bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga las/ dbang rjes gnang man ngag khrid lung sogs nyan pa dang / sgra snyan ngag rtsis sa ris sman sogs bslabs te mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa khong du chud par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis chos sde chen po 'di nyid bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dang / man ngag gi gter mdzod/ rig pa'i gnas kyi 'byung khungs su gyur pa yin no/ /phyogs gzhan gyi chos sde dag gi dbang lung man ngag phyag len dgon sde 'di nas ma brgyud pa med cing / mtshan nyid rig gnas sogs 'di nas ma brgyud pa med pas chu klung mtha' dag 'byung ba'i gnam mtsho chen po ma dros pa lta bur gyur to/ /zhes pa 'di ni zla zer rtsom sgrig gi 'gan 'khur ba dag gis skyes bzang dang bcas bskul ngor/jibasam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas gang dran thol byung du smras pa'o / / 867

rgan po'i snying gtam/mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang dkar rte'i rtse dga' yis/ /'gro ba'i lam gyi smag chen rab bsal te/ / gtan bde'i drung du 'khrid pa'i 'dren pa der/ /dus nalokun tu yan lag mchog gis 'dud/ /chos srid nyi zla zung gi dpa' rtsal gyis / /ljongs 'di'i rmongs pa kun nas rab bcom ste/ /bde skyid pad+mo'i tshal chen rgyas mdzad pa/ /mes po srong btsan sgam po rab tu bsngags/ / phyogs ba cu'i rig pa bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ //rnam dpyod gser gyi 'khor los 'dren mdzad ba/ /yang dag bod ces grags pa de nyid la/ /bsam byed khong nas dus kun brjed ma gyur/ /dkar nag rgya dang li dang bal bo'i yul/ /kha che'i yul sogs dar ba'i yul kun nas/ /868

sna tshogs rig pa mdzes pa'i mi na kā/ /ljongs 'dir 'dren pa'i gyed po rnams la 'dud/ /de lta'i rig pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang bo/ / 'dzin dang spel ba'i rjesaṃ 'jug paṇ+ḍi ta/ / sa steng mdzes pa'i mkhas dbang de dag la/ /blo gros ldan pa'i skye bo su mi gus / /chos srid nyi zla zung gis rab mdzes shing / /lnga phrag rig pa'i chu skyes phung phung g.yo/ / d+kude 'dra'i ljongs la mun nag 'thibs po zhes/ /sgro 'dogs skur 'debs tshig dag ya ma brla/ /mkhas dang grub pas rab gang yul ljongs der/ /gshis rgyud 'jam zhing brtson pa ches che ba'i /skye bo dpa' bos rab gang rigs de dag /gtum po yin zhes dma' 'beb ya ma brla/ /dam chos bdud rtsir rab gus las 'bras la/ /brtsi ba'i lugs de rang gi gshis su grub/ /bden par smra ba'i goms gshis kyis brgyan pa/ /kla klo yin zhes smra ba ya ma brla/ /'on kyang sngon byon dam pas de dus kyi/ /869

rig pa'i nor mchog de dag rab drangs te/ /rig pa'i gter du grub pa'i mkhas dbang gi/ /pha rjes bu yis zin pa shin tu dko na/ / deng dus phyogs bcu'i rig pa gzhon nu dag /khab tu bsu ba'i rjes 'jug skye bo ni/ /nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin du gyur pa dang / / ca co smra ba'i sgra 'dis sa 'di gang / / deng dus phyogs bcu'i rig pa'i za ma tog /'dren pa'i stobs shugs med pa tsam ma zad/ /khyi brgyags bdag por dmur ba'i dbe bzhin du/ /nang dmur ca co'i sgra yis sa 'di gang / /de lta'i gnas babs de dag mthong ba'i tshe /sgam po bdag gi shes pa khong nas 'phyo/ /gzur gnas dkon pa'i gnas tshul de dag gis/ /sgam po'i brtson pa kun nas snyod par gyur/ /bsil ldan bod kyi yul ljongs 'dir/ 'dzam gling spyi'i spyi tshogs yar 'phel gyi rjes su 'brangs te/ rig gnas sogs dar rgyas byung ba'i rim pa mdo tsam glerjod na/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus su dmag las shin tu dar bas mtha' bzhi'i rgyal 870

phran dag dbang du bsdus na'ang / yon tan gyi rtsa ba yi gi mid pa'i dka' tshegs byung stabs/ blon po gnyal thu mi snang grags kyi bu thu mi a nu'am thu mi mi chung zer ba'i blon phrug rig pa can grogs dang bcas pa nub phyogs kyi yul gru chen por mngags te/nā len+d+ra sogs slob grwa chen po dag tu yon tan la sbyangs/ yig rigs du ma mkhyen zhing sgra rig pa sogs la bslabs pas mkhas pa chen por gyur stabs/ sam snyo ṭa'am yang dag pa'i bod ces pa'i mtshan snyan po thob bo/ /mkhas pa de nyid bod gangs can du phyir phebs nas si skṛ ta'i skad la gzhi byas te bod kyi yi ge gtan la phab/ sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos brgyad mdzad/ saṃ skṛ ta'i skad yig las 'dor len byas tshul ni/ saṃ skṛ ta'i skad la dbyangs bcu drug dang / gsal byed so bzhi yod la/ legs par sbyaroba'i skad kyi dbyangs yig bcu drug gi nang nas bod skad la mi mkho ba'i dbyangs yig bcu gcig dor/ dbyangs yig a gsal byed kyi khongs su sbyar/ lhag ma ipo'i e o ste dbyangs bzhi ru nges par mdzad do/ /legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyi gsal byed yi ge so bzhi'i nang nas/ 'thug po lnga dang / log pa bzhi/dro ba gcig mthar zad kyi yi ge gcig bcas gsal byed yi ge bcu gcig bod skad la mi mkho bas dor/ lhag ma gsal byed kyi 871

yi ge nyer gsum dang dbyangs nas blangs pa'i a yig bcas sprer bzhi dang / stod du ca cha ja gsum dang / smad du zha za 'a gsum ste yi ge drug gsar du bsnan nas gsal byed kyi yi ge grangs sum curakhunges par mdzad do/ /des na skad rigs mi gcig pa'i dbyangs gsal dag ji bzhin bkod pa yin zer ba ni tshan rig dang mi mthun pa'i gtam mo/ / bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs su rig gnas dar rgyas— byung ba'i rgya gar nag li yul bal bo kha che sogs nas/ rig gnas sna tshogs sgyur mkhan gyi lo tsā ba ni/ thon mi sam bho ṭa/ dharma kodzi dang / lha lung rdo rje dpal dang / bran ka snyu la kodzi dang /kha che a nan+ta dang / khri bzher saṃ shi ta dang / sprang rgya ra legs gzigs dang / seng gong lha lung gzigs dang / sba ye shes dbang bo dang / ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang / dbas malja shrī dang / pa gor be+e ro tsa na dang / sba rmang rje gsal snang dang / sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms dang / gnyags tsā na ku mā ra dang / lce dzñā na sirnyi dang / mchims shākya pra bha dang / brang ti dza ya rak+ṣi ta dang / shud pu dpal gyi seng ge dang / rtsang sa de ben+d+ra rak+ṣi ta dang / bran ka mu ti ka dang / khon nā gen+d+ra pak+ṣi ta dang / rma rin chen mchog dang / rtsangs sa la'i bu rin chen 87lha

legs grub dang / lharma ā lo ka dang / dran pa nam mkha' dang /risgro rin chen sde dang / rma rnam par mi rtog pa dabhā / rma shākya 'od dang / rtse khyi 'brug dang / rlangs khams pa go cha dang / gnyagaspode wa kodzi dang / zhang rgyal nyen nya bzang dang / 'gos chos grub dang / stod ā tsar+ya dang / snyarma tā shī la dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan dang / ska ba dpal brtsegs bsrung ba dang / zhang ye shes sde dang / rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang / dza ya rak+ṣi ta dang / mazhu shrī warma dang / rasna n+d+ra shī la dang / bzang skyong dang / lha'i zla ba dang / dpal gyi lhun po dang / dpal 'byor dang / ye shertswasnying bo dang / rgyal ba shes rab dang / shākya bshes gnyen dang /dge ba dpal dang / legs pa'i sde dang / gnubs nam mkha'i snying bo dang / yi ge ba dgon gling rma dang / gzhon nu srung ba dang / nam mkha' skyong sogs kyis de skabs su 'dzam gling du dar ba'i gzhung lugs 'bum phrag du ma bsgyur ro/ /de rjes bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su spyi tshogartswayar 'phel gyi dbang gis 'dzam gling du dar ba'i rig pa du ma zhig yod pa yang lo tsā ba dag gis gsar du bsgyur/ de skabs kyi lo tsā ba ni/lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang / lo chen rin chen bzang bo dang / grags 'byor shes rab dang / mgar chos bzang dang / dge 873

tshul khyung grogs dang / bal bo pad+ma rle tsi dang / ba tshab tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang / se tsa bso da nams rgyal mtshan dang / rong ba chos bzang dang / 'bro seng dkar shākya 'od dang / khyung bo chos— brtson dang / rgya brtson 'grus seng ge dang / —nag tsho tshule khrimes rgyal bajidang / rngog legs pa'i shes rab dang / 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang / khyung bo rnal 'byor dang / yol lcags rdo rje‘dbang rgyug dang / rma dge ba'i blo gros dang / gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zerazudang / lha zhi ba 'od dang / khu dngos grub dang /chos kyi shes rab dang / mar thung dad pa shes rab dang / gtong tshul khrims 'byung gnas dang / 'brog mi shākya blo gros dang /'brog mi shākya ye shes dang / stag lo gzhon brtson dang / mar ba chos kyi blo gros dang / 'gos khug pa lhas btsas dang / zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab dang / gnyan dar ma grags dang /rwa rdo rje grags dang / kher gad 'khor lo grags dang / mchings yon tan 'bar dang / spong zho gsol ba grags dang / she'u badz+ra de ba dang / snarab zhi bshes gnyen dang / mar ba do ba chos kyi dbang phyug dang / spu hreng lo chung legs pa'i shes rab dang /gzu dga' ba rdo rje dang / chos kyi yon tan dang / chos kyi rinachen kedang / glog skya shes rab brtsegs dang / ba ri rin chen 874

grags dang / ba tshab nyi ma grags dngaji/ lha btsan po ma 4ra rā dz+rapyidang / ding ri chos grags dang / rgyus smon lam grags dang / mang 'or byang chub shes rab dang / mal gyos blo gros grags dang / gyi ljangs dbu dkar dang / 'bro shes rab grags dang / ba reg thos pa dga' dang / rma chos 'bar dang / mtshur dbyig gi rgyal mtshan dang / rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags dang / sga lo gzhon nu dpal dang / tre bo shes rab dpal dang / mtshuracaston dbang gi rdo rje dang / rwa chos rab dang / dpyal kun dga' rdo rje dang /dpyal kun dga' grags pa dang / zhang shes rab bla ma dang /bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang / chos kyi snying bo dang / ka ma chos kyi ye shes dang / phyug mtshams dbang phyug rgya mtsho dang / tshul khrims yon tan dang / kher gad yon tan dpal dang / bsod nams bzang bo dang / sum bha dpal mchog dbang bo'i rdo rje dang / nyi ma rdo rje dang / khu dge bsnyen de tso dang / glog skya gzhon nu 'bar dang / lha ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / byang chub 'byung gnas dang / glan chos kyi blo gros dang / cog gru ting 'dzin bzang bo dang / shes rab ye shes dang / reg pa gzhon nu dang / gzhon tshul dang / khu mdo sde 'bar dang / steng lo tshul khrims 'byung gnas dang / shes rab brtson 'grus dang / 875

g.yung drung 'od dang / bsod nams rgyal ba dang / cog gru tshoshes rab bla ma dang / cog gru mya ngan med dang / bsod nams mos pa dang / tshul khrims brtsegs dang / rngog buṣ+ka pā li ta dang / rgyal lo tsā ba dang / sbal rdo rje rgyal bo dang / lha rin chen dang / lha chos kyi rin chen dang / ca ra tshul khrims 'od zer dang / dge slong bya'i gdong can dang / dpyid lo tsā ba dang / phur bu 'od dang / shes rab legs dang / nag tsho dharma grags dang / mar ba blo gros bzang bo dang / se lo tsā ba dang / rong glong lo tsā dang / sho rim lo tsā dang / zla ba grags pa dang / gnyal mi ye shes chos dang / chos kyi zla ba dang / shes rab skyabs dang /nag tsho shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / 'a zha rgya gar brtsegs dang / gnyan bsod nams dang / ba ri chos grags dang / ong bo lo tsā dang / gzhon nu shes rab dang / mgar shes 'byung dang /'jam dpal gzhon nu dang / shes rab 'od zer dang / lce dga' ba da pal dang / ye shes 'byung gnas dang / shākya brtson 'grus dang / lo rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / zham dge bsnyen seng rgyal dang / lce bkra shis dang / chag dgra bcom dang / dpyal chos bzang dang / dkar lo tsā ba dang / zhang dge ba dang / gnubs byams pa'i dpal dang / chag chos rje dpal dang / dpyal shes 876

rab 'od dang / zhang grub pa dpal dang / sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / glo bo shes rab rin chen dang / lho brag pa 'u ru dar ma seng ge dang / mi mnyam bzang bo dang / o rgyan pa rin chen dpal dang / shong rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / shong blo gros brtan pa dang / khams pa blo gros rgyal ba dang / 'dan ma tshul seng dang / ra sa gzhon brtson dang / shud ge grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang / dpang blo gros brtan pa dang / sgra tshad pa rin rgyal dang / dbus pa blo gsal dang / stag lung ba shākya bzang bo dang / legs pa'i blo gros dang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang / thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal dang / jo nang lo tsā ba blo gros dpal dang / sa bzang ba blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / 'bri khung lo tsā ba dang / kun spangs grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / yar lo grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / lo chen byang chub rtse mo dang / bo dong grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / snar thang pa sesne shrī dang / lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang dang / chos 'khor sgang ba shes rab rin chen dang / 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal dang / khrims khang ba bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / chag lo rin chen chos rgyal dang / zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang bo dang / jo nang lo tsā ba 877

tā ra na tha dang / 'dar lo ngag dbang phunasatshogs dang / rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po dang / smin grol gling ba snyarma shrī dang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang / bdag gi bla ma oṃ 'khyil ba 'jam dbyangs legs bshad sogs lo tsā ba dag gis dus skabs der spyi tshogs yar 'phel gyi dbang gis gsar du dar ba'i rig gnas dag gangs can bod kyi skad du bsgyur ba mdzad do/ /deng skabs 'jig rten 'dir spyi tshogs yar 'phel gyi dbang gis gsar du dar ba'i rig gnas dang 'phrul las sogs shin tu mang stabs de dag bsgyur ba'i las 'gan ni rang re rjes nejug dag la rag las pa'i khur chen de ni nges par du 'khur dgos mod/ deng skabs kyi gnas tshul la bltas na khur chen de 'khur mkhan shin tu nyung zhing / phran bu rer sbyangs pa dag gis mdung kha nang skor gyis bod rang gi rig gnas dag dma' 'beb byed pa mang bar gyur to/ /gzur gnas blo ldan dag gis deng dus su spyi tshogs yar 'phel gyi dbang gis dar ba'i mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas po ti bcu phrag khajishas bsgyur ba la brtson par rigs so/ /de ltar lo tsā ba snga ma dag gi yon tan la 'gran par bya'o/ / smras pa/ rnam par dpyod pa'i chu skyes las byung ba'i/ /878

yon tan sprang rtsi gsar ba'i zel mngar gyis/ /rang rigs ra yig gnyis pa tshims byas te/ / rig pa'i dbyangs snyan dar dir sgrog par shog /ces pa 'di'ang bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas1991lo'i zla5ba'i tshes 26nyin sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni dge tshul bslab gsum rgya mtsho'o/ /879
